A NIGHT DAT ARRIVES EARLY

A TRACK WORN INTO DA MOSS

AIR WARM ENOUGH TA OPEN A VISOR IN
hazard: DA CALM ENDIN' WITOUT NOTICE
A DOWNDRAUGHT WIT NO FLOOR
DA TEMPTATION TA GO LOWER

A MOORIN' MAST WIT NUTTIN' MOORED
A WINDSOCK, STILL TURNIN'

n0.text:
{SENSORS PICKED UP A WEIRD GROWTH AT {place}. IT IZ SPREADIN' FAST IN AN INWARD SPIRAL, COVERIN' NINE HECTARES, AN' {instrument} SAYS IT IZ ALREADY DOUBLED IN SIZE.|DERE IZ A MASSIVE, AGGRESSIVE ORGANISM GROWIN' AT {place}. IT IZ CLOSIN' INWARD LIKE A TIGHTENIN' KNOT, AN' {instrument} SHOWS IT IZ EXPANDIN' AT AN ALARMIN' RATE.}
DA SPIRAL HAB BIN TIGHTENIN' AT A CONSTANT RATE, WHICH MEANS IT STARTED SOMEWHERE, ON A DAY, AN' DA DAY CAN BE WORKED OUT!

choices.text: {WALK TA DA CENTRE|HEAD INTO DA MIDDLE|PUSH TOWARD DA CORE|ADVANCE TA DA CENTER} OF DA SPIRAL!
{TAKE A SAMPLE|COLLECT A SPECIMEN|SCRAPE OFF A SAMPLE|BAG A PIECE} FROM DA EDGE!
{BURN A FIREBREAK|TORCH DA PERIMETER|IGNITE A CONTROLLED BURN|DROP A THERMAL LINE} AN' WATCH WHAT IT DOES!

n0.emText: {SOMETINK'S GROWIN' AT {place} IN A TIGHT SPIRAL DAT CLOSES INWARD. IT IZ DA ONLY LIVIN' TINK ON DA ENTIRE ROCK, AN' IT IZ EXPANDIN' WAY TOO FAST FOR COMFORT.|YOU RECOGNIZE DIS PATTERN-IT IZ AN AGGRESSIVE GROWTH ENCLOSIN' SOMETINK AT DA CENTER. WHATEVER'S IN DA MIDDLE, IT IZ DEFINITELY TRAPPED.}
n0.bubba: BUBBA WILL NO STEP ON IT. "IT IZ GROWED ITSELF INWARD, SUGAR. ROBA CA SE CHIUDE 'NCOPPA A QUACCOSA. SOMETHIN'S IN DERE."

a.text: DA GROWTH GETS {DENSER AN' QUIETER|THICKER AN' QUIETER} TOWARDS DA MIDDLE. {AT DA CORE, DA GROWTH HAB ENVELOPED A SOLID OBJECT|IN DA DEAD CENTER, DA BIOMASS HAB SEALED AROUND AN ALIEN RELIC|AT DA MIDDLE OF DA SPIRAL SITS AN ENCASED METAL ARTIFACT} DAT IT DID NO GROW, AN' HAB BIN CAREFUL 'BOUT IT!

choices.text: CUT IT OUT.
LEAVE IT AN' LOG DA POSITION!

a.emText:
DA GROWTH GOES QUIET TOWARDS DA MIDDLE, DA WAY A STREET GOES QUIET OUTSIDE A HOSPITAL.
AT DA CENTRE IT HAB GROWN AROUND A TINK IT DID NO GROW, PATIENTLY, OVER YEARS, DA WAY A HEDGE GROWS ROUND A BICYCLE. WHATEVER IZ IN DERE HAB BIN KEPT DA WAY YOU KEEP A WALLET IN AN INSIDE POCKET ON A BAD STREET!

b.text:
{DA SAMPLE FIGHTS DA KNIFE.|DA SAMPLE ARGUES WIT DA KNIFE.} IT IZ UNWILLIN'.
IN DA TUBE IT GOES ON MOVIN', AN' BY DA TIME DA TEAM IZ BACK AT DA LANDER IT HAB ARRANGED ITSELF INTO DA SAME SPIRAL, {ONE CENTIMETRE|A CENTIMETRE|HALF AN INCH} ACROSS!

choices.text: KEEP IT ABOARD.
PUT IT BACK WHERE IT CAME FROM!

c.text:
DA FIREBREAK BURNS {A CLEAN LINE|A CLEAN LANE} ACROSS DA SPIRAL'S ARM.
DA GROWTH DOES NO TRY TA CROSS IT. IT GOES ROUND, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, AN' MEETS ITSELF BEHIND DA AWAY TEAM IN UNDER {few} MINUTES!

choices.text: STAND AN' FIGHT IT BACK TA DA LANDER!
DROP EVERYTINK AN' RUN.

a1.text: IT COMES FREE IN {A WET HANDFUL|A WET DOUBLE HANDFUL} OF STEMS AN' WHAT IZ INSIDE HAB BIN KEPT ALIVE, {ON PURPOSE|DELIBERATELY}, BY SOMETINK WIT NO REASON TA KEEP ANYTINK ALIVE!

a2.text: DA TEAM BACKS OUT ALONG ITS OWN TRAIL. BEHIND DEM DA SPIRAL CLOSES OVER DA GAP AT WALKIN' PACE, AN' DA CENTRE IZ {EXACTLY|PRECISELY} WHERE IT WAZ, AN' {EXACTLY|PRECISELY} AS HIDDEN!

b1.text: SEALED, MONITORED, AN' WORTH {A GREAT DEAL|A GOOD DEAL|RATHER A LOT} TA DA RIGHT LABORATORY. DA SHIP'S BIOLOGY BAY IZ A LIVELIER PLACE DEN IT WAZ, AN' {NOBODY|NO ONE} SLEEPS QUITE AS WELL!

b2.text:
IT IZ TAKEN BACK AN' SET DOWN AT DA EDGE, AN' DA WHOLE SPIRAL SHIFTS A METRE TOWARDS DA LANDER {AN' DEN|DEN|AN' AFTER DAT} STOPS, WHICH EVERYONE AGREES TA RECORD AS WIND.
SOMETINK'S LEFT ON {ground} WHERE DA SAMPLE LAY!

c1.text: {IT IZ NO A PLANT|WHATEVER IT IZ, IT IZ NO A PLANT} AN' IT DOES NO BURN A SECOND TIME!

c2.text:
{EVERYONE GETS ABOARD.|EVERYBODY GETS ABOARD.} DA SAMPLE KITS, DA CUTTER AN' ONE BOOT DO NO.
{leader} IZ LAST UP DA LADDER AN' DOES NO LOOK BACK, AN' SAYS AFTERWARDS DAT IT WAZ SEEIN' DEM OFF!

c_m.text:
DA FIREBREAK BURNS {A CLEAN LINE|A CLEAN LANE} ACROSS DA SPIRAL'S ARM AN' DA GROWTH DOES NO TRY TA CROSS IT. IT GOES ROUND, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, AN' MEETS ITSELF.
WHAT DAT LEAVES IZ A RING OF UNBURNT GROUND IN DA MIDDLE WIT DA GROWTH SEALED OUTSIDE IT, AN' DA RING IZ {NINE METRES|'BOUT TEN METRES|A GOOD SIZE} ACROSS, AN' NUTTIN' IN IT IZ MOVIN'!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{WE HAB JUST BUILT IT A WALL.|IT LET US DO DAT.|A GOOD STRETCH OF SOMEWHERE IT NO CAN GO, AN' IT IZ NO TRYIN'.}"
asides.any: {member} {WALKS DA BURN LINE ONCE, ALL DA WAY ROUND|WATCHES DA RING RATHER DEN DA FIRE|PUTS DA TORCH DOWN}

choices.text: WALK INTO DA RING.
BURN DA WHOLE TINK, RING INCLUDED!
WORK OUT WHEN DA SPIRAL STARTED!

c_ring.text:
INSIDE DA RING DA GROUND IZ {BARE|CLEAN|SCOURED}, AN' IN DA MIDDLE OF IT DERE IZ A HOLLOW DA EXACT SHAPE OF SOMETINK DAT IZ NO LONGER IN IT.
DA GROWTH OUTSIDE DA LINE STOPS GROWIN' DAT NIGHT. ALL OF IT, EVERYWHERE, AT ONCE, WHICH IZ HOW DA PARTY LEARNS DAT DA SPIRAL WAZ NEVER DA ORGANISM: IT WAZ {DA SEARCH|DA DIGGIN'|WHAT DA ORGANISM DOES WHEN IT IZ LOOKIN' FOR SOMETINK}!

c_date.text:
GROWTH RATE AGAINST DA INWARD PITCH OF DA SPIRAL GIVES A DATE, AN' DA DATE IZ {YEARS AN' YEARS AGO|DA SPRING OF A YEAR DA PARTY CAN NAME|A SPECIFIC WEEK}, AN' DA SURVEY RECORD FOR DIS ROCK HAB AN ENTRY FOR DAT WEEK.
DA ENTRY IZ A LANDIN'. ONE VESSEL, DA BEST PART OF A WEEK, AN' A DEPARTURE DAT IZ LOGGED AS HAVIN' TAKEN OFF {FOUR HOURS|SOME HOURS|A WHILE} LATER DEN DA VESSEL'S OWN LOG SAYS IT DID!

n0.text:
DA TRANSMISSION IZ A VOICE, IN A LANGUAGE DA SHIP'S TABLES GET TA EIGHTY PER CENT OF, AN' IT IZ ASKIN' FOR HELP BY NAME, AN' DA NAME IZ {leader}'S.
DA SOURCE IZ A SHELTER AT {place}, DUG IN AGAINST {hazard} AN' HOLDIN' PRESSURE.
DERE IZ A SECOND SURVIVAL BEACON IN DA KIT AN' IT HAB NEVER BIN SWITCHED ON, WHICH TAKES {A DECISION|DECIDIN'|SOMEBODY DECIDIN'} RATHER DEN AN ACCIDENT!

choices.text: KNOCK.
CUT DA POWER TA DA SHELTER FIRST!
ASK IT HOW IT KNOWS DA NAME!

n0.emText:
DA VOICE IZ ASKIN' FOR HELP BY NAME, AN' DA NAME IZ YA, AN' IT IZ USING DA ONE DAT ONLY EIGHT PER CENT OF YOU CAN HEAR PROPERLY.
DA TABLES GET IT TA EIGHTY PER CENT. DA OTHER TWENTY PER CENT IZ A SOUND LIKE SOMEBODY SAYIN' A WORD INTO A COAT. IT HAB BIN SAYIN' IT FOR A LONG TIME OUT OF A SHELTER DA SIZE OF A BUS STOP ON A WORLD WIT NO BUS ROUTES!
n0.bubba: "IT IZ SAYIN' YA NAME," SAYS BUBBA, REAL QUIETLY, ON DA LADDER. "NUN RISPUNNERE SUBITO. LET IT SAY IT TWICE."

a.text:
{DA DOOR CYCLES BEFORE ANYONE TOUCHES IT.|DA DOOR CYCLES BEFORE A HAND GOES NEAR IT.} INSIDE IZ ONE ROOM, ONE CHAIR, ONE LIGHT, AN' A PERSON IN A SUIT {TWO GENERATIONS|A GENERATION|THREE GENERATIONS} OUT OF DATE SITTIN' WIT DEY BACK TA DA DOOR.
DEY DO NO TURN AROUND. DEY SAY DEY HAB BIN PRACTISIN' DIS FOR {A LONG TIME|A GOOD WHILE|LONGER DEN ANYBODY SAYS}!

choices.text: SIT DOWN AN' LISTEN.
TURN DA CHAIR AROUND.

b.text:
{DA TEAM TRACES DA FEED AN' PULLS IT.|DA TEAM FOLLOWS DA FEED BACK AN' PULLS IT.} DA SHELTER GOES DARK; DA VOICE DOES NO STOP.
IT HAB NO BIN USING DA SHELTER'S POWER FOR A {REAL|REMARKABLY} LONG TIME. {IT IZ BEING POLITE.|IT HAB BIN BEING POLITE.}

choices.text: GO IN ANYWAY.
STRIP DA SHELTER FOR PARTS AN' LEAVE!

c.text:
DA QUESTION GETS {A LONG PAUSE|A REAL LONG PAUSE}, AT LEAST DAT PART WAZ HONEST.
DEN: IT DOES NO KNOW DA NAME. IT KNOWS DA SHAPE OF WHOEVER IZ LISTENIN', AN' IT FITS A NAME TA IT. IT HAB BIN FITTIN' NAMES TA LISTENERS {SINCE BEFORE DIS WORLD HAB AN ATMOSPHERE|SINCE BEFORE DERE WAZ AIR ON DIS WORLD}!

choices.text: ASK WHAT IT WANTS.
STOP TRANSMITTIN'. WALK AWAY!

a1.text:
IT TAKES {AN HOUR|DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR|HALF A SHIFT}. DEY WAZ ON A SURVEY DAT NEVER FILED, DEY HAB BIN ALONE SINCE BEFORE DA PARTY WAZ BORN, AN' DEY IZ NO ASKIN' TA BE RESCUED. {DEY IZ ASKIN' TA BE REMEMBERED.|WHAT DEY IZ ASKIN' FOR IZ TA BE REMEMBERED.}
DEY GIVE {leader} EVERYTINK DEY HAB LEFT, WHICH IZ NO MUCH, AN' IT IZ MORE DEN DA SHIP DESERVES!

a2.text: {DA SUIT IZ EMPTY|DERE IZ NOBODY IN DA SUIT} AN' HAB BIN EMPTY FOR A {REAL|REMARKABLY} LONG TIME, AN' DA VOICE KEEPS TALKIN' OUT OF DA CHAIR, OUT OF DA WALLS, OUT OF DA AWAY TEAM'S OWN HELMETS!

b1.text: INSIDE IZ {lots} YEARS OF SOMEBODY'S HANDWRITIN' ON {EVERY FLAT SURFACE|EVERY FLAT SURFACE IN DA PLACE}, AN' AT DA END OF IT, IN DA LAST CLEAR SPACE BY DA DOOR, AN APOLOGY ADDRESSED TA WHOEVER CAME!

b2.text: GOOD HARDWARE, WELL MAINTAINED, AN' DA TEAM IZ UP AN' AWAY IN {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|AN HOUR AN' A HALF|A COUPLE OF HOURS}. DA VOICE IZ STILL ON DA BAND WHEN DA SHIP MAKES ITS BURN OUT OF ORBIT!

c1.text: IT WANTS WHAT IT HAB ALWAYS WANTED, AN' IT EXPLAINS DIS AT LENGTH, AN' NONE OF IT SURVIVES DA TRIP BACK UP AS ANYTINK DA CREW CAN REPEAT. WHAT SURVIVES IZ IN {leader}'S HANDS, AN' {NOBODY|NO ONE} REMEMBERS BEING HANDED IT!

c2.text: {DA BAND GOES QUIET.|DA BAND GOES FLAT AN' QUIET.} DA TEAM WALKS BACK ACROSS {ground} IN A SILENCE DAT EVERYBODY IZ GRATEFUL FOR, AN' DA SHELTER DOES NO CALL AFTER DEM, WHICH IZ SOMEHOW DA UNKINDEST PART!

a1_m.text:
IT TAKES {AN HOUR|DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR|TWO HOURS}. DEY WAZ ON A SURVEY DAT NEVER FILED, DEY HAB BIN ALONE SINCE BEFORE DA PARTY WAZ BORN, AN' DEY IZ NO ASKIN' TA BE RESCUED.
WHAT DEY IZ ASKIN' FOR TAKES ANOTHER {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|QUARTER OF AN HOUR|WHILE} TA ARRIVE AT, COZ DEY HAB NO HAB TA PHRASE IT FOR ANYBODY BEFORE AN' DA PHRASIN' KEEPS COMIN' OUT AS {AN APOLOGY|AN EXCUSE|A LIST OF REASONS}!

asides.nurturing: {member} HAB MOVED A CHAIR ACROSS DA FLOOR WITOUT ANYBODY HEARIN' IT AN' IZ SITTIN' WHERE DA LIGHT IZ!
asides.any: {member} {CHECKS DA SUIT'S OWN CLOCK AN' LETS IT RUN|DOES NO INTERRUPT|KEEPS DEY HANDS WHERE DEY CAN BE SEEN}

choices.text: LET DEM FINISH. HOWEVER LONG IT TAKES!
ASK 'BOUT DA SECOND BEACON!
READ DA SUIT BEFORE BELIEVIN' ANY OF IT!

a1_beacon.text:
DA SECOND BEACON HAB NEVER BIN SWITCHED ON COZ SWITCHIN' IT ON IZ DA END OF DA ARRANGEMENT, AN' DA ARRANGEMENT IZ DA ONLY TINK OUT HERE DAT HAB BIN KEEPIN' TA ITS SIDE.
WHAT DA ARRANGEMENT IZ TAKES {NINE MINUTES|DA REST OF DA HOUR|A WHILE} TA EXPLAIN AN' IZ NO MADNESS, WHICH IZ DA PART DAT COSTS EVERYBODY SLEEP. IT IZ ALSO, IN ITS OWN TERMS, {HOLDIN'|WORKIN'|ENTIRELY STABLE}, AN' DA PARTY IZ NOW DA THIRD PARTY TA IT!

a1_suit.text:
DA SUIT IZ {TWO GENERATIONS|A GENERATION|THREE GENERATIONS} OLD AN' DA PERSON IN IT IZ DA RIGHT SHAPE FOR IT AN' IZ BREATHIN' AT DA RIGHT RATE AN' IZ, ON EVERY READIN' ANYBODY CAN TAKE THROUGH A FACEPLATE, ALIVE.
DA TINK DAT IZ WRONG IZ DA HANDS. DEY HAB BIN IN DA SAME POSITION FOR DA WHOLE HOUR, INCLUDIN' THROUGH {TWO|THREE} GESTURES DAT SHOULD HAB MOVED DEM, AN' ONCE DAT IZ NOTICED DA CONVERSATION ENDS REAL QUICKLY ON BOTH SIDES!

c1_m.text:
IT WANTS WHAT IT HAB ALWAYS WANTED, AN' IT EXPLAINS DIS AT LENGTH, AN' 'BOUT {TWO THIRDS|HALFWAY|MOST OF DA WAY} THROUGH DA EXPLANATION IT STOPS AN' ASKS WHETHER DA PARTY WOULD PREFER DA SHORT VERSION.
DA SHORT VERSION IZ {A COUPLE OF WORDS|ONE SENTENCE|REAL SHORT}. DA LONG ONE HAB BIN RUNNIN' FOR {YEARS|A REAL LONG TIME|LONGER DEN DA SHELTER HAB BIN HERE} AN' HAB NO BIN HEARD BY ANYBODY!

choices.text: DA LONG VERSION. ALL OF IT!
DA SHORT VERSION.
NEITHER. ASK WHAT IT WOULD TAKE TA MAKE IT STOP WANTIN' IT!

c1_short.text:
FOUR WORDS, AN' DEY IZ ORDINARY WORDS IN AN ORDINARY ORDER, AN' NONE OF DA AWAY TEAM CAN REPEAT DEM AFTERWARDS TA ANYBODY INCLUDIN' EACH OTHER.
WHAT SURVIVES DA TRIP BACK UP IZ IN {leader}'S HANDS AN' IZ REAL LIL' AN' IZ WARM. DA BAND IZ QUIET ALL DA WAY TA ORBIT, WHICH IZ DA FIRST TIME IT HAB BIN QUIET SINCE DA SHIP ARRIVED!

c1_stop.text:
NOBODY HAB ASKED IT DAT. IT TAKES {A LONG PAUSE|A REAL LONG PAUSE|DA LONGEST PAUSE OF DA AFTERNOON} TA ANSWER, AN' DA ANSWER IZ A CONDITION, AN' DA CONDITION IZ LIL' AN' SPECIFIC AN' CAN ACTUALLY BE MET BY FOUR PEOPLE WIT A SHUTTLE.
IT IZ MET. DA SHELTER GOES QUIET {DAT EVENIN'|WITHIN DA HOUR|BEFORE DA SHIP LIFTS} AN' STAYS QUIET, AN' DA BAND IT WAZ USING IZ CLEAR FOR DA FIRST TIME IN {YEARS|A DECADE|A LONG WHILE}!

choices.text: CUT INTO DA PRESSURE HULL!
FOLLOW DA CABLE RUNNIN' OUT OF DA WRECK!
STRIP DA WRECK AN' LEAVE.

n0.emText:
A DISTRESS CARRIER DAT HAB OUTLIVED TWO POWER PLANTS, RUNNIN' OUT OF A HULL LYING ON {ground} LIKE A PIECE OF JUNK DUMPED ON DA ROCKS.
IT IZ REAL TIDY INSIDE. DAT IZ DA TINK 'BOUT WRECKS DAT HAB BIN THOUGHT 'BOUT: DEY IZ ALWAYS TIDIER DEN DA PEOPLE WHO LEFT DEM!
n0.bubba: BUBBA PATS DA HULL LIKE A MAN PATTIN' A HORSE. "SHE'S BIN DEAD A LONG TIME AN' SHE'S STILL HOLLERIN'. OVERO? DAT IZ SOMEBODY'S MAMMA CALLIN' 'EM IN FOR TEA."

a.text: {YOU TORCH THROUGH DA MAIN HATCH.|CUTTIN' THROUGH DA EMERGENCY AIRLOCK REVEALS DA CARGO DECK.|PRYIN' DA BLAST DOORS OPEN GIVES ACCESS TA DA HOLD.} {DA INTERIOR SMELLS OF STALE NITROGEN AN' RUSTED PLATIN'.|DEAD ELECTRONICS AN' FROZEN CONDENSATION COAT EVERY SURFACE.|EMERGENCY LIGHTIN' FLICKERS IN DA GLOOM.}

choices.text: OPEN DA LOCKER.
TAKE DA LOG RECORDER AN' GO!

b.text: {CLIMBIN' INTO DA UPPER SUPERSTRUCTURE BRINGS YOU TA DA TRANSMITTER MAST.|DA ACCESS LADDER LEADS DIRECTLY TA DA BEACON HOUSIN'.|YOU SCRAMBLE UP DA OUTER HULL TOWARD DA ANTENNA ARRAY.} {DA BEACON IZ BUZZIN' LOUDLY, RADIATIN' A GREASY ELECTROMAGNETIC FIELD.|SPARKS SPIT FROM DA DAMAGED DISH.|DA TRANSMITTER IZ RUNNIN' HOT DESPITE DA SUB-ZERO COLD.}

choices.text: CUT DA MAST DOWN AN' TAKE DA CORE!
POINT DA MAST AT DA SHIP AN' LISTEN!

c.text:
DA TEAM WORKS DA WRECK DA WAY A WRECK IZ MEANT TA BE WORKED: PANELS OFF, CELLS OUT, ANYTINK WIT A SERIAL NUMBER INTO DA BAGS. {IT GOES QUICKLY.|IT GOES QUICKLY ENOUGH.}
HALFWAY THROUGH, {instrument} SHOWS {A SECOND HEAT SOURCE|A SECOND SOURCE OF HEAT} UNDER DA HULL!

choices.text: DIG IT OUT.
TAKE WHAT IZ IN DA BAGS AN' LIFT!

a1.text: {DA SEAL GIVES.|DA SEAL LETS GO.} WHATEVER DA CREW SHUT IN DERE HAB BIN WAITIN' WIT DA PATIENCE OF A TINK DAT DOES NO NEED TA BREATHE, AN' IT COMES OUT AT {leader} FIRST!

a2.text:
DA RECORDER COMES OUT WIT ITS CASIN' INTACT. TWO HUNDRED HOURS OF WATCH REPORTS, {AN' DEN|DEN|AN' AFTER DAT} ONE VOICE, ON DA LAST DAY, SAYIN' DAT DA SHIP IZ NO WHERE DA SHIP THINKS IT IZ.
{NOBODY|NO ONE} OPENS DA LOCKER. DA TEAM IZ BACK ABOARD INSIDE DA HOUR!

b1.text: DA CORE COMES OUT OF DA MAST {IN ONE PIECE|WHOLE|IN A SINGLE PIECE}, HEAVIER DEN IT HAB ANY BUSINESS BEING, AN' DA DISTRESS CARRIER STOPS DA MOMENT IT IZ CLEAR OF DA HOUSIN'. DA SILENCE AFTERWARDS IZ DA LOUDEST TINK ON DA RECORDIN'!

b2.text:
TURNED AROUND, DA MAST PLAYS BACK DA LAST {many} SECONDS OF EVERYTINK DA AWAY TEAM HAB SAID, IN DEY OWN VOICES, BEFORE DEY HAB FINISHED SAYIN' IT.
{leader} CALLS DA WALK SHORT. DA TEAM COMES UP SHAKEN AN' ONE OF DEM WILL NO TALK 'BOUT IT!

c1.text: UNDER DA HULL IZ A REACTOR {DA SIZE OF A BARREL|NO BIGGER DEN A BARREL}, STILL LIT, STILL GOVERNED, AN' SALVAGE OF DAT QUALITY DOES NO COME ALONG {TWICE|TWO SEPARATE TIMES} IN A CAREER!

c2.text: DA BAGS COME UP HEAVY WIT {CELLS, PLATE AN' CABLE|CELLS, PLATE, CABLE}. {NOBODY|NO ONE} LOOKS AT DA SECOND HEAT SOURCE AGAIN, AN' DA SHIP IZ OUT OF DA SYSTEM BEFORE ANYBODY DECIDES DEY SHOULD HAB!

c1_m.text:
UNDER DA HULL IZ A REACTOR {DA SIZE OF A BARREL|NO BIGGER DEN A BARREL}, STILL LIT, STILL GOVERNED, AN' SALVAGE OF DAT QUALITY DOES NO COME ALONG {TWICE|TWO SEPARATE TIMES} IN A CAREER.
IT IZ ALSO BOLTED THROUGH DA SHIP, INTO WHATEVER IZ UNDER IT, BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB DA TOOLS AN' DA TIME AN' DID IT {AFTER|WELL AFTER|A LONG TIME AFTER} DA CRASH!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY MOORED A REACTOR TA DIS ROCK.|DAT IZ AN INSTALLATION.|BOLTED DOWN. AFTER. TINK 'BOUT DAT.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A LIGHT ON DA BOLTS|STEPS BACK A PACE WITOUT DECIDIN' TA|COUNTS DA FIXINGS}

choices.text: CUT DA BOLTS AN' TAKE IT.
READ DA INSTALLATION BEFORE TOUCHIN' IT!
LEAVE IT LIT. TAKE DA BAGS AN' LIFT!

c1_read.text:
DIS IZ A POWER STATION: DA REACTOR FEEDS A RUN OF CABLE DAT GOES DOWN INTO DA GROUND, AN' DA RUN IZ {FOUR HUNDRED METRES|A LONG WAY|FURTHER DEN DA SURVEY COVERS} AN' IZ STILL CARRYIN'.
WHATEVER IZ AT DA OTHER END HAB HAB POWER FOR AS LONG AS DIS WRECK HAB BIN HERE. DA PARTY CAN TAKE DA REACTOR, OR FOLLOW DA CABLE, AN' DERE IZ NO HONEST WAY TA DO BOTH IN DA DAYLIGHT AVAILABLE!

c1_arc.text:
DA FIRST BOLT COMES OFF FINE. DA SECOND ONE IZ A CONDUCTOR, AN' IT HAB BIN AT POTENTIAL FOR {YEARS|A REAL LONG TIME|DA WHOLE OF DA WRECK'S STAY HERE}.
DA ARC TAKES DA CUTTER, DA GLOVE AN' 'BOUT {FOUR HOURS|DA REST OF DA SHIFT|HALF A DAY} OUT OF EVERYBODY'S AFTERNOON. DA REACTOR STAYS EXACTLY WHERE IT IZ, HUMMIN', UNIMPRESSED!

b1_m.text:
DA CORE COMES OUT OF DA MAST {IN ONE PIECE|WHOLE|IN A SINGLE PIECE}, HEAVIER DEN IT HAB ANY BUSINESS BEING, AN' DA DISTRESS CARRIER STOPS DA MOMENT IT IZ CLEAR OF DA HOUSIN'.
DA SILENCE AFTERWARDS IZ {A BREATH OR TWO|A FEW SECONDS|BRIEF}, AN' DEN DA MAST STARTS AGAIN, ON DA SAME CARRIER, WIT NO CORE IN IT!

choices.text: TAKE DA CORE AN' GO. QUICKLY!
FIND OUT WHAT IZ DRIVIN' DA MAST NOW!
PUT DA CORE BACK.

b1_drive.text:
NUTTIN' ON DA SHIP IZ DRIVIN' IT. DA MAST IZ BEING DRIVEN FROM {SOMEWHERE ELSE|OFF-HULL|A BEARIN'}, AN' DA BEARIN' IZ {A HUNDRED AN' ELEVEN DEGREES|FIXED|CONSTANT} AN' DOES NO MOVE WIT DA SKY, WHICH MEANS IT IZ NO ORBITAL AN' IT IZ NO FAR.
DAT BEARIN' IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA CORE, AN' DA PARTY HAB BOTH, AN' DA WALK BACK TA DA SHUTTLE IZ DONE FACIN' DA RIGHT WAY DA ENTIRE TIME!

b1_back.text:
DA CORE GOES BACK INTO DA HOUSIN' AN' SEATS WIT {A CLICK|A NOISE|A SOUND} DAT IZ FAR TOO SATISFIED FOR A PIECE OF HARDWARE.
DA CARRIER CHANGES. IT IZ DA SAME SIGNAL AN' IT IZ NOW {STRONGER|CONSIDERABLY STRONGER|GOING SOMEWHERE}, AN' DA AWAY TEAM IZ OFF DA WRECK INSIDE {A COUPLE OF MINUTES|NO TIME AT ALL} AN' DOES NO DISCUSS IT UNTIL ORBIT!

choices.text: MATCH ITS DEPTH AN' HOLD.
GO BELOW IT AN' LOOK UP.
GRAPPLE IT AN' HAUL IT UP!

n0.emText:
NO GROUND. DA SIGNAL HOLDS STATION AT A FIXED DEPTH IN {place} HOVERIN' DEAD STILL IN DA ATMOSPHERE.
YOU TAKE DA CAPSULE DOWN AN' DA ATMOSPHERE CLOSES OVER DA PORTS AT NINE KILOMETRES, AN' IT DOES NO FEEL LIKE SINKIN'. IT FEELS LIKE A LIFT GOING DOWN INTO A BUILDIN' DAT HAB MORE BASEMENTS DEN IT HAB FLOORS!
n0.bubba: "AN HOUR ON DA ROAD," SAYS BUBBA, WATCHIN' DA PORTS GO DARK. "AN' STILL GOIN'. STO' PALAZZO TENE TROPPE CANTINE, SUGAR."

a.text: {DESCENDIN' THROUGH DA ATMOSPHERIC SOUP, DA SHAPE RESOLVES:|DROPPIN' LOWER THROUGH DA CLOUDS, YOU SPOT IT:|SENSORS CLEAR UP AS YOU APPROACH:} {AN INTACT STATION|A MASSIVE FLOATIN' PLATFORM|A FLOATIN' INDUSTRIAL RIG}, NO A WRECK, {ANCHORED DIRECTLY IN DA DENSE GAS LAYERS|HOLDIN' STATION AGAINST DA HURRICANE WINDS|SILENTLY HUMMIN' WIT BACKUP POWER}!

choices.text: DOCK.
PHOTOGRAPH EVERYTINK AN' CLIMB OUT!

b.text: BELOW IT DA PRESSURE IZ AT DA CAPSULE'S RATIN' AN' DA VIEW UP IZ {WORTH IT|WORTH DA RATIN'}: DA TINK IZ STANDIN' ON A COLUMN OF SOMETINK DAT GOES DOWN PAST DA CAPSULE, PAST DA SOUNDER'S RANGE, {PAST ANY FLOOR DIS WORLD HAB|PAST ANY BOTTOM DIS WORLD HAB}!

choices.text: FOLLOW DA COLUMN DOWN.
{TAKE A SAMPLE|COLLECT A SPECIMEN|SCRAPE OFF A SAMPLE|BAG A PIECE} OF DA COLUMN AN' GO!

c.text:
DA GRAPPLE TAKES HOLD ON DA {SECOND|THIRD|FIRST} PASS. WHATEVER IT IZ MASSES FAR LESS DEN IT SHOULD AN' COMES UP EASILY FOR {SIX|FIVE|SEVEN} KILOMETRES.

a1.text: DA DOCK TAKES DA CAPSULE LIKE IT WAZ BUILT FOR IT, COZ IT WAZ. INSIDE DERE IZ AIR, AN' GRAVITY, AN' A SINGLE CORRIDOR WIT A DOOR AT DA END OF IT, AN' DA DOOR OPENS FOR {leader} AN' FOR {NOBODY|NO ONE} ELSE!

b1.text: DA CAPSULE GOES PAST ITS RATIN' ON DA WAY TA FINDIN' OUT WHAT DA COLUMN STANDS ON. IT COMES BACK UP WIT {TWO PORTS CRAZED|BOTH PORTS CRAZED}, ONE CREW MEMBER'S RIBS GONE, AN' DA ANSWER, WHICH {NOBODY|NO ONE} HAB BIN ABLE TA WRITE DOWN!

b2.text: DA SAMPLE ARM COMES BACK WIT THREE GRAMS OF DA COLUMN IN DA POT, AN' DA POT WEIGHS {many} KILOS, {AN' IT IZ STILL COOLIN'|AN' IT HAB NO FINISHED COOLIN'}!

a1_corr.text:

WHILE IT COOLS, DA COLUMN DOES SOMETINK IT HAB NO DONE IN DA {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|HOUR|WHILE} DA CAPSULE HAB BIN UNDER IT: IT {NARROWS|DRAWS IN|CLOSES} BY 'BOUT A METRE, FROM DA BOTTOM UP, AT DA RATE A TINK MOVES WHEN IT HAB NOTICED SOMETINK!

DA CAPSULE CLIMBS OUT WIT AN EMPTY POT, TWO HUNDRED FRAMES OF DA COLUMN, AN' DA SINGLE MOST USEFUL PIECE OF INFORMATION ANYBODY HAB EVER BROUGHT BACK OFF DIS WORLD, WHICH IZ DAT IT CAN BE ASKED!

b2_watch.text:

IT STOPS {DA LENGTH OF DA ROOM|A HUNDRED METRES|SHORT}, AN' HOLDS, AN' FOR {ELEVEN MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|SOME TIME} DA TWO OF DEM SIT DERE. WHAT IZ RECORDED IN DOZE MINUTES WILL BE ARGUED 'BOUT BY PEOPLE WHO WAZ NO DERE FOR DA REST OF DA PARTY'S LIVES!

{DA HEAT HERE WILL COOK YOU ALIVE IN SECONDS.|DA HEAT HERE WILL MELT YA SUIT SEALS IN SECONDS.|DA HEAT HERE WILL SCORCH YA EYEBROWS OFF IN SECONDS.|THERMAL SENSORS IZ SCREAMIN' AT MAXIMUM.|DA SURFACE TEMPERATURE IZ COMPLETELY UNHINGED.} {DA SIGNAL IZ TRANSMITTIN' OUT OF DA HOTTEST POINT ON DA SWEEP.|SOMETINK IZ BROADCASTIN' DIRECTLY FROM DA CENTER OF DA MAGMA FIELD.|A BEACON IZ SCREAMIN' FROM INSIDE DA HOTTEST VENT.}

SEND DA DRONE IN AN' STAY OUT!

a.text: {APPROACHIN' DA MAGMA VENT, DA RADIATION COUNTERS SPIKE VIOLENTLY.|HEAT SHIELDS GLOW CHERRY RED AS YOU PUSH CLOSER TA DA SOURCE.|DA GROUND CRUNCHES LIKE BREAKIN' GLASS UNDER YA BOOTS.} {AT DA CENTER OF DA CALDERA SITS A GLOWIN' CYLINDER, TOTALLY UNFAZED BY DA LAVA.|DA SOURCE IZ A SOLID METAL BEACON SUBMERGED IN MOLTEN ROCK.|AN ALLOY HOUSIN' SITS IN DA MIDDLE OF DA MAGMA FLOW.}

a1.text: DA GLOVE DOES NO BURN. SOMETINK'S PUT INTO IT, {DELIBERATELY|ON PURPOSE}, BY SOMETINK WIT NO HANDS, AN' {leader} WALKS OUT OF DA HEAT CARRYIN' AN OBJECT DAT IZ COLD!

DA DRONE IZ AT DA EDGE OF DA HEAT, {SET DOWN FACIN' OUTWARDS|SET DOWN WIT ITS FACE TURNED OUTWARDS}, WIT ITS RECORDER FULL AN' ITS CASIN' PACKED WIT SOMETINK DAT SHOULD NO EXIST AT DAT TEMPERATURE.

choices.text: GO DOWN AFTER IT.

a1.text: AT DA MIDDLE IZ DA TINK DA WHOLE BODY WAZ BUILT AROUND, HANGIN' AT DA CENTRE OF GRAVITY, {TURNIN' SLOWLY|TURNIN', SLOWLY|TURNIN' AT A WALKIN' PACE}, AN' IT LETS {leader} TAKE ONE PIECE OF ITSELF WITOUT ANY ARGUMENT AT ALL!

a2.text: DA MAP TAKES {SIX|FIVE|EIGHT} HOURS AN' IZ WORTH EVERY MINUTE: A COMPLETE INTERIOR SURVEY OF AN ARTIFICIAL WORLD, WIT DA MACHINERY OF IT LAID BARE ALONG DA WALL LIKE AN ANATOMY!

b1.text: {IT IZ NO A CHAMBER.|DAT IZ NO A CHAMBER.} IT IZ AN OCCUPANT, AN' IT HAB BIN FOLDED INTO DAT SPACE FOR LONGER DEN DA BODY HAB BIN IN DIS ORBIT, AN' IT UNFOLDS!

b2.text: {DA ANSWERIN' CHAMBERS IZ STORES|DA CHAMBERS DAT ANSWERED IZ STORES}, AN' DA STORES IZ FULL, AN' WHOEVER PACKED DEM EXPECTED TA COME BACK FOR DEM!

c1.text: DA DRONE IZ {lots} METRES DOWN, UNDAMAGED, AN' POINTIN' BACK UP DA SHAFT. SOMETINK SET IT DOWN {CAREFULLY|WIT CARE}, AN' PUT SOMETINK NEXT TA IT, AN' LEFT!

c2.text: {many} MINUTES OF DA INSIDE OF A HOLLOW WORLD SELLS FOR {WHAT A LIL' MOON SELLS FOR|DA PRICE OF A LIL' MOON}. DA BUYER DOES NO GIVE A NAME AN' DOES NO HAGGLE. DAT TELLS YOU ENOUGH!

a1_m.text:
CROSSIN' TA DA MIDDLE OF A HOLLOW WORLD MEANS CROSSIN' {FOUR HUNDRED METRES|A LONG WAY|DA WIDTH OF DA INSIDE} OF FLOOR DAT CURVES UP ON ALL SIDES, IN DA DARK, WIT DA LAMPS ONLY REACHIN' SO FAR.
HALFWAY ACROSS, DA LAMPS PICK UP DA CROSSIN' POINT OF {TWO|THREE} OTHER SETS OF TRACKS, ALL OF DEM HEADIN' DA SAME WAY, ALL OF DEM {OLD|REAL OLD|OLDER DEN DA SURVEY}, AN' NONE OF DEM COMIN' BACK!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{THREE LOTS IN. NONE OUT.|NOBODY HAB EVER WALKED BACK ACROSS DIS FLOOR.|WE IZ NO DA FIRST AN' DA FIRST IZ STILL HERE.}"
asides.any: {member} {TAKES A BEARIN' BACK TA DA SHAFT AN' WRITES IT ON A GLOVE|COUNTS DA SETS|DOES NO STOP WALKIN'}

choices.text: KEEP GOING TA DA MIDDLE.
FOLLOW DA OLDEST SET OF TRACKS INSTEAD!
LAY A LINE BACK TA DA SHAFT BEFORE GOING ANOTHER METRE!

a1_old.text:
DA OLDEST SET DOES NO GO TA DA MIDDLE. IT GOES {THREE QUARTERS OF DA WAY|MOST OF DA WAY|NEARLY DERE} AN' DEN TURNS AN' WALKS A CIRCLE ROUND IT, TWICE, AN' DEN GOES BACK TA DA WALL AT A DIFFERENT POINT FROM DA SHAFT.
AT DAT POINT IN DA WALL DERE IZ A HATCH, AN' DA HATCH IZ ON DA INSIDE OF A WORLD DAT NOBODY BUILT A DOOR INTO, AN' IT OPENS!

a1_line.text:
FOUR HUNDRED METRES OF LINE PAID OUT ACROSS A FLOOR DAT CURVES UP ON ALL SIDES, ANCHORED AT BOTH ENDS, WHICH TAKES {AN HOUR|A LONG TIME|MOST OF DA AIR BUDGET}.
DA TINK AT DA MIDDLE LETS {leader} TAKE WHAT {leader} TAKES, EXACTLY AS IT WOULD HAB ANYWAY. DA DIFFERENCE IZ DAT DA WALK BACK IZ A WALK RATHER DEN {A SEARCH|FOUR HOURS OF LAMPS|DA REST OF EVERYBODY'S AIR}, AN' EVERYBODY IZ STANDIN' ON DA RAMP BEFORE DARK!

c1_m.text:
DA DRONE IZ {lots} METRES DOWN, UNDAMAGED, AN' POINTIN' BACK UP DA SHAFT. SOMETINK SET IT DOWN {CAREFULLY|WIT CARE}, AN' PUT SOMETINK NEXT TA IT, AN' LEFT.
DA SOMETINK NEXT TA IT IZ {DA SIZE OF A FIST|LIL'|'BOUT DA SIZE OF A HELMET} AN' IZ DA ONLY OBJECT IN DA WHOLE INTERIOR DAT IZ NO PART OF DA INTERIOR, AN' IT HAB BIN PLACED WHERE A DRONE'S CAMERA WOULD SEE IT!

choices.text: TAKE IT AN' CLIMB OUT.
PHOTOGRAPH EVERYTINK 'BOUT HOW IT WAZ PLACED FIRST!
PUT SOMETINK OF OURS NEXT TA IT AN' LEAVE BOTH!

c1_place.text:
IT HAB BIN PLACED AT DA DRONE'S FOCAL DISTANCE, SQUARED TA DA LENS, ON A SURFACE DAT WAZ {SWEPT|CLEARED|PREPARED} FIRST. EVERYTINK 'BOUT DA PLACEMENT IZ AN ANSWER TA A CAMERA.
WHICH MEANS IT WAZ LEFT FOR WHOEVER SENT DA DRONE RATHER DEN FOR WHOEVER FINDS IT, AN' DAT IZ A DIFFERENT OBJECT ENTIRELY, AN' IT IZ WORTH REPORTIN' AS ONE!

c1_swap.text:
A TOOL OFF DA PARTY'S OWN BELT, SET DOWN AT DA SAME FOCAL DISTANCE, SQUARED TA DA SAME LENS, ON DA SAME SWEPT SURFACE.
DA DRONE IZ LEFT RUNNIN'. IT SENDS FOR {DA REST OF DA SHIFT|MOST OF A DAY|A LONG TIME} AN' DEN STOPS, AN' WHAT IT SENT IN DA LAST FOUR MINUTES IZ DA REASON DA SHIP STAYS IN DIS SYSTEM ANOTHER {FORTNIGHT|A FEW WEEKS|MONTH}!

n0.text:
{DA SCANNER IZ PICKIN' UP AN EXACT DUPLICATE OF {vessel}'S TRANSPONDER SIGNATURE.|SOMETINK DOWN ON {ground} IZ BROADCASTIN' OUR EXACT SHIP ID AN' CALLSIGN.|SENSOR TELEMETRY IZ MIRRORIN' OUR OWN SHIP DATA WIT ZERO DELAY.} {IT IZ EITHER A SEVERE SENSOR GLITCH, A REAL WEIRD RELAY, OR SOMEONE TRYIN' TA MOCK US.|EITHER DA ELECTRONICS IZ FRIED, OR SOMETINK DOWN DERE IZ COPYIN' OUR HOMEWORK.}
DA DUPLICATE SIGNATURE IZ {HALF A SECOND|A FRACTION|SLIGHTLY} AHEAD, AN' DA GAP HAB BIN CLOSIN' SINCE DA LANDER TOUCHED!

choices.text: FOLLOW DA OTHER TEAM'S TRACKS!
SET UP AN' WAIT FOR DEM TA ARRIVE!
TALK TA DEM ON DA SUIT CHANNEL!

n0.emText:
YA OWN SUIT TELEMETRY, FIVE CHANNELS, CORRECT HEADERS, CORRECT NAMES, ARRIVIN' FROM {place} {many} MINUTES BEFORE YOU LAND DERE.
SOMEBODY HAB ALREADY DONE DIS. SOMEONE'S DOING IT NOW, SLIGHTLY AHEAD, WEARIN' YA HEADERS. YOU IZ DA LAST PERSON IN DIS UNIVERSE ENTITLED TA BE SQUEAMISH 'BOUT A COPY OF A WOMAN TURNIN' UP WHERE DA ORIGINAL HAB NO ARRIVED YET!
n0.bubba: BUBBA LOOKS AT DA TELEMETRY AN' DEN AT YOU AN' PUTS HIS HAND ON YA SHOULDER. "WHATEVER'S WEARIN' OUR NAMES DOWN DERE, IT AIN'T US. RICORDATELO. WHATEVER IT SAYS."

a.text:
DA TRACKS IZ DA AWAY TEAM'S OWN BOOTS, IN DA AWAY TEAM'S OWN SIZES, LAID DOWN IN {ground} BEFORE DA LANDER TOUCHED.
DEY LEAD AWAY FROM DA LANDIN' SITE, DO EVERYTINK DA TEAM IZ 'BOUT TA DO, AN' STOP!

choices.text: WALK TA WHERE DEY STOP.
DO SOMETINK DA TRACKS DID NO DO!

b.text:
{DEY ARRIVE ON SCHEDULE|DEY ARRIVE EXACTLY ON SCHEDULE}, FROM DA DIRECTION DA TELEMETRY SAID, FIVE OF DEM, IN DA SAME SUITS, WALKIN' DA WAY DA AWAY TEAM WALKS.
DEY STOP {lots} METRES OUT AN' WAIT TA BE SPOKEN TA!

choices.text: TRADE WIT DEM.
DO NO LET DEM ANY CLOSER.

c.text:
DA CHANNEL IZ OPEN BOTH WAYS AN' DA VOICE ON IT IZ {leader}'S, HALF A SECOND EARLY, GETTIN' EVERY WORD RIGHT BEFORE IT IZ SAID.
IT ASKS DA AWAY TEAM NO TA COME TA {place}. IT IZ {REAL|REMARKABLY} CALM 'BOUT IT!

choices.text: ASK WHAT HAPPENS DERE.
GO DERE.

a1.text: WHERE DEY STOP DERE IZ A CACHE, PACKED BY PEOPLE {WIT DA SAME HANDS|WHOSE HANDS WAZ DA SAME AS DEY}, AN' A NOTE IN {leader}'S HANDWRITIN' DAT SAYS ONLY: IT IZ WORTH IT, TAKE IT, DO NO STAY!

a2.text:
{leader} SITS DOWN IN {ground} AN' REFUSES TA MOVE FOR {few} MINUTES, OUT OF SPITE.
IT WORKS. DA TRACKS STOP BEING AHEAD OF DEM. EVERYTINK SINCE LANDIN' HAB TA BE DONE AGAIN, {PROPERLY|CORRECTLY}, AN' DA TEAM IZ TIRED IN A WAY SLEEP DOES NO TOUCH!

b1.text: DEY TRADE FAIRLY, AN' HARD, AN' DEY KNOW {EXACTLY|PRECISELY} WHAT DA TEAM CAN SPARE, WHICH IZ DA MOST FRIGHTENIN' TINK 'BOUT DA WHOLE EXCHANGE!

b2.text: {DEY COME CLOSER.|DEY COME CLOSER DEN DAT.}

c1.text: IT TELLS DEM. IT TAKES {FOUR|THREE|FIVE} MINUTES AN' DA TEAM DOES NO GO, AN' ON DA WALK BACK DA VOICE THANKS DEM, ONCE, AN' STOPS HALF A SECOND BEFORE IT SHOULD!

c2.text: AT {place} DERE IZ NUTTIN' BUT {remnant} AN' A {REAL|REMARKABLY} CLEAR VIEW, AN' EVERYBODY COMES BACK, AN' DA COUNT IZ RIGHT, AN' DA SHIP'S LOG WILL RECORD DAT DA COUNT WAZ RIGHT!

b1_m.text:
DEY TRADE FAIRLY, AN' HARD, AN' DEY KNOW {EXACTLY|PRECISELY} WHAT DA TEAM CAN SPARE, WHICH IZ DA MOST FRIGHTENIN' TINK 'BOUT DA WHOLE EXCHANGE.
WHAT DEY OFFER FOR IT IZ {FOUR|FIVE} ITEMS, LAID OUT ON A SHEET, AN' ONE OF DEM IZ SOMETINK DA PARTY HAB NO LOST YET: IT IZ ON SOMEBODY'S BELT RIGHT NOW, AN' DERE IZ A SECOND ONE ON DA SHEET!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DO NO PICK DAT UP.|DAT IZ ME. DAT IZ ON ME. NOW.|DEY IZ TRADIN' US OUR OWN WEEK.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A HAND OVER DEY OWN BELT|COUNTS DA ITEMS ON DA SHEET TWICE|STEPS BACK OFF DA SHEET}

choices.text: TRADE. TAKE ALL FOUR.
TAKE EVERYTINK EXCEPT DA DUPLICATE!
ASK HOW DEY CAME BY DA ONE DAT IZ STILL ON OUR BELT!

b1_three.text:
THREE ITEMS OFF DA SHEET AN' DA FOURTH LEFT LYING DERE, WHICH DEY ACCEPT WITOUT COMMENT AN' WITOUT PICKIN' IT UP.
IT IZ STILL ON DA SHEET WHEN DA PARTY LOOKS BACK FROM {TWO HUNDRED METRES|DA RIDGE|A DISTANCE}, AN' DA SHEET IZ STILL DERE DA NEXT DAY, AN' DA DAY AFTER DAT IT IZ NO, AN' NEITHER IZ DA TINK ON IT, AN' NEITHER IZ DA ONE DAT WAZ ON DA BELT!

b1_ask.text:
DA QUESTION IZ ASKED PLAINLY AN' DA ANSWER IZ GIVEN PLAINLY, WHICH IZ DA ONLY TIME EITHER SIDE DOES DAT: DEY CAME BY IT DA SAME WAY DA PARTY IZ 'BOUT TA COME BY IT, WHICH IZ {BACKWARDS|FROM DA OTHER END|IN DA ORDER DEY IZ STANDIN' IN}.
DA TRADE IZ COMPLETED. BOTH PARTIES WALK AWAY. ON DA WAY BACK TA DA LANDER {member} WORKS OUT WHAT DA ANSWER MEANS AN' HAB TA SIT DOWN ON {ground} FOR A MINUTE, AN' DOES NO EXPLAIN!

c2_m.text:
AT {place} DERE IZ NUTTIN' BUT {remnant} AN' A {REAL|REMARKABLY} CLEAR VIEW, AN' DA WALK OUT TA IT TAKES {HALF A SHIFT|DA AFTERNOON|LONGER DEN DA MAP SAYS}.
DA VIEW IZ CLEAR IN EVERY DIRECTION INCLUDIN' DA ONE DA PARTY CAME FROM, AN' FROM HERE IT IZ POSSIBLE TA SEE DA LANDER, AN' DA AWAY TEAM'S OWN TRACKS, AN' {FIVE|FOUR} FIGURES AT DA LANDER WHO IZ NO DERE YET!

choices.text: WALK BACK. COUNT EVERYBODY AT DA RAMP!
STAY AT {place} UNTIL DA FIGURES IZ GONE!
WATCH DEM THROUGH DA GLASS AN' WORK OUT WHAT DEY IZ DOING!

c2_wait.text:
SITTIN' AT {place} WIT A CLEAR VIEW FOR {FOUR HOURS|DA REST OF DA LIGHT|A LONG TIME}, WATCHIN' A LANDER DAT HAB FOUR PEOPLE AT IT AN' FOUR PEOPLE WALKIN' TOWARDS IT AN' FOUR PEOPLE SITTIN' ON A RIDGE.
DA FIGURES AT DA LANDER GO INSIDE AT DUSK. DA PARTY WALKS BACK IN DA DARK, FINDS DA HATCH DOGGED FROM INSIDE, AN' OPENS IT, AN' DERE IZ NOBODY ABOARD AN' DA KETTLE IZ WARM!

c2_watch.text:
THROUGH DA GLASS, AT {FOUR KILOMETRES|DAT DISTANCE|A LONG WAY}, DA FIVE OF DEM IZ DOING EXACTLY WHAT DA PARTY DID AT LANDIN': DA SAME CHECKS, IN DA SAME ORDER, WIT DA SAME ONE GOING ROUND DA GEAR TWICE.
AN' DEN ONE OF DEM STOPS, AN' TURNS, AN' LOOKS UP AT {place}, AT DA RIDGE, AT DA GLASS. DA PARTY LEAVES BEFORE DA OTHERS ARRIVE. DA SHIP'S LOG RECORDS A CLEAN DEPARTURE AN' A CREW COUNT DAT IZ RIGHT!

n0.text:
{DA TRANSPONDER SIGNAL IZ MOVIN' FAST ACROSS {ground}, HEADIN' ON A DIRECT INTERCEPT COURSE.|SOMETINK IZ TRACKIN' US, CARRYIN' AN OBSOLETE DISTRESS BEACON AS BAIT.|A FAST-MOVIN' RADAR CONTACT IZ CLOSIN' DA DISTANCE ACROSS {place}.} {IT IZ USING DA SIGNAL TA HUNT.|WHATEVER'S CARRYIN' DAT BEACON DEFINITELY NO IZ A STRANDED CREW MEMBER.}
DA BEACON IT IZ CARRYIN' WAZ LOGGED AS DESTROYED {DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE|A DECADE|A LONG TIME} AGO, WIT DA WRECK, WIT EVERYBODY ABOARD!

choices.text: {SET AN AMBUSH|TAKE COVER AN' WAIT|HIDE BEHIND DA ROCKS|PREPARE AN AMBUSH} AN' WAIT FOR IT!
{CIRCLE ROUND|FLANK IT FROM BEHIND|SNEAK UP ON ITS BLIND SIDE|COME AROUND DA BACK} AN' COME AT IT FROM BEHIND!
{BROADCAST ON DA SAME FREQUENCY|HAIL DEM ON DA OPEN BAND|ANSWER DA SIGNAL|OPEN A COMMS CHANNEL}!

n0.emText:
A SHIP-STANDARD TRANSPONDER ON A FREQUENCY NOBODY HAB USED IN DECADES, MOVIN' OVER {ground} ON A LINE DAT WILL CROSS YA.
IT STOPS WHEN YOU STOP. IT HAB DONE DIS BEFORE AN' IT HAB DONE IT ENOUGH TIMES TA HAB GOT POLITE 'BOUT IT, DA WAY A MAN FOLLOWIN' YOU HOME KEEPS A CONSISTENT DISTANCE SO DAT NEITHER OF YOU HAB TA SAY ANYTINK!
n0.bubba: "IT STOPPED WHEN WE STOPPED," SAYS BUBBA. "AOH. NUN E' CURIOSA. IT IZ GOT A METHOD."

a.text:
{TWO HOURS|THREE HOURS|AN HOUR AN' A HALF} IN COVER AT {place}. DA TRANSPONDER COMES ON AT LAST LIGHT AN' IT IZ BEING CARRIED BY SOMETINK DA SIZE OF A LANDER LEG DAT MOVES {LIKE IT HAB ALL DA TIME IN DA WORLD|AS THOUGH NUTTIN' IZ CHASIN' IT}.
IT IZ DRAGGIN' A NET, AN' DA NET IZ FULL!

choices.text: {TAKE DA SHOT|OPEN FIRE|PULL DA TRIGGER|SHOOT FIRST}!
{LET IT PASS|HOLD FIRE AN' WAIT|STAY HIDDEN UNTIL IT MOVES ON|LET IT WALK BY} AN' FOLLOW DA NET!

b.text:
{COMIN' AT IT FROM BEHIND WORKS|COMIN' UP BEHIND IT WORKS}, IN DAT DA TEAM GETS TA SEE IT BEFORE IT SEES DEM.
IT IZ SITTIN' IN A SCRAPE IT HAB MADE FOR ITSELF, AN' IT IZ SURROUNDED BY SUIT HELMETS, ARRANGED IN A CIRCLE, {ALL FACIN' INWARDS|EVERY ONE FACIN' INWARDS}!

choices.text: TAKE A HELMET.
BACK OFF QUIETLY.

c.text:
{leader} KEYS DA OLD FREQUENCY AN' SAYS DA STANDARD HAIL.
DA ANSWER IZ DA STANDARD REPLY, WORD PERFECT, IN {leader}'S OWN VOICE, AN' IT IZ COMIN' FROM {'BOUT|SOMETINK LIKE|ROUGHLY} SIXTY METRES AWAY!

choices.text: {ANSWER IT AGAIN|SEND ANOTHER REPLY|HAIL DEM BACK|REPEAT DA RESPONSE}!
{GO TA IT|APPROACH DA SOURCE|MOVE IN CLOSER|HEAD TOWARD DA SIGNAL}!

a1.text: {DA FIRST SHOT IZ GOOD|DA FIRST SHOT GOES EXACTLY WHERE IT SHOULD} AN' DOES NUTTIN' AT ALL EXCEPT MAKE IT PUT DA NET DOWN!

a2.text: IT DRAGS DA NET TA A CACHE UNDER AN OVERHANG AN' {STOWS IT WIT DA OTHERS|PUTS IT AWAY WIT DA OTHERS}. DERE IZ {lots} YEARS OF OTHERS. DA TEAM LIFTS ONE AN' IZ GONE BEFORE IT COMES BACK!

b1.text: DERE IZ A NAME {STENCILLED|STENCILLED IN PAINT} INSIDE DA HELMET AN' A RECORDER STILL IN DA COLLAR WIT {many} SECONDS ON IT. GETTIN' OUT WIT BOTH IZ DA HARDEST WALKIN' ANYONE DOES DAT YEAR!

b2.text: {NOBODY|NO ONE} SPEAKS UNTIL DA LANDER HATCH IZ SHUT. DA TRANSPONDER IZ STILL MOVIN' OUT DERE, AN' DA SHIP LOGS DA POSITION, AN' MARKS DA WHOLE HEMISPHERE AS {A PLACE TA NO GO BACK TA|SOMEWHERE NOBODY RETURNS TA}!

c1.text:
{THREE|FOUR|TWO} EXCHANGES AN' IT RUNS OUT OF RECORDED PHRASES AN' STARTS MAKIN' ITS OWN, BADLY, AN' DA BADNESS IZ WHAT EVERYBODY REMEMBERS.
IT LEAVES. IT LEAVES A TINK BEHIND, ON {ground}, HALFWAY BETWEEN!

c2.text: IT HAB BIN WAITIN' {A LONG TIME|A GOOD WHILE|LONGER DEN ANYBODY SAYS} FOR {SOMEBODY|SOMEONE} TA WALK TOWARDS IT!

a2_m.text:
IT DRAGS DA NET PAST DA COVER AT {A COUPLE OF PACES|CLOSE RANGE|ARM'S LENGTH} AN' DOES NO LOOK, AN' KEEPS GOING, AN' DA TEAM GETS TA BREATHE AGAIN 'BOUT A MINUTE LATER.
IT STOWS DA NET AT A CACHE UNDER AN OVERHANG, WIT DA OTHERS. DERE IZ {lots} YEARS OF OTHERS, AN' DEY IZ STACKED IN DATE ORDER, AN' DA OLDEST ONES AT DA BACK HAB BIN {OPENED|GONE THROUGH|SORTED} AN' DA NEWEST HAB NO!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{IT IZ KEEPIN' DEM FOR SOMETINK.|DATE ORDER. DAT IZ A COLLECTION.|NUTTIN' HUNTS AN' DEN FILES.}"
asides.any: {member} {READS DA DATES OFF DA OUTSIDE OF DA NETS|LIFTS ONE AN' FINDS IT HEAVIER DEN EXPECTED|WORKS OUT HOW MANY YEARS IZ IN DA STACK}

choices.text: LIFT ONE AN' BE GONE.
OPEN DA OLDEST ONE, AT DA BACK!
WORK OUT WHAT ORDER IT IZ ACTUALLY KEEPIN' DEM IN!

a2_old.text:
DA OLDEST NET HAB BIN OPENED BEFORE AN' CLOSED AGAIN, CAREFULLY, AN' WHAT IZ IN IT HAB BIN {ARRANGED|LAID OUT|SORTED} RATHER DEN STORED.
IT IZ A CREW. ALL OF IT, EVERY MEMBER, WIT EACH PERSON'S OWN KIT BESIDE DEM IN DA ORDER DEY WORE IT. DA TEAM LIFTS NUTTIN' FROM DAT ONE. WHAT DEY LIFT INSTEAD IZ {DA LOG|A PLATE|DA NAME}, WHICH IZ ENOUGH TA CLOSE A FILE DAT HAB BIN OPEN FOR A DECADE!

a2_order.text:
{SIZE|MASS|WEIGHT} ORDER, AN' INSIDE DAT, DATE ORDER, AN' DA WHOLE STACK IZ GRADED SO FINELY DAT DA GAPS IN IT IZ AS LEGIBLE AS DA CONTENTS.
DERE IZ {THREE|FOUR} GAPS. THREE NETS HAB BIN TAKEN OUT OF DIS CACHE AN' NO PUT BACK, BY SOMETINK DAT IZ NO DA ONE WIT DA BEACON, AN' DAT IZ DA MOST USEFUL TINK ANYBODY HAB LEARNED ON DIS ROCK!

b1_m.text:
GETTIN' TA DA HELMET MEANS {A COUPLE OF PACES|CROSSIN' DA SCRAPE|GOING IN} WHILE IT IZ SITTIN' IN ITS OWN HOLLOW DOING SOMETINK WIT ITS HANDS DAT NOBODY WANTS DESCRIBED.
DERE IZ A NAME {STENCILLED|STENCILLED IN PAINT} INSIDE DA HELMET AN' A RECORDER STILL IN DA COLLAR. DERE IZ ALSO, UNDER DA HELMET, A SECOND ONE, AN' A THIRD, AN' DA PILE GOES DOWN FURTHER DEN DA LIGHT DOES!

choices.text: TAKE DA TOP HELMET AN' GET OUT!
TAKE DA RECORDER OUT OF EVERY HELMET YOU CAN REACH!
READ DA NAMES WITOUT MOVIN' ANYTINK!

b1_all.text:
{NINE|ELEVEN|SEVEN} RECORDERS OUT OF {NINE|ELEVEN|SEVEN} COLLARS, ONE AT A TIME, BY TOUCH, WIT SOMETINK BREATHIN' {FOUR METRES|A FEW FEET|NO FAR ENOUGH} AWAY.
DA EIGHTH ONE CLICKS. WHAT HAPPENS AFTER DA CLICK IZ FOUR MINUTES LONG AN' IZ DA REASON TWO OF DA PARTY WILL NO GO FIRST THROUGH A HATCH EVER AGAIN, AN' EVERYBODY GETS OUT, AN' DA RECORDERS COME WIT DEM!

b1_names.text:
DA NAMES IZ READ OFF {FOUR|FIVE} COLLARS WITOUT A FINGER BEING LAID ON ANY OF DEM, WHICH TAKES PATIENCE AN' A GOOD LIGHT AN' DA WILLINGNESS TA LIE STILL IN A SCRAPE.
DEY IZ ALL OFF DA SAME SHIP AN' DA SHIP IZ {ONE DA PARTY HAB HEARD OF|ON DA REGISTRY|STILL LISTED AS IN SERVICE}. DA LAST PART IZ WHAT DEY CARRY OUT OF DERE, AN' IT IZ WORTH MORE DEN ANY OF DA HELMETS!

n0.text:
{place} HOLDS {AN ABANDONED TOWN|A RUINED SETTLEMENT|A CLUSTER OF COLLAPSED STONE BUILDINGS}. {STREETS, BROKEN DRAINS, A CENTRAL SQUARE, AN' {remnant} SITTIN' IN DA MIDDLE.|A CRUMBLIN' GHOST TOWN WHERE NOBODY HAB LIVED FOR CENTURIES.|TOPPLED ARCHWAYS AN' CRACKED STONE FOUNDATIONS UNDER A DEAD SKY.}
NUTTIN' HERE FELL DOWN. EVERY BUILDIN' DAT IZ OPEN IZ OPEN COZ {A WALL WAZ TAKEN OUT|SOMEBODY REMOVED A WALL|IT WAZ OPENED}, FROM DA INSIDE, {NEATLY|CAREFULLY|WITOUT HURRY}!

choices.text: GO INTO DA LARGEST BUILDIN'!
{FOLLOW DA DRAINS|HEAD DOWN DA DRAIN TUNNELS|CLIMB DOWN INTO DA DRAINAGE CONDUIT|FOLLOW DA SEWER PIPE} DOWN!
READ DA SQUARE.

n0.emText:
STREETS, DRAINS, A SQUARE, AN' {remnant} WHERE A MONUMENT WOULD GO. NUTTIN' BURNED. NUTTIN' FELL. DEY STOPPED, ALL AT ONCE, LIKE A MARKET AT CLOSIN'.
YOU WALK DOWN A ROAD DAT WAZ BUILT TA BE WALKED DOWN AN' EVERY DOORWAY YOU PASS IZ DA RIGHT SIZE FOR YOU, WHICH IZ EITHER A COINCIDENCE OR DA SINGLE MOST FRIGHTENIN' PIECE OF INFORMATION AVAILABLE ON DIS WORLD!
n0.bubba: BUBBA STANDS IN DA MIDDLE OF DA SQUARE AN' TURNS ROUND SLOWLY. "DOORS IZ OUR SIZE. STEPS IZ OUR SIZE. CHI LL'HA FATTE, STI SCALE?"

a.text:
IT IZ A HALL, AN' IT IZ FULL OF SEATS FACIN' A STAGE, AN' ON DA STAGE IZ A MACHINE DAT HAB BIN RUNNIN' DA SAME {SIX|FOUR|NINE} SECONDS OF SOMETINK FOR AS LONG AS IT HAB HAB POWER.
{EVERY SEAT IZ OCCUPIED.|EVERY SEAT IN DA HALL IZ OCCUPIED.} DEY IZ DA SHAPES BODIES LEAVE IN A ROOM DAT HAB NO BIN DISTURBED!

choices.text: LET DA MACHINE FINISH.
{TAKE DA MACHINE|DISMANTLE DA DEVICE|HAUL DA HARDWARE BACK|PRY DA MACHINE LOOSE}!

b.text:
DA DRAINS IZ {DRY, WALKABLE|DRY AN' WALKABLE}, AN' BETTER BUILT DEN DA STREETS ABOVE DEM. {TWO HUNDRED|THREE HUNDRED|A HUNDRED AN' FIFTY} METRES IN DEY STOP BEING DRAINS AN' START BEING A CORRIDOR.
{sound}, FROM FURTHER ALONG!

choices.text: {KEEP GOING|PUSH DEEPER|CONTINUE FORWARD|PRESS ON}!
BLOW DA TUNNEL ENTRANCE.

c.text:
{DA SQUARE IZ A RECORD.|DA SQUARE ITSELF IZ DA RECORD.} EVERY FLAT SURFACE CARRIES NAMES, AN' DA NAMES IZ IN COLUMNS, AN' DA COLUMNS IZ DATED, AN' DA DATES STOP.
{leader} WORKS OUT DA LAST COLUMN IZ A ROTA!

choices.text: CHECK DA NAMES ON DA WALL!
{COPY DA RECORD AN' GO|DOWNLOAD DA ARCHIVES AN' LEAVE|GRAB DA DATA AN' RETREAT|LOG DA DATA AN' EXTRACT}!

a1.text: IT TAKES {NINE|SEVEN|ELEVEN} MINUTES. IT IZ A MESSAGE, AN' IT IZ AN APOLOGY, AN' AT DA END OF IT DA SEATS IZ EMPTY IN A WAY DEY WAZ NO BEFORE, AN' EVERYBODY IN DA AWAY TEAM FEELS IT HAPPEN!

a2.text: IT COMES OFF DA STAGE IN {few} PIECES AN' EVERY PIECE IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA LANDER. DA HALL IZ {REAL|REMARKABLY} QUIET ON DA WAY OUT, AN' DA SEATS IZ STILL OCCUPIED!

b1.text: DA CORRIDOR ENDS AT A DOOR DAT WAZ LOCKED FROM DIS SIDE, BY HAND, {IN A HURRY|AN' IN A HURRY}, AN' WHATEVER DEY LOCKED IN HAB HAB A {REAL|REMARKABLY} LONG TIME TA GET USED TA DA IDEA!

b2.text: DA CHARGE BRINGS DA ROOF DOWN {NEATLY|CLEANLY|SQUARE} ACROSS DA CORRIDOR MOUTH. ON DA WALK BACK UP, DA TEAM LIFTS A PLATE OF WORKED METAL OUT OF DA DRAIN WALL: A STREET SIGN, OR A PRAYER!

c1.text: WHATEVER NEEDED WATCHIN' IZ UNDER DA SQUARE, IT IZ STILL DERE, AN' DA LAST NAME ON DA ROTA {NEVER GOT RELIEVED|WAZ NEVER RELIEVED}. DA TEAM RELIEVES DEM, IN DA ONLY WAY LEFT, AN' TAKES DA POST'S KIT UP!

c2.text: {many} THOUSAND NAMES IN DA SHIP'S ARCHIVE, NONE OF WHICH CAN BE PRONOUNCED. {SOMEBODY|SOMEONE} IN DA CREW STARTS READIN' DEM OUT LOUD ON DA TRIP HOME, AN' DOES NO STOP!

a1_m.text:
DA MACHINE IZ LET RUN. IT TAKES {NINE|SEVEN|ELEVEN} MINUTES, AN' IT IZ A MESSAGE, AN' IT IZ AN APOLOGY, AN' 'BOUT {TWO THIRDS|HALFWAY|MOST OF DA WAY} THROUGH IT STOPS BEING ADDRESSED TA WHOEVER WAZ IN DA SEATS AN' STARTS BEING ADDRESSED TA WHOEVER WOULD BE STANDIN' WHERE DA PARTY IZ STANDIN'.
IT DESCRIBES DEM BY {NUMBER|POSTURE|HOW MANY OF DEM DERE IZ}, AN' IT IZ CORRECT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{IT IZ COUNTIN' US.|FOUR. IT SAID FOUR.|DAT WAZ RECORDED BEFORE ANYBODY HERE WAZ BORN.}"
asides.any: {member} {SITS DOWN IN ONE OF DA SEATS|LOOKS AT DA EMPTY ROWS RATHER DEN DA STAGE|LETS IT RUN}

choices.text: LET IT FINISH AN' TAKE WHAT IT LEAVES!
ANSWER IT. IT IZ A MESSAGE; MESSAGES IZ ANSWERED!
STOP DA MACHINE BEFORE DA LAST MINUTE!

a1_reply.text:
ANSWERIN' A RECORDIN' IZ NO A SENSIBLE ACT AN' IT IZ DONE ANYWAY, IN DA SAME CONSTRUCTION, IN DA SAME ORDER, STANDIN' IN DA AISLE WIT DA SEATS {EMPTY|WATCHIN'|BEHIND}.
DA MACHINE STOPS BEFORE ITS OWN ENDIN'. IT RUNS A SECOND TRACK DAT HAB NEVER BIN PLAYED, WHICH IZ {FOUR MINUTES|SHORTER|MUCH SHORTER}, AN' WHICH IZ NO AN APOLOGY AT ALL, AN' WHICH IZ WORTH CARRYIN' HOME IN FULL!

a1_stop.text:
DA MACHINE IZ STOPPED WIT {A HAND|A LEVER|DA OBVIOUS CONTROL} AT EIGHT MINUTES AN' CHANGE, WHICH IZ DA FIRST TIME IN A REAL LONG TIME DAT ANYBODY HAB INTERRUPTED IT.
DA HALL IZ {IMMEDIATELY|AT ONCE|INSTANTLY} A DIFFERENT ROOM. DA SEATS IZ ONLY SEATS. ON DA WAY OUT, AT DA DOOR, DA LAST TINK ANYBODY HEARS IZ DA MACHINE STARTIN' AGAIN FROM DA BEGINNIN', FOR NOBODY, EXACTLY AS BEFORE!

c2_m.text:
COPYIN' DA RECORD IZ {A COUPLE OF HOURS|AN AFTERNOON|A LONG JOB} OF PHOTOGRAPHIN' WALLS, AN' SOMEWHERE IN DA THIRD HOUR DA COLUMNS STOP BEING A ROTA AN' START BEING SOMETINK ELSE: DA DATES RUN PAST DA LAST NAME AN' KEEP GOING, IN DA SAME HAND, {INTO NEXT YEAR|FORWARD|PAST TODAY}.
DA COLUMNS AHEAD IZ BLANK. DA HEADINGS IZ NO!

choices.text: COPY DA LOT AN' GO. IT IZ ONLY A RECORD!
READ DA HEADINGS OF DA COLUMNS DAT HAB NO HAPPENED!
PUT A NAME IN DA NEXT BLANK!

c2_head.text:
DA HEADINGS IZ DUTIES, AN' DEY IZ ORDINARY DUTIES: WATCHIN', FEEDIN', {TURNIN' SOMETINK|KEEPIN' SOMETINK|DA SAME THREE VERBS}, ALLOCATED IN A ROTA DAT HAB RUN WITOUT INTERRUPTION FOR AS LONG AS DA SQUARE HAB STOOD AN' HAB {FOUR|THREE} CENTURIES OF BLANKS AHEAD OF IT.
WHAT DAT IMPLIES 'BOUT DA TINK UNDER DA SQUARE IZ WRITTEN UP ON DA WAY HOME AN' IZ DA MOST-READ DOCUMENT DA FOUNDATION PUBLISHES DAT YEAR!

c2_sign.text:
A NAME GOES IN DA NEXT BLANK IN DA COLUMN, IN CHALK, BY SOMEBODY WHO SAYS AT DA TIME DAT IT IZ A JOKE.
IT IZ STILL DERE {A YEAR LATER|WHEN ANYBODY NEXT CHECKS|IN DA PHOTOGRAPHS}, IN A HAND DAT IZ NO CHALK ANY MORE. NUTTIN' COMES FOR ANYBODY. DAT IZ DA PART DAT IZ HARDEST TA LIVE WIT, OVER DA FOLLOWIN' SEASONS: NUTTIN' COMES, AN' DA ROTA GOES ON BEING CORRECT!

n0.text:
{AT {place} STANDS AN ALIEN MONUMENT DAT CLEARLY NO BELONG HERE, COMPLETELY UNTOUCHED BY DA LOCAL WEATHER.|DERE IZ AN INTACT STRUCTURE AT {place}, LOOKIN' PRISTINE DESPITE BEING IN DA MIDDLE OF A BARREN WASTELAND.|A STRANGE, SEAMLESS MONOLITH RISES OUT OF {ground}, COMPLETELY CLEAN OF DUST OR CORROSION.}
DA STEP IZ WORN, {WALKED ON|WORN BY FEET|USED}, IN A PLACE WHERE NUTTIN' WALKS!

choices.text: {WALK IN|STEP THROUGH DA ENTRANCE|CROSS DA THRESHOLD|HEAD INSIDE}!
TOSS SOME JUNK ON DA STEP!
SCAN IT FROM A SAFE DISTANCE!

n0.emText:
SOMETINK AT {place} DAT NUTTIN' HERE COULD HAB MADE AN' NUTTIN' HERE HAB TOUCHED, AN' DA GROUND AROUND IT SWEPT CLEAN BY SOMETINK DAT COMES BACK TA SWEEP IT.
IT IZ KEPT DA WAY A DIFFICULT RELATIVE'S FLAT IZ KEPT, BY SOMEBODY WHO COMES ROUND ON A TUESDAY, DOES WHAT HAB TA BE DONE, AN' LEAVES BEFORE DARK!
n0.bubba: BUBBA PUTS HIS HAT ON, WHICH HE DOES WHEN HE IZ BEING RESPECTFUL. "SOMEBODY CLEANS DIS. SO SOMEBODY'S COMIN' BACK. NUN TUCCAMMO NIENTE 'E SBAGLIATO."

a.text:
DA INSIDE IZ ONE ROOM AN' DA ROOM IZ MUCH LARGER DEN DA OUTSIDE ALLOWS. DA FAR WALL IZ {A LONG WAY OFF|FURTHER OFF DEN IT CAN BE} AN' DERE IZ A QUEUE OF {maker} STANDIN' AT IT, WIT DEY BACKS TURNED, IN PERFECT ORDER.
DEY HAB BIN STANDIN' DERE LONG ENOUGH TA HAB WORN {GROOVES|HOLLOWS} INTO DA FLOOR!

choices.text: {JOIN DA QUEUE|STAND IN LINE|WAIT YA TURN|STEP INTO FORMATION}!
{TAKE SOMETINK FROM DA WALL AN' RUN|GRAB A RELIC AN' SPRINT FOR DA DOOR|RIP HARDWARE OFF DA WALL AN' BOLT|SNATCH A PIECE AN' RETREAT}!

b.text:
{leader} PUTS A RATION TIN ON DA STEP, COZ IT IZ WHAT DERE IZ.
DA TIN IZ GONE BEFORE DA TEAM HAB WALKED TEN PACES, AN' IN ITS PLACE, ARRANGED WIT CARE, IZ A SET OF TOOLS DAT IZ DA RIGHT SIZE FOR HANDS {NOBODY|NO ONE} ABOARD HAB!

choices.text: {TAKE DA TOOLS|GRAB DA SALVAGE GEAR|POCKET DA EQUIPMENT|TAKE DA HARDWARE}!
{LEAVE DEM AN' PUT DOWN SOMETINK BETTER|TRADE FOR A BETTER OFFERIN'|LEAVE A HIGHER-VALUE ITEM|SWAP WIT A BETTER PIECE OF SCRAP}!

c.text:
{THREE HOURS OF SCANNIN'|AFTER THREE HOURS RUNNIN' DA SENSORS|THREE HOURS OF MAPPIN' DATA|LOGGIN' SENSOR SWEEPS FOR THREE HOURS} FROM {lots} METRES OUT. DA STRUCTURE HAB NO SEAMS, NO FOUNDATIONS, AN' A MASS DAT CHANGES DEPENDIN' ON WHICH WAY IT IZ MEASURED FROM.
ON DA WAY BACK, {leader} FINDS A TRACK IN {ground} DAT GOES ROUND DA WHOLE SITE. IT IZ FRESH!

choices.text: {FOLLOW DA TRACK|TRACK DA TRAIL|SHADOW DA FOOTPRINTS|FOLLOW DA PATH}!
{FILE DA SURVEY AN' LIFT|LOG DA COORDINATES AN' LIFT OFF|PACK UP DA SENSORS AN' LAUNCH|UPLOAD DA REPORT AN' EXTRACT}!

a1.text: {leader} STANDS IN LINE FOR WHAT DA SUIT CLOCK CALLS {few} MINUTES AN' DA CREW ABOVE CALLS HALF A SHIFT. AT DA FRONT DERE IZ A SLOT, AN' WHATEVER IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE OF IT TAKES ONE MEMORY AN' LEAVES SOMETINK IN ITS PLACE!

a2.text: {DA QUEUE TURNS AROUND ALL|DA WHOLE QUEUE TURNS AROUND ALL} {AT ONCE|ALL AT DA SAME TIME|TOGETHER}, AN' NONE OF DEM IZ FACIN' DA WAY FACES SHOULD FACE!

b1.text: DEY COME APART AN' GO TOGETHER IN WAYS DA SHIP'S WORKSHOP WILL BE ARGUIN' 'BOUT FOR MONTHS. TWO OF DEM IZ MISSIN' A USE {NOBODY|NO ONE} HAB FOUND YET!

b2.text:
DA SECOND OFFERIN' IZ {A PHOTOGRAPH|A PHOTOGRAPH OUT OF SOMEBODY'S LOCKER}, WHICH IZ DA MOST EXPENSIVE TINK ANYONE IZ CARRYIN'.
WHAT COMES BACK FOR IT IZ A LENGTH OF QUIET IN DA MIDDLE OF DA AWAY TEAM, AN' EVERYBODY WHO WALKS THROUGH IT COMES OUT OF IT WELL!

c1.text: DA TRACK GOES ROUND DA SITE OVER AN' OVER {AN' DEN|DEN|AN' AFTER DAT} STRAIGHT OUT TA A CACHE BURIED {A METRE|A COUPLE OF PACES|A HALF-METRE} DOWN, PACKED AN' LABELLED BY WHOEVER DOES DA SWEEPIN', AS THOUGH FOR COLLECTION!

c2.text: DA SURVEY IZ DA MOST VALUABLE DOCUMENT DA SHIP HAB FILED ALL YEAR, AN' IT WILL BE ARGUED OVER BY PEOPLE WHO WAZ NO DERE. {NUTTIN' FOLLOWS DA LANDER UP.|NUTTIN' COMES UP AFTER DA LANDER.}

b2_m.text:
DA SECOND OFFERIN' IZ {A PHOTOGRAPH|A PHOTOGRAPH OUT OF SOMEBODY'S LOCKER}, WHICH IZ DA MOST EXPENSIVE TINK ANYONE IZ CARRYIN', AN' PUTTIN' IT DOWN ON DA STEP TAKES {LONGER DEN IT SHOULD|A MOMENT|SOME DOING}.
IT IZ NO TAKEN. IT SITS DERE FOR {NINE SECONDS|A COUNT OF NINE|A WHILE}, AN' DEN IT IZ TURNED OVER, BY NUTTIN', SO DAT DA PICTURE FACES UP, AN' DEN IT IZ LEFT!

asides.nurturing: {member} DOES NO LOOK AWAY FROM DA STEP FOR DA WHOLE DA BETTER PART OF A MINUTE!
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A HAND ON DA SHOULDER OF WHOEVER OWNS DA PHOTOGRAPH|SAYS NUTTIN'|WRITES DA TIME DOWN}

choices.text: TAKE DA PHOTOGRAPH BACK AN' GO!
LEAVE IT. PUT DOWN SOMETINK TA GO WIT IT!
ASK, OUT LOUD, WHAT IT IZ FOR!

b2_pair.text:
A SECOND PHOTOGRAPH, OUT OF A DIFFERENT LOCKER, PUT DOWN BESIDE DA FIRST, FACE UP, IN DA SAME ORIENTATION.
BOTH IZ GONE IN DA MORNIN' AN' WHAT IZ ON DA STEP IN DEY PLACE IZ {LIL'|NO LARGE|'BOUT DA SIZE OF A HAND} AN' WARM, AN' EVERYBODY WHO LOOKS AT IT SEES SOMETINK DIFFERENT IN IT, AN' ALL OF DEM IZ CORRECT!

b2_ask.text:
ASKIN' A BUILDIN' A QUESTION OUT LOUD IN FRONT OF YA OWN CREW IZ {A TINK YOU ONLY DO ONCE|A DECISION|NO NUTTIN'}, AN' DA ANSWER COMES IN DA ONLY WAY DA PLACE HAB OF ANSWERIN', WHICH IZ BY EXCHANGE.
WHAT IZ PUT ON DA STEP IN REPLY IZ A PHOTOGRAPH. IT IZ OF {DIS PLACE|DA SHRINE|DA STEP}, TAKEN FROM WHERE DA PARTY IZ STANDIN', BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB NO BIN BORN YET!

c1_m.text:
DA TRACK GOES ROUND DA SITE NINE TIMES AN' DEN STRAIGHT OUT, AN' FOLLOWIN' IT TAKES {TWO HOURS|DA REST OF DA LIGHT|A LONG WALK} ACROSS GROUND DAT GETS PROGRESSIVELY HARDER TA CROSS.
IT ENDS AT A CACHE BURIED {A METRE|TWO METRES|A HALF-METRE} DOWN, PACKED AN' LABELLED BY SOMEBODY WIT A SYSTEM, AN' DA LABELS IZ IN {TWO|THREE} HANDS, AN' ONE OF DA HANDS IZ MUCH MORE RECENT DEN DA OTHER!

choices.text: DIG IT UP AN' TAKE DA LOT!
SORT DA RECENT LABELS FROM DA OLD ONES FIRST!
RE-BURY IT AN' MARK DA POSITION FOR DA SHIP!

c1_sort.text:
DA OLD HAND PACKED A CACHE. DA RECENT HAND HAB BIN {ADDIN' TA IT|KEEPIN' IT|MAINTAININ' IT}, AN' DA MOST RECENT ADDITION IZ {DIS SEASON|WEEKS OLD|NO OLD AT ALL}, AN' IT IZ A SURVIVAL KIT OF A MAKE DA PARTY RECOGNISES.
SOMEBODY HAB BIN ALIVE OUT HERE, ALONE, USING DIS CACHE, FOR A WHILE. DA PARTY LEAVES A NOTE IN IT AN' TAKES ONLY WHAT IZ SPOILIN', WHICH IZ DA CORRECT ANSWER AN' IZ NO DA PROFITABLE ONE!

c1_mark.text:
IT GOES BACK IN DA HOLE EXACTLY AS IT CAME OUT, AN' DA POSITION GOES TA DA SHIP WIT A NOTE DAT IT IZ NO TA BE LIFTED.
DAT NOTE IZ IGNORED {MOST OF A YEAR|DA FOLLOWIN' YEAR|EVENTUALLY} BY SOMEBODY ELSE'S CREW, AN' DA PARTY READS 'BOUT WHAT HAPPENED TA DEM IN A BULLETIN, AN' DOES NO SAY ANYTINK AT DA TABLE FOR A WHILE AFTERWARDS!

n0.text:
{IT IZ {tone}, BROADCASTIN' FROM {place} ON AN ENDLESS LOOP.|AN AUTOMATED TRANSMISSION ({tone}) IZ PULSIN' FROM {place} EVERY FEW SECONDS.|AN AUTOMATED TRANSMISSION ({tone}) IZ PULSIN' FROM {place} EVERY MANY SECONDS.|A RHYTHMIC SIGNAL IZ BROADCASTIN' OUT OF {place}, CLEAR AN' UNBOTHERED BY ATMOSPHERIC STATIC.}
DA LOOP IZ NO QUITE A LOOP. EVERY {NINE|ELEVEN} REPETITIONS IT {DROPS A BEAT|ADDS ONE|CHANGES IN ONE PLACE}, AN' DA CHANGE IZ NO IN DA SAME PLACE TWICE!

choices.text: {ANSWER IT IN DA SAME PATTERN|ECHO DA SIGNAL RHYTHM|TRANSMIT DA MATCHIN' CODE|MIRROR DA TRANSMISSION FREQUENCY}!
{FIND DA TRANSMITTER AN' OPEN IT|LOCATE DA BEACON AN' PRY IT OPEN|TRACK DOWN DA TRANSMITTER HATCH|DIG UP DA BROADCASTIN' UNIT}!
JAM IT.

n0.emText:
A COUNT, GOING OUT OF {place} FOR LONGER DEN DA CATALOGUE ADMITS.
COUNTS IZ DA OLDEST MAGIC DERE IZ. SOMEBODY SAID A NUMBER HERE AN' DEN KEPT SAYIN' DA NEXT ONE, AN' DA UNIVERSE TOOK IT SERIOUSLY, AN' IT HAB BIN GOING EVER SINCE LIKE A TAP SOMEBODY LEFT RUNNIN' IN AN EMPTY FLAT!
n0.bubba: "IT IZ COUNTIN'," SAYS BUBBA. "AN' IT AIN'T STOPPED FOR US. CHILL' STA' CUNTANNO PE' QUACCHEDUNO ATO."

a.text:
{leader} KEYS DA PATTERN BACK, ONE BEAT LATE, {DELIBERATELY|ON PURPOSE} WRONG IN DA LAST PLACE.
DA COUNT STOPS. DA BETTER PART OF A MINUTE LATER IT STARTS AGAIN, CORRECTED, AN' NOW IT IZ ANSWERIN' DA MISTAKE RATHER DEN REPEATIN' ITSELF!

choices.text: KEEP DA CONVERSATION GOING!
SHUT DA RADIO OFF AN' BACK AWAY!

b.text:
DA TRANSMITTER IZ BURIED IN {ground} WIT ONLY ITS COLLAR SHOWIN', AN' DA COLLAR IZ A HATCH. IT OPENS BY HAND. IT WAZ BUILT TA OPEN BY HAND.
INSIDE: A MECHANISM WIT NO MOVIN' PARTS, AN' {remnant} LAID NEATLY ON TOP OF IT, LIKE AN OFFERIN'!

choices.text: {TAKE DA MECHANISM|PRY OUT DA CORE ASSEMBLY|SALVAGE DA INTERNAL CLOCKWORK|STRIP DA MECHANISM FOR PARTS}!
{TAKE DA OFFERIN' AN' CLOSE DA HATCH|GRAB DA CACHE AN' SEAL DA LID|TAKE DA PRIZE AN' LOCK DA HATCH|POCKET DA GOODS AN' SHUT DA DOOR}!

c.text:
DA JAMMER GOES UP ON A TRIPOD AN' DA BAND FLATTENS OUT. FOR {many} MINUTES DERE IZ NUTTIN' ACROSS DA WHOLE SPECTRUM BUT DA SOUND OF DA AWAY TEAM BREATHIN'.
DEN {hazard} MAKES ITSELF FELT, AN' DA COUNT COMES BACK AT TWICE OVER DA POWER!

choices.text: {HOLD DA POSITION AN' BURN IT OUT|KEEP DA JAMMER RUNNIN' AT MAXIMUM|OVERLOAD DA FREQUENCY UNTIL IT POPS|BURN OUT DA TRANSMITTER}!
{PULL BACK TA DA LANDER|RETREAT TA DA SHIP|PACK UP AN' GET TA SAFETY|EVACUATE DA AREA}!

a1.text: IT TAKES {few} HOURS TA BUILD A SHARED COUNT AN' ANOTHER TWO TA TRADE NOUNS. WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER END IZ NO CLOSE, IZ NO ALIVE IN ANY SENSE DA TEAM CAN USE, AN' GIVES {leader} A SET OF COORDINATES AS A GIFT FOR DA TROUBLE!

a2.text: {DA RADIO GOES DARK.|DA COMMS CUT OUT COMPLETELY.|STATIC DIES ON DA CHANNEL.|DA SIGNAL FLATLINES.|DA RADIO GOES DEAD.|DA CHANNEL GOES COMPLETELY SILENT.|DEAD AIR ON DA FREQUENCY.|DA RECEIVER DROPS TA ZERO.} DA COUNT KEEPS ON OVER {ground} BEHIND DEM ALL DA WAY BACK TA DA LANDER, AN' DA TEAM WALKS DA LAST HUNDRED METRES FASTER DEN DEY WALKED DA FIRST!

b1.text: {IT LIFTS OUT EASILY.|DA ASSEMBLY SLIDES OUT SMOOTHLY.|IT POPS FREE WITOUT ANY RESISTANCE.|DA MODULE UNLATCHES CLEANLY.|IT LIFTS OUT WITOUT ANY TROUBLE.} DA COUNT STOPS, AN' EVERY INSTRUMENT DA AWAY TEAM IZ CARRYIN' REPORTS DA SAME TIME TA DA SAME TENTH OF A SECOND FOR DA FIRST TIME SINCE DEY LEFT EARTH!

b2.text: DA HATCH SHUTS {SWEETLY|CLEANLY|DA WAY IT SHOULD}, DA WAY A WELL-MADE TINK DOES. DA COUNT CARRIES ON, AN' DA TEAM GOES UP WIT SOMETINK IN A BAG DAT {NOBODY|NO ONE} HAB A WORD FOR YET!

c1.text: DA JAMMER WINS, {EVENTUALLY|IN DA END|SOONER OR LATER}, AN' DA SOURCE DIES WIT A NOISE LIKE {A HELD BREATH LET GO|A BREATH FINALLY LET OUT}. DA TEAM DIGS DA EMITTER OUT OF DA SLAG AFTERWARDS: IT IZ BEAUTIFUL, AN' IT IZ WORTH A FORTUNE!

c2.text: WHATEVER DA COUNT BELONGS TA GETS TA DA LANDER {BEFORE DA TEAM DOES|AHEAD OF DA TEAM}, AN' IT IZ STANDIN' BETWEEN DEM AN' DA HATCH WHEN DEY COME OVER DA LAST RISE!

b1_m.text:
INSIDE DA COLLAR DA MECHANISM IZ {BEAUTIFUL|ABSURDLY WELL MADE|DA WORK OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB TIME}: A COUNT, MECHANICAL, GEARED, DRIVIN' A TRANSMITTER DAT HAB BIN FED BY DA GROUND ITSELF FOR LONGER DEN ANYBODY CAN ESTIMATE.
UNDER IT, IN A RECESS, DERE IZ AN OFFERIN'. SOMETINK HAB BIN PUTTIN' ONE DERE, REGULARLY, AN' DA OLDER ONES UNDERNEATH HAB {ROTTED|GONE TA POWDER|TURNED TA NUTTIN'} AN' DA NEWEST IZ {FRESH|RECENT|DIS SEASON'S}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY FEEDS DIS.|DAT IZ MAINTENANCE, AN' IT HAB A SCHEDULE.|WE IZ STANDIN' IN SOMEBODY'S CHAPEL.}"
asides.any: {member} {COUNTS DA LAYERS IN DA RECESS|PHOTOGRAPHS DA RECESS BEFORE ANYTINK IZ TOUCHED|DOES NO REACH IN}

choices.text: TAKE DA MECHANISM. IT IZ DA VALUABLE PART!
WORK OUT HOW OFTEN DA OFFERINGS IZ LEFT!
LEAVE AN OFFERIN' OF OUR OWN AN' CLOSE DA HATCH!

b1_rate.text:
LAYER BY LAYER IT COMES OUT AT {ONCE A SEASON|MORE DEN ONCE A LOCAL YEAR|REGULARLY}, AN' DA LAYERS GO DOWN {NINE HUNDRED|A GREAT MANY|FURTHER DEN DA CORE SAMPLE}, AN' DA TOP ONE IZ NO DA LAST ONE: DERE IZ A GAP, AN' DEN DIS SEASON'S.
SOMETINK STOPPED COMIN' FOR {DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE|A DECADE|A LONG WHILE} AN' DEN STARTED AGAIN. WORKIN' OUT WHAT CHANGED IN DAT GAP IZ DA SINGLE MOST PUBLISHABLE TINK ANYBODY BRINGS BACK OFF DIS ROCK!

c1_m.text:
DA JAMMER WINS, {EVENTUALLY|IN DA END|SOONER OR LATER}, AN' DA SOURCE DIES WIT A NOISE LIKE {A HELD BREATH LET GO|A BREATH FINALLY LET OUT}, AN' DA BAND ACROSS DA WHOLE SPECTRUM GOES PROPERLY FLAT.
AN' STAYS FLAT. INCLUDIN' DA PARTY'S OWN CHANNELS, INCLUDIN' DA LANDER'S BEACON, INCLUDIN' {DA SHIP|ORBIT|DA LINK UP}, WHICH WAZ NO PART OF DA PLAN AN' DOES NO COME BACK WHEN DA JAMMER IZ SWITCHED OFF!

choices.text: DIG OUT DA EMITTER AN' GET OFF DIS ROCK!
RESTART DA COUNT. PUT IT BACK DA WAY IT WAZ!
WALK BACK TA DA LANDER WITOUT RADIO AN' WITOUT HURRYIN'!

c1_restart.text:
RESTARTIN' A MECHANICAL COUNT DAT HAB BIN RUNNIN' SINCE BEFORE DA SPECIES DAT BUILT IT HAB A WORD FOR COUNTIN' TAKES {HALF A SHIFT|DA REST OF DA DAY|A LONG TIME} AN' A GREAT DEAL OF CARE 'BOUT DA PHASE.
IT COMES UP. A BREATH OR TWO LATER SO DOES EVERYTINK ELSE: DA LANDER, DA BEACON, DA SHIP, ALL OF IT, ALL AT ONCE. NOBODY ABOARD EVER FILES A FULL ACCOUNT OF WHY DA LINK WAZ DOWN, COZ DERE IZ NO WAY TA WRITE IT DAT DOES NO SOUND LIKE AN APOLOGY TA A MACHINE!

c1_walk.text:
{FOUR KILOMETRES|A LONG WALK|DA WHOLE WAY BACK} ACROSS OPEN GROUND WIT NO RADIO, AT A DELIBERATE PACE, COZ RUNNIN' WOULD BE AN ADMISSION.
DA LANDER IZ WHERE IT WAZ LEFT. DA HATCH IZ SHUT, AN' IT WAZ LEFT OPEN, AN' IT OPENS ON A CABIN WHERE EVERY CHANNEL IZ LIVE AGAIN AN' DA COUNT IZ ON ALL OF DEM, AT {FOUR TIMES|TWICE|A GREAT DEAL MORE DEN} ITS OLD RATE!

n0.text:
{THOUSANDS OF LIL' MACHINE DRONES IZ CRAWLIN' ACROSS {ground} LIKE IRON ANTS.|A MASSIVE SWARM OF TINY AUTONOMOUS AUTOMATONS IZ BUSY DISMANTLIN' {place}.|AUTOMATED SALVAGE DRONES IZ CRAWLIN' OVER {place} IN TIGHT, SYNCHRONIZED PATTERNS.}
DEY IZ TAKIN' DA PLACE APART IN DA REVERSE OF DA ORDER IT WAZ BUILT IN, WHICH MEANS DEY HAB {DA PLANS|A COPY OF DA PLANS|SOMETINK TA WORK FROM}!

choices.text: FIGURE OUT WHAT DEY IZ UP TA!
{CATCH ONE|SNAG A DRONE WIT A NET|TRAP ONE OF DA UNITS|GRAB A SPECIMEN}!
{PUT SOMETINK IN DEY WAY|DROP AN OBSTACLE ON DEY PATH|BLOCK DEY LINE WIT A CRATE|SET DOWN A BARRIER}!

n0.emText:
THOUSANDS OF MACHINES, NONE BIGGER DEN A HAND, WORKIN' OVER {ground} AT {place} ON A JOB DAT HAB BIN RUNNIN' FOR CENTURIES.
DEY IGNORE YOU COMPLETELY. DAT IZ DA INSULT AN' DA INFORMATION: A WORK PARTY DAT HAB BIN TOLD WHAT DA JOB IZ DOES NO STOP FOR A WOMAN WIT NO PAPERS, AN' YOU HAB SPENT ELEVEN MONTHS BEING EXACTLY DAT EVERYWHERE YOU GO!
n0.bubba: BUBBA SQUATS DOWN AMONG DEM AN' LETS FOUR OF DEM WALK OVER HIS BOOT. "DEY GOT A JOB. TENENE 'A FATICA. SUGAR, NO GET IN DA WAY OF FOLKS WORKIN'."

a.text:
{TWO HOURS OF SURVEILLANCE|AFTER WATCHIN' FOR TWO HOURS|TWO SOLID HOURS OF OBSERVATION|WATCHIN' DA LINE FOR A COUPLE OF HOURS} AN' DA PATTERN COMES CLEAR. DEY IZ TAKIN' SOMETINK APART, {REAL|REMARKABLY} SLOWLY, {REAL|REMARKABLY} {CAREFULLY|WIT CARE}, AN' PUTTIN' DA PIECES IN ORDER ALONG A LINE DAT RUNS TA DA HORIZON.
DA TINK BEING TAKEN APART IZ DA WORLD!

choices.text: {FOLLOW DA LINE|TRACK DA CABLE|TRACE DA CONDUIT|FOLLOW DA ROUTE} TA DA FAR END!
TAKE A PIECE OFF DA LINE.

b.text:
IT COMES UP IN A GLOVE {WITOUT A FIGHT|WITOUT ANY ARGUMENT}, FOLDS ITS LEGS, AN' GOES STILL.
EVERY OTHER MACHINE WITHIN SIGHT STOPS AT DA SAME INSTANT, AN' STAYS STOPPED, {AN' TURNS TA FACE DA GLOVE|AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM TURNS TA FACE DA GLOVE}!

choices.text: PUT IT DOWN.
POCKET IT AN' WALK.

c.text:
{leader} SETS A SAMPLE CASE DOWN ACROSS DEY LINE AN' STEPS BACK.
DA SWARM STOPS AT IT, CONSIDERS IT FOR NINE SECONDS, {AN' DEN|DEN|AN' AFTER DAT} GOES ROUND. ON DA WAY PAST, ONE OF DEM MEASURES DA CASE AN' WRITES DA MEASUREMENT ON IT!

choices.text: {GIVE DEM SOMETINK WORTH MEASURIN'|TOSS A HIGH-TECH TOOL INTO DEY LINE|OFFER AN ALLOY SAMPLE|DROP A PIECE OF ADVANCED COMPOSITE}!
{TAKE DA CASE BACK AN' LEAVE DEM TA IT|PICK UP YA GEAR AN' WALK AWAY|RETRIEVE DA CASE AN' BACK OFF|PACK YA TOOLS AN' LEAVE}!

a1.text: DA FAR END IZ A STACK, SORTED BY MATERIAL, {TALLER DEN DA LANDER|HIGHER DEN DA LANDER}, AN' AT DA TOP OF IT IZ DA FIRST TINK DEY EVER TOOK OFF DIS WORLD, LABELLED IN A NOTATION DAT PREDATES DA SWARM!

a2.text: DA LINE CLOSES DA GAP IN {many} SECONDS AN' DOES NO REACT OTHERWISE. DA PIECE IZ A MACHINED BLOCK OF SOMETINK DA SHIP'S ASSAY NO CAN NAME, AN' DERE IZ {few} HUNDRED KILOMETRES OF DEM!

b1.text: DA MOMENT IT TOUCHES {ground} DA WHOLE FIELD GOES BACK TA WORK {AS THOUGH NUTTIN' HAPPENED|AS THOUGH NUTTIN' AT ALL HAB HAPPENED}. WHERE IT WAZ STANDIN' DERE IZ NOW A LIL' OBJECT DAT WAZ NO DERE BEFORE, AN' IT IZ A GIFT, OR A RECEIPT!

b2.text: {few} HUNDRED METRES FROM DA LANDER DA FIELD DECIDES HOW IT FEELS 'BOUT THEFT!

c1.text: DA CUTTER GOES DOWN ON DA LINE. DEY SWARM IT, MEASURE IT, TAKE IT APART, AN' PUT IT BACK TOGETHER {IMPROVED|BETTER DEN IT WAZ}, AN' LEAVE IT ON {ground} POINTIN' AT DA LANDER!

c2.text: DA CASE COMES BACK WIT A NUMBER ON IT IN A BASE {NOBODY|NO ONE} USES, {AN' DA SWARM CARRIES ON|AN' DA SWARM GOES BACK TA WORK}, AN' DA AWAY TEAM IZ UP AN' GONE BEFORE ANYBODY HAB TA FIND OUT WHAT DA NUMBER MEANS!

a1_m.text:
DA FAR END OF DA LINE IZ A STACK, SORTED BY MATERIAL, {TALLER DEN DA LANDER|HIGHER DEN DA LANDER}, AN' IT HAB BIN GROWIN' FOR A REAL LONG TIME.
AT DA TOP OF IT, ALONE ON A LEVELLED PLATFORM, IZ DA FIRST TINK DEY EVER TOOK OFF DIS WORLD, AN' IT HAB BIN {KEPT|SET ASIDE|PUT SOMEWHERE IT CAN BE SEEN}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DAT IZ A MONUMENT.|EVERYTINK ELSE IZ SORTED. DAT IZ DISPLAYED.|DEY KEPT DA FIRST ONE.}"
asides.any: {member} {WORKS OUT DA HEIGHT OF DA STACK|COUNTS DA MATERIAL BANDS DOWN DA SIDE|LOOKS AT DA PLATFORM RATHER DEN DA OBJECT}

choices.text: CLIMB IT AN' TAKE DA TINK OFF DA TOP!
READ DA STACK FROM DA BOTTOM UP!
ADD SOMETINK OF OURS TA DA STACK IN DA RIGHT BAND!

a1_read.text:
DA BANDS GOING UP DA STACK IZ DA MATERIALS OF DIS WORLD IN DA ORDER DEY WAZ TAKEN, AN' DA ORDER IZ DA ORDER A BUILDER DISMANTLES IN, AN' DA LAST BAND IZ {HALF FINISHED|THIN|ONLY JUST STARTED}.
WHICH MEANS DEY IZ NEARLY DONE, AN' WHAT HAPPENS TA A SWARM DAT FINISHES IZ A QUESTION WIT {TWO|THREE} POSSIBLE ANSWERS, AN' DA PARTY HAB 'BOUT {A SEASON|A YEAR|NO LONG} TA DECIDE WHO TA SELL DAT QUESTION TA!

a1_give.text:
A PLATE OFF DA LANDER'S OWN SKIN, CUT TA SIZE, CARRIED TA DA STACK AN' SET INTO DA CORRECT MATERIAL BAND BY HAND WHILE DA LINE GOES ROUND DA PARTY'S BOOTS.
DA SWARM STOPS. ALL OF IT, EVERYWHERE, FOR {NINE SECONDS|A COUNT OF NINE|DA LENGTH OF DA PLACEMENT}. DEN IT GOES BACK TA WORK, AN' DA PLATE STAYS WHERE IT WAZ PUT, AN' ONE DRONE FOLLOWS DA PARTY TA DA LANDER AN' DOES NO COME ABOARD AN' DOES NO LEAVE!

c1_m.text:
DA CUTTER GOES DOWN ON DA LINE. DEY SWARM IT, MEASURE IT, TAKE IT APART, AN' PUT IT BACK TOGETHER {IMPROVED|BETTER DEN IT WAZ}, AN' LEAVE IT ON {ground} POINTIN' AT DA PARTY.
DA IMPROVEMENT ADDS SOMETINK. DERE IZ A COMPONENT IN IT DAT WAZ NO IN IT BEFORE, AN' DA COMPONENT IZ {GROWN|DA SAME MATERIAL AS DA SWARM|PART OF ONE OF DEM}!

choices.text: PICK IT UP. A BETTER CUTTER IZ A BETTER CUTTER!
TAKE DA NEW COMPONENT OUT BEFORE USING IT!
PUT ANOTHER TOOL DOWN AN' SEE WHAT DEY DO WIT DAT ONE!

c1_part.text:
IT COMES OUT CLEANLY, WHICH IZ ITSELF INFORMATIVE, AN' UNDER DA GLASS IT IZ {ONE OF DEM|A DRONE|A MEMBER OF DA SWARM}, FOLDED DOWN TA DA SIZE OF A COMPONENT AN' DOING DA JOB DA COMPONENT DID.
DA CUTTER STILL WORKS WITOUT IT. DA TINK IN DA JAR IZ WORTH CONSIDERABLY MORE DEN DA CUTTER AN' WILL BE DA SUBJECT OF {FOUR|FIVE} PAPERS, ALL OF WHICH DISAGREE 'BOUT WHETHER IT WAZ A GIFT OR A PASSENGER!

c1_keep.text:
TAKIN' IT OUT GOES WRONG IN DA WAY DAT TINKZ GO WRONG WHEN YOU DO NO KNOW WHAT YOU IZ HOLDIN', AN' WHAT COMES OUT IZ {IN PIECES|NO LONGER WHOLE|DEAD, IF DAT IZ DA WORD}.
DA CUTTER IZ WORSE DEN IT WAZ BEFORE DA SWARM TOUCHED IT. DA LINE GOES ROUND IT NOW RATHER DEN TOWARDS IT, AN' NUTTIN' ON DIS ROCK WILL COME NEAR DA PARTY FOR DA REST OF DA SURVEY!

c1_more.text:
A SECOND TOOL GOES DOWN, DEN A THIRD, DEN A RATION TIN, DEN A HELMET, AN' EACH COMES BACK {IMPROVED|ALTERED|BETTER} IN A WAY DAT IZ MORE SPECIFIC TA ITS OWNER DEN DA LAST ONE.
BY DA FOURTH IT IZ UNMISTAKABLE: DEY IZ LEARNIN' DA PARTY, ONE OBJECT AT A TIME, AN' DA HELMET COMES BACK WIT AN ADJUSTMENT IN IT DAT NOBODY HAB EVER MENTIONED TA ANYBODY!

e_ocean.title: {DA BELL BUOY DAT IZ NO ON DA CHART|SOMETINK IZ RINGIN' OUT DERE|A DOOR PAINTED ON A CAN}

n0.emText: {A BELL IZ CLANGIN' OUT ACROSS DA WATER WIT AN ANNOYIN', REPETITIVE RHYTHM. DA BUOY IZ BOBBIN' IN DA CHOP WIT A LADDER WELDED ON AN' A FAKE DOOR PAINTED ONTO DA STEEL. IN DIS LINE OF WORK, WEIRD DOORS IZ USUALLY TROUBLE.|DA BUOY RINGS OUT OVER DA SWELL. UP CLOSE IT HAB A LADDER AN' A PAINTED DOOR WIT A REAL HANDLE. DEFINITELY SUSPICIOUS.}
n0.bubba: BUBBA LEANS OVER DA RAIL WIT HIS HAT IN HIS HAND. "SUGAR, DAT IZ A DOOR ON A CAN. UH-UH. BACK HOME WE GOT A WORD FOR OPENIN' DAT, AN' DA WORD IZ {FUNERALE|STUPIDAGGINE}."

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX THREE TIMES AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}

asides.melancholic: {member} SAYS BELLS AT SEA USED TA MEAN SOMEBODY WAZ BEING COUNTED, AN' STOPS DERE!
asides.mischievous: {member} {GRINS: "DIBS ON WHATEVER LOOKS SHINY AN' DANGEROUS."|IZ ALREADY TRYIN' TA PICK DA MAINTENANCE LOCK WIT A WIRE|WONDERS ALOUD WHAT HAPPENS IF WE PRESS ALL DA BUTTONS AT ONCE|SMIRKS AN' TAPS DA CONSOLE TA SEE IF IT SPARKS}

choices.text: COME ALONGSIDE AN' CLIMB DA LADDER!
CIRCLE IT ONCE AN' READ EVERYTINK WRITTEN ON IT!
CUT DA BUOY LOOSE AN' TOW IT IN!
LOG DA POSITION AN' GO ON!

a.text:
DA LADDER IZ WARM. SUSPICIOUS.
DA PAINTED DOOR HAB A PAINTED HANDLE, AN' WHEN YOU TAKE HOLD OF DA PAINT YA HAND CLOSES ON BRASS. INSIDE IZ A STAIRWELL, DRY, LIT, GOING DOWN FURTHER DEN DA WATER IZ DEEP. {SOUND|SOMEWHERE BELOW, A RADIO PLAYIN' UNDER A FLOOR} COMES UP DA STAIRS TA MEET YOU!
a.bubba: "WELL, MADONNA SANTA," SAYS BUBBA, TESTIN' DA TOP STEP WIT HIS BOOT. "STAIRS IN DA OCEAN. JAMME, DEN. YOU FIRST, ON ACCOUNTA YOU FLOAT BETTER."

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.stoic: {member} {SAYS NUTTIN' AN' CHECKS DA SEALS ON DEY SUIT|NODS ONCE AN' TAKES UP A DEFENSIVE POSITION|STANDS GUARD BY DA DOOR, COMPLETELY SILENT|KEEPS DEY EYES ON DA HORIZON WITOUT A WORD}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO ALL DA WAY DOWN.
TAKE WHAT IZ ON DA FIRST LANDIN' AN' GET OUT!

b.text:
THREE LANGUAGES, FOUR HANDS, AN' ONE OF DEM RECENT.
A NAME AN' A DATE, TWICE. A TIDE TABLE FOR A PORT DAT DOES NO EXIST. A PHONE NUMBER WIT DA {BRITANNIA|VARLENIA|COLLECTIVE} CODE. AN' UNDER DA WATERLINE, WHERE YOU HAB TA HANG OFF DA LADDER TA READ IT: {rumour}!

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: RING DA NUMBER FROM DA BOAT'S SET!
NOTE IT ALL DOWN AN' SELL DA NOTES TA SOMEBODY WHO WANTS DEM!

c.text:
IT CUTS EASIER DEN IT SHOULD, AN' IT TOWS LIKE SOMETINK DAT WANTS TA COME.
HALF A MILE IN, DA BELL STOPS. TWO MILES IN, {A CORMORANT|A GULL|SOMETINK WIT TOO MANY JOINTS} LANDS ON IT AN' STAYS DERE, FACIN' DA WAY YOU CAME. DA HARBOURMASTER AT {region} TAKES ONE LOOK AN' PAYS YOU TA TAKE IT AWAY AGAIN!

d.text:
YOU WRITE DA POSITION IN DA LOG WIT DA TIME NEXT TA IT AN' YOU GO ON.
DA BEST PART OF A WEEK LATER, IN A BAR IN {region}, A MAN WHO SAYS HE IZ A HYDROGRAPHER BUYS DA PAGE OFF YOU. HE DOES NO WANT DA PAGE. HE WANTS TA KNOW IF DA BELL WAZ RINGIN' ON DA SWELL OR AGAINST IT.
AGAINST IT, YOU TELL HIM. HE PAYS YOU AN' LEAVES WITOUT HIS COAT!

a1.text:
ELEVEN LANDINGS DOWN, DA STAIRWELL OPENS INTO A ROOM WIT A TABLE, A CHAIR, A LAMP AN' A SEA CHART WIT YA OWN COURSE PENCILLED ON IT IN A HAND YOU DO NO KNOW, ENDIN' WHERE YOU IZ STANDIN'.
ON DA TABLE, IN {relicWord}, IZ DA TINK DA BELL WAZ FOR!
a1.emText:
ELEVEN LANDINGS DOWN DERE IZ A TABLE, A CHAIR, A LAMP, AN' A CHART WIT YA OWN COURSE ALREADY DRAWN ON IT, ENDIN' UNDER YA FEET. DA PENCIL IZ STILL WARM. NINETY-TWO PER CENT OF YA LIFE IZ FILED SOMEWHERE YOU NO CAN GET TA AN' SOMEBODY DOWN HERE HAB BETTER RECORDS DEN YOU DO.
ON DA TABLE, IN {relicWord}, IZ DA TINK DA BELL WAZ RINGIN' FOR. IT IZ NO A SPELLBOOK. YOU CHECK TWICE!
a1.bubba: "NO TOUCH DA CHART," SAYS BUBBA, TOUCHIN' DA CHART. "MANNAGGIA. OKAY. TOUCHED IT."

a2.text:
DA FIRST LANDIN' IZ A STORE: ROPE, TINNED FOOD, A CRATE OF LAMP OIL, AN' FOUR BOXES OF DA KIND OF HARDWARE NOBODY SELLS TA A BOAT.
YOU TAKE WHAT TWO OF YOU CAN CARRY AN' YOU IZ BACK IN DAYLIGHT BEFORE DA TIDE TURNS, WHICH IZ DA ONLY SENSIBLE TINK ANYBODY HAB DONE ALL WEEK!

b1.text:
IT RINGS FOUR TIMES. DEN A WOMAN'S VOICE, FLAT AS A CHART DATUM, SAYS A BEARIN', A DEPTH AN' A TIME, AN' HANGS UP.
YOU IZ AT DAT BEARIN' AT DAT TIME COZ YOU IZ DA KIND OF CREW DAT TURNS UP. SOMETINK COMES UP OUT OF DA DARK TA MEET DA BOAT, AN' IT IZ NO INTERESTED IN TALKIN' 'BOUT IT!

asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.timid: {member} ASKS, REASONABLY, WHETHER ANYBODY WROTE DOWN WHERE WE IZ!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b2.text:
DA FOUNDATION OFFICE IN {region} TAKES DA WHOLE NOTEBOOK, GIVES YOU A RECEIPT IN A LANGUAGE DAT IZ NO ONE OF DA FOUR ON DA BUOY, AN' PAYS YOU FOR IT IN {coin}.
DEY ASK YOU TA STOP WRITIN' TINKZ DOWN. DEY ASK IT REAL POLITELY!

c_m.text:
IT CUTS EASIER DEN IT SHOULD, AN' IT TOWS LIKE SOMETINK DAT WANTS TA COME, AN' HALF A MILE IN DA BELL STOPS.
TWO MILES IN DA TOW GOES {LIGHT|SLACK|WEIGHTLESS}, AS THOUGH DA BUOY HAB STOPPED BEING IN DA WATER WITOUT STOPPIN' BEING ON DA END OF DA LINE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{CUT IT. CUT IT NOW.|NUTTIN' TOWS LIKE DAT.|DAT TINK IZ COMIN' ON ITS OWN.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A HAND ON DA TOW AN' TAKES IT OFF AGAIN|WATCHES DA WAKE WHERE DA BUOY SHOULD BE|GOES AFT WITOUT BEING ASKED}

choices.text: KEEP TOWIN'. IT IZ SALVAGE AN' SALVAGE IZ MONEY!
GET DA LINE OFF AN' LET IT GO!
TAKE A BEARIN' ON WHERE DA WEIGHT WENT!

c_cut.text:
DA LINE GOES OVER DA SIDE AN' DA BUOY IZ ASTERN AN' {DEN IT IZ NO|DEN IT IZ NO ASTERN|DEN DA WATER IZ EMPTY}, INSIDE DA LENGTH OF TIME IT TAKES TA COIL A ROPE.
DA BELL STARTS AGAIN 'BOUT {FOUR HUNDRED METRES|A CABLE|SOME DISTANCE} OFF DA PORT BOW, WHICH IZ DA WRONG SIDE, AN' KEEPS STATION DERE UNTIL DA COAST COMES UP!

c_bear.text:
TWO BEARINGS, FOUR MINUTES APART, OFF A BOAT DAT IZ MAKIN' WAY: IT IZ ROUGH WORK AN' IT GIVES A POSITION, AN' DA POSITION IZ {ELEVEN MILES|A LONG WAY|WELL} OFF DA TOW LINE AN' IZ IN WATER DA CHART CALLS {FOUR HUNDRED FATHOMS|DEEP|UNSOUNDED}.
DA BUOY COMES IN ON DA END OF DA LINE AN HOUR LATER, WET, ORDINARY, AN' WORTH WHAT A BUOY IZ WORTH. DA POSITION IZ WORTH CONSIDERABLY MORE AN' DERE IZ {THREE|FOUR} OFFICES DAT WILL PAY FOR IT!

d_m.text:
YOU WRITE DA POSITION IN DA LOG WIT DA TIME NEXT TA IT AN' YOU GO ON, AN' DAT IZ DA WHOLE OF IT FOR {A COUPLE OF DAYS|A DAY AN' A HALF|DA REST OF DA PASSAGE}.
IN A BAR IN {region} A MAN WHO SAYS HE IZ A HYDROGRAPHER OFFERS TA BUY DA PAGE. HE HAB DA MONEY ON DA TABLE BEFORE DA SENTENCE IZ FINISHED AN' HE KNOWS WHICH PAGE IT IZ WITOUT BEING TOLD!

choices.text: SELL HIM DA PAGE.
FIND OUT HOW HE KNEW WHICH PAGE!
KEEP DA LOG. SELL HIM A DRINK INSTEAD!

d_how.text:
HE IZ NO A HYDROGRAPHER AN' HE DOES NO PRETEND TA BE ONE FOR LONGER DEN {A COUPLE OF QUESTIONS|A MINUTE|IT TAKES}, AN' WHAT HE IZ IZ DA THIRD MAN DIS YEAR SENT ROUND DA COAST BARS BUYIN' PAGES OUT OF LOGS.
WHO SENDS DEM IZ WORTH KNOWIN'. HE GIVES IT UP IN EXCHANGE FOR DA PAGE, WHICH HE GETS, AN' BOTH SIDES CONSIDER IT A GOOD EVENIN''S WORK!

d_keep.text:
DA PAGE STAYS IN DA LOG, DA DRINK IZ BOUGHT, AN' HE TAKES IT AN' IZ PLEASANT 'BOUT DA WHOLE TINK AN' LEAVES BEFORE CLOSIN'.
DA LOG IZ IN DA WHEELHOUSE. DA PAGE IZ NO IN IT IN DA MORNIN', AN' NO LOCK HAB BIN TOUCHED, AN' DA ENTRY EITHER SIDE OF DA GAP IZ UNDISTURBED IN A WAY DAT IZ {WORSE|MORE UNPLEASANT|HARDER TA TINK 'BOUT} DEN A TORN SPINE WOULD BE!

a2_m.text:
DA FIRST LANDIN' IZ A STORE: ROPE, TINNED FOOD, A CRATE OF LAMP OIL, AN' FOUR BOXES OF DA KIND OF HARDWARE NOBODY SELLS TA A BOAT.
IT IZ ALL {DATED|STAMPED|MARKED}, AN' DA DATES IZ RECENT, AN' DA OLDEST TINK ON DA LANDIN' IZ {A FORTNIGHT|THREE WEEKS|NO OLD}. SOMEBODY RESTOCKS DIS, FROM BELOW, AN' DA STAIRWELL GOES DOWN ELEVEN LANDINGS!

choices.text: TAKE WHAT TWO OF YOU CAN CARRY AN' GO!
READ DA STAMPS ON DA HARDWARE BOXES!
LEAVE PAYMENT ON DA LANDIN' FOR WHAT YOU TAKE!

a2_stamp.text:
DA STAMPS IZ NAVAL, AN' DEY IZ CURRENT, AN' DA CONTRACT NUMBER ON DA SIDE OF DA CRATE IZ ONE DAT IZ {STILL RUNNIN'|LIVE|BEING INVOICED AGAINST DIS YEAR}.
SOMEBODY IZ SUPPLYIN' A STAIRWELL INSIDE A BUOY IN WATER DA CHART SAYS IZ EMPTY. DAT IZ NO A SALVAGE JOB AN' IT IZ NO A STORY FOR A BAR, AN' DA PARTY TAKES DA BOXES AN' DA NUMBERS BOTH!

a2_pay.text:
COINS ON DA CRATE, COUNTED OUT AT WHAT DA GOODS IZ WORTH ASHORE AN' DEN A BIT OVER, WHICH EVERYBODY IN DA BOAT AGREES AFTERWARDS WAZ EITHER {SENSIBLE|SUPERSTITION|GOOD MANNERS} AN' NONE OF DEM WILL SAY WHICH.
DA MONEY IZ GONE DA NEXT TIME ANYBODY LOOKS, AN' IN ITS PLACE DERE IZ A CHART, FOLDED, OF WATER DA PARTY HAB NO SAILED YET, WIT DA SAFE LINE ON IT MARKED IN PENCIL!

e_fields.title: {DA STANDIN' CROP|DA SQUARE DEY NEVER CUT|{lots} PACES ON A SIDE}

n0.text:
DA FIELD WAZ CUT A MONTH AGO. ONE SQUARE OF IT IZ STILL STANDIN'.
{lots} PACES ON A SIDE, CORNERS SHARPER DEN ANY PLOUGH HAB EVER MANAGED, AN' INSIDE IT {sound_field}. OUTSIDE IT, IN DA STUBBLE, NUTTIN' AT ALL IZ MOVIN', NO EVEN DA {CROWS|GULLS|PIGEONS} DAT OUGHT TA BE HERE.
DERE IZ A GATE, AN' A FARMHOUSE {distance}, AN' A TRACTOR PARKED EXACTLY WHERE SOMEBODY STOPPED IT.
DA STANDIN' SQUARE IZ {EXACTLY|PRECISELY} SQUARE, AN' DA CORNERS POINT AT DA COMPASS POINTS, AN' DA FARM DOES NO!
n0.emText:
ONE SQUARE OF CROP STILL STANDIN' IN A CUT FIELD, SIDES TOO STRAIGHT TA BE AN ACCIDENT, AN' YOU CAN FEEL IT DA WAY YOU FEEL A HELD NOTE: SOMETINK IN DERE HAB BIN LEFT DELIBERATELY UNHARVESTED, DA WAY YOU WAZ LEFT DELIBERATELY UNFINISHED.
INSIDE IT {sound_field}. OUTSIDE, DA STUBBLE IZ NO DOING ANYTINK AT ALL. DA TRACTOR IZ PARKED WHERE SOMEBODY STOPPED IT AN' GOT OUT AN' DID NO COME BACK FOR IT!
n0.bubba: BUBBA SQUINTS AT DA CORNERS. "DAT IZ SURVEYED, SUGAR. SOMEBODY PAID A FELLA WIT A STICK AN' A CHAIN. UH-HUH. DAT AIN'T FAIRIES, DAT IZ PAPERWORK."

choices.text: WALK INTO DA MIDDLE OF IT!
GO AN' FIND WHOEVER FARMS DIS!
CUT A SHEAF AN' TAKE IT AWAY!
BURN IT, AN' STAND UPWIND!

a.text:
DA STALKS {LEAN AWAY|PART|BEND ASIDE} AS YOU COME ON AN' CLOSE AGAIN BEHIND YOU, POLITELY, LIKE A CROWD LETTIN' SOMEBODY THROUGH TA DA FRONT.
IN DA MIDDLE DERE IZ A PATCH OF BARE PACKED EARTH WIT A HOLLOW IN IT, 'BOUT DA SIZE OF {A SLEEPIN' DOG|A SLEEPIN' CHILD|SOMETINK DAT SLEEPS CURLED UP}. IT IZ WARM. DA CROP AROUND DA HOLLOW HAB COME UP A SECOND TIME DIS YEAR, OUT OF SEASON, AN' IT HAB COME UP HEAVY!
