choices.text: LIE DOWN IN DA HOLLOW.
DIG IT OUT.
FILL IT IN AN' WALK AWAY.

b.text:
DA FARMHOUSE SMELLS OF {smell}. DA MAN DERE DOES NO WANT TA TALK 'BOUT DA SQUARE.
HE WANTS TA TALK 'BOUT HIS FATHER, WHO LEFT IT STANDIN' FOR {lots} YEARS, AN' 'BOUT DA TWO DRY SUMMERS DAT FOLLOWED DA ONE TIME IT GOT CUT. HE TALKS WIT HIS HANDS FLAT ON DA TABLE, DA WAY YOU TALK WHEN DA TABLE IZ DA ONLY STEADY TINK IN DA ROOM.
HE WILL PAY FOR IT TA BE LEFT ALONE. HE WILL PAY A GOOD DEAL MORE IF SOMEBODY WILL GO IN AN' LOOK AN' COME BACK AN' TELL HIM IT IZ NUTTIN'!
b.bubba: BUBBA IZ ALREADY EATIN' DIS MAN'S BREAD. "SIGNO', NO YOU FRET. WE IZ PROFESSIONALS. MOSTLY HER. UH-HUH."

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TAKE HIS MONEY TA LEAVE IT STANDIN'!
TAKE HIS MONEY TA GO AN' LOOK!
TAKE HIS TOOLS AN' CUT IT FLAT!

c.text:
DA SHEAF COMES AWAY EASILY, LIKE SOMETINK HANDED OVER.
IT STAYS GREEN FOR {many} DAYS IN A PACK WHERE BREAD GOES MOULDY IN THREE. DA GRAIN IZ HEAVIER DEN DA GRAIN AROUND IT AN' IT SEEDS TRUE. DA AGRICULTURAL OFFICE IN {region} TAKES DA WHOLE SHEAF, ASKS NO QUESTIONS WORTH ANSWERIN', AN' PAYS ON DA SPOT RATHER DEN BY DA USUAL CHEQUE IN APRIL!

e.text:
IT GOES UP LIKE IT WAZ WAITIN' TA.
DA FIRE KEEPS DA SQUARE. IT BURNS TA DA EXACT EDGE AN' STOPS, AN' WHAT WALKS OUT OF DA MIDDLE OF IT IZ ON FIRE TOO, AN' DOES NO APPEAR TA CONSIDER DAT A PROBLEM WORTH DISCUSSIN' WIT YOU!

asides.aggressive: "DERE," SAYS {member}, WIT ENORMOUS SATISFACTION, 'BOUT A COUPLE OF SECONDS TOO EARLY!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

a1.text:
IT IZ DA LENGTH OF A PERSON AN' IT FITS DA WAY A COAT FITS WHEN SOMEBODY HAB HAB IT MADE FOR YOU.
{leader} IZ OUT FOR {many} MINUTES BY DA WATCH AN' COMES UP WIT A TASTE OF COPPER, A SCAR CLOSED DAT HAB BIN OPEN SINCE DA SPRING, AN' EVERYBODY STANDIN' OVER DEM LOOKIN' RESTED FOR DA FIRST TIME IN A MONTH!
a1.emText:
IT IZ DA LENGTH OF A PERSON, AN' IT FITS YOU DA WAY NUTTIN' HAB FITTED YOU SINCE DA FIRST OF JANUARY.
YOU IZ OUT FOR {many} MINUTES. YOU GET BACK DA SHAPE OF A MEMORY, DA DENT WHERE IT WAZ, AN' SOMETINK IN DA FIELD TURNS OVER IN ITS SLEEP AN' GIVES YOU BACK A SCAR CLOSED AN' A NIGHT'S REST YOU DID NO PAY FOR!
a1.bubba: BUBBA IZ HOLDIN' YA HAT WHEN YOU COME UP. "NAH, NO SAY NOTHIN'. YOU WAZ SMILIN'. AIN'T SEEN DAT. UH-UH."

a2.text:
{A FOOT DOWN|TWO FEET DOWN|HALF A SPADE DOWN}, DA EARTH STOPS BEING EARTH.
WHAT COMES UP OUT OF DA HOLLOW HAB SLEPT THROUGH SEVERAL HARVESTS AN' IT WANTS {DA REST OF ITS YEAR|DA REST OF DA YEAR IT IZ OWED|DA WINTER IT WAZ PROMISED}. IT IZ WORSE DEN ANGRY: IT IZ AWAKE EARLY!

a3.text:
YOU FILL DA HOLLOW WIT DA LOOSE EARTH AROUND IT AN' TREAD IT DOWN, AN' DA CROP CLOSES OVER DA TOP OF IT, AN' DA FIELD LETS YOU LEAVE.
DA FARMER WILL NO TAKE A PENNY BACK OFF YOU. IN DA YARD HE GIVES YOU {payment} INSTEAD AN' STANDS IN DA ROAD WATCHIN' UNTIL YOU IZ OUT OF SIGHT!

b1.text:
HE PAYS IN NOTES HIS FATHER KEPT BACK FROM {THREE|TWO|FOUR} GOOD YEARS, AN' SHAKES EVERY HAND TWICE.
DA SQUARE IZ STILL STANDIN'. EVERYTINK AROUND IT WILL BE, TOO, AN' IN A BAD YEAR THREE VILLAGES WILL NO KNOW WHY DEY CAME THROUGH IT!

b2.text:
YOU CUT IT IN AN AFTERNOON, WIT HIS OWN MACHINE, AN' HE WATCHES FROM DA GATE WIT HIS CAP IN HIS HANDS.
DA GRAIN FILLS MORE SACKS DEN DA FIELD HAB ANY BUSINESS FILLIN'. IT SELLS FOR A GREAT DEAL. DA FOLLOWIN' SPRING IZ REAL DRY, AN' DA SPRING AFTER DAT IZ WORSE, AN' NOBODY IN DAT PARISH EVER SAYS YA NAME OUT LOUD AGAIN, THOUGH DEY ALL KNOW IT!

c_m.text:
DA SHEAF COMES AWAY EASILY, LIKE SOMETINK HANDED OVER, AN' IT STAYS GREEN IN A PACK WHERE BREAD GOES MOULDY IN DA BEST PART OF A WEEK.
ON DA FOURTH DAY IT HAB {PUT OUT A ROOT|ROOTED|STARTED GROWIN'} THROUGH DA CANVAS, INTO WHATEVER IZ UNDER DA PACK, AN' IT IZ NO FUSSY 'BOUT WHAT DAT IZ!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DAT IZ A PASSENGER.|DAT HAB GONE THROUGH DA PACK.|WHATEVER WE TOOK, IT IZ STILL FARMIN'.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS DA SHEAF IN A TIN|HOLDS IT UP TA DA LIGHT|CUTS DA ROOT AN' WATCHES IT GO AGAIN}

choices.text: KEEP IT. SELL IT. SOMEBODY WILL PAY!
PLANT IT SOMEWHERE IT CAN BE WATCHED!
TAKE IT BACK TA DA SQUARE AN' PUT IT WHERE IT CAME FROM!

c_plant.text:
A POT, A FRAME, A WALL TA STAND IT AGAINST, AN' {FOUR MONTHS|A SEASON|A WINTER} OF WRITIN' DOWN WHAT IT DOES.
WHAT IT DOES IZ GROW IN A SQUARE: IT PUTS OUT ONE RUNNER IN EACH OF FOUR DIRECTIONS AT DA COMPASS POINTS, EXACTLY, AN' BY SPRING DERE IZ A {NINE-PACE|LIL'|PERFECT} SQUARE OF IT AN' DA GROUND INSIDE DA SQUARE IZ DA BEST GROUND ON DA PLOT!

c_spread.text:
IT GOES IN DA GROUND IN A CORNER OF SOMEWHERE DA PARTY IZ STAYIN', WHICH IZ A DECISION MADE IN {A COUPLE OF SECONDS|HASTE|DA WAY DEZE DECISIONS IZ MADE}.
BY DA {THIRD WEEK|MONTH|SPRING} IT HAB A SQUARE OF ITS OWN AN' DA SQUARE HAB TAKEN IN A WALL, HALF A SHED AN' SOMEBODY'S WASHIN' LINE, AN' DA PEOPLE WHO LIVE DERE HAB STOPPED USING DAT END OF DA GARDEN AN' WILL NO SAY WHY!

c_back.text:
IT IZ {A COUPLE OF DAYS|A LONG WAY|TWO DAYS} BACK TA DA FIELD AN' DA SHEAF IZ PUT DOWN INSIDE DA SQUARE, IN DA STANDIN' CROP, WHICH CLOSES OVER IT {POLITELY|DA WAY IT CLOSED BEFORE|WITOUT COMMENT}.
DA FARMER SEES DA PARTY AT DA GATE AN' DOES NO ASK. HE DOES PUT A HAND UP. DAT AUTUMN DA SQUARE IZ DA ONLY TINK IN THREE COUNTIES DAT DOES NO TAKE DA BLIGHT, AN' EVERYTINK WITHIN A MILE OF IT IZ {CLEAN|UNTOUCHED|FINE}!

e_m.text:
IT GOES UP LIKE IT WAZ WAITIN' TA, AN' DA FIRE KEEPS DA SQUARE: IT BURNS TA DA EXACT EDGE AN' STOPS.
WHAT WALKS OUT OF DA MIDDLE OF IT IZ ON FIRE TOO AN' DOES NO APPEAR TA MIND, AN' IT WALKS {A COUPLE OF PACES|A SHORT WAY|OUT} AN' DEN STOPS AN' {WAITS|STANDS|DOES NUTTIN' AT ALL}, WHICH IZ NO WHAT ANYBODY WAZ BRACED FOR!

choices.text: PUT IT DOWN.
STAND STILL AN' LET IT BE ON FIRE!
PUT DA FIRE OUT. ALL OF IT, INCLUDIN' DAT!

e_wait.text:
IT BURNS FOR {A GOOD WHILE|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|A LONG TIME} WITOUT GOING ANYWHERE AN' WITOUT GOING OUT, AN' EVERYBODY STANDS UPWIND AN' NOBODY RAISES ANYTINK.
WHEN IT STOPS BURNIN' DERE IZ A PERSON STANDIN' IN DA ASH, WHO IZ {NOBODY'S|NO ANYBODY'S} IDEA OF A PERSON, AN' WHO SAYS ONE SENTENCE 'BOUT DA FIELD AN' DEN LIES DOWN IN DA HOLLOW AN' DOES NO GET UP AGAIN!

e_out.text:
BEATIN' OUT A CROP FIRE WIT COATS AT DA EDGE OF A SQUARE DAT IZ BURNIN' TA ITS OWN LINE, AN' DEN GOING IN AFTER DA TINK IN DA MIDDLE OF IT WIT DA SAME COATS.
IT LETS DEM. DA FIRE GOES OUT. WHAT IZ LEFT IZ STANDIN' DERE SMOKIN' WIT {DA WHOLE SQUARE|FOUR ACRES|EVERYTINK} BLACK AROUND IT, AN' IT WALKS WIT DA PARTY AS FAR AS DA GATE AN' DEN GOES BACK AN' SITS DOWN IN DA MIDDLE OF ITS OWN ASH!

e_meadows.title: {DA LONG GRASS NOBODY CUTS|FOUR ACRES LEFT STANDIN'|DA BENCH BY DA STONE}

n0.text:
DA MEADOW HAB NO BIN CUT IN YEARS, AN' IT SHOULD HAB BIN: IT IZ GOOD GROUND, AN' DERE IZ A FARM ON IT, AN' DA FARM IZ WORKIN'.
WHAT STOPS DA MOWER IZ HALFWAY OUT: A STONE, WAIST-HIGH, WIT A BENCH NEXT TA IT, AN' DA BENCH IZ NEW. SOMEBODY REPLACES DAT BENCH. SOMEBODY HAB BIN REPLACIN' IT FOR A WHILE, JUDGIN' BY DA FOUR SETS OF POST HOLES.
{smell}, AN' IN DA GRASS, {sound}.
DERE IZ A SECOND BENCH, FURTHER OUT, {ROTTED TA NUTTIN'|ALMOST GONE|DOWN TA ITS LEGS}, ON DA SAME LINE!
n0.emText:
GOOD GROUND, UNCUT FOR YEARS, AN' A STONE IN DA MIDDLE OF IT WIT A BENCH NEXT TA IT DAT SOMEBODY KEEPS REPLACIN'.
YOU CAN FEEL DA SHAPE OF DA ARRANGEMENT WITOUT BEING TOLD: DIS IZ A PLACE WHERE A TINK WAZ AGREED, AN' DA AGREEMENT IZ STILL RUNNIN', AN' DA GRASS IZ DA PAYMENT. YOU KNOW 'BOUT AGREEMENTS YOU NO CAN REMEMBER MAKIN'!
n0.bubba: "SOMEBODY'S GRANDMA SITS HERE," SAYS BUBBA, SITTIN' ON IT. "OOH. COMODO. NAH, ME IZ STAYIN'."

asides.calm: {member} SITS DOWN ON DA BENCH AN' LETS DA MEADOW GET ON WIT WHATEVER IT IZ DOING!

choices.text: SIT ON DA BENCH AN' WAIT FOR WHOEVER REPLACES IT!
READ DA STONE.
CUT A SWATHE THROUGH DA MEADOW WIT WHATEVER IZ IN DA PACK!
GO TA DA FARM AN' ASK.

a.text:
YOU WAIT AN HOUR AN' A HALF AN' {stranger} COMES UP DA TRACK WIT A FOLDIN' STOOL, SEES DA BENCH OCCUPIED, AN' SITS DOWN ON DA STOOL INSTEAD WITOUT COMPLAINT.
DEY HAB BROUGHT {food} FOR TWO. DEY OFFER YOU HALF WITOUT BEING ASKED AN' WITOUT LOOKIN' AT YOU.
"YOU WILL WANT TA BE GONE BY DARK," DEY SAY, COMFORTABLY. "IT JUST FORGETS YOU IZ PEOPLE."

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}

choices.text: STAY PAST DARK WIT DEM.
ASK WHAT DA ARRANGEMENT IZ, PLAINLY!

b.text:
NO NAME. NO DATE. A LINE OF LETTERS CUT WIT A CHISEL BY SOMEBODY WHO WAZ NO A MASON, AN' UNDER DEM, MORE RECENTLY, IN PAINT: {rumour}.
DA STONE IZ WARM ON DA NORTH FACE AN' COLD ON DA SOUTH, WHICH IZ DA WRONG WAY ROUND FOR A SUNNY AFTERNOON, AN' HAB BIN DA WRONG WAY ROUND FOR AS LONG AS ANYBODY HAB BIN COMIN' HERE WIT A BENCH!

asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: DIG AT DA BASE OF DA STONE!
COPY DA LETTERS AN' TAKE DEM TA SOMEBODY WHO READS DAT SORT OF TINK!

c.text:
YOU GET A COUPLE OF PACES IN.
DA GRASS IZ NO GRASS ALL DA WAY DOWN: AT DA ROOT IT IZ THREADED THROUGH WIT SOMETINK WHITE AN' FINE, AN' IT GOES TAUT WHEN YOU CUT IT, ALL ACROSS DA MEADOW AT ONCE, LIKE A NET BEING TAKEN UP.
DA FARM DOGS START, A MILE OFF. DEN DEY STOP, ALL TOGETHER!

d.text:
DA FARMER IZ A WOMAN IN HER SIXTIES WHO DOES NO PUT DA KETTLE ON, WHICH TELLS YOU WHERE YOU STAND.
"IT IZ FOUR ACRES," SHE SAYS. "FOUR ACRES IZ NUTTIN'. ME MOTHER DID DA SAME AN' HER MOTHER DID DA SAME AN' ME HAB A GOOD CROP OFF EVERYTINK ELSE, NO HAB ME."
SHE PAYS YOU NO TA WRITE 'BOUT IT. SHE PAYS IN CASH AN' IN {payment}, AN' SHE WATCHES DA MEADOW DA WHOLE TIME SHE IZ TALKIN' TA YOU!

a1.text:
AFTER DARK DA MEADOW DOES SOMETINK WIT SOUND: EVERYTINK YOU SAY ARRIVES 'BOUT A SECOND LATE AN' FROM SLIGHTLY DA WRONG DIRECTION.
{stranger} KEEPS TALKIN' ANYWAY, CALMLY, INTO DA DARK, AN' AT SOME POINT STOPS TALKIN' TA YOU AN' STARTS TALKIN' TA SOMETINK ELSE. WHATEVER ANSWERS USES YA VOICE, WHICH DEY SEEM TA EXPECT, AN' WHICH DEY DO NO APPEAR TA TINK IZ WORTH MENTIONIN'.
IN DA MORNIN' DERE IZ DEW ON EVERYTINK BUT DA BENCH, AN' SOMETINK IN YA PACK DAT WAZ NO DERE!

a2.text:
"DA GRASS STANDS, AN' IT KEEPS DA REST OF DA FARM RIGHT. DAT IZ IT. DAT IZ DA WHOLE OF IT."
DEY SAY IT DA WAY PEOPLE SAY DA RULES OF A GAME DEY HAB PLAYED ALL DEY LIFE. DEN DEY TEACH YOU DA TWO TINKZ YOU DO IF YOU IZ EVER CAUGHT IN DA MIDDLE OF IT AT DARK, AN' MAKE YOU SAY DEM BACK, TWICE, AN' CORRECT YOU ONCE!

b1.text:
NINE INCHES DOWN, DA CHALK IZ PACKED WIT LIL' BROWN BONES, ALL OF DEM BIRD, ALL OF DEM ARRANGED.
A FOOT FURTHER, IN {relicWord}, IZ DA TINK DA ARRANGEMENT WAZ MADE OVER. IT COMES OUT CLEAN AN' DA HOLE FILLS ITSELF IN BEHIND IT WIT A SOUND LIKE SOMEBODY SITTIN' DOWN!

b2.text:
A WOMAN IN {region} WHO RESTORES CHURCH PLATE READS IT IN 'BOUT A COUPLE OF SECONDS AN' DEN WILL NO READ IT AGAIN.
SHE PAYS YOU FOR DA RUBBIN', WHICH SHE BURNS, AN' FOR DA PROMISE DAT YOU WILL NO GO BACK, WHICH SHE NO CAN ENFORCE AN' WHICH YOU MAKE ANYWAY!

c_m.text:
YOU GET FOUR METRES IN. DA GRASS IZ NO GRASS ALL DA WAY DOWN: AT DA ROOT IT IZ THREADED THROUGH WIT SOMETINK WHITE AN' FINE, AN' IT GOES TAUT WHEN YOU CUT IT, ALL ACROSS DA MEADOW AT ONCE.
NUTTIN' COMES. IT STAYS TAUT, DA WHOLE FOUR ACRES OF IT, {HUMMIN'|TIGHT|LIKE A DRUM HEAD}, AN' IT IZ POSSIBLE TA STAND REAL STILL AN' TINK 'BOUT DA NEXT SWING!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{STOP CUTTIN'.|DA WHOLE FIELD IZ ONE TINK AN' WE JUST PULLED ON IT.|PUT DA BLADE DOWN. SLOWLY.}"
asides.any: {member} {DOES NO MOVE|PUTS A HAND FLAT ON DA GRASS AN' FEELS IT THRUMMIN'|COUNTS DA SECONDS}

choices.text: FINISH DA SWATHE.
BACK OUT ALONG DA CUT AN' LEAVE DA BLADE WHERE IT IZ!
FOLLOW ONE THREAD BY HAND AN' FIND OUT WHERE IT GOES!

c_back.text:
A COUPLE OF PACES BACKWARDS DOWN YA OWN CUT, SLOWLY, WIT DA BLADE LEFT STANDIN' IN DA GRASS WHERE IT STOPPED.
DA TENSION GOES OUT OF DA MEADOW AT DA EDGE AN' NO BEFORE. DA BLADE IZ STILL DERE DA NEXT MORNIN' AN' IZ STILL DERE {A YEAR LATER|DA FOLLOWIN' SEASON|YEARS AFTERWARDS}, UPRIGHT, AN' DA GRASS HAB GROWN ROUND IT AN' NO OVER IT!

c_thread.text:
ONE WHITE THREAD, FOLLOWED ON HANDS AN' KNEES FOR {A LONG WAY OFF|A LONG WAY|MOST OF AN AFTERNOON}, UNDER DA CUT AN' OUT OF IT, ACROSS DA MEADOW, TA DA FOOT OF DA STONE.
EVERY THREAD GOES DERE. DA MEADOW IZ {A SINGLE TINK|ONE ORGANISM|DA TOP OF SOMETINK}, AN' DA BENCH IZ WHERE YOU SIT WHEN YOU IZ MINDIN' IT, AN' DA ARRANGEMENT IZ SUDDENLY A GREAT DEAL MORE LEGIBLE!

d_m.text:
DA FARMER IZ A WOMAN IN HER SIXTIES WHO DOES NO PUT DA KETTLE ON, WHICH TELLS YOU WHERE YOU STAND, AN' WHO SAYS FOUR ACRES IZ NUTTIN' AN' HER MOTHER DID DA SAME.
WHAT SHE DOES NO SAY, AN' WHAT IZ OBVIOUS FROM DA YARD, IZ DAT DA FARM IZ DOING {FAR BETTER|CONSIDERABLY BETTER|BETTER DEN IT HAB ANY RIGHT TA} DEN DA LAND AROUND IT, AN' HAB BIN FOR {THREE GENERATIONS|A REAL LONG TIME|AS LONG AS DA BENCH HAB BIN DERE}!

choices.text: LEAVE IT. HER FARM, HER ARRANGEMENT!
ASK HER WHAT HAPPENS IF NOBODY SITS DA BENCH!
ASK TA SEE DA FARM'S BOOKS!

d_bench.text:
DA KETTLE GOES ON FOR DAT QUESTION, WHICH IZ HOW DA PARTY KNOWS IT IZ DA RIGHT ONE.
NOBODY HAB EVER NO SAT IT. DERE IZ A ROTA, DERE HAB ALWAYS BIN A ROTA, IT COVERS {ELEVEN|NINE} HOUSEHOLDS AN' IT GOES BACK FURTHER DEN DA PARISH REGISTER, AN' SHE IZ DA ONE WHO KEEPS IT, AN' SHE IZ {SEVENTY-ONE|SIXTY-EIGHT|OLDER DEN SHE SAYS} AN' DERE IZ NOBODY AFTER HER!

d_books.text:
DA BOOKS GO BACK TA {1911|DA TWENTIES|BEFORE DA WAR} IN FOUR DIFFERENT HANDS AN' DEY IZ HONEST BOOKS, WHICH IZ WHAT MAKES DEM FRIGHTENIN': DA YIELDS IZ NO EXTRAORDINARY IN ANY ONE YEAR AN' DEY HAB NEVER ONCE HAB A BAD ONE.
NO IN DA DROUGHT, NO IN DA BLIGHT, NO IN DA YEAR DA RIVER CAME UP. DA WOMAN WATCHES DA PARTY WORK DAT OUT AN' SAYS NUTTIN', AN' DEN SAYS: FOUR ACRES!

e_forest.title: {DA BLIND|SOMEBODY IZ SITTIN' IN DA TREES|{landmark}}

n0.text:
DA TRACK IN IZ BETTER KEPT DEN DA ROAD DAT BROUGHT YOU TA IT. SOMEBODY GRADES IT. NOBODY ADMITS TA IT.
HALF A MILE IN DERE IZ A HIDE UP IN A BEECH: A SHOOTIN' BLIND, BOARDED, WIT A LADDER AN' A FELT ROOF AN' A STOVE PIPE. IT FACES {landmark}. ZERO GAME HERE WORTH A STOVE.
DA LADDER HAB BIN USED DIS MORNIN'. IN DA TREES, {sound}.
DA GRADIN' IZ DONE WIT A PROPER BLADE AN' IT IZ DONE {AT NIGHT|AFTER DARK|BETWEEN VISITS}, COZ DA TRACK IZ NEVER GRADIN'-FRESH WHEN ANYBODY IZ ON IT!
n0.emText:
DA TRACK IZ GRADED AN' DA WOOD IZ QUIET IN DA WAY A ROOM IZ QUIET WHEN SOMEONE HAB JUST STOPPED TALKIN' 'BOUT YOU.
DERE IZ A HIDE UP A BEECH, BOARDED, WIT A STOVE PIPE, FACIN' {landmark}, AN' NO GAME HERE WORTH SITTIN' OUT FOR. SOMEBODY WATCHES DIS PLACE PROFESSIONALLY. YOU HAB BIN IN DA WORLD MOST OF A YEAR AN' YOU ALREADY KNOW WHAT A PROFESSIONAL WATCHER'S CHAIR SMELLS LIKE FROM UNDERNEATH!
n0.bubba: BUBBA LOOKS UP DA LADDER AN' BACK AT YOU. "DEER BLIND. SURE. AN' ME IZ DA POPE. NUN C'E' STA NIENTE 'A CACCIARE CCÀ, SUGAR."

choices.text: CLIMB UP.
GO AN' STAND IN WHATEVER DA HIDE IZ WATCHIN'!
WAIT IN DA BRUSH UNTIL SOMEBODY COMES BACK FOR IT!
FOLLOW DA GRADED TRACK TA WHOEVER GRADES IT!

a.text:
WARM STOVE. A FLASK, STILL HOT. A CAMP STOOL, A PAIR OF REAL GOOD FIELD GLASSES, AN' A LOGBOOK.
DA LOGBOOK IZ A LIST OF DATES AN' TIMES AN', IN DA THIRD COLUMN, ONE WORD EACH: NAMES, MOSTLY. SOME OF DEM IZ NAMES OF PEOPLE. SOME OF DEM IZ NAMES OF DAYS.
TODAY'S DATE IZ AT DA BOTTOM. DA THIRD COLUMN HAB BIN FILLED IN ALREADY, AN' DA WORD IZ YA!
a.bubba: BUBBA READS OVER YA SHOULDER AN' GOES REAL QUIET, WHICH FROM HIM IZ AN ALARM. "SUGAR. UH-UH. CHILL' CCÀ NUN SO' CACCIATORI."

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.stoic: {member} {SAYS NUTTIN' AN' CHECKS DA SEALS ON DEY SUIT|NODS ONCE AN' TAKES UP A DEFENSIVE POSITION|STANDS GUARD BY DA DOOR, COMPLETELY SILENT|KEEPS DEY EYES ON DA HORIZON WITOUT A WORD}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TAKE DA LOGBOOK AN' GO.
SIT IN DA STOOL AN' WAIT FOR DA OWNER!
WRITE A FOURTH COLUMN OF YA OWN!

b.text:
YOU WALK OUT INTO DA MIDDLE OF WHAT DA GLASSES IZ POINTED AT, WHICH IZ {landmark}, AN' YOU STAND DERE, AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS FOR FOUR FULL MINUTES.
DEN DA BIRDS STOP IN A RING, CLOSIN', DA WAY SILENCE GOES ACROSS A ROOM WHEN DA WRONG PERSON COMES IN!

asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.timid: {member} COUNTS DA RING CLOSIN' AN' SAYS DA NUMBER OUT LOUD, WHICH DOES NO HELP!
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: STAND YA GROUND AN' LET IT COME!
SPEAK FIRST. SAY WHAT YOU IZ DOING HERE!

c.text:
HALF A SHIFT IN DA WET BRUSH, AN' DEN SOMEBODY COMES: NO UP DA TRACK, OUT OF {landmark}, WALKIN' AS IF DA WOOD WAZ A CORRIDOR IN DEY OWN HOUSE.
DEY CLIMB DA LADDER, DEY LIGHT DA STOVE, AN' DEY OPEN DA LOGBOOK. DEN DEY LEAN OUT OF DA HIDE, LOOK DIRECTLY AT WHERE YOU IZ LYING, AN' WAVE YOU IN FOR TEA!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO UP AN' HAB DA TEA.
LEAVE, QUICKLY, WHILE DEY IZ BEING POLITE!

d.text:
DA TRACK ENDS AT A FORESTRY HUT WIT A BRITANNIA LICENCE PLATE ON A VARLENIAN VAN AN' A WOMAN DOING PAPERWORK ON DA BONNET.
SHE IZ NO SURPRISED. SHE HAB A FOLDER WIT YA ROUTE IN IT, DRAWN IN DA SAME PENCIL DA CHART ON DA BUOY WAZ DRAWN IN, IF YOU HAB EVER SEEN ONE OF DOZE.
"A FEW QUESTIONS," SHE SAYS. "DEN EITHER YOU WORK FOR US DIS AFTERNOON OR YOU NEVER CAME UP DIS TRACK."

choices.text: WORK FOR HER DIS AFTERNOON!
NEVER CAME UP DIS TRACK.

asides.authoritative: {member} {BARKS OUT ORDERS TA SECURE DA PERIMETER|DEMANDS STATUS REPORTS ON DA DOUBLE|REMINDS EVERYONE TA MAINTAIN RADIO DISCIPLINE|TAKES CHARGE OF DA ENTRY TEAM WIT A BRISK NOD}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

a1.text:
YOU IZ THREE MILES OFF BEFORE YOU LOOK AT DA EARLIER PAGES PROPERLY.
IT IZ A REGISTER OF EVERYBODY WHO HAB COME UP DAT TRACK FOR YEARS AN' YEARS, AN' WHAT BECAME OF DEM, AN' DA LAST COLUMN FOR MOST OF DEM READS DA SAME SHORT WORD. DA FOUNDATION OFFICE IN {region} BUYS IT OFF YOU IN A CORRIDOR, STANDIN' UP, AN' PAYS WHAT IT COSTS TA MAKE YOU STOP ASKIN' 'BOUT DA WORD!

a2.text:
YOU SIT IN A DEAD MAN'S STOOL FOR AN HOUR AN' FORTY MINUTES AN' DEN DA LADDER CREAKS AN' SOMEBODY COMES UP WHO IZ NO CARRYIN' A RIFLE.
WHAT YOU TALK 'BOUT IZ DA THIRD COLUMN. WHAT DEY LEAVE YOU WIT, COZ YOU SAT AN' WAITED INSTEAD OF RUNNIN', IZ {relicWord} OUT OF DA STOVE BENCH, AN' A RULE 'BOUT DIS WOOD YOU WILL USE TWICE MORE DIS YEAR!

a3.text:
YOU WRITE DOWN WHAT EACH OF DEM WAZ WEARIN'.
IT TAKES A LONG STRETCH AN' IT IZ DA MOST PETTY TINK ANYBODY IN DIS PARTY HAB DONE ALL MONTH, AN' DA WOOD DOES NO LIKE IT. SOMETINK COMES UP DA LADDER DAT DOES NO USE DA RUNGS!

b1.text: IT COMES OUT OF DA TREES AT A WALK, ON DA WRONG NUMBER OF LEGS FOR DA SOUND IT WAZ MAKIN', AN' IT HAB BIN EATIN' WHAT DA HIDE WAZ FOR!

b2.text:
YOU SAY YA NAME AN' YA BUSINESS, OUT LOUD, TA A WOOD.
DA RING STOPS CLOSIN'. SOMETINK DA SIZE OF A DOOR LEANS OUT OF DA DARK TA LOOK AT YOU, DECIDES, AN' GOES AWAY, AN' DA BIRDS COME BACK ON ONE AFTER ANOTHER LIKE LIGHTS.
WHERE IT STOOD DERE IZ A GAP IN DA LEAF LITTER WIT SOMETINK IN IT DAT WAZ PRESSED INTO DA EARTH BY WEIGHT AN' TIME!

c1.text:
TEA IN A HIDE WIT A STRANGER WHO HAB BIN WATCHIN' DIS WOOD FOR DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE AN' HAB NEVER ONCE BIN PAID FOR IT.
DEY TELL YOU WHAT DA THIRD COLUMN MEANS, AN' WHAT TA DO IF YOU EVER SEE YA OWN NAME IN IT, AN' DEN DEY GIVE YOU {payment} AN' PUT YOU BACK ON DA TRACK FACIN' DA RIGHT WAY!

c2.text:
YOU GO, AN' DA WOOD LETS YOU, AN' BEHIND YOU DA STOVE SMOKE COMES UP STRAIGHT IN A WIND DAT IZ BENDIN' EVERY TREE IT PASSES.
ON DA ROAD YOU FIND DA FLASK IN YA PACK. NOBODY PUT IT DERE. IT IZ STILL HOT IN {region}, A COUPLE OF HOURS LATER, AN' IT IZ STILL HOT DA NEXT MORNIN'!

d1.text:
DA AFTERNOON'S WORK IZ CARRYIN' FOUR SEALED BOXES FROM {landmark} TA DA VAN WITOUT STOPPIN', RESTIN', OR PUTTIN' DEM DOWN ON GROUND.
YOU EARN EVERY NOTE OF IT. ONE OF DA BOXES IZ WARM ON ONE SIDE AN' SOMETINK IN IT MOVES WHEN YOU TAKE DA CORNER!

d2.text:
YOU NEVER CAME UP DAT TRACK. SHE WRITES DAT DOWN TOO, IN DA FOLDER, AN' THANKS YOU SINCERELY.
WHAT YOU TAKE AWAY IZ DA SIGHT OF WHAT WAZ IN DA OPEN FOLDER: A MAP OF DIS WOOD WIT NINETEEN HIDES ON IT, AN' A NOTE IN DA CORNER 'BOUT WHICH OF DEM IZ STILL MANNED!

a1_m.text:
DA LOGBOOK GOES IN DA COAT AN' DA LADDER COMES DOWN AN' YOU IZ {THREE MILES|TWO MILES|A GOOD WAY} OFF BEFORE ANYBODY LOOKS AT DA EARLIER PAGES PROPERLY.
DA THIRD COLUMN IZ DATES, AN' DA FOURTH COLUMN, WHICH NOBODY NOTICED IN DA HIDE, IZ A COLUMN OF {TIMES|DURATIONS|NUMBERS IN MINUTES}, AN' EVERY ENTRY IN IT IZ UNDER {NINE|ELEVEN} EXCEPT DA LAST THREE, WHICH IZ BLANK!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{BLANK MEANS STILL RUNNIN'.|A HANDFUL OF PEOPLE IZ STILL BEING TIMED.|WHOEVER IZ IN DA FOURTH COLUMN IZ NO FINISHED.}"
asides.any: {member} {READS DA LAST THREE LINES OUT LOUD|CHECKS DA DATES AGAINST TODAY|CLOSES DA BOOK AN' DOES NO OPEN IT AGAIN}

choices.text: KEEP IT. SELL IT. IT IZ NINETEEN YEARS OF SOMEBODY'S WORK!
WORK OUT WHAT DA FOURTH COLUMN IZ COUNTIN'!
TURN ROUND AN' PUT IT BACK IN DA HIDE!

a1_col.text:
IT IZ HOW LONG EACH OF DEM WAZ IN DA WOOD: HOW LONG DEY WAZ {INSIDE DA LINE|IN DERE|UNACCOUNTED FOR}, MEASURED AGAINST A WATCH, AN' DA THREE BLANKS IZ THREE PEOPLE WHO WENT IN AN' IZ COUNTED AS STILL IN.
ONE OF DA THREE DATES IZ {DIS SPRING|FOUR MONTHS AGO|RECENT}. DA WOOD IZ TWO MILES ACROSS. DERE IZ NOWHERE IN IT TA BE FOR FOUR MONTHS!

a1_back.text:
THREE MILES BACK, UP DA LADDER, AN' DA LOGBOOK ON DA TABLE WIT DA FLASK MOVED TA HOLD DA PAGE, WHICH IZ {MORE CARE|A COURTESY|MORE DEN WAZ TAKEN REMOVIN' IT}.
DA STOVE IZ STILL WARM. DA GLASSES HAB BIN MOVED. ON DA BOTTOM RUNG OF DA LADDER ON DA WAY DOWN DERE IZ A {PENCIL|NEW PENCIL|FRESHLY SHARPENED PENCIL} DAT WAZ NO DERE ON DA WAY UP, AN' IT IZ FOR DA PARTY, AN' EVERYBODY UNDERSTANDS DAT!

d1_m.text:
DA AFTERNOON'S WORK IZ CARRYIN' FOUR SEALED BOXES FROM {landmark} TA DA VAN WITOUT STOPPIN', RESTIN', OR PUTTIN' DEM DOWN ON GROUND.
DA FIRST THREE IZ HEAVY AN' AWKWARD AN' ORDINARY. DA FOURTH IZ {LIGHT|MUCH LIGHTER|ALMOST NUTTIN'}, AN' DA WOMAN WATCHES DAT ONE DA ENTIRE WAY ACROSS DA CLEARIN' WITOUT PRETENDIN' NO TA!

choices.text: CARRY IT TA DA VAN AN' TAKE DA MONEY!
PUT IT DOWN.
ASK WHAT IZ IN IT, ON DA WALK, WITOUT STOPPIN'!

d1_down.text:
IT GOES DOWN ON DA LEAF MOULD FOR {FOUR SECONDS|'BOUT FOUR SECONDS|NO TIME AT ALL} AN' DA WOMAN DOES NO SHOUT, WHICH IZ DA FRIGHTENIN' PART: SHE JUST STOPS WRITIN'.
IT IZ PICKED UP AGAIN. DA MARK IT LEAVES ON DA GROUND IZ DA SHAPE OF DA BOX AN' STAYS DERE, AN' IZ {STILL DERE|VISIBLE|UNFADED} DA FOLLOWIN' SPRING, AN' NUTTIN' GROWS IN IT!

d1_ask.text:
ASKED ON DA MOVE, AT DA RIGHT DISTANCE, WIT DA BOX ON DA SHOULDER, SHE ANSWERS, WHICH SHE WOULD NO HAB DONE SITTIN' DOWN.
WHAT MATTERS IZ WHAT DA BOX IZ: {FOUR OF DEM|ONE A SEASON|A SET}, CARRIED OUT OF DAT CLEARIN' EVERY YEAR SINCE DA WAR BY WHOEVER SHE CAN HIRE, TA A VAN, TA A FERRY, TA AN ADDRESS DA PARTY IZ GIVEN AN' TOLD TA FORGET!

e_forestice.title: {DA LONG COLD|WOODSMOKE AN' NO CHIMNEY|NINETY TREES MARKED IN BLUE}

n0.text:
SNOW TA DA KNEE BETWEEN BLACK TRUNKS, AN' NINETY TREES MARKED IN BLUE PAINT AT CHEST HEIGHT, IN A LINE DAT RUNS STRAIGHT THROUGH A WOOD DAT HAB NUTTIN' STRAIGHT IN IT.
DERE IZ WOODSMOKE. ZERO CHIMNEY, NO HUT, NO TRACK, AN' NO FOOTPRINTS BUT YA, AN' DA SMOKE IZ COMIN' UP OUT OF DA SNOW ITSELF 'BOUT {distance} ALONG DA LINE.
DA BLUE ON DA NINETIETH TREE IZ WET, AN' DA NEAREST ROAD IZ {ELEVEN MILES|A DAY'S WALK|A LONG WAY} BACK!
n0.emText:
NINETY TREES MARKED IN BLUE, DEAD STRAIGHT THROUGH A CROOKED WOOD, AN' WOODSMOKE COMIN' OUT OF DA SNOW WHERE NUTTIN' IZ BURNIN'.
SOMEBODY DREW A LINE HERE AN' DA WORLD TOOK IT SERIOUSLY. YOU KNOW HOW DAT WORKS. YOU WAZ A LINE SOMEBODY DREW ONCE, AN' DA WORLD TOOK YOU SERIOUSLY TOO, AN' LOOK AT YOU NOW!
n0.bubba: BUBBA PUTS HIS HAND OVER DA SMOKE AN' PULLS IT BACK SHARPISH. "COLD SMOKE. DAT AIN'T A TINK. DAT AIN'T A TINK, SUGAR. UH-UH. MAMMA MIA."

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.stoic: {member} {SAYS NUTTIN' AN' CHECKS DA SEALS ON DEY SUIT|NODS ONCE AN' TAKES UP A DEFENSIVE POSITION|STANDS GUARD BY DA DOOR, COMPLETELY SILENT|KEEPS DEY EYES ON DA HORIZON WITOUT A WORD}
asides.artistic: {member} SAYS DA BLUE IZ DA SAME BLUE AS DA PAINT ON A SCHOOL CORRIDOR. {member} IZ RIGHT!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: FOLLOW DA BLUE LINE.
DIG WHERE DA SMOKE COMES UP!
MAKE CAMP ON DA LINE AN' SEE WHAT WALKS IT!
GO BACK DA WAY YOU CAME, QUICKLY!

a.text:
NINETY TREES, AN' AT DA NINETIETH DA PAINT IZ FRESH.
BEYOND IT DERE IZ NO MORE WOOD: DERE IZ A CLEARIN' DA SHAPE OF A ROOM, FLOORED IN ICE YOU CAN SEE DOWN INTO, AN' UNDER DA ICE, LAID OUT AN' NEAT, A SURVEYOR'S KIT, A COAT, AN' A PAIR OF BOOTS WIT DA LACES STILL TIED.
DA BLUE PAINT TIN IZ STANDIN' ON DA ICE, OPEN, UNFROZEN!

asides.melancholic: {member} LOOKS AT DA LACES FOR A LONG TIME. SOMEBODY TIED DOZE!
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: CUT THROUGH AN' BRING DA KIT UP!
TAKE DA TIN AN' FINISH DA LINE!

b.text:
TWO FEET OF SNOW, DEN A HATCH: A PROPER ONE, STEEL, WIT A WHEEL, WARM TA DA HAND.
IT IZ A BUNKER, AN' IT IZ LIT, AN' DERE IZ NOBODY IN IT, AN' DA STOVE IN DA MIDDLE OF DA MAIN ROOM IZ BURNIN' SOMETINK OTHER DEN WOOD OR COAL, AN' DA PILE STAYS EXACTLY AS HIGH AS IT BURNS!
b.bubba: "ALRIGHT," SAYS BUBBA, HANDS ON HIPS, ENTIRELY HAPPY. "NOW WE IZ TALKIN'. SOTTO 'A NEVE, 'NU PALAZZO."

asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: STRIP DA PLACE OF ANYTINK USEFUL!
FIND OUT WHAT DA STOVE IZ BURNIN'!

c.text:
YOU KEEP A FIRE AN' YOU KEEP WATCH, AN' AT SOME POINT BETWEEN THREE AN' FOUR IN DA MORNIN' DA WOOD GOES QUIET IN DA WAY IT GOES QUIET WHEN DA SNOW STOPS.
SOMETINK WALKS DA LINE. IT IZ UPRIGHT. IT STOPS AT EACH BLUE MARK AN' PUTS ITS HAND ON IT, DA WAY A PERSON COUNTS STAIRS IN DA DARK, AN' IT IZ COMIN' DIS WAY AT EXACTLY DA SPEED OF SOMEBODY WHO IZ NO IN A HURRY!

asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.timid: {member} IZ REAL STILL AN' REAL QUIET AN' DOES EVERYTINK RIGHT!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: LET IT COME AN' SPEAK TA IT!
PUT DA FIRE OUT AN' {LET IT PASS|HOLD FIRE AN' WAIT|STAY HIDDEN UNTIL IT MOVES ON|LET IT WALK BY}!

d.text:
YOU GET OUT, AN' IT TAKES LONGER DEN IT TOOK TA COME IN, AN' DA LAST MILE HAB BLUE MARKS ON TREES YOU SWEAR YOU DID NO PASS.
ON DA ROAD YOU FIND DA COUNT IN YA OWN NOTEBOOK IN YA OWN HAND: NINETY, DEN NINETY-ONE, DEN A MARK DAT IZ NO A NUMBER!

a1.text:
DA ICE DOES NO WANT TA BE CUT AN' DEN, ALL AT ONCE, IT DOES.
DA COAT POCKETS HOLD {paper}, A COMPASS FROZEN TA NORTH WHICHEVER WAY YOU TURN IT, AN' A SURVEY BOOK WIT DA LAST ENTRY WRITTEN FROM UNDERNEATH DA ICE, IN DA SAME BLUE!

a2.text:
YOU TAKE DA TIN AN' YOU PAINT DA NINETY-FIRST TREE, AN' DA WOOD MAKES A SOUND LIKE A HELD BREATH BEING LET GO.
DA COLD BREAKS. SNOW COMES OFF BRANCHES FOR A HUNDRED METRES IN EVERY DIRECTION AT ONCE, AN' DA CLEARIN' BEHIND YOU IZ ONLY A CLEARIN', AN' DA BOOTS UNDER DA ICE IZ ONLY BOOTS.
SOMEBODY'S WORK IZ FINISHED. SOMETINK IN YA PACK IZ HEAVIER DEN IT WAZ!

b1.text:
TINNED FOOD DAT IZ STILL GOOD, FORTY LITRES OF LAMP OIL, TOOLS, WIRE, TWO COATS AN' A CRATE OF DA KIND OF AMMUNITION NOBODY STOCKS ANY MORE.
YOU TAKE WHAT A COUPLE OF DEM CAN CARRY UPHILL THROUGH SNOW, WHICH IZ LESS DEN YOU WOULD LIKE AN' MORE DEN YOU SHOULD!

b2.text:
YOU OPEN DA DOOR OF DA STOVE.
WHAT IZ IN DERE IZ LOOKIN' BACK, AN' IT HAB BIN BURNIN' FOR A REAL LONG TIME, AN' IT WOULD LIKE DA DOOR SHUT, OR OPENED ALL DA WAY!

c1.text:
IT STOPS AT YA FIRE, PUTS ITS HAND ON DA TREE BESIDE YOU AS IF DA TREE WAZ DA NEXT NUMBER, AN' WAITS.
YOU TALK. NO, BUT IT TURNS ITS HEAD WHEN YOU GET TA DA PART IT WANTS, AN' WHEN YOU HAB GOT IT RIGHT IT TAKES SOMETINK OUT OF DA SNOW AT YA FEET DAT WAZ NO DERE BEFORE AN' PUTS IT IN YA HANDS!

c2.text:
YOU KILL DA FIRE AN' IT GOES BY CLOSE ENOUGH TA HEAR IT COUNTIN', AN' IT COUNTS IN A LANGUAGE DAT STOPS BEING A LANGUAGE 'BOUT HALFWAY ALONG.
IN DA MORNIN' DA BLUE MARKS IZ GONE OFF EVERY TREE, AN' DA LINE IZ STILL DERE, WORN INTO DA SNOW, AN' IT GOES SOMEWHERE YOU WILL NO BE GOING TODAY!

b1_m.text:
TINNED FOOD DAT IZ STILL GOOD, FORTY LITRES OF LAMP OIL, TOOLS, WIRE, TWO COATS AN' A CRATE OF DA KIND OF AMMUNITION NOBODY STOCKS ANY MORE.
AN' A DUTY BOARD BY DA DOOR, WIT {FOUR|FIVE} NAMES ON IT AN' A ROTA WRITTEN UP TA DA END OF NEXT MONTH, AN' DA MOST RECENT TICK IZ AGAINST {YESTERDAY|TWO DAYS AGO|A DATE DIS WEEK}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY IZ ON SHIFT.|DAT TICK IZ FRESH. WE IZ IN DEY HOUSE.|TAKE WHAT YOU LIKE, BUT BE QUICK 'BOUT IT.}"
asides.any: {member} {READS DA ROTA TWICE|PUTS A HAND ON DA STOVE|LOOKS AT DA DOOR}

choices.text: STRIP IT AN' GO BEFORE ANYBODY COMES BACK!
WAIT FOR WHOEVER IZ ON SHIFT!
WORK OUT WHAT DA ROTA IZ A ROTA FOR!

b1_wait.text:
HALF A SHIFT IN A WARM BUNKER IN A WOOD DAT IZ {FORTY BELOW|COLD ENOUGH TA KILL|NO SURVIVABLE OUTSIDE}, WHICH IZ DA EASIEST WAITIN' ANYBODY HAB DONE ALL YEAR.
WHOEVER COMES IN AT DUSK IZ {NINETEEN|REAL YOUNG|YOUNGER DEN DA ROTA}, IZ ALONE, IZ NO ARMED, AN' IZ VISIBLY RELIEVED TA FIND PEOPLE, AN' HAB NO HAB ANYBODY TA TALK TA SINCE {DA AUTUMN|OCTOBER|A LONG TIME AGO}!

b1_rota.text:
IT IZ A {FEEDIN'|STOKIN'|BURN} ROTA, AN' DA COLUMN HEADINGS IZ HOURS, AN' DA TINK DAT HAB TA BE DONE AT EACH OF DEM IZ DONE AT DA STOVE.
WHICH PUTS DA PARTY'S UNDERSTANDIN' OF DA BUNKER, DA WOOD, DA NINETY BLUE TREES AN' DA SMOKE DAT COMES UP THROUGH TWO FEET OF SNOW IN AN ENTIRELY DIFFERENT ORDER, AN' IT IZ NOW {FOUR HOURS|TWO HOURS|NO LONG} UNTIL DA NEXT ENTRY IZ DUE!

c2_m.text:
DA FIRE GOES OUT AN' IT GOES BY CLOSE ENOUGH TA HEAR IT COUNTIN', AN' IT COUNTS IN A LANGUAGE DAT STOPS BEING A LANGUAGE 'BOUT HALFWAY ALONG.
IT STOPS AT {DA THIRTIETH|A TREE|DA TRUNK IT HAB REACHED} AN' GOES BACK THREE, AN' COUNTS DOZE THREE AGAIN, AN' GETS A DIFFERENT ANSWER, AN' STANDS DERE IN DA DARK {FOR A LONG TIME|NO MOVIN'|WORKIN' AT IT}!

choices.text: STAY DOWN. LET IT WORK IT OUT!
COUNT DA THREE TREES OUT LOUD, CORRECTLY!
MARK DA THREE TREES WIT DA BLUE TIN WHILE IT IZ TURNED AWAY!

c2_count.text:
THREE NUMBERS SAID OUT LOUD FROM BEHIND A DEAD FIRE, IN DA RIGHT LANGUAGE, IN DA RIGHT ORDER, BY SOMEBODY WHOSE VOICE IZ NO STEADY.
IT TAKES DEM. IT GOES ON. NINETY TREES BECOME NINETY-THREE AN' DA LINE RUNS ON INTO WOOD DA PARTY NO CAN SEE, AN' AT FIRST LIGHT DERE IZ A PATH WHERE DERE WAZ NO PATH, GOING DA SAME WAY, AN' IT IZ WALKABLE!

c2_mark.text:
THREE TRUNKS MARKED AT CHEST HEIGHT WIT A TIN OF PAINT DAT IZ NEARLY EMPTY, DONE IN DA DARK, {A COUPLE OF PACES|NO FAR|A STONE'S THROW} FROM SOMETINK DAT IZ COUNTIN'.
IT FINDS DEM. IT IZ SATISFIED. IT GOES ON AN' DA WOOD LETS GO ALL AT ONCE, DA WAY A HELD BREATH GOES, AN' DA PARTY SLEEPS WHERE DEY IZ AN' WAKES WIT {DA SNOW OFF DA BRANCHES|A THAW|WATER DRIPPIN'} AN' BLUE ON DEY HANDS DAT DOES NO WASH OFF FOR A FORTNIGHT!

e_foresttropical.title: {DA CANOPY|A LONG WAY OFF UP AN' SOMEBODY'S KETTLE|DA GREEN ROOM}

n0.text:
HEAT LIKE A HAND ON DA BACK OF DA NECK, AN' A RESEARCH PLATFORM DA FAR END OF IT UP IN DA CANOPY WIT A ROPE LADDER HANGIN' DOWN TA HEAD HEIGHT.
DERE IZ A KETTLE UP DERE. YOU CAN HEAR IT. IT HAB BIN WHISTLIN' FOR AS LONG AS YOU HAB BIN STANDIN' HERE, AN' NOBODY HAB TAKEN IT OFF.
AT DA FOOT OF DA TREE, ARRANGED IN A NEAT SQUARE: ELEVEN PAIRS OF BOOTS.
ELEVEN CAMP BEDS, ELEVEN PLATES, AN' {TEN|NINE} PAIRS OF BOOTS IN DA SQUARE BY DA LADDER!
n0.emText:
HEAT, GREEN LIGHT, A PLATFORM A LONG WAY OFF UP WIT A KETTLE SCREAMIN' ON IT, AN' ELEVEN PAIRS OF BOOTS LAID OUT IN A SQUARE AT DA FOOT OF DA TREE.
DA SQUARE IZ DELIBERATE. SOMEBODY MADE AN ARRANGEMENT HERE, AN' DA ARRANGEMENT IZ STILL RUNNIN', AN' DA KETTLE IZ DA METRONOME. YOU IZ GETTIN' QUITE GOOD AT SPOTTIN' OTHER PEOPLE'S SPELLS. YA IZ DA ONE YOU NO CAN SEE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA COUNTS DA BOOTS TWICE. "ELEVEN. AOH. ELEVEN PAIRS AN' NO FEET. VUO' SAPE' 'A VERITA'? ME NO LIKE IT. LETZ GO UP."

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: CLIMB.
TAKE A PAIR OF BOOTS AN' SEE WHAT HAPPENS!
SHOUT UP FIRST.
CUT DA LADDER DOWN AN' LEAVE!

a.text:
DA PLATFORM IZ BOARDS AN' MESH AN' IT MOVES UNDER YOU. DERE IZ A STOVE, DA KETTLE, ELEVEN CAMP BEDS, AN' A TABLE WIT A MEAL LAID OUT ON IT FOR ELEVEN, GONE BAD IN DA HEAT, EXCEPT ONE PLATE, WHICH HAB NO.
DERE IZ NOBODY. DERE IZ ALSO, QUITE CLEARLY, SOMEBODY: YOU CAN HEAR DA PLATFORM TAKE WEIGHT WHEN YOU IZ ALL STANDIN' STILL!

asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX THREE TIMES AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.calm: {member} TAKES DA KETTLE OFF DA HEAT, COZ SOMEBODY SHOULD!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: SIT DOWN AT DA GOOD PLATE AN' EAT!
SEARCH DA PLATFORM PROPERLY!

b.text:
YOU LIFT A PAIR OFF DA SQUARE AN' DA WHOLE CANOPY ABOVE YOU MOVES AT ONCE, WITOUT WIND, LIKE AN AUDIENCE LEANIN' IN.
DA KETTLE STOPS. IN DA SILENCE YOU CAN HEAR SOMETINK COME DOWN DA TRUNK ON DA FAR SIDE, FAST, AN' STOP, AN' WAIT FOR YOU TA PUT DEM BACK!

choices.text: PUT DEM BACK AN' STEP AWAY!
KEEP DEM.

asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text:
YA VOICE GOES UP INTO DA GREEN AN' DOES NO COME BACK, AN' 'BOUT A COUPLE OF SECONDS LATER SOMEBODY UP DERE ANSWERS, IN YA VOICE, SAYIN' DA SAME WORDS, IN DA SAME ORDER, WIT ONE WORD CHANGED.
DA CHANGED WORD IZ A NAME. IT IZ NO A NAME ANY OF YOU HAB HEARD, AN' ONE OF YOU FLINCHES AT IT ANYWAY!

asides.melancholic: "DAT WAZ ME MOTHER'S NAME," SAYS {member}, REAL QUIETLY, AN' DEN WILL NO DISCUSS IT!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: ANSWER IT. USE DA NAME.
CLIMB UP AN' SEE WHO IZ DOING IT!

d.text:
IT COMES DOWN IN A HEAP OF ROPE AN' DA PLATFORM ABOVE YOU DOES NO REACT AT ALL, WHICH IZ SOMEHOW WORSE.
DA BEST PART OF A WEEK LATER, IN {region}, A WOMAN FROM A UNIVERSITY YOU HAB NEVER HEARD OF BUYS YA ACCOUNT OF IT OVER THREE COFFEES AN' PAYS FOR DA COFFEES, AN' ASKS YOU, AS YOU LEAVE, WHETHER DA KETTLE WAZ STILL GOING WHEN YOU CUT IT!

a1.text:
IT IZ DA BEST MEAL YOU HAB HAB IN A MONTH AN' IT IZ STILL HOT AN' IT SHOULD NO BE.
HALFWAY THROUGH, DA PLATFORM TAKES WEIGHT OPPOSITE YOU AN' DA CHAIR MOVES, AN' YOU HAB DA REAL STRONG SENSE OF BEING KEPT COMPANY BY SOMEBODY BEING POLITE 'BOUT NO APPEARIN'.
WHEN YOU FINISH DERE IZ A GIFT UNDER DA PLATE, IN DA WAY DERE ALWAYS IZ WHEN YOU EAT WHAT IZ OFFERED PROPERLY!

a2.text:
ELEVEN FIELD NOTEBOOKS, ALL OF DEM USEFUL, AN' ONE OF DEM WRONG: DA LAST THREE WEEKS IZ WRITTEN BY A HAND DAT GETS BETTER AT HANDWRITIN' EACH DAY, DA WAY SOMEBODY LEARNS.
YOU TAKE DA ELEVEN, AN' DA MESH FLOOR UNDER DA WRONG ONE IZ WORN WHERE SOMETINK HAB SAT DERE A GREAT DEAL!

b1.text:
YOU PUT DEM BACK IN DA SQUARE, AN' DA CANOPY RELAXES, AN' DA KETTLE STARTS AGAIN.
ON DA WAY OUT YOU FIND A PAIR OF BOOTS ON DA TRACK DAT FITS ONE OF YOU EXACTLY. DEY WAZ NO DERE ON DA WAY IN. EVERYBODY AGREES NO TA TALK 'BOUT IT, AN' EVERYBODY KEEPS DEM!

b2.text: DA TINK DAT CAME DOWN DA TRUNK WOULD LIKE DEM BACK AN' IT IZ NO GOING TA ASK TWICE!

c1.text:
YOU SAY DA NAME INTO FORTY METRES OF GREEN AN' DA WOOD ANSWERS BY GOING COMPLETELY, ABSOLUTELY SILENT: NO INSECTS, NO BIRDS, NO LEAF NOISE.
INTO DAT SILENCE, SOMETINK COMES DOWN TA HEAD HEIGHT AN' LOOKS AT WHICHEVER OF YOU FLINCHED, AN' GIVES DEM WHAT IT HAB BIN HOLDIN' FOR A CROWD OF DEM'S WORTH OF TIME!

a2_m.text:
ELEVEN FIELD NOTEBOOKS, ALL OF DEM USEFUL, AN' ONE OF DEM WRONG: DA LAST THREE WEEKS IZ WRITTEN BY A HAND DAT GETS BETTER AT HANDWRITIN' EACH DAY.
DA FIRST ENTRIES IN IT IZ {BARELY LEGIBLE|A CHILD'S|SHAPES}. DA LAST ONES IZ INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM DA NOTEBOOK NEXT TA DEM, INCLUDIN' DA SIGNATURE, AN' DA DATE ON DA LAST ONE IZ {TODAY|DIS WEEK|DA BEST PART OF A WEEK AGO}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMETINK IZ LEARNIN' TA BE ONE OF DEM.|IT IZ UP TA ELEVEN. WE IZ DA TWELFTH.|PUT DA BOOK DOWN AN' GO DOWN DA LADDER.}"
asides.any: {member} {COMPARES DA TWO HANDS SIDE BY SIDE|LOOKS AT DA TEN PAIRS OF BOOTS AN' DEN AT DA BEDS|COUNTS DA PLATES AGAIN}

choices.text: TAKE ALL ELEVEN NOTEBOOKS AN' CLIMB DOWN!
WORK OUT WHICH OF DA ELEVEN IT HAB BIN COPYIN'!
LEAVE DA ELEVENTH NOTEBOOK AN' TAKE DA OTHER TEN!

a2_copy.text:
IT HAB NO BIN COPYIN' ONE OF DEM. IT HAB BIN COPYIN' {ALL OF DEM IN TURN|EACH IN ORDER|ONE A WEEK}, AN' DA ORDER IZ DA ORDER OF DA CAMP BEDS, AN' IT HAB REACHED DA LAST BED.
DAT BED IZ MADE. DA NOTEBOOK BELONGIN' TA IT IZ DA ONLY ONE MISSIN' FROM DA TABLE: IT IZ UNDER DA PILLOW, UNOPENED, BLANK, AN' DA PARTY IZ {ARM'S LENGTH AN' A BIT|NO FAR|DA WIDTH OF DA PLATFORM} FROM IT WHEN DA LADDER BELOW STARTS TAKIN' WEIGHT!

a2_ten.text:
TEN NOTEBOOKS IN DA PACK AN' DA ELEVENTH LEFT OPEN ON DA TABLE AT DA PAGE WHERE DA HANDWRITIN' IZ STILL GOING WRONG.
DA PLATFORM IZ QUIET ALL DA WAY DOWN DA LADDER. {A COUPLE OF MONTHS|A SEASON|SOME MONTHS} LATER, IN {region}, TEN FIELD NOTEBOOKS IZ HANDED TA AN INSTITUTE AN' TEN FAMILIES GET A LETTER, AN' DERE IZ NO ELEVENTH FAMILY TA WRITE TA, WHICH IZ EXACTLY DA POINT!

b2_m.text:
DA BOOTS GO IN DA PACK AN' DA CANOPY ABOVE HOLDS ITS BREATH, AN' DA TINK DAT COMES DOWN DA TRUNK COMES DOWN IT {HEAD FIRST|DA WRONG WAY UP|LIKE WATER GOING DA WRONG WAY}.
IT STOPS AT HEAD HEIGHT, {ARM'S LENGTH AN' A BIT|A FEW PACES|NO DISTANCE} OFF, AN' PUTS OUT ONE HAND, PALM UP, WHICH IZ A GESTURE NUTTIN' IN DIS WOOD SHOULD HAB!

choices.text: KEEP DA BOOTS.
PUT DA BOOTS IN DA HAND.
PUT SOMETINK BETTER IN DA HAND INSTEAD!

b2_hand.text:
DA BOOTS GO INTO DA HAND AN' DA HAND CLOSES AN' GOES BACK UP DA TRUNK WIT DEM, AN' DA CANOPY LETS GO, AN' DA KETTLE STARTS AGAIN.
DERE IZ {NINE|EIGHT} PAIRS IN DA SQUARE NOW. ON DA TRACK OUT DERE IZ A PAIR DAT FITS {leader} EXACTLY, SET DOWN IN DA MIDDLE OF DA PATH, LACED!

b2_trade.text:
WHAT GOES IN DA HAND IZ {A NOTEBOOK|A COMPASS|SOMETINK OF DA PARTY'S OWN DAT HAB A NAME IN IT}, WHICH IZ WORTH MORE DEN BOOTS TA ANYTINK DAT IZ TRYIN' TA LEARN HOW TA BE ELEVEN PEOPLE.
IT TAKES IT, AN' READS IT, IN DA SENSE DAT IT HOLDS IT AN' GOES STILL FOR {NINE SECONDS|A COUNT OF NINE|A WHILE}. DEN IT GIVES BACK DA BOOTS, AN' SOMETINK ELSE, AN' GOES UP DA TRUNK, AN' DA PLATFORM IZ EMPTY OF IT FROM DAT DAY!

e_spiritwoods.title: {DA LANTERN|SOMEBODY IZ WALKIN' A LIGHT BETWEEN DA TREES|NINE STEPS BEHIND}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A LIGHT IN DA WOOD, AN' IT IZ A LANTERN, AN' IT IZ BEING CARRIED: IT SWINGS DA WAY A LAMP SWINGS ON A PERSON'S ARM, AN' IT GOES BEHIND TRUNKS AN' COMES OUT DA OTHER SIDE.
WHOEVER IZ CARRYIN' IT STAYS EXACTLY NINE STEPS AHEAD. WHEN YOU STOP, IT STOPS. WHEN YOU GO BACK, IT COMES BACK WIT YOU.
{smell}. UNDER DAT, FAINTLY, {smell2}.
DA LANTERN HAB BIN GOING DA SAME ROUND FOR AS LONG AS ANYBODY IN DA NEAREST VILLAGE HAB BIN ALIVE, AN' DA ROUND IZ {NINE|NINE TREES|NINE TURNS} WIDE!
n0.emText:
A LANTERN IN DA WOOD, CARRIED, A GOOD STRETCH AHEAD, MATCHIN' YOU.
EVERYTINK HERE IZ THINNER DEN IT IZ ELSEWHERE: DA TREES HAB DA QUALITY OF A HELD IDEA. YOU KNOW EXACTLY WHERE YOU IZ. YOU IZ IN DA PART OF DA WORLD DAT HAB NO MADE UP ITS MIND, AN' YOU WOKE UP IN ONE OF DEZE ON DA FIRST OF JANUARY AN' WALKED OUT OF IT ALONE!
n0.bubba: "NINE STEPS," SAYS BUBBA, COUNTIN' UNDER HIS BREATH. "NOVE. OGNI VOTA NOVE. DAT IZ A FELLA WIT' A SYSTEM, SUGAR."

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.calm: {member} IZ WALKIN' AT EXACTLY DA PACE DEY WAZ WALKIN' BEFORE, AN' IT HELPS!
asides.artistic: {member} SAYS DA LIGHT IZ DA WRONG COLOUR FOR OIL, OR GAS, OR ANYTINK DEY CAN NAME!
asides.fatalistic: {member} {SIGHS: "WELL, WE WAZ GOING TA DIE EVENTUALLY."|SHRUGS: "IF DA REACTOR BLOWS, AT LEAST IT IZ QUICK."|MUTTERS DAT DA UNIVERSE ALWAYS FINDS A WAY TA RUIN YA DAY|EXPECTS DA WORST AN' NO IZ DISAPPOINTED}
asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: FOLLOW IT, AT A GOOD STRETCH, FOR AS LONG AS IT GOES!
PUT YA OWN LIGHT OUT AN' SEE WHAT IT DOES!
CALL TA IT. ASK WHAT IT WANTS!
WALK DIRECTLY AT IT, FAST!

a.text:
AN HOUR, MAYBE TWO: DA WOOD DOES NO AGREE WIT YA WATCH.
IT TAKES YOU TA A CLEARIN' WIT A WELL IN IT, BOARDED OVER AN' WEIGHTED WIT A STONE, AN' IT SETS DA LANTERN DOWN ON DA BOARDS, AN' IT IZ NO DERE ANY MORE, AN' DA LANTERN GOES ON BURNIN'.
UNDER DA BOARDS, SOMETINK SAYS A WORD. ONCE!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: OPEN DA WELL.
TAKE DA LANTERN AN' GO.
ANSWER DA WORD.

b.text:
YOU PUT YA LIGHT OUT AN' DA WOOD GOES ABSOLUTELY BLACK EXCEPT DA LANTERN, WHICH STOPS, AN' TURNS, AN' COMES BACK A COUPLE OF STEPS.
DEN IT WAITS, AT SIX, WHICH IZ DA CLOSEST IT HAB BIN, AN' HOLDS ITSELF A LIL' HIGHER, DA WAY SOMEBODY HOLDS A LIGHT UP TA SEE A FACE!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX THREE TIMES AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: STAND STILL AN' BE LOOKED AT!
LIGHT UP AGAIN AN' CLOSE DA DISTANCE!

c.text:
"NINE," IT SAYS. DA NUMBER ARRIVES DA WAY A SMELL ARRIVES.
"NINE," IT SAYS AGAIN, AN' DA LANTERN SWINGS, AN' YOU UNDERSTAND DAT IT IZ TELLIN' YOU DA PRICE, AN' IT IZ WAITIN' TA HEAR WHAT YOU IZ COUNTIN' IN!

choices.text: OFFER DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT!
OFFER NINE OF SOMETINK ELSE!
OFFER IT NUTTIN' AN' SAY SO PLAINLY!

asides.hedonistic: {member} OFFERS NINE DRINKS. NO LAUGH. NEITHER DOES ANYBODY ELSE!
asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

d.text:
YOU COVER NINE STEPS AN' IT DOES NO MOVE, AN' AT DA END OF DA NINE YOU IZ STANDIN' IN FRONT OF A LANTERN HANGIN' IN DA AIR AT DA HEIGHT OF A HAND, WIT NUTTIN' HOLDIN' IT, IN A WOOD DAT HAB GONE COMPLETELY STILL.
DEN DA LANTERN GOES OUT, AN' EVERYTINK DAT WAZ STANDIN' NINE STEPS BEHIND YOU ALL AFTERNOON IZ NOW STANDIN' DIRECTLY IN FRONT OF YOU, IN DA DARK!

a1.text:
DA STONE COMES OFF, AN' DA BOARDS COME UP, AN' DA WELL IZ DRY, AN' DERE IZ A LADDER, AN' AT DA BOTTOM OF DA LADDER DERE IZ A ROOM DAT IZ OLDER DEN DA WELL, WIT DA WOOD'S OWN NAME WRITTEN ROUND DA WALLS 'BOUT FOUR HUNDRED TIMES.
WHAT IZ IN DA MIDDLE OF DA ROOM HAB BIN WAITIN' TA BE GIVEN TA SOMEBODY WHO CAME DA WHOLE WAY AT A GOOD STRETCH AN' DID NO RUSH IT!

a2.text:
IT BURNS FOR A WEEK AN' A BIT IN YA PACK WITOUT OIL AN' DEN STOPS, AN' AFTER DAT IT IZ A LANTERN.
WHILE IT BURNS, NUTTIN' FOLLOWS YOU AT NIGHT, WHICH YOU ONLY NOTICE PROPERLY ON DA TWELFTH DAY!

a3.text:
YOU ANSWER IT, AN' YOU GET IT RIGHT, WHICH IZ LARGELY LUCK AN' A LIL' BIT OF LISTENIN'.
DA BOARDS DO NO MOVE. DA WORD IZ SAID AGAIN, GENTLY, AN' DIS TIME IT IZ A THANK YOU, AN' DA WOOD OPENS A WAY OUT DAT IZ 'BOUT A FIFTH AS LONG AS DA WAY IN.
ON DA PATH DERE IZ {relicWord}, PUT DOWN WHERE YOU WILL TRIP OVER IT, COZ IT HAB NEVER HAB TA GIVE ANYBODY ANYTINK BEFORE AN' IT IZ NO SURE HOW!

b1.text:
IT COMES TA ARM'S LENGTH AN' LOOKS AT EACH OF YOU FOR AS LONG AS IT TAKES, AN' AT ONE OF YOU FOR LONGER.
DEN IT PUTS DA LANTERN IN DAT PERSON'S HAND, CLOSES DEY FINGERS ON DA HANDLE, AN' IZ NO DERE, AN' DA WOOD IZ AN ORDINARY WOOD FULL OF ORDINARY NIGHT!

c1.text:
NINE DAYS GO SOMEWHERE. YOU IZ NO AWARE OF LOSIN' DEM; DA CALENDAR IZ.
WHAT YOU HAB WHEN YOU COME OUT OF DA WOOD IZ NINE DAYS OLDER, NINE DAYS POORER, AN' HOLDIN' SOMETINK DAT IZ WORTH A GREAT DEAL MORE DEN NINE DAYS!

c2.text:
NINE COINS, NINE STEPS, NINE WORDS, NINE OF ANYTINK: IT TAKES WHAT IZ OFFERED, IF IT IZ OFFERED IN NINES, WHICH IZ DA ONLY RULE IT HAB EVER HAB.
WHAT IT GIVES BACK IZ NO WHAT YOU ASKED FOR AN' IZ WORTH HAVIN' ANYWAY!

c3.text:
"NUTTIN'," YOU SAY. "WE HAB NUTTIN' FOR YOU AN' WE IZ NO GOING TA PRETEND OTHERWISE."
DA LANTERN GOES DOWN, AN' STAYS DOWN, AN' BURNS ON DA GROUND WHERE IT WAZ SET, AN' DA WOOD LETS YOU OUT IN DA DIRECTION YOU ACTUALLY WANTED RATHER DEN DA DIRECTION IT WAZ TAKIN' YOU.
HONESTY IZ ALWAYS NOTICED!

a2_m.text:
DA LANTERN IZ TAKEN OFF ITS HOOK AN' IT COMES {EASILY|WITOUT ARGUMENT|AS THOUGH IT HAB BIN PUT DERE FOR DA PURPOSE}, AN' IT BURNS WITOUT OIL.
WHAT IZ STANDIN' WHERE IT WAZ STANDIN' DOES NO FOLLOW, BUT IT DOES SPEAK, ONCE, AN' WHAT IT SAYS IZ A QUESTION IN DA SHAPE OF A NUMBER, AN' DA NUMBER IZ NINE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{IT IZ ASKIN' WHAT WE WILL PAY.|EVERYTINK OUT HERE COSTS NINE.|WE HAB TAKEN SOMETINK AN' IT HAB NOTICED.}"
asides.any: {member} {HOLDS DA LANTERN OUT AT ARM'S LENGTH|COUNTS NINE OF SOMETINK WITOUT BEING ASKED|DOES NO LET GO OF IT}

choices.text: TAKE IT AN' GO. DO NO ANSWER!
ANSWER WIT NINE OF SOMETINK!
ASK WHAT DA LANTERN IZ FOR BEFORE CARRYIN' IT ANYWHERE!

a2_for.text:
IT IZ FOR DA WELL. IT HAB ALWAYS BIN FOR DA WELL: IT IZ CARRIED A GOOD STRETCH AHEAD OF WHOEVER IZ GOING TA DA WELL SO DAT DA WELL KNOWS SOMEBODY IZ COMIN' AN' HAB TIME TA {COMPOSE ITSELF|BE READY|STOP}.
CARRYIN' IT OUT OF DA WOOD DOES NO BREAK ANYTINK. IT DOES MEAN DAT FOR {A WEEK AN' A BIT|AS LONG AS IT BURNS|A WHILE} DERE IZ A WELL SOMEWHERE WIT NUTTIN' WALKIN' AHEAD OF IT, AN' DA PARTY KNOWS EXACTLY WHAT DAT COSTS AN' CHOOSES IT ANYWAY!

c1_m.text:
NINE DAYS IZ OFFERED AN' DA NUMBER IZ ACCEPTED DA WAY A SHOP ACCEPTS A NOTE: WITOUT CEREMONY, WIT A LIL' MOVEMENT OF DA LANTERN.
DEN IT WAITS, COZ NINE DAYS IZ A PRICE AN' A PRICE IZ PAID AT A COUNTER, AN' DA COUNTER IZ {DA WELL|DA CLEARIN'|SOMEWHERE IT INTENDS TA TAKE DA PARTY}, AN' IT STARTS WALKIN'!

choices.text: FOLLOW IT AN' PAY.
PAY HERE. SIT DOWN AN' LET DA NINE DAYS GO!
FOLLOW, BUT COUNT DA STEPS!

c1_here.text:
SITTIN' DOWN IN A WOOD AN' DELIBERATELY LETTIN' NINE DAYS GO IZ DA SINGLE STRANGEST TINK DA PARTY DOES ALL YEAR, AN' IT TAKES {A COUPLE OF SECONDS|NO TIME|AN INSTANT} FROM DA INSIDE.
FROM DA OUTSIDE IT TAKES NINE DAYS. DA WOOD IZ EXACTLY AS IT WAZ. DA PARTY IZ NINE DAYS HUNGRIER, NINE DAYS THINNER, AN' CARRYIN' SOMETINK DAT WAZ NO IN ANY PACK WHEN DEY SAT DOWN!

c1_steps.text:
COUNTED, DA WALK TA DA WELL IZ {NINE HUNDRED|NINE HUNDRED AN' NINE|NINE TIMES NINE TIMES NINE} STEPS, WHICH IZ NO A COINCIDENCE AN' IZ NO A DISTANCE DA CLEARIN' IZ FROM HERE.
KNOWIN' DAT, IT IZ POSSIBLE TA PAY AT DA FOUR HUNDRED AN' FIFTY-FIRST STEP INSTEAD OF AT DA WELL, WHICH IZ EXACTLY HALF, AN' HALF IZ A PRICE DA LANTERN WILL TAKE FROM SOMEBODY WHO HAB BOTHERED TA COUNT. FOUR AN' A HALF DAYS GO. DA PARTY KEEPS DA REST!

e_mountain.title: {DA CAIRN|SOMEBODY COMES UP HERE EVERY WEEK|DA OFFERIN' AT DA COL}

n0.text:
THREE HUNDRED METRES ABOVE DA LAST HOUSE IN {country}, AT DA COL, DERE IZ A CAIRN WIT TINKZ LEFT ON IT.
ON DA TOP STONE, IN A ROW: {offering}, {offering2}, AN' A THIRD DAT SOMEBODY HAB TAKEN AWAY AN' LEFT DA MARK OF.
DA STONES IZ DRY. IT RAINED HERE HALF A SHIFT AGO.
DA OFFERINGS IZ SORTED. LIL' ONES ON DA TOP STONE, HEAVIER ONES IN DA RING AT DA BASE, AN' NONE OF DEM {RUSTED|WEATHERED|SPOILED} DESPITE DA WEATHER!
n0.emText:
A CAIRN AT DA COL WIT TINKZ LEFT ON IT: {offering}, {offering2}, AN' DA DRY RING WHERE A THIRD STOOD UNTIL RECENTLY.
DA STONES IZ DRY IN WEATHER DAT HAB SOAKED YOU TA DA SHOULDERS. SOMETINK UP HERE IZ HOLDIN' A LIL' PATCH OF DA WORLD EXEMPT, AN' DOING IT POLITELY, AN' DOING IT EVERY WEEK!

WAIT FOR WHOEVER BRINGS DEZE UP!
TAKE DA CAIRN APART.

a.text:
YOU PUT SOMETINK OF YA ON DA STONE, AN' DA WEATHER CHANGES: NO DRAMATICALLY, JUST A WIND DAT HAB BIN IN YA FACE ALL MORNIN' AN' NOW IZ NO.
GOING DOWN, YOU FIND DA WAY EASIER DEN IT WAZ COMIN' UP, WHICH IZ NO HOW MOUNTAINS WORK, AN' AT DA LAST GATE SOMEBODY HAB LEFT {payment} ON DA POST WIT A STONE ON TOP OF IT SO DA WIND NO CAN HAB IT!

b.text:
TWO HOURS IN DA LEE OF A ROCK, AN' DEN {stranger} COMES UP DA LAST OF DA PATH WIT A CARRIER BAG AN' STOPS DEAD WHEN DEY SEE YOU.
"YOU HAB NO MOVED ANYTINK," DEY SAY. IT IZ DA FIRST TINK DEY CHECK, AN' DEY CHECK IT PROPERLY, ON DEY KNEES, BEFORE DEY WILL LOOK AT YOU AGAIN!

OFFER TA CARRY IT UP NEXT WEEK!

c.text:
DA STONES COME DOWN EASILY. UNDER DA BOTTOM ONE DERE IZ A HOLLOW LINED WIT SLATE, AN' IN DA HOLLOW DERE IZ A LIL' HEAVY TINK WRAPPED IN OILCLOTH, AN' TAKIN' IT IZ DA EASIEST THEFT ANY OF YOU HAB EVER COMMITTED.
DA WIND GETS UP WHILE YOU IZ DOING IT. DA PATH DOWN IZ NO WHERE YOU LEFT IT!

d.text:
DA OFFERINGS COME UP FROM A FARM ON DA SOUTH SIDE BY A PATH DAT IZ NO ON ANY MAP, AN' DA FARM HAB A WALL ROUND IT DAT IZ FAR TOO GOOD FOR A FARM.
DA WOMAN DERE HAB BIN EXPECTIN' SOMEBODY FOR A WHILE, AN' YOU WILL DO!

choices.text: TAKE HER JOB.
ASK WHAT HAPPENS IF NOBODY TAKES IT!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}

b1.text:
"FOR DA COL," DEY SAY, AS IF DAT WAZ DA WHOLE ANSWER, AN' DEN, COZ YOU HAB WAITED TWO HOURS IN DA WET: "FOR WHAT WALKS IT. IT HAB BIN WALKED A LONG TIME AN' IT DOES NO LIKE BEING WALKED ON FOR NUTTIN'."
DEY TEACH YOU DA FOUR TINKZ YOU LEAVE AN' DA ONE TINK YOU NEVER LEAVE, AN' MAKE YOU SAY DA ONE TINK BACK!

b2.text:
DEY LOOK AT YOU FOR A LONG MOMENT AN' DEN HAND YOU DA BAG, AN' IT IZ MUCH HEAVIER DEN A BAG OF LIL' OBJECTS SHOULD BE.
YOU DO IT FOR A MONTH. ON DA FOURTH WEEK DA COL LEAVES SOMETINK FOR YOU, WHICH IZ NO HOW DA ARRANGEMENT HAB EVER RUN, AN' DA WOMAN AT DA FARM GOES WHITE WHEN SHE SEES IT!

d1.text:
DA JOB IZ TA GO UP IN WEATHER SHE NO CAN GO UP IN AN' PUT A SPECIFIC TINK ON A SPECIFIC STONE AT A SPECIFIC HOUR, AN' TA NO LOOK BEHIND YOU BETWEEN DA COL AN' DA SECOND GATE.
YOU DO IT. YOU DO NO LOOK. WHAT IZ BEHIND YOU TALKS DA WHOLE WAY DOWN, PLEASANTLY, 'BOUT PEOPLE YOU HAB NEVER MET, AN' KNOWS ALL DEY NAMES, AN' ONE OF DEM IZ YA!

d2.text:
"NINETY-ONE," SHE SAYS. "NINETY-ONE AN' DEN DA COL COMES DOWN HERE AN' DOES DA ASKIN' ITSELF. IT DID IT IN {timeAgo} AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' LEFT OF DA HOUSE IT ASKED AT BUT DA GATE."
SHE PAYS YOU TA MAKE DA WEEK'S CLIMB ONCE, WHICH IZ ALL YOU IZ WILLIN' TA PROMISE, AN' PAYS OVER DA ODDS FOR IT!

a_m.text:
LEAVIN' SOMETINK OF YA OWN ON DA STONE TAKES {FOUR SECONDS|A MOMENT|NO DECIDIN'}, AN' DA WIND DAT HAB BIN IN YA FACE ALL MORNIN' GOES ROUND BEHIND YOU.
DA TINK YOU LEFT HAB BIN MOVED {THREE STONES DOWN|TA DA BASE RING|INTO DA RING WIT DA HEAVY ONES}, WHICH IZ WHERE DA HEAVY TINKZ GO, AN' IT IZ NO HEAVY!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{IT HAB BIN SORTED. BY SOMETINK. JUST NOW.|IT GRADED OUR OFFERIN'.|WHATEVER GRADES DAT CAIRN IZ STANDIN' HERE.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A SECOND TINK ON DA TOP STONE TA SEE|WATCHES DA RING RATHER DEN DA TOP|STEPS BACK OFF DA COL}

choices.text: TAKE DA HINT. WALK ON.
WORK OUT WHAT DA SORTIN' IZ BY!
PUT IT BACK ON DA TOP STONE!

a_sort.text:
IT GOES BY {HOW MUCH IT COST DA PERSON WHO LEFT IT|WHAT IT WAZ WORTH TA GIVE|HOW MUCH WAZ GIVEN UP}, WHICH IZ A TINK DA CAIRN CAN APPARENTLY MEASURE AN' NOBODY ELSE CAN.
WHICH MEANS DA BASE RING IZ DA EXPENSIVE RING, AN' DA BASE RING IZ {FULL|PACKED|FOUR DEEP}, AN' DA PEOPLE OF DIS VALLEY HAB BIN PAYIN' A GREAT DEAL MORE UP HERE DEN ANYBODY DOWN DERE ADMITS!

a_back.text:
IT GOES BACK ON DA TOP STONE AN' STAYS DERE FOR {NINE SECONDS|A COUNT OF NINE|'BOUT AS LONG AS IT TAKES TA STEP BACK}.
DEN DA WIND COMES ROUND INTO YA FACE AGAIN, HARDER, AN' DA WHOLE COL DOES DA TINK A ROOM DOES WHEN YOU HAB BIN RUDE IN IT, AN' DA WALK DOWN IZ {A COUPLE OF HOURS|AN HOUR|DA LONGEST} OF EVERYBODY BEING REAL CAREFUL 'BOUT DEY FOOTIN'!

c_m.text:
DA STONES COME DOWN EASILY. UNDER DA BOTTOM ONE DERE IZ A HOLLOW LINED WIT SLATE, AN' IN DA HOLLOW DERE IZ A LIL' HEAVY TINK WRAPPED IN OILCLOTH.
DERE IZ ALSO {A SECOND HOLLOW|ROOM FOR ANOTHER|AN EMPTY SLATE BOX}, BESIDE IT, DA SAME SIZE, LINED DA SAME WAY, AN' IT HAB CLEARLY HELD SOMETINK AN' DOES NO NOW!

choices.text: TAKE IT AN' REBUILD DA CAIRN BADLY!
TAKE IT AN' REBUILD DA CAIRN PROPERLY, STONE FOR STONE!
FIND OUT WHAT CAME OUT OF DA SECOND HOLLOW!

c_build.text:
REBUILDIN' A CAIRN PROPERLY MEANS PUTTIN' EVERY STONE BACK ON ITS OWN BED, IN ITS OWN ORDER, WHICH TAKES {A COUPLE OF HOURS|DA REST OF DA LIGHT|UNTIL DUSK} AN' IZ DONE BY PEOPLE WHO IZ NO MASONS AN' GET IT RIGHT ANYWAY.
NOBODY IN DA VALLEY EVER KNOWS IT WAZ OPENED. DA TINK IN DA OILCLOTH IZ WORTH WHAT IT IZ WORTH, AN' DA PARTY IZ DA ONLY PARTY EVER TA HAB TAKEN SOMETINK OFF DAT COL AN' LEFT IT EXACTLY AS DEY FOUND IT!

c_second.text:
DA WEAR IN DA SECOND HOLLOW SAYS IT HELD ITS TINK FOR A REAL LONG TIME AN' LOST IT {RECENTLY|INSIDE DA YEAR|DIS SEASON}, AN' DA SLATE IZ SCRATCHED ON DA WAY OUT RATHER DEN DA WAY IN.
SOMEBODY TOOK IT. SOMEBODY WHO KNEW DA CAIRN WAZ A LID. DAT IZ A MUCH MORE INTERESTIN' FACT DEN DA OBJECT IN DA PARTY'S HAND, AN' IT IZ ONE DAT CAN BE FOLLOWED!

e_mountainice.title: {DA CREVASSE|DA FAR END OF IT DOWN AN' STILL TALKIN'|DA ROPE SOMEBODY LEFT}

n0.text:
A ROPE, ANCHORED PROPERLY, ICE SCREWS IN SOUND ICE, GOING DOWN INTO A CREVASSE AN' PULLED TIGHT.
SOMEONE'S ON DA OTHER END OF IT. SOMEBODY HAB BIN ON DA OTHER END OF IT FOR A WHILE, JUDGIN' BY DA ICE DAT HAB FORMED ON DA ROPE WHERE IT CROSSES DA LIP.
WHEN YOU GET TA DA EDGE AN' LOOK, A VOICE COMES UP FROM A LONG WAY DOWN, CONVERSATIONAL, UNHURRIED, AN' SAYS: "IZ DAT YOU, DEN?"
DA SCREWS IZ IN SOUND ICE AN' DEY IZ {NEW|DIS SEASON'S|NO TWENTY YEARS OLD}, AN' DA ROPE IZ OLD!
n0.emText:
A ROPE GOING DOWN INTO A CREVASSE, TIGHT, ICED OVER AT DA LIP. DOWN DERE, A VOICE, UNHURRIED: "IZ DAT YOU, DEN?"
YOU HAB NEVER HEARD DA VOICE. IT KNOWS YOU. DAT IZ NOW DA FOURTH TINK DIS MONTH DAT HAB KNOWN YOU WHEN YOU DID NO KNOW IT, AN' YOU IZ KEEPIN' COUNT, COZ COUNTIN' IZ DA ONLY ARCHIVE YOU HAB!
n0.bubba: BUBBA LIES FLAT AN' SHOUTS DOWN DA HOLE. "WHO IZ ASKIN'?" A PAUSE. "HE SAYS HE KNOWS YA, SUGAR. UH-UH. NUN ME PIACE."

choices.text: GO DOWN.
TALK TA IT FROM DA TOP.
HAUL DA ROPE UP AN' SEE WHAT IZ ON DA END!
CUT DA ROPE.

a.text:
DA FAR END OF IT DOWN DA BLUE GOES REAL DARK AN' DEN OPENS: A CHAMBER IN DA ICE WIT A SHELF OF GEAR ON IT, MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE OF IT, ARRANGED.
DA MAN ON DA END OF DA ROPE IZ SITTIN' ON DA SHELF. HE IZ NO COLD. HE OFFERS YOU DA THERMOS. HE HAB BIN DOWN HERE SINCE A DATE HE GIVES CHEERFULLY AN' WHICH IZ ON DA WRONG SIDE OF WHAT A PERSON SURVIVES!

choices.text: TAKE HIM UP.
TAKE DA GEAR AN' LEAVE HIM WHERE HE IZ COMFORTABLE!
ASK HIM WHAT HE IZ WAITIN' FOR!

b.text:
HE TALKS FOR A LONG STRETCH AN' HE IZ REAL GOOD COMPANY.
HE KNOWS DA NAMES OF TWO OF YA PARTY, ONE OF DEM A NAME DEY HAB NO USED SINCE DEY WAZ A CHILD. HE IZ ONLY FILLIN' A SILENCE, DA WAY PEOPLE DO WHO HAB BIN ALONE A WHILE, AN' EVERY SO OFTEN HE STOPS MID-WORD AN' WAITS FOR A SOUND DAT DOES NO COME!

choices.text: ASK WHAT HE IZ LISTENIN' FOR!
PROMISE TA SEND HELP AN' GO!

asides.melancholic: {member} SITS AT DA LIP LONG AFTER DA REST OF YOU HAB GOT COLD!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text:
IT COMES UP LIGHT, AN' IT KEEPS COMIN', AN' IT KEEPS COMIN': A HUNDRED AN' TEN METRES OF ROPE OUT OF A CREVASSE DAT IZ SIXTY DEEP, AN' ON DA END OF IT A HARNESS, BUCKLED, WIT NOBODY IN IT AN' NO WEAR ON DA LEG LOOPS.
DA VOICE, STILL DOWN DERE, SAYS: "AH. WELL."

d.text:
YOU CUT IT, AN' DA END GOES DOWN WITOUT A SOUND, AN' DA VOICE DOES NO SHOUT.
IT SAYS, QUITE KINDLY, "DAT IZ ALL RIGHT," AN' DEN NUTTIN' AT ALL, AN' DA CREVASSE IZ A HOLE IN A GLACIER ON A COLD AFTERNOON.
ONE OF YA PARTY DOES NO SLEEP PROPERLY FOR A FORTNIGHT AN' WILL NO SAY WHICH PART OF IT IZ DA PROBLEM!

a1.text:
HE COMES UP EASILY. HE WEIGHS 'BOUT AS MUCH AS A COAT.
AT DA LIP, IN DAYLIGHT, HE THANKS EACH OF YOU BY NAME, WALKS A GOOD STRETCH ONTO DA SNOW, AN' IZ NO DERE. DA GEAR YOU BROUGHT UP WIT HIM IZ ENTIRELY REAL AN' WORTH A FORTUNE TA DA RIGHT MUSEUM!

a2.text:
FORTY YEARS OF MOUNTAINEERIN' HARDWARE, ALL OF IT GOOD, SOME OF IT MADE BY FIRMS DAT CLOSED BEFORE YOU WAZ BORN.
HE HELPS YOU PACK IT AN' HOLDS DA ROPE WHILE YOU GO UP, WHICH IZ DA PART DAT STAYS WIT YOU!

a3.text:
"DA REST OF DA ROPE," HE SAYS.
DEN HE EXPLAINS, PATIENTLY, WHAT HE MEANS, AN' IT TAKES SOME TIME, AN' BY DA END OF IT YOU IZ QUITE CERTAIN DAT DA ICE HAB BIN KEEPIN' HIM UNDER AN AGREEMENT, AN' DAT YOU HAB BIN HANDED DA TERMS!

b1.text:
"DA SECOND ONE," HE SAYS. "DERE IZ ALWAYS A SECOND ONE ON A ROPE. ME KEEP LISTENIN' FOR DA SECOND ONE."
ZERO SECOND ANCHOR. DERE NEVER WAZ. WHAT COMES UP DA ROPE WHEN YOU FINALLY STOP TALKIN' IZ NO HIM!

b2.text:
YOU PROMISE, AN' YOU MEAN IT, AN' DA RESCUE SERVICE IN {region} TAKES DA GRID REFERENCE AN' LOOKS AT EACH OTHER IN A WAY YOU WILL TINK 'BOUT LATER.
DEY HAB DAT REFERENCE. DEY HAB HAB IT FOR A LONG TIME. DEY PAY YA EXPENSES, TAKE A STATEMENT, AN' ASK YOU, REAL CAREFULLY, WHETHER HE USED YA NAMES!

a2_m.text:
FORTY YEARS OF MOUNTAINEERIN' HARDWARE, ALL OF IT GOOD, SOME OF IT MADE BY FIRMS DAT CLOSED BEFORE YOU WAZ BORN, AN' HE HELPS YOU PACK IT AN' HOLDS DA BAG OPEN.
WHILE HE HOLDS IT HE ASKS, WITOUT ANY WEIGHT ON DA QUESTION AT ALL, WHETHER DA PARTY WOULD MIND LEAVIN' {ONE TINK|A SINGLE ITEM|SOMETINK OF DEY} ON DA SHELF, COZ DA SHELF {HAB TA HAB SOMETINK ON IT|NO CAN BE EMPTY|IZ NO ALLOWED TA BE EMPTY}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DO NO PUT ANYTINK OF OURS ON DAT SHELF.|HE IZ REAL RELAXED 'BOUT A LIFETIME OF WORK OF HIS OWN KIT.|DAT SHELF IZ DA POINT.}"
asides.any: {member} {LOOKS AT DA SHELF AN' DEN AT DA MAN|KEEPS PACKIN'|HOLDS ONE TINK BACK WITOUT BEING ASKED}

choices.text: LEAVE SOMETINK. IT IZ A FAIR TRADE!
TAKE DA GEAR AN' LEAVE NUTTIN'!
ASK WHAT HAPPENS TA A SHELF DAT IZ EMPTY!

a2_leave.text:
ONE ITEM OFF DA PARTY'S OWN KIT, PUT ON DA SHELF IN DA GAP DA BAG CAME OUT OF, AN' HE STRAIGHTENS IT {SLIGHTLY|BY A FINGER'S WIDTH|SO IT SITS SQUARE}.
DA CLIMB OUT IZ EASY IN A WAY DA CLIMB IN WAZ NO. DA ITEM IZ ON DA SHELF FOR GOOD AN' EVERYBODY KNOWS IT. WHICHEVER OF DA PARTY PUT IT DERE DREAMS 'BOUT A BLUE ROOM {FOUR|FIVE|SEVERAL} TIMES A YEAR FOR DA REST OF DEY LIFE AN' DOES NO MIND!

a2_empty.text:
"DEN IT IZ A HOLE IN DA ICE," HE SAYS, REASONABLY, "AN' HOLES IN ICE WANT FILLIN', AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' DOWN HERE TA FILL IT WIT EXCEPT WHAT WALKS IN."
HE IZ EXPLAININ' A SYSTEM HE HAB BIN MAINTAININ', ALONE, FOR {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE|FOUR DECADES|LONGER DEN DAT}, AN' HE WOULD REAL MUCH LIKE TA BE RELIEVED, AN' HE SAYS SO, OUT LOUD, FOR DA FIRST TIME!

b2_m.text:
DA PROMISE IZ MADE AN' IT IZ MEANT, AN' DA WALK DOWN TAKES {FOUR HOURS|DA REST OF DA DAY|UNTIL DARK}, AN' DA RESCUE SERVICE IN {region} TAKES DA GRID REFERENCE.
DEY LOOK AT EACH OTHER. DEN ONE OF DEM OPENS A FOLDER DAT IZ {TWO INCHES|REAL} THICK, AN' TURNS IT ROUND ON DA DESK, AN' DA GRID REFERENCE AT DA TOP OF DA FIRST PAGE IZ DA ONE DA PARTY HAB JUST GIVEN DEM!

choices.text: TAKE DA MONEY FOR DA REPORT AN' LEAVE IT WIT DEM!
READ DA FOLDER.
GO BACK UP WIT DEM.

b2_folder.text:
{NINE|ELEVEN|A GREAT MANY} CALL-OUTS TA DA SAME GRID REFERENCE OVER {THIRTY YEARS|THREE DECADES|A LONG TIME}, EVERY ONE OF DEM A ROPE GOING DOWN INTO A CREVASSE WIT A VOICE ON DA END OF IT, EVERY ONE OF DEM CLOSED AS A RECOVERY WIT NUTTIN' RECOVERED.
AN' DA NAMES OF DA TEAMS. TWO OF DA NAMES IZ ON DA CURRENT DUTY BOARD IN DA NEXT ROOM, AN' NEITHER OF DEM WILL TALK 'BOUT IT, AN' ONE OF DEM GOES OUTSIDE!

b2_back.text:
GOING BACK UP WIT DA SERVICE MEANS GOING UP WIT {FOUR|FIVE} PEOPLE WHO HAB DONE DIS BEFORE AN' WHO DO NO TALK ON DA WAY.
DEY BRING UP A ROPE. DERE IZ NUTTIN' ON DA END OF IT. DEY COIL IT, LOG IT, AN' GO BACK DOWN, AN' ON DA WAY ONE OF DEM SAYS, TA NOBODY, DAT DA SECOND ANCHOR IZ DA PART EVERYBODY GETS WRONG, AN' DA PARTY DOES NO ASK WHAT DAT MEANS UNTIL MUCH LATER!

e_mountaindesert.title: {DA STAIR|TWO HUNDRED STEPS CUT INTO NUTTIN'|DA LADDER IN DA ROCK}

n0.text:
STEPS CUT INTO DA ROCK FACE, GOING UP: TWO HUNDRED OF DEM, WORN IN DA MIDDLE, ENDIN' AT A LEDGE WIT NUTTIN' ON IT AN' NOWHERE TA GO.
NO TEMPLE. NO DOOR. NO NICHE. A LEDGE, AN ARM'S LENGTH DEEP, TWO HUNDRED STEPS ABOVE DA VALLEY FLOOR, AN' WORN STEPS MEAN FEET, AN' A LOT OF DEM.
AT DA BOTTOM, IN DA SHADE, SOMEBODY HAB LEFT A WATER JAR. IT IZ FULL.
DA TWO HUNDREDTH STEP IZ WORN LIKE DA OTHERS. NUTTIN' HAB EVER STOOD ON IT LONG ENOUGH TA WEAR IT AN' GONE NO FURTHER!
n0.emText:
TWO HUNDRED STEPS CUT INTO A CLIFF, WORN HOLLOW IN DA MIDDLE, AN' AT DA TOP A LEDGE WIT NUTTIN' ON IT AT ALL.
SOMETINK USED TA BE DERE. YOU IZ BECOMIN' AN EXPERT ON DA SHAPE OF TINKZ DAT USED TA BE DERE. AT DA BOTTOM OF DA STAIR, IN DA SHADE, A FULL WATER JAR, PUT DOWN TODAY BY SOMEBODY WHO EXPECTS DA WALK TA BE MADE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA DRINKS FROM DA JAR, WHICH EVERYONE WOULD HAB ADVISED AGAINST. "AH. FRESH. SOMEBODY'S MINDIN' DIS PLACE. STATTE ACCUORTO NCOPPA, SUGAR."

choices.text: CLIMB AN' STAND ON DA LEDGE!
WAIT AT DA BOTTOM FOR WHOEVER FILLS DA JAR!
SEARCH DA FOOT OF DA CLIFF FOR WHAT FELL OFF DA LEDGE!
CLIMB AT NIGHT.

a.text:
DA VALLEY FROM UP HERE IZ DA WHOLE OF DA WORLD LAID FLAT, AN' DA LEDGE IZ EXACTLY DEEP ENOUGH TA STAND ON WIT YA BACK TA DA ROCK, WHICH IZ WHAT IT IZ FOR.
WHEN YOU HAB BIN DERE LONG ENOUGH FOR YA BREATHIN' TA SETTLE, DA ROCK BEHIND YA SHOULDERS IZ WARM, AN' DERE IZ A HOLLOW IN IT AT DA HEIGHT OF A HEAD, WORN BY HEADS!

choices.text: PUT YA HEAD IN DA HOLLOW.
COME DOWN AN' SAY NUTTIN' 'BOUT IT!

asides.calm: {member} HAB ALREADY GOT DEY HEAD IN DA HOLLOW AN' DEY EYES SHUT!
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
DA JAR IZ FILLED BY A BOY OF 'BOUT ELEVEN WHO RUNS DA LAST HUNDRED METRES COZ HE IZ LATE, AN' WHO IZ NO REMOTELY BOTHERED BY FINDIN' A FEW STRANGERS DERE.
"IT IZ ME WEEK," HE SAYS. "YOU HAB TA KEEP IT FULL. IF IT IZ EMPTY DEY COME DOWN."
HE SAYS DIS DA WAY YOU WOULD SAY DAT DA BINS GO OUT ON TUESDAY!

choices.text: ASK WHO DEY IZ.
EMPTY DA JAR AN' WAIT.
FILL IT, AN' FILL DA SPARE, AN' GO!

asides.nurturing: {member} CARRIES DA WATER DA LAST HUNDRED METRES FOR HIM, OBVIOUSLY!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text: TWO HUNDRED STEPS OF DROPPED TINKZ: COINS FROM SIX CENTURIES, BUTTONS, A SHOE, FOUR RINGS, A KNIFE WIT A SAINT'S NAME ON DA BLADE, AN', HALF UNDER A SLAB, IN {relicWord}, SOMETINK DAT WAZ HIDDEN ON PURPOSE!

d.text:
AT NIGHT DA STEPS IZ COLD AN' DA LEDGE IZ NO.
STANDIN' ON IT IN DA DARK, YOU CAN SEE DA VALLEY DA WAY IT WAZ: LIGHTS IN A PATTERN OF A TOWN DAT IZ NO DERE, AN' A ROAD GOING SOMEWHERE DAT HAB NO EXISTED IN FOUR HUNDRED YEARS, AN', ON DA LEDGE WIT YOU, DA SHOULDER-TA-SHOULDER PRESS OF A QUEUE.
NOBODY PUSHES. YOU IZ, HOWEVER, IN DA WAY!

a1.text: LEANIN' AGAINST DA WARM ROCK, YOU GET A SUDDEN SHARP CLARITY: A COUPLE OF MINUTES OF KNOWIN' EXACTLY WHERE YOU IZ, IN A SENSE OF DA WORD 'WHERE' DAT INCLUDES DA YEAR, AN' COMIN' OUT OF IT YOU CAN FEEL DA SIZE OF DA MISTAKE YOU HAB BIN MAKIN' 'BOUT SOMETINK!

a2.text:
YOU COME DOWN WITOUT MENTIONIN' IT AN' SOMEBODY AT DA BOTTOM TAKES ONE LOOK AT YA FACE AN' HANDS YOU DA WATER JAR WITOUT A WORD.
WHATEVER DA LEDGE DOES, IT DOES NO DO IT TA EVERYBODY, AN' DA PEOPLE WHO KEEP DA JAR FULL HAB KNOWN DAT FOR FOUR HUNDRED YEARS!

b1.text:
"DA ONES ON DA STAIR," HE SAYS, AN' DEN WILL NO BE DRAWN FURTHER, EXCEPT TA SAY DAT HIS GRANDMOTHER SAW DEM AN' DAT DEY {WALK IN|STEP THROUGH DA ENTRANCE|CROSS DA THRESHOLD|HEAD INSIDE} A QUEUE AN' DAT YOU MUST NEVER BE ON DA STEPS WHEN DEY IZ, COZ DERE IZ ONLY ONE WIDTH OF STAIR.
HE TELLS YOU WHEN, WHICH IZ DA USEFUL PART, AN' IT IZ TONIGHT!

b2.text:
YOU TIP IT OUT ON DA STONES AN' DA BOY GOES WHITE AN' RUNS, WHICH IZ DA CORRECT RESPONSE, AN' WHICH YOU WILL REMEMBER.
DEY COME DOWN. DERE IZ ONLY ONE WIDTH OF STAIR, AN' YOU IZ ON IT!

b3.text:
YOU FILL BOTH JARS AN' CARRY DEM UP TA DA SECOND LANDIN' WHERE DEY IZ SUPPOSED TA SIT, AN' DA BOY TALKS DA WHOLE WAY 'BOUT A BICYCLE HE IZ STASHIN' FOR.
AT DA BOTTOM HIS MOTHER IZ WAITIN' WIT DA WHOLE FAMILY, WHO KNEW YOU WAZ COMIN' BEFORE YOU DID, AN' WHO FEED YOU UNTIL YOU NO CAN STAND!

c_m.text:
TWO HUNDRED STEPS OF DROPPED TINKZ, WORKED OVER ON HANDS AN' KNEES IN DA SHADE: COINS FROM SIX CENTURIES, BUTTONS, A SHOE, FOUR RINGS, A KNIFE WIT A SAINT'S NAME ON DA BLADE.
AN', HALF UNDER DA BOTTOM STEP, A JAR. AN OLDER ONE DEN DA WATER JAR, DA SAME SHAPE, BROKEN, AN' {FULL OF|PACKED WIT|HOLDIN'} DA SAME LIL' OBJECTS DAT IZ ON DA CAIRN-STONE OF EVERY COL IN DIS COUNTRY!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SAME OFFERINGS, DIFFERENT MOUNTAIN.|SOMEBODY HAB BIN RUNNIN' DIS SYSTEM FOR A WHILE.|SIX CENTURIES OF PEOPLE PAYIN' DA SAME TOLL.}"
asides.any: {member} {LAYS DA COINS OUT BY CENTURY|TURNS DA BROKEN JAR OVER|COUNTS DA RINGS}

choices.text: BAG DA LOT AN' GO.
DATE DA CONTENTS OF DA BROKEN JAR!
TAKE NUTTIN'. PUT DA GOOD JAR BACK WHERE DA BROKEN ONE WAZ!

c_date.text:
SIX CENTURIES IZ WRONG. DA OLDEST TINK IN DA JAR IZ {TWO THOUSAND YEARS|CONSIDERABLY OLDER|OLDER DEN DA LANGUAGE DA SAINT'S NAME IZ IN}, AN' DA NEWEST IZ {DIS YEAR|FROM DIS SPRING|RECENT}, AN' DERE IZ NO GAP ANYWHERE IN DA SEQUENCE.
NUTTIN' IN DIS COUNTRY HAB BIN CONTINUOUS FOR TWO THOUSAND YEARS. DIS HAB. DAT IZ DA FINDIN', AN' IT IZ WORTH MORE DEN EVERY COIN IN DA PARTY'S HANDS!

c_jar.text:
DA WHOLE JAR, FILLED AT DA SPRING, CARRIED UP AN' SET INTO DA HOLLOW UNDER DA BOTTOM STEP WHERE DA BROKEN ONE HAB SAT FOR {HOWEVER LONG|A REAL LONG TIME|NOBODY KNOWS HOW LONG}.
DA PARTY TAKES NO ONE COIN OFF DAT CLIFF. ON DA WAY DOWN THROUGH DA VILLAGE A WOMAN NONE OF DEM HAB SPOKEN TA PUTS BREAD AN' CHEESE INTO {leader}'S HANDS AN' CLOSES DA DOOR BEFORE ANYONE CAN SAY ANYTINK!

b3_m.text:
BOTH JARS FILLED, AN' CARRIED UP TA DA SECOND LANDIN' WHERE DEY IZ SUPPOSED TA SIT, WIT DA BOY TALKIN' DA WHOLE WAY 'BOUT A BICYCLE HE IZ STASHIN' FOR.
AT DA SECOND LANDIN' DERE IZ {FOUR|FIVE} JARS ALREADY, ALL OF DEM FULL, ALL OF DEM FRESH, AN' DA BOY SAYS DA OTHERS IZ NO HIS, AN' DAT HE DOES NO KNOW WHOSE DEY IZ, AN' DAT DEY IZ ALWAYS DERE!

choices.text: SET DA JARS DOWN AN' GO BACK DOWN WIT HIM!
WAIT AT DA LANDIN' TA SEE WHO BRINGS DA OTHERS!
CARRY A JAR TA DA TOP. ALL TWO HUNDRED STEPS!

b3_wait.text:
HALF A SHIFT ON A LANDIN' HALFWAY UP A CLIFF IN DA HEAT, WIT DA BOY GONE HOME AN' DA JARS SITTIN' DERE GETTIN' WARM.
NOBODY COMES. AT {DUSK|DA HOUR DA LIGHT GOES|'BOUT SEVEN} DERE IZ {SIX|SEVEN} JARS ON DA LANDIN', AN' DA PARTY HAB BIN LOOKIN' AT DA LANDIN' DA ENTIRE TIME, AN' NOBODY HAB COME!

b3_top.text:
TWO HUNDRED STEPS WIT A FULL JAR AN' NO FREE HAND IZ A DIFFERENT CLIMB FROM TWO HUNDRED STEPS WIT TWO FREE HANDS, AN' DA LAST {FORTY|THIRTY} IZ DONE REAL SLOWLY.
DA JAR GOES ON DA LEDGE. DERE IZ NOWHERE ON DA LEDGE FOR IT TA GO AN' IT GOES SOMEWHERE ANYWAY, AN' DA HOLLOW IN DA ROCK AT HEAD HEIGHT IZ {WARM|WARMER|HOT} AN' DA VALLEY BELOW IZ BRIEFLY AN' ENTIRELY SILENT!

e_desert.title: {DA BURIED CONVOY|ELEVEN LORRIES AN' NO CARGO|DA SAND HAB MOVED AGAIN}

n0.text:
DA SAND HAB MOVED AN' GIVEN SOMETINK BACK: CAB ROOFS, IN A LINE, ELEVEN OF DEM, A CONVOY NOSE TA TAIL UNDER DA DUNE WIT DA DRIVERS' DOORS ALL STANDIN' OPEN.
DA PAINT IZ COLLECTIVE. DA PLATES IZ FOUR DIFFERENT COUNTRIES. DA TYRES IZ PERFECT.
DA HEAT IZ STILL COMIN' UP OUT OF DA GROUND AN' DA METAL IZ COLD.
ELEVEN CABS, AN' DA DOORS IZ OPEN ON DA {LEFT|DRIVER'S} SIDE OF EACH OF DEM, AN' DA SAND INSIDE DA CABS IZ LEVEL WIT DA SAND OUTSIDE!
n0.emText:
ELEVEN LORRY CABS IN A LINE UNDER A MOVED DUNE, DOORS OPEN, TYRES PERFECT, METAL COLD IN A DESERT.
DA WHOLE CONVOY IZ HOLDIN' ITS BREATH AN' HAB BIN FOR YEARS. YOU KNOW DAT STATE. IT IZ DA STATE YOU WOKE UP IN: EVERYTINK PRESERVED, NUTTIN' EXPLAINED, AN' DA DOORS OPEN AS THOUGH WHOEVER LEFT DID IT IN A HURRY DAT HAB SINCE BECOME PERMANENT!
n0.bubba: BUBBA CLIMBS INTO DA FIRST CAB LIKE A MAN BUYIN' A TRUCK. "DIESEL'S STILL IN HER. KEYS IN IT. AOH. CHESTA E' 'NA TRAPPOLA, SUGAR, BUT SHE'D START."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: DIG OUT A TRAILER AN' SEE WHAT DA CARGO WAZ!
START ONE OF DEM.
STRIP DA CONVOY FOR PARTS AN' FUEL!
FOLLOW DA FOOTPRINTS OUT.

a.text:
HALF A SHIFT OF DIGGIN' IN DA SHADE OF A DUNE AN' DA TRAILER DOORS COME CLEAR.
INSIDE: CRATES, STENCILLED WIT A FRANCHISE MARK SOMEBODY HAB SCRATCHED OFF, AN' EVERY CRATE IZ EMPTY, AN' EVERY CRATE WAZ OPENED FROM DA INSIDE!

asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: OPEN DA REST.
TAKE DA CRATE MARKS TA SOMEBODY WHO KNOWS DA FRANCHISE!

b.text:
IT TURNS OVER ON DA FOURTH TRY AN' CATCHES, AN' DA NOISE OF A DIESEL ENGINE IN DAT SILENCE IZ OBSCENE.
EVERY OTHER CAB IN DA LINE STARTS. ALL TEN OF DEM, ONE AFTER ANOTHER, DOWN DA ROW, IN ORDER, AN' DEN DEY IDLE, AN' DA TEN EMPTY CABS SIT DERE RUNNIN'!
b.bubba: "NOPE," SAYS BUBBA, ALREADY REVERSIN' OUT OF DA DOOR. "NOPE NOPE NOPE. JAMME. JAMME JA'."

asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.timid: {member} IZ BACK AT DA DUNE CREST BEFORE DA FOURTH ONE HAB CAUGHT!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: DRIVE YA OUT.
TURN DEM ALL OFF, ONE BY ONE, IN ORDER!

c.text:
FUEL, FILTERS, BATTERIES, ELEVEN SETS OF TOOLS, FOUR SPARE WHEELS AN' ENOUGH COPPER TA MATTER.
IT TAKES ALL AFTERNOON AN' YOU IZ CAREFUL AN' YOU LEAVE DA CABS OTHERWISE AS YOU FOUND DEM, AN' A MAN IN {region} BUYS DA LOT WITOUT ASKIN' A SINGLE QUESTION, WHICH HE CHARGES YOU FOR BY PAYIN' LESS!

d.text:
ELEVEN SETS OF PRINTS LEAVE DA CONVOY AN' GO OUT INTO DA SAND TOGETHER, AN' STAY TOGETHER, AN' DO NO SCATTER, AN' AT 'BOUT A KILOMETRE DEY STOP DEAD.
ALL ELEVEN, MID-STRIDE, IN A LINE ABREAST, FACIN' DA SAME WAY, WHICH IZ DA WAY YOU CAME!

choices.text: STAND WHERE DEY STOPPED AN' FACE DA WAY DEY FACED!
DIG WHERE DEY STOPPED.
