asides.fatalistic: {member} {SIGHS: "WELL, WE WAZ GOING TA DIE EVENTUALLY."|SHRUGS: "IF DA REACTOR BLOWS, AT LEAST IT IZ QUICK."|MUTTERS DAT DA UNIVERSE ALWAYS FINDS A WAY TA RUIN YA DAY|EXPECTS DA WORST AN' NO IZ DISAPPOINTED}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

a1.text: EVERY TRAILER, DA SAME: OPENED FROM INSIDE, AN' IN DA NINTH ONE, STILL IN DERE, DA TINK DAT DID DA OPENIN', WHICH HAB BIN OUT HERE A LONG TIME ON NUTTIN' AT ALL AN' WHICH IZ EXTREMELY INTERESTED IN DA ARRIVAL OF SOMETINK WIT BLOOD IN IT!

a2.text:
DA FRANCHISE MARK BELONGS TA A COLLECTIVE OPERATION DAT STOPPED FILIN' RETURNS IN {timeAgo}.
A LOSS ADJUSTER IN {region} HAB BIN CARRYIN' DIS CONVOY ON HIS BOOKS FOR YEARS AN' PAYS YOU HANDSOMELY FOR DA COORDINATES, DA PHOTOGRAPHS AN' DA EXACT WORDIN' OF DA STENCIL!

b1.text:
YOU DRIVE OUT WIT TEN ENGINES IDLIN' BEHIND YOU AN' DEY IZ STILL IDLIN' WHEN DA DUNE CLOSES DA MIRROR.
IT IZ A GOOD LORRY. IT IZ WORTH REAL MONEY. FOR A YEAR AFTERWARDS IT WILL NO START FOR ANYBODY BUT WHOEVER TURNED DAT KEY!

b2.text:
DOWN DA LINE, ONE AT A TIME, IN ORDER, AN' EACH ONE DIES AS YOU REACH IT AN' DA NEXT ONE IZ ALREADY QUIETER, AS THOUGH IT WAZ BEING ASKED POLITELY RATHER DEN SWITCHED OFF.
DA LAST CAB DOES NO HAB A KEY IN IT. IT HAB A HAND ON DA WHEEL. IT THANKS YOU!

d1.text:
YOU STAND IN DA LINE ABREAST WIT DA ELEVEN AN' FACE DA CONVOY, AN' FOR 'BOUT A LONG MINUTE DA DESERT BECOMES A ROAD AT NIGHT WIT HEADLIGHTS COMIN', AN' EVERY ONE OF YOU SEES IT.
WHAT HAPPENED TA ELEVEN DRIVERS HAPPENED OVER 'BOUT FOUR SECONDS. YOU GET DA FOUR SECONDS. YOU ALSO GET WHAT DEY DROPPED WHEN IT HAPPENED!

d2.text:
A METRE DOWN: SAND, DEN A FLOOR. TILED. WARM.
A METRE FURTHER ALONG, A HATCH, AN' DA HATCH HAB BIN OPENED FROM UNDERNEATH ELEVEN TIMES BY ELEVEN PAIRS OF HANDS, AN' NEVER OPENED FROM DA TOP BY ANYBODY!

b1_m.text:
YA GOES INTO GEAR AN' PULLS OUT OF DA LINE AN' DA OTHER TEN SIT DERE IDLIN', AN' DA MIRROR FILLS WIT {ELEVEN|TEN} SETS OF LIGHTS DAT NOBODY SWITCHED ON.
AT 'BOUT {FOUR HUNDRED METRES|A QUARTER OF A MILE|DA FIRST RISE} DA TEN OF DEM MOVE OFF TOGETHER, IN CONVOY, NOSE TA TAIL, {BEHIND YOU|IN DA MIRROR|AT DA SAME SPEED}, KEEPIN' STATION!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DEY IZ IN CONVOY WIT US.|WE IZ DA LEAD LORRY NOW.|WHATEVER DIS RUN WAZ, WE HAB JOINED IT.}"
asides.any: {member} {WATCHES DA MIRROR AN' STOPS NARRATIN'|CHECKS DA FUEL|WINDS DA WINDOW DOWN TA LISTEN}

choices.text: KEEP DRIVIN'. KEEP DA LEAD!
PULL OVER AN' LET DEM PASS!
READ DA RUN. WHERE WAZ DIS CONVOY GOING?

b1_pass.text:
PULLIN' OVER IN OPEN DESERT AN' WATCHIN' TEN LORRIES GO PAST AT {FORTY|THIRTY|A STEADY} IZ A TINK DAT TAKES {NINE MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|A LONG TIME} AN' IZ NO SURVIVABLE AS A MEMORY.
DA LAST ONE STOPS LEVEL WIT DA CAB. DA DOOR ON DA DRIVER'S SIDE OPENS. NUTTIN' GETS OUT, AN' NUTTIN' GETS IN, AN' AFTER A WHILE IT CLOSES AN' DA CONVOY GOES ON OVER DA RISE AN' DA LIGHTS GO OUT ONE BY ONE!

b1_run.text:
DA TACHO IN DA LEAD CAB IZ STILL LEGIBLE AN' DA ROUTE CARD IZ IN DA DOOR POCKET AN' DA RUN IZ {FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES|A LONG HAUL|TWO DAYS} TA A DEPOT DAT IZ ON DA MAP AN' IZ STILL DERE.
DRIVIN' IT, DA WHOLE RUN, WIT TEN LORRIES BEHIND, TAKES {TWO DAYS|A DAY AN' A HALF|DA BETTER PART OF TWO DAYS}, AN' DA DEPOT GATE IZ OPENED AT DAWN BY A MAN WHO COUNTS ELEVEN AN' DEN SITS DOWN ON DA STEP!

d1_m.text:
STANDIN' IN DA LINE ABREAST WIT DA ELEVEN AN' FACIN' DA CONVOY, DA DESERT BECOMES, FOR 'BOUT MOST OF A MINUTE, A ROAD AT NIGHT WIT LIGHTS ON IT.
WHEN IT STOPS BEING DAT, DERE IZ {ELEVEN|TEN|A LINE OF} DEPRESSIONS IN DA SAND AROUND DA PARTY'S BOOTS, AN' DEY IZ DA SHAPE OF PEOPLE KNEELIN', AN' DEY IZ FRESH!

choices.text: WALK BACK TA DA CONVOY WITOUT LOOKIN' DOWN AGAIN!
KNEEL.
READ DA GROUND PROPERLY BEFORE MOVIN'!

d1_kneel.text:
A HANDFUL OF PEOPLE KNEEL IN A DESERT FACIN' A BURIED CONVOY COZ DA SAND SUGGESTED IT, WHICH IZ EITHER DA STUPIDEST OR DA MOST CORRECT TINK ANYBODY DOES DIS YEAR.
DA NINETY SECONDS COME BACK AN' DIS TIME DEY LAST {ELEVEN MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|A GREAT DEAL LONGER}, AN' DERE IZ A ROAD, AN' DERE IZ ELEVEN DRIVERS ON IT, AN' ONE OF DEM TURNS ROUND!

d1_read.text:
DA DEPRESSIONS IZ {OLD|REAL OLD|FROM DA DAY} AN' DEY HAB BIN UNDER DA SAND AN' DA SAND HAB JUST COME OFF DEM, WHICH IZ NO HOW SAND WORKS AN' IZ EXACTLY HOW DIS DUNE HAB BIN BEHAVIN' ALL WEEK.
UNDERNEATH DA KNEELIN' MARKS, A HAND'S DEPTH DOWN, DA SAND STOPS AN' DA {FLOOR|TILE|SOMETINK FLAT} STARTS, AN' IT IZ DA SAME FLOOR DAT IZ A METRE DOWN WHERE DA PRINTS STOP!

e_badlands.title: {DA BONE BED|EVERYTINK HERE DIED FACIN' DA SAME WAY|DA WASH BELOW DA RIM}

n0.text:
A FLASH FLOOD HAB CUT A NEW CHANNEL AN' OPENED A BONE BED IN DA SIDE OF IT: HUNDREDS OF ANIMALS, LAYERED, AN' EVERY SKULL TURNED DA SAME WAY.
HALF OF DEM IZ SPECIES DAT SHOULD NO BE IN DA SAME CENTURY AS EACH OTHER. ALL OF DEM IZ FACIN' DA RIM OF DA CANYON, WHERE DERE IZ A GAP IN DA ROCK LIKE A DOORWAY WIT NUTTIN' BEHIND IT.
{smell}, AN' UNDER YA BOOTS DA GROUND IZ WARM.
DEY IZ ALL TURNED {UP DA WASH|AT DA RIM|TOWARDS DA GAP}!
n0.emText:
A NEW CHANNEL CUT BY A FLOOD, AN' IN ITS WALL A BONE BED: HUNDREDS OF ANIMALS FROM CENTURIES DAT SHOULD NO TOUCH, ALL OF DEM FACIN' DA SAME GAP IN DA RIM.
DEY WAZ ALL LOOKIN' AT DA SAME TINK WHEN IT HAPPENED TA DEM. YOU HAB NEVER BIN ABLE TA FIND OUT WHAT YOU WAZ LOOKIN' AT!
n0.bubba: BUBBA CROUCHES AT DA LAYER LINE WIT HIS HAT PUSHED BACK. "DAT IZ A WHOLE LOTTA CRITTERS AGREEIN' ON SOMETHIN'. UH-HUH. E NUN ERA 'NA BELLA COSA."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.artistic: {member} SAYS IT IZ A CONGREGATION. IT IZ EXACTLY DA RIGHT WORD AN' NOBODY THANKS DEM FOR IT!
asides.fatalistic: {member} {SIGHS: "WELL, WE WAZ GOING TA DIE EVENTUALLY."|SHRUGS: "IF DA REACTOR BLOWS, AT LEAST IT IZ QUICK."|MUTTERS DAT DA UNIVERSE ALWAYS FINDS A WAY TA RUIN YA DAY|EXPECTS DA WORST AN' NO IZ DISAPPOINTED}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO UP TA DA GAP IN DA RIM!
DIG DA BED OUT PROPERLY AN' SEE WHAT IZ IN DA LAYERS!
TAKE A SKULL AN' GO. MUSEUMS PAY!
CAMP HERE AN' SEE WHAT HAPPENS AFTER DARK!

a.text:
IT TAKES AN HOUR TA GET UP, AN' FROM DA TOP DA GAP IZ A DOORWAY, WORKED, WIT A LINTEL, AN' DA ROCK EITHER SIDE HAB BIN SHAPED AN' DEN WEATHERED FOR AS LONG AS DA BONES HAB BIN DOWN DERE.
THROUGH IT, DA BADLANDS. DA SAME BADLANDS. SLIGHTLY DA WRONG COLOUR!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: STEP THROUGH.
BLOCK IT. BRING DA LINTEL DOWN!

b.text:
A COUPLE OF DAYS OF WORK IN HALF A SHIFT, COZ DA FLOOD HAB DONE MOST OF IT.
LAYER FOUR HAB A HORSE IN IT WEARIN' TACK. LAYER SEVEN HAB A MAN, CURLED, WIT HIS ARMS OVER HIS HEAD, HOLDIN' A TIN BOX. LAYER NINE IZ NO ANIMALS AT ALL!

choices.text: OPEN DA TIN BOX.
DIG DOWN TA LAYER NINE.

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text:
YOU TAKE ONE CLEAN SKULL OUT OF LAYER TWO, WRAP IT PROPERLY AN' CARRY IT OUT.
DA MUSEUM IN {region} IZ DELIGHTED, PAYS WELL, AN' ASKS FOR DA LOCATION, WHICH YOU GIVE. MOST OF A SEASON LATER DERE IZ NO BONE BED: DERE IZ A FENCE, A FOUNDATION SEAL, AN' A MAN ON A FOLDIN' CHAIR WHO HAB BIN TOLD YA NAME!

d.text:
AFTER DARK DA WARM GROUND GETS WARMER AN' DA BONES IN DA WALL DO NO MOVE, WHICH IZ IMPORTANT, COZ EVERYTINK ELSE DOES: YA SHADOWS, THROWN BY DA FIRE, GO DA WRONG WAY AN' LIE FLAT AGAINST DA BONE BED AN' STAY DERE WHEN YOU STAND UP.
AT SOME POINT IN DA LIL' HOURS DA WHOLE HERD, ALL OF IT, ALL DA LAYERS AT ONCE, TURNS TA FACE DA RIM AGAIN, WIT A SOUND LIKE A BOOK BEING SHUT!

a1.text:
DA SAME COUNTRY, DA SAME HOUR, AN' NO BONE BED IN DA WASH: DA WALL IZ CLEAN ROCK, UNCUT, UNFLOODED.
YOU IZ THROUGH FOR 'BOUT NINETY SECONDS BEFORE DA DOORWAY BEHIND YOU STARTS TA CLOSE, AN' YOU GET BACK WIT EVERYBODY, AN' ONE OF YOU IZ CARRYIN' SOMETINK DAT WAZ PICKED UP ON DA OTHER SIDE AN' WHICH DOES NO EXIST ON DIS ONE!

a2.text:
IT TAKES BOTH DA CROWBAR AN' EVERYTINK ANYBODY HAB DAT GOES BANG.
DA LINTEL COMES DOWN AN' DA DOORWAY IZ A HEAP OF ROCK, AN' DOWN IN DA WASH EVERY SKULL IN DA WALL TURNS, ALL TOGETHER, TA FACE WHERE IT USED TA BE, WHICH IZ DA WORST APPLAUSE ANY OF YOU WILL EVER RECEIVE!

b1.text:
A TIN BOX HELD BY A MAN WHO HAB TIME TA CURL UP: INSIDE IT, DRY, {paper}, AN' A RING, AN' A PHOTOGRAPH OF A DOORWAY IN A CANYON RIM WIT MORE PEOPLE DEN YOU EXPECTED STANDIN' UNDER IT.
ONE OF DEM IZ HOLDIN' DA TIN BOX. DA PHOTOGRAPH IZ OLDER DEN PHOTOGRAPHY!

b2.text: LAYER NINE IZ WORKED STONE, LAID, WIT A FLOOR AN' A DRAIN AN' A DOORWAY OF ITS OWN, AN' DA ANIMALS ABOVE IT IZ A ROOF!

c_m.text:
ONE CLEAN SKULL OUT OF LAYER TWO, WRAPPED PROPERLY AN' CARRIED OUT, WHICH TAKES {AN HOUR|NO TIME|'BOUT AN HOUR} AN' IZ DA EASIEST MONEY IN DA BADLANDS.
DA MUSEUM IN {region} IZ DELIGHTED AN' PAYS WELL, AN' DEN DA CURATOR TURNS IT OVER UNDER DA LAMP AN' GOES QUIET, COZ DERE IZ A MARK CUT INTO DA BONE {BEHIND DA JAW|UNDER DA CREST|AT DA BASE} AN' IT IZ A MASON'S MARK!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY SIGNED A HORSE.|DAT IZ A MAKER'S MARK ON A DEAD ANIMAL.|WHOEVER LAID DAT BED LAID IT.}"
asides.any: {member} {ASKS TA SEE IT UNDER DA LAMP|PHOTOGRAPHS DA MARK|SAYS NUTTIN' AN' LOOKS AT DA CURATOR}

choices.text: TAKE DA MONEY AN' LET DEM KEEP IT!
MATCH DA MARK AGAINST DA REGION'S MASONS!
BUY IT BACK AN' TAKE IT TA DA BONE BED!

c_mark.text:
IT IZ ON {FOUR|FIVE} CHURCHES IN DIS COUNTRY AN' ON A BRIDGE, AN' ALL OF DEM IZ DA WORK OF ONE FAMILY, AN' DA FAMILY IZ STILL IN DA TRADE AN' STILL USES DA MARK.
DA CURRENT HOLDER OF IT LOOKS AT DA PHOTOGRAPH FOR {NINE SECONDS|A LONG MOMENT|A WHILE}, ASKS WHERE IT WAZ FOUND, AN' DEN ASKS DA PARTY TA SIT DOWN, WHICH IZ DA BEGINNIN' OF SOMETINK DAT RUNS FOR YEARS!

c_back.text:
BUYIN' IT BACK COSTS MORE DEN IT SOLD FOR, COZ MUSEUMS IZ MUSEUMS, AN' CARRYIN' IT {TWO DAYS|A LONG WAY|BACK OUT} TA DA WASH COSTS DA REST OF DA WEEK.
IT GOES BACK IN LAYER TWO, IN ITS OWN SOCKET, TURNED DA WAY DA OTHERS IZ TURNED. DA BED IZ {A COUPLE OF PACES|A GOOD DEAL} MORE EXPOSED DEN IT WAZ AN' NUTTIN' FURTHER HAB COME OUT OF IT IN ANY YEAR SINCE!

b2_m.text:
LAYER NINE IZ WORKED STONE, LAID, WIT A FLOOR AN' A DRAIN AN' A DOORWAY OF ITS OWN, AN' DA ANIMALS ABOVE IT IZ {FILL|PACKIN'|WHAT WAZ PUT ON TOP}.
DA DRAIN IZ CLEAR. IT HAB BIN KEPT CLEAR, WHICH IZ NO SOMETINK A BURIED FLOOR DOES FOR ITSELF, AN' DERE IZ {NO SILT|NUTTIN'|NO A HANDFUL OF DIRT} IN A CHANNEL DAT HAB BIN UNDER A FLOOD PLAIN FOR {ELEVEN THOUSAND|A GREAT MANY} YEARS!

choices.text: TAKE WHAT IZ ON DA FLOOR AN' GET OUT OF DA HOLE!
FOLLOW DA DRAIN.
WORK OUT WHAT DA FILL WAZ MEANT TA DO!

b2_drain.text:
DA DRAIN IZ {A METRE|NO QUITE A METRE|LOW} AN' RUNS {DA FAR END OF IT|A LONG WAY|FURTHER DEN ANYBODY IZ COMFORTABLE WIT} ON HANDS AN' KNEES IN WATER DAT IZ MOVIN' DA WRONG WAY, WHICH IZ TA SAY UPHILL.
IT COMES OUT IN A CHAMBER WIT A FLOOR DAT IZ DRY AN' SWEPT, AN' DA PARTY IZ STANDIN' IN DA MIDDLE OF IT BEFORE ANYBODY WORKS OUT DAT DA WATER IZ BEING PUMPED!

b2_fill.text: DA FILL IZ GRADED: BIG ANIMALS AT DA BOTTOM, LIL' AT DA TOP, IN LAYERS OF {FOUR|FIVE}, AN' IT IZ INSULATION. SOMEBODY PUT A METRE AN' A HALF OF DEAD ANIMALS OVER A FLOOR TA KEEP DA TEMPERATURE IN DA ROOM BELOW IT STEADY, AN' DEY WAZ CAREFUL 'BOUT IT, AN' IT HAB WORKED FOR ELEVEN THOUSAND YEARS!

e_tundra.title: {DA SURVEY STAKE|SOMEBODY MARKED DIS OUT FOR SOMETINK|GRID REFERENCE IN DA MOSS}

n0.text:
SURVEY STAKES IN DA MOSS, ORANGE TOPS, IN A GRID: A HUNDRED METRES BY FOUR HUNDRED, MARKED OUT FOR A BUILDIN' NOBODY IZ EVER GOING TA BUILD OUT HERE.
DEY IZ NEW. DA MOSS HAB NO CLOSED ROUND DEM. DERE IZ A PORTABLE TOILET AT DA CORNER OF DA GRID AN' A WHEELBARROW WIT A WHEEL MISSIN', AN' NO OTHER SIGN OF ANY HUMAN BEING FOR MOST OF A DAY ON DA ROAD.
{sound}, A LONG WAY OFF, AN' IT DOES NO STOP WHEN YOU STOP.
DA PROJECT NUMBER ON DA STAKES IZ DA SAME NUMBER ON {FOUR|FIVE} OTHER GRIDS IN DIS COUNTRY, AN' NONE OF DEM HAB EVER BIN BUILT ON EITHER!
n0.emText:
A SURVEY GRID STAKED OUT IN DA MOSS, A HUNDRED BY FOUR HUNDRED, BRAND NEW, MOST OF A DAY ON DA ROAD FROM ANYBODY. A PORTABLE TOILET AT DA CORNER. A BROKEN WHEELBARROW.
SOMEONE'S GOING TA BUILD SOMETINK HERE AN' DEY HAB NO TOLD DA GROUND. DA MOSS KNOWS. YOU CAN FEEL DA SHAPE OF DA ARGUMENT, DA WAY YOU CAN FEEL A ROOM WHERE A HANDFUL OF PEOPLE HAB JUST STOPPED SHOUTIN'!
n0.bubba: BUBBA TIPS DA PORTALOO DOOR OPEN WIT A BOOT, LOOKS IN, AN' SHUTS IT FAST. "NAH. OCCUPIED. UH-UH. NON CE TRASITE."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: OPEN DA PORTABLE TOILET.
WALK DA GRID AN' FIND DA CENTRE!
PULL EVERY STAKE AN' STACK DEM!
FOLLOW DA SOUND.

a.text:
IT IZ CLEAN, AN' IT IZ STOCKED, AN' DERE IZ A CHAIR IN IT INSTEAD OF DA USUAL, AN' ON DA CHAIR DERE IZ A COAT, AN' IN DA COAT DERE IZ A WALLET, FOUR KEYS AN' A PHOTOGRAPH OF DA GRID YOU IZ STANDIN' IN WIT SOMEBODY'S ARM ROUND SOMEBODY IN DA MIDDLE OF IT.
DA PHOTOGRAPH IZ DATED FOUR MONTHS FROM NOW!

choices.text: TAKE DA WALLET AN' DA PHOTOGRAPH!
SIT IN DA CHAIR.

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
DA CENTRE OF DA GRID IZ A PATCH WHERE DA MOSS IZ DEAD IN A CIRCLE A COUPLE OF PACES ACROSS, AN' IN DA MIDDLE OF IT, DRIVEN FLUSH WIT DA GROUND, ONE STAKE WIT NO ORANGE TOP.
AROUND IT, AT DA EIGHT COMPASS POINTS, EIGHT LIL' PILES OF STONES, MADE BY HAND, RECENTLY, BY SOMEBODY WHO KNOWS DIS IZ NO HOW YOU MARK A SURVEY!

choices.text: PULL DA FLUSH STAKE.
ADD A NINTH PILE AN' WAIT!

asides.fatalistic: {member} {SIGHS: "WELL, WE WAZ GOING TA DIE EVENTUALLY."|SHRUGS: "IF DA REACTOR BLOWS, AT LEAST IT IZ QUICK."|MUTTERS DAT DA UNIVERSE ALWAYS FINDS A WAY TA RUIN YA DAY|EXPECTS DA WORST AN' NO IZ DISAPPOINTED}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text:
A HUNDRED AN' SIXTY STAKES, STACKED, IN AN HOUR AN' A HALF.
DA MOSS CLOSES OVER DA HOLES WITHIN MINUTES: YOU CAN WATCH IT DOING IT. AN' WHEN DA LAST STAKE IZ OUT, DA SOUND YOU HAB BIN HEARIN' ALL AFTERNOON STOPS, AN' SOMETINK EIGHT KILOMETRES OFF STARTS WALKIN' TOWARDS YOU ACROSS GROUND DAT TAKES TWO DAYS TA CROSS!

d.text:
A LONG STRETCH' WALK. IT IZ A GENERATOR, RUNNIN', CHAINED TA A SLEDGE, WIT NO FUEL LINE AN' NO FUEL, AN' IT IZ WARM, AN' IT HAB BIN RUNNIN' LIKE DIS SINCE SOMEBODY LEFT IT.
IT IZ POWERIN' A SINGLE CABLE DAT GOES INTO DA GROUND AN' DOES NO COME OUT!

choices.text: DIG DA CABLE UP.
STOP DA GENERATOR.

a1.text:
YOU IZ ELEVEN KILOMETRES AWAY WHEN SOMEBODY USES DA NAME ON DA WALLET TA CALL ACROSS DA TUNDRA, ONCE, CLEARLY, IN A VOICE DAT CARRIES DA WAY VOICES DO NO.
DA WALLET HAB THREE HUNDRED IN IT AN' A CARD DAT IZ WORTH MORE DEN THREE HUNDRED TA DA RIGHT OFFICE. DA PHOTOGRAPH YOU KEEP. IN FOUR MONTHS YOU WILL LOOK AT IT AGAIN!

a2.text:
YOU SIT DOWN IN A PORTABLE TOILET IN DA MIDDLE OF DA TUNDRA WIT DA DOOR OPEN, COZ YOU IZ DA KIND OF PERSON WHO FOLLOWS A TINK THROUGH.
WHAT YOU GET, OVER 'BOUT A SHORT WHILE, IZ DA WHOLE PROJECT: WHAT IZ GOING TA BE BUILT HERE, WHO IZ PAYIN', WHAT IZ UNDER DA GRID DAT DEY WANT TA BE ON TOP OF, AN' WHY DEY BROUGHT A CHAIR!

b1.text:
IT COMES UP A COUPLE OF PACES LONG, SHARPENED, IRON, AN' OLD: OLDER DEN DA SURVEY, OLDER DEN DA PROJECT NUMBER, OLDER DEN DA ORANGE PAINT BY CENTURIES.
IT WAZ HERE FIRST. DA SURVEY GRID IZ CENTRED ON IT COZ WHOEVER LAID DA GRID FOUND IT AN' BUILT DA WHOLE JOB ROUND IT, AN' DA EIGHT PILES IZ SOMEBODY'S ATTEMPT TA KEEP IT IN DA GROUND!

b2.text:
YOU BUILD A NINTH PILE AT DA CENTRE, OVER DA FLUSH STAKE, AN' SIT DOWN, AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS FOR TWO HOURS.
DEN DA MOSS CLOSES OVER YA PILE, AN' OVER ALL EIGHT, AN' DA DEAD CIRCLE GREENS IN FRONT OF YOU AT DA SPEED OF A TIDE COMIN' IN, AN' DA SURVEY STAKES AT DA EDGE OF DA GRID FALL OVER, ALL OF DEM, IN ONE LONG CLATTER GOING ROUND!

d1.text:
IT GOES DOWN ARM'S LENGTH AN' A BIT AN' ENDS IN A PLATE, AN' DA PLATE IZ BOLTED TA SOMETINK DAT IZ NO A ROCK.
WHAT YOU GET OUT OF IT BEFORE DA GENERATOR STOPS ON ITS OWN IZ A COIL OF CABLE, A PLATE OF AN ALLOY DAT DOES NO BELONG TA DIS DECADE, AN' A REAL STRONG SENSE OF HAVIN' INTERRUPTED SOMETINK HALFWAY!

d2.text:
YOU KILL IT, AN' DA SILENCE IZ ENORMOUS, AN' EVERY STAKE IN DA GRID NINETY MINUTES BEHIND YOU GOES OVER AT ONCE. YOU HEAR IT. ACROSS NINETY MINUTES OF TUNDRA, YOU HEAR IT.
WHEN YOU GET BACK DA MOSS HAB CLOSED AN' DA PORTABLE TOILET IZ GONE AN' DA WHEELBARROW HAB BOTH ITS WHEELS!

a1_m.text:
DA WALLET GOES IN DA PACK, AN' DA PHOTOGRAPH WIT IT, AN' DA PARTY IZ {FOUR KILOMETRES|A COUPLE OF MILES|WELL} OUT BEFORE ANYBODY LOOKS AT DA PHOTOGRAPH PROPERLY.
IT IZ OF DIS GRID. DA STAKES IZ IN IT, AN' DA MOSS IZ IN IT, AN' SO IZ DA PORTABLE TOILET, AN' SO IZ {FOUR|FIVE} PEOPLE STANDIN' WHERE DA PARTY WAZ STANDIN', AN' IT IZ {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE OLD|OLD|MUCH OLDER DEN DA STAKES}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SAME GRID. SAME STAKES. A LIFETIME OF WORK.|SOMEBODY HAB DONE DIS BEFORE US.|PUT IT BACK. PUT IT ALL BACK.}"
asides.any: {member} {TURNS DA PHOTOGRAPH OVER LOOKIN' FOR A DATE|COUNTS DA PEOPLE IN IT|LOOKS BACK DA WAY DEY CAME}

choices.text: KEEP IT ALL. KEEP WALKIN'!
READ DA BACK OF DA PHOTOGRAPH!
TAKE IT BACK TA DA COAT.

a1_back.text:
DERE IZ WRITIN' ON DA BACK IN PENCIL AN' IT IZ {FOUR NAMES|FIVE NAMES|A LIST OF NAMES}, AN' DA LAST ONE ON DA LIST IZ DA NAME IN DA WALLET, AN' IT HAB BIN WRITTEN IN A DIFFERENT HAND AN' MORE RECENTLY DEN DA OTHERS.
WHICH MEANS DA LIST IZ KEPT, AN' IT IZ KEPT BY WHOEVER COMES AFTER, AN' DA PARTY IZ HOLDIN' A PENCIL AN' STANDIN' IN A SURVEY GRID IN DA MIDDLE OF DA TUNDRA WIT DA MOSS CLOSIN' OVER DEY OWN BOOT PRINTS!

a1_return.text:
AN HOUR ON DA ROAD BACK, AN' DA COAT IZ ON DA CHAIR, AN' DA WALLET GOES INTO DA COAT AN' DA PHOTOGRAPH GOES BACK INTO DA WALLET, AN' DA DOOR IZ SHUT PROPERLY.
NOBODY CALLS ACROSS DA TUNDRA DAT NIGHT. NOBODY CALLS DA NEXT NIGHT EITHER. DA PARTY SLEEPS BADLY FOR {A FORTNIGHT|SOME WEEKS|A WHILE} OUT OF SHEER ANTICIPATION AN' NUTTIN' EVER COMES OF IT, WHICH IZ DA BEST AVAILABLE OUTCOME AN' IZ REAL HARD TA ENJOY!

d2_m.text:
KILLIN' DA GENERATOR TAKES {A BREATH OR TWO|ONE MOVEMENT|A HAND ON DA SWITCH} AN' DA SILENCE AFTERWARDS IZ ENORMOUS.
DEN, A LONG STRETCH BEHIND, EVERY STAKE IN DA GRID GOES OVER AT ONCE, AN' IT IZ AUDIBLE ACROSS DAT DISTANCE, WHICH IZ NO A TINK DAT NOISE DOES OUT HERE!

choices.text: KEEP WALKIN'. IT IZ DONE.
START DA GENERATOR AGAIN.
GO BACK TA DA GRID AT A RUN!

d2_start.text:
IT STARTS ON DA FIRST PULL, WIT NO FUEL LINE AN' NO FUEL, AS THOUGH IT HAB BIN WAITIN' TA BE ASKED.
DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR AWAY DA STAKES STAND BACK UP. DA PARTY HEARS DAT TOO. NOBODY IN DA PARTY EVER TELLS DIS PART OF DA STORY AT A FIRE, AN' DA GENERATOR IZ STILL RUNNIN' OUT DERE AS FAR AS ANYBODY KNOWS!

d2_run.text:
NINETY MINUTES AT A RUN OVER MOSS IZ {TWO HOURS|LONGER DEN NINETY MINUTES|A BAD TWO HOURS}, AN' DA GRID, WHEN IT COMES UP, IZ FLAT: A HUNDRED AN' SIXTY STAKES LYING DOWN, ALL POINTIN' DA SAME WAY, AT DA CENTRE.
DA DEAD CIRCLE AT DA CENTRE IZ {TWICE DA SIZE|A COUPLE OF PACES WIDER|BIGGER}, AN' DA FLUSH STAKE IZ STANDIN' PROUD OF DA GROUND BY A HAND'S WIDTH, AN' IT IZ COMIN' UP ON ITS OWN!

e_permafrost.title: {DA THAW|WHAT DA GROUND IZ GIVIN' BACK|A GOOD STRETCH OF HELD BREATH}

n0.text:
DA GROUND IZ GOING SOFT FOR DA FIRST TIME IN ELEVEN THOUSAND YEARS AN' IT IZ GIVIN' TINKZ BACK.
A POST, UPRIGHT, WORKED WIT A BLADE. A BOAT, OR DA RIBS OF ONE, A HUNDRED KILOMETRES FROM WATER. AN' A HAND: A HUMAN HAND, BROWN, PERFECT, AT DA END OF AN ARM DAT IZ STILL IN DA ICE, AN' DA FINGERS IZ CLOSED ON SOMETINK.
DA SMELL IZ MORE LIKE {smell}.
DA THAW IZ A STRIP, NO A PATCH, AN' A STRIP MEANS SOMETINK IZ {RUNNIN' UNDER IT|WARM UNDERNEATH|BEING FOLLOWED}!
n0.emText:
ELEVEN THOUSAND YEARS OF HELD GROUND GOING SOFT, AN' EVERYTINK IT HAB BIN HOLDIN' COMIN' UP AT ONCE: A CARVED POST, DA RIBS OF A BOAT, AN' A HAND OUT OF DA ICE WIT ITS FINGERS SHUT ON SOMETINK.
DA GROUND HERE HAB BETTER MEMORY DEN YOU DO AN' IT IZ LOSIN' IT IN A SINGLE SEASON, AN' YOU CAN FEEL EXACTLY HOW DAT FEELS FROM DA INSIDE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA TAKES HIS HAT OFF TA DA HAND, SERIOUSLY, NO JOKE IN IT. "SIGNO'. REQUIEM. AWRIGHT. NOW LETZ SEE WHAT HE'S HOLDIN'."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.melancholic: "HE WAZ CARRYIN' IT," {member} SAYS. "WHATEVER IT IZ, HE WAZ CARRYIN' IT WHEN IT GOT HIM."
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: OPEN DA HAND.
DIG DA ARM OUT. GET ALL OF HIM!
FOLLOW DA STRIP OF THAW.
TAKE DA POST. IT IZ DA ONLY TINK YOU CAN CARRY!

a.text:
DA FINGERS GIVE LIKE COLD WAX, ONE AT A TIME, AN' WHAT IZ IN DA PALM IZ A BEAD OF SOMETINK DARK DAT IZ WARM, AN' DAT GETS WARMER DA LONGER IT IZ OUT OF DA ICE.
BEHIND YOU, DA THAW ACCELERATES. YOU CAN HEAR IT: WATER MOVIN' UNDER A METRE OF GROUND FOR A HUNDRED METRES IN EVERY DIRECTION!

choices.text: KEEP DA BEAD.
PUT IT BACK AN' CLOSE DA HAND!

asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
HALF A SHIFT WIT PICKS AN' HOT WATER AN' HE COMES UP ENTIRE: A MAN OF 'BOUT THIRTY, DRESSED FOR WEATHER, WIT A HEALED BREAK IN HIS FOREARM AN' FOUR OBJECTS ON HIM.
DA FOURTH OBJECT IZ NO OF HIS CENTURY, OR OURS. IT WAZ IN HIS COAT, AN' HIS COAT WAZ MADE TA HOLD IT, AN' DA COAT IZ ELEVEN THOUSAND YEARS OLD!

c.text:
DA THAW RUNS IN A STRIP TWO METRES WIDE FOR A FEW KILOMETRES AN' ENDS AT A MOUND, AN' DA MOUND IZ WHITE WIT FROST IN DA MIDDLE OF A WARM AFTERNOON.
DERE IZ A DOOR IN IT. DERE HAB ALWAYS BIN A DOOR IN IT. DA THAW CAME FROM DA DOOR OUTWARDS, LIKE SOMETINK BREATHIN' ON DA GROUND!

choices.text: OPEN DA DOOR.
PUT YA EAR TA IT FIRST.

d.text:
IT TAKES TWO OF YOU TA CARRY AN' IT IZ WORTH EVERY STEP.
DA UNIVERSITY IN {region} PAYS OUT OF A FUND DAT EXISTS FOR EXACTLY DIS, AN' A WOMAN FROM DA FOUNDATION IZ AT DA LOADIN' BAY WHEN YOU DELIVER IT, AN' BUYS YOU A COFFEE, AN' ASKS A FEW QUESTIONS 'BOUT WHAT ELSE WAZ IN DA STRIP!

a1.text:
IT IZ WARM IN YA PACK ALL DA WAY HOME AN' IT NEVER COOLS.
NO DO ANYTINK ELSE. DAT IZ DA POINT: IT DOES NO DO ANYTINK ELSE, AN' ELEVEN THOUSAND YEARS AGO A MAN WALKED INTO A COLD HE COULD NO SURVIVE RATHER DEN PUT IT DOWN!

a2.text:
YOU PUT IT BACK AN' FOLD DA FINGERS OVER IT AN' PACK DA ICE ROUND DA HAND WIT YA OWN HANDS UNTIL IT IZ COVERED.
DA THAW STOPS DEAD, IN A RING AROUND HIM, AN' DA WATER DAT WAZ RUNNIN' UNDER DA GROUND GOES QUIET.
WHAT YOU TAKE AWAY IZ WHAT WAZ UNDER DA BOAT RIBS, WHICH DA GROUND OFFERS UP WHILE YOU IZ WASHIN' YA HANDS!

c1.text:
IT OPENS OUTWARDS, WHICH IZ WRONG FOR A MOUND, AN' DA COLD DAT COMES OUT OF IT SITS ON YOU WIT REAL WEIGHT.
INSIDE DERE IZ A STAIR, AN' AT DA BOTTOM OF DA STAIR DERE IZ A ROOM WIT ELEVEN THOUSAND YEARS OF QUIET IN IT AN' SOMETINK IN DA MIDDLE OF DA QUIET DAT HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR DA GROUND TA SOFTEN!

c2.text:
BREATHIN'. SLOW: 'BOUT ONE TA YA FOUR. AN' UNDER DA BREATHIN', A SOUND LIKE SOMEBODY TURNIN' OVER IN BED.
YOU BACK OFF, AN' YOU MARK DA MOUND ON DA MAP, AN' YOU TAKE DA NEWS TA DA ONE OFFICE DAT WILL DO ANYTINK WIT IT, AN' DEY THANK YOU IN A WAY DAT SUGGESTS DEY KNEW, AN' PAY YOU IN A WAY DAT SUGGESTS DEY DID NO KNOW IT HAB STARTED!

d_m.text:
IT TAKES TWO OF YOU TA CARRY AN' IT IZ WORTH EVERY STEP, AN' DA UNIVERSITY IN {region} PAYS OUT OF A FUND DAT EXISTS FOR EXACTLY DIS.
DEN DEY CLEAN IT, WHICH TAKES {THREE WEEKS|A MONTH|SOME WEEKS}, AN' UNDER DA BLADE-WORK DERE IZ MORE BLADE-WORK, OLDER, AN' UNDER DAT A THIRD LAYER, AN' DA POST HAB BIN RECUT {THREE TIMES|TWICE|BY THREE DIFFERENT HANDS} OVER WHAT MUST BE CENTURIES!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY KEPT RE-CARVIN' IT.|THREE HANDS. SAME POST.|DAT IZ MAINTENANCE, NO ART.}"
asides.any: {member} {ASKS TA SEE DA CLEANIN' PHOTOGRAPHS|WRITES DOWN DA ORDER OF DA LAYERS|READS DA REPORT TWICE}

choices.text: TAKE DA MONEY. IT IZ DEY POST NOW!
READ DA OLDEST LAYER.
GO BACK AN' LOOK FOR WHERE IT WAZ STANDIN'!

d_old.text:
DA OLDEST CUT IZ {AN INSTRUCTION|A WARNIN'|A SET OF DIRECTIONS}, AN' DA TWO LATER HANDS HAB CARVED OVER DA TOP OF IT WITOUT EFFACIN' IT, WHICH TAKES A PARTICULAR KIND OF RESPECT.
WHAT IT SAYS IZ SHORT AN' IZ 'BOUT DA MOUND AT DA END OF DA THAW, AN' IT IZ NO ADVICE 'BOUT HOW TA OPEN IT!

d_site.text:
DA HOLE DA POST STOOD IN IZ STILL DERE AN' IZ {FULL OF MELTWATER|OPEN|NO FILLED IN}, AN' UNDER DA MELTWATER DA PACKIN' STONES IZ SET IN A PATTERN DAT GOES ON PAST DA HOLE.
IT IZ A LINE OF DEM, AN' DA LINE RUNS {A FEW KILOMETRES|A LONG WAY|STRAIGHT} ALONG DA STRIP OF THAW, AN' DERE IZ POST HOLES IN IT EVERY {A LONG WAY|HUNDRED METRES|SO OFTEN}, AN' ALL OF DEM IZ EMPTY!

c2_m.text:
AN EAR ON DA DOOR OF DA MOUND: BREATHIN', SLOW, 'BOUT ONE TA YA FOUR, AN' UNDER IT A SOUND LIKE SOMEBODY TURNIN' OVER IN BED.
DERE IZ ALSO, ONCE DA EAR HAB BIN DERE {A MINUTE|LONG ENOUGH|A WHILE}, A SECOND SOUND, AN' DA SECOND SOUND IZ {A DOOR BEING TRIED|SOMEBODY AT A HANDLE|DA LATCH MOVIN'} FROM DA INSIDE, PATIENTLY, AT INTERVALS, AS THOUGH IT HAB BIN TRIED A GREAT MANY TIMES!

choices.text: BACK OFF AN' MARK IT FOR SOMEBODY ELSE!
HOLD DA DOOR SHUT AN' PUT SOMETINK THROUGH DA LATCH!
KNOCK.

c2_bar.text:
A BAR THROUGH DA LATCH, COLD-SET, HAMMERED OVER AT BOTH ENDS WIT WHAT IZ IN DA PACK, WHICH TAKES {AN HOUR|DA REST OF DA LIGHT|LONGER DEN ANYBODY WANTS TA STAND DERE}.
DA TRYIN' STOPS WHILE DA WORK IZ GOING ON AN' STARTS AGAIN AFTERWARDS, AT DA SAME INTERVAL, AGAINST A DOOR DAT WILL NOW NO OPEN. DA PARTY MARKS DA MOUND FOR DA FOUNDATION AN' WALKS {FOUR KILOMETRES|DA WHOLE STRIP|BACK} WIT DEY EARS RINGIN'!

c2_knock.text:
FOUR KNOCKS ON A DOOR IN A MOUND IN DA MIDDLE OF A THAW, COZ SOMEBODY IN DIS PARTY IZ DA KIND OF PERSON WHO KNOCKS.
DA BREATHIN' STOPS. EVERYTINK STOPS. DEN DA LATCH IZ TRIED ONCE MORE, AN' DERE IZ A SOUND ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DA DOOR DAT IZ UNMISTAKABLY {A PERSON SITTIN' DOWN|SOMEBODY SITTIN' DOWN|WEIGHT SETTLIN' ON A FLOOR}, AN' AFTER DAT IT IZ QUIET, AN' DA DOOR IZ NO TRIED AGAIN WHILE ANYBODY IZ LISTENIN'!

e_volcano.title: {DA VENT|A MAN EXPLAININ' DAT LAVA IZ SAFE NOW|FOUR HUNDRED DEGREES AN' A DECKCHAIR}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A DECKCHAIR AT DA LIP OF AN ACTIVE VENT, AN' A MAN IN IT, IN SHORTS, READIN' A NEWSPAPER, AT A DISTANCE WHERE DA NEWSPAPER SHOULD BE ALIGHT.
HE HAB A COOL BOX. HE OFFERS YOU A DRINK WITOUT LOOKIN' UP.
"IT IZ BIN SAFE SINCE DA RITUAL," HE SAYS. "NOBODY BELIEVES ME. DERE IZ A RADIO PROGRAMME 'BOUT IT."
DA DECKCHAIR HAB BIN IN DAT SPOT LONG ENOUGH TA HAB {LEFT MARKS|WORN DA ROCK|MADE ITS OWN TWO DENTS}!
n0.emText:
A DECKCHAIR AT DA LIP OF AN ACTIVE VENT, AN' A MAN IN IT IN SHORTS, READIN', AT A TEMPERATURE DAT SHOULD HAB TAKEN DA PAPER OFF HIM.
"IT IZ BIN SAFE SINCE DA RITUAL," HE SAYS. SINCE DA RITUAL. DAT IZ YA CALENDAR HE IZ USING. EVERYTINK IN DIS WORLD DATES ITSELF FROM DA NIGHT DEY TOOK NINETY-TWO PER CENT OF YOU AN' MADE A SPEAR OUT OF IT!
n0.bubba: BUBBA IZ ALREADY IN DA SECOND DECKCHAIR WIT A BOTTLE FROM DA MAN'S COOL BOX. "HE'S RIGHT, Y'KNOW. IT IZ WARM. IT IZ REAL WARM. MA NUN COCE. SIT DOWN, SUGAR."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.hedonistic: {member} TAKES DA DRINK, SITS ON DA GROUND, AN' DECLARES DIS DA BEST AFTERNOON OF DA MONTH!
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: SIT DOWN AN' HAB DA DRINK!
ASK WHAT HAPPENED DURIN' DA RITUAL!
GO DOWN INTO DA VENT.
TELL HIM TA GET AWAY FROM DA EDGE AN' MEAN IT!

a.text:
YOU SIT AT DA LIP OF A VOLCANO IN A DECKCHAIR AN' DRINK SOMETINK COLD, AN' DA HEAT COMES UP PAST YOU AN' DOES NO TOUCH YOU, AN' IT IZ DA STRANGEST TWENTY MINUTES OF DA SEASON.
HE TALKS. HE HAB BIN DOING DIS FOR FOUR YEARS. HIS WIFE THINKS HE IZ AT WORK!

choices.text: ASK WHAT HE DOES DOWN DERE!
STAY UNTIL DARK.

asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
"SOMETINK CAME UP AN' SOMETINK WENT DOWN," HE SAYS. "DA MOUNTAIN GOT QUIET AFTER. PROPERLY QUIET."
HE WAZ HERE. HE WAZ ONE OF DA MEN ON DA EMERGENCY CORDON ON DA THIRTY-FIRST, AN' HE HAB DA PHOTOGRAPHS, AN' HE KEEPS DEM IN DA COOL BOX UNDER DA BOTTLES, IN A PLASTIC BAG, COZ DAT IZ WHERE DEY IZ SAFEST!

choices.text: LOOK AT DA PHOTOGRAPHS.
BUY DA PHOTOGRAPHS.

c.text:
DERE IZ STEPS. SOMEBODY CUT STEPS.
DA FAR END OF IT DOWN IT IZ BRIGHT AN' IT IZ BEARABLE AN' DA AIR IZ WRONG IN DA MOUTH, AN' DERE IZ A LEDGE, AN' ON DA LEDGE DERE IZ TINKZ LEFT: TOOLS, A BOOT, A WEDDIN' RING, A FOUNDATION SEAL WIT DA DATE SCRATCHED OFF, AN' A DOORWAY IN DA ROCK WIT DA HEAT GOING INTO IT!

choices.text: GO THROUGH DA DOORWAY.
TAKE WHAT IZ ON DA LEDGE AN' CLIMB OUT!

asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

d.text:
HE GOES, COZ YOU SAID IT LIKE DAT, AN' HE IZ FURIOUS 'BOUT IT, AN' HALFWAY UP DA SLOPE HE STOPS BEING FURIOUS AN' STARTS SHAKIN'.
DA SAFE ZONE ENDS FOUR METRES FROM WHERE HIS DECKCHAIR WAZ. YOU FIND DAT OUT BY WATCHIN' WHAT HAPPENS TA DA DECKCHAIR WHEN HE TAKES IT!

a1.text:
"FETCHIN'," HE SAYS. "FETCHIN'. DERE IZ A LEDGE. PEOPLE LEAVE TINKZ AN' OTHER PEOPLE WANT DEM."
HE IZ A COURIER FOR A DOORWAY IN A VOLCANO AN' HE IZ PAID IN CASH BY FOUR DIFFERENT OFFICES. HE WILL TAKE YOU DOWN AS FAR AS DA LEDGE AN' NO FURTHER, AN' HE TELLS YOU EXACTLY WHY NO, AN' DA REASON IZ NO FIRE!

a2.text:
AFTER DARK DA VENT GLOW LIGHTS HIM FROM UNDERNEATH LIKE A STAGE, AN' DA MOUNTAIN DOES SOMETINK YOU WILL NEVER BE ABLE TA DESCRIBE TA ANYBODY: IT EXHALES, ONCE, AN' DA EXHALATION IZ SHAPED, AN' DERE IZ WORDS IN IT DAT IZ NO IN ANY LANGUAGE AN' IZ UNMISTAKABLY A GREETIN'.
HE WAVES BACK. HE DOES IT DA WAY YOU WAVE AT A NEIGHBOUR!

b1.text:
FOUR PHOTOGRAPHS OF DA NIGHT OF DA THIRTY-FIRST, TAKEN FROM A CORDON AT DA WRONG ANGLE, OF A TINK GOING DOWN INTO A VENT DAT IZ A GREAT DEAL LARGER DEN DA VENT.
DA FOURTH PHOTOGRAPH HAB PEOPLE IN IT. ONE OF DEM IZ LOOKIN' AT DA CAMERA!
b1.emText:
FOUR PHOTOGRAPHS FROM DA CORDON ON DA THIRTY-FIRST OF DECEMBER, 2001. SOMETINK ENORMOUS GOING DOWN INTO A VENT DAT IZ FAR TOO LIL' FOR IT.
IN DA FOURTH, AT DA EDGE OF DA FRAME, DERE IZ A WOMAN ON A STRETCHER WIT HER EYES OPEN, AN' YOU HAB NEVER SEEN YA OWN FACE FROM DA OUTSIDE ON DAT NIGHT, AN' NOW YOU HAB!
b1.bubba: BUBBA LOOKS AT DA FOURTH ONE FOR A LONG TIME AN' DEN PUTS IT FACE DOWN. "NAH, SUGAR. BASTA ACCUSSI'. NO TODAY."

b2.text:
HE WILL NO SELL DEM. HE GIVES YOU ONE, DA SECOND, WHICH IZ DA LEAST USEFUL AN' DA MOST BEAUTIFUL, AN' ASKS YOU TA SHOW IT TA PEOPLE.
YOU DO. A COUPLE OF DEM LAUGH. DA FIFTH PAYS ENOUGH TA KEEP DA WHOLE PARTY FED FOR A MONTH AN' ASKS WHERE DA OTHER THREE IZ!

c1.text:
THROUGH DA DOORWAY DA HEAT STOPS ENTIRELY, WHICH DA BODY READS AS FALLIN'.
WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE HAB BIN PAID BY EVERYBODY WHO HAB EVER STOOD ON DAT LEDGE AN' IT IZ REAL INTERESTED IN SOMEBODY WHO CAME THROUGH WITOUT LEAVIN' ANYTINK!

c2.text:
TOOLS, A BOOT, A RING AN' A SEAL. DA RING IZ GOLD AN' DA SEAL IZ WORTH TWICE OVER DA GOLD TA DA RIGHT BUYER.
ON DA WAY UP DA STEPS YOU UNDERSTAND DAT YOU HAB TAKEN PAYMENT OFF AN ALTAR, AN' DAT DIS IZ NOTED, AN' DAT IT IZ NO DA SORT OF DEBT DAT GETS COLLECTED QUICKLY!

c2_m.text:
TOOLS, A BOOT, A RING AN' A SEAL, ALL OF IT ON DA LEDGE FORTY METRES DOWN WHERE DA AIR IZ WRONG IN DA MOUTH AN' DA LIGHT COMES UP FROM BELOW.
DA LEDGE IZ ALSO {SWEPT|BRUSHED|KEPT}, WIT DA DUST PUSHED TA ONE END IN A LINE, AN' DA TOOLS IZ LAID OUT IN DA ORDER A PERSON LAYS TOOLS OUT WHEN DEY INTEND TA COME BACK TA DEM!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DAT IZ A WORKBENCH.|SOMEBODY WORKS HERE. TODAY.|DO NO TAKE DA TOOLS.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS DA RING BACK DOWN|LOOKS AT DA DOORWAY RATHER DEN DA LEDGE|COUNTS DA TOOLS}

choices.text: TAKE DA LOT AN' CLIMB OUT!
TAKE DA SEAL AN' LEAVE DA TOOLS!
READ DA TOOLS. WHOSE TRADE IZ DIS?

c2_seal.text:
DA SEAL GOES IN DA POCKET AN' EVERYTINK ELSE STAYS EXACTLY WHERE IT WAZ LYING, IN ITS OWN ORDER, ON A SWEPT LEDGE IN A VOLCANO.
ON DA WAY UP DA STEPS DERE IZ SOMEBODY COMIN' DOWN. DEY STAND ASIDE FOR EACH OTHER ON A CUT STAIR {A LONG WAY OFF|A LONG WAY} DOWN A VENT, AN' NEITHER SAYS ANYTINK, AN' DA PARTY IZ A HUNDRED METRES UP DA SLOPE BEFORE ANYBODY BREATHES PROPERLY!

c2_tools.text:
DEY IZ {A SMITH'S|A JEWELLER'S|FINE WORK} TOOLS, FOR REAL LIL' HOT WORK, AN' TWO OF DEM IZ FOR A JOB DAT DOES NO EXIST IN ANY TRADE ANYBODY IN DA PARTY CAN NAME.
WHICH MEANS WHAT IZ MADE ON DIS LEDGE IZ MADE FOR WHATEVER IZ THROUGH DA DOORWAY, AN' IT IZ MADE {TA ORDER|TA A PATTERN|TA SOMEBODY'S SPECIFICATION}, AN' DA COURIER IN DA DECKCHAIR IZ DA DELIVERY END OF A WORKIN' BUSINESS!

b1_m.text:
FOUR PHOTOGRAPHS OF DA NIGHT OF DA THIRTY-FIRST, TAKEN FROM A CORDON AT DA WRONG ANGLE, OF A TINK GOING DOWN INTO A VENT DAT IZ {A GREAT DEAL BRIGHTER|MUCH BRIGHTER|LIT} DEN IT SHOULD HAB BIN.
IN DA FOURTH ONE DERE IZ SOMEBODY ON DA LIP IN DA FOREGROUND, OUT OF FOCUS, IN A DECKCHAIR, READIN'. DA PHOTOGRAPHS IZ {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE OLD|FROM DA YEAR OF DA RITUAL|OLD}, AN' DA MAN IN DA CHAIR BESIDE DA PARTY IZ DA MAN IN DA CHAIR IN DA PICTURE, AT DA SAME AGE!

choices.text: SAY NUTTIN' 'BOUT DA FOURTH PHOTOGRAPH!
PUT IT TA HIM.
ASK TA SEE DA NEGATIVES.

b1_put.text:
HE DOES NO DENY IT AN' HE DOES NO EXPLAIN IT. HE FOLDS DA NEWSPAPER, WHICH HE HAB NO DONE ALL AFTERNOON, AN' SAYS DAT DA MOUNTAIN WENT QUIET AFTER DA THIRTY-FIRST AN' DAT SOMEBODY HAB TA SIT AT DA LIP, AN' DAT IT HAB BIN HIM SINCE.
HE WOULD LIKE IT TA STOP BEING HIM. HE SAYS SO ONCE, CLEARLY, AN' DEN UNFOLDS DA NEWSPAPER AGAIN, AN' DAT IZ DA WHOLE OF DA OFFER!

b1_neg.text:
DA NEGATIVES IZ IN A TIN UNDER DA DECKCHAIR, WHICH TELLS YOU HOW SERIOUSLY HE TAKES DA POSSIBILITY OF DA CHAIR EVER BEING MOVED.
ON DA NEGATIVE DA FOURTH FRAME HAB {MORE IN IT|A GREAT DEAL MORE IN IT|SOMETINK IN DA CORNER} DEN DA PRINT DOES, COZ DA PRINT WAZ CROPPED, AN' WHAT WAZ CROPPED OUT IZ STANDIN' ON DA FAR LIP, AN' DERE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN} OF DEM!

e_ruins.title: {DA SUNKEN FLOOR|A ROOM DAT IZ LOWER DEN IT WAZ|DA HOUSE WIT FOUR CELLARS}

n0.text:
HALF A HOUSE, AN' DA HALF DAT IZ LEFT HAB A FLOOR IN IT DAT HAB GONE DOWN: NO COLLAPSED, LOWERED, ALL IN ONE PIECE, TILES UNBROKEN, 'BOUT A METRE AN' A HALF BELOW WHERE DA DOORSTEP SAYS IT SHOULD BE.
AT DA FAR SIDE OF DA SUNKEN FLOOR DERE IZ A DOOR DAT USED TA BE A CELLAR DOOR AN' IZ NOW AT EYE LEVEL, AN' IT IZ SHUT, AN' IT IZ NEWER DEN DA HOUSE.
IN DA WALLPAPER, {sign}.
DA LOWERED FLOOR HAB GONE DOWN {EVENLY|LEVEL|BY EXACTLY DA SAME AMOUNT ALL ROUND}, WHICH IZ NO SOMETINK A FLOOR DOES WHEN IT FAILS!
n0.emText:
HALF A HOUSE WIT ITS FLOOR LOWERED A METRE AN' A HALF, ALL IN ONE PIECE, TILES UNBROKEN, AN' A CELLAR DOOR DAT IZ NOW AT EYE LEVEL AN' IZ NEWER DEN EVERYTINK AROUND IT.
SOMETINK TOOK A LEVEL OF DIS BUILDIN' AWAY AN' PUT A DIFFERENT ONE IN. YOU KNOW DA TRICK FROM DA INSIDE. DERE IZ AN ENTIRE FLOOR OF YOU MISSIN' AN' DA DOOR TA IT IZ AT DA WRONG HEIGHT TOO!
n0.bubba: BUBBA DROPS DOWN ONTO DA TILES AN' STAMPS TWICE. "SOLID. UH-HUH. SOMEBODY BUILT DIS HERE ON A TUESDAY, SUGAR, AN' DA HOUSE AIN'T FROM A TUESDAY."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.artistic: {member} SAYS DA WALLPAPER PATTERN CONTINUES BELOW DA NEW FLOOR LEVEL, WHICH MEANS DA NEW FLOOR IZ INSIDE DA OLD ROOM!
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: OPEN DA CELLAR DOOR.
TAKE DA FLOOR UP.
SEARCH DA STANDIN' HALF OF DA HOUSE!
KNOCK. PROPERLY. AN' WAIT!

a.text:
BEHIND IT: A CORRIDOR, DRY, PLASTERED, LIT BY NUTTIN' YOU CAN IDENTIFY, RUNNIN' FURTHER DEN DA FOOTPRINT OF DA HOUSE ALLOWS.
ON DA LEFT-HAND WALL, AT REGULAR INTERVALS, IZ DOORS, AN' EACH DOOR HAB A NUMBER, AN' DA NUMBERS DO NO RUN IN ORDER, AN' DA FOURTH ONE IZ YA OWN HOUSE NUMBER, WHICHEVER OF YOU IZ THINKIN' 'BOUT DAT!

choices.text: OPEN DA NUMBERED DOOR DAT MEANS SOMETINK TA SOMEBODY!
WALK DA CORRIDOR TA DA END!

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
DA TILES COME UP IN ONE PIECE EACH, LAID ON SAND, AN' UNDER DA SAND DERE IZ A SECOND FLOOR, AN' IT IZ DA ORIGINAL, AN' BETWEEN DA TWO DERE IZ A HAND'S WIDTH OF SPACE WIT TINKZ IN IT: A SHOE, A COMB, {paper}, A BUNDLE OF LETTERS, A DOLL.
EVERYTINK DAT WAZ ON DA OLD FLOOR WHEN IT WAZ LOWERED WAZ SWEPT INTO DA GAP FIRST. NEATLY!

c.text:
TWO ROOMS AN' A STAIR TA NOWHERE.
IN DA SECOND ROOM DERE IZ A TABLE WIT A MEAL ON IT, FOUR PLACES, CUTLERY DOWN, AN' A CHAIR PULLED OUT. DA FOOD IZ DUST. DA CHAIR IZ NO: DA CHAIR HAB BIN SAT IN DIS WEEK, AN' DA DUST ROUND IT HAB BIN DISTURBED BY A COAT!

choices.text: SIT IN DA CHAIR.
LAY A FIFTH PLACE.

d.text:
YOU KNOCK ON A CELLAR DOOR AT EYE LEVEL IN A RUINED HOUSE AN' YOU WAIT, AN' IT TAKES A MINUTE AN' A HALF, AN' DEN SOMEBODY KNOCKS BACK: FOUR KNOCKS, EVENLY SPACED, FROM A LONG WAY OFF, GETTIN' NEARER WIT EACH ONE.
DA FOURTH IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DA DOOR!

choices.text: OPEN IT.
SAY WHO YOU IZ THROUGH DA DOOR!

a1.text:
IT OPENS ON A ROOM YOU KNOW, AN' IT IZ NO DIS DECADE, AN' DERE IZ PEOPLE IN IT WHO IZ NO SURPRISED TA SEE YOU AN' DO NO STOP WHAT DEY IZ DOING.
YOU IZ IN DERE FOR FOUR MINUTES. YOU COME OUT WIT SOMETINK DAT WAZ ON DA SIDEBOARD, AN' WIT A HEADACHE, AN' A CERTAINTY 'BOUT A TINK YOU HAB CHOSEN NO TA BE CERTAIN 'BOUT!

a2.text:
FOUR HUNDRED METRES, WHICH DA HOUSE DOES NO HAB.
DA END OF DA CORRIDOR IZ A WALL WIT A BELL PUSH IN IT. ZERO BELL, DERE IZ NO WIRE, AN' WHEN YOU PRESS IT, SOMEWHERE BEHIND YOU, IN DA RUIN, A DOOR OPENS!

c1.text:
DA CHAIR IZ WARM. FROM DA CHAIR, DA TABLE LOOKS LAID RATHER DEN ABANDONED, AN' DA ROOM LOOKS LIT, AN' DERE IZ A FIFTH PERSON IN DA DOORWAY YOU NO CAN LOOK AT DIRECTLY.
YOU IZ WELCOME. YOU IZ, QUITE CLEARLY AN' QUITE KINDLY, WELCOME, AN' YOU IZ NO BEING ASKED FOR ANYTINK, AN' DAT IZ DA FRIGHTENIN' PART!

c2.text:
YOU SET A FIFTH PLACE WIT WHAT IZ IN DA SIDEBOARD AN' YOU SIT DOWN AN' EAT YA OWN FOOD AT A DEAD TABLE.
WHEN YOU HAB FINISHED, DA FIFTH PLACE HAB BIN USED. NOBODY SAW IT HAPPEN. UNDER DA PLATE DERE IZ {relicWord} AN' A NOTE IN A HAND NOBODY CAN READ, AN' DA PULLED-OUT CHAIR IZ PUSHED IN!

d1.text:
DA CORRIDOR IZ DERE AN' SO IZ DA PERSON WHO KNOCKED, AN' DEY IZ A METRE AN' A HALF BELOW YOU, STANDIN' IN DA OLD HOUSE AT DA OLD FLOOR LEVEL, LOOKIN' UP.
DEY HAB BIN DOWN DERE SINCE DA FLOOR WAZ PUT IN. DEY IZ ONLY ASKIN' WHETHER IT IZ STILL {timeAgo} UP HERE!

d2.text:
YOU SAY YA NAME AN' YA BUSINESS THROUGH A CELLAR DOOR.
DA ANSWER COMES BACK IN YA OWN VOICE, SAYIN' YA NAME AN' YA BUSINESS, AN' DEN A SECOND VOICE, SAYIN': "NO DAT ONE. DA OTHER ONE. SEND DA OTHER ONE."
NOBODY OPENS DA DOOR. EVERYBODY AGREES, LATER, DAT DIS WAZ CORRECT!

b_m.text:
DA TILES COME UP IN ONE PIECE EACH, LAID ON SAND, AN' UNDER DA SAND DERE IZ A SECOND FLOOR, AN' IT IZ DA ORIGINAL.
BETWEEN DA TWO DERE IZ {A HAND'S DEPTH|A GAP|ROOM}, AN' IN DA GAP, LAID FLAT AN' SPACED OUT ON DA LOWER FLOOR, DERE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN} OBJECTS, ONE UNDER EVERY THIRD TILE, AN' NONE OF DEM IZ VALUABLE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{NOBODY HIDES WORTHLESS TINKZ CAREFULLY.|DOZE IZ PLACED.|ONE EVERY THIRD TILE. DAT IZ A PLAN.}"
asides.any: {member} {NUMBERS DA TILES AS DEY COME UP|LEAVES EACH OBJECT WHERE IT IZ AN' PHOTOGRAPHS IT|COUNTS TA NINE AN' DEN COUNTS AGAIN}

choices.text: LIFT DEM ALL AN' TAKE DA LOT!
WORK OUT WHAT DA SPACIN' IZ FOR!
PUT DA TILES BACK DOWN AN' LEAVE IT AS IT WAZ!

b_space.text:
DA SPACIN' IZ {BALLAST|PACKIN'|A LEVEL}, AN' EACH OBJECT HAB BIN CHOSEN FOR ITS WEIGHT, AN' TOGETHER DEY HOLD DA UPPER FLOOR EXACTLY {LEVEL|TRUE|SQUARE} ON DA SAND.
TAKE ONE AN' DA FLOOR TILTS. TAKE ALL NINE AN' DA FLOOR GOES DOWN DA REST OF DA WAY, AN' DA REST OF DA WAY IZ A GOOD DEAL FURTHER DEN DA HOUSE HAB UNDER IT!

b_back.text:
EVERY TILE BACK ON ITS OWN BED OF SAND IN ITS OWN PLACE, WHICH TAKES {HALF A SHIFT|DA REST OF DA DAY|LONGER DEN LIFTIN' DEM DID} AN' IZ DONE BY PEOPLE WHO HAB DECIDED DEY WOULD RATHER NO FIND OUT.
DA FLOOR IZ LEVEL. IT IZ STILL LEVEL {A YEAR LATER|WHEN ANYBODY NEXT PASSES|YEARS AFTER}, AN' DA HALF-HOUSE IZ STILL STANDIN', AN' NOBODY IN DA VILLAGE CAN EXPLAIN WHY DAT CORNER NEVER FALLS!

d2_m.text:
YOU SAY YA NAME AN' YA BUSINESS THROUGH A CELLAR DOOR AN' DA ANSWER COMES BACK IN YA OWN VOICE, SAYIN' YA NAME AN' YA BUSINESS, {ONE WORD BEHIND|A BEAT LATE|HALF A SECOND AFTER}.
DEN IT SAYS A THIRD TINK, WHICH YOU HAB NO SAID, AN' WHICH IZ A QUESTION, AN' DA QUESTION IZ WHETHER YOU IZ COMIN' DOWN OR WHETHER IT SHOULD COME UP!

choices.text: SAY NUTTIN' ELSE. LEAVE DA HOUSE!
SAY: COME UP.
ANSWER IN A LANGUAGE IT HAB NO HEARD YOU USE!

d2_up.text:
DA DOOR OPENS BY ITSELF FROM DA OTHER SIDE AN' DA CORRIDOR IZ DERE AN' SO IZ DA STEP UP, WHICH IZ {A METRE AN' A HALF|A GOOD HEIGHT|HIGHER DEN IT SHOULD BE}.
WHAT COMES UP IZ NO IN A HURRY AN' IZ NO HOSTILE AN' IZ WEARIN' A COAT DA PARTY RECOGNISES. IT STAYS {FOUR MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|A WHILE}, IN DA STANDIN' HALF OF DA HOUSE, AN' DEN GOES BACK DOWN, AN' DA CELLAR DOOR WILL NO OPEN AGAIN FOR ANYBODY!

d2_lang.text:
A SENTENCE IN A LANGUAGE NONE OF DA PARTY HAB SPOKEN OUT LOUD IN DIS COUNTRY, SAID THROUGH A CELLAR DOOR IN A RUIN, AN' DA DOOR DOES NO ANSWER IT.
IT NO CAN. WHATEVER IZ DOWN DERE WORKS FROM WHAT IT HAB HEARD, AN' IT HAB JUST BIN SHOWN DA EDGE OF DAT, AN' DA KNOCK DAT FOLLOWS IZ {FOUR KNOCKS|DIFFERENT|A REQUEST RATHER DEN AN ECHO}, AN' AFTER DAT DA ARRANGEMENT BETWEEN DA PARTY AN' DA HOUSE IZ ON AN ENTIRELY DIFFERENT FOOTIN'!

e_graveyard.title: {DA FRESH GRAVE|NOBODY HAB DIED HERE SINCE {timeAgo}|DUG LAST NIGHT}

n0.text:
A COUNTRY GRAVEYARD WIT NINE HUNDRED YEARS IN IT AN' ONE GRAVE DUG LAST NIGHT: SHARP EDGES, HEAPED SPOIL, NO STONE, NO FLOWERS, NO NOTICE ON DA GATE.
DA PARISH REGISTER IN DA PORCH SAYS NOBODY HAB BIN BURIED HERE SINCE {timeAgo}.
DA HOLE IZ EXACTLY DA RIGHT SIZE, AN' IT IZ DUG DA WAY A PROFESSIONAL DIGS, AN' DERE IZ A SPADE LEFT IN DA SPOIL HEAP, WHICH NO PROFESSIONAL WOULD EVER DO.
DA SPADE IZ LEFT STANDIN' IN DA SPOIL AT AN ANGLE DAT MEANS SOMEBODY INTENDS TA COME BACK TA IT {TONIGHT|SHORTLY|BEFORE MORNIN'}!
n0.emText:
ONE FRESH GRAVE IN A NINE-HUNDRED-YEAR CHURCHYARD, CUT LAST NIGHT BY SOMEBODY WHO KNEW DA WORK, AN' A SPADE LEFT STANDIN' IN DA SPOIL, WHICH NOBODY WHO KNOWS DA WORK WOULD DO.
DA HOLE IZ DA RIGHT SIZE FOR A PERSON. YOU HAB A HORRIBLE AN' SPECIFIC FEELIN' 'BOUT WHICH PERSON, AN' IT IZ DA SAME FEELIN' YOU GET LOOKIN' AT A DOORWAY YOU NO CAN REMEMBER WALKIN' THROUGH!
n0.bubba: BUBBA LOOKS IN DA HOLE, DEN AT YOU, DEN BACK IN DA HOLE. "SUGAR, DAT IZ 'BOUT YA SIZE. NUN ME PIACE PE' NIENTE. C'MON NOW."

asides.melancholic: {member} READS FOUR HEADSTONES AN' COMES BACK QUIETER DEN DEY LEFT!
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GET IN DA GRAVE.
WAIT FOR WHOEVER COMES BACK FOR DA SPADE!
FILL IT IN.
FIND DA PRIEST.

a.text:
IT IZ DEEP ENOUGH DAT DA SKY IZ A RECTANGLE AN' DA CHURCH IZ GONE.
DA SIDES IZ CUT CLEAN. AT DA FOOT END, AT 'BOUT DA DEPTH OF A KNEE, DERE IZ A NICHE CUT INTO DA EARTH, AN' DERE IZ SOMETINK IN DA NICHE, WRAPPED, AN' IT IZ DA ONLY REASON DIS HOLE EXISTS!

b.text:
DEY COME BACK AT DUSK: A WOMAN IN HER FIFTIES WIT A WHEELBARROW AN' A SECOND SPADE, AN' SHE IZ A SOLICITOR FROM {region}, AN' SHE HAB BIN DIGGIN' HER OWN FAMILY'S GRAVES FOR A FEW YEARS COZ DA PARISH WILL NO.
"DERE IZ NOBODY IN ANY OF DEM," SHE SAYS. "DAT IZ DA TINK NOBODY WILL PUT IN WRITIN'."

choices.text: HELP HER DIG.
ASK WHAT SHE IZ EXPECTIN' TA FIND!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text:
IT TAKES A LONG STRETCH AN' IT IZ DA RIGHT TINK TA DO AN' EVERYBODY KNOWS IT.
AT 'BOUT DA HALFWAY POINT DA SPOIL STOPS GOING IN. IT GOES IN AN' IT IZ NO DERE; DA LEVEL DOES NO RISE. YOU IZ SHOVELLIN' EARTH INTO A HOLE DAT IZ NO ACCEPTIN' IT, AN' DA LAST OF DA LIGHT IZ GOING!

choices.text: {KEEP GOING|PUSH DEEPER|CONTINUE FORWARD|PRESS ON} UNTIL IT IZ FULL!
STOP, AN' PUT DA SPADE BACK WHERE IT WAZ!

d.text:
DA PRIEST IZ IN DA VESTRY WIT DA REGISTER PAGES IN FRONT OF HIM, DA FOUR DAT WAZ CUT OUT, AN' A GLASS OF SOMETINK, AN' HE IZ NO SURPRISED.
"IT IZ DA FOURTEENTH," HE SAYS. "DEY DIG ONE EVERY SO OFTEN AN' IF YOU FILL IT IN DEY DIG ANOTHER AN' IF YOU LEAVE IT ALONE IT FILLS ITSELF AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' IN DA RITE FOR DIS, ME HAB LOOKED, ME HAB WRITTEN TA DA DIOCESE."

choices.text: ASK WHAT HAPPENED WIT DA FIRST THIRTEEN!
OFFER TA SIT UP WIT DA GRAVE ALL NIGHT!

asides.nurturing: {member} TAKES DA GLASS OFF HIM GENTLY AN' PUTS DA KETTLE ON INSTEAD!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b1.text:
HALF A SHIFT IN DA DARK WIT A SOLICITOR, OPENIN' A GRAVE DAT IZ A HUNDRED YEARS OLD, AN' SHE IZ RIGHT: DERE IZ A COFFIN, AN' IT IZ EMPTY, AN' IT HAB BIN EMPTY SINCE IT WENT IN, COZ DA WOOD HAB NEVER BIN UNDER WEIGHT.
WHAT IZ IN IT INSTEAD IZ A BOX OF PAPERS, AN' DA PAPERS IZ WHAT HER FAMILY HAB BIN PAYIN' FOR DA SILENCE OF FOR A CENTURY!

b2.text:
"NUTTIN'," SHE SAYS. "DAT IZ WHAT ME IZ EXPECTIN'. ME WANT TA BE ABLE TA SAY ME HAB SEEN DA NUTTIN'."
YOU SIT WIT HER UNTIL DA LIGHT IZ GONE AN' SHE TALKS 'BOUT HER BROTHER, AN' AT DA END OF IT SHE GIVES YOU DA SECOND SPADE AN' {payment}, AN' DRIVES HOME, AN' DOES NO DIG AGAIN!

c1.text:
YOU FILL A HOLE DAT WILL NO FILL, IN DA DARK, UNTIL DA SPOIL HEAP IZ GONE AN' DA HOLE IZ EXACTLY AS DEEP AS IT WAZ.
DEN SOMETINK TAKES HOLD OF DA SPADE FROM DA OTHER END AN' DOES NO PULL, JUST HOLDS, DA WAY SOMEBODY HOLDS A DOOR YOU IZ TRYIN' TA SHUT!

c2.text:
YOU STOP, AN' YOU PUT DA SPADE BACK IN DA SPOIL AT EXACTLY DA ANGLE YOU FOUND IT, AN' YOU LEAVE DA CHURCHYARD BY DA GATE RATHER DEN DA WALL.
IN DA MORNIN' DA GRAVE IZ FILLED AN' DA TURF IZ ON AN' DA GRASS HAB TAKEN, AN' DA SEXTON, WHO HAB NO BIN OUT IN A YEAR, WILL NO DISCUSS IT!

d1.text:
"FILLED, DUG, FILLED, DUG, AN' AFTER DA NINTH ME STOPPED FILLIN' DEM."
DA FIVE HE STOPPED FILLIN' IZ ALL IN DA NORTH CORNER, ALL GRASSED OVER, ALL WIT GRASS A DIFFERENT GREEN, AN' DA PRIEST HAB NEVER ONCE BIN ABLE TA BRING HIMSELF TA WALK ON IT.
YOU WALK ON IT. SOMETINK UNDER IT IZ REAL GLAD SOMEBODY FINALLY DID!

d2.text:
YOU SIT UP IN A CHURCHYARD FROM DARK TA FOUR WIT A FLASK AN' A PRIEST WHO TALKS FOR DA FIRST TWO HOURS AN' SLEEPS FOR DA LAST TWO.
AT FOUR DA GRAVE FILLS ITSELF. IT TAKES 'BOUT A MINUTE AN' IT DOES IT FROM DA BOTTOM, AN' DERE IZ A SOUND WIT IT DAT IZ NEARLY A VOICE, AN' AFTERWARDS DERE IZ A STONE DAT WAZ NO DERE, WIT A NAME ON IT, AN' DA NAME IZ NO ANYBODY'S YET!

a_m.text:
IT IZ DEEP ENOUGH DAT DA SKY IZ A RECTANGLE AN' DA CHURCH IZ GONE, AN' DA SIDES IZ CUT CLEAN BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB DUG A GREAT MANY OF DEZE.
AT DA FOOT END, AT 'BOUT DA DEPTH OF A KNEE, DERE IZ {A HOLE|AN OPENIN'|A GAP IN DA CUT} GOING SIDEWAYS, AN' IT HAB BIN DUG FROM DA OTHER DIRECTION, AN' DA SPOIL FROM IT IZ NO IN DIS GRAVE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY DUG INWARDS.|DA SPOIL WENT SOMEWHERE ELSE.|DAT HOLE HAB A FAR END AN' WE IZ AT DA NEAR ONE.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A LAMP TA DA HOLE|MEASURES IT AGAINST AN ARM|DOES NO PUT A HAND IN IT}

choices.text: REACH IN AN' SEE WHAT IZ IN DERE!
WORK OUT WHERE DA FAR END COMES UP!
GET OUT OF DA GRAVE AN' WAIT FOR DA SPADE'S OWNER!

a_far.text:
BEARIN', DISTANCE, A BIT OF ARITHMETIC IN A GRAVE BY LAMPLIGHT, AN' DA FAR END COMES UP {UNDER DA NORTH CORNER|IN DA NORTH CORNER|AT DA FIVE DAT WAZ NEVER FILLED}.
DERE IZ A HOLE DERE, IN DA TURF, DA SAME SIZE, WIT DA SPOIL FROM DIS GRAVE HEAPED BESIDE IT. SOMETINK HAB BIN DIGGIN' BETWEEN DA TWO FOR {A WHILE|SOME TIME|LONGER DEN LAST NIGHT}, AN' IT HAB BIN GOING IN BOTH DIRECTIONS!

d1_m.text:
"FILLED, DUG, FILLED, DUG, AN' AFTER DA NINTH ME STOPPED FILLIN' DEM." HE SAYS IT DA WAY A MAN SAYS A TINK HE HAB BIN WAITIN' {FOUR YEARS|A LONG TIME|YEARS} TA SAY TA SOMEBODY WHO IZ NO IN DA PARISH.
DA FIVE HE STOPPED FILLIN' IZ ALL IN DA NORTH CORNER. HE HAB DA REGISTER PAGES HERE, DA FOUR DAT WAZ CUT OUT, AN' HE HAB NO SHOWN DEM TA DA DIOCESE, AN' HE SAYS WHY, AN' DA REASON IZ {GOOD|BETTER DEN ANYBODY WOULD EXPECT|NO WHAT DA PARTY EXPECTED}!

choices.text: GO AN' LOOK AT DA FIVE IN DA NORTH CORNER!
READ DA FOUR CUT PAGES.
TELL HIM TA SEND DEM TA DA DIOCESE. TONIGHT!

d1_pages.text:
FOUR PAGES OF A NINE-HUNDRED-YEAR REGISTER, CUT OUT WIT A BLADE, COVERIN' {ELEVEN|NINE} BURIALS ACROSS {TWO HUNDRED YEARS|TWO CENTURIES|A LONG SPAN}, AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM IZ DA SAME SURNAME.
DA SURNAME IZ ON DA GATE OF DA FARM AT DA BOTTOM OF DA LANE. IT IZ ALSO, IN DA CURRENT GENERATION, DA WOMAN WIT DA WHEELBARROW, AN' SHE DOES NO KNOW, AN' DA PRIEST HAB BIN CARRYIN' DAT ON HIS OWN SINCE {DA SPRING|DA BAD WINTER|WHENEVER IT WAZ}!

d1_send.text:
TELLIN' A COUNTRY PRIEST TA HAND HIS OWN PARISH'S WORST SECRET TA DA DIOCESE TAKES {AN HOUR|MOST OF DA BOTTLE|LONGER DEN ANYBODY WANTS}, AN' IT WORKS COZ DA ARGUMENT MADE IZ A THEOLOGICAL ONE AN' HE NO CAN ANSWER IT.
HE POSTS DEM HIMSELF IN DA MORNIN'. WHAT COMES BACK {MOST OF A SEASON|A SEASON|EVENTUALLY} IZ A COUPLE OF MEN, A FACULTY, AN' PERMISSION TA FILL DA FIVE IN DA NORTH CORNER, WHICH IZ DONE PROPERLY, WIT DA WHOLE VILLAGE DERE!

e_swamp.title: {DA CHAPEL IN DA WATER|ANKLE DEEP IN SOMEBODY'S NAVE|DA ROOF IZ STILL ABOVE DA REEDS}

n0.text:
DA REEDS PART ON A CHAPEL ROOF. DA REST OF IT IZ UNDER, AN' DA WATER IZ EXACTLY WAIST DEEP IN DA DOORWAY AN' STAYS WAIST DEEP ALL DA WAY TA DA ALTAR, WHICH IZ NO HOW WATER WORKS IN A BUILDIN' DAT IZ STANDIN' ON A SLOPE.
CANDLES HAB BIN LIT IN DERE. RECENTLY. ON A SHELF ABOVE DA WATERLINE DERE IZ FOUR, AN' TWO IZ STILL BURNIN', AN' DERE IZ NO WAY IN BUT DA WAY YOU CAME.
AN' DA FLOOR {SLOPES|RUNS DOWNHILL|GOES DOWN} TOWARDS DA ALTAR DA WHOLE WAY!
n0.emText:
A CHAPEL DROWNED TA DA ROOFLINE, DA WATER EXACTLY WAIST DEEP ALL DA WAY TA DA ALTAR REGARDLESS OF DA FLOOR, AN' FOUR CANDLES ON A SHELF ABOVE DA LINE WIT TWO OF DEM STILL LIT.
SOMEBODY COMES HERE AN' KEEPS A RULE. RULES LIKE DAT HOLD A PLACE TOGETHER DA WAY A STITCH HOLDS A WOUND. YOU HAB 'BOUT EIGHT PER CENT OF YOURSELF AN' NO STITCHES AT ALL!
n0.bubba: BUBBA WADES IN FIRST, HAT HELD UP OVER HIS HEAD LIKE A MAN CARRYIN' A CAKE. "AOH. NUN STA' FREDDA. SUGAR, DIS WATER AIN'T COLD. IT OUGHTA BE COLD."

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.artistic: {member} SAYS DA REFLECTION IN DA WATER IZ A BEAT BEHIND, AN' DEN REFUSES TA LOOK AT IT AGAIN!
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WADE TA DA ALTAR.
WAIT OUTSIDE FOR WHOEVER LIGHTS DA CANDLES!
GO DOWN. LOOK AT DA FLOOR!
TAKE DA CANDLES AN' GO.

a.text:
DA ALTAR IZ ABOVE DA WATER BY DA THICKNESS OF A HAND. ON IT: A BOWL, A STONE, AN' A PHOTOGRAPH OF A MAN IN A SUIT DAT FITTED HIM TEN YEARS AGO, WEIGHTED DOWN WIT A COIN.
UNDER DA WATER, ALL ROUND DA ALTAR STEP, DA FLOOR IZ COVERED IN COINS. THOUSANDS. EVERY ONE OF DEM FACE UP!

choices.text: TAKE A COIN.
ADD A COIN.
TAKE DA PHOTOGRAPH.

asides.hedonistic: {member} IZ DOING ARITHMETIC 'BOUT THOUSANDS OF COINS AN' NO ENJOYIN' ANYBODY'S REACTION!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
A WOMAN COMES AT DUSK IN WADERS WIT FOUR CANDLES IN A BREAD BAG, AN' SHE DOES DA WHOLE TINK WITOUT SPEAKIN': IN, LIGHT, OUT, AN' ON DA WAY OUT SHE PUTS ONE HAND FLAT ON DA DOOR FRAME.
SHE HAB DONE DIS EVERY WEEK FOR YEARS AN' YEARS. SHE WAZ TOLD TA BY SOMEBODY WHO IZ IN DA PHOTOGRAPH ON DA ALTAR!

choices.text: ASK HER TA TEACH YOU DA RULE!
OFFER TA TAKE A WEEK FOR HER!

c.text:
YOU GO UNDER. DA WATER IZ WARM AN' CLEAR AN' DERE IZ LIGHT FROM SOMEWHERE BELOW.
DA FLOOR IZ A FOOT BELOW YA FEET AN' IT IZ TILED AN' IT IZ DRY: DERE IZ A SKIN ON DA UNDERSIDE OF DA WATER, AN' UNDER DA SKIN DA CHAPEL IZ A DRY CHAPEL WIT PEWS AN' A HYMN BOARD WIT NUMBERS STILL ON IT, AN' SOMEBODY IZ SITTIN' IN DA THIRD ROW FROM DA BACK!

d.text:
YOU TAKE FOUR CANDLES OUT OF A CHAPEL, TWO OF DEM BURNIN', AN' DA WATER FOLLOWS YOU.
IT COMES OUT OF DA DOOR BEHIND YOU AT WALKIN' PACE, KEEPS TA WAIST HEIGHT, AN' STAYS EXACTLY WIT YOU FOR TWO KILOMETRES THROUGH A SWAMP UNTIL SOMEBODY HAB DA SENSE TA PUT DA CANDLES DOWN ON A TUSSOCK!

a1.text:
DA COIN IZ SILVER AN' OLD AN' WORTH SOMETINK, AN' TAKIN' IT TURNS EVERY OTHER COIN ON DAT FLOOR FACE DOWN.
ALL OF DEM. AT ONCE. WIT A SOUND LIKE A REAL LONG WORD BEING SAID BACKWARDS!

a2.text:
YOU PUT YA OWN COIN ON DA ALTAR FACE UP AN' DA WATER DROPS, ALL AT ONCE, BY DA WIDTH OF A HAND, ALL THROUGH DA CHAPEL.
ON DA FLOOR BY DA ALTAR STEP, UNCOVERED, IZ {relicWord} DAT HAB BIN UNDER WATER FOR A LONG TIME AN' IZ COMPLETELY DRY!

a3.text:
DA PHOTOGRAPH IZ DRY AN' DA COIN HOLDIN' IT DOWN IZ NO.
WHEN YOU LIFT IT, DA MAN IN DA SUIT DAT FITTED HIM YEARS AN' YEARS AGO IZ STANDIN' AT DA BACK OF DA CHAPEL, WAIST DEEP, WAITIN' TA BE ASKED SOMETINK. HE HAB BIN WAITIN' ELEVEN YEARS AN' HE IZ EXTREMELY PATIENT!

b1.text:
SHE TEACHES YOU DA RULE, WHICH IZ FOUR CANDLES, ONE HAND ON DA FRAME, AN' NUTTIN' SAID INSIDE.
DEN SHE TELLS YOU WHAT HAPPENS WHEN A WEEK IZ MISSED, WHICH HAPPENED ONCE, IN DA SECOND YEAR, AN' WHICH IZ WHY DA VILLAGE ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DA REEDS HAB FORTY HOUSES AN' THIRTY-ONE ROOFS!

b2.text:
YOU TAKE A WEEK. IT IZ FOUR CANDLES AN' ELEVEN KILOMETRES AN' A WET AFTERNOON.
ON DA WAY OUT, WIT YA HAND FLAT ON DA DOOR FRAME, SOMETINK PUTS ITS HAND FLAT ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DA FRAME, LEVEL WIT YA, DA WAY CHILDREN DO AT A WINDOW.
SHE IZ WAITIN' AT DA REED EDGE. "IT IZ NEVER DONE DAT," SHE SAYS, AN' DEN SHE GIVES YOU DA BREAD BAG, WHICH MEANS DA JOB IZ YA WHENEVER YOU WANT IT!

a3_m.text:
DA PHOTOGRAPH IZ DRY AN' DA COIN HOLDIN' IT DOWN IZ NO, AN' LIFTIN' IT IZ {FOUR SECONDS|A MOMENT|NUTTIN' AT ALL}.
UNDER IT, STUCK TA DA BACK, DERE IZ A SECOND PHOTOGRAPH, OF DA SAME MAN, IN DA SAME SUIT, STANDIN' IN DIS CHAPEL WIT DA WATER AT HIS {KNEES|WAIST|ANKLES}, AN' DA SUIT FITS HIM IN DIS ONE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{TWO PHOTOGRAPHS. ONE OF DEM IZ LATER.|PUT DEM BOTH BACK.|HE CAME BACK. DAT IZ WHAT DAT MEANS.}"
asides.any: {member} {HOLDS DA TWO UP SIDE BY SIDE|LOOKS AT DA WATER LEVEL IN DA SECOND ONE|TURNS DEM OVER}

choices.text: TAKE DA PHOTOGRAPH. BOTH OF DEM!
PUT DEM BACK AN' PUT A COIN ON TOP!
READ DA WATER LEVEL IN DA SECOND PHOTOGRAPH!

a3_back.text:
BOTH PHOTOGRAPHS FLAT ON DA ALTAR, DA COIN ON TOP OF DEM, AN' DA PARTY'S OWN COIN BESIDE IT, FACE UP.
DA WATER DROPS BY DA WIDTH OF A HAND ALL THROUGH DA CHAPEL. IT DOES NO COME BACK UP. {A YEAR LATER|DA FOLLOWIN' SEASON|YEARS AFTERWARDS} DA DOORWAY IZ DRY AN' DERE IZ A PATH OF TRODDEN REEDS TA IT, WHICH DERE WAZ NO BEFORE!

a3_level.text:
DA SECOND PHOTOGRAPH WAZ TAKEN WIT DA WATER {TWO FEET LOWER|MUCH LOWER|AT DA KNEE}, WHICH PUTS IT {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE|DECADES|A LONG TIME} BEFORE DA FIRST ONE ON ANY READIN' OF HOW DIS SWAMP HAB RISEN.
EXCEPT DAT DA MAN IZ OLDER IN IT. WHICH MEANS DA SEQUENCE RUNS DA OTHER WAY, AN' DA FOUR CANDLES AN' DA BOWL AN' DA COINS IZ {A SCHEDULE|AN APPOINTMENT|SOMEBODY BEING EXPECTED}!

b2_m.text:
A WEEK OF IT: FOUR CANDLES AN' ELEVEN KILOMETRES AN' A WET AFTERNOON, REPEATED, IN WADERS DAT DO NO FIT, WITOUT SPEAKIN' INSIDE.
ON DA FOURTH DAY DA BOWL ON DA ALTAR HAB SOMETINK IN IT DAT DA PARTY DID NO PUT DERE, AN' ON DA FIFTH DERE IZ {TWO TINKZ|A SECOND TINK|MORE}, AN' ON DA SIXTH DA WOMAN IZ WAITIN' AT DA ROAD AN' ASKS, WITOUT ANY PREAMBLE, HOW MANY!

choices.text: TELL HER. FINISH DA WEEK.
SAY NUTTIN' AN' FINISH DA WEEK!
ASK HER WHAT DA NUMBER IZ SUPPOSED TA BE!

b2_quiet.text:
DA SEVENTH DAY IZ DONE WITOUT ANSWERIN' HER, WHICH SHE ACCEPTS, AN' DA BOWL HAB {FOUR|FIVE} TINKZ IN IT BY DEN AN' DA PARTY TAKES NONE OF DEM.
AT DA ROAD ON DA LAST AFTERNOON SHE TAKES DA WADERS BACK AN' SAYS, TA NOBODY IN PARTICULAR, DAT IT HAB NEVER GONE PAST THREE BEFORE. DEN SHE GOES HOME. DA PARTY IZ {TWO COUNTIES|A LONG WAY|WELL} AWAY BEFORE ANYBODY SAYS ANYTINK 'BOUT IT!

b2_number.text:
IT IZ SUPPOSED TA BE NONE. IT HAB BIN NONE EVERY WEEK FOR {ELEVEN YEARS|AS LONG AS SHE HAB DONE IT|A REAL LONG TIME}, AN' DA NUMBER IZ HOW YOU KNOW DA ARRANGEMENT IZ HOLDIN', AN' DA PARTY HAB BROKEN DA RUN.
SHE IZ {RELIEVED|FRIGHTENED AN' RELIEVED|GLAD}, COZ SHE HAB BIN DOING ELEVEN KILOMETRES A WEEK FOR ELEVEN YEARS WITOUT EVER ONCE BEING TOLD WHETHER IT WAZ WORKIN', AN' NOW SOMEBODY ELSE HAB SEEN IT WORK!

e_temple.title: {DA OFFERIN'|SOMEBODY STILL FEEDS DIS PLACE|FOUR BOWLS AN' ONE EMPTY}

n0.text:
DA TEMPLE IZ ROOFLESS AN' DA STEPS IZ WORN AN' DERE IZ FOUR BOWLS ON DA THRESHOLD WIT FOOD IN DEM, FRESH, AN' A FIFTH BOWL DAT IZ EMPTY AN' CLEAN AN' SET APART.
DA FOOD IN DA FOUR IZ UNTOUCHED. DA EMPTY ONE HAB BIN USED, AN' WASHED, AN' PUT BACK, TODAY.
{smell}, AN' FROM INSIDE, {sound}.
DA FIFTH BOWL IZ DRY, AN' IT HAB BIN WASHED, AN' IT IZ DA ONLY ONE OF DA FIVE DAT HAB EVER BIN WASHED!
n0.emText:
FOUR BOWLS OF FRESH FOOD ON A ROOFLESS THRESHOLD, UNTOUCHED, AN' A FIFTH BOWL, EMPTY, WASHED, SET APART.
DA FIFTH IZ DA ONE DAT IZ BEING EATEN OUT OF. WHATEVER LIVES HERE HAB A DIET AN' IT IZ NO DA FOOD. YOU HAB OPINIONS 'BOUT BEINGS DAT TAKE SOMETINK OTHER DEN WHAT IZ OFFERED. YOU HAB BIN DA SOMETINK OTHER!
n0.bubba: "FOUR FULL, ONE EMPTY," SAYS BUBBA, COUNTIN' ON HIS FINGERS LIKE IT NEEDS COUNTIN'. "VIDE 'A CHESTA. SOMEBODY'S HUNGRY AN' IT AIN'T FOR RICE."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.hedonistic: {member} IZ EYEIN' DA FOOD, AN' IZ TOLD NO, FIRMLY, BY EVERYBODY!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PUT SOMETINK OF YA OWN IN DA EMPTY BOWL!
GO INSIDE.
EAT FROM ONE OF DA FOUR.
WAIT FOR WHOEVER BRINGS DA FOOD!

a.text:
WHATEVER YOU PUT IN IT IZ GONE BEFORE YOU HAB STRAIGHTENED UP, GONE DA WAY A WORD IZ GONE ONCE SAID.
DA FIFTH BOWL IZ CLEAN AGAIN. AN' ON DA STEP BESIDE IT DERE IZ NOW SOMETINK DAT WAZ NO DERE, PUT DOWN DA WAY YOU PUT DOWN CHANGE ON A COUNTER!

choices.text: TAKE IT.
PUT SOMETINK ELSE IN DA BOWL AN' SEE HOW LONG IT GOES ON!

b.text:
ROOFLESS, FLOORED IN GRASS, AN' AT DA FAR END A PLINTH WIT NUTTIN' ON IT AN' DA MARKS WHERE DA SOMETINK STOOD.
IT WAZ TAKEN OUT THROUGH DA WALL RATHER DEN DA DOOR: YOU CAN SEE WHERE DA STONE WAZ OPENED AN' PUT BACK, AN' PUT BACK BY SOMEBODY WHO COULD NO QUITE MATCH DA COURSES!

choices.text: OPEN DA WALL AGAIN.
STAND ON DA PLINTH.

asides.artistic: {member} FINDS PAINT IN DA SHELTER OF DA PLINTH: COLOURS NOBODY HAB BIN ABLE TA MAKE FOR A THOUSAND YEARS!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text:
IT IZ REAL GOOD AN' IT IZ REAL PLAIN AN' IT IZ WARM, AN' DA MOMENT IT IZ SWALLOWED EVERY BIRD WITHIN A MILE LEAVES AT ONCE.
WHAT COMES TA DA THRESHOLD IZ CONFUSED, AN' IT IZ LOOKIN' FOR DA FIFTH TINK, AN' IT IZ GOING TA KEEP LOOKIN' WIT ITS HANDS!

d.text:
IT IZ A BOY ON A MOPED WIT A CRATE ON DA BACK, AN' HE DOES DA FOUR BOWLS IN NINETY SECONDS AN' TAKES DA FIFTH ONE DOWN TA DA STREAM AN' WASHES IT AN' PUTS IT BACK.
"IT IZ A JOB," HE SAYS. "IT PAYS. ME AUNT DID IT. YOU WANT IT? ME IZ GOING TA {region} IN DA AUTUMN AN' SOMEBODY HAB TA."

choices.text: TAKE DA JOB FOR A SEASON.
ASK WHAT HAPPENS IF DA FIFTH BOWL IZ NO WASHED!

a1.text: IT IZ LIL' AN' HEAVY AN' IT IZ WARM ON ONE FACE, AN' IT HAB BIN GIVEN RATHER DEN FOUND, WHICH IZ A DISTINCTION DAT MATTERS ENORMOUSLY TA CERTAIN BUYERS AN' TA CERTAIN OTHER TINKZ!

a2.text:
ELEVEN TIMES. YOU PUT IN ELEVEN TINKZ, OF DECREASIN' VALUE, AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM IZ TAKEN, AN' ON DA ELEVENTH DA EXCHANGE STOPS BEING AN EXCHANGE.
WHAT IZ PUT DOWN ON DA STEP DA ELEVENTH TIME IZ A REQUEST, AN' IT IZ WRITTEN IN DA ONLY ALPHABET EVERYBODY UNDERSTANDS, WHICH IZ A MAP!

b1.text:
DA WALL COMES OUT IN FOUR COURSES AN' BEHIND IT DERE IZ A CAVITY WIT A WOODEN CRATE IN IT, BANDED, STAMPED WIT A FOUNDATION SEAL AN' A DATE, AN' NEVER COLLECTED.
WHOEVER TOOK DA TEMPLE'S GOD AWAY HID IT HERE TA COME BACK FOR AN' DID NO COME BACK!

b2.text:
YOU STAND WHERE A GOD STOOD AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS FOR 'BOUT NINETY SECONDS.
DEN DA ROOF IZ ON. ONLY FROM DA INSIDE, ONLY WHILE YOU IZ STANDIN' DERE, AN' IT IZ PAINTED, AN' IT IZ BEAUTIFUL, AN' DERE IZ FOUR HUNDRED PEOPLE IN DA NAVE WHO IZ EXTREMELY PLEASED TA SEE YOU AN' HAB BIN WAITIN' A LONG TIME AN' IZ REAL SORRY 'BOUT WHAT COMES NEXT!

d1.text:
FOUR BOWLS A DAY FOR A SEASON, AN' DA FIFTH WASHED IN DA STREAM, AN' BY DA THIRD WEEK YOU IZ DOING IT WITOUT THINKIN', AN' BY DA SIXTH YOU IZ TALKIN' TA IT.
ON DA LAST DAY OF DA SEASON IT ANSWERS, BRIEFLY, AN' GIVES YOU SOMETINK FOR YA TROUBLE, AN' DA BOY IN {region} GETS A LETTER 'BOUT IT DAT HE WILL NEVER SHOW ANYBODY!

d2.text:
"IT GOT MISSED IN DA BAD WINTER," HE SAYS. "DA BEST PART OF A WEEK. ME AUNT'S HANDS WAZ BAD."
WHAT HE DESCRIBES TOOK FOUR DAYS TA STOP AN' COST DA VILLAGE ITS ORCHARD, AN' HE SAYS IT IN DA TONE OF A BOY DESCRIBIN' A POWER CUT, AN' DEN HE GETS BACK ON DA MOPED AN' ASKS IF YOU WANT A LIFT DOWN!

b2_m.text:
STANDIN' WHERE A GOD STOOD AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS FOR 'BOUT A LONG MINUTE, AN' DEN DA ROOF IZ ON: ONLY FROM DA INSIDE, ONLY WHILE YOU IZ UP DERE, AN' IT IZ {A GOOD ROOF|BEAUTIFULLY MADE|NO A RUIN'S ROOF}.
FROM DA PLINTH DA TEMPLE IZ IN USE. DERE IZ PEOPLE IN IT, WIT DEY BACKS TA YOU, {FOUR|FIVE} OF DEM, AN' DEY IZ FACIN' DA DOOR AN' WAITIN' FOR SOMETINK TA COME IN!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{GET DOWN OFF DA PLINTH.|DEY IZ NO LOOKIN' AT YOU. TINK 'BOUT WHY.|WHATEVER DEY IZ WAITIN' FOR IZ BEHIND US.}"
asides.any: {member} {DOES NO TURN ROUND|COUNTS DA PEOPLE|STAYS EXACTLY WHERE DEY IZ}

choices.text: STEP DOWN. IT IZ A RUIN AN' IT STAYS A RUIN!
TURN AN' LOOK AT DA DOOR.
STAY UP DERE AN' WAIT WIT DEM!

b2_door.text:
TURNIN' ROUND ON A PLINTH IN A TEMPLE DAT HAB A ROOF ONLY WHILE YOU IZ STANDIN' ON IT IZ A DECISION DAT LASTS {MOST OF A MINUTE|A MINUTE AN' A HALF|'BOUT AS LONG AS IT TAKES}.
WHAT IZ IN DA DOORWAY IZ WAITIN' TA BE INVITED, AN' IT HAB BIN WAITIN' SINCE DA WALL WAZ OPENED, AN' EVERY FACE IN DA ROOM IZ TURNED TA IT AN' NONE OF DEM CAN GIVE DA INVITATION COZ NONE OF DEM IZ ON DA PLINTH!

b2_wait.text:
STANDIN' STILL ON A PLINTH, DOING NUTTIN', FOR AS LONG AS IT TAKES, IZ A DISCIPLINE RATHER DEN A TACTIC AN' IT TAKES {AN HOUR|A GREAT DEAL LONGER DEN NINETY SECONDS|MOST OF DA AFTERNOON}.
NUTTIN' COMES IN. AT DA END OF IT DA FOUR OF DEM TURN ROUND, ONE AT A TIME, AN' IZ SATISFIED, AN' DA ROOF GOES, AN' WHAT IZ LEFT ON DA PLINTH WHEN DA PARTY STEPS DOWN IZ DA TINK DAT WAZ TAKEN OFF IT WHEN DA WALL WAZ OPENED!

d1_m.text:
FOUR BOWLS A DAY FOR A SEASON, AN' DA FIFTH WASHED IN DA STREAM, AN' BY DA THIRD WEEK IT IZ BEING DONE WITOUT THINKIN'.
IN DA FIFTH WEEK DA BOY DOES NO COME, AN' DOES NO COME DA DAY AFTER, AN' DA CRATE ON DA BACK OF DA MOPED IZ AT DA BOTTOM OF DA LANE WIT DA MOPED ON ITS SIDE AN' NUTTIN' WRONG WIT EITHER OF DEM!

choices.text: DO DA BOWLS. DO DEM EVERY DAY. SAY NUTTIN'!
GO AN' FIND DA BOY.
PUT DA FIFTH BOWL OUT UNWASHED AN' SEE WHAT HAPPENS!

d1_boy.text:
HE IZ {FOUR HUNDRED METRES|UP DA LANE|NO FAR} AWAY, SITTIN' IN A FIELD, ENTIRELY UNHURT AN' ENTIRELY UNWILLIN' TA COME ANY CLOSER TA DA TEMPLE, AN' IT TAKES {AN HOUR|A LONG TIME|DA REST OF DA AFTERNOON} TA GET OUT OF HIM WHY.
WHAT HE SAW AT DA FIFTH BOWL IZ A SENTENCE LONG. DA PARTY FINISHES DA SEASON FOR HIM AN' HE TAKES IT BACK DA FOLLOWIN' SPRING, AN' DA BOWLS HAB NO BIN MISSED SINCE!

d1_late.text:
TWO DAYS OF LOOKIN' IN DA WRONG FIELDS, AN' DA BOWLS GO OUT LATE ON BOTH OF DEM, WHICH IZ {TWO DAYS|DA SAME AS DA BAD WINTER|EXACTLY AS LONG AS HIS AUNT'S HANDS}.
WHAT STARTS ON DA SECOND EVENIN' TAKES FOUR DAYS TA STOP AN' COSTS DA VILLAGE {A BARN|A BYRE AN' TWO BEASTS|MORE DEN ANYBODY WANTS TA TOTAL UP}, AN' DA PARTY IZ DERE FOR ALL OF IT, DOING DA BOWLS ON TIME, WHICH IZ ALL DAT CAN BE DONE BY DEN!

d1_dirty.text:
ONE UNWASHED BOWL, PUT OUT AT DA CORRECT HOUR ON DA CORRECT STEP, AS AN EXPERIMENT, BY PEOPLE WHO HAB BIN DOING DIS FOR FIVE WEEKS AN' TINK DEY UNDERSTAND IT.
IT IZ NO TOUCHED. NUTTIN' IN ANY OF DA FIVE BOWLS IZ TOUCHED DAT EVENIN' OR DA NEXT, AN' ON DA THIRD MORNIN' ALL FIVE IZ {STACKED|STACKED BY DA DOOR|PILED NEATLY} WIT DA UNWASHED ONE AT DA BOTTOM, AN' DA PARTY WASHES IT AN' STARTS AGAIN AN' IZ REAL CAREFUL FOR DA REST OF DA SEASON!

e_castle.title: {DA POSTERN|DA LIL' DOOR AT DA BACK|SOMEBODY USES DIS GATE}

n0.text:
DA CASTLE IZ A RUIN AN' A TICKET OFFICE AN' A CAR PARK, AN' ROUND DA BACK, BEHIND DA INTERPRETATION BOARDS, DERE IZ A POSTERN GATE DAT IZ NO ON DA PLAN ON DA BOARD.
IT IZ OILED. DA STEP IN FRONT OF IT IZ WORN AN' SWEPT. DERE IZ A BOOTSCRAPER.
DA MAIN GATE TAKES FOUR EUROS. DIS ONE TAKES SOMETINK ELSE.
DA POSTERN IZ ON DA INTERPRETATION BOARD AS {BLOCKED|INFILLED IN DA NINETEENTH CENTURY|LOST}, WIT A PHOTOGRAPH OF DA BLOCKIN'!
n0.emText:
A RUIN WIT A TICKET OFFICE AT DA FRONT AN', ROUND DA BACK BEHIND DA BOARDS, A POSTERN DAT IZ NO ON DA PLAN: OILED HINGES, SWEPT STEP, A BOOTSCRAPER.
DA CASTLE IZ A MUSEUM IN FRONT AN' SOMETINK ELSE BEHIND, DA WAY A PERSON IZ A NAME IN FRONT AN' A LOCKED ROOM BEHIND. YOU IZ EXTREMELY INTERESTED IN DOORS DAT IZ NO ON DA PLAN!
n0.bubba: BUBBA SCRAPES HIS BOOTS ON DA SCRAPER, OUT OF PURE POLITENESS, AN' DA DOOR OPENS AN INCH ON ITS OWN. "AOH. SUGAR. IT IZ GOT MANNERS TOO."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.mischievous: {member} {GRINS: "DIBS ON WHATEVER LOOKS SHINY AN' DANGEROUS."|IZ ALREADY TRYIN' TA PICK DA MAINTENANCE LOCK WIT A WIRE|WONDERS ALOUD WHAT HAPPENS IF WE PRESS ALL DA BUTTONS AT ONCE|SMIRKS AN' TAPS DA CONSOLE TA SEE IF IT SPARKS}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO THROUGH.
BUY A TICKET AN' ASK DA WOMAN IN DA OFFICE 'BOUT DA BACK GATE!
WAIT AN' SEE WHO USES IT.
KNOCK AN' WAIT TA BE RECEIVED!

a.text:
BEHIND DA POSTERN DA CASTLE IZ WHOLE.
DA STAIR IZ ROOFED. DA PASSAGE IZ SWEPT. DERE IZ GLASS IN DA WINDOWS AN' DERE IZ A SMELL OF WOODSMOKE AN' COOKIN', AN' FROM SOMEWHERE ABOVE DERE IZ DA SOUND OF A HOUSEHOLD DOING WHAT A HOUSEHOLD DOES AT DIS HOUR.
BEHIND YOU, DA DOOR YOU CAME THROUGH OPENS ONTO DA CAR PARK, AN' YOU CAN SEE YA OWN VEHICLE, AN' IT IZ RAININ' OUT DERE AN' DRY IN HERE!

choices.text: GO UP.
TAKE ONE TINK AN' GO BACK OUT!
ANNOUNCE YOURSELVES.

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
"DERE IZ NO GATE AT DA BACK," SHE SAYS, PLEASANTLY, AN' SELLS YOU FOUR TICKETS AN' A GUIDEBOOK.
DA GUIDEBOOK HAB A PLAN IN IT. DA PLAN HAB DA POSTERN ON IT, IN DA 1908 EDITION, PRINTED ON DA ENDPAPER, AN' SOMEBODY HAB BIN THROUGH DIS BOX OF GUIDEBOOKS WIT A SCALPEL AN' CUT DA ENDPAPER OUT OF ALL OF DEM BUT ONE!

choices.text: BUY DA UNCUT GUIDEBOOK.
ASK HER WHAT SHE IZ AFRAID OF!

c.text:
AT FOUR O'CLOCK A WOMAN COMES OUT OF DA POSTERN WIT A BASKET, SCRAPES HER BOOTS ON DA WAY OUT, LOCKS IT, AN' WALKS TA DA CAR PARK AN' DRIVES AWAY IN ONE OF DA ELEVEN CARS.
SHE IZ DRESSED FOR DIS DECADE. DA BASKET IZ NO FROM DIS DECADE, AN' NEITHER IZ WHAT IZ IN IT!

choices.text: FOLLOW HER.
GET TA DA DOOR BEFORE IT LOCKS!

d.text:
YOU KNOCK, MORE DEN ONCE, AN' STAND BACK, AN' TAKE YA HAT OFF IF YOU HAB ONE.
IT IZ ANSWERED IN 'BOUT A MINUTE BY A MAN OF 'BOUT SIXTY IN A CARDIGAN WHO LOOKS AT ALL OF YOU, AN' AT YA BOOTS, AN' SAYS: "YOU WOULD BETTER COME IN. YOU IZ DA FIRST ONES IN DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE WHO KNOCKED."

a1.text:
UPSTAIRS IZ A HOUSEHOLD: FOUR GENERATIONS, A FIRE, A TABLE BEING LAID, A WIRELESS PLAYIN' {radio}.
DEY IZ LIVIN' PEOPLE, AN' DISPLEASED. DIS IZ A HOME, AN' YOU HAB COME IN THROUGH DA BACK DOOR, AN' DA ELDEST OF DEM PUTS DOWN WHAT SHE IZ HOLDIN' AN' ASKS YOU, QUITE REASONABLY, WHAT YOU TINK YOU IZ DOING!

a2.text:
YOU TAKE DA NEAREST PORTABLE TINK OFF DA PASSAGE SHELF, WHICH IZ A LAMP, AN' YOU GO STRAIGHT BACK OUT INTO DA RAIN.
DA LAMP IZ WORTH A YEAR'S WAGES TA A COLLECTOR. IT ALSO BURNS WITOUT FUEL AN' NO CAN BE PUT OUT, AN' IT IZ A LAMP OUT OF A HOUSE WHERE PEOPLE LIVE, AN' ONE OF YOU IZ GOING TA HAB TA TINK 'BOUT DAT EVENTUALLY!

a3.text:
YOU CALL UP DA STAIR, LOUDLY, DAT DERE IZ FOUR OF YOU AN' YOU CAME IN BY DA BACK GATE AN' YOU IZ SORRY.
DERE IZ A LONG SILENCE AN' DEN SOMEBODY COMES DOWN WIT A LAMP, AN' LOOKS AT YOU, AN' SAYS DA YEAR, AN' ASKS YOU TA CONFIRM IT, AN' WHEN YOU DO DA WHOLE HOUSE COMES DOWN TA LOOK AT YOU.
YOU EAT WIT DEM. YOU IZ DA NEWS. DEY HAB NO HAB NEWS IN A LONG TIME!

b1.text:
SHE SELLS IT TA YOU FOR DA COVER PRICE, DEN GOES REAL QUIET AN' ASKS YOU NO TA OPEN IT IN DA CAR PARK.
DA ENDPAPER PLAN HAB DA POSTERN, THREE CELLARS DAT DA TOUR DOES NO GO TA, AN' A PENCILLED LINE IN A MODERN HAND JOININ' DA POSTERN TA A PLACE A LONG HAUL AWAY!

b2.text:
"LOSIN' DA JOB," SHE SAYS, FIRST, WHICH IZ HONEST. DEN, AFTER A MOMENT: "AN' DA FOUR O'CLOCK."
SHE HAB WORKED HERE NINETEEN YEARS. SHE HAB NEVER GONE ROUND DA BACK AFTER FOUR. SHE TELLS YOU WHY, AN' IT TAKES TEN MINUTES, AN' SHE CRIES ONCE AN' APOLOGISES FOR IT, AN' AT DA END SHE GIVES YOU DA SPARE KEY AN' ASKS YOU NO TA BRING IT BACK!

c1.text:
SHE DRIVES TA A SUPERMARKET IN {region} AN' SHOPS, AN' PAYS IN CASH, AN' DRIVES BACK, AN' IT IZ DA MOST ORDINARY TINK YOU HAB EVER FOLLOWED ANYBODY TA.
AT DA CAR PARK SHE TAKES DA BASKET OUT, LOOKS STRAIGHT AT WHERE YOU IZ PARKED, AN' HOLDS UP FOUR FINGERS, AN' WAITS.
SHE IZ TELLIN' YOU AN HOUR. SHE IZ INVITIN' YOU!

a2_m.text:
DA NEAREST PORTABLE TINK OFF DA PASSAGE SHELF IZ A LAMP, AN' IT COMES OFF DA SHELF {EASILY|WITOUT ARGUMENT|DA WAY ANYTINK DOES}, AN' DA RAIN IZ A COUPLE OF PACES AWAY.
BETWEEN DA SHELF AN' DA DOOR DERE IZ A MIRROR, AN' IN DA MIRROR DA PASSAGE IZ A RUIN: NO GLASS, NO SWEEPIN', {NO LAMP|NUTTIN' ON DA SHELF|NO SHELF}, AN' A PERSON STANDIN' IN DA RAIN HOLDIN' NUTTIN'!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{PUT IT BACK.|LOOK AT DA MIRROR AN' DEN LOOK AT YA HANDS.|WHATEVER DAT LAMP IZ, IT IZ NO A LAMP OUT DERE.}"
asides.any: {member} {LOOKS AT DA MIRROR TWICE|PUTS A HAND OUT INTO DA RAIN AN' TAKES IT BACK|HOLDS DA DOOR}

choices.text: TAKE IT OUT INTO DA RAIN AN' SEE!
PUT IT BACK ON DA SHELF EXACTLY WHERE IT WAZ!
TAKE DA MIRROR INSTEAD.

a2_back.text:
DA LAMP GOES BACK ON ITS OWN RING OF DUST, WHICH IZ {EXACT|DA SIZE OF DA BASE|DERE TA BE MATCHED}, AN' DA PARTY GOES OUT THROUGH DA POSTERN INTO DA RAIN WIT NUTTIN'.
DA GATE IZ SHUT BEHIND DEM BY SOMEBODY DEY DO NO SEE. IN DA CAR PARK DA WOMAN IN DA TICKET OFFICE WAVES, WHICH SHE DID NO DO ON DA WAY IN, AN' DA GUIDEBOOK SHE SELLS DEM AFTERWARDS IZ {DA UNCUT ONE|A DIFFERENT EDITION|NO DA ONE ON DA RACK}!

a2_mirror.text:
IT COMES OFF DA WALL IN ONE PIECE AN' IT IZ {HEAVIER DEN GLASS|A GOOD DEAL HEAVIER|NO GLASS}, AN' CARRYIN' IT OUT INTO DA RAIN IZ A TWO-PERSON JOB DONE AT SPEED.
IN DA CAR PARK IT SHOWS DA CAR PARK. IN DA HOTEL IT SHOWS DA ROOM. IN IT, AN' ONLY IN IT, DA POSTERN IZ OPEN, DAY AN' NIGHT, FROM ANY DISTANCE, AN' EVERYTINK DAT GOES THROUGH IT CAN BE COUNTED!

c1_m.text:
