SHE DRIVES TA A SUPERMARKET IN {region} AN' SHOPS, AN' PAYS IN CASH, AN' DRIVES BACK, AN' IT IZ DA MOST ORDINARY HOUR ANYBODY HAB SPENT IN WEEKS.
DA BASKET, GOING IN, WAZ EMPTY. DA BASKET COMIN' BACK OUT OF DA SUPERMARKET IZ FULL, AN' DA BASKET SHE CARRIED OUT OF DA POSTERN AT FOUR O'CLOCK WAZ ALSO FULL, AN' NUTTIN' WENT INTO DA CAR IN BETWEEN!

choices.text: FOLLOW HER BACK AN' WATCH DA POSTERN!
READ HER SHOPPIN'.
SPEAK TA HER IN DA CAR PARK!

c1_shop.text:
IT IZ A HOUSEHOLD'S WEEK: {FOUR|FIVE} OF EVERYTINK, BREAD, TEA, A JOINT OF MEAT, AN' WASHIN' POWDER, AN' IT IZ NO ONE WOMAN'S SHOPPIN' AN' SHE DOES NO LIVE AT DA CASTLE.
IT IZ ALSO, ITEM FOR ITEM, EXACTLY DA SAME SHOP EVERY WEEK, WHICH DA CHECKOUT GIRL CONFIRMS WITOUT BEING ASKED TWICE, AN' WHICH SHE HAB BIN DOING SINCE {BEFORE DA TICKET OFFICE OPENED|DA NINETEEN-SEVENTIES|A REAL LONG TIME}!

c1_talk.text:
SHE IZ NO SURPRISED TA BE SPOKEN TA AN' SHE DOES NO PRETEND NO TA KNOW WHAT 'BOUT, AN' WHAT SHE SAYS IN A SUPERMARKET CAR PARK IN DA RAIN TAKES {FOUR MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|NO TIME AT ALL}.
SHE IZ PAID. BY A FIRM OF SOLICITORS, MONTHLY, SINCE {1961|DA WAR|BEFORE SHE WAZ BORN, BY STANDIN' ORDER}, TA TAKE A BASKET THROUGH A GATE AT FOUR O'CLOCK, AN' SHE HAB NEVER ONCE BIN TOLD WHY AN' HAB NEVER ONCE BIN LATE!

e_city.title: {DA SHUTTERED DOOR|NUMBER ELEVEN IZ NO OPEN TODAY EITHER|DA SHOP DAT NEVER OPENS}

n0.text:
{ON {street}, WEDGED BETWEEN A PHONE REPAIR SHOP AN' A DRY CLEANER, DERE IZ A SHUTTERED STOREFRONT DAT HAB NEVER OPENED.
DA PROPERTY TAXES IZ PAID UP, DA STOOP GETS SWEPT EVERY MORNIN', BUT NOBODY HAB EVER SEEN DA DOOR UNLOCK.
TODAY DERE IZ A HANDWRITTEN NOTE TAPED TA DA METAL: BACK IN FOUR MINUTES.|A SHUTTERED SHOP ON {street} DAT HAB SAT CLOSED FOR YEARS AN' YEARS SUDDENLY HAB A CARDBOARD SIGN TAPED TA DA FRONT: BACK IN FOUR MINUTES. DA RATES IZ PAID, DA LIGHTS IZ ON UPSTAIRS, BUT DA PLACE LOOKS COMPLETELY SHUT DOWN.}
DA FOUR MINUTES IZ NO A RUMOUR: {THREE|FOUR} SHOPS ON DAT STREET SET DEY WATCHES BY IT!
n0.emText: {A SHUTTERED SHOP ON {street} DAT HAB SAT CLOSED FOR OVER A DECADE SUDDENLY HAB A SIGN: BACK IN FOUR MINUTES. DA TAXES IZ PAID, DA SIDEWALK IZ SWEPT, BUT NOBODY HAB EVER SEEN INSIDE. FOUR MINUTES IZ SUSPICIOUSLY SPECIFIC.|A PERMANENTLY CLOSED STOREFRONT ON {street} HAB A NOTE CLAIMIN' DEY WILL BE BACK IN FOUR MINUTES. {LOOKS LIKE|APPEARS TA BE|SEEMS LIKE|CLEARLY} A SETUP OR A REAL WEIRD ROUTINE.}
n0.bubba: BUBBA READS DA CARD TWICE. "A COUPLE OF MINUTES. SINCE WHEN? AOH. CHESTA E' 'NA PROMESSA, NUN E' 'NU CARTELLO."

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.mischievous: {member} {GRINS: "DIBS ON WHATEVER LOOKS SHINY AN' DANGEROUS."|IZ ALREADY TRYIN' TA PICK DA MAINTENANCE LOCK WIT A WIRE|WONDERS ALOUD WHAT HAPPENS IF WE PRESS ALL DA BUTTONS AT ONCE|SMIRKS AN' TAPS DA CONSOLE TA SEE IF IT SPARKS}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WAIT EXACTLY A COUPLE OF MINUTES!
LIFT DA SHUTTER.
GO ROUND DA BACK AN' UP TA DA LIT WINDOW!
ASK DA STREET 'BOUT IT PROPERLY, SHOP BY SHOP!

a.text:
AT THREE MINUTES FIFTY DA SHUTTER GOES UP FROM DA INSIDE, IN ONE MOVEMENT, AN' STAYS UP.
BEHIND IT: A SHOP, FULLY STOCKED, LIT, WARM, WIT A TILL AN' A COUNTER AN' A MAN BEHIND DA COUNTER IN A SHOP COAT, AN' DA STOCK IZ OF A KIND DAT HAB NO BIN SOLD IN EUROPE SINCE BEFORE ANY OF YOU WAZ BORN, AN' ALL OF IT IZ NEW.
"SORRY 'BOUT DAT," HE SAYS. "ME WAZ AT DA BANK."

choices.text: BUY SOMETINK.
ASK WHICH BANK.
ASK HIM WHAT YEAR HE THINKS IT IZ!

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
IT GOES UP EASILY AN' BEHIND IT DERE IZ BRICK: A WALL, MORTARED, OLD, WIT DA SHOP'S OWN FITTINGS EMBEDDED IN IT AS IF DA BUILDIN' HAB BIN POURED ROUND DEM.
DA CARD FALLS OFF. ON DA BACK OF IT, IN DA SAME HAND: TOLD YOU. A COUPLE OF MINUTES!

choices.text: PUT DA SHUTTER DOWN AN' WAIT DA FOUR MINUTES!
TAKE DA BRICK OUT.

c.text:
DA STAIR AT DA BACK GOES UP TA A LANDIN' AN' A DOOR WIT DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE OF POST ON DA MAT, ALL OF IT ADDRESSED TA A BUSINESS, AN' A LIGHT ON BEHIND FROSTED GLASS.
DA LIGHT IZ A BULB IN A ROOM WIT NUTTIN' IN IT BUT DA BULB, AN' DA BULB IZ NO WIRED TA ANYTINK!

choices.text: TAKE DA POST.
TAKE DA BULB.

d.text:
ELEVEN SHOPS, ELEVEN VERSIONS. DA ZIP WOMAN HAB SEEN DA SWEEPER: AN OLD MAN, FIVE IN DA MORNIN'. DA PHONE SHOP LAD HAB SEEN DA BIN GO OUT AN' SWEARS DA HAND DAT PUT IT OUT CAME FROM INSIDE A WALL.
DA KEBAB SHOP AT DA CORNER HAB DA BEST STORY, AN' DA BEST STORY COMES WIT A PHOTOGRAPH, AN' DA PHOTOGRAPH IZ OF DA SHOP OPEN, WIT A QUEUE OUTSIDE IT, DATED FOUR YEARS AGO AT THREE IN DA MORNIN'!

a1.text:
YOU BUY WHATEVER IZ NEAREST AN' PAY IN EUROS, AN' HE TAKES DEM WITOUT COMMENT AN' GIVES YOU CHANGE IN A CURRENCY DAT HAB NO EXISTED IN YA LIFETIME, AN' DA CHANGE IZ WORTH 'BOUT FOUR HUNDRED TIMES WHAT YOU SPENT.
DA TINK YOU BOUGHT WORKS PERFECTLY. IT WILL STILL WORK PERFECTLY IN FIFTY YEARS!

a2.text:
HE TELLS YOU WHICH BANK, AN' WHERE IT IZ, AN' IT IZ FOUR STREETS AWAY AN' IT HAB BIN A CAR PARK SINCE 1988.
YOU GO. DERE IZ A DOOR IN DA CAR PARK'S STAIRWELL DAT IZ NO ON DA FIRE PLAN. HE WAZ NO LYING. HE IZ NEVER GOING TA BE LYING 'BOUT ANYTINK!

a3.text:
HE TELLS YOU A YEAR, CHEERFULLY, AN' IT IZ NO DIS ONE, AN' DEN HE SEES YA FACE.
HE PUTS DOWN WHAT HE IZ HOLDIN', AN' HE GOES AN' LOOKS OUT THROUGH HIS OWN DOORWAY AT {street} FOR A LONG MOMENT, AT DA PHONE SHOP AN' DA TRAFFIC AN' DA CLOTHES, AN' HE SAYS, QUIETLY: "AH."
HE ASKS YOU TA STAY WHILE HE SHUTS UP PROPERLY. IT TAKES AN HOUR. HE GIVES YOU DA TILL AN' DA STOCK GRIMORIE AN' DA KEYS AN' ASKS YOU TA LOCK IT AFTER HIM, AN' DEN HE GOES OUT THROUGH DA BACK AN' DOES NO COME BACK!

b1.text: FOUR COURSES IN, DA BRICK STOPS BEING BRICK AN' BECOMES SHELVIN', AN' DERE IZ SHOP BEHIND IT, AN' DERE IZ SOMEBODY IN DA SHOP WHO HAB BIN WALLED IN FOR A REAL LONG TIME AN' WHO IZ NO, AT DIS POINT, ESPECIALLY GLAD TA SEE ANYBODY!

c1.text:
ELEVEN YEARS OF A BUSINESS'S POST: BANK STATEMENTS FOR AN ACCOUNT DAT HAB BIN GROWIN', FOUR COURT LETTERS, AN' A HAND-ADDRESSED ENVELOPE EVERY FEBRUARY FROM DA SAME PERSON IN {region}.
DA FEBRUARY LETTERS IZ DA INTERESTIN' ONES. SOMEBODY HAB BIN WRITIN' TA DIS SHOP FOR ELEVEN YEARS AN' NEVER ONCE BIN ANSWERED!

c2.text:
YOU UNSCREW A BULB DAT IZ NO WIRED TA ANYTINK AN' IT GOES OUT AN' DA WHOLE BUILDIN' DROPS 'BOUT FOUR DEGREES.
DOWNSTAIRS, DA SHUTTER GOES UP, AN' STAYS UP, AN' IT IZ A SHOP, AN' IT IZ EMPTY, AN' IT HAB BIN EMPTY SINCE DA EIGHTIES, AN' A WOMAN FROM DA ESTATE AGENT'S IZ AT YA ELBOW WITHIN A MINUTE ASKIN' IF YOU IZ HERE 'BOUT DA VIEWIN'!

a1_m.text:
YOU BUY WHATEVER IZ NEAREST AN' PAY IN EUROS, AN' HE TAKES DEM WITOUT COMMENT AN' GIVES YOU CHANGE IN A CURRENCY DAT HAB NO EXISTED FOR {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE|A LONG TIME|DECADES}.
DA CHANGE IZ WARM. HE ALSO, WITOUT BEING ASKED, PUTS DA ITEM IN A BAG AN' WRITES DA DATE ON DA BAG IN PENCIL, AN' DA DATE IZ {TODAY'S|CORRECT|DIS ONE}, WHICH DOES NO FIT ANYTINK ELSE IN DA SHOP!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{HE KNOWS WHAT YEAR IT IZ OUT HERE.|HE WROTE TODAY ON DAT BAG.|HE IZ OPEN FOR BUSINESS.}"
asides.any: {member} {READS DA BAG TWICE|LOOKS AT DA CHANGE UNDER DA LIGHT|SAYS THANK YOU}

choices.text: TAKE DA BAG AN' GET OUT BEFORE DA FOUR MINUTES IZ UP!
ASK HIM WHAT DA DATE ON DA BAG IZ FOR!
BUY EVERYTINK ON DA COUNTER!

a1_date.text:
IT IZ FOR DA RETURNS POLICY. FOURTEEN DAYS, HE SAYS, WIT DA RECEIPT, AN' HE SAYS IT IN DA TONE OF A MAN WHO HAB SAID IT {TEN THOUSAND TIMES|HIS WHOLE WORKIN' LIFE|EVERY DAY SINCE DA SHOP OPENED}.
WHICH MEANS SOMEBODY COMES BACK. WHICH MEANS DA FOUR MINUTES IZ {OPENIN' HOURS|A SHIFT|A TRADIN' WINDOW}, AN' DA PARTY IZ DA FIRST CUSTOMER IN {ELEVEN YEARS|A LONG TIME|AS LONG AS DA SHUTTER HAB BIN DOWN} TA ASK 'BOUT DA TERMS!

a1_all.text:
EVERYTINK ON DA COUNTER, AT DA MARKED PRICES, PAID IN EUROS, WIT {A COUPLE OF MINUTES|NO LONG} TA GO AN' EVERYBODY CARRYIN'.
DA SHUTTER COMES DOWN AT FOUR MINUTES EXACTLY ON DA PARTY'S HEELS. WHAT IZ IN DA BAGS IZ WORTH {A GREAT DEAL|FAR MORE DEN WAZ PAID|A SEASON'S MONEY} TA FOUR SEPARATE KINDS OF BUYER, AN' ONE OF DA ITEMS HAB A SERIAL NUMBER ON IT DAT IZ GOING TA CAUSE TROUBLE!

c1_m.text:
DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE OF A BUSINESS'S POST ON A LANDIN' MAT: BANK STATEMENTS FOR AN ACCOUNT DAT HAB BIN GROWIN', FOUR COURT LETTERS, AN' A HAND-ADDRESSED ENVELOPE DAT IZ NO LIKE DA OTHERS.
DA HAND-ADDRESSED ONE IZ {DIS YEAR'S|RECENT|POSTMARKED LAST MONTH} AN' DERE IZ NO STAMP ON IT, WHICH MEANS IT WAZ PUT THROUGH DAT DOOR BY SOMEBODY STANDIN' ON DIS LANDIN'!

choices.text: TAKE DA LOT AN' READ IT SOMEWHERE ELSE!
OPEN DA HAND-ADDRESSED ONE HERE!
READ DA BANK STATEMENTS PROPERLY!

c1_hand.text:
ONE SHEET, NO SIGNATURE, FOUR LINES, AN' DA FOUR LINES IZ ADDRESSED TA WHOEVER IZ STANDIN' ON DA LANDIN' RATHER DEN TA DA BUSINESS.
DEY IZ ALSO INSTRUCTIONS, AN' DEY IZ COURTEOUS, AN' DEY CONCERN DA BULB. DA PARTY FOLLOWS DEM OR DOES NO; EITHER WAY, DA LANDIN' IZ A DIFFERENT PLACE AFTER READIN' DEM AN' NOBODY SUGGESTS STAYIN' ON IT!

c1_bank.text:
DA ACCOUNT HAB BIN RECEIVIN' {DA SAME AMOUNT|A STANDIN' ORDER|ONE PAYMENT} EVERY MONTH FOR ELEVEN YEARS FROM A COMPANY DAT DOES NO TRADE, AN' PAYIN' OUT ONE BILL: {DA ELECTRICITY|POWER|DA SUPPLY} FOR DIS BUILDIN'.
SOMEBODY IZ PAYIN', BY STANDIN' ORDER, TA KEEP ONE BULB BURNIN' ON A LANDIN' ABOVE A SHOP DAT HAB BIN BRICKED UP. DA COMPANY'S REGISTERED ADDRESS IZ {FOUR STREETS|DA NEXT STREET|CLOSE}!

e_docks.title: {DA IMPOUND|NOBODY HAB CLAIMED IT IN ELEVEN YEARS|BERTH FOUR}

n0.text:
AT DA FAR END OF DA IMPOUND, PAST DA FISHIN' BOATS WIT DA TAX OWING, DERE IZ A VESSEL WIT NO NAME, NO PORT OF REGISTRY AN' NO RUST.
DA HARBOUR OFFICE HAB IT ON DA BOOKS AS UNCLAIMED SINCE {timeAgo}. NOBODY HAB BIN ABOARD. DA FENDERS IZ NEW, AN' SOMEBODY REPLACES DEM, AN' DA HARBOURMASTER WILL TELL YOU STRAIGHT OUT DAT IT IZ NO HIM.
DERE IZ A GANGWAY. IT IZ DOWN.
SHE IZ ON {ELEVEN|NINE} FENDERS AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM IZ NEW!
n0.emText:
AN UNCLAIMED BOAT AT DA END OF DA IMPOUND WIT NO NAME, NO REGISTRY AN' NO RUST, ELEVEN YEARS ON DA BOOKS, AN' SOMEBODY REPLACIN' DA FENDERS.
DA GANGWAY IZ DOWN. TINKZ WIT NO NAME AN' NO PAPERS DAT NOBODY WILL CLAIM: YOU HAB A PROFESSIONAL INTEREST. YOU IZ ONE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA WALKS DA LENGTH OF HER AN' WHISTLES. "NO RUST. AOH. YEARS AN' YEARS IN SALT WATER AN' NO RUST. CHESTA NUN E' 'NA VARCA, SUGAR."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO ABOARD.
BUY HER AT DA UNCLAIMED SALE!
WATCH DA BERTH OVERNIGHT.
CUT HER LOOSE AN' SEE WHAT HAPPENS!

a.text:
BELOW DECKS SHE IZ DRY, WARM, AN' STOCKED: CHARTS, TINNED FOOD, BUNKS MADE UP, A STOVE LAID READY AN' NO LIT.
DA CHART ON DA TABLE IZ OF DIS HARBOUR, AN' DERE IZ A COURSE PENCILLED OFF IT, AN' DA COURSE LEAVES IN 'BOUT A COUPLE OF HOURS ON A TIDE DAT IZ NO DA TIDE TODAY!

choices.text: WAIT FOUR HOURS AN' SEE.
TAKE DA CHARTS AN' GO.
LIGHT DA STOVE.

b.text:
DA UNCLAIMED SALE IZ A MAN IN AN OFFICE WIT A FORM AN' A RUBBER STAMP, AN' DA PRICE IZ NUTTIN', COZ NOBODY WANTS A BOAT WIT NO PAPERS.
HE FILLS IN DA FORM. HE GETS TA DA FIELD MARKED VESSEL NAME AN' STOPS, AN' SITS BACK, AN' SAYS: "EVERY ELEVEN YEARS SOMEBODY BUYS HER. EVERY ELEVEN YEARS DA FORM COMES BACK FROM DA REGISTRY BLANK."

choices.text: BUY HER ANYWAY AN' NAME HER YOURSELF!
ASK TA SEE DA ELEVEN PREVIOUS FORMS!

c.text:
AT 'BOUT THREE IN DA MORNIN' SOMEBODY COMES DOWN DA QUAY WIT A BAG OF FENDERS AN' A SPLICIN' KIT, AN' DOES AN HOUR'S CAREFUL WORK, AN' DOES NO GO ABOARD.
WHEN DEY HAB FINISHED DEY STAND AT DA FOOT OF DA GANGWAY FOR A WHILE, DA WAY PEOPLE STAND OUTSIDE A HOUSE DEY USED TA LIVE IN, AN' DEN DEY GO!

choices.text: FOLLOW DEM.
SPEAK TA DEM DERE, ON DA QUAY!

d.text:
SHE GOES OUT ON DA EBB, SLOWLY, WIT NOBODY ABOARD, AN' TURNS AT DA HARBOUR MOUTH, CORRECTLY, DA WAY A VESSEL TURNS UNDER HELM.
DEN SHE COMES BACK. SHE COMES BACK TA BERTH FOUR AN' PUTS HERSELF ALONGSIDE, AN' DA MOORIN' LINES GO OVER DA BOLLARDS WITOUT ANYBODY THROWIN' DEM, AN' DA HARBOURMASTER IZ STANDIN' NEXT TA YOU BY DEN AN' NEITHER OF YOU SAYS ANYTINK FOR A WHILE!

a1.text:
FOUR HOURS. DA TIDE DOES WHAT DA ALMANAC SAYS IT WILL DO AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS.
AT ONE MINUTE PAST, DA STOVE LIGHTS ITSELF, AN' DA COMPASS SWINGS, AN' DA BOAT IZ UNDER WAY IN A HARBOUR DAT HAB NO MOVED, AN' OUT OF DA PORTHOLE DA QUAY IZ DERE AN' GOING PAST.
YOU IZ AT SEA FOR DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR AN' BACK ALONGSIDE WIT WHAT SHE WENT OUT TA FETCH!

a2.text:
CHARTS OF FOUR COASTS WIT SOUNDINGS DAT IZ NO IN ANY SURVEY AN' A PENCILLED COURSE BETWEEN DEM DAT TOUCHES AT ELEVEN PLACES.
DEY IZ WORTH MONEY TA A FISHIN' FLEET AN' A FORTUNE TA DA FOUNDATION, AN' ONE OF DA ELEVEN PLACES IZ SOMEWHERE YOU IZ GOING TA WANT TA GO!

a3.text:
IT LIGHTS FIRST TIME ON A MATCH, ON A STOVE DAT HAB NO BIN LIT IN YEARS AN' YEARS, AN' DA CABIN FILLS WIT DA SMELL OF SOMEBODY ELSE'S DINNER.
ALL FOUR OF YOU EAT ABOARD A BOAT NOBODY OWNS. IT IZ DA BEST MEAL OF DA MONTH AN' EVERYBODY SLEEPS ABOARD AN' NOBODY DREAMS, AN' IN DA MORNIN' DA BUNKS IZ MADE AN' DA STOVE IZ COLD AN' LAID READY AGAIN!

b1.text:
YOU NAME HER OUT LOUD ON DA QUAY WIT DA FORM ON DA BONNET OF A CAR, AN' DA MAN FROM DA OFFICE WRITES IT IN, AN' DA REGISTRY, DA BETTER PART OF A SEASON LATER, SENDS DA PAPERS BACK COMPLETE.
NOBODY CAN EXPLAIN DAT. HE FRAMES HIS COPY. YOU HAB A BOAT!

b2.text:
ELEVEN FORMS IN A FOLDER, EACH WIT A BUYER, EACH WIT A BLANK NAME FIELD, AN' DA ELEVENTH BUYER IZ A WOMAN WHO IZ STILL ALIVE AN' STILL IN DIS TOWN AN' HAB NEVER ONCE MENTIONED IT TA ANYBODY.
SHE IZ DELIGHTED TA BE ASKED. SHE HAB BIN WAITIN' ELEVEN YEARS FOR SOMEBODY TA ASK!

c1.text:
DEY WALK TWO MILES TA A HOUSE ON DA HILL WIT A LIGHT ON IN ONE WINDOW AN' A HOSPITAL BED VISIBLE THROUGH IT.
DA FENDERS IZ FOR HER FATHER. HE WAZ MASTER OF DAT BOAT. HE HAB NO SPOKEN FOR A FEW YEARS AN' EVERY TIME DA FENDERS IZ CHANGED HE SQUEEZES HER HAND!

c2.text:
SHE HAB BIN HALF HOPIN' SOMEBODY WOULD BE DERE.
WHAT SHE GIVES YOU, AT THREE IN DA MORNIN' ON A QUAY, IZ DA KEY TA A LOCKER ABOARD DAT NOBODY ELSE HAB EVER OPENED, AN' DA NAME OF DA BOAT, WHICH SHE ASKS YOU TA SAY OUT LOUD WHEN YOU IZ ABOARD, COZ SHE NO CAN BRING HERSELF TA!

a2_m.text:
CHARTS OF FOUR COASTS WIT SOUNDINGS DAT IZ NO IN ANY SURVEY AN' A PENCILLED COURSE BETWEEN DEM DAT TOUCHES AT ELEVEN PLACES.
DA ELEVEN PLACES IZ NO PORTS. FOUR OF DEM IZ OPEN WATER, AN' ONE OF DEM IZ {DIS BERTH|WHERE DA PARTY IZ STANDIN'|DA IMPOUND}, AN' DA PENCIL MARK AT DAT ONE IZ {FRESH|NEWER DEN DA REST|DIS YEAR'S}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SHE IZ ON A RUN AN' DIS IZ A STOP ON IT.|SOMEBODY PENCILLED US IN.|ELEVEN MARKS. FOUR OF DEM IN OPEN WATER.}"
asides.any: {member} {LAYS DA CHARTS OUT IN ORDER|MEASURES DA LEGS|CHECKS DA DATES IN DA MARGIN}

choices.text: ROLL DEM UP AN' TAKE DEM.
WORK OUT WHAT IZ AT DA FOUR OPEN-WATER MARKS!
LEAVE DA CHARTS AN' TAKE DA ALMANAC INSTEAD!

a2_open.text:
THREE OF DEM IZ OVER {DEEPS|CHARTED DEEPS|NUTTIN' AT ALL}. DA FOURTH IZ OVER A BANK DAT IZ {FOUR FATHOMS|SHALLOW|NO DEEP}, AN' DA BANK IZ NO ON DA MODERN SURVEY AN' IZ ON A CHART FROM {1903|BEFORE DA WAR|A LONG TIME AGO}, AN' ON DAT CHART IT HAB A NAME.
DA NAME IZ DA NAME DAT IZ NO PAINTED ON DIS BOAT'S BOW, AN' DA PARTY IZ DA FIRST CREW IN {YEARS AN' YEARS|A LONG WHILE|A REAL LONG TIME} TA HAB BOTH HALVES OF DAT!

a2_alm.text:
DA ALMANAC IZ DIS YEAR'S, WHICH IZ DA STRANGEST TINK ON DA BOAT: SOMEBODY BUYS HER A NEW ONE EVERY JANUARY AN' WORKS DA TIDES IN IT IN PENCIL, {A MONTH AHEAD|IN ADVANCE|RIGHT THROUGH TA DECEMBER}.
DA WORKINGS IZ CORRECT AN' DEY IZ IN A HAND DAT CHANGES, OVER DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE, FROM A YOUNG HAND TA AN OLD ONE. DA PARTY TAKES IT, LEAVES DA CHARTS, AN' DA BOAT IZ STILL IN DA IMPOUND DA NEXT TIME ANYBODY PASSES!

b1_m.text:
YOU NAME HER OUT LOUD ON DA QUAY WIT DA FORM ON DA BONNET OF A CAR, AN' DA MAN FROM DA OFFICE WRITES IT IN, AN' DA REGISTRY HAB A BOAT IN IT DAT IT DID NO HAB DIS MORNIN'.
HE DEN TURNS DA FOLDER ROUND AN' SHOWS DA PARTY SOMETINK HE HAB CLEARLY DECIDED IN DA LAST {A BREATH OR TWO|MOMENT|MINUTE} TA SHOW DEM: DA ELEVEN PREVIOUS FORMS, ALL WIT DA NAME FIELD BLANK, AN' ELEVEN BUYERS, AN' A COLUMN HE HAB NO FILLED IN FOR ANY OF DEM!

choices.text: DO NO LOOK AT DA COLUMN. TAKE DA KEYS!
READ DA COLUMN.
ASK WHY HE IZ SHOWIN' YOU!

b1_col.text:
DA COLUMN IZ HEADED {DISPOSAL|OUTCOME|CLOSED} AN' IT IZ BLANK COZ NONE OF DA ELEVEN WAZ EVER DISPOSED OF: DA BOAT CAME BACK INTO DA IMPOUND {ELEVEN TIMES|EVERY TIME|EACH TIME}, UNCLAIMED, WIT NO NAME ON DA BOW AN' DA FENDERS NEW.
HE HAB BIN DOING DA PAPERWORK ON DA SAME VESSEL FOR {NINETEEN YEARS|TWO DECADES|MOST OF HIS WORKIN' LIFE} AN' HAB NEVER ONCE BIN ABLE TA WRITE IN DAT COLUMN, AN' TODAY, COZ SOMEBODY NAMED HER, HE CAN!

b1_why.text:
COZ DA PARTY IZ DA FIRST BUYER WHO SAID A NAME OUT LOUD ON DA QUAY RATHER DEN WRITIN' ONE ON DA FORM, WHICH HE SAYS AS THOUGH IT WAZ OBVIOUS AN' WHICH HE HAB EVIDENTLY BIN WAITIN' {YEARS|A REAL LONG TIME|HIS WHOLE CAREER} FOR SOMEBODY TA DO.
HE GIVES DEM DA FOLDER. ALL ELEVEN FORMS. IT IZ NO HIS TA GIVE AN' HE GIVES IT ANYWAY AN' GOES BACK INTO DA OFFICE AN' SHUTS DA DOOR!

e_road.title: {DA WAYSIDE SHRINE|SOMEBODY KEEPS DA FLOWERS FRESH|A SHORT DRIVE FROM ANYWHERE}

n0.text:
A SHRINE AT DA ROADSIDE: A NICHE, A PHOTOGRAPH BEHIND GLASS, PLASTIC FLOWERS AN' REAL ONES, AN' A CANDLE IN A JAR WIT A LID ON SO DA WIND NO CAN HAB IT.
DA REAL FLOWERS IZ FRESH. DA ROAD HERE IZ STRAIGHT, SIGHTED, WIDE AN' DRY, AN' DERE IZ NO REASON ON EARTH FOR ANYBODY TA HAB DIED ON IT, AN' DA DATES ON DA PLAQUE IZ FOUR.
FOUR, AT DA SAME SPOT, OVER DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE.
DA PLAQUE HAB THREE NAMES ON IT AN' ROOM CUT FOR {A FOURTH|MORE|ONE MORE}!
n0.emText:
A ROADSIDE SHRINE WIT FRESH FLOWERS, ON A STRAIGHT DRY SIGHTED ROAD WHERE DERE IZ NO REASON FOR ANYBODY TA HAB COME OFF, AN' FOUR DATES ON DA PLAQUE OVER DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE.
DA ROAD IZ NO DA PROBLEM. SOMETINK AT DIS EXACT SPOT TAKES ONE PERSON EVERY SO OFTEN, AN' SOMEBODY LOCAL KNOWS DA INTERVAL WELL ENOUGH TA KEEP DA FLOWERS GOING!
n0.bubba: BUBBA COUNTS DA DATES. "FOUR. AN' DEY'S ALL IN DA SAME MONTH, SUGAR. GUARDA CCÀ. STESSO MESE."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.melancholic: {member} READS DA PHOTOGRAPH RATHER DEN DA PLAQUE AN' STAYS DERE A WHILE!
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WAIT FOR WHOEVER BRINGS DA FLOWERS!
WALK DA HUNDRED METRES SLOWLY, LOOKIN' AT EVERYTINK!
DRIVE IT. FAST.
LIGHT DA CANDLE AN' SAY SOMETINK!

a.text:
SHE COMES ON FOOT FROM A FARM TRACK WIT FLOWERS OUT OF HER OWN GARDEN AN' A CLOTH TA DO DA GLASS.
SHE HAB DONE IT FOR YEARS AN' YEARS AN' SHE WAZ NO RELATED TA ANY OF DA FOUR. "YOU KEEP IT LIT," SHE SAYS, "AN' IT STAYS FOUR."

choices.text: ASK WHAT HAPPENS IF IT GOES OUT!
ASK 'BOUT DA FOURTH ONE.

b.text:
A HUNDRED METRES OF CLEAN TARMAC, AN' AT 'BOUT SIXTY DERE IZ A PLACE WHERE DA ROAD NOISE UNDER YA BOOTS CHANGES, AN' DERE IZ A SMELL OF {smell}, AN' EVERY ONE OF YOU FEELS DA PULL OF IT: DA EXACT, SPECIFIC DESIRE TA BE ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DA ROAD.
IT IZ FOUR METRES ACROSS. IT IZ NO VISIBLE. FOUR PEOPLE HAB DRIVEN INTO IT AT SPEED!

choices.text: STAND IN IT.
MARK IT, PROPERLY, WIT PAINT AN' POSTS!

c.text:
YOU GET TA 'BOUT NINETY AN' AT SIXTY METRES PAST DA SHRINE DA WHEEL GOES LIGHT, AN' DA ROAD IZ ON DA WRONG SIDE, AN' EVERYBODY IN DA VEHICLE SEES A DIFFERENT TINK STANDIN' AT DA VERGE.
SOMEBODY'S HANDS IZ ON DA WHEEL AN' DEY IZ NO DA DRIVER'S HANDS, AN' WHETHER YOU COME OUT OF IT IZ DECIDED IN 'BOUT A SECOND AN' A HALF!

d.text:
YOU LIGHT A CANDLE AT A ROADSIDE SHRINE AN' SAY A NAME OUT LOUD, WHICH IZ ALL ANYBODY HAB EVER WANTED DONE AT ANY SHRINE ANYWHERE.
DA PULL AT DA FAR END OF IT IZ GONE BY DA TIME YOU GET BACK IN DA VEHICLE. IT COMES BACK WITHIN DA WEEK; DA WOMAN WIT DA FLOWERS TELLS YOU AS MUCH, LATER, WIT NO DRAMA AT ALL.
BUT DIS WEEK, ON DIS ROAD, NOBODY IZ GOING TA BE NUMBER FIVE!

a1.text:
"IT WENT OUT IN DA BAD WINTER," SHE SAYS, "AN' DAT IZ NUMBER FOUR."
SHE HAB KEPT IT GOING THROUGH WEATHER, ILLNESS AN' A HOSPITAL STAY SHE DISCHARGED HERSELF FROM. SHE IZ SEVENTY-EIGHT. SHE WOULD LIKE, REAL MUCH, TA BE ABLE TA STOP, AN' SHE NO CAN SEE A WAY TA!

choices.text: TAKE DA SHRINE ON.
FIND OUT WHAT IZ ACTUALLY AT DA FAR END OF IT!

a2.text:
"NUMBER FOUR WAZ DA MAN WHO PUT DA PLAQUE UP FOR DA FIRST THREE," SHE SAYS.
HE HAB WORKED OUT DA INTERVAL. HE HAB COME OUT TA BE HERE ON DA DAY, WIT A CAMERA, TA SEE IT. SHE HAB DA CAMERA. SHE HAB NEVER HAB DA FILM DEVELOPED AN' SHE GIVES IT TA YOU AN' ASKS YOU TA DO IT SOMEWHERE FAR AWAY FROM HERE!

b1.text:
FOUR METRES OF ROAD WHERE DA LIGHT IZ REAL SLIGHTLY ON A DELAY.
STANDIN' IN IT, YOU CAN SEE DA ROAD AS IT WAZ: UNMETALLED, A TRACK, AN' A CROWD ON IT, AN' SOMETINK BEING BROUGHT ALONG IT AT WALKIN' PACE WIT EVERYBODY FOLLOWIN'.
WHEN YOU STEP OUT YOU IZ HOLDIN' SOMETINK DAT WAZ PRESSED INTO YA HAND BY SOMEBODY IN DAT CROWD!

b2.text:
FOUR POSTS, A CAN OF PAINT, AN' TWO HOURS' WORK, AN' ANY DRIVER ON DAT ROAD NOW HAB A REASON TA LIFT OFF.
DA COUNCIL TAKE DA POSTS OUT IN DA SPRING. BY DEN DA COUNTY SURVEYOR HAB BIN OUT TA SEE WHY SOMEBODY MARKED IT, AN' HAB STOOD AT DA FAR END OF IT HIMSELF, AN' HAB PUT IN A REQUEST FOR A BEND!

a1a.text:
IT IZ FLOWERS, A CLOTH, AN' A CANDLE, ONCE A WEEK, A FEW KILOMETRES FROM ANYWHERE, FOR AS LONG AS YOU IZ IN DIS COUNTRY.
SHE SHOWS YOU HOW DA JAR GOES SO DA WIND NO CAN HAB IT, AN' HOW DA GLASS IZ DONE, AN' SHE CRIES WHEN YOU TAKE DA CLOTH OFF HER, AN' SHE IZ DEAD WITHIN DA YEAR AN' DA SHRINE HAB FIVE NAMES ON IT AN' NONE OF DEM IZ NEW!

c_m.text:
NINETY ON A CLEAN STRAIGHT WIT DA SHRINE COMIN' UP ON DA LEFT, AN' AT SIXTY METRES PAST IT DA WHEEL GOES LIGHT AN' DA ROAD IZ ON DA WRONG SIDE.
IT LASTS {FOUR SECONDS|'BOUT FOUR SECONDS|NO TIME}. EVERYBODY IZ STILL IN DA VEHICLE, IT IZ STILL ON DA TARMAC, AN' IT IZ NOW STOPPED, SIDEWAYS, {A HUNDRED METRES|SOME WAY|WELL} PAST DA SHRINE WIT DA ENGINE RUNNIN'!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DO NO DO DAT AGAIN.|DAT IZ NUMBER FOUR AN' WE IZ SITTIN' IN IT.|DA ROAD DID DAT.}"
asides.any: {member} {IZ OUT OF DA DOOR AN' BEING SICK ON DA VERGE|LOOKS BACK AT DA SHRINE|TURNS DA ENGINE OFF}

choices.text: DRIVE ON AN' DO NO TALK 'BOUT IT!
GO BACK AN' WALK DA SIXTY METRES!
CHECK DA VEHICLE. ALL OF IT!

c_check.text:
WHEELS, STEERIN', TYRES, AN' DEN DA TYRES AGAIN WIT A LAMP, AN' IT IZ ALL SOUND, AN' DA TREAD ON DA NEAR SIDE FRONT HAB {A COUPLE OF SECONDS|A MARK ON IT|A FLAT} WORN INTO IT DAT WAZ NO DERE DIS MORNIN'.
IT IZ A FLAT SPOT DA SHAPE OF A LOCKED WHEEL, AN' NOBODY LOCKED A WHEEL, AN' DA MARK IZ DA SAME ON DA OFF SIDE, AN' IT IZ DA ONLY PHYSICAL EVIDENCE ANYBODY HAB EVER BROUGHT OFF DAT SIXTY METRES!

b2_m.text:
FOUR POSTS, A CAN OF PAINT, AN' TWO HOURS' WORK, AN' ANY DRIVER ON DAT ROAD NOW HAB A REASON TA LIFT OFF.
WHILE DA SECOND POST IZ GOING IN, DA GROUND AT SIXTY METRES GIVES {DIFFERENTLY|DA WRONG WAY|LIKE NUTTIN' ELSE ON DAT VERGE}, AN' WHAT IZ UNDER DA TOPSOIL IZ {TARMAC|AN OLD SURFACE|A ROAD} RUNNIN' AT AN ANGLE TA DA ONE DAT IZ DERE NOW!

choices.text: FINISH DA POSTS. LEAVE DA OLD SURFACE ALONE!
DIG DA OLD SURFACE OUT AN' SEE WHERE IT GOES!
PUT A POST THROUGH IT.

b2_old.text:
IT RUNS {AT FORTY DEGREES|ACROSS|AT AN ANGLE} TA DA MODERN ROAD AN' IT IZ UNMETALLED UNDER DA TAR, AN' FOLLOWIN' IT WIT A BAR AN' A SPADE FOR {TWO HOURS|AN AFTERNOON|A LONG WHILE} TAKES IT TA A GATE DAT IZ NO A GATE ANY MORE.
ON DA MODERN MAP DA TWO ROADS DO NO CROSS. ON A MAP FROM {1911|BEFORE DA WAR|A LONG TIME AGO} DEY DO, AT EXACTLY SIXTY METRES PAST DA SHRINE, AN' DAT CROSSROADS HAB A NAME AN' DA NAME IZ ON DA PLAQUE!

b2_post.text:
DA POST GOES THROUGH DA OLD SURFACE ON DA FOURTH BLOW AN' DEN GOES IN {ALL DA WAY|A GREAT DEAL FURTHER DEN IT SHOULD|TA DA HEAD} AS THOUGH DERE WAZ NUTTIN' UNDER IT AT ALL.
IT IZ NO RECOVERABLE. DA HOLE IT LEAVES IZ {A HAND'S WIDTH|LIL'|NARROW} AN' DOES NO FILL, AN' DA LIGHT AT DAT POINT ON DA ROAD STOPS BEING ON A DELAY FROM DAT AFTERNOON ONWARD, WHICH IZ EITHER A REPAIR OR A WOUND!

e_beach.title: {DA WRACK LINE|WHAT DA TIDE HAB SORTED|EVERYTINK ABOVE DA WEED IZ ARRANGED}

n0.text:
DA WRACK LINE IZ SORTED.
PLASTIC WIT PLASTIC, WOOD WIT WOOD, BONE WIT BONE, IN BANDS RUNNIN' DA WHOLE LENGTH OF DA BEACH, AN' AT DA TOP OF DA BEACH A FOURTH BAND OF TINKZ DAT DO NO GO TOGETHER AT ALL EXCEPT DAT EVERY ONE OF DEM BELONGED TA SOMEBODY.
DERE IZ NO FOOTPRINTS ANYWHERE ON DA SAND. DA TIDE WENT OUT A COUPLE OF HOURS AGO.
DA SORTIN' IZ FINISHED AT DA TOP AN' STILL GOING ON AT DA WATERLINE!
n0.emText:
DA TIDE LINE IZ SORTED INTO BANDS: PLASTIC, WOOD, BONE, AN' AT DA TOP A FOURTH BAND OF TINKZ WHOSE ONLY SHARED QUALITY IZ DAT EACH ONE BELONGED TA A PERSON.
SOMETINK CAME OUT OF DA WATER AN' DID DA FILIN'. YOU CAN FEEL DA PATIENCE IN IT. WHATEVER SORTS A BEACH INTO CATEGORIES IZ A MIND, AN' A MIND DAT WORKS AT LOW TIDE AN' DOES NO LEAVE FOOTPRINTS HAB HAB A LONG TIME TA PRACTISE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA WALKS DA FOURTH BAND WIT HIS HANDS BEHIND HIS BACK LIKE A MAN IN A GALLERY. "WATCHES. RINGS. A LIL' SHOE. UH. SUGAR, CHESTO E' 'NU CIMITERO, NUN E' 'NA SPIAGGIA."

asides.melancholic: {member} STOPS AT DA FOURTH BAND AN' DOES NO WALK ANY FURTHER ALONG IT!
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TAKE SOMETINK FROM DA FOURTH BAND!
ADD SOMETINK TA DA FOURTH BAND!
WAIT FOR DA TIDE AN' WATCH IT WORK!
BREAK DA BANDS. KICK DEM ALL TOGETHER!

a.text:
YOU LIFT A WATCH OUT OF DA BAND AN' EVERY GULL ON DA BEACH TURNS ITS HEAD.
DA WATCH IZ GOING. IT HAB BIN IN DA SEA LONG ENOUGH TA BE A SHELL AN' IT IZ GOING, AN' IT IZ SHOWIN' A TIME DAT IZ FOUR HOURS OFF, AN' DA FOUR HOURS IZ IN DA WRONG DIRECTION!

choices.text: KEEP IT AN' WEAR IT.
PUT IT BACK, EXACTLY WHERE IT WAZ!

b.text:
YOU PUT SOMETINK OF YA IN DA BAND OF TINKZ DAT BELONGED TA SOMEBODY.
DA BEACH DOES NO REACT. BUT WHEN YOU LOOK BACK FROM DA DUNE PATH, AN HOUR LATER, YA TINK HAB BIN MOVED: IT IZ IN DA BAND, CORRECTLY PLACED, BETWEEN AN OBJECT DAT IZ OLDER DEN IT AN' AN OBJECT DAT IZ NEWER.
IT HAB BIN FILED. YOU HAB BIN FILED!

c.text:
HALF A SHIFT OF WAITIN' IN DA MARRAM GRASS AN' DEN DA TIDE IZ IN AN' DA SORTIN' HAPPENS IN DA DARK, IN DA LAST TWENTY MINUTES BEFORE DA WATER TURNS.
IT IZ A GREAT MANY LIL' TINKZ WORKIN' IN A LINE, AN' DEY IZ NO ANIMALS, AN' WHEN DEY HAB FINISHED DEY GO BACK INTO DA WATER TOGETHER AN' DA BEACH IZ FILED AN' DA SAND IZ SMOOTH.
ONE OF DEM STAYS. IT HAB FOUND SOMETINK IT NO CAN CATEGORISE, AN' IT WOULD LIKE HELP!

d.text:
IT TAKES FOUR MINUTES TA RUIN A DAY'S WORK.
BY DA TIME YOU IZ AT DA TOP OF DA BEACH DA BANDS IZ RE-FORMIN' BEHIND YOU, AN' BY DA TIME YOU IZ AT DA DUNE PATH DEY IZ DONE, AN' EVERY SINGLE TINK IN DA FOURTH BAND IZ NOW FACIN' DA DUNE PATH.
DAT NIGHT, AT DA CAMP, SOMETINK IZ HEARD DOING DA SAME SORTIN' TA YA PACKS!

a1.text: IT KEEPS FOUR HOURS' BAD TIME FOR ELEVEN DAYS AN' DEN STOPS, AN' DA MOMENT IT STOPS SOMETINK COMES UP DA BEACH TA DA CAMP TA COLLECT IT, AN' IT IZ QUITE PREPARED TA TAKE DA ARM AS WELL!

a2.text:
YOU PUT IT BACK IN ITS SLOT AN' STEP AWAY, AN' DA TIDE, WHICH IZ NO DUE, COMES UP DA BEACH FOUR METRES, ONCE, OVER YA BOOTS, AN' GOES BACK.
WHERE IT TOUCHED, AT DA EDGE OF DA FOURTH BAND, DERE IZ NOW A TINK DAT WAZ NO DERE. IT IZ PAYMENT!

b_m.text:
SOMETINK OF YA GOES INTO DA BAND OF TINKZ DAT BELONGED TA SOMEBODY, AN' DA BEACH DOES NO REACT, AN' DA GULLS DO NO TURN.
WHEN YOU LOOK BACK FROM DA TOP OF DA BEACH DA FOURTH BAND HAB BIN {RE-SORTED|GONE THROUGH|WORKED}, AN' YA TINK IZ {IN DA MIDDLE|FOUR ALONG|PLACED}, BETWEEN TWO OBJECTS DAT IZ DA SAME AGE AS EACH OTHER AN' NO DA SAME AGE AS IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{IT HAB BIN FILED.|SORTED BY SOMETINK WIT A SYSTEM.|GO AN' LOOK AT WHAT IT IZ SITTIN' BETWEEN.}"
asides.any: {member} {WALKS BACK DOWN DA BEACH ON DEY OWN|COUNTS ALONG DA BAND|LOOKS AT DA TWO OBJECTS EITHER SIDE}

choices.text: LEAVE IT. IT IZ IN DA BAND NOW!
WORK OUT WHAT DA FOURTH BAND IZ SORTED BY!
TAKE IT BACK OUT.

b_sort.text:
DA FOURTH BAND IZ SORTED BY {HOW LONG DA OWNER HAB IT|HOW MUCH IT WAZ USED|WEAR}, AN' DA PARTY'S OBJECT HAB BIN PLACED CORRECTLY TA WITHIN {A YEAR|MONTHS|A SEASON}, BY SOMETINK DAT HAB NEVER MET ITS OWNER.
WHICH MAKES DA BAND A RECORD RATHER DEN A HEAP, AN' MAKES DA BEACH {A CLERK|AN ARCHIVE|SOMEBODY'S SYSTEM}, AN' MAKES DA WHOLE WRACK LINE LEGIBLE TA ANYBODY WILLIN' TA READ LEFT TA RIGHT!

b_take.text:
IT COMES OUT OF DA BAND {EASILY|WITOUT RESISTANCE|DA WAY ANYTINK COMES OFF A BEACH} AN' GOES BACK IN DA POCKET, AN' DA WALK TA DA TOP OF DA BEACH IZ A LONG ONE.
DA BAND CLOSES OVER DA GAP BEFORE ANYBODY HAB GOT DERE. FOR {DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT|A FORTNIGHT|SOME TIME} AFTERWARDS, EVERYTINK ANY OF DA PARTY PUTS DOWN IZ FOUND LATER {SORTED|MOVED|PLACED IN A LINE WIT OTHER TINKZ}, INDOORS, IN ROOMS NOBODY ELSE HAB BIN IN!

d_m.text:
FOUR MINUTES TA RUIN A DAY'S WORK, KICKIN' NINE BANDS INTO ONE HEAP ALONG A HUNDRED METRES OF WRACK LINE.
BY DA TIME ANYBODY IZ AT DA TOP OF DA BEACH DA BANDS IZ RE-FORMIN' BEHIND DEM, AN' DEY IZ RE-FORMIN' {FASTER|MUCH FASTER|AT A PACE NUTTIN' SHOULD MANAGE}, AN' DA FOURTH ONE IZ RE-FORMIN' FIRST!

choices.text: KEEP WALKIN'. LET IT COME!
GO BACK AN' HELP IT. SORT DA FOURTH BAND PROPERLY!
WATCH DA RE-FORMIN' AN' WORK OUT WHAT IZ DOING IT!

d_help.text:
A HANDFUL OF PEOPLE ON DEY KNEES ON A COLD BEACH AT DUSK PUTTIN' A STRANGER'S FILIN' SYSTEM BACK DA WAY IT WAZ, WHICH TAKES {THREE HOURS|UNTIL DARK|CONSIDERABLY LONGER DEN KICKIN' IT OVER}.
IT IZ CLOSE TA RIGHT. DA GULLS COME BACK AT SOME POINT AN' STAND 'BOUT WATCHIN' WITOUT TURNIN' DEY HEADS, WHICH IZ APPARENTLY DA BEACH'S WAY OF ACCEPTIN' AN APOLOGY, AN' NUTTIN' COMES UP TA DA CAMP DAT NIGHT!

d_watch.text:
IT IZ DA {SAND|BEACH|GROUND} ITSELF, MOVIN' EACH OBJECT {A HAND'S WIDTH|A LIL'|A FEW CENTIMETRES} AT A TIME IN DA INTERVALS WHEN NOBODY IZ LOOKIN' DIRECTLY AT IT.
WHICH IZ, IT TURNS OUT, MEASURABLE, AN' DA RATE IZ CONSTANT, AN' DA RATE GIVES A DATE FOR WHEN DA SORTIN' STARTED, AN' DA DATE IZ {DIS YEAR|RECENT|INSIDE DA LAST TWELVE MONTHS}!

e_lake.title: {DA WEIR|DA WATER GOES OVER AN' DOES NO COME BACK|FOUR METRES OF MISSIN' RIVER}

n0.text:
DA LAKE DRAINS OVER A WEIR INTO A RIVER, AN' IT SHOULD BE DA SAME AMOUNT OF WATER ON BOTH SIDES, AN' IT IZ NO: DA RIVER BELOW IZ 'BOUT HALF WHAT GOES OVER DA TOP.
DA WEIR KEEPER'S HUT IZ PADLOCKED FROM DA INSIDE. DERE IZ A GAUGE BOARD IN DA WATER WIT DA NUMBERS PAINTED ON IT, AN' SOMEBODY HAB REPAINTED DA NUMBERS SO DEY RUN DA OTHER WAY.
UNDER DA WEIR, {sound}.
DA GAUGE BOARDS IZ PAINTED BACKWARDS ON BOTH BANKS, AN' ON BOTH BANKS DA PAINT IZ {FRESH|LESS DEN A YEAR OLD|NEWER DEN TOMAS}!
n0.emText:
HALF DA WATER GOING OVER DIS WEIR DOES NO COME OUT DA OTHER SIDE, AN' DA GAUGE BOARD HAB BIN REPAINTED SO DA NUMBERS RUN BACKWARDS, AN' DA KEEPER'S HUT IZ PADLOCKED FROM DA INSIDE.
SOMEWHERE UNDER DIS WEIR DERE IZ A HOLE IN DA WORLD DAT TAKES WATER AN' DOES NO GIVE IT BACK, AN' SOMEBODY LOCAL HAB ADAPTED TA IT BY RELABELLIN' DA MEASURIN' STICK, WHICH IZ DA MOST HUMAN TINK YOU HAB SEEN ALL WEEK!
n0.bubba: BUBBA STANDS IN DA TAILRACE UP TA HIS KNEES AN' HOLDS HIS HAT OUT. "SUGAR, HALF A RIVER'S GOIN' SOMEPLACE. E' 'NU BUCO. SOMEWHERE DERE IZ A TOWN GETTIN' RAINED ON INDOORS."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GET INTO DA HUT.
GO UNDER DA WEIR.
FOLLOW DA MISSIN' WATER.
ASK IN DA NEAREST VILLAGE 'BOUT DA GAUGE BOARD!

a.text:
DA WINDOW GOES IN EASILY. INSIDE: A BED, A STOVE, FORTY YEARS OF TIDE TABLES FOR A LAKE WIT NO TIDE, AN' A MAN'S COAT ON A HOOK.
DA PADLOCK IZ ON DA INSIDE OF DA DOOR AN' DA KEY IZ IN DA LOCK. ZERO OTHER WAY OUT AN' DERE IZ NOBODY IN DA HUT!

choices.text: READ DA TIDE TABLES.
WAIT IN DA HUT FOR DA KEEPER!

b.text:
UNDER DA SHEET OF FALLIN' WATER DERE IZ A LEDGE, AN' PAST DA LEDGE DERE IZ A DOORWAY IN DA WEIR'S OWN STONEWORK, AN' DA MISSIN' HALF OF DA RIVER IZ GOING INTO IT AN' NO MAKIN' ANY NOISE AT ALL.
IT GOES DOWN. IT GOES DOWN A LONG WAY AN' DA LIGHT GOES WIT IT!

c.text:
YOU FOLLOW IT BY FINDIN' WHERE IT COMES OUT, WHICH TAKES TWO DAYS AN' FOUR WRONG GUESSES AN' ONE REAL GOOD IDEA 'BOUT WELLS.
IT COMES OUT ELEVEN KILOMETRES AWAY, IN A CELLAR, INTO A STONE TANK DAT IZ ALWAYS EXACTLY DA SAME LEVEL, IN A HOUSE DAT HAB BIN IN DA SAME FAMILY FOR FOUR HUNDRED YEARS AN' HAB NEVER ONCE BIN SHORT OF WATER!

choices.text: KNOCK ON DA DOOR.
TELL DA WATER BOARD.

d.text:
"OLD TOMAS DID DAT," DEY SAY, IN DA BAR, WITOUT BEING PRESSED. "PAINTED DEM BACKWARDS IN DA EIGHTIES. SAID DA LAKE WAZ GOING DA OTHER WAY AN' SOMEBODY HAB BETTER BE COUNTIN' IT RIGHT."
DEN DA ROOM GOES QUIET FOR A MOMENT AN' SOMEBODY CHANGES DA SUBJECT WIT REAL SKILL, AN' YOU HAB TA BUY FOUR ROUNDS TA GET BACK TA IT!

choices.text: BUY DA FOUR ROUNDS.
ASK WHERE TOMAS IZ NOW.

a1.text:
FORTY YEARS OF A LAKE'S LEVELS, TAKEN TWICE A DAY BY HAND, AN' IN DA LAST FOUR YEARS DA NUMBERS STOP BEING LEVELS AN' START BEING A COUNTDOWN.
IT REACHES ZERO IN A MONTH OR TWO. UNDERNEATH DA LAST ENTRY, IN DIFFERENT INK: "LOCKED IN. DO NO OPEN. IT COMES UP DA TAILRACE."

a2.text:
YOU SIT IN A WEIR KEEPER'S HUT UNTIL DARK, AN' AT DARK DA WATER NOISE CHANGES, AN' SOMETINK COMES UP DA TAILRACE AN' TRIES DA DOOR.
IT TRIES DA DOOR FOR A GOOD WHILE. IT IZ WEAK, ONLY EXTREMELY PERSISTENT, AN' IT KNOWS DA DOOR OPENS INWARDS, AN' IT KNOWS 'BOUT DA PADLOCK, AN' IT IZ DISAPPOINTED DAT DA PADLOCK IZ DONE UP!

c1.text:
DA FAMILY IZ HOSPITABLE AN' COMPLETELY UNEMBARRASSED. DEY HAB KNOWN FOR FOUR HUNDRED YEARS. DERE IZ A PAPER 'BOUT IT, SIGNED BY AN ABBOT, AN' AN OBLIGATION ATTACHED, AN' DEY HAB KEPT DA OBLIGATION EVERY YEAR WITOUT FAIL.
DEY IZ GETTIN' OLD. DERE IZ NOBODY AFTER DEM. DEY WOULD LIKE TA KNOW IF DA PARTY WOULD CONSIDER DA OBLIGATION, AN' DEY EXPLAIN EXACTLY WHAT IT INVOLVES BEFORE ASKIN'!

c2.text:
DA WATER BOARD SEND AN ENGINEER WHO TAKES ONE LOOK AT DA TANK, SAYS A WORD YOU DO NO EXPECT FROM AN ENGINEER, AN' FILES A REPORT DAT GOES TA FOUR OFFICES AN' DISAPPEARS IN ALL FOUR.
HE PAYS FOR YA DRINKS HIMSELF, OUT OF HIS OWN POCKET, AN' THANKS YOU, AN' TELLS YOU WHAT HAPPENED TA DA LAST MAN WHO FILED ONE!

d1.text:
FOUR ROUNDS GETS YOU DA WHOLE TINK: DA COUNT, DA COUNTDOWN, DA ELEVEN WEEKS, AN' DA FACT DAT DA WHOLE VILLAGE KNOWS AN' HAB DECIDED, COLLECTIVELY, WITOUT A MEETIN', TA BE SOMEWHERE ELSE DAT MONTH.
DEY HAB BIN PACKIN' FOR A COUPLE OF YEARS. DEY SHOW YOU DA ARRANGEMENTS. DEY IZ EXTREMELY WELL ORGANISED AN' NOBODY HAB SAID IT OUT LOUD ONCE!

d2.text:
"IN DA HUT," DEY SAY. "WHERE ELSE WOULD HE BE?"
IT HAB BIN ELEVEN YEARS. NOBODY HAB BIN IN. NOBODY HAB TAKEN HIM A MEAL IN ELEVEN YEARS AN' NOBODY THINKS DIS IZ STRANGE, AN' WHEN YOU POINT OUT DAT A MAN NO CAN BE IN A HUT FOR ELEVEN YEARS, DEY AGREE WIT YOU COMPLETELY AN' GO BACK TA DEY DRINKS!

c2_m.text:
DA WATER BOARD SEND AN ENGINEER WHO TAKES ONE LOOK AT DA TANK, SAYS A WORD YOU DO NO EXPECT FROM AN ENGINEER, AN' GOES BACK TA DA VAN FOR A TORCH.
HE IZ DOWN DERE {FORTY MINUTES|A LONG TIME|DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR}. WHEN HE COMES UP HE IZ NO WRITIN' ANYTINK, WHICH FOR A MAN WIT A CLIPBOARD IZ A DECISION, AN' HE ASKS DA PARTY, QUIETLY, HOW MUCH OF IT DEY SAW!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{HE IZ DECIDIN' WHETHER TA FILE.|DAT IZ A MAN WORKIN' OUT WHAT HE CAN AFFORD TA HAB SEEN.|WATCH WHAT HE WRITES.}"
asides.any: {member} {HOLDS DA TORCH|WAITS|DOES NO ANSWER STRAIGHT AWAY}

choices.text: SAY: ALL OF IT. LET HIM FILE WHAT HE LIKES!
SAY: NUTTIN'. LET HIM CLOSE IT!
LOOK AT HIS FILE NUMBER AN' FOLLOW IT UP YOURSELF!

c2_shut.text:
HE FILES IT AS A {BLOCKAGE|STRUCTURAL QUERY|ROUTINE DEFECT} AN' DA TANK IZ SEALED AN' GROUTED INSIDE DA FORTNIGHT, BY A CONTRACTOR, AT NIGHT, AN' DA RIVER BELOW DA WEIR IZ DA SAME AMOUNT OF WATER AS DA LAKE ABOVE IT FROM DAT WEEK ONWARD.
HE POSTS DA PARTY {payment} IN CASH FROM HIS OWN MONEY {FOUR MONTHS|A SEASON|SOME TIME} LATER WIT NO NOTE, WHICH IZ EITHER GRATITUDE OR A DOWN PAYMENT ON DEY SILENCE AN' IZ MAYBE-MAYBE BOTH!

c2_file.text:
DA FILE NUMBER IZ ON DA CLIPBOARD AN' DA FILE IZ PUBLIC, AN' PULLIN' IT TAKES {TWO AFTERNOONS|A FORTNIGHT|SOME PERSISTENCE} AN' A REQUEST IN WRITIN'.
DERE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN} OF DEM FOR DIS CATCHMENT GOING BACK TA {1954|DA FIFTIES|A LONG WAY}, ALL WIT DIFFERENT ENGINEERS' NAMES, ALL CLOSED AS ROUTINE DEFECTS, ALL WIT DA SAME PARAGRAPH TYPED IN DA SAME WORDS. SOMEBODY HAB BIN CLOSIN' DIS FOR {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE|HALF A CENTURY|A REAL LONG TIME}!

d2_m.text:
"IN DA HUT," DEY SAY. "WHERE ELSE WOULD HE BE?" IT HAB BIN DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE. NOBODY HAB BIN IN. NOBODY HAB TAKEN HIM A MEAL.
DEY IZ NO BEING CRUEL 'BOUT IT, WHICH IZ DA STRANGE PART: DA BAR TALKS 'BOUT TOMAS IN DA PRESENT TENSE AN' HAB {A CHAIR|HIS CHAIR|A PLACE} DAT NOBODY SITS IN, AN' SOMEBODY BUYS HIM A DRINK ON A FRIDAY AN' DA GLASS IZ LEFT ON DA BAR!

choices.text: GO UP TA DA HUT AN' OPEN IT!
BUY HIM A DRINK AN' LEAVE IT ON DA BAR!
ASK, CAREFULLY, WHEN DEY LAST SAW HIM!

d2_drink.text:
A DRINK BOUGHT FOR A MAN NOBODY HAB SEEN IN ELEVEN YEARS, LEFT ON DA BAR IN DA RIGHT GLASS, WHICH DA LANDLORD POURS WITOUT BEING TOLD WHICH ONE.
IT IZ GONE AT CLOSIN' AN' DA GLASS IZ ON DA SHELF. WHATEVER ELSE DAT MEANS, IT MEANS DA PARTY HAB BIN ACCEPTED BY DAT BAR IN A WAY DAT TAKES MOST PEOPLE {YEARS|A LIFETIME|GENERATIONS}, AN' WHAT COMES OUT OF DA REST OF DAT EVENIN' IZ WORTH GOING BACK FOR!

d2_seen.text:
DA ANSWER, ONCE A HANDFUL OF PEOPLE HAB STOPPED GIVIN' DA EASY VERSION, IZ {LAST WEEK|TUESDAY|RECENTLY}, AN' DA ANSWER BEFORE DAT IZ DAT HE COMES DOWN ON A BICYCLE FOR DA PAINT, TWICE A YEAR, AN' PAYS CASH.
HE HAB BIN DEAD {YEARS AN' YEARS|SINCE DA BAD WINTER|A LONG TIME} BY DA PARISH REGISTER, WHICH DA PARTY CHECKS, AN' DA REGISTER IZ NO WRONG, AN' NEITHER IZ DA BAR!

e_wayside.title: {DA MARKER|A STONE WIT DA WRONG NUMBER ON IT|NINE KILOMETRES TA NOWHERE}

n0.text:
A MILESTONE AT DA SIDE OF DA TRACK, CUT, PAINTED, MAINTAINED, WIT A PLACE NAME ON IT AN' A DISTANCE.
DA DISTANCE IZ NINE. IT WAZ NINE AN HOUR AGO AT DA LAST ONE, AN' IT WILL BE NINE AT DA NEXT, AN' DA PLACE IT NAMES IZ NO ON YA MAP OR ON ANYBODY'S.
SOMEBODY PAINTS DEZE. DERE IZ A PAINT TIN IN DA GRASS BEHIND IT WIT DA LID ON PROPERLY.
DA PAINT ON EVERY STONE IZ DA SAME AGE, WHICH MEANS DEY IZ ALL DONE ON DA SAME DAY, WHICH MEANS SOMEBODY DOES {NINE KILOMETRES|DA WHOLE RUN|ALL FOUR} IN AN AFTERNOON!
n0.emText:
A MILESTONE DAT SAYS NINE KILOMETRES TA A PLACE DAT IZ NO ON ANY MAP, AN' IT SAID NINE AT DA LAST ONE, AN' IT WILL SAY NINE AT DA NEXT.
SOMEBODY KEEPS DA PAINT FRESH. IN YA EXPERIENCE, DA TINKZ DAT GET MAINTAINED IZ DA TINKZ DAT IZ STILL IN USE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA SHAKES DA PAINT TIN. "HALF FULL. FRESH. AOH. SUGAR, 'O PITTORE STA' VICINO."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WALK TOWARDS IT.
WAIT FOR WHOEVER PAINTS DA STONES!
REPAINT DA STONE WIT DA RIGHT NUMBER!
NOTE IT, AN' GO ON.

a.text:
NINE KILOMETRES OF GOOD TRACK, FOUR MILESTONES, ALL OF DEM NINE.
AT DA FOURTH DERE IZ A BENCH AN' A VIEW AN' A MAN SITTIN' ON IT WIT A FLASK, WHO NODS AT YOU AS IF YOU WAZ EXPECTED AN' SAYS: "IT IZ ALWAYS NINE. DAT IZ DA DISTANCE."

choices.text: SIT DOWN WIT HIM.
KEEP WALKIN' ANYWAY.

b.text:
IT TAKES UNTIL EVENIN'. HE IZ 'BOUT SEVENTY, ON A BICYCLE, WIT A BRUSH AN' A RAG, AN' HE DOES DA STONE IN FOUR MINUTES AN' DOES NO REPAINT DA NUMBER, ONLY DA LETTERS.
"DA NUMBER'S RIGHT," HE SAYS, WHEN YOU ASK. "IT IZ DA NAME PEOPLE NO CAN DO."

c.text:
YOU PAINT A NUMBER ON A STONE DAT HAB HAB DA SAME NUMBER ON IT FOR TWO HUNDRED YEARS, AN' DA PAINT TAKES, AN' DA TRACK AHEAD OF YOU IZ NOW A FEW KILOMETRES SHORTER AN' IT ARRIVES SOMEWHERE.
WHERE IT ARRIVES IZ A FARM, WIT A FAMILY, AN' A DOG, AN' A WOMAN IN DA YARD WHO DROPS WHAT SHE IZ HOLDIN' WHEN SHE SEES DA TRACK COME OUT OF DA TREES, COZ IT HAB NO COME OUT OF DA TREES IN HER LIFETIME!

d.text:
YOU WRITE IT DOWN, COZ DAT IZ WHAT A PARTY WIT ANY SENSE DOES, AN' YOU GO ON.
DA ENTRY IN DA BOOK IZ WORTH SOMETINK TA A MAN IN {region} WHO COLLECTS EXACTLY DIS, AN' HE PAYS FOR IT, AN' ASKS WHETHER DA PAINT TIN HAB DA LID ON.
IT DID. HE NODS AS IF DAT SETTLED SOMETINK!

a1.text:
FLASK TEA ON A BENCH WIT A VIEW OF NUTTIN' IN PARTICULAR, AN' AN HOUR OF A MAN WHO HAB BIN SITTIN' AT DA FOURTH STONE FOR A LONG TIME.
HE EXPLAINS DA NINE. IT TAKES FOUR MINUTES AN' IT IZ ENTIRELY SATISFACTORY AN' NONE OF YOU CAN REPEAT IT AFTERWARDS, AN' EVERYBODY FEELS CONSIDERABLY BETTER FOR HAVIN' HEARD IT!

a2.text:
FOUR MORE STONES, ALL NINE, AN' DA LIGHT GOING, AN' DA TRACK GETTIN' BETTER RATHER DEN WORSE DA FURTHER YOU GO, WHICH IZ DA WRONG WAY ROUND.
AT DA NINTH STONE DA TRACK ENDS AT A GATE IN A WALL, AN' ON DA GATE DERE IZ A BELL, AN' DA BELL HAB A ROPE, AN' DA ROPE IZ DA ONLY TINK OUT HERE DAT IZ NO MAINTAINED!

b_m.text:
IT TAKES UNTIL EVENIN'. HE IZ 'BOUT SEVENTY, ON A BICYCLE, WIT A BRUSH AN' A RAG, AN' HE DOES DA STONE IN FOUR MINUTES AN' DOES NO LOOK UP UNTIL IT IZ DONE.
DEN HE DOES LOOK UP, AN' HE IZ NO STARTLED, AN' HE SAYS: "YOU HAB NO WALKED IT, DEN." HE SAYS IT AS A FACT AN' AS A KINDNESS AN' IT IZ NO CLEAR WHICH OF DOZE IZ MEANT TA HURT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{HE HAB MET PEOPLE LIKE US BEFORE.|DAT IZ A MAN ON A SCHEDULE.|ASK HIM WHAT IZ AT DA NINTH KILOMETRE.}"
asides.any: {member} {HOLDS DA BICYCLE|LOOKS AT DA WET NINE ON DA STONE|ASKS IF HE WANTS A HAND}

choices.text: TALK TA HIM AT DA STONE.
ASK HIM WHY DA NUMBER NEVER CHANGES!
DO DA NEXT STONE FOR HIM.

b_why.text:
COZ IT IZ SOMETINK ELSE, HE SAYS, AN' DEN EXPLAINS WHAT IT IZ, AN' DA EXPLANATION IZ {FOUR SENTENCES|SHORT|NO LONG} AN' IZ ENTIRELY COHERENT AN' TAKES 'BOUT A MINUTE TA BECOME HORRIBLE.
DA NUMBER IZ A COUNT, DA COUNT IZ OF SOMETINK DAT HAB NO HAPPENED YET, AN' DA PAINTIN' IZ WHAT KEEPS IT AT NINE. IT HAB BIN AT NINE SINCE {HIS FATHER|DA WAR|BEFORE HE TOOK IT ON}!

b_paint.text:
ONE STONE, A COUPLE OF MINUTES, WIT HIS BRUSH AN' HIS RAG AN' HIM WATCHIN' FROM DA SADDLE WITOUT COMMENT.
HE CHECKS IT AFTERWARDS, PROPERLY, WIT A THUMB ON DA EDGE OF DA NINE, AN' DEN SAYS THANK YOU AN' GIVES DA PARTY {DA RAG|HIS RAG|DA TIN}, WHICH IZ A TINK HE HAB EVIDENTLY THOUGHT 'BOUT FOR {SOME TIME|YEARS|A WHILE}, AN' RIDES OFF BEFORE ANYBODY CAN DECLINE IT!

d_m.text:
YOU WRITE IT DOWN, COZ DAT IZ WHAT A PARTY WIT ANY SENSE DOES, AN' YOU GO ON, AN' DA ENTRY IN DA BOOK IZ WORTH SOMETINK TA SOMEBODY.
A FEW KILOMETRES FURTHER ON DERE IZ ANOTHER STONE, AN' IT SAYS NINE, AN' DA TRACK BEHIND IZ {VISIBLY|OBVIOUSLY|BY ANY MEASURE} LONGER DEN NINE KILOMETRES AN' DA PARTY HAB BIN WALKIN' AWAY FROM DA PLACE NAME DA WHOLE TIME!

choices.text: KEEP GOING. WRITE DOWN DA SECOND ONE TOO!
TURN ROUND AN' WALK BACK TA DA FIRST STONE!
PACE DA DISTANCE BETWEEN DA TWO STONES EXACTLY!

d_back.text:
WALKIN' BACK TA DA FIRST STONE TAKES {A SHORT DRIVE|AN HOUR|DA SAME AS IT TOOK}, AN' IT IZ NO DERE, AN' DA TRACK BEHIND IZ {EMPTY|CLEAN|UNMARKED} FOR AS FAR AS ANYBODY WANTS TA KEEP LOOKIN'.
DA SECOND ONE IZ STILL AHEAD OF DEM WHEN DEY TURN ROUND AGAIN, WHICH IZ DA WRONG DIRECTION FOR IT TA BE IN, AN' IT STILL SAYS NINE!

d_pace.text:
PACED PROPERLY, OUT AN' BACK, TWICE, DA GAP BETWEEN DA TWO STONES IZ {THREE THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED|NO FOUR KILOMETRES|THREE POINT NINE} PACES, AN' DA SECOND MEASUREMENT DISAGREES WIT DA FIRST BY EXACTLY NINE.
SO DOES DA THIRD. DA ERROR IZ {A RATE|A CONSTANT|AN INTEREST}, AN' A PARTY WIT AN ENTRY IN A BOOK AN' A NUMBER LIKE DAT HAB SOMETINK A CARTOGRAPHER WILL PAY REAL MONEY FOR!

e_camp.title: {DA COLD CAMP|SOMEBODY STOPPED HERE LAST NIGHT|FOUR CUPS, THREE DRUNK}

n0.text:
A CAMP, COLD, FROM LAST NIGHT: FIRE RING, FOUR CUPS, THREE OF DEM DRUNK, AN' ONE FULL AN' COVERED WIT A SAUCER.
DA KIT IZ ALL HERE. TWO PACKS, A BEDROLL ROLLED, A COAT OVER A BRANCH, A PAIR OF BOOTS SIDE BY SIDE AN' POINTED AT DA FIRE DA WAY YOU POINT BOOTS WHEN YOU INTEND TA PUT DEM BACK ON.
NUTTIN' HAB BIN DRAGGED. NUTTIN' HAB BIN TAKEN. DERE IZ NO TRACKS OUT.
THREE CUPS IZ DRUNK TA DA LEAVES AN' DA LEAVES IZ {DRY|NO WET|A WEEK DRY}, AN' DA FOURTH IZ UNDER A SAUCER!
n0.emText:
A COLD CAMP FROM LAST NIGHT WIT FOUR CUPS, THREE DRUNK AN' ONE COVERED WIT A SAUCER, AN' DA BOOTS POINTED AT DA FIRE DA WAY YOU LEAVE BOOTS WHEN YOU IZ COMIN' BACK TA DEM.
EVERYTINK HERE SAYS DEY INTENDED TA COME BACK AN' NUTTIN' SAYS DEY LEFT. DAT IZ YA WHOLE BIOGRAPHY IN A FIRE RING!
n0.bubba: BUBBA CROUCHES BY DA FOURTH CUP AN' DOES NO LIFT DA SAUCER. "COVERED UP. DAT IZ FOR SOMEBODY. ASPETTAVANO A QUACCHEDUNO."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX THREE TIMES AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.nurturing: {member} IZ ALREADY GOING THROUGH DA PACKS FOR A NAME, AN ADDRESS, SOMEBODY TA TELL!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: LIFT DA SAUCER.
GO THROUGH DA PACKS.
MAKE YA OWN CAMP HERE AN' LIGHT DA FIRE AGAIN!
DRINK DA FOURTH CUP.

a.text:
UNDER DA SAUCER DA TEA IZ HOT, WIT STEAM ON DA UNDERSIDE OF DA CHINA, IN A CUP DAT HAB BIN SITTIN' IN A COLD FIRE RING SINCE LAST NIGHT.
DA MOMENT DA SAUCER IZ OFF, EVERYTINK IN DA CAMP IZ A DEGREE OR TWO WARMER, AN' SOMEWHERE BEHIND YOU IN DA SCRUB SOMETINK PUTS WEIGHT ON A FOOT!

choices.text: PUT DA SAUCER BACK.
LEAVE IT OFF AN' WAIT.

b.text:
TWO PACKS: A WOMAN'S AN' A BOY'S. A PERMIT FOR SOMETINK ELSE ENTIRELY, FOUR LETTERS HOME UNPOSTED, A MAP WIT A ROUTE ON IT DAT ENDS HERE AN' DOES NO GO ON, AN' A PHOTOGRAPH OF FOUR PEOPLE AT A FIRE RING.
DA PHOTOGRAPH IZ OF DIS FIRE RING. DERE IZ FOUR IN IT AN' TWO PACKS, WHICH DOES NO ADD UP UNTIL YOU COUNT AGAIN AN' NOTICE DAT TWO OF DA FOUR IZ WEARIN' DA SAME COAT!

c.text:
YOU BUILD DA FIRE BACK UP IN SOMEBODY ELSE'S RING AN' COOK, AN' EAT, AN' SIT, AN' DA EVENIN' IZ ONE OF DA GOOD ONES: NO WIND, A CLEAR SKY, AN' SOMETINK IN DA ARRANGEMENT OF DA PLACE DAT MAKES EVERYBODY TALK MORE DEN USUAL.
AT 'BOUT FOUR IN DA MORNIN' DA FOURTH CUP IZ EMPTY AN' DA SAUCER IZ STACKED ON DA OTHER THREE, WASHED!

d.text:
IT IZ REAL GOOD TEA, AN' IT IZ HOT, AN' IT IZ SOMEBODY'S.
WHAT COMES TA COLLECT DA CUP DOES NO WANT DA CUP BACK. IT WANTS TA KNOW WHY YOU THOUGHT IT WAZ FOR YOU, AN' IT ASKS IN A WAY DAT DOES NO USE LANGUAGE, AN' IT ASKS MORE DEN ONCE!

a1.text:
YOU PUT IT BACK EXACTLY AS IT WAZ AN' DA CAMP COOLS AN' DA TINK IN DA SCRUB TAKES ITS WEIGHT OFF DA FOOT AN' EVERYTINK IZ ORDINARY.
YOU LEAVE DA CAMP AS YOU FOUND IT, AN' MARK DA POSITION, AN' REPORT IT IN {region} WHERE SOMEBODY AT A DESK GOES QUITE STILL AN' ASKS YOU TA REPEAT DA BIT 'BOUT DA SAUCER.
DEY HAB FOUR OTHER REPORTS. ALL FOUR WIT A SAUCER!

a2.text:
A LONG STRETCH, SITTIN' IN A COLD CAMP WIT A HOT CUP OF TEA IN DA MIDDLE OF IT, AN' DEN DEY COME BACK FOR DEY KIT: TWO OF DEM, A WOMAN AN' A BOY, WALKIN' IN OUT OF DA SCRUB FROM A DIRECTION DAT HAB NUTTIN' IN IT.
DEY IZ PERFECTLY ALL RIGHT. DEY HAB BIN GONE ONE NIGHT. DEY HAB BIN GONE, AS FAR AS ANYBODY ELSE IZ CONCERNED, SINCE {timeAgo}, AN' DEY IZ EXTREMELY KEEN TA KNOW WHAT DA PARTY IZ DOING AT DEY FIRE!

b_m.text:
TWO PACKS: A WOMAN'S AN' A BOY'S. A PERMIT FOR SOMETINK ELSE ENTIRELY, FOUR LETTERS HOME UNPOSTED, A MAP WIT A ROUTE ON IT DAT DOES NO GO WHERE DA PERMIT SAYS.
DA ROUTE ENDS {FOUR KILOMETRES|NO FAR|A MORNIN''S WALK} FROM HERE AT A SPOT DAT IZ MARKED WIT A CROSS AN' A TIME, AN' DA TIME IZ {DIS MORNIN'|TODAY|TWO HOURS AGO}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DEY HAB AN APPOINTMENT.|SOMEBODY WENT TA MEET SOMETINK AT EIGHT O'CLOCK.|DAT IZ A RENDEZVOUS, NO A ROUTE.}"
asides.any: {member} {FOLDS DA MAP AN' PUTS IT IN A POCKET|READS ONE OF DA LETTERS AN' PUTS IT BACK|LOOKS AT DA TIME AN' DEN AT DA SUN}

choices.text: TAKE DA USEFUL KIT AN' GO!
WALK DA ROUTE TA DA CROSS!
POST DA FOUR LETTERS.

b_cross.text:
A SHORT DRIVE ON A BEARIN' OFF SOMEBODY ELSE'S MAP, AN' DA CROSS IZ A {HOLLOW|DIP|PLACE WHERE DA GROUND GOES DOWN} WIT A FLAT STONE IN IT AN' TWO SETS OF BOOT PRINTS GOING IN.
ONE SET COMES OUT. IT IZ DA BOY'S, AN' IT GOES {EAST|DA WRONG WAY|AWAY FROM DA CAMP}, AT A RUN, AN' IT IZ {TWO HOURS|DIS MORNIN''S|RECENT}, AN' IT IZ FOLLOWABLE!

b_lost.text:
FOUR KILOMETRES ON A BEARIN' TAKEN OFF A SKETCH MAP IN A HURRY IZ {THREE KILOMETRES|FOUR KILOMETRES|A WALK} IN DA WRONG DIRECTION, AN' DA GROUND ALL LOOKS DA SAME, AN' DA LIGHT GOES.
DA PARTY GETS BACK TA DA CAMP AT {TEN|DARK|SOME HOUR} WIT NUTTIN', AN' DA FOURTH CUP IZ COLD, AN' DA SAUCER IZ ON DA GROUND BESIDE IT, AN' NOBODY IN DA PARTY PUT IT DERE!

b_post.text:
FOUR LETTERS, STAMPED AT {DA NEXT TOWN|DA FIRST POST OFFICE|A VILLAGE FOUR HOURS ON} OUT OF DA PARTY'S OWN MONEY, AN' PUT IN A BOX, WHICH IZ DA SMALLEST POSSIBLE ACT AN' TAKES 'BOUT A LONG MINUTE.
TWO OF DEM IZ ANSWERED, {MONTHS LATER|EVENTUALLY|IN DA SPRING}, CARE OF A POSTE RESTANTE DA PARTY NEVER GAVE ANYBODY. DA ANSWERS IZ ADDRESSED TA DA WOMAN AN' DA BOY. BOTH OF DEM START: {"WE GOT YA LETTER"|"THANK GOD"|"WE HAB GIVEN UP"}!

c_m.text:
DA FIRE GOES BACK UP IN SOMEBODY ELSE'S RING AN' DA EVENIN' IZ ONE OF DA GOOD ONES: NO WIND, FOOD, AN' DA COUNTRY GOING DARK POLITELY AROUND FOUR PEOPLE WHO DID NO HAB TA WALK ANY FURTHER TODAY.
AT 'BOUT {ELEVEN|MIDNIGHT|DA HOUR EVERYBODY STOPS TALKIN'} DA FIRE DOES SOMETINK IT SHOULD NO: IT {GOES GREEN|BURNS GREEN FOR A MOMENT|CHANGES COLOUR} FOR 'BOUT FOUR SECONDS, ALL DA WAY THROUGH, AN' DEN DOES NO DO IT AGAIN!

choices.text: NOBODY MENTIONS IT. SLEEP WELL!
PUT DA FOURTH CUP ON DA FIRE!
WORK OUT WHAT IZ IN DA RING!

c_cup.text:
A FULL CUP OF SOMEBODY ELSE'S TEA, POURED ONTO A FIRE DAT IZ NO YA, IN DA MIDDLE OF DA NIGHT, BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB DECIDED TA FIND OUT.
DA FIRE GOES OUT. ALL OF IT, INSTANTLY, INCLUDIN' DA EMBERS, INCLUDIN' DA HEAT IN DA STONES. DA REST OF DA NIGHT IZ {REAL COLD|EXTREMELY COLD|AS COLD AS IT GETS} AN' IN DA MORNIN' DA RING IZ FULL OF CLEAN DRY ASH AN' DA SAUCER IZ IN DA MIDDLE OF IT, UNMARKED!

c_ring.text:
DA STONES OF DA RING IZ RIVER STONE AN' ONE OF DEM IZ NO: IT IZ {WORKED|CUT|SHAPED}, SET AT DA {NORTH|UPSTREAM} POINT, AN' IT HAB BIN IN A FIRE A GREAT MANY MORE TIMES DEN DIS RING HAB BIN USED.
IT IZ ALSO DA REASON DA FIRE WENT GREEN, AN' DA REASON IT BURNED DAT WELL, AN' IT IZ PORTABLE, AN' WHOEVER LAID DIS CAMP KNEW TA PUT IT IN DA RING AN' KNEW TA LEAVE IT DERE!

e_city_lanes.title: {YA COUSIN WANTS TA BOWL|FRAME NINE|TEN PINS ON {street}}

n0.text:
SOMEBODY SHOUTS YA NAME ACROSS {street} IN A VOICE DAT HAB KNOWN YOU SINCE YOU WAZ FOUR.
IT IZ {cousin}, OUT OF DA FAMILY YOU HAB BIN AVOIDIN', IN A COAT DAT COST MORE DEN YA BOOTS, AN' {kinTalk}, AN' DERE IZ NO VERSION OF DIS CONVERSATION WHERE YOU GET AWAY IN UNDER AN HOUR.
"TWO LANES BOOKED AT {lane}," DEY SAY, ALREADY STEERIN' YOU. "SIX O'CLOCK. YOU IZ COMIN'. BRING YA PEOPLE, DA MORE DA BETTER, ME HAB PAID FOR DA SHOES."
{cousin} HAB BIN ON DAT PAVEMENT {A WHILE|LONGER DEN A MAN WAITS FOR A BUS|SINCE BEFORE YOU CAME ROUND DA CORNER}!
n0.emText:
SOMEBODY SHOUTS A NAME ACROSS {street} IN A VOICE DAT HAB KNOWN DA OWNER OF DAT NAME SINCE DEY WAZ FOUR. DA NAME IZ YA. DA VOICE BELONGS TA {cousin}.
YOU DO NO REMEMBER DEM. YOU DO NO REMEMBER ANY OF DEM. DEY REMEMBER EVERYTINK: DA POND, DA WEDDIN', DA SUMMER YOU BROKE YA ARM, AN' DEY IZ TELLIN' YOU 'BOUT IT NOW, AT SPEED, WIT TREMENDOUS AFFECTION, AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' IN YOU FOR ANY OF IT TA LAND ON.
"TWO LANES AT {lane}," DEY SAY. "SIX O'CLOCK. BRING YA PEOPLE. ME HAB PAID FOR DA SHOES."
n0.bubba: BUBBA IZ DELIGHTED. "A COUSIN! SUGAR, YOU GOT PEOPLE! AGGIA' SEMP' DITTO CA TENIVE 'NA FAMIGLIA!" HE IZ ALREADY SHAKIN' DEY HAND WIT BOTH OF HIS!

asides.sanguine: {member} HAB ACCEPTED ON BEHALF OF DA ENTIRE PARTY BEFORE YOU HAB OPENED YA MOUTH!
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.mischievous: {member} {GRINS: "DIBS ON WHATEVER LOOKS SHINY AN' DANGEROUS."|IZ ALREADY TRYIN' TA PICK DA MAINTENANCE LOCK WIT A WIRE|WONDERS ALOUD WHAT HAPPENS IF WE PRESS ALL DA BUTTONS AT ONCE|SMIRKS AN' TAPS DA CONSOLE TA SEE IF IT SPARKS}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO BOWLIN'. IT IZ ONE EVENIN'!
ASK WHY DEY REALLY WANTED YOU DERE!
SAY NO, KINDLY, AN' MEAN IT!
SAY YES, AN' MAKE IT INTERESTIN': PUT MONEY ON IT!

a.text:
{lane}. SHOES DAT FIT NOBODY. A JUKEBOX DAT ONLY PLAYS DA FOUR SONGS, AN' {drink} IN PLASTIC CUPS, AN' YA COUSIN BUYIN' EVERY ROUND AN' REFUSIN' TA LET ANYBODY ELSE PAY.
BY FRAME FOUR DA WHOLE PARTY IZ IN IT. BY FRAME SIX {cousin} HAB STOPPED TALKIN' 'BOUT DA FAMILY AN' STARTED LOOKIN' AT DA DOOR EVERY TIME IT OPENS.
BY FRAME NINE YOU CAN SEE DERE IZ A REASON. FRAME TEN IZ GOING TA BE 'BOUT DA REASON. BUT DERE IZ STILL TWO FRAMES TA BOWL FIRST.
FRAME TEN. TWO MEN COME IN WHO DID NO BOOK A LANE, AN' {cousin} MISSES DA SHOT DEY HAB BIN MAKIN' ALL NIGHT!
a.bubba: BUBBA BOWLS LIKE A MAN THROWIN' A CHAIR THROUGH A WINDOW AN' IZ SOMEHOW LEADIN'. "STRIKE! AOH! 'A PALLA VO' 'O RISPETTO!"

asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.hedonistic: {member} IZ FOUR DRINKS IN AN' HAVIN' DA NIGHT OF DEY LIFE!
asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.artistic: {member} SAYS DA LIGHT IN HERE IZ DA BEST LIGHT IN DA WHOLE CITY AN' DEY IZ NO JOKIN'!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
DEY STOP STEERIN' YOU. DAT IZ HOW YOU KNOW.
"ME OWE SOMEBODY," DEY SAY, TA DA PAVEMENT. "NO MUCH. IT GOT NO-MUCH FOR A WHILE AN' DEN IT GOT TA BE DIS MUCH. AN' DEY KNOW ME HAB GOT FAMILY WHO CAN, YOU KNOW. HANDLE THEMSELVES."
ALL DEY IZ ASKIN' IZ FOR YOU TA SIT IN A BOWLIN' ALLEY FOR TWO HOURS LOOKIN' LIKE DA SORT OF PEOPLE WHO MIGHT!

asides.authoritative: {member} {BARKS OUT ORDERS TA SECURE DA PERIMETER|DEMANDS STATUS REPORTS ON DA DOUBLE|REMINDS EVERYONE TA MAINTAIN RADIO DISCIPLINE|TAKES CHARGE OF DA ENTRY TEAM WIT A BRISK NOD}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: SIT IN DA ALLEY AN' LOOK EXPENSIVE!
PAY DA DEBT OFF YOURSELF.
GO AN' HAB A WORD WIT DA SOMEBODY INSTEAD!

c.text:
YOU SAY NO, AN' YOU SAY IT KINDLY, AN' IT LANDS LIKE A SLAP ANYWAY.
{cousin} TAKES IT WELL IN DA WAY PEOPLE TAKE TINKZ WELL WHEN DEY HAB RUN OUT OF OTHER FIDDLY BITS: WIT A JOKE, AN' A SHRUG, AN' AN INVITATION TA DA WEDDIN' IN DA AUTUMN DAT EVERYBODY KNOWS YOU WILL NO BE AT.
TWO STREETS LATER {member} SAYS DA TINK EVERYBODY WAZ THINKIN', AN' YOU TURN ROUND!

choices.text: TURN ROUND AN' GO BACK.
KEEP WALKIN'.

asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.melancholic: {member} SAYS NUTTIN' FOR A COUPLE OF STREETS, WHICH SAYS IT!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

d.text:
"MONEY," SAYS {cousin}, DELIGHTED AN' TERRIFIED. "FINE. RIGHT. MONEY. LOSER BUYS DA LOT."
DA STAKE GROWS ON DA WAY TA {lane}, DA WAY STAKES DO, AN' BY DA TIME DA SHOES IZ ON IT IZ {stake}, AN' BY FRAME FOUR IT IZ MORE DEN DAT, AN' BY FRAME SIX DERE IZ FOUR MEN AT DA BAR WHO DID NO COME TA BOWL AN' WHO IZ EXTREMELY INTERESTED IN DA SCORE.
FRAME TEN, AN' DA FOUR AT DA BAR HAB STOPPED PRETENDIN' TA DRINK!

b1.text:
TWO HOURS OF BOWLIN' BADLY AN' LOOKIN' CAPABLE. IT IZ DA EASIEST MONEY ANYBODY HAB EVER NO BIN PAID.
AT HALF NINE, TWO MEN COME IN, LOOK AT DA FOUR OF YOU FOR SLIGHTLY TOO LONG, AN' BUY {cousin} A DRINK INSTEAD OF WHAT DEY CAME TA DO. NOBODY'S HAND GOES ANYWHERE NEAR ANYTINK.
YA COUSIN CRIES IN DA CAR PARK AN' DEN INSISTS ON DRIVIN' YOU ALL TA A PLACE DAT DOES FOOD AT DAT HOUR!

b2.text:
YOU PAY IT. IT IZ NO A LIL' AMOUNT AN' IT IZ NO A LARGE ONE, AN' HANDIN' IT OVER IN A BOWLIN' ALLEY CAR PARK TA A MAN WHO COUNTS IT IN HIS COAT POCKET IZ ONE OF DA LEAST DRAMATIC TINKZ YOU WILL DO ALL YEAR.
{cousin} TRIES TA REFUSE AN' DEN DOES NO. WHAT YOU GET OUT OF IT IZ A COUSIN, PERMANENTLY, AN' A FAMILY DAT NOW SAYS YA NAME AT CHRISTMAS, AN', FOUR MONTHS LATER, A FAVOUR REPAID WIT ENORMOUS INTEREST!

b3.text:
DA SOMEBODY WORKS OUT OF A BACK ROOM BEHIND {bar} AN' IZ NO, WHEN YOU GET DERE, ESPECIALLY FRIGHTENIN'.
WHAT HE IZ IZ ORGANISED, AN' HE HAB ELEVEN OTHER PEOPLE ON DA SAME BOOK, AN' DA CONVERSATION GOES DA WAY CONVERSATIONS GO WHEN BOTH SIDES HAB MADE DEY POINT IN DA FIRST THIRTY SECONDS AN' EVERYBODY ELSE IN DA ROOM IZ HOLDIN' A BOTTLE!

c1.text:
YOU KEEP WALKIN', AN' IT IZ FINE, AN' IT IZ FINE FOR 'BOUT A WEEK.
DEN DERE IZ A PHONE CALL FROM AN AUNT YOU NO CAN PLACE, AN' DA NEWS IN IT IZ NO TERRIBLE, QUITE, BUT IT IZ DA SORT OF NEWS DAT WOULD HAB BIN BETTER IF SOMEBODY HAB BIN IN A BOWLIN' ALLEY ON DA TUESDAY!

b2_m.text:
YOU PAY IT. IT IZ NO A LIL' AMOUNT AN' IT IZ NO A LARGE ONE, AN' HANDIN' IT OVER IN A BOWLIN' ALLEY CAR PARK TA A MAN WHO COUNTS IT {TWICE|IN DA DARK|WITOUT LOOKIN' AT ANYBODY} TAKES 'BOUT FOUR MINUTES.
HE COUNTS IT A THIRD TIME AN' DEN SAYS, PLEASANTLY, DAT DIS CLEARS {LAST MONTH|DA FIRST ONE|ONE OF DEM}, AN' ASKS WHICH OF DA OTHERS DA PARTY WOULD LIKE TA SETTLE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DERE IZ ALWAYS ANOTHER ONE.|YA COUSIN SAID NO MUCH. HE SAID NO MUCH.|WE HAB JUST BIN INTRODUCED TA A SCHEDULE.}"

choices.text: PAY DA LOT. CLEAR IT ALL TONIGHT!
GET DA WHOLE ACCOUNT OUT OF HIM FIRST!
STOP PAYIN'. GO AN' HAB A WORD INSTEAD!

b2_acct.text:
IT TAKES {A COUPLE OF QUESTIONS|TEN MINUTES|A NOTEBOOK} TA ESTABLISH DAT DERE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN} OF DEZE RUNNIN' ON DA SAME STREET AN' DAT DA INTEREST IZ CHARGED WEEKLY ON DA ORIGINAL IN EVERY ONE OF DEM, WHICH MAKES IT {A FARM|AN ANNUITY|A BUSINESS MODEL}.
WRITTEN DOWN LIKE DAT IT IZ ALSO, IN DIS COUNTRY, ENTIRELY ILLEGAL, AN' DERE IZ A DESK DAT PAYS FOR EXACTLY DIS KIND OF PAGE!

b2_worse.text:
ASKIN' A MAN IN A CAR PARK TA ITEMISE WHAT HE IZ OWED IZ TAKEN AS AN ACCUSATION, WHICH IT IZ, AN' HE STOPS BEING PLEASANT {IMMEDIATELY|BETWEEN ONE WORD AN' DA NEXT|WITOUT ANY TRANSITION AT ALL}.
DA MONEY ALREADY HANDED OVER IZ GONE AN' IZ NO CREDITED AGAINST ANYTINK. {cousin} IZ {FOUR HUNDRED|DA SAME AMOUNT|WORSE OFF} DEEPER DEN DEY WAZ AT NINE O'CLOCK AN' WILL NO LOOK AT ANYBODY ON DA WAY HOME!

e_city_checkpoint.title: {DA PUBLICATION ORDER|CHECKPOINT ON {street}|EVERYTINK YOU IZ CARRYIN'}

n0.text:
A CHECKPOINT ACROSS {street} DAT WAZ NO DERE YESTERDAY: TWO VANS, A FOLDIN' TABLE, AN' FOUR PEOPLE IN ARCHIVE FOUNDATION COATS GOING THROUGH A QUEUE OF CITIZENS' BAGS ITEM BY ITEM.
DEY IZ READIN'. EVERY BOOK, EVERY LETTER, EVERY NOTEBOOK, AN' ANYTINK DEY READ GOES IN A CRATE.
DA QUEUE IZ NO COMPLAININ'. DAT IZ DA PART DAT GETS YOU. NOBODY IN DA QUEUE IZ COMPLAININ'.
DA CRATE ON DA FOLDIN' TABLE IZ {ADDRESSED|STENCILLED|LABELLED} TA AN ADDRESS ON DIS STREET!
n0.emText:
A FOUNDATION CHECKPOINT ON {street}, FOUR COATS GOING THROUGH A QUEUE OF ORDINARY PEOPLE'S BAGS, READIN' EVERYTINK AN' CRATIMG ANYTINK WRITTEN.
A PUBLICATION ORDER: EVERYTINK MUST BE KNOWN, IMMEDIATELY, IN PUBLIC. SOMEWHERE IN A BUILDIN' IN BRITANNIA DERE IZ A FILE ON DA WOMAN YOU WAZ, AN' IT IZ DA ONLY COPY OF HER DAT EXISTS, AN' YOU WOULD LET DEM READ EVERY LETTER YOU OWN FOR FOUR MINUTES WIT IT!
n0.bubba: BUBBA SHIFTS SOMETINK FROM HIS COAT TA HIS BOOT WITOUT APPEARIN' TA MOVE. "SUGAR. 'A LIBBRA. DA BOOK. NO LET 'EM HAB DA BOOK."

choices.text: QUEUE, AN' HAND OVER EVERYTINK!
GO ROUND. DERE IZ ALWAYS A WAY ROUND!
ASK TA SEE DA ORDER.
TAKE DA CRATE.

a.text:
DEY IZ POLITE, QUICK, AN' THOROUGH, AN' DEY READ FASTER DEN ANYBODY SHOULD BE ABLE TA.
EVERYTINK WRITTEN IZ COPIED. NUTTIN' IZ KEPT. AT DA END DEY HAND YOU A RECEIPT WIT A CATALOGUE NUMBER ON IT AN' TELL YOU, SINCERELY, DAT YA NOTEBOOK IZ NOW SAFE FOREVER, AN' DAT DIS IZ A SERVICE!

choices.text: ASK WHAT HAPPENS TA DA COPIES!
ASK DEM TA LOOK SOMETINK UP FOR YOU WHILE YOU IZ HERE!

b.text: DA WAY ROUND IZ A YARD, A WALL AN' A FIRE ESCAPE, AN' AT DA TOP OF DA FIRE ESCAPE DERE IZ A FIFTH FOUNDATION COAT SITTIN' ON DA STEPS WIT A FLASK, ENTIRELY RELAXED, WHO SAYS: "EVERYONE COMES UP HERE. SIT DOWN. YOU HAB GOT 'BOUT A COUPLE OF MINUTES BEFORE ME COLLEAGUE LOOKS UP."

choices.text: SIT DOWN AN' TALK TA DEM.
GO PAST DEM.

c.text:
DEY PRODUCE IT IMMEDIATELY, LAMINATED, IN FOUR LANGUAGES, AN' IT IZ REAL, AN' IT IZ SIGNED, AN' DA TINK IT AUTHORISES IZ ENORMOUS.
IT NAMES DIS STREET, DIS WEEK, AN' ONE DOCUMENT, AN' DA DESCRIPTION OF DA DOCUMENT IZ FOUR LINES LONG AN' ONE OF DA LINES DESCRIBES SOMETINK YOU IZ CARRYIN'!

choices.text: HAND IT OVER.
LIE.

d.text:
DA CRATE IZ ON DA FOLDIN' TABLE. DERE IZ FOUR OF DEM AN' A STREET FULL OF WITNESSES AN' A VAN WIT ITS BACK DOORS OPEN.
YOU GET ELEVEN METRES WIT IT. WHAT HAPPENS IN DA ELEVEN METRES IZ DAT DA ENTIRE QUEUE, EVERY ONE OF WHOM WAZ STANDIN' DERE QUIETLY HANDIN' OVER DEY LETTERS, GETS BETWEEN YOU AN' DA COATS WITOUT DISCUSSIN' IT FIRST!

a1.text:
"EVERYTINK, IMMEDIATELY, IN PUBLIC," DEY SAY, AN' MEAN IT, AN' SHOW YOU: DA COPIES GO ON A PUBLIC CATALOGUE DAT ANYBODY MAY READ.
ANYBODY. INCLUDIN' DA FOUR PEOPLE WHOSE LETTERS YOU HAB JUST WATCHED GO INTO DA CRATE, AN' INCLUDIN' WHOEVER DEY WAZ WRITIN' TA HIDE FROM!

a2.text:
DEY CAN, AN' DEY DO, ON DA SPOT, OUT OF A CARD INDEX IN DA VAN.
WHAT YOU GET IZ A FEW LINES 'BOUT A TINK YOU HAB BIN CHASIN' FOR A SEASON, AN' IT COSTS YOU EVERY NOTEBOOK IN DA PARTY, COPIED, CATALOGUED AN' PUBLIC FOREVER, AN' IT IZ WORTH IT AN' YOU WILL TINK 'BOUT DA PRICE FOR A LONG TIME!

b1.text:
DEY IZ MOST OF A YEAR INTO DA JOB AN' DEY HAB NO SLEPT PROPERLY SINCE DA SECOND MONTH, AN' DEY TALK FOR A SHORT WHILE 'BOUT WHAT DEY HAB READ ON DIS STREET DIS WEEK.
DEN DEY TELL YOU WHICH WAY IZ ACTUALLY CLEAR, AN' GIVE YOU A NAME TA USE IF YOU IZ STOPPED, AN' GO BACK TA DEY FLASK!

b2.text: YOU GO PAST DEM AN' DEY DO NO STOP YOU, AN' AT DA BOTTOM OF DA FAR STAIRS DERE IZ TWO MORE COATS WHO WAZ TOLD YOU WAZ COMIN' BY DA ONE ON DA STEPS, AN' WHO IZ NO RELAXED AT ALL!

c1.text:
YOU HAND OVER A TINK YOU DID NO KNOW YOU WAZ CARRYIN' UNDER A DESCRIPTION FOUR LINES LONG, AN' DA CHANGE IN DA FOUR OF DEM IZ IMMEDIATE AN' TOTAL.
ONE OF DEM SITS DOWN ON DA FOLDIN' TABLE. ANOTHER ONE GETS ON A RADIO. DEY PAY YOU WHAT AN OFFICE PAYS WHEN AN OFFICE IZ NO ALLOWED TA BE PLEASED IN PUBLIC, AN' ONE OF DEM SAYS THANK YOU IN A WAY DAT IZ NO PROCEDURE!

c2.text:
YOU LIE TA DA ARCHIVE FOUNDATION ON A PUBLIC STREET WIT DA ORDER IN YA HAND, WHICH IZ A SPECIFIC AN' FAMOUS KIND OF MISTAKE.
DEY LET YOU THROUGH. DEY IZ EXTREMELY PLEASANT 'BOUT IT. AN' FOR DA NEXT FOUR MONTHS, EVERYWHERE YOU GO, SOMEBODY IN A COAT IZ ALREADY DERE, BEING PLEASANT!

a2_m.text:
DEY CAN LOOK IT UP AN' DEY DO, ON DA SPOT, OUT OF A CARD INDEX IN DA VAN, WHICH TAKES {NINETY SECONDS|NO TIME|FOUR CARDS}.
WHAT COMES BACK IZ FOUR LINES 'BOUT A TINK DA PARTY HAB BIN CARRYIN' FOR {A SEASON|A WHILE|MONTHS}, AN' DA FOURTH LINE IZ A CROSS-REFERENCE, AN' DA CROSS-REFERENCE IZ TA DA CRATE ON DA TABLE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DEY HAB JUST TOLD US WE IZ PART OF DA SEIZURE.|DAT CARD HAB OUR OWN KIT ON IT.|DO NO REACH FOR DA PACK.}"
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS BOTH HANDS ON DA STRAP|READS DA CARD UPSIDE DOWN|DOES NO MOVE}

choices.text: TAKE DA FOUR LINES AN' SAY NUTTIN'!
ASK TA SEE DA CRATE'S OWN CARD!
HAND YA OWN TINK IN TA BE CATALOGUED WIT IT!

a2_card.text:
DA ORDER IZ PUBLIC AN' SO, BY DA SAME ORDER, IZ DA INDEX, WHICH DA OFFICER ON DA TABLE CONCEDES {IMMEDIATELY|WITOUT ARGUIN'|WIT SOMETINK LIKE RELIEF}.
DA CRATE'S CARD NAMES {FOUR|FIVE} OBJECTS, A FINDER, AN' A DATE, AN' DA FINDER IZ SOMEBODY DA PARTY HAB MET, AN' DA DATE IZ {BEFORE DA CRATE WAZ FOUND|A FEW WEEKS BEFORE DA SEIZURE|EARLIER DEN DA PAPERWORK ALLOWS}!

a2_hand.text:
IT GOES ON DA FOLDIN' TABLE BESIDE DA CRATE AN' IZ CATALOGUED IN PUBLIC, IN FOUR LANGUAGES, WIT DA PARTY NAMED AS DA FINDERS, WHICH TAKES {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|LONGER DEN HANDIN' IT OVER}.
DEY PAY DA FINDER'S RATE, WHICH IZ LOWER DEN A FENCE'S AN' IZ PAID ON DA SPOT IN CASH, AN' DA CATALOGUE ENTRY IZ READABLE BY ANYBODY FOR EVER, WHICH TURNS OUT TA MATTER {YEARS|A LONG TIME|LATER} IN A WAY NOBODY AT DA TABLE PREDICTS!

c2_m.text:
YOU LIE TA DA ARCHIVE FOUNDATION ON A PUBLIC STREET WIT DA ORDER IN YA HAND, WHICH IZ A SPECIFIC AN' FAMOUS KIND OF MISTAKE, AN' IT WORKS FOR 'BOUT {A BREATH OR TWO|A MOMENT|AS LONG AS IT TAKES DEM TA READ A FACE}.
DA ONE AT DA END OF DA TABLE DOES NO SAY ANYTINK. DEY WRITE ONE WORD ON A CARD, AN' TURN DA CARD FACE DOWN, AN' GO ON WIT DA QUEUE AS THOUGH DA PARTY WAZ ALREADY SOMEWHERE ELSE!

choices.text: WALK AWAY WHILE DA WALKIN' IZ GOOD!
TAKE DA LIE BACK. NOW, OUT LOUD, IN FRONT OF DA QUEUE!
READ DA CARD.

c2_take.text:
UNSAYIN' A LIE TA DA FOUNDATION IN PUBLIC IZ {A SOCIAL MOVE|A PERFORMANCE|SOMETINK DA CATALOGUE RECORDS}, AN' IT IZ DONE CLEARLY AN' COMPLETELY IN FRONT OF {ELEVEN|A DOZEN} WITNESSES.
DEY ACCEPT IT, IN PUBLIC, WHICH DEY IZ OBLIGED TA DO, AN' DEY WRITE DAT DOWN TOO. DA TINK IZ HANDED OVER. NUTTIN' IZ CHARGED. DA PARTY'S NAME IZ NOW IN A CATALOGUE ATTACHED TA DA WORDS {"WITHDREW"|"CORRECTED"|"RECANTED, UNPROMPTED"}, WHICH READS BETTER DEN MOST ENTRIES IN DERE!

c2_worse.text:
DA RETRACTION COMES OUT {BADLY|AS A SECOND LIE|WORSE DEN DA FIRST ONE} AN' DA QUEUE CAN HEAR IT AN' SO CAN DA CARD INDEX.
DA SEIZURE IZ EXTENDED TA DA PARTY'S OWN PACKS ON DA SPOT, LAWFULLY, WIT DA ORDER HELD UP AT ARM'S LENGTH, AN' WHAT COMES OUT OF DEM IZ CATALOGUED IN PUBLIC WIT DA PARTY STANDIN' DERE!

c2_card.text:
DA CARD IZ FACE DOWN ON A FOLDIN' TABLE IN DA OPEN AN' IT TAKES {FOUR SECONDS|ONE MOVEMENT|NO TIME} TA TURN IT OVER AN' PUT IT BACK.
DA WORD ON IT IZ DA PARTY'S OWN NAME, SPELLED CORRECTLY, AN' IT WAZ WRITTEN BEFORE ANYBODY GAVE IT. UNDERNEATH IT DERE IZ A SECOND LINE, IN DA SAME HAND, WHICH IZ A DATE, AN' DA DATE IZ {NEXT SPRING|FOUR MONTHS OUT|NO YET}!

e_city_hall.title: {DA TABLE IN DA BACK|NINE BALL, TWO RULES|DA HALL ON {street}}

n0.text:
A POOL HALL ON {street} WIT ELEVEN TABLES AN' ONE OF DEM ROPED OFF WIT A LENGTH OF CURTAIN CORD.
DA ROPED TABLE IZ DA BEST TABLE IN DA ROOM: NEW CLOTH, TRUE, LIT. NOBODY PLAYS ON IT. DERE IZ TWO RULES ON A CARD ON DA RAIL, HAND-LETTERED, AN' DA SECOND ONE HAB BIN ADDED LATER IN DIFFERENT INK.
ONE: NUTTIN' ON DA TABLE BUT DA BALLS.
TWO: IF SOMEBODY IZ ALREADY PLAYIN', LET DEM FINISH.
DA CURTAIN CORD IZ {NEW|REPLACED OFTEN|NO DA ORIGINAL}, AN' DA TABLE UNDER IT HAB BIN {RE-CLOTHED|RECOVERED|KEPT} AT SOMEBODY'S EXPENSE!
n0.emText:
ELEVEN TABLES IN A HALL ON {street} AN' DA BEST ONE ROPED OFF WIT CURTAIN CORD, UNDER A CARD WIT TWO RULES, DA SECOND ADDED LATER IN DIFFERENT INK.
ONE: NUTTIN' ON DA TABLE BUT DA BALLS.
