choices.text: PLAY ON IT.
ASK DA BARMAN.
PUT SOMETINK ON DA TABLE.
WATCH IT FOR AN HOUR.

a.text:
YOU RACK, YOU BREAK, AN' EVERYTINK RUNS TRUE, AN' IT IZ DA BEST TABLE ANY OF YOU HAB EVER PLAYED ON.
AT 'BOUT DA THIRD RACK YOU NOTICE DAT DA CUE BALL IZ COMIN' BACK OFF DA CUSHION INTO POSITIONS YOU HAB NO PLAYED, AN' DAT YOU IZ, IN FACT, IN A FRAME WIT SOMEBODY, AN' DAT DEY IZ AHEAD!

b.text:
"FRAME'S BIN GOING SINCE EIGHTY-NINE," HE SAYS, WITOUT LOOKIN' UP FROM DA GLASS HE IZ DRYIN'. "TWO OF DEM STARTED IT. ONE OF DEM'S DEAD. IT IZ NO FINISHED."
DA LIVIN' ONE COMES IN ON THURSDAYS, PLAYS HIS SHOT, AN' GOES HOME. SOMETIMES DERE IZ A SHOT PLAYED BACK AN' SOMETIMES DERE IZ NO, AN' HE WAITS, AN' HE HAB WAITED AS LONG AS A COUPLE OF MONTHS!

choices.text: COME BACK ON THURSDAY AN' WATCH!
ASK IF YOU CAN PLAY DA DEAD MAN'S SHOT!

c.text:
YOU PUT A GLASS DOWN ON DA CLOTH OF A TABLE WIT A RULE 'BOUT IT, IN A HALL WHERE EVERYBODY KNOWS DA RULE.
DA ROOM GOES QUIET IN 'BOUT A SECOND AN' A HALF. WHAT COMES OFF DA TABLE IZ NO DA GLASS!

d.text:
AN HOUR OF WATCHIN' A TABLE NOBODY IZ PLAYIN' ON, IN A ROOM WHERE ELEVEN OTHER TABLES IZ IN USE AN' NOBODY LOOKS AT DIS ONE.
AT 'BOUT DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR A BALL MOVES A FRACTION, DA SETTLIN' OF A SHOT PLAYED SOMEWHERE ELSE, AN' DA BALLS ON DAT TABLE IZ NOW IN A POSITION DAT A PERSON WOULD HAB TA HAB PLAYED!

b1.text:
HE IZ 'BOUT SEVENTY AN' HE PLAYS ONE SHOT, BADLY, AN' STANDS BACK, AN' WAITS, AN' DA WHOLE HALL PRETENDS NO TA WATCH.
DA ANSWERIN' SHOT COMES AT FOUR MINUTES PAST NINE. IT IZ A BEAUTIFUL SHOT. HE LAUGHS AT IT, OUT LOUD, LIKE A MAN AT A MATE'S JOKE, AN' DEN HE BUYS EVERYBODY IN DA HALL A DRINK AN' CRIES IN DA DOORWAY ON DA WAY OUT!

b2.text:
DA OLD MAN THINKS 'BOUT IT FOR A REAL LONG TIME AN' DEN SAYS YES, AN' HANDS YOU DA DEAD MAN'S CUE, WHICH IZ BEHIND DA BAR IN A CASE.
YOU PLAY A SHOT ON BEHALF OF SOMEBODY YOU NEVER MET, IN A FRAME DAT STARTED IN 1989, AN' YOU PLAY IT WELL, AN' DA OLD MAN PUTS A HAND OVER HIS MOUTH.
WHAT YOU IZ GIVEN AFTERWARDS, BY BOTH OF DEM, IZ NO A LIL' TINK!

d_m.text:
AN HOUR OF WATCHIN' A TABLE NOBODY IZ PLAYIN' ON, IN A ROOM WHERE ELEVEN OTHER TABLES IZ IN USE AN' NOBODY LOOKS AT DA TWELFTH.
IN DA FIFTY-FIRST MINUTE A BALL MOVES {FOUR INCHES|A HAND'S WIDTH|DA LENGTH OF A FINGER}, ACROSS A LEVEL CLOTH, WIT NOBODY WITHIN THREE METRES OF IT, AN' DA ROOM DOES NO REACT, WHICH MEANS DA ROOM IZ USED TA IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{NOBODY LOOKED UP. NOBODY.|DAT IZ A FRAME IN PROGRESS.|DEY IZ GIVIN' DA TABLE ROOM.}"
asides.any: {member} {MARKS WHERE DA BALL WAZ WIT A BEER MAT|CHECKS DA LEVEL OF DA TABLE WIT A COIN|GOES TA DA BAR}

choices.text: KEEP WATCHIN'. SAY NUTTIN'!
CHART DA POSITION AFTER EVERY SHOT!
TAKE DA SHOT DAT IZ OBVIOUSLY ON!

d_chart.text:
FOUR HOURS, THREE EVENINGS, AN' A NOTEBOOK: EVERY POSITION, EVERY INTERVAL, DRAWN TA SCALE ON SQUARED PAPER BY SOMEBODY WIT A STEADY HAND.
DA FRAME IZ {LEGAL|CORRECT|A REAL FRAME}. WHOEVER IZ PLAYIN' IT IZ {FOUR SHOTS|TWO SHOTS|ONE SHOT} FROM A FINISH DAT HAB BIN COMIN' SINCE {EIGHTY-NINE|DA YEAR IT STARTED|DA BEGINNIN'}, AN' IT IZ POSSIBLE, FROM DA CHART, TA SAY WHICH POCKET!

d_shot.text:
A CUE OFF DA RACK, A SHOT NOBODY ASKED FOR, PLAYED ON A ROPED TABLE IN A FULL HALL, AN' DA ROOM {STOPS|GOES QUIET|PUTS ITS GLASSES DOWN} AS DA CUE COMES BACK.
IT GOES IN. DEN EVERYTINK ON DA TABLE MOVES AT ONCE, AN' DA FRAME DAT HAB BIN GOING SINCE EIGHTY-NINE IZ {OVER|RUINED|FINISHED DA WRONG WAY}, AN' DA HALL IZ ON ITS FEET, AN' DA OLD MAN WHO STARTED IT IZ ONE OF DA PEOPLE ON DEY FEET!

b2_m.text:
DA OLD MAN THINKS 'BOUT IT FOR A REAL LONG TIME AN' DEN SAYS YES, AN' HANDS OVER DA DEAD MAN'S CUE, WHICH IZ BEHIND DA BAR IN A CASE AN' COMES OUT OF DA CASE {ONCE A YEAR|RARELY|FOR DIS}.
DA SHOT ON IZ {A LONG SCREW BACK|A PLANT|NO AN EASY ONE} AN' EVERYBODY IN DA HALL KNOWS IT, AN' DA HALL ARRANGES ITSELF ROUND DA TABLE WITOUT BEING ASKED TA, DA WAY A CONGREGATION DOES!

choices.text: PLAY IT. TAKE DA SHOT.
PLAY IT DA WAY DA DEAD MAN WOULD HAB!
HAND DA CUE BACK. IT IZ NO YA TA PLAY WIT!

b2_dead.text:
SOMEBODY IN DA PARTY HAB WATCHED ENOUGH OF DA OLD MEN IN DIS HALL TA KNOW DAT DA DEAD MAN PLAYED {EVERYTINK OFF DA CUSHION|WIT SIDE|SLOW}, AN' DA SHOT IZ PLAYED DAT WAY, AN' IT IZ DA WRONG CHOICE TECHNICALLY AN' IT IZ DA RIGHT ONE HERE.
IT GOES. DA HALL MAKES A NOISE IT HAB NO MADE IN {YEARS AN' YEARS|A DECADE|SINCE EIGHTY-NINE}, AN' DA CUE GOES BACK IN DA CASE, AN' DA PARTY DRINKS FREE UNTIL DA DOORS IZ LOCKED!

b2_miss.text:
IT IZ PLAYED WELL AN' IT IZ PLAYED WRONG, IN DA MODERN WAY, WIT DA CUE DAT IZ NO DA RIGHT CUE FOR IT, AN' DA OBJECT BALL {RATTLES|SITS IN DA JAWS|COMES BACK}.
NOBODY SAYS ANYTINK. DA OLD MAN TAKES DA CUE BACK AN' PUTS IT IN DA CASE AN' THANKS DA PARTY FOR TRYIN', WHICH IZ WORSE DEN ANYTINK HE COULD HAB SAID, AN' DA HALL GOES BACK TA ITS OWN TABLES!

b2_back.text:
DA CUE GOES BACK INTO DA OLD MAN'S HANDS UNPLAYED, WIT DA REASON SAID OUT LOUD SO DA HALL CAN HEAR IT, WHICH TAKES {FOUR WORDS|ONE SENTENCE|A MOMENT}.
HE PLAYS IT HIMSELF. HE MISSES. HE LAUGHS, FOR DA FIRST TIME SINCE ANYBODY IN DAT HALL CAN REMEMBER, AN' DEN HE SITS DOWN WIT DA PARTY FOR DA REST OF DA EVENIN' AN' TELLS DEM WHAT HAPPENED IN EIGHTY-NINE!

e_village_bell.title: {DA BELL DAT RINGS ITSELF|HOUSE AFTER HOUSE AN' A ROPE|DA WRONG HOURS}

n0.text:
FORTY HOUSES, ONE CHURCH, AN' A BELL DAT RINGS AT HOURS DAT IZ NO HOURS: TWENTY PAST FOUR, TEN TA NINE, SEVEN MINUTES PAST ELEVEN.
DA ROPE IZ TIED OFF. IT HAB BIN TIED OFF FOR YEARS, IN A KNOT DAT DA SEXTON RENEWS EVERY SUNDAY, AN' DA BELL RINGS ANYWAY AN' DA ROPE DOES NO MOVE.
DA VILLAGE HAB ADAPTED. DEY HAB A NOTE PINNED IN DA SHOP OF WHAT EACH WRONG HOUR MEANS, AN' EVERYBODY READS IT, AN' NOBODY DISCUSSES IT.
DA KNOT IZ A {SHEEPSHANK|SPECIFIC KNOT|KNOT WIT A NAME}, AN' IT IZ TIED SO DAT IT WILL FAIL IF IT IZ PULLED FROM BELOW!
n0.emText:
A BELL DAT RINGS AT HOURS DAT IZ NO HOURS, WIT DA ROPE TIED OFF IN A KNOT RENEWED EVERY SUNDAY, AN' A NOTE PINNED UP IN DA SHOP TELLIN' FORTY HOUSEHOLDS WHAT EACH WRONG HOUR MEANS.
DEY HAB BUILT A WORKIN' LITURGY AROUND SOMETINK NOBODY UNDERSTANDS. DAT IZ WHAT PEOPLE DO. IT IZ MORE OR LESS WHAT HAB BIN DONE WIT YOU, IN FOUR COUNTRIES, BY PEOPLE WHO HAB NEVER MET YOU!
n0.bubba: BUBBA READS DA NOTE IN DA SHOP TWICE AN' BUYS A PACKET OF BISCUITS OUT OF POLITENESS. "TWENTY PAST FOUR MEANS 'STAY IN'. AOH. NUN E' OVERO. DAT IZ A VILLAGE WIT A SCHEDULE FOR DA UNCANNY."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}

choices.text: GO UP DA TOWER.
BE IN DA SQUARE AT A WRONG HOUR AN' WATCH WHAT DA VILLAGE DOES!
ASK DA SEXTON 'BOUT DA KNOT!
UNTIE DA ROPE.

a.text:
SIXTY-ONE STEPS AN' A TRAPDOOR, AN' DA BELL CHAMBER IZ CLEAN, SWEPT, AN' LIVED IN: A CHAIR, A LAMP, FOUR BOOKS, AN' A CHALK TALLY ON DA BEAM DAT RUNS INTO DA THOUSANDS.
SOMEBODY HAB BIN COUNTIN' DA WRONG HOURS. DEY HAB BIN DOING IT FROM UP HERE, IN DIS CHAIR, AN' DA DUST ON DA CHAIR IZ A FORTNIGHT OLD AT MOST!

choices.text: SIT IN DA CHAIR UNTIL DA NEXT WRONG HOUR!
READ DA FOUR BOOKS.

b.text:
TWENTY PAST FOUR. IT TAKES A LONG MINUTE: SHUTTERS, DOORS, AN' DA SHOP BOLTED, ALL OF IT DONE WITOUT HURRY BY PEOPLE WHO HAB BIN DOING IT FOR YEARS.
DA SQUARE IZ YA. IT STAYS YA FOR A GOOD WHILE AN' DEN DA BELL STOPS AN' DA SHUTTERS GO BACK, AN' ONE WOMAN LOOKS AT YOU STANDIN' IN DA MIDDLE OF DA SQUARE AN' PUTS HER HAND OVER HER MOUTH!

choices.text: ASK HER WHAT SHOULD HAB HAPPENED!
BE IN DA SQUARE AGAIN AT SEVEN MINUTES PAST ELEVEN!

c.text:
"ME FATHER TIED IT," HE SAYS. "HIS FATHER TIED IT. ME RENEW IT SUNDAYS COZ DA KNOT GOES SOFT, AN' ME DO NO KNOW WHAT HAPPENS IF IT NO IZ DERE, AN' ME IZ NO DA MAN WHO FINDS OUT."
HE SHOWS YOU DA KNOT. NO SAILOR OR BELLRINGER WOULD USE IT. IN FACT IT IZ ONE CONTINUOUS PIECE OF ROPE DAT HAB BIN MADE INTO DAT SHAPE WITOUT EITHER END GOING THROUGH ANYTINK!

d.text:
IT COMES APART IN YA HANDS LIKE DA ROPE WANTS TA BE HELPFUL.
DA BELL RINGS AT ONCE, AN' DOES NO STOP, AN' RINGS EVERY HOUR ON DA HOUR FOR DA BEST PART OF A WEEK, CORRECTLY, PROPERLY, DA WAY A BELL SHOULD, AN' DA VILLAGE STANDS IN DA STREET LISTENIN' TA A RIGHT HOUR FOR DA FIRST TIME IN THREE GENERATIONS AN' DOES NO KNOW WHAT TA DO WIT ITSELF.
ON DA FIFTH DAY IT STOPS, AN' SOMETINK IN DA TOWER HAB GONE, AN' DA VILLAGE IZ QUIETER DEN ANY OF YOU HAB EVER HEARD A PLACE BE!

a1.text:
TEN TA NINE. DA BELL MOVES. NUTTIN' IZ HOLDIN' IT AN' NUTTIN' SWINGS IT: DA METAL SIMPLY IZ ON ONE SIDE AN' DEN DA OTHER, AN' IT IZ MUCH LOUDER IN HERE DEN A BELL SHOULD BE, AN' IT HURTS.
IN DA MIDDLE OF IT, IN DA CHAIR, YOU UNDERSTAND DA COUNT ON DA BEAM: IT IZ COUNTIN' DOWN!

a2.text:
FOUR NOTEBOOKS: A LIFETIME OF WORK OF WRONG HOURS, DATED AN' TIMED, WIT DA WEATHER, AN' A COLUMN FOR WHAT HAPPENED IN DA VILLAGE DAT DAY.
HALFWAY THROUGH DA THIRD BOOK DA HANDWRITIN' CHANGES. IN DA FOURTH, IT CHANGES AGAIN, AN' DA LAST ENTRY IZ A FORTNIGHT OLD, AN' IT SAYS: "HANDIN' OVER. WHOEVER COMES UP NEXT, SIT IN DA CHAIR."

b1.text:
"NUTTIN'," SHE SAYS. "TA YOU, NUTTIN'. DAT IZ DA BIT DAT COSTS."
SHE EXPLAINS IT OVER TEA, IN ELEVEN MINUTES, AN' BY DA END OF IT YOU UNDERSTAND DAT DA BELL WAZ WARNIN' DEM 'BOUT SOMETINK DAT STOPPED COMIN' YEARS AGO, AN' DAT DA SHUTTERS AN' DA NOTE AN' DA WHOLE ARRANGEMENT IZ NOW GRIEF WIT A TIMETABLE!

b2.text:
SEVEN MINUTES PAST ELEVEN, AN' DA SQUARE, AN' DA SHUTTERS GOING, AN' DIS TIME SOMEBODY BOLTS DA CHURCH AS WELL, WHICH IZ NO IN DA NOTE.
WHAT COMES UP DA LANE AT SEVEN MINUTES PAST ELEVEN IZ WHAT DA BELL HAB BIN ANNOUNCIN' FOR THREE GENERATIONS, AN' IT IZ INTERESTED ONLY IN WHOEVER IZ STANDIN' IN DA SQUARE!

a2_m.text:
FOUR NOTEBOOKS: SEVENTY YEARS OF WRONG HOURS, DATED AN' TIMED, WIT DA WEATHER, AN' A COLUMN FOR WHAT HAPPENED IN DA VILLAGE DAT DAY.
DA FOURTH COLUMN IZ ALMOST ALWAYS EMPTY. IT IZ NO EMPTY {NINE|ELEVEN} TIMES IN SEVENTY YEARS, AN' ON DOZE NINE DAYS DA ENTRY IZ ONE WORD, AN' IT IZ DA SAME WORD EVERY TIME!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{NINE TIMES IN SEVENTY YEARS IZ A RATE.|LOOK AT DA GAPS BETWEEN DEM.|ONE WORD, NINE TIMES.}"
asides.any: {member} {COPIES OUT DA NINE DATES|WORKS OUT DA INTERVALS IN DA MARGIN|READS DA WORD ALOUD AN' STOPS}

choices.text: TAKE DA FOUR NOTEBOOKS AN' GO!
WORK OUT WHEN DA TENTH IZ DUE!
PUT DEM BACK AN' GO AN' FIND DA SEXTON!

a2_due.text:
DA NINE INTERVALS {SHORTEN|CONTRACT|CLOSE UP} ON A CURVE, AN' DA CURVE IZ A CLEAN ONE, AN' IT GIVES A TENTH DATE.
DA TENTH DATE IZ {DIS YEAR|FOUR MONTHS OUT|INSIDE DA YEAR}. DA ELEVENTH, ON DA SAME CURVE, IZ {FOUR DAYS AFTER IT|A FORTNIGHT LATER|REAL SOON AFTER}, AN' DA TWELFTH IZ NO FAR ENOUGH AWAY TA BE A SEPARATE EVENT AT ALL!

b1_m.text:
"NUTTIN'," SHE SAYS. "TA YOU, NUTTIN'. DAT IZ DA BIT DAT COSTS." SHE EXPLAINS IT OVER TEA, IN ELEVEN MINUTES, AN' BY DA END OF IT DA SHUTTERS MAKE SENSE AN' SO DOES DA SHOP.
DEN SHE ASKS WHETHER DA PARTY IZ STAYIN' FOR {SEVEN MINUTES PAST ELEVEN|DA NEXT ONE|TONIGHT}, AN' WHEN DEY SAY YES SHE GETS UP AN' STARTS DOING TINKZ IN HER OWN HOUSE DAT LOOK A GREAT DEAL LIKE PREPARATION!

choices.text: STAY IN HER KITCHEN FOR IT!
BE IN DA SQUARE FOR IT INSTEAD!
HELP HER PREPARE, PROPERLY, DOING WHAT SHE DOES!

b1_prep.text:
IT IZ {FOUR TINKZ|A SHORT LIST|NO MUCH}: DA WATER COVERED, DA MIRROR TURNED, DA DOOR ON DA LATCH RATHER DEN DA BOLT, AN' DA FIRE BANKED DOWN LOW.
DOING IT ALONGSIDE HER, IN DA RIGHT ORDER, IZ DA WHOLE OF IT, AN' AT SEVEN MINUTES PAST ELEVEN DA BELL GOES AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS IN DAT KITCHEN, AN' SHE CRIES AFTERWARDS COZ FOR {A LIFETIME OF WORK|A REAL LONG TIME|AS LONG AS SHE HAB DONE IT} SHE HAB DONE IT ALONE!

e_village_loop.title: {EVERY DAY IZ TUESDAY|DA VILLAGE IN DA BUBBLE|EIGHTY GOING OUT}

n0.text:
DA VILLAGE IZ FINE. DAT IZ WHAT IZ WRONG WIT IT.
DA BREAD IZ FRESH, DA PAPER ON DA RACK IZ TUESDAY'S, DA PUB HAB A CHALKBOARD WIT TUESDAY'S SPECIAL, AN' EVERYBODY YOU SPEAK TA IZ HAVIN' A PERFECTLY GOOD DAY AN' HAB BIN HAVIN' IT FOR SOME TIME.
"YOU WILL HAB NOTICED," SAYS DA WOMAN IN DA SHOP, CHEERFULLY, RINGIN' UP YA TINKZ. "{loopTalk}."
DA PAPER ON DA RACK IZ TUESDAY'S AN' IT IZ {DIS WEEK'S TUESDAY|TODAY'S DATE|NO AN OLD PAPER}, WHICH IZ DA PART DAT TAKES LONGEST TA NOTICE!
n0.emText:
A VILLAGE WHERE DA BREAD IZ ALWAYS FRESH AN' DA PAPER ON DA RACK IZ ALWAYS TUESDAY'S, AN' EVERYBODY KNOWS, AN' EVERYBODY IZ FINE.
"{loopTalk}," SAYS DA WOMAN IN DA SHOP, CHEERFULLY, RINGIN' UP YA TINKZ.
A BUBBLE. YOU IZ STANDIN' INSIDE A HELD MOMENT, WHICH IZ WHAT YOU WOULD BE IF DA RITUAL HAB GONE DA OTHER WAY, AN' DA PEOPLE IN HERE HAB MADE A LIFE OF IT, WHICH IZ MORE DEN YOU HAB MANAGED!
n0.bubba: BUBBA BUYS A PAPER, LOOKS AT DA DATE, AN' BUYS ANOTHER ONE. SAME DATE. "AH. AH, SI. CHESTA E' 'NA BOLLA. SUGAR, NO BUY NOTHIN' ON CREDIT."

asides.sanguine: {member} THINKS A TUESDAY YOU NO CAN USE UP SOUNDS RATHER NICE AN' IZ ONLY HALF JOKIN'!
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.melancholic: {member} ASKS A CHILD HOW OLD DEY IZ AN' GETS AN ANSWER DAT HAB BIN TRUE FOR A LONG TIME!
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: ASK HOW ANYBODY GETS OUT.
TRY TA GET OUT AT EIGHTY.
STAY A NIGHT AN' SEE WHAT DA MORNIN' IZ!
FIND WHOEVER IZ HOLDIN' IT!

a.text:
"EIGHTY ON DA WAY OUT," SAYS DA LANDLORD, "AN' IT IZ UPHILL, WHICH DOES NO HELP."
A CROWD OF DEM HAB MANAGED IT SINCE DA BUBBLE CLOSED. FOUR CAME BACK. DA FOUR WHO CAME BACK IZ DA ONES WHO WILL TALK 'BOUT IT AN' DEY ALL SAY DA SAME TINK, WHICH IZ DAT OUTSIDE IZ NOW FOUR YEARS FURTHER ON AN' EVERYBODY DEY KNEW IZ FOUR YEARS FURTHER ON WIT IT!

choices.text: TAKE SOMEBODY OUT WIT YOU!
ASK DA FOUR WHO CAME BACK WHAT IT WAZ LIKE OUTSIDE!

b.text:
DA ROAD OUT IZ A MILE AN' A HALF OF GRADIENT AN' A BEND AT DA TOP, AN' EIGHTY IZ NO A SPEED ANYBODY SENSIBLE DOES ON IT.
AT SIXTY DA HEDGES GET TALLER. AT SEVENTY DA LIGHT GOES DA COLOUR OF A BAD COIN. AT SEVENTY-EIGHT DERE IZ SOMEBODY STANDIN' AT DA CROWN OF DA BEND WHO IZ NO GOING TA MOVE, AN' WHO HAB BIN STANDIN' DERE SINCE DA BUBBLE CLOSED, AN' WHO IZ DA REASON DA FOUR WHO CAME BACK CAME BACK!

choices.text: LIFT OFF.
KEEP YA FOOT DOWN.

c.text:
YOU SLEEP IN DA PUB IN A BED DAT HAB BIN MADE FOR A REAL LONG TIME, AN' YOU WAKE UP ON TUESDAY.
DA PARTY'S OWN KIT IZ WHERE YOU LEFT IT. DA PARTY'S OWN BREAD HAB NO GONE STALE. AN' ONE OF YOU IZ UP BEFORE DAWN AN' OUT IN DA SQUARE IN DRESSIN' GOWN AN' BOOTS, STANDIN' QUITE STILL, COZ DEY HAB REALISED DAT DEY HAB STOPPED BEING HUNGRY AN' NO CAN SAY WHEN!

d.text:
IT IZ A MILK FLOAT.
IT IZ PARKED AT DA TOP OF DA VILLAGE OUTSIDE A HOUSE WIT DA CURTAINS SHUT, AN' IT HAB BIN PARKED DERE SINCE DA BUBBLE CLOSED, ENGINE OFF, AN' ITS CLOCK IZ DA ONLY CLOCK IN DA VILLAGE DAT SHOWS A DIFFERENT TIME EACH TIME YOU LOOK AT IT.
DA WOMAN IN DA HOUSE BEHIND DA SHUT CURTAINS IZ DA ONE WHO BOUGHT IT, ON DA TUESDAY, FROM A MAN WHO WAZ NO SELLIN' MILK!

choices.text: KNOCK ON DA DOOR.
TAKE DA MILK FLOAT OUT OF DA VILLAGE!

a1.text:
YOU TAKE DA LANDLORD'S DAUGHTER, WHO IZ NINETEEN AN' HAB BIN NINETEEN FOR FOUR YEARS, AN' SHE DOES DA WHOLE OF DA UPHILL MILE WIT HER EYES SHUT.
AT EIGHTY SHE OPENS DEM, ON DA FAR SIDE, IN A COUNTRY DAT HAB MOVED ON WITOUT HER, AN' SHE CRIES IN A LAY-BY FOR AN HOUR AN' DEN ASKS YOU, REAL CALMLY, TA DRIVE HER TA AN ADDRESS!

a2.text:
FOUR PEOPLE, FOUR ACCOUNTS, IN A PUB, OVER AN AFTERNOON, AN' DA FOUR ACCOUNTS DO NO AGREE 'BOUT ANYTINK EXCEPT DA FIGURE AT DA BEND.
WHAT YOU WRITE DOWN IZ DA FIRST PROPER RECORD ANYBODY HAB MADE OF A CLOSED BUBBLE FROM INSIDE, AN' DERE IZ TWO OFFICES IN DIS COUNTRY DAT WILL PAY A GREAT DEAL FOR IT, AN' ONE DAT WILL PAY MORE TA HAB IT NO EXIST!

b1.text:
YOU LIFT OFF AN' DA LIGHT COMES BACK AN' DA HEDGES SHRINK AN' YOU IZ IN DA VILLAGE AGAIN COMIN' DOWN DA HILL, WHICH IZ NO DA DIRECTION YOU WAZ DRIVIN'.
DA LANDLORD HAB A DRINK READY. HE HAB HAB IT READY FOR A WHILE. "EVERYONE LIFTS OFF," HE SAYS. "DAT IZ DA WHOLE OF IT. EVERYONE LIFTS OFF."

b2.text:
EIGHTY AT DA CROWN OF DA BEND, AN' DA FIGURE DOES NO MOVE, AN' YOU DO NO LIFT, AN' DA SOUND DA VEHICLE MAKES GOING THROUGH IZ NO A SOUND A VEHICLE MAKES.
YOU IZ OUT. ALL OF YOU IZ OUT. DA VILLAGE IZ A FEW YEARS BEHIND YOU IN EVERY SENSE AN' SOMETINK HAB COME OUT WIT YOU, IN DA BACK, QUIETLY, AN' IT IZ GOING TA BE A WHILE BEFORE ANYBODY NOTICES!

d1.text:
SHE HAB NO OPENED DA CURTAINS IN A FEW YEARS AN' SHE OPENS DA DOOR ON DA FIRST KNOCK, AS THOUGH SHE HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR SOMEBODY TA WORK IT OUT.
SHE BOUGHT A LIMINAL ENGINE OFF A MAN ON A TUESDAY AN' HAB IT FITTED TA A MILK FLOAT COZ IT WAZ WHAT SHE HAB, AN' SHE STARTED IT ONCE, AN' SHE HAB NO BIN ABLE TA SWITCH IT OFF, AN' SHE NO CAN LEAVE DA VILLAGE COZ IT IZ HOLDIN' EVERYBODY'S TUESDAY INCLUDIN' HERS!

d2.text:
A MILK FLOAT DOES 'BOUT FIFTEEN MILES AN HOUR AN' DA RULE IZ EIGHTY, AN' IT TAKES YOU FOUR HOURS TA WORK OUT DAT DA RULE DOES NO APPLY TA DA TINK DAT IZ MAKIN' DA RULE.
YOU DRIVE IT OUT OF DA VILLAGE AT FIFTEEN MILES AN HOUR WIT DA WHOLE POPULATION WALKIN' BEHIND IT, AN' AT DA PARISH BOUNDARY DA LIGHT CHANGES AN' IT IZ THURSDAY, AN' IT HAB BIN THURSDAY FOR FOUR YEARS, AN' FORTY PEOPLE SIT DOWN IN DA ROAD!

a1_m.text:
DA LANDLORD'S DAUGHTER IZ NINETEEN AN' HAB BIN NINETEEN FOR FOUR YEARS AN' SHE IZ IN DA PASSENGER SEAT BEFORE DA SENTENCE IZ FINISHED, WIT A BAG DAT WAZ ALREADY PACKED.
AT DA BOTTOM OF DA HILL SHE SAYS, WITOUT BEING ASKED, DAT {FOUR|THREE} PEOPLE HAB TAKEN HER DIS FAR AN' DAT DA DIFFERENCE DIS TIME IZ DAT DA PARTY IZ NO FROM HERE, AN' ASKS DEM TA PROMISE NO TA LOOK AT HER ON DA WAY UP!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DO NO LOOK AT HER. WHATEVER HAPPENS, DO NO LOOK.|DAT IZ A RULE AN' RULES OUT HERE IZ LOAD-BEARIN'.|EYES FRONT.}"
asides.any: {member} {GETS IN DA BACK AN' FACES DA REAR WINDOW|TAKES DA PROMISE SERIOUSLY|PUTS A COAT OVER DA MIRROR}

choices.text: PROMISE, AN' DRIVE, AN' DO NO LOOK!
COVER DA MIRRORS FIRST. PROPERLY!
TAKE DA FOUR WHO CAME BACK INSTEAD. ASK DEM FIRST!

a1_mirror.text:
THREE MIRRORS COVERED WIT A COAT AN' A MAP AN' A STRIP OF TAPE, WHICH TAKES {FOUR MINUTES|A FEW MINUTES|NO TIME} AN' LOOKS RIDICULOUS AN' MEANS DAT NOBODY CAN LOOK EVEN BY ACCIDENT.
EIGHTY AT DA CROWN OF DA BEND WIT FOUR PEOPLE FACIN' FORWARD AN' ONE OF DEM COUNTIN' OUT LOUD. ON DA FAR SIDE DERE IZ FIVE PEOPLE IN DA VEHICLE AN' DA FIFTH ONE IZ {CRYIN'|BREATHIN' REAL CAREFULLY|TWENTY-THREE YEARS OLD}!

a1_look.text:
SOMEBODY LOOKS BY ACCIDENT: A MIRROR IZ A MIRROR AN' A BEND IZ A BEND AN' DA EYE GOES WHERE DA EYE GOES, AN' IT IZ {ONE GLANCE|HALF A SECOND|LESS DEN DAT}.
DA VEHICLE COMES OVER DA TOP WIT FOUR PEOPLE IN IT. DA BAG IZ ON DA SEAT. IN DA VILLAGE, DAT AFTERNOON, DA LANDLORD'S DAUGHTER IZ NINETEEN AN' PULLIN' PINTS AN' HAB NEVER MET DA PARTY BEFORE, AN' DA BAG IZ NO PACKED!

d2_m.text:
A MILK FLOAT DOES 'BOUT FIFTEEN MILES AN HOUR AN' DA RULE IZ EIGHTY, AN' IT TAKES {HALF A SHIFT|MOST OF DA DAY|A LONG TIME} TA WORK OUT DAT DIS DOES NO MATTER.
IT DOES NO MATTER COZ DA FLOAT IZ {HOLDIN' IT|KEEPIN' IT|DOING A ROUND}, AN' DA ROUND IZ DA SAME ROUND EVERY DAY, AN' DA PARTY IZ NOW DRIVIN' IT AN' DERE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN} STOPS LEFT!

choices.text: FINISH DA ROUND. ALL OF IT!
STOP DA FLOAT AT DA NINTH STOP AN' SEE!
WORK OUT WHAT DA ROUND IZ ACTUALLY DELIVERIN'!

d2_stop.text:
DA FLOAT IZ STOPPED AT DA NINTH HOUSE WIT {TWO|THREE} BOTTLES STILL IN DA CRATE, AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS FOR 'BOUT A MINUTE AN' A HALF.
DEN DA BREAD ON DA RACKS IN DA SHOP {GOES|IZ NO FRESH|IZ WEDNESDAY'S}, ALL AT ONCE, IN A VILLAGE WHERE DA PAPER HAB SAID TUESDAY FOR FOUR YEARS, AN' DA PARTY HAB 'BOUT FOUR MINUTES TA DECIDE WHETHER DAT IZ A RESCUE OR A DEMOLITION!

d2_round.text:
PLOTTED ON PAPER DA ROUND IZ {A CIRCUIT|A BOUNDARY|A PERIMETER}: IT TOUCHES EVERY ROAD OUT OF DA VILLAGE, IN ORDER, AN' IT CLOSES, AN' DA FLOAT HAB BIN CLOSIN' IT {EVERY MORNIN'|DAILY|WITOUT A DAY OFF} SINCE DA CURTAINS WAZ SHUT.
WHOEVER IZ IN DA HOUSE AT DA TOP HAB BIN DRIVIN' A LINE ROUND DIS PLACE FOR FOUR YEARS. DA PARTY CAN KEEP DRIVIN' IT, OR DEY CAN HAND DA KEYS BACK, AN' BOTH OF DOZE IZ ANSWERS!

e_village_witch.title: {DA WOMAN AT DA END OF DA LANE|NO A WITCH, SAYS DA VILLAGE|DA POULTICE}

n0.text:
"SHE'S NO A WITCH," SAYS DA FIRST PERSON YOU ASK, BEFORE YOU HAB ASKED ANYTINK 'BOUT A WITCH.
DA HOUSE AT DA END OF DA LANE HAB A QUEUE AT IT: FOUR PEOPLE, SITTIN' ON DA WALL, WIT DA PATIENCE OF A DOCTOR'S WAITIN' ROOM. A MAN WIT HIS ARM IN A SLING. A WOMAN WIT A JAR. A FEW CHILDREN WHO HAB BIN SENT.
ON DA GATE DERE IZ A PRICE LIST. IT IZ REAL REASONABLE AN' IT IZ WRITTEN IN A GOOD CLEAR HAND, AN' DA LAST ITEM ON IT IZ: TA BE TOLD DA TRUTH, FREE.
DA LIST ON DA DOOR IZ IN {FOUR|THREE} HANDS AN' DA OLDEST HAND IZ {A HUNDRED YEARS|REAL OLD|OLDER DEN DA HOUSE}!
n0.emText:
A QUEUE ON A GARDEN WALL AT DA END OF A LANE, AN' A PRICE LIST ON DA GATE IN A GOOD CLEAR HAND, AN' DA LAST ITEM ON IT: TA BE TOLD DA TRUTH, FREE.
"LOVELY WOMAN," SAYS EVERYBODY, BEFORE YOU ASK. SHE IZ A WITCH. YOU IZ A WITCH. YOU HAB BIN A WITCH FOR ELEVEN MONTHS AN' YOU IZ STILL NO SURE IT IZ A JOB YOU CAN DO, AN' HERE IZ SOMEBODY DOING IT AS A TRADE WIT A PRICE LIST!
n0.bubba: BUBBA READS DA LIST AN' TAKES HIS HAT OFF. "FREE FOR DA TRUTH. AOH. SUGAR, DAT IZ DA MOST EXPENSIVE TINK ON DERE."

choices.text: QUEUE, AN' PAY FOR SOMETINK OFF DA LIST!
ASK TA BE TOLD DA TRUTH.
ASK HER WHAT DA VILLAGE SAYS 'BOUT HER!
ASK HER TA TEACH YOU.

a.text:
SHE IZ 'BOUT SIXTY, IN A CARDIGAN, WIT A KITCHEN DAT SMELLS OF {smell} AN' A SINK FULL OF JARS.
WHATEVER YOU HAB COME IN WIT, SHE DEALS WIT IN 'BOUT DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR: A POULTICE, A WORD SAID OVER IT, AN' INSTRUCTIONS GIVEN TWICE AN' DEN WRITTEN DOWN COZ PEOPLE NEVER LISTEN DA FIRST TIME.
IT WORKS. DAT IZ DA TINK. WHATEVER IT WAZ, IT WORKS!

b.text:
SHE PUTS DA KETTLE ON FOR DIS ONE. IT IZ DA ONLY ITEM DAT GETS DA KETTLE.
DEN SHE TELLS YOU A TRUE TINK 'BOUT YOURSELVES. A FACT, ONE DAT EVERYBODY IN DA PARTY EXCEPT ONE HAB ALREADY NOTICED, AN' SHE SAYS IT OUT LOUD IN A KITCHEN AT FOUR IN DA AFTERNOON, AN' IT IZ FREE, AN' IT COSTS A GREAT DEAL!
b.emText:
SHE PUTS DA KETTLE ON FOR DIS ONE, WHICH SHE DOES NO DO FOR DA OTHERS.
DEN SHE LOOKS AT YOU FOR A LONG TIME AN' SAYS: "DERE IZ NINETY-TWO PARTS OF YOU SOMEWHERE ELSE AN' YOU {KEEP GOING|PUSH DEEPER|CONTINUE FORWARD|PRESS ON} ROUND DA WORLD ASKIN' AFTER DEM LIKE A WOMAN AT A LOST PROPERTY OFFICE. YOU WILL GET SOME BACK DA WAY YOU GET ANYTINK BACK: BY MAKIN' NEW ONES AN' FINDIN' OUT DEY FIT DA SAME HOLES."
IT IZ FREE. IT IZ DA MOST EXPENSIVE TINK ANYBODY SAYS TA YOU ALL YEAR!
b.bubba: BUBBA DOES NO SAY A WORD. HE DRINKS HIS TEA AN' LOOKS OUT DA WINDOW AT DA GARDEN DA WHOLE TIME, SO NOBODY HAB TA LOOK AT ANYBODY!

c.text:
"DEY SAY ME IZ NO A WITCH," SHE SAYS, PLEASED. "DAT IZ WHAT DEY SAY WHEN DEY WANT A TINK KEPT. IF DEY SAID ME WAZ, SOMEBODY FROM DA EMPIRE WOULD HAB TA DO SOMETINK 'BOUT IT, AN' DEN WHO DOES DA POULTICES?"
SHE HAB HAB ONE VISIT FROM DA UMBRA EXCIDII, IN {timeAgo}, AN' SHE MADE DEM TEA, AN' DEY WENT AWAY, AN' SHE WILL TELL YOU EXACTLY WHAT WAZ SAID IF YOU HAB HALF AN HOUR!

choices.text: HAB DA HALF HOUR.
ASK WHAT SHE WOULD DO IF DEY CAME BACK!

d.text:
SHE LAUGHS AT YOU. DEN SHE STOPS LAUGHIN', AN' LOOKS AT YA HANDS, AN' SAYS: "GO ON DEN. WEDNESDAY. BRING YA OWN JARS."
YOU GET FOUR WEDNESDAYS. IT IZ DOSAGES, AN' DA FOUR RULES 'BOUT WHAT YOU NEVER SAY IN A SICK ROOM, AN' HOW TA BE DA PERSON WHO ARRIVES, AN' IT IZ WORTH MORE DEN ANY GRIMOIRE ANY OF YOU HAB EVER PAID FOR!

c1.text:
HALF AN HOUR, TWO POTS OF TEA, AN' DA WHOLE ACCOUNT OF A VISIT FROM DA EMPIRE'S OWN WITCH-FINDERS TA A KITCHEN AT DA END OF A LANE.
WHAT SHE SAYS AT DA END OF IT, 'BOUT WHAT DEY IZ ACTUALLY LOOKIN' FOR AN' HOW DEY DECIDE, IZ NO WRITTEN DOWN ANYWHERE AN' WOULD BE WORTH SOMEBODY'S LIFE IN {country}!

c2.text:
"PUT DA KETTLE ON," SHE SAYS. "SAME AS LAST TIME."
DEN SHE GOES QUIET, AN' ADDS: "AN' IF IT IZ DA OTHER LOT, DA ONES WIT DA GOOD COATS AN' DA LISTS, ME WOULD WANT SOMEBODY IN DA HOUSE. DAT IZ ALL. JUST SOMEBODY IN DA HOUSE."
SHE IZ ASKIN'. SHE IZ ASKIN' SO CAREFULLY DAT YOU COULD WALK OUT WITOUT NOTICIN' YOU HAB BIN ASKED!

choices.text: BE IN DA HOUSE.
LEAVE HER DA MEANS TA BE SOMEWHERE ELSE!

c2a.text:
DEY COME ON A THURSDAY, FOUR OF DEM, IN GOOD COATS, WIT A LIST.
NUTTIN' HAPPENS, COZ DERE IZ FOUR OF YOU IN DA KITCHEN AN' IT IZ REAL HARD TA TAKE A WOMAN OUT OF A HOUSE IN FRONT OF WITNESSES WHO IZ CLEARLY GOING TA WRITE IT ALL DOWN. DEY HAB TEA. DEY LEAVE. DA LIST HAB HER NAME ON IT AN' IT WILL HAB HER NAME ON IT NEXT YEAR TOO!

c2b.text:
YOU LEAVE HER MONEY, A ROUTE, AN' DA NAME OF SOMEBODY FOUR COUNTRIES AWAY WHO WILL TAKE HER IN, AN' SHE TAKES ALL THREE AN' PUTS DEM IN DA JAR ON DA MANTELPIECE AN' SAYS THANK YOU AN' MEANS IT.
SHE DOES NO GO. OF COURSE SHE DOES NO GO. BUT FOR DA REST OF HER LIFE DERE IZ A JAR ON A MANTELPIECE WIT A WAY OUT IN IT, AN' SHE TELLS PEOPLE 'BOUT IT, AN' TWO OF DEM USE IT!

a_m.text:
SHE IZ 'BOUT SIXTY, IN A CARDIGAN, WIT A KITCHEN DAT SMELLS OF {smell} AN' A SINK FULL OF JARS, AN' WHATEVER DA PARTY HAB SHE HAB AN ANSWER FOR.
DA ANSWER COSTS WHAT DA LIST SAYS AN' DA LIST IZ {CHEAP|ALMOST FREE|NO A BUSINESS}. WHILE IT IZ BEING MADE UP SHE ASKS, MILDLY, WHETHER ANYBODY IN DA PARTY WOULD LIKE DA OTHER TINK, AN' DOES NO SAY WHAT DA OTHER TINK IZ!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DO NO ASK WHAT DA OTHER TINK IZ.|SHE KNOWS WHICH OF US IZ GOING TA ASK.|DAT IZ NO A MENU ITEM.}"
asides.any: {member} {LOOKS AT DA JARS|SAYS YES BEFORE ANYBODY ELSE CAN|ASKS WHAT IT COSTS}

choices.text: TAKE WHAT WAZ ASKED FOR AN' GO!
ASK WHAT DA OTHER TINK IZ!
SAY YES TA IT WITOUT ASKIN'!

a_other.text:
IT IZ {A QUESTION ANSWERED|ONE TRUE ANSWER|A TINK SHE CAN TELL YOU}, ONE PER PERSON, EVER, AN' IT COSTS NUTTIN' COZ SHE HAB NEVER BIN ABLE TA TINK OF A PRICE DAT WOULD BE HONEST.
ASKIN' IT IZ OPTIONAL. EVERYBODY IN DA PARTY THINKS 'BOUT IT FOR DA REST OF DA WEEK AN' AT LEAST ONE OF DEM COMES BACK ON DEY OWN, LATER, WITOUT TELLIN' DA OTHERS!

a_yes.text:
YES, TA A TINK NOBODY HAB DESCRIBED, IN A KITCHEN, FROM SOMEBODY WHO IZ NO A WITCH, WHICH IZ EITHER TRUST OR DA EXACT OPPOSITE OF JUDGEMENT.
WHAT SHE GIVES IZ {LIL'|IN A JAR|NO MUCH}, AN' WHAT IT DOES TAKES {A COUPLE OF DAYS|A FORTNIGHT|SOME TIME} TA BECOME CLEAR, AN' IT IZ KIND ENOUGH, IN A WAY NOBODY WOULD HAB CHOSEN, AN' IT STAYS!

c1_m.text:
HALF AN HOUR, TWO POTS OF TEA, AN' DA WHOLE ACCOUNT OF A VISIT FROM DA EMPIRE'S OWN WITCH-FINDERS TA A KITCHEN AT DA END OF A VILLAGE LANE IN {timeAgo}.
IT DOES NO END DA WAY DA PARTY EXPECTS. NOBODY WAZ TAKEN. WHAT HAPPENED INSTEAD IZ {ON PAPER|WRITTEN DOWN|IN A FILE}, AN' SHE HAB DA FILE, AN' IT IZ IN A BISCUIT TIN ON TOP OF A CUPBOARD AN' SHE GETS IT DOWN WITOUT BEING ASKED!

choices.text: READ IT. DRINK DA TEA. LEAVE IT WIT HER!
READ IT PROPERLY, AS A DOCUMENT!
ASK HER TA LET YOU COPY IT AN' LODGE DA COPY SOMEWHERE SAFE!

c1_doc.text:
IT IZ A FINDIN'. SIGNED, SEALED, AN' {NEVER REVOKED|STILL STANDIN'|IN FORCE}, AN' WHAT IT FINDS IZ DAT DA HOUSE AT DA END OF DA LANE AN' WHOEVER IZ IN IT IZ {EXEMPT|OUTSIDE DA JURISDICTION|NO TA BE ASKED 'BOUT}, IN PERPETUITY, BY ORDER OF SOMEBODY WHOSE TITLE NO LONGER EXISTS.
WHICH MEANS SHE IZ PROTECTED BY A DOCUMENT, AN' DA DOCUMENT IZ NO SECRET, AN' IT CAN BE SHOWN AT A DOOR!

c1_copy.text:
COPYIN' IT TAKES AN EVENIN' BY HAND AT HER KITCHEN TABLE, AN' LODGIN' IT TAKES {TWO WEEKS|A FORTNIGHT|A LONG DETOUR} AN' A SOLICITOR IN {region} WHO DOES NO ASK WHAT IT IZ.
SHE DOES NO THANK ANYBODY FOR IT AT DA TIME. {FOUR YEARS LATER|YEARS LATER|EVENTUALLY}, WHEN SOMEBODY DOES COME BACK, DA COPY IZ WHAT IZ PRODUCED, FROM AN OFFICE, BY A STRANGER, AN' DAT IZ DA WHOLE OF DA PARTY'S INVOLVEMENT AN' IT IZ ENOUGH!

e_village_fair.title: {DA FAIR ON DA GREEN|THREE SHOTS A GO|DA SHOOTIN' GALLERY}

n0.text:
A FAIR ON DA GREEN: FOUR STALLS, A GENERATOR, A HOOPLA, AN' A SHOOTIN' GALLERY WIT A MAN BEHIND IT WHO IZ FAR TOO GOOD AT HIS OWN GAME.
THREE SHOTS A GO. DA TOP PRIZE HAB BIN ON DA SHELF SINCE BEFORE ANY OF YOU WAZ BORN AN' DA DUST ON IT HAB BIN DUSTED ROUND RATHER DEN OFF.
"NOBODY'S HAB IT," HE SAYS, CHEERFULLY. "YOU IZ WELCOME TA TRY. EVERYBODY'S WELCOME TA TRY."
DA PRIZE ON DA TOP SHELF HAB {NEVER BIN TAKEN DOWN|NO BIN WON|BIN UP DERE LONGER DEN DA STALL HAB BIN IN DA FAMILY}!
n0.emText:
A FAIR ON A GREEN, AN' A SHOOTIN' GALLERY WHOSE TOP PRIZE HAB BIN ON DA SHELF SO LONG DA DUST HAB BIN DUSTED AROUND IT RATHER DEN OFF IT.
"NOBODY'S HAB IT. YOU IZ WELCOME TA TRY." DA PRIZE IZ A LIL' CARVED TINK YOU NO CAN LOOK AT DIRECTLY, AN' IT IZ A BET SOMEBODY MADE A LONG TIME AGO AN' HAB BIN WINNIN' EVERY YEAR SINCE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA PUTS MONEY DOWN FOR THREE SHOTS WITOUT BREAKIN' STRIDE. "NOW HOLD ON. HOLD ON. ME BIN SHOOTIN' SINCE ME WAZ SIX. MO' VEDIMMO." HE MISSES ALL THREE!

asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.hedonistic: {member} IZ EATIN' SOMETINK OUT OF PAPER AN' ENJOYIN' DA WHOLE FAIR ENORMOUSLY!
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.sanguine: {member} HAB MADE MATES WIT DA WOMAN ON DA HOOPLA AN' IZ GETTIN' DA HISTORY OF DA FAIR!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: HAB A GO.
WORK OUT DA BEND ON DA SIGHTS FIRST!
ASK WHAT DA PRIZE IZ.
ENJOY DA FAIR. ALL OF IT. PROPERLY!

a.text: THREE SHOTS, A RIFLE WIT A BENT BARREL, A ROW OF DUCKS WIT WEIGHTED BASES, AN' A MAN BEHIND DA COUNTER WHO IZ WATCHIN' YOU RATHER DEN DA TARGETS!

b.text:
FOUR GOES' WORTH OF WATCHIN' AN' A CHALK MARK ON DA COUNTER WHERE YA ELBOW NEEDS TA BE, AN' DA BEND IZ 'BOUT A DUCK AN' A HALF LEFT AT DAT RANGE.
HE KNOWS EXACTLY WHAT YOU IZ DOING. HE LETS YOU DO IT. WHEN YOU FINALLY PAY, HE PUTS DOWN DA NEWSPAPER!

c.text:
"IT CAME WIT DA STALL," HE SAYS. "ME FATHER HAB DA STALL OFF A MAN IN {timeAgo} AN' IT WAZ ON DA SHELF DEN AN' DA MAN TOLD HIM WHAT IT WAZ AN' ME FATHER TOLD ME AN' ME IZ NO TELLIN' YOU, COZ YOU WOULD WANT A GO."
DEN HE LOOKS AT DA FOUR OF YOU PROPERLY AN' CHANGES HIS MIND, AN' TELLS YOU, AN' IT TAKES 'BOUT A MINUTE, AN' AFTERWARDS NOBODY IN DA PARTY WANTS A GO!

d.text:
FOUR STALLS, A HOOPLA, CHIPS OUT OF PAPER, A GENERATOR DAT HUMS UNDER EVERYTINK, AN' A FAIR ON A GREEN IN DA EVENIN' WIT DA LIGHTS ON AN' SOMEBODY'S RADIO GOING.
NOBODY WINS ANYTINK. EVERYBODY IZ A GREAT DEAL BETTER FOR IT, AN' DA WALK BACK TA DA VEHICLE IZ DA FIRST TIME IN WEEKS ANYBODY HAB HEARD DIS PARTY LAUGHIN'!

c_m.text:
"IT CAME WIT DA STALL," HE SAYS. "ME FATHER HAB DA STALL OFF A MAN IN {timeAgo} AN' IT WAZ ON DA SHELF DEN AN' DERE IZ NO TICKET ON IT."
HE HAB NEVER TAKEN IT DOWN. HE SAYS DAT AS A FACT 'BOUT DA SHELF RATHER DEN A RULE, AN' DEN ADDS, AFTER A MOMENT, DAT HE HAB {NEVER WANTED TA|NO LIKED TA|NO BIN ABLE TA BRING HIMSELF TA}, AN' LOOKS {SURPRISED|CAUGHT OUT|AT HIS OWN HANDS} AT HAVIN' SAID IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{NOBODY HAB EVER WON IT COZ HE NEVER LETS ANYBODY GET CLOSE.|LOOK AT DA BEND IN DAT BARREL AGAIN.|DA PRIZE IZ DA POINT OF DA STALL.}"
asides.any: {member} {LOOKS AT DA SHELF RATHER DEN DA DUCKS|PUTS MONEY DOWN|ASKS HIM HOW MANY GOES IT TAKES}

choices.text: ASK HIM TA HAND IT DOWN.
WORK OUT WHAT IT IZ FROM DA COUNTER!
WIN IT PROPERLY. PAY FOR EVERY GO IT TAKES!

c_what.text:
FROM FOUR FEET, IN FAIRGROUND LIGHT, THROUGH DA DUST OF {FORTY YEARS|A REAL LONG TIME|TWO GENERATIONS}, IT IZ POSSIBLE TA SEE DAT IT WAZ ALWAYS {A CASE|A RELIQUARY|A CONTAINER} WIT A LID, AN' DA LID HAB BIN {SEALED|SOLDERED|CLOSED} RATHER DEN FITTED.
DA SEAL IZ A MAKER'S SEAL AN' DA PARTY HAB SEEN DAT MAKER'S MARK BEFORE, AN' IT WAZ NO ON A FAIRGROUND!

d_m.text:
FOUR STALLS, A HOOPLA, CHIPS OUT OF PAPER, A GENERATOR DAT HUMS UNDER EVERYTINK, AN' A FAIR ON A GREEN IN DA EVENIN' WIT NUTTIN' REQUIRED OF ANYBODY.
AT 'BOUT {TEN|HALF NINE|CLOSIN'} DA GENERATOR STUMBLES, AN' EVERY LIGHT ON DA GREEN GOES WIT IT, AN' IN DA FOUR SECONDS OF DARK DA SHOOTIN' GALLERY'S TOP SHELF IZ {VISIBLE|LIT FROM SOMEWHERE ELSE|DA ONLY TINK ANYBODY CAN SEE}!

choices.text: FINISH DA EVENIN'. IT WAZ A GOOD EVENIN'!
GO AN' LOOK AT DA SHELF NOW, IN DA DARK!
GO AN' FIX DA GENERATOR.

d_dark.text:
FOUR SECONDS IZ NO LONG AN' DA GALLERY IZ {A LONG WAY|ACROSS DA GREEN|NO FAR}, AN' SOMEBODY IN DA PARTY IZ STANDIN' AT DA COUNTER WHEN DA LIGHTS COME BACK.
DA STALLHOLDER IZ LOOKIN' AT DA SHELF AN' NO AT DEM. DA PRIZE IZ EXACTLY WHERE IT WAZ AN' IZ {FACIN' DA OTHER WAY|TURNED ROUND|NO HOW IT WAZ}, AN' HE SAYS, WITOUT ANY PARTICULAR EMPHASIS, DAT IT DOES DAT!

d_gen.text:
IT IZ {A FUEL LINE|A PLUG LEAD|DA BRUSHES} AN' IT TAKES {A GOOD WHILE|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|NO TIME AT ALL} WIT A LAMP HELD BY A CHILD WHO IZ THRILLED TA BE ALLOWED.
DA FAIR GETS ANOTHER {HALF A SHIFT|HOUR|EVENIN'}. DA STALLHOLDER WILL NO TAKE MONEY OFF DA PARTY AFTER DAT, DA HOOPLA WOMAN FEEDS DEM, AN' DA WHOLE GREEN IZ A BETTER PLACE TA HAB SPENT AN EVENIN' DEN ANYWHERE ELSE IN DA COUNTRY!

e_village_truckers.title: {DA CONVOY IN DA YARD|LOAD AN' TWO PIGEONS|NIGHTS ON DA ENCOMPASSIN' ROAD}

n0.text:
SIX UNITS AN' FOUR TRAILERS IN A FARMYARD DAT IZ NO A DEPOT, AN' A TRUCKER'S SOCIETY FLAG ON A POLE MADE OUT OF AN EXHAUST STACK.
DEY HAB BIN HERE TWO DAYS WAITIN' FOR A LOAD DAT HAB NO COME, AN' DEY IZ BORED, AN' BORED DRIVERS IZ DA MOST HOSPITABLE PEOPLE IN EUROPE.
DERE IZ A FIRE, DERE IZ FOOD, DERE IZ SOMEBODY'S DOG, AN' DERE IZ TWO PIGEONS IN A BASKET DAT EVERYBODY IZ BEING CAREFUL 'BOUT.
FOUR TRAILERS IN DA YARD AN' {TWO|THREE} OF DEM HAB NO BIN MOVED IN {A YEAR|A LONG TIME|TWO SEASONS}, BY DA WEEDS!
n0.emText:
SIX UNITS IN A FARMYARD UNDER A SOCIETY FLAG ON AN EXHAUST STACK, TWO DAYS WAITIN' ON A LOAD, A FIRE GOING, AN' TWO PIGEONS IN A BASKET DAT EVERYBODY IZ BEING CAREFUL 'BOUT.
DA PIGEONS IZ DA ROAD'S OWN POST AN' DEY IZ HOW DA SOCIETY KNOWS TINKZ BEFORE DA COLLECTIVE DOES. YOU HAB BIN IN DIS WORLD MOST OF A YEAR AN' DA BIRDS IZ STILL DA FASTEST TINK IN IT!
n0.bubba: BUBBA IZ OUT OF DA VEHICLE BEFORE IT STOPS AN' IZ HOLDIN' A PLATE WITHIN MOST OF A MINUTE. "AOH! CHESTA E' GENTE MIA! SUGAR, COME EAT SOMETHIN'."

asides.sanguine: {member} IZ ON DA FIRE CREW ALREADY AN' HAB BIN TOLD FOUR STORIES!
asides.hedonistic: {member} HAB FOUND DA DRINK AN' HAB BIN WELCOMED AS FAMILY!
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: EAT WIT DEM AN' STAY DA NIGHT!
ASK 'BOUT DA PIGEONS.
ASK WHAT HAPPENED TA DA OTHER TWO TRAILERS!
OFFER TA RUN DEY LOAD FOR DEM!

a.text:
FOOD OUT OF FOUR COUNTRIES, A FIRE, A DOG DAT GOES ROUND EVERY LAP OF DA YARD, AN' ELEVEN HOURS OF STORIES DAT ALL END WIT SOMEBODY HAVIN' DONE SOMETINK EXTREMELY STUPID ON A WET ROAD.
YOU SLEEP IN A CAB WIT A BLANKET DAT SMELLS OF DIESEL AN' SOMEBODY ELSE'S TOBACCO, AN' IT IZ DA BEST NIGHT'S SLEEP ANY OF YOU HAB HAB SINCE DA SPRING!

b.text:
"POST," SAYS DA OLDEST DRIVER. "FASTER DEN DA PHONE AN' NOBODY READS IT BUT US."
ONE OF DA TWO IZ NO DEY. IT CAME IN ON TUESDAY, IT WILL NO LEAVE, AN' IT HAB A RING ON IT STAMPED WIT A YEAR DAT IZ NO DIS ONE, AN' DA SOCIETY HAB A RULE 'BOUT DAT AN' DA RULE IZ DAT YOU FEED IT AN' YOU WAIT!

choices.text: WAIT WIT DEM FOR WHOEVER IT IZ FOR!
OFFER TA CARRY IT TA WHEREVER IT WANTS TA GO!

c.text:
DA YARD GOES QUIET IN A WAY A YARD WIT MORE PEOPLE DEN YOU EXPECTED IN IT SHOULD NO BE ABLE TA.
"ON DA COAST ROAD," SAYS SOMEBODY, EVENTUALLY. "TWO UNITS, TWO TRAILERS, FOUR DRIVERS, IN DA SPRING. EVERYTINK CAME BACK EXCEPT DA DRIVERS, AN' EVERYTINK DAT CAME BACK WAZ LOCKED FROM INSIDE."
DEY HAB KEPT DA TWO TRAILERS. DEY IZ IN DA TOP OF DA YARD UNDER A SHEET, AN' NOBODY HAB OPENED DEM, AN' DEY WOULD REAL MUCH LIKE SOMEBODY WHO IZ NO SOCIETY TA OPEN DEM!

choices.text: OPEN DA TRAILERS.
ASK DEM TA BURY DA TRAILERS INSTEAD!

d.text:
DA LOAD TURNS UP AT FOUR IN DA MORNIN' AN' IT IZ FOUR PALLETS AN' ONE CRATE, AN' DA CRATE GOES IN YA VEHICLE RATHER DEN A TRAILER COZ A CRATE DAT GOES IN A TRAILER IZ A CRATE SOMEBODY LOOKS FOR.
IT IZ ELEVEN HOURS TA DA DROP AN' DA DROP IZ A FARM GATE WIT NOBODY AT IT, AN' DA CRATE IZ WARM AN' IT IZ NO SUPPOSED TA BE!

b1.text:
FOUR DAYS. ON DA FOURTH, A MAN WALKS INTO DA YARD ON FOOT OFF DA MAIN ROAD WIT NO VEHICLE AN' NO BAG AN' ASKS FOR HIS BIRD.
HE IZ WEARIN' A UNIFORM DAT HAB NO BIN ISSUED SINCE BEFORE ANY OF DEZE DRIVERS WAZ BORN, AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM STANDS UP, AN' DA OLDEST HANDS HIM DA BASKET!

b2.text:
IT WILL NO FLY, SO YOU CARRY IT: AN HOUR ON DA ROAD, DEN FORTY, DEN TWO HUNDRED, AN' AT EVERY STOP IT WILL NO LEAVE DA BASKET, AN' DEN AT A CROSSROADS IN DA MIDDLE OF NOWHERE IT STANDS UP AN' LOOKS AT YOU.
WHAT IZ AT DAT CROSSROADS IZ A MILESTONE WIT DA WRONG DISTANCE ON IT AN', UNDER DA MILESTONE, WHAT DA BIRD HAB BIN CARRYIN', WHICH WAZ NEVER ON ITS LEG!

c1.text:
DA SHEET COMES OFF AN' DA DOORS IZ LOCKED FROM INSIDE AN' IT TAKES AN HOUR WIT A BAR TA OPEN A DOOR DAT IZ BOLTED ON DA FAR SIDE OF ITSELF.
DEY IZ EMPTY. BOTH OF DEM. EMPTY AN' CLEAN AN' WARM, AN' DA INSIDE OF EACH DOOR HAB FOUR SETS OF HANDPRINTS ON IT, AN' DA HANDPRINTS IZ ON DA INSIDE, AN' DEY IZ PRESSED IN, NO SMEARED!

c2.text:
"BURY DEM," YOU SAY. "NO OPEN DEM. BURY DEM, WIT DA NAMES ON, AN' HAB SOMEBODY SAY SOMETINK."
IT TAKES A DAY AN' A DIGGER FROM DA FARM AN' FOUR DRIVERS WHO HAB NO CRIED SINCE DEY WAZ BOYS.
DA SOCIETY DO NO FORGET DIS EITHER. DERE IZ A DIFFERENCE BETWEEN DA PEOPLE WHO OPEN DA TRAILER AN' DA PEOPLE WHO BURY IT, AN' DEY HAB NEEDED SOMEBODY TA SAY WHICH ONE DEY WAZ FOR A LONG TIME!

c2_m.text:
"BURY DEM," YOU SAY. "NO OPEN DEM. BURY DEM, WIT DA NAMES ON, AN' HAB SOMEBODY SAY SOMETINK."
DA YARD AGREES {IMMEDIATELY|WITOUT A VOTE|FASTER DEN ANYBODY EXPECTS}, WHICH TELLS YOU DEY HAB WANTED SOMEBODY FROM OUTSIDE TA SAY IT. DEN DA OLDEST DRIVER ASKS WHO IZ GOING TA DO DA SAYIN', COZ DERE IZ NO PRIEST WHO WILL COME OUT HERE AN' DERE HAB NO BIN FOR {FOUR YEARS|A LONG TIME|YEARS}!

asides.nurturing: {member} IZ ALREADY ASKIN' WHAT DA TWO DRIVERS' NAMES WAZ!
asides.any: {member} {LOOKS AT DA TRAILERS|SAYS NUTTIN' AN' STARTS MOVIN' DA DIGGERS|VOLUNTEERS BEFORE ANYBODY ELSE CAN}

choices.text: BURY DEM. SOMEBODY WILL SAY SOMETINK!
SAY IT YOURSELF. PROPERLY!
GO AN' FETCH A PRIEST. HOWEVER LONG IT TAKES!

c2_say.text:
IT TAKES {AN HOUR|DA AFTERNOON|SOME TIME} TA WORK OUT WHAT TA SAY FOR TWO DRIVERS OFF DA COAST ROAD IN A FARMYARD WIT A CROWD OF DEM STANDIN' ROUND A HOLE, AN' IT IZ SAID PROPERLY, WIT DA NAMES, TWICE.
DA SOCIETY HEARS 'BOUT IT {FOUR COUNTIES|A LONG WAY|EVERYWHERE} AWAY INSIDE DA MONTH. DERE IZ NO A YARD ON DIS ROAD AFTERWARDS WHERE DA PARTY PAYS FOR ANYTINK, AN' DAT IZ NO DA IMPORTANT PART AN' EVERYBODY KNOWS IT!

c2_priest.text:
IT IZ {FOUR DAYS|A WEEK|A COUPLE OF DAYS EACH WAY} AN' THREE REFUSALS AN' ONE REAL LONG ARGUMENT IN A PRESBYTERY, AN' DA ONE WHO SAYS YES IN DA END IZ {YOUNG|NEW|NO FROM HERE} AN' COMES ON DA BACK OF SOMEBODY'S BIKE.
HE DOES IT PROPERLY AN' STAYS DA NIGHT AN' EATS WIT DA YARD, AN' DA YARD HAB A PRIEST AGAIN FROM DAT WEEK, WHICH IZ WORTH MORE TA DEM OVER DA FOLLOWIN' YEARS DEN ANYTINK IN EITHER TRAILER COULD HAB BIN!

b2_m.text:
IT WILL NO FLY, SO YOU CARRY IT: ELEVEN KILOMETRES, DEN FORTY, DEN TWO HUNDRED, AN' AT EVERY STOP IT WILL NO LEAVE DA HAND IT IZ IN.
AT DA TWO-HUNDRED-KILOMETRE STOP SOMEBODY IN A YARD DA PARTY HAB NEVER BIN IN BEFORE COMES STRAIGHT OVER, LOOKS AT DA BIRD, AN' SAYS A NAME, AN' IT IZ NO A NAME ANYBODY IN DA PARTY HAB SAID OUT LOUD!

choices.text: HAND IT OVER. DAT IZ DA DELIVERY!
ASK HOW DEY KNEW DA NAME.
KEEP CARRYIN' IT. DA BIRD HAB NO LET GO YET!

b2_name.text:
COZ DA BIRD IZ {DEY|FROM DEY LOFT|ONE OF DA FOUR DAT WENT OUT}, AN' COZ IT HAB DONE DIS {TWICE BEFORE|BEFORE|MORE DEN ONCE}, AN' COZ DA NAME IT IZ CARRYIN' IZ DA NAME OF DA PERSON IT IZ GOING TA RATHER DEN DA PERSON WHO SENT IT.
DA PARTY HAB BIN DA LAST LEG OF A ROUTE DAT RUNS {FOUR COUNTRIES|DA LENGTH OF DIS ROAD|A REAL LONG WAY} AN' IZ ENTIRELY OFF ANY WIRE, AN' DEY IZ NOW ON IT, WHICH IZ AN INVITATION RATHER DEN A JOB!

b2_keep.text:
ANOTHER {FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES|DA BEST PART OF A WEEK|LONG LEG} WIT A BIRD DAT WILL NO FLY AN' WILL NO LEAVE DA HAND, THROUGH {THREE|FOUR} MORE YARDS AN' ONE BORDER.
IT LETS GO ON DA FAR SIDE OF DA BORDER, ON A BRIDGE, AT {FOUR IN DA MORNIN'|DAWN|AN HOUR NOBODY CHOSE}, AN' GOES UP AN' AWAY NORTH, AN' WHAT IZ LEFT IN DA HAND IZ DA STICK, AN' DA STICK HAB BIN READ BY SOMETINK ON DA WAY!

e_road_hitch.title: {DA HITCH-HIKER|THUMB OUT ON DA {country} ROAD|SOMEBODY WAITIN' AT DA JUNCTION}

n0.text:
DERE IZ SOMEBODY AT DA JUNCTION WIT A BAG AN' DEY THUMB OUT, AN' DERE HAB BIN FOR A WHILE: DA GRASS AT DAT SPOT IZ WORN FLAT IN A PATCH DA SIZE OF A PERSON STANDIN'.
DEY IZ DRESSED FOR A SEASON DAT IZ NO DIS ONE. DEY WAVE WHEN DEY SEE YOU, AN' DEY WAVE LIKE SOMEBODY WHO KNOWS YOU.
{weather}, AN' DEY HAB NO COAT.
DA WORN PATCH IZ WORN ON {BOTH SIDES|DA VERGE AN' DA TARMAC|A WIDTH OF FOUR FEET}, WHICH TAKES A GREAT MANY MORE YEARS DEN ONE PERSON STANDIN'!
n0.emText:
SOMEBODY AT DA JUNCTION WIT DEY THUMB OUT, STANDIN' IN A PATCH OF GRASS WORN FLAT BY STANDIN', DRESSED FOR DA WRONG SEASON, WAVIN' AT YOU LIKE DEY KNOW YOU.
EVERYBODY IN DIS WORLD WAVES AT YOU LIKE DEY KNOW YOU. SOME OF DEM DO. DERE IZ A VERSION OF YOU MOST OF A YEAR AGO WHO WOULD HAB FOUND DIS COMFORTIN'!
n0.bubba: BUBBA IZ ALREADY SLOWIN' DOWN. "WE IZ STOPPIN'. NAH, NO ARGUE. NUN SE LASSA NISCIUNO 'NMIEZ'A VIA."

asides.nurturing: {member} HAB DA SPARE COAT OUT OF DA BACK BEFORE DA VEHICLE HAB STOPPED!
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.sanguine: {member} IZ ALREADY TALKIN' TA DEM THROUGH DA WINDOW!
asides.melancholic: {member} LOOKS AT DA WORN PATCH OF GRASS AN' WORKS OUT HOW LONG SOMEBODY HAB TA STAND SOMEWHERE!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PICK DEM UP.
ASK WHERE DEY IZ GOING FIRST!
GIVE DEM DA COAT AN' DRIVE ON!
DRIVE PAST.

a.text:
DEY GET IN, AN' DEY IZ GOOD COMPANY, AN' DEY KNOW DA ROAD: EVERY TURNIN', EVERY BAD BEND, WHICH GARAGE IZ OPEN ON A SUNDAY.
DEY DO NO KNOW WHAT YEAR IT IZ. DEY FIND DIS OUT 'BOUT AN HOUR ON DA ROAD IN, FROM DA RADIO, AN' DEY GO REAL QUIET, AN' DEN DEY ASK, EXTREMELY POLITELY, TA BE LET OUT AT DA NEXT JUNCTION, WHICH IZ WHERE DEY GOT IN!

choices.text: TAKE DEM TA WHERE DEY WAZ GOING ANYWAY!
LET DEM OUT WHERE DEY ASK!

b.text:
DEY NAME A TOWN. DA TOWN IZ FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES AWAY AN' IT IZ ON YA ROAD AN' IT HAB NO EXISTED SINCE {timeAgo}: IT WENT UNDER A RESERVOIR, AN' EVERYBODY KNOWS DAT, AN' DEY DO NO.
DEY HAB A PHOTOGRAPH OF A HOUSE IN IT. DEY SHOW YOU DA PHOTOGRAPH DA WAY PEOPLE DO WHEN DEY HAB SHOWN IT TA A GREAT MANY DRIVERS!

choices.text: DRIVE DEM TA DA RESERVOIR!
TELL DEM, AT DA JUNCTION, BEFORE DEY GET IN!

c.text:
YOU PUT YA SPARE COAT ROUND DEY SHOULDERS AN' DRIVE ON, AN' IN DA MIRROR DEY IZ STILL STANDIN' DERE WIT DA COAT ON, WAVIN'.
DA COAT IZ IN DA BACK OF YA VEHICLE WHEN YOU NEXT LOOK FOR IT, FOLDED, WIT SOMETINK IN DA POCKET DAT WAZ NO DERE, AN' DA SOMETINK IZ WORTH 'BOUT TWICE OVER DA COAT!

d.text:
YOU DRIVE PAST AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS, WHICH IZ DA HONEST OUTCOME AN' WHICH EVERYBODY IN DA VEHICLE SITS WIT FOR DA NEXT TWENTY KILOMETRES.
AT DA NEXT JUNCTION, A LONG HAUL ON, DEY IZ STANDIN' DERE. SAME BAG. SAME WORN PATCH OF GRASS. SAME WAVE!

choices.text: STOP DIS TIME.
DRIVE PAST AGAIN.

a1.text:
DEY DIRECT YOU DA WHOLE WAY TA A HOUSE DAT IZ NO DERE, ON A STREET DAT IZ UNDER A RESERVOIR, AN' DEY GET OUT AT DA WATER'S EDGE AN' STAND LOOKIN' AT IT FOR A LONG TIME.
DEN DEY THANK YOU, PROPERLY, BY NAME, AN' WALK DOWN DA SLIPWAY INTO DA WATER, AN' DA WATER IZ EXACTLY AS DEEP AS A PERSON IZ TALL, AN' DEY IZ NO IN IT.
ON DA SEAT WHERE DEY WAZ SITTIN': {relicWord}!

a2.text:
DEY GET OUT AT DEY JUNCTION AN' STAND IN DA WORN PATCH AN' PUT DEY THUMB OUT, AN' DA LAST YOU SEE OF DEM IN DA MIRROR DEY IZ WAVIN' AT A CAR DAT IZ NO DERE YET.
AN HOUR ON DA ROAD LATER, DA RADIO IN YA VEHICLE PLAYS FOUR BARS OF SOMETINK DAT IZ NO ON ANY STATION, AN' EVERYBODY HEARS IT, AN' NOBODY SAYS ANYTINK!

b1.text:
FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES OF EXTREMELY GOOD COMPANY, AN' A RESERVOIR AT DA END OF IT, AN' A CONVERSATION AT DA WATER'S EDGE DAT NONE OF YOU WILL REPEAT TA ANYBODY.
DEY TAKE IT WELL. DAT IZ DA TINK DAT STAYS WIT YOU: DEY TAKE IT REAL WELL, AN' DEY THANK YOU FOR DA LIFT, AN' DEY ASK YOU TA DO ONE TINK IN DA NEAREST TOWN, WHICH IZ TA FIND OUT WHETHER DA SCHOOL WAZ MOVED OR DROWNED!

b2.text:
YOU TELL DEM AT DA JUNCTION, IN DA RAIN, WIT DA ENGINE RUNNIN'.
DEY DO NO BELIEVE YOU. DEN DEY DO. IT TAKES 'BOUT A COUPLE OF SECONDS AN' DEY AGE YEARS AN' YEARS IN IT, AN' DEY SIT DOWN ON DEY BAG AT DA SIDE OF DA ROAD, AN' YOU SIT DOWN WIT DEM, AN' NOBODY DRIVES ANYWHERE FOR AN HOUR!

d1.text:
THIRD JUNCTION, FOURTH JUNCTION, FIFTH. SAME BAG, SAME WAVE, AN' BY DA SIXTH NOBODY IN DA VEHICLE IZ TALKIN'.
AT DA SEVENTH DEY IZ NO DERE, AN' DA RELIEF LASTS 'BOUT A KILOMETRE, AN' DEN SOMEBODY IN DA BACK SAYS, IN A COMPLETELY NORMAL VOICE, DAT DEY IZ IN DA BACK!

a2_m.text:
DEY ASK TA BE LET OUT AT A JUNCTION DAT IZ NO DA ONE DEY GOT IN AT AN' IZ NO NEAR ANYTINK, AN' DEY THANK EVERYBODY BY NAME, INCLUDIN' {member}, WHO DID NO GIVE A NAME.
DA BAG GOES WIT DEM. ON DA SEAT WHERE DEY WAZ SITTIN' DERE IZ {A COAT BUTTON|A TICKET|SOMETINK LIL'} DAT IZ NO DA PARTY'S, AN' IT IZ WARM!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DEY USED ME NAME. ME NEVER SAID IT.|DO NO TOUCH WHAT IZ ON DA SEAT.|DRIVE.}"
asides.any: {member} {PICKS IT UP|LOOKS BACK AT DA JUNCTION|WINDS DA WINDOW DOWN}

choices.text: DRIVE ON. DO NO LOOK BACK!
TAKE WHAT IZ ON DA SEAT BACK TA DEM!
WORK OUT WHAT IT IZ.

a2_give.text:
DA JUNCTION IZ {TWO HUNDRED METRES|NO DISTANCE|JUST BEHIND} BACK AN' DERE IZ NOBODY AT IT AN' DA GRASS IZ NO WORN.
DA OBJECT IZ PUT ON DA VERGE ANYWAY, AT DA SPOT, BY SOMEBODY WHO SAYS SO OUT LOUD WHILE DOING IT. IT IZ NO DERE {AN HOUR LATER|WHEN DA PARTY PASSES AGAIN|DA NEXT TIME ANYBODY LOOKS}, AN' NEITHER IZ DA WORN PATCH, AN' DAT ROAD HAB NEVER HAB ANYBODY STANDIN' ON IT SINCE!

a2_what.text:
IT IZ {A TICKET|A COAT BUTTON|A TOKEN} FOR A TOWN DAT HAB BIN UNDER A RESERVOIR SINCE {timeAgo}, ISSUED ON A DATE, AN' DA DATE IZ {A COUPLE OF DAYS FROM NOW|NEXT WEEK|NO YET}.
IT IZ ALSO, BY DA STATE OF IT, BRAND NEW. EVERYBODY IN DA VEHICLE LOOKS AT IT AN' NOBODY SUGGESTS THROWIN' IT OUT OF DA WINDOW, WHICH IZ DA FIRST SIGN DAT DIS IZ GOING TA BE A LONG-RUNNIN' ARRANGEMENT!

b2_m.text:
YOU TELL DEM AT DA JUNCTION, IN DA RAIN, WIT DA ENGINE RUNNIN', AN' DEY DO NO BELIEVE YOU, AN' DEN DEY DO.
IT TAKES {A COUPLE OF MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|A WHILE}. AT DA END OF IT DEY ASK ONE TINK, WHICH IZ WHETHER ANYBODY KNOWS WHAT HAPPENED TA {DA HOUSES ON DEY STREET|DA CHURCH|DA SCHOOL}, AN' NOBODY IN DA VEHICLE DOES!

choices.text: SAY SO. SAY NOBODY KNOWS.
GO AN' FIND OUT. TAKE DEM WIT YOU!
FIND OUT FROM DA RECORD OFFICE AN' COME BACK!

b2_rec.text:
DA RECORD OFFICE IN {region} HAB DA WHOLE VALLEY ON {FOUR SHEETS|MICROFILM|A ROLL}: EVERY STREET, EVERY HOUSE, DA COMPENSATION REGISTER AN' DA PHOTOGRAPHS TAKEN DA WEEK BEFORE DA WATER CAME.
DA PARTY DRIVES FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES BACK TA A JUNCTION WIT COPIES. DEY IZ STILL DERE. DA READIN' TAKES UNTIL {DARK|DA LIGHT GOES|DA RAIN STOPS}, AN' AT DA END OF IT DEY FOLD DA SHEETS UP AN' PUT OUT DEY THUMB AN' IZ NO DERE DA NEXT TIME DA ROAD IZ DRIVEN!

e_road_convoy.title: {DA SECOND LORRY|CONVOY AT DA COUNTY LINE|HAZARDS GOING}

n0.text:
FOUR LORRIES IN CONVOY, HAZARDS GOING, DOING 'BOUT FORTY IN A SIXTY LIMIT, AN' DA SECOND ONE IZ DA PROBLEM.
DA FIRST, THIRD AN' FOURTH IZ TRUCKER'S SOCIETY. DA SECOND HAB NO PLATE ON DA FRONT, NO MUD ON IT ANYWHERE, AN' A DRIVER WHO DOES NO RESPOND TA A LIFTED HAND, WHICH ON DIS ROAD IZ DA SAME AS SPITTIN'.
AT DA COUNTY LINE DA CONVOY PULLS IN AN' DA DRIVERS GET OUT AN' STAND IN A GROUP LOOKIN' AT DA SECOND LORRY, WHICH DOES NO PULL IN AN' DOES NO GO ON EITHER. IT WAITS, IN DA ROAD, ENGINE RUNNIN'.
DA SECOND LORRY'S PLATE IZ {LEGIBLE|CLEAN|READABLE} AN' IT IZ A PLATE DAT WAZ ISSUED {DIS YEAR|RECENTLY|AFTER DA VEHICLE STOPPED BEING MADE}!
n0.emText:
A CONVOY OF FOUR, HAZARDS GOING, AN' DA SECOND LORRY HAB NO PLATE, NO MUD, AN' A DRIVER WHO DOES NO LIFT A HAND BACK.
AT DA COUNTY LINE DA OTHER THREE PULL IN AN' STAND LOOKIN' AT IT, AN' IT WAITS IN DA ROAD WIT ITS ENGINE GOING, AN' DA WHOLE SCENE HAB DA EXACT SHAPE OF A FAMILY DAT HAB BIN TRAVELLIN' WIT SOMEBODY DEY NO CAN GET RID OF!
n0.bubba: "DEY PICKED IT UP," SAYS BUBBA, QUIETLY. "SOMEWHERE BACK DERE IT FELL IN BEHIND AN' DEY NO CAN SHAKE IT. 'O SSACCIO, CHESTO. IT HAPPENS."

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TALK TA DA THREE DRIVERS.
WALK UP AN' KNOCK ON DA CAB!
GET IN FRONT OF IT AN' LEAD IT AWAY!
LOOK IN DA TRAILER.

a.text:
"IT CAME IN BEHIND US AT DA ROADWORKS," DA OLDEST SAYS. "A COUPLE OF DAYS AGO. IT KEEPS STATION. IT TAKES DA FUEL STOPS. NOBODY'S SEEN HIM GET OUT."
DEY HAB TRIED LOSIN' IT, DEY HAB TRIED STOPPIN' FOR A NIGHT, AN' DEY HAB TRIED, ONCE, AT THREE IN DA MORNIN', GOING UP AN' LOOKIN' IN, AN' DA MAN WHO DID DAT IZ DA ONE STILL SITTIN' IN HIS CAB AN' HE HAB NO SPOKEN SINCE!

choices.text: GO AN' TALK TA DA DRIVER WHO LOOKED!
OFFER TA TAKE DA SECOND LORRY OFF DEM!

b.text:
DA DOOR IZ UNLOCKED. DA CAB IZ CLEAN AN' WARM AN' DERE IZ A FLASK IN DA HOLDER AN' A PHOTOGRAPH CLIPPED TA DA SUN VISOR AN' DA SEAT IZ WORN DA WAY A SEAT WEARS UNDER A MAN WHO DRIVES FOR A LIVIN'.
DERE IZ NOBODY IN IT, AN' DA HANDBRAKE IZ OFF, AN' DA ENGINE IZ RUNNIN', AN' WHILE YOU IZ STANDIN' ON DA STEP IT PUTS ITSELF INTO GEAR!

choices.text: GET IN AN' DRIVE IT.
GET OFF DA STEP.

c.text:
YOU PULL OUT IN FRONT OF IT AN' LEAD, AN' IT FOLLOWS: PERFECTLY, AT FOUR METRES, WHATEVER YOU DO.
YOU LEAD IT A GOOD DRIVE OFF DA ROUTE TA A LAY-BY DAT HAB NUTTIN' ON EITHER SIDE OF IT, AN' YOU PULL IN, AN' IT PULLS IN BEHIND YOU, AN' DEN IT DOES NO DO ANYTINK AT ALL, FOREVER, AN' DA THREE LORRIES AT DA COUNTY LINE GET TA GO HOME.
DA SOCIETY DO NO FORGET TINKZ LIKE DIS!

d.text:
DA TRAILER DOORS IZ NO LOCKED. INSIDE DERE IZ A LOAD: PALLETS, SHRINK-WRAPPED, STACKED PROPERLY, SECURED PROPERLY, BY SOMEBODY WHO KNOWS DA JOB.
EVERY PALLET IZ DA SAME. EVERY PALLET IZ A STACK OF ROAD: TARMAC, CUT INTO SQUARES, STILL WARM!

a1.text:
HE IZ SITTIN' WIT HIS HANDS ON DA WHEEL OF A PARKED LORRY AN' HE HAB BIN LIKE DAT FOR FOUR DAYS AN' HIS MATES TAKE HIM FOOD.
HE WILL NO TALK 'BOUT WHAT HE SAW. HE WILL WRITE IT, THOUGH, IF YOU GIVE HIM PAPER, AN' WHAT HE WRITES IZ FOUR WORDS, AN' DEN HE ASKS FOR DA PAPER BACK AN' EATS IT!

a2.text:
DEY GIVE YOU DA KEYS TA A LORRY DEY DO NO OWN AN' NO CAN GET RID OF, IN DA MIDDLE OF A ROAD, WIT TREMENDOUS RELIEF AN' A CERTAIN AMOUNT OF SHAME 'BOUT DA RELIEF.
IT IZ YA NOW. IT FOLLOWS YOU. WHAT DAT IZ WORTH DEPENDS ENTIRELY ON WHAT YOU DECIDE TA DO WIT A TINK DAT WILL FOLLOW YOU ANYWHERE!

b1.text:
YOU DRIVE SOMEBODY ELSE'S LORRY WIT SOMEBODY ELSE'S FLASK IN DA HOLDER AN' SOMEBODY ELSE'S PHOTOGRAPH ON DA VISOR, AN' IT DRIVES BEAUTIFULLY, AN' DA ROAD AHEAD OF YOU IZ ONE YOU HAB NEVER BIN ON AN' KNOW PERFECTLY.
AT SOME POINT YOU NOTICE DA CONVOY IZ BEHIND YOU AN' YOU IZ DA SECOND LORRY!

b2.text:
YOU GET OFF DA STEP AN' IT PULLS AWAY AN' TAKES ITS PLACE IN DA CONVOY, AN' DA THREE DRIVERS GET IN AN' FOLLOW IT COZ DAT IZ WHAT DEY HAB BIN DOING FOR FOUR DAYS.
WHAT YOU TAKE AWAY IZ DA PHOTOGRAPH OFF DA VISOR, WHICH YOU TOOK WITOUT DECIDIN' TA, AN' WHICH IZ OF A HOUSE ON A ROAD WIT FOUR LORRIES OUTSIDE IT!

a2_m.text:
DEY GIVE YOU DA KEYS TA A LORRY DEY DO NO OWN AN' NO CAN GET RID OF, IN DA MIDDLE OF A ROAD, WIT TREMENDOUS RELIEF AN' NO EYE CONTACT AT ALL.
DA KEYS IZ {WARM|WORN SMOOTH|NO NEW}. DA THREE OF DEM IZ BACK IN DEY CABS AN' GONE INSIDE FOUR MINUTES, WHICH LEAVES DA PARTY STANDIN' IN A LAY-BY WIT A VEHICLE DAT HAB BIN KEEPIN' STATION FOR FOUR DAYS AN' IZ NOW KEEPIN' STATION WIT DEM!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{WE HAB BIN GIVEN A PROBLEM WIT WHEELS.|DEY DID NO EVEN WAIT TA SEE US START IT.|IT HAB A NEW DRIVER NOW. US.}"
asides.any: {member} {WALKS ROUND IT ONCE|GETS IN AN' DOES NO START IT|LOOKS AT DA PHOTOGRAPH ON DA VISOR}

choices.text: DRIVE IT. SEE WHERE IT WANTS TA GO!
FIND OUT WHOSE PHOTOGRAPH IZ ON DA VISOR!
PARK IT, LOCK IT, AN' LEAVE DA KEYS AT A DEPOT!

a2_photo.text:
IT IZ A WOMAN AN' TWO CHILDREN ON A BEACH IN {1974|DA SEVENTIES|A YEAR DAT CAN BE DATED OFF DA CAR BEHIND DEM}, AN' DA BACK OF IT HAB A NAME AN' A TOWN.
DA TOWN IZ {HALF A SHIFT|NO FAR|ON DIS ROAD}. DA HOUSE IZ STILL DERE. DA WOMAN IZ STILL IN IT, AN' SHE IZ {EIGHTY|REAL OLD|NO SURPRISED}, AN' SHE HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR DAT LORRY TA COME BACK SINCE BEFORE EITHER OF DA CHILDREN IN DA PHOTOGRAPH LEFT HOME!

a2_park.text:
PARKED, LOCKED, KEYS THROUGH A DEPOT LETTERBOX WIT A NOTE, WHICH TAKES {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|AN AFTERNOON|NO TIME} AN' IZ ENTIRELY REASONABLE.
IT IZ BEHIND DA PARTY'S OWN VEHICLE ON DA ROAD OUT OF TOWN, AT FOUR METRES, KEEPIN' STATION, WIT DA HAZARDS GOING AN' DA CAB EMPTY, AN' IT IZ STILL DERE {TWO HUNDRED KILOMETRES|FOUR HOURS|DA WHOLE WAY} LATER!

e_road_eighty.title: {NINETY ON DA STRAIGHT|DA RULE OF EIGHTY|DA CAR DAT DOES NO SLOW}

n0.text:
EVERYBODY KNOWS DA RULE. OVER EIGHTY, ON ANY ROAD, FOR LONG ENOUGH, AN' YOU IZ SOMEWHERE DA ROAD REMEMBERS.
DERE IZ A CAR ON DIS STRAIGHT DOING WELL OVER A HUNDRED, AN' IT HAB BIN DOING IT PAST DIS POINT FOR DA LAST FORTY MINUTES, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, WHICH IZ NO POSSIBLE, AN' EVERY LOCAL VEHICLE HAB PULLED ONTO DA VERGE TA LET IT THROUGH.
A MAN ON DA VERGE WIT A FLASK SAYS: "HE'S BIN AT IT SINCE TUESDAY. IT IZ DA SAME LAP."
DERE IZ {FOUR|THREE} LAPS' WORTH OF TYRE MARKS ON DA SAME BEND AN' DEY IZ ALL HIS!
n0.emText:
A CAR DOING A HUNDRED AN' TEN ON A STRAIGHT, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, EVERY FOUR MINUTES, WHICH NO CAN BE A LAP AN' IZ ONE.
DA RULE OF EIGHTY: GO FAST ENOUGH FOR LONG ENOUGH AN' DA ROAD STOPS BEING WHERE YOU IZ. SOMEBODY IN DERE HAB BIN OVER DA LINE SINCE TUESDAY AN' HAB NO MANAGED TA STOP, AN' DA WHOLE COUNTY IZ STANDIN' ON DA VERGE WAITIN' FOR A DECISION DAT ONLY DA DRIVER CAN MAKE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA WATCHES IT GO PAST AN' HIS HAT MOVES IN DA WIND OF IT. "MAMMA D''O CARMENE. HE'S INSIDE IT. HE'S INSIDE IT AN' HE'S STILL DRIVIN'."

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GET IN FRONT OF HIM AN' SLOW HIM DOWN!
PUT SOMETINK ACROSS DA ROAD!
GO WIT HIM. MATCH HIM AT NINETY!
TALK TA DA PEOPLE ON DA VERGE!

a.text:
IT TAKES FOUR LAPS TA GET DA TIMIN' AN' ONE TA DO IT, AN' DOING IT MEANS BEING IN FRONT OF A CAR DOING A HUNDRED AN' TEN WIT A DRIVER WHO HAB NO BLINKED SINCE TUESDAY.
HE SEES YOU. DAT IZ DA TINK: AT DA FOURTH LAP HE SEES YOU, AN' DA CAR COMES DOWN THROUGH DA GEARS, AN' IT TAKES A FEW KILOMETRES, AN' AT DA END OF IT DERE IZ A CAR STOPPED ON A STRAIGHT ROAD WIT DA ENGINE TICKIN' AN' A MAN IN IT WHO HAB BIN DRIVIN' FOR FOUR DAYS!

b.text:
YOU LAY WHATEVER YOU HAB ACROSS DA CARRIAGEWAY AN' STAND BACK.
HE GOES THROUGH IT AT A HUNDRED AN' TEN AN' NUTTIN' ON DA ROAD IZ DISTURBED AT ALL, AN' NEITHER IZ DA CAR, AN' ON DA NEXT LAP DA TINKZ YOU LAID OUT IZ BACK ON DA VERGE, STACKED, NEATLY, DA WAY SOMEBODY TIDIES UP AFTER YOU!

choices.text: TRY AGAIN WIT SOMETINK HE NO CAN GO THROUGH!
STAND IN DA ROAD YOURSELF!

c.text:
EIGHTY, NINETY, A HUNDRED, AN' AT 'BOUT DA FOURTH MINUTE DA HEDGES STOP BEING HEDGES.
HE IZ BESIDE YOU. HE LOOKS ACROSS. HE IZ PERFECTLY CALM AN' HE HAB BIN CALM SINCE TUESDAY AN' HE MOUTHS SOMETINK AT YOU DAT TAKES A FULL LAP TA UNDERSTAND, AN' WHAT IT IZ, IZ: NO!

d.text:
ELEVEN OF DEM ON DA VERGE, WIT FLASKS, SINCE TUESDAY.
IT IZ HIS WIFE'S BROTHER. IT IZ DA THIRD ONE ON DIS ROAD IN ELEVEN YEARS. DEY HAB ALREADY RUNG EVERYBODY DERE IZ TA RING AN' DA POLICE CAME OUT AN' STOOD HERE FOR HALF A SHIFT AN' WENT AWAY AGAIN.
WHAT DEY WANT IZ SOMEBODY TA BE HERE WHEN IT STOPS, COZ DEY NO CAN BEAR TA BE, AN' DEY WILL PAY FOR DAT, AN' DEY IZ ASHAMED OF PAYIN' FOR IT!

choices.text: STAY UNTIL IT STOPS.
TAKE DA MONEY AN' STAY ANYWAY!

b1.text:
A TRAILER, A FELLED TREE, AN' DA TUG UNIT OFF A LORRY.
HE COMES THROUGH AT A HUNDRED AN' TEN AN' DIS TIME DA ROAD DOES NO TIDY UP AFTERWARDS: DERE IZ A SOUND LIKE A REAL LONG WORD ENDIN', AN' DERE IZ A CAR SIDEWAYS IN A FIELD, AN' DERE IZ A MAN CRAWLIN' OUT OF IT WHO HAB BIN DRIVIN' SINCE TUESDAY AN' WHO IZ, REMARKABLY, ALIVE.
WHAT COMES OUT OF DA PASSENGER SIDE IZ NO!

b2.text:
YOU STAND ON DA CENTRE LINE OF A STRAIGHT ROAD WIT A CAR COMIN' AT A HUNDRED AN' TEN AN' FOUR DAYS OF MOMENTUM BEHIND IT, AN' YOU DO NO MOVE.
HE STOPS. OF COURSE HE STOPS. HE WAZ NEVER GOING TA BE ABLE TA STOP FOR A TREE!

d1.text:
YOU STAY. IT TAKES UNTIL HALF PAST FOUR IN DA MORNIN' AN' DEN DA INTERVAL STARTS STRETCHIN': FOUR MINUTES, FOUR AN' A HALF, SIX, ELEVEN.
DA LAST LAP IZ AT WALKIN' PACE. HE PULLS IN ON DA VERGE NEXT TA ELEVEN PEOPLE WIT FLASKS AN' TURNS DA ENGINE OFF, AN' GETS OUT, AN' IZ FOUR DAYS OLDER AN' NINETEEN YEARS YOUNGER, AN' NOBODY SAYS ANYTINK AT ALL FOR A WHILE!

d2.text:
YOU TAKE IT, COZ DEY NEED YOU TA, AN' YOU STAY, WHICH WAZ NEVER IN QUESTION.
WHAT YOU DO FOR FOUR HOURS ON A VERGE IN DA DARK WIT ELEVEN FRIGHTENED PEOPLE IZ MAKE TEA AN' KEEP DEM TALKIN', AN' AT HALF PAST FOUR YOU IZ DA ONES WHO WALK OUT TA DA CAR!

d1_m.text:
YOU STAY. IT TAKES UNTIL HALF PAST FOUR IN DA MORNIN' AN' DEN DA INTERVAL STARTS STRETCHIN': FOUR MINUTES, FOUR AN' A HALF, {FIVE|SIX|LONGER}.
DA ELEVEN ON DA VERGE GO REAL QUIET WHEN IT PASSES EIGHT MINUTES, COZ EIGHT MINUTES HAB HAPPENED BEFORE, {TWICE|ON TWO NIGHTS|MORE DEN ONCE}, AN' BOTH TIMES IT WENT BACK TA FOUR BY DAWN!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DEY HAB BIN COUNTIN' FOR FOUR DAYS. ASK DEM WHAT HAPPENED AFTER DA EIGHT MINUTES.|DIS IZ NO DA FIRST NIGHT.|EIGHT MINUTES IZ NO GOOD NEWS.}"
asides.any: {member} {TAKES DA WATCH OFF DA WIFE'S BROTHER, WHO HAB NO SLEPT|WRITES DA INTERVALS DOWN|PUTS DA KETTLE ON}

choices.text: STAY FOR IT. WHATEVER IT IZ!
TIME IT PROPERLY AN' WORK OUT DA CURVE!
GET EVERYBODY OFF DA VERGE BEFORE DA NEXT PASS!

d1_curve.text:
ELEVEN PASSES TIMED ON A BORROWED WATCH AN' DA INTERVALS PLOTTED ON DA BACK OF A FLASK LABEL, AN' DA CURVE IZ {DOUBLIN'|LENGTHENIN' GEOMETRICALLY|GOING UP BY HALF EACH TIME}.
WHICH GIVES A LAST PASS. IT IZ {FOUR HOURS|AT 'BOUT NINE|IN DA MORNIN'} AWAY, AN' IT IZ DA LAST ONE, AN' KNOWIN' DAT CHANGES WHAT EVERYBODY ON DAT VERGE DOES WIT DA REST OF DA NIGHT!

d1_clear.text:
GETTIN' ELEVEN PEOPLE WHO HAB BIN ON A VERGE SINCE TUESDAY TA LEAVE IT TAKES {ONE ARGUMENT|DA RIGHT TINK SAID ONCE|'BOUT A SHORT WHILE} AN' IT IZ DA WIFE'S BROTHER WHO IZ HARDEST AN' WHO GOES FIRST IN DA END.
DA NEXT PASS IZ AT {NINE MINUTES|ELEVEN MINUTES|A LONG INTERVAL} AN' DA VERGE IZ EMPTY FOR IT AN' IT {SLOWS|STOPS|DOES SOMETINK NOBODY SEES}. NOBODY IZ ON DA VERGE TA SEE IT. DAT IZ DA POINT, AN' IT IZ DA REASON DERE IZ NO A FOURTH ONE ON DIS ROAD!

b2_m.text:
STANDIN' ON DA CENTRE LINE OF A STRAIGHT ROAD WIT A CAR COMIN' AT A HUNDRED AN' TEN AN' FOUR DAYS OF MOMENTUM BEHIND IT IZ A TINK DAT LASTS 'BOUT {NINE SECONDS|FOUR SECONDS|NO TIME AT ALL} FROM DA OUTSIDE.
FROM DA INSIDE DERE IZ TIME TA SEE DA DRIVER. HE IZ {LOOKIN' AT YOU|AWAKE|NO ENJOYIN' IT}, AN' HIS HANDS IZ ON DA WHEEL PROPERLY, AN' HE IZ TRYIN' TA LIFT OFF AN' DA CAR IZ NO LETTIN' HIM!

choices.text: STAND. DO NO MOVE.
GET OUT OF DA ROAD AN' GO AFTER DA CAR INSTEAD!
SIGNAL HIM. SOMETINK HE CAN DO WIT HIS HANDS!

b2_sig.text:
ONE SIGNAL, MADE BIG, FROM DA CENTRE LINE, IN DA TIME AVAILABLE: {IGNITION|KILL IT|DA KEY}, WHICH IZ A TINK A DRIVER CAN DO WIT ONE HAND WHEN DA PEDALS HAB STOPPED BELONGIN' TA DEM.
HE DOES IT ON DA NEXT LAP. DA CAR GOES {FOUR HUNDRED METRES|A LONG WAY|MOST OF A STRAIGHT} ON ITS OWN MOMENTUM AN' COMES TA REST ON DA VERGE, AN' EVERYTINK AFTER DAT IZ A MAN BEING HELPED OUT OF A CAR BY ELEVEN PEOPLE WHO HAB BIN WAITIN' SINCE TUESDAY!

e_ocean_fisher.title: {DA CATCH NOBODY WILL BUY|A COUPLE OF MEN AN' A FULL HOLD|EVERY FISH FACIN' YOU}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A BOAT LYING TA OUT HERE WIT THREE MEN ON IT AN' NONE OF DEM WORKIN'.
DA HOLD IZ FULL. DAT IZ DA PROBLEM. DEY WILL NO PUT IN WIT IT, DEY WILL NO TIP IT BACK, AN' DEY HAB BIN OUT HERE {TWO|THREE|FIVE} DAYS DECIDIN'. DA SKIPPER, {trade}'S BROTHER BY DA LOOK OF HIM, WAVES YOU ALONGSIDE LIKE A MAN WAVIN' DOWN A BUS.
"YOU KNOW ANYTINK 'BOUT FISH," HE SAYS. IT IZ NO A QUESTION.
DA NET IZ INBOARD AN' STOWED AN' {DRY|BONE DRY|NO WET}, AN' DA HOLD IZ FULL!
n0.emText:
A FEW MEN, ONE BOAT, A FULL HOLD, AN' A STILLNESS ON DA WATER DAT YOU RECOGNISE FROM DA INSIDE OF YA OWN HEAD: DA STILLNESS OF PEOPLE WHO HAB MADE A DECISION DEY NO CAN SAY OUT LOUD.
DA SKIPPER WAVES YOU ALONGSIDE LIKE A MAN FLAGGIN' A BUS IN A DREAM. "YOU KNOW ANYTINK 'BOUT FISH," HE SAYS, AN' DA WATER UNDER HIS HULL IZ EXACTLY, UNNATURALLY FLAT, DA WAY TINKZ GO FLAT AROUND YOU WHEN DA EIGHT PER CENT DAT CAME BACK STARTS PAYIN' ATTENTION!
n0.bubba: "FISH," SAYS BUBBA, DELIGHTED. "NOW FISH ME KNOW. Y'ALL GOT A FISH PROBLEM, YOU GOT YOURSELF A BUBBA SOLUTION. STATTE' BBUONO, CAP'."

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: LOOK IN DA HOLD.
ASK DEM WHAT DEY TINK DEY CAUGHT!
OFFER TA TAKE DA CATCH OFF DEY HANDS, NO QUESTIONS!
TELL DEM TA DUMP IT AN' SAY A PRAYER OVER IT!

a.text:
IT IZ FULL OF FISH. ORDINARY, SILVER, PERFECTLY GOOD FISH.
EVERY ONE OF DEM IZ FACIN' DA SAME WAY, PACKED IN DA ICE AS NEATLY AS A CHORUS, AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM IZ FACIN' YOU. WHEN YOU MOVE TA DA OTHER SIDE OF DA HOLD, DEY IZ STILL FACIN' YOU. NOBODY HAB TOUCHED DEM!
a.bubba: BUBBA TAKES HIS HAT OFF. "UH. SUGAR. DEY IZ LOOKIN' AT YA." DEN, QUIETER, TA DA FISH: "GUAGLIUNI, CE NE JAMME, EH?"

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.artistic: {member} SAYS IT IZ BEAUTIFUL. {member} IZ NO ENTIRELY WRONG!
asides.fatalistic: {member} {SIGHS: "WELL, WE WAZ GOING TA DIE EVENTUALLY."|SHRUGS: "IF DA REACTOR BLOWS, AT LEAST IT IZ QUICK."|MUTTERS DAT DA UNIVERSE ALWAYS FINDS A WAY TA RUIN YA DAY|EXPECTS DA WORST AN' NO IZ DISAPPOINTED}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BUY DA LOT AN' TAKE IT TA MARKET YOURSELF!
TAKE ONE FISH AN' PUT DA REST BACK IN DA SEA!

b.text:
"WE NO CATCH IT," DA SKIPPER SAYS. "IT COME IN DA NET AFTER. DA NET WAZ EMPTY AN' DEN IT NO WAZ AN' DERE IZ NO FISH DAT DOES DAT."
DA YOUNGEST OF DEM HAB NO SPOKEN. HE IZ HOLDIN' A ROSARY IN ONE HAND AN' A MARKER PEN IN DA OTHER, AN' HE HAB BIN WRITIN' ON DA WHEELHOUSE WALL: DA SAME FOUR WORDS, {A HUNDRED|TWO HUNDRED} TIMES, IN A HAND DAT GETS WORSE AN' DEN GETS BETTER AGAIN!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX THREE TIMES AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.nurturing: {member} GETS TEA INTO ALL THREE OF DEM BEFORE ANOTHER WORD IZ SAID!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: READ DA FOUR WORDS OUT LOUD!
GET DA CREW OFF DA BOAT AN' INTO YA!

c.text:
DEY TAKE YA MONEY LIKE MEN HANDIN' OVER A DOG DAT BITES.
YOU LAND IT AT FOUR IN DA MORNIN' AT A QUAY WHERE NOBODY ASKS. DA BUYER PAYS OVER DA ODDS, IN CASH, AN' ASKS YOU TA SIGN NUTTIN'. SOMEWHERE BETWEEN DA QUAY AN' DA MARKET IT BECOMES SOMEBODY ELSE'S PROBLEM, WHICH IZ WHAT MONEY IZ FOR!

d.text:
YOU SAY IT FLATLY AN' YOU SAY IT ONCE, AN' COZ YOU SAY IT LIKE DAT, DEY DO IT.
DA HOLD GOES BACK OVER DA SIDE IN DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR. DA SEA TAKES IT WITOUT A SOUND. DA SKIPPER SHAKES YA HAND FOR SLIGHTLY TOO LONG, AN' DA YOUNGEST ONE STOPS WRITIN' ON DA WALL AN' STARTS CRYIN', WHICH EVERYBODY SENSIBLY IGNORES.
DEY PUT YA NAME ON DEY BOAT, PAINTED ON DA HULL!

a1.text:
DA MARKET WILL NO HAB IT. NEITHER WILL DA SECOND MARKET. DA THIRD BUYER IZ A WOMAN IN A FOUNDATION COAT WHO HAB BIN WAITIN' AT DA WEIGHBRIDGE SINCE BEFORE YOU DECIDED TA COME.
SHE BUYS DA ENTIRE HOLD, ICE AN' ALL, AN' ASKS YOU A FEW QUESTIONS 'BOUT WHICH WAY DA FISH WAZ FACIN' WHEN YOU FIRST LOOKED!

a2.text:
DEY GO BACK OVER DA SIDE IN ONE LONG SILVER ROPE AN' DA SEA CLOSES ON DEM.
DA ONE YOU KEPT DOES NO SPOIL. IT IZ IN YA PACK A WEEK LATER, COLD, SILVER, PERFECT, STILL FACIN' WHICHEVER WAY YOU IZ. IN {region} A COLLECTOR OF EXACTLY DIS SORT OF TINK PAYS WHAT HE THINKS IT IZ WORTH, WHICH IZ A GREAT DEAL MORE DEN A FISH!

b1.text:
DEY IZ ONE WORD WRITTEN FOUR WAYS, AN' IT IZ A NAME, AN' WHEN YOU SAY IT DA NET GOES OVER DA SIDE BY ITSELF.
WHAT COMES UP ON IT IZ NO FISH, AN' IT IZ NO PLEASED TA BE INTERRUPTED AT WHATEVER IT WAZ DOING!

b2.text:
YOU GET ALL THREE OFF, AN' DA YOUNGEST ONE LAST, AN' YOU IZ HALF A MILE OFF WHEN DEY BOAT PUTS ITS OWN ENGINE ON AN' GOES EAST AT A SPEED DAT BOAT NO CAN DO.
YOU PUT DA THREE OF DEM ASHORE AT {region}. DA SKIPPER GIVES YOU {payment} AN' DA ROSARY, AN' ASKS YOU NO TA WRITE DOWN DA NAME OF DA BOAT!

a2_m.text:
DEY GO BACK OVER DA SIDE IN ONE LONG SILVER ROPE AN' DA SEA CLOSES ON DEM, AN' DA HOLD IZ EMPTY IN 'BOUT {A SHORT WHILE|NO TIME|LESS TIME DEN FILLIN' IT WOULD TAKE}.
DA ONE KEPT BACK DOES NO SPOIL. IT ALSO DOES NO STOP FACIN' DA SAME WAY: PUT IT DOWN IN ANY ORIENTATION ON ANY SURFACE AN' IT IZ {POINTIN' NORTH|POINTIN' DA SAME WAY|TURNED ROUND} DA NEXT TIME ANYBODY LOOKS!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{IT IZ A COMPASS AN' IT USED TA BE A FISH.|PUT IT IN A BOX. A METAL BOX.|IT IZ STILL POINTIN'.}"
asides.any: {member} {TURNS IT ROUND AGAIN TA CHECK|PUTS IT ON DA CHART TABLE|MARKS DA DIRECTION ON DA DECK}

choices.text: KEEP IT. IT IZ A GOOD FISH AN' A BETTER STORY!
FOLLOW WHERE IT POINTS.
PUT IT OVER DA SIDE AFTER DA OTHERS!

a2_follow.text:
IT IZ NO POINTIN' NORTH. CORRECTED FOR DA BOAT'S OWN SWING OVER {FOUR HOURS|A WATCH|AN AFTERNOON} IT IZ POINTIN' AT A FIXED SPOT, AN' DA SPOT IZ {ELEVEN MILES|NO FAR|A FEW HOURS} OFF, AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' MARKED DERE.
DERE IZ SOMETINK DERE. DA PARTY GETS TA IT AT DUSK AN' DA SOUNDER READS {FOUR FATHOMS|SHALLOW|A BANK} OVER GROUND DAT DA CHART CALLS TWO HUNDRED, AN' DA FISH STOPS POINTIN' DA MOMENT DA BOAT IZ OVER IT!

a2_over.text:
ONE FISH OVER DA SIDE AFTER DA REST OF DEM, WHICH IZ THROWIN' AWAY DA ONLY EVIDENCE ANYBODY WILL EVER HAB, AN' IZ DONE ANYWAY BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB DECIDED DA BOAT HAB HAB ENOUGH.
DA THREE MEN ON IT WILL NO TAKE MONEY AFTERWARDS AN' WILL NO TAKE THANKS. WHAT DEY DO IZ GIVE DA PARTY {A NAME|AN ADDRESS|SOMEBODY TA ASK FOR} AT EVERY PORT ON DIS COAST, WHICH IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA CATCH WAZ AN' DOES NO HAB TA BE EXPLAINED TA ANYBODY!

b2_m.text:
YOU GET ALL THREE OFF, AN' DA YOUNGEST ONE LAST, AN' YOU IZ HALF A MILE OFF WHEN DEY BOAT PUTS ITS OWN ENGINE AHEAD AN' TURNS FOR OPEN WATER WIT NOBODY ABOARD.
DA SKIPPER WATCHES IT GO AN' SAYS, WITOUT ANY PARTICULAR EMOTION, DAT SHE IZ {FORTY YEARS|HIS FATHER'S|NO INSURED} AN' DAT DA FOUR WORDS IZ STILL CHALKED ON DA HATCH AN' DAT WHOEVER FINDS HER WILL READ DEM!

choices.text: LET HER GO. GET DA MEN ASHORE!
GO AFTER HER AN' GET DA HATCH BOARD OFF!
PUT OUT A WARNIN' ON DA BAND DAT NAMES HER!

b2_chase.text:
HALF A MILE OF CHASE, AN AWKWARD COME-ALONGSIDE IN A SWELL, AN' SOMEBODY OVER ONTO A DECK DAT NOBODY IZ STEERIN', WIT A BAR AN' FOUR SECONDS OF RESOLVE.
DA HATCH BOARD COMES OFF AN' GOES IN DA SEA. DA BOAT STOPS {IMMEDIATELY|AT ONCE|AS THOUGH IT HAB BIN LET GO OF}, AN' DRIFTS, AN' IZ TOWED IN DA NEXT MORNIN' BY HER OWN SKIPPER, AN' DA FOUR WORDS IZ AT DA BOTTOM OF FORTY FATHOMS WHERE DEY CAN BE LEFT!

b2_radio.text:
A WARNIN' ON DA BAND, BY NAME, WIT HER POSITION AN' HER HEADIN' AN' ONE SENTENCE 'BOUT NO BOARDIN' HER, REPEATED EVERY {A GOOD WHILE|HALF HOUR|HOUR} UNTIL DA COASTGUARD TAKES IT OVER.
NOBODY BOARDS HER. SHE IZ FOUND {A WEEK AN' A BIT|A FORTNIGHT|WEEKS} LATER ON A BEACH FOUR COUNTRIES AWAY, AN' DA FOUR WORDS IZ PHOTOGRAPHED BY SOMEBODY OFFICIAL AN' GO INTO A FILE, AN' IT IZ DA PARTY'S OWN TRANSMISSION DAT PUT DEM DERE!

e_lake_angler.title: {DA ANGLER AT DA SLUICE|NUTTIN' HAB BIN CAUGHT HERE SINCE {timeAgo}|DA STILL WATER}

n0.text:
ONE MAN, ONE ROD, ONE FOLDIN' CHAIR, AT A SLUICE ON A LAKE WHERE DA OFFICIAL RECORD SAYS NUTTIN' HAB BIN CAUGHT SINCE {timeAgo}.
HE HAB FOUR ROD RESTS AN' ONLY ONE ROD. HE HAB A LANDIN' NET BIG ENOUGH FOR SOMETINK DA LAKE DOES NO CONTAIN. HE HAB A FLASK, A RADIO PLAYIN' {radio}, AN' DA PATIENCE OF A MAN WHO HAB BIN COMIN' HERE LONGER DEN YOU HAB BIN ALIVE.
"YOU CAN FISH IT," HE SAYS. "YOU NO WILL CATCH ANYTINK. DAT IZ NO WHY ANYBODY FISHES IT."
DERE IZ FOUR ROD RESTS SET IN DA BANK AN' HE IZ USING {ONE|ONLY ONE|DA MIDDLE ONE}!
n0.emText:
ONE MAN AT A SLUICE WIT ONE ROD, FOUR ROD RESTS, AN' A LANDIN' NET FAR TOO BIG FOR ANYTINK DIS LAKE HOLDS.
"YOU CAN FISH IT. YOU NO WILL CATCH ANYTINK. DAT IZ NO WHY ANYBODY FISHES IT," HE SAYS, AN' DA WATER IN FRONT OF HIM IZ NO MOVIN' AT ALL, AN' NEITHER IZ HIS FLOAT, AN' NEITHER, YOU NOTICE, IZ HIS REFLECTION!
n0.bubba: BUBBA SITS DOWN ON DA BANK UNINVITED AN' STARTS TALKIN' 'BOUT A CATFISH HE CAUGHT IN LOUISIANA, AN' WITHIN FOUR MINUTES DA TWO OF DEM IZ MATES FOR LIFE. HE DOES DAT!

asides.calm: {member} SITS DOWN ON DA BANK AN' WATCHES DA FLOAT AN' IZ ENTIRELY CONTENT!
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
