asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: FISH IT.
ASK WHY ANYBODY FISHES IT!
ASK 'BOUT DA OTHER THREE ROD RESTS!
OPEN DA SLUICE.

a.text:
YOU FISH A LAKE DAT HAB GIVEN UP NUTTIN' IN YEARS, NEXT TA A MAN WHO DOES IT EVERY WEEK, AN' DA WATER IZ GLASS AN' DA AFTERNOON IZ LONG.
AN' DEN DA FLOAT GOES UNDER, WHICH HAB NO HAPPENED HERE SINCE {timeAgo}, AN' HE STANDS UP SO FAST HIS CHAIR GOES OVER!

b.text:
"COZ IT ANSWERS," HE SAYS. "NO WIT FISH."
HE HAB BIN COMIN' FOR THIRTY-ONE YEARS. DA FIRST ELEVEN HE CAME FOR FISH. DA OTHER TWENTY HE HAB COME TA SIT NEXT TA SOMETINK DAT SITS NEXT TA HIM, AN' HE SAYS DIS WITOUT ANY DRAMA AT ALL, AN' DEN OFFERS YOU DA FLASK!

c.text:
"FOR DA OTHER THREE," HE SAYS, AN' PUTS A ROD IN EACH ONE, BAITED, AN' SETS DA RATCHETS.
DEY ALL THREE GO AT ONCE, AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' ON ANY OF DEM, AN' DA RATCHETS SCREAM, AN' HE SITS WIT HIS HANDS ON HIS KNEES LOOKIN' AT DA WATER WIT AN EXPRESSION DAT IZ NO FEAR.
"DAT IZ FOUR OF US AGAIN," HE SAYS. "BIN THREE SINCE DA SPRING."

d.text:
DA SLUICE GATE IZ STIFF AN' DEN IT GOES, AN' DA LAKE STARTS TA MOVE FOR DA FIRST TIME IN YEARS, AN' EVERY BIRD ON DA WATER LEAVES AT ONCE.
HE DOES NO SHOUT. HE PACKS UP, QUIETLY, ALL FOUR RESTS, AN' WALKS UP DA BANK, AN' SAYS AS HE PASSES: "YOU WANT TA BE OFF DIS WATER IN 'BOUT FOUR MINUTES."

b_m.text:
"COZ IT ANSWERS," HE SAYS. "NO WIT FISH." HE HAB BIN COMIN' FOR THIRTY-ONE YEARS. DA FIRST ELEVEN HE CAME WIT {THREE OTHERS|HIS FATHER AN' TWO OTHERS|DA MEN WHO CUT DA OTHER RESTS}.
HE DOES NO SAY WHAT HAPPENED TA DEM AN' HE DOES NO HAB TA, COZ DERE IZ A BENCH BEHIND HIM WIT FOUR NAMES ON A BRASS PLATE AN' {THREE|TWO} OF DEM HAB DATES AN' ONE DOES NO!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DA PLATE HAB HIS OWN NAME ON IT WIT NO DATE.|THREE DEAD AN' ONE FISHIN'.|HE HAB DAT MADE HIMSELF.}"
asides.any: {member} {READS DA PLATE AN' SITS DOWN ON DA BENCH|PUTS DA KETTLE ON HIS STOVE|DOES NO ASK}

choices.text: LET HIM FISH. SIT WIT HIM!
ASK WHAT IT ANSWERED WIT.
SET DA OTHER THREE RODS FOR HIM!

b_ans.text:
IT ANSWERS WIT {A LEVEL|DA WATER|AN INCH}, HE SAYS: DA LAKE GOES UP OR DOWN BY DA WIDTH OF A FINGER AGAINST DA SLUICE WALL, ONCE, AFTER DA QUESTION, AN' IT HAB NEVER ONCE BIN WRONG.
HE HAB {THIRTY-ONE YEARS|THREE DECADES|A LIFETIME} OF QUESTIONS AN' ANSWERS IN A NOTEBOOK AN' NO IDEA WHAT TA DO WIT IT, AN' HE HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR SOMEBODY WHO WOULD NO LAUGH, AN' DA PARTY IZ NO LAUGHIN'!

d_m.text:
DA SLUICE GATE IZ STIFF AN' DEN IT GOES, AN' DA LAKE STARTS TA MOVE FOR DA FIRST TIME IN YEARS, AN' EVERY BIRD ON IT LEAVES AT ONCE.
DA OLD MAN DOES NO SHOUT. HE PICKS UP HIS CHAIR, AN' FOLDS IT, AN' WALKS {A COUPLE OF PACES|UP DA BANK|BACK} AN' STANDS DERE WIT IT UNDER HIS ARM, WATCHIN' DA LEVEL ON DA WALL GO DOWN PAST MARKS DAT HAB NO BIN UNCOVERED SINCE {BEFORE DA WAR|DA FIFTIES|A REAL LONG TIME}!

choices.text: LET IT RUN. SEE WHAT IZ UNDER!
SHUT IT. NOW, BEFORE DA MARKS IZ UNCOVERED!
READ DA MARKS AS DEY COME OUT OF DA WATER!

d_shut.text:
SHUTTIN' A SLUICE AGAINST A HEAD OF WATER DAT IZ ALREADY MOVIN' TAKES {A HANDFUL OF PEOPLE|EVERYTINK DA PARTY HAB|BOTH HANDS AN' A BAR} AN' 'BOUT MOST OF A MINUTE OF BEING GENUINELY IN DANGER.
DA LEVEL STOPS {A FINGER|AN INCH|JUST} BELOW DA LOWEST OLD MARK. DA OLD MAN SAYS NUTTIN' AT ALL, SETS DA CHAIR BACK UP, SITS DOWN, AN' CASTS, AN' AFTER A WHILE SAYS DAT IT HAB ANSWERED AN' DAT DA ANSWER WAZ YES!

d_marks.text:
DEY COME OUT OF DA WATER IN ORDER: {A LEVEL|A LINE|A MARK} AN' A YEAR, CUT INTO DA WALL, GOING BACK {TWO HUNDRED YEARS|A REAL LONG WAY|FURTHER DEN DA SLUICE}, AN' DA LOWER DEY GO DA DEEPER DA CUTTIN'.
DA LAST FOUR IZ NO YEARS. DA PARTY IZ STANDIN' KNEE DEEP READIN' DEM WHEN DA WATER STARTS COMIN' BACK UP, WHICH NOBODY HAB OPENED ANYTINK TA CAUSE!

e_beach_surf.title: {DA SET NOBODY RIDES|OUT PAST DA POINT|SIX WAVES}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A PERFECT BREAK OFF DA POINT AN' ELEVEN SURFERS ON DA BEACH AN' NONE OF DEM IN DA WATER.
DEY HAB BIN HERE SINCE FIRST LIGHT. DA SET COMES IN EVERY TWENTY MINUTES, SIX WAVES, TEXTBOOK, DA KIND OF WAVE PEOPLE MOVE COUNTRY FOR, AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM SITS ON DA SAND AN' WATCHES IT.
"SIXTH ONE," SAYS A GIRL WIT A BOARD SHE HAB NO WAXED. "RIDE DA FIRST FIVE IF YOU LIKE. NOBODY RIDES DA SIXTH."
DA BREAK HAB NO BIN DERE {A YEAR|TWO SEASONS|LONG}, AN' DERE IZ NO REEF UNDER IT ON ANY CHART!
n0.emText:
A TEXTBOOK BREAK, ELEVEN SURFERS ON DA SAND, AN' NONE OF DEM IN DA WATER. SIX WAVES A SET, EVERY TWENTY MINUTES, AN' A RULE 'BOUT DA SIXTH.
"NOBODY RIDES DA SIXTH," SAYS A GIRL WIT AN UNWAXED BOARD, AN' DA SEA BEHIND HER IZ KEEPIN' PERFECT TIME, AN' TINKZ DAT KEEP PERFECT TIME IN DIS WORLD IZ ALMOST ALWAYS KEEPIN' IT FOR SOMEBODY!
n0.bubba: BUBBA IZ ALREADY DOWN TA HIS SHORTS AN' IZ A SHOCKIN' SIGHT. "WELL, FIVE'S PLENTY. CINCHE ONNE SO' ASSAIE. COME ON NOW, SUGAR, NO BE GREEDY."

asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.hedonistic: {member} HAB BORROWED A BOARD AN' IZ NO LISTENIN' TA DA END OF DA SENTENCE!
asides.sanguine: {member} HAB MADE MATES WIT ALL ELEVEN SURFERS WITHIN 'BOUT NINETY SECONDS!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PADDLE OUT AN' TAKE DA FIRST FIVE!
ASK WHAT HAPPENED TA DA LAST PERSON WHO TOOK DA SIXTH!
TAKE DA SIXTH.
SIT ON DA SAND WIT DEM AN' WAIT IT OUT!

a.text:
FIVE WAVES OFF A BREAK DAT HAB NO BUSINESS EXISTIN' ON DIS COAST, WIT MORE PEOPLE DEN YOU EXPECTED CHEERIN' FROM DA BEACH COZ DEY HAB NO SEEN ANYBODY RIDE IT FOR A FORTNIGHT.
YOU COME IN BEFORE DA SIXTH, WHICH IZ DA WHOLE ART OF IT: YOU HAB TA WANT TA STOP!

b.text:
"HE CAME BACK IN," SHE SAYS. "DAT IZ DA TINK EVERYONE GETS WRONG. HE CAME BACK IN FINE AN' HE WAZ FINE AN' HE'S STILL FINE. HE JUST NO IZ DA SAME AGE AS HE WAZ."
HE IZ IN DA CAR PARK. HE IZ NINETEEN. HE WAZ THIRTY-FOUR IN DA SPRING AN' HE WILL NO TALK 'BOUT DA WAVE, BUT HE WILL TALK 'BOUT WHAT HE SAW IN DA FACE OF IT, AN' HE TELLS YOU, AN' IT IZ WORTH DA DRIVE!

c.text:
DA SIXTH WAVE IZ BIGGER AN' SLOWER AN' QUIETER, AN' DA FACE OF IT IZ GLASS, AN' DERE IZ SOMEBODY STANDIN' IN DA WATER ON DA FAR SIDE OF DA GLASS LOOKIN' OUT AT YOU WIT GREAT INTEREST.
YOU RIDE IT. WHETHER IT LETS YOU OFF AT DA BEACH IZ A DIFFERENT QUESTION, AN' IT IZ ASKED AN' ANSWERED AT 'BOUT DA FOUR SECOND MARK!

d.text:
ELEVEN SURFERS, A FIRE IN AN OIL DRUM, FOUR SETS AN HOUR AN' NOBODY IN DA WATER: IT IZ DA MOST PEACEFUL AFTERNOON DIS PARTY HAB HAB IN MONTHS.
BY DUSK YOU KNOW ALL ELEVEN NAMES, DA STORY OF DA BREAK, AN' DA TWO RULES DAT IZ NO DA SIXTH-WAVE RULE, AN' ONE OF DEM GIVES YOU A BOARD DAT HAB BIN IN HER FAMILY SINCE HER FATHER RODE DIS BREAK DA YEAR IT APPEARED!

b_m.text:
"HE CAME BACK IN," SHE SAYS. "DAT IZ DA TINK EVERYONE GETS WRONG. HE CAME BACK IN FINE AN' HE WAZ FINE AN' HE'S STILL FINE."
SHE SAYS STILL FINE {TWICE|A THIRD TIME|AGAIN}, AN' DEN SAYS DAT HE IZ AT HOME, {A COUPLE OF STREETS|UP DA HILL|NO FAR} AWAY, AN' DAT NOBODY FROM DA BEACH HAB BIN TA SEE HIM SINCE, AN' DAT SHE WOULD RATHER SOMEBODY DID!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{FINE IZ DOING A LOT OF WORK IN DAT SENTENCE.|NOBODY HAB VISITED HIM. ELEVEN MATES AN' NOBODY HAB VISITED.|ASK WHAT FINE MEANS.}"
asides.any: {member} {ASKS FOR DA ADDRESS|LOOKS AT DA WATER|SAYS DEY WILL GO}

choices.text: TAKE WHAT SHE SAYS AN' LEAVE IT!
GO AN' SEE HIM.
ASK HER WHAT FINE MEANS.

b_see.text:
HE IZ AT HOME, AN' HE IZ FINE, AN' HE MAKES TEA AN' TALKS 'BOUT DA BREAK LIKE A MAN DESCRIBIN' A JOB HE USED TA HAB.
DA ONLY TINK WRONG WIT HIM IZ DAT HE DOES NO GO NEAR DA WATER AN' NO CAN SAY WHY, AN' DAT {EVERY CLOCK IN DA HOUSE|DA KITCHEN CLOCK|ALL FOUR CLOCKS} IZ FOUR MINUTES FAST, AN' HE SAYS HE NO CAN GET DEM TA HOLD TIME AN' HAB STOPPED TRYIN'!

b_fine.text:
FINE MEANS HE CAME OUT OF DA WATER {A COUPLE OF MINUTES|A FEW MINUTES|SOME TIME} AFTER HE WENT UNDER, IN FRONT OF ELEVEN WITNESSES, HAVIN' BIN UNDER FOR {A LONG STRETCH|MUCH LONGER DEN DAT|MOST OF AN HOUR}.
ALL ELEVEN OF DEM AGREE 'BOUT DAT. NONE OF DEM WILL SAY IT TA A STRANGER, AN' SHE HAB JUST SAID IT, AN' SHE IZ {CRYIN'|NO CRYIN'|REAL STEADY} AN' ASKS DA PARTY NO TA MAKE HER SAY IT TWICE!

d_m.text:
ELEVEN SURFERS, A FIRE IN AN OIL DRUM, FOUR SETS AN HOUR AN' NOBODY IN DA WATER: IT IZ DA MOST PEACEFUL AFTERNOON ANYBODY HAB HAB IN MONTHS.
AT 'BOUT {FIVE|DA TURN OF DA TIDE|FOUR} DA SIXTH WAVE OF A SET COMES THROUGH, AN' EVERY ONE OF DA ELEVEN STANDS UP AT DA SAME TIME WITOUT SAYIN' ANYTINK, AN' WATCHES IT ALL DA WAY IN!

choices.text: WATCH IT WIT DEM AN' STAY ON DA SAND!
ASK, WHILE EVERYBODY IZ STANDIN', WHAT DEY SEE!
GET IN DA WATER FOR DA NEXT ONE!

d_see.text:
ASKED WHILE DEY IZ ALL STILL STANDIN', DEY ANSWER HONESTLY, COZ STANDIN' UP HAB ALREADY ADMITTED IT: DEY SEE SOMEBODY IN DA FACE OF DA SIXTH WAVE, EVERY SET, EVERY DAY, SINCE DA BREAK ARRIVED.
EACH OF DA ELEVEN SEES {A DIFFERENT ONE|SOMEBODY OF DEY OWN|A PERSON DEY KNOW}, AN' TWO OF DEM HAB COMPARED NOTES AN' STOPPED COMPARIN' NOTES, AN' DA PARTY IZ DA FIRST OUTSIDER TA BE TOLD!

n0.text:
FOUR HUNDRED PALLETS OF BOTTLED WATER UNDER A HYPERCAPITALIST COLLECTIVE SEAL, ON A QUAY, UNDER GUARD, IN A COUNTRY WIT RIVERS.
DA MANIFEST SAYS IT IZ FOR DA INTERIOR. DA STEVEDORES SAY PALLET FOUR HUNDRED HAB BIN ON DAT QUAY FOR DA BETTER PART OF A YEAR AN' DOES NO MOVE WIT DA REST.
DA GUARD ON DA GATE IZ ASLEEP, AN' IT IZ FOUR IN DA AFTERNOON, AN' NOBODY WAKES HIM.
PALLET FOUR HUNDRED IZ {AT DA BACK|DA ONE UNDER DA CRANE|KEPT}, AN' IT HAB BIN RE-WRAPPED {TWICE|MORE DEN ONCE|RECENTLY}!
n0.emText:
FOUR HUNDRED PALLETS OF COLLECTIVE WATER ON A QUAY, UNDER SEAL, UNDER A GUARD WHO IZ ASLEEP AT FOUR IN DA AFTERNOON.
EVERYTINK ELSE IN DIS WORLD IZ CUT WIT SOMETINK. DA WATER IZ DA ONE TINK DEY SELL STRAIGHT, WHICH IZ WHY DEY OWN ALL OF IT. PALLET FOUR HUNDRED DOES NO MOVE WIT DA REST, AN' TINKZ DAT DO NO MOVE WIT DA REST IZ, IN DIS WORLD, EITHER SACRED OR EVIDENCE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA READS DA SEAL AN' SUCKS HIS TEETH. "COLLECTIVE. UH-HUH. 'A GENTE CA VENNENE LL'ACQUA. SUGAR, ME NO LIKE DEZE PEOPLE AN' ME AIN'T NEVER MET 'EM."

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: OPEN PALLET FOUR HUNDRED.
TALK TA DA STEVEDORES PROPERLY!
TAKE A CASE AN' HAB IT ANALYSED!
TAKE DA WHOLE PALLET. DERE IZ A MARKET FOR WATER!

a.text:
UNDER DA SHRINK WRAP, IN DA MIDDLE OF DA PALLET, IN DA PLACE WHERE DA LEAST ACCESSIBLE CASE WOULD BE, DERE IZ NO CASE.
DERE IZ A DRUM, SEALED, COLD, SWEATIN' IN DA SUN, WIT A HAZARD LABEL IN FOUR LANGUAGES AN' A SERIAL DAT MATCHES NUTTIN' ON DA MANIFEST.
IT IZ WHAT EVERYTINK ELSE IZ CUT WIT!

choices.text: {TAKE A SAMPLE|COLLECT A SPECIMEN|SCRAPE OFF A SAMPLE|BAG A PIECE}!
PHOTOGRAPH EVERYTINK AN' PUT DA WRAP BACK!

b.text:
IT COSTS FOUR ROUNDS AN' IT TAKES AN HOUR AN' DEY TALK ALL AT ONCE.
PALLET FOUR HUNDRED CAME IN ELEVEN MONTHS AGO ON A SHIP DAT IZ NO ON DA PORT RECORD. A COUPLE OF MEN FROM DA FRANCHISE COME AN' LOOK AT IT EVERY FORTNIGHT. ONE STEVEDORE TOUCHED IT IN DA SPRING AN' HAB NO BIN AT WORK SINCE, AN' DEY WILL GIVE YOU HIS ADDRESS IF YOU PROMISE TA GO AN' SEE HIM!

choices.text: GO AN' SEE HIM.
WAIT FOR DA FORTNIGHTLY VISIT!

c.text:
A CASE OF COLLECTIVE WATER, OPENED IN A CHEMIST'S BACK ROOM IN {region} BY A WOMAN WHO DOES DIS FOR A LIVIN' AN' WHO HAB NEVER ONCE BIN SURPRISED BY A BOTTLE OF WATER.
SHE IZ SURPRISED. SHE RUNS IT TWICE OVER. DEN SHE ASKS YOU TA LEAVE DA ROOM WHILE SHE RINGS SOMEBODY, AN' WHEN YOU COME BACK SHE HAB WRITTEN A NUMBER ON A PIECE OF PAPER AN' SHE WANTS YOU TA TAKE IT TA DA FOUNDATION AN' NO TA HER PROFESSIONAL BODY!

d.text:
A PALLET OF BOTTLED WATER IZ WORTH 'BOUT WHAT YOU WOULD EXPECT AN' MOVES IN 'BOUT FOUR HOURS THROUGH DA RIGHT YARD.
WHAT YOU HAB ALSO MOVED, WITOUT KNOWIN' IT, IZ A SEALED DRUM, AN' DA MEN WHO COME EVERY FORTNIGHT ARRIVE ON DA THURSDAY AN' FIND A GAP IN DA WRAP, AN' BY FRIDAY DERE IZ FOUR PHOTOGRAPHS OF DA PARTY CIRCULATIN' IN AN OFFICE IN {region}!

a1.text:
IT COMES OUT OF DA DRUM LIKE WATER AN' BEHAVES LIKE WATER FOR 'BOUT A LONG MINUTE AN' DEN REMEMBERS WHAT IT IZ.
WHATEVER IT IZ, HALF A LITRE OF IT IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA BOAT YOU CAME IN ON, AN' DERE IZ FOUR OFFICES DAT WILL BUY IT AN' ONLY ONE OF DEM WILL LET YOU WALK OUT AFTERWARDS!

a2.text:
ELEVEN PHOTOGRAPHS, DA WRAP BACK DOWN, DA TAPE SQUARED OFF, AN' NUTTIN' TOUCHED.
DA FOUNDATION TAKE DA PHOTOGRAPHS AN' OPEN A FILE AN' PAY PROPERLY. NUTTIN' HAPPENS TA DA COLLECTIVE, COZ NUTTIN' EVER DOES, BUT DA NUMBER OF PALLETS ON DAT QUAY IZ THREE HUNDRED AN' NINETY-NINE WITHIN A FORTNIGHT AN' PALLET FOUR HUNDRED IZ ON A LORRY TA SOMEWHERE WIT AN INQUIRY ATTACHED TA IT!

b1.text:
HE IZ AT HOME WIT DA CURTAINS SHUT AN' HIS HANDS WRAPPED IN GAUZE HE CHANGES TWICE OVER A DAY, AN' HIS WIFE HAB STOPPED ASKIN'.
WHAT IZ UNDER DA GAUZE IZ NO A BURN. HE HAB NO BIN TA A DOCTOR COZ DA FRANCHISE PAYS HIS WAGES AN' HE HAB SIGNED SOMETINK.
DERE IZ A CLINIC DAT WILL TAKE HIM. IT COSTS MONEY. YOU HAB MONEY!

choices.text: PAY FOR DA CLINIC.
TAKE HIM TA DA FOUNDATION INSTEAD!

b2.text:
A FEW MEN IN A HIRE CAR, ON DA THURSDAY, WIT A HAND-HELD METER AN' A CLIPBOARD.
DEY DO NO OPEN DA PALLET. DEY STAND FOUR METRES FROM IT, TAKE A READIN', WRITE IT DOWN, AN' DRIVE AWAY, AN' DA WHOLE TINK TAKES NINETY SECONDS, AN' IT IZ DA NINETY SECONDS DAT TELLS YOU DA MOST: DA NUMBER DEY WROTE DOWN IZ GOING UP!

b1a.text:
DA CLINIC TAKES HIS HANDS SERIOUSLY AN' TAKES MOST OF A SEASON OVER DEM AN' GETS HIM MOST OF DA WAY BACK.
HE PAYS YOU NUTTIN', COZ HE HAB NUTTIN', AN' GIVES YOU DA ONLY TINK HE HAB: WHAT HE SAW INSIDE DA PALLET DA DAY HE TOUCHED IT, DESCRIBED PROPERLY, BY SOMEBODY WHO WAZ DERE!

b1b.text:
DA FOUNDATION TAKE HIM, TREAT HIM, CATALOGUE HIM, AN' PUBLISH HIM, AN' HE IZ ON A PUBLIC REGISTER FOR DA REST OF HIS LIFE AS A CASE NUMBER, AN' HIS HANDS WORK AGAIN.
HE IZ NO SURE IT WAZ WORTH IT. HIS WIFE IZ REAL SURE IT WAZ. YOU IZ SOMEWHERE IN BETWEEN, AN' YOU TAKE DA FEE!

a2_m.text:
ELEVEN PHOTOGRAPHS, DA WRAP BACK DOWN, DA TAPE SQUARED OFF, AN' NUTTIN' TOUCHED, WHICH TAKES {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|NO TIME|A CAREFUL HALF HOUR}.
DA ELEVENTH PHOTOGRAPH IZ OF DA PALLET LABEL, AN' DA LABEL HAB A CONSIGNOR ON IT, AN' DA CONSIGNOR IZ {A HOSPITAL|A RESEARCH INSTITUTE|A NAME WIT NO ADDRESS}, AN' DA SEAL WAZ PUT ON AFTERWARDS!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DA SEAL IZ DA COVER, NO DA SOURCE.|SOMEBODY BOUGHT A COLLECTIVE SEAL FOR ONE PALLET.|DAT LABEL IZ DA WHOLE STORY.}"
asides.any: {member} {PHOTOGRAPHS DA LABEL TWICE MORE|WRITES DA CONSIGNOR DOWN|LOOKS AT DA GUARDS}

choices.text: SELL DA PHOTOGRAPHS TA DA FOUNDATION!
TRACE DA CONSIGNOR.
TAKE DA PHOTOGRAPHS TA DA COLLECTIVE INSTEAD!

a2_trace.text:
DA CONSIGNOR HAB NO ADDRESS AN' DOES HAB A BANK, AN' DA BANK HAB A CORRESPONDENT, AN' DA CORRESPONDENT HAB {FOUR|FIVE} OTHER CONSIGNMENTS ON DA SAME ACCOUNT, AN' ALL OF DEM IZ PALLETS OF BOTTLED WATER, AN' ALL OF DEM IZ UNDER COLLECTIVE SEALS.
WHICH IZ {FOUR HUNDRED THOUSAND|A GREAT MANY|A REAL LARGE NUMBER OF} BOTTLES DAT IZ NO WHAT DA LABEL SAYS, IN {FOUR|FIVE} COUNTRIES, AN' DA PARTY HAB DA ACCOUNT NUMBER!

a2_coll.text:
DA COLLECTIVE'S OWN PEOPLE IZ {FOUR HOURS|A DAY|NO LONG} AWAY AN' IZ CONSIDERABLY MORE ALARMED DEN DA PARTY EXPECTS, COZ A FORGED SEAL IZ WORSE TA DEM DEN WHATEVER IZ IN DA PALLET.
DEY PAY FOR DA PHOTOGRAPHS, GENEROUSLY, AN' FOR SILENCE, LESS GENEROUSLY, AN' DA PALLET IZ GONE FROM DA QUAY BY MORNIN' AN' SO IZ DA GUARD WHO WAZ ON IT, AN' NUTTIN' IZ EVER SAID 'BOUT DA CONSIGNOR!

b2_m.text:
TWO MEN IN A HIRE CAR, ON DA THURSDAY, WIT A HAND-HELD METER AN' A CLIPBOARD. DEY DO NO OPEN DA PALLET. DEY {WALK ROUND IT|HOLD DA METER AGAINST IT|TAKE A READIN'} AN' WRITE, AN' GET BACK IN DA CAR.
DA METER IZ NO A METER ANYBODY IN DA PARTY RECOGNISES AN' DA CLIPBOARD IZ A PRINTED FORM WIT {FOUR HUNDRED|A GREAT MANY} LINES ON IT, AN' MOST OF DA LINES IZ FILLED IN!

choices.text: LET DEM GO. NOTE DA PLATE!
GET A LOOK AT DA FORM.
FOLLOW DA CAR.

b2_form.text:
FOUR HUNDRED LINES, ONE PER PALLET, WIT A READIN' AGAINST EACH AN' A COLUMN AT DA RIGHT HEADED {WIT ONE LETTER|BY A SINGLE CHARACTER|WIT A SYMBOL}, AN' PALLET FOUR HUNDRED'S ENTRY IN DAT COLUMN IZ DA ONLY ONE DAT IZ NO BLANK.
DA READINGS ON DA OTHER THREE HUNDRED AN' NINETY-NINE IZ ALL DA SAME NUMBER. FOUR HUNDRED'S IZ NO, AN' IT HAB BIN GOING UP, FORTNIGHT BY FORTNIGHT, FOR DA BETTER PART OF A YEAR!

b2_caught.text:
DA CLIPBOARD IZ HELD BY A MAN WHO HAB BIN HOLDIN' CLIPBOARDS PROFESSIONALLY FOR {A LIFETIME OF WORK|A LONG TIME|HIS WHOLE WORKIN' LIFE} AN' WHO DOES NO TURN ROUND SO MUCH AS STOP.
NUTTIN' IZ SAID. DA PARTY IZ PHOTOGRAPHED, FROM DA HIRE CAR, TWICE, ON DA WAY OFF DA QUAY, AN' DA FOLLOWIN' WEEK DERE IZ A MAN AT DA END OF WHICHEVER STREET DEY IZ STAYIN' ON, AN' DERE IZ ONE DA WEEK AFTER DAT TOO!

b2_follow.text:
DA HIRE CAR DOES {FOUR|FIVE} MORE QUAYS IN TWO DAYS, AT A STEADY PACE, AN' ENDS AT A UNIT ON AN INDUSTRIAL ESTATE IN {region} WIT NO SIGN ON IT AN' A GOOD LOCK.
WHAT IZ IN DA UNIT IZ {THREE HUNDRED AN' NINETY-NINE|DA REST OF DEM|EVERY OTHER PALLET ON DA FORM}, STACKED, SEALED, BEING READ FORTNIGHTLY BY TWO MEN WIT A METER, AN' ONE EMPTY SPACE AT DA END OF DA ROW DAT IZ DA SIZE OF PALLET FOUR HUNDRED!

e_fields_pigeon.title: {DA LOFT WIT DA DOOR LEFT OPEN|FORTY BIRDS AN' A SHOEBOX|THURSDAY'S POST}

n0.text:
A PIGEON LOFT IN DA CORNER OF A FIELD, PAINTED DA SAME GREEN AS EVERYTINK DA COUNCIL EVER PAINTED, DOOR SWINGIN'.
INSIDE: FORTY BIRDS, FED AN' WATERED, AN' ONE GIRL OF 'BOUT NINE SITTIN' ON AN UPTURNED CRATE WIT A SHOEBOX ON HER KNEES, DOING DA ACCOUNTS OF SOMEBODY ELSE'S BUSINESS IN A SCHOOL EXERCISE BOOK.
"YOU IZ LATE," SHE SAYS, WITOUT LOOKIN' UP. "HE SAID TWO PEOPLE. DERE IZ {TWO|THREE|FOUR} OF YOU."
DA LOFT DOOR SWINGS AN' DA BIRDS DO NO LEAVE, WHICH IZ NO HOW A LOFT WIT DA DOOR OPEN WORKS!
n0.emText:
A PIGEON LOFT, DOOR SWINGIN', FORTY BIRDS ALL FED. A GIRL OF 'BOUT NINE ON A CRATE WIT A SHOEBOX AN' AN EXERCISE BOOK, RUNNIN' AN OPERATION.
"YOU IZ LATE," SHE SAYS. "HE SAID TWO PEOPLE." YOU HAB BIN ALIVE, AS FAR AS YOU CAN PROVE, FOR ELEVEN MONTHS, AN' A NINE-YEAR-OLD HAB YA APPOINTMENT WRITTEN DOWN. SOMEWHERE IN DA NINETY-TWO PER CENT, YOU SUSPECT, YOU WAZ ALSO SOMEBODY'S APPOINTMENT!
n0.bubba: BUBBA CROUCHES DOWN TA HER LEVEL, WHICH TAKES SOME DOING. "MA' GUAGLIONA, WHO IZ HE? TALK TA ME. ME IZ DA MONEY." HE IZ NO DA MONEY!

asides.nurturing: {member} IZ LOOKIN' AT HOW LONG SHE HAB BIN SITTIN' DERE AN' DOING SUMS 'BOUT IT!
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}

choices.text: ASK WHO HE IZ.
ASK WHAT IZ IN DA SHOEBOX!
TAKE DA MESSAGE AN' FLY IT YOURSELVES!
TAKE DA BIRDS. FORTY RACIN' PIGEONS IZ WORTH MONEY!

a.text:
"ME UNCLE. HE DOES DA THURSDAY ONES."
DA THURSDAY ONES, IT TURNS OUT, COME IN FROM FOUR COUNTRIES, AN' NONE OF DEM CARRY A RING WIT A CLUB NUMBER ON IT. SHE HAB BIN WRITIN' DOWN DA ARRIVAL TIMES FOR A YEAR AN' A HALF. HER UNCLE HAB BIN DEAD FOR ELEVEN MONTHS AN' SHE HAB NO TOLD DA BIRDS!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.melancholic: {member} LOOKS AT DA LOG BOOK, AT DA ELEVEN MONTHS, AN' HAB TA GO AN' LOOK AT DA BIRDS FOR A MINUTE!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TAKE OVER DA THURSDAY ONES!
READ DA LAST YEAR OF ARRIVAL TIMES PROPERLY!

b.text:
A PIGEON, ALIVE, CALM, AN' WRONG: A BIRD WIT {A SECOND|AN EXTRA|ONE TOO MANY} SET OF EYELIDS AN' A RING ON ITS LEG STAMPED WIT A YEAR DAT HAB NO HAPPENED.
"HE CAME TUESDAY," SHE SAYS. "HE NO WILL GO. HE'S BIN SITTIN' IN DA BOX SINCE TUESDAY AN' HE NO WILL EAT AN' HE NO WILL GO."
b.bubba: "AOH," SAYS BUBBA, PEERIN' IN. "DAT DERE IZ A PIGEON FROM DA FUTURE. NO LOOK AT ME LIKE DAT. CE STA 'O PICCIONE, E VENE 'A DIMANE."

asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX THREE TIMES AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: READ DA MESSAGE ON ITS LEG!
LET IT GO AN' WATCH WHICH WAY IT FLIES!

c.text:
YOU TAKE DA TIN, YOU TAKE DA BIRD SHE PICKS FOR YOU, AN' YOU WALK IT ELEVEN MILES TA DA WALL SHE SAYS TA WALK IT TA.
DA MAN ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DA WALL TAKES DA TIN WITOUT A WORD AN' GIVES YOU {coin} AN' A DOCKET WIT THREE SIGNATURES AN' NO DATE, AN' TELLS YOU THURSDAY IZ THURSDAY, AN' SHUTS DA HATCH!

d.text:
DEY IZ WORTH MONEY. DAT IZ DA WHOLE OF DA ARGUMENT FOR IT AN' IT IZ NO A LIL' ARGUMENT.
A MAN IN {region} BUYS DA LOT IN ONE GO AN' ASKS NUTTIN'. YOU IZ THREE FIELDS AWAY WHEN YOU HEAR DA GIRL START SHOUTIN', AN' DA SHOUTIN' DOES NO STOP FOR A LONG TIME, AN' IT FOLLOWS YOU FURTHER DEN SOUND SHOULD!

a1.text:
THURSDAY, AN' DA SKY OVER DAT FIELD FILLS WIT BIRDS COMIN' IN OFF FOUR BORDERS.
YOU LOG DEM DA WAY SHE HAB BIN LOGGIN' DEM. SOMEWHERE IN DA MIDDLE OF IT, YOU UNDERSTAND DAT DA TIMES IZ A CODE AN' DA CODE IZ A ROUTE, AN' DAT YOU HAB JUST BIN HANDED A COURIER NETWORK BY A CHILD WHO IZ NOW, VISIBLY, HUGELY RELIEVED!

a2.text:
A YEAR AN' A HALF OF ARRIVAL TIMES, AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM A MINUTE OR TWO OFF WHAT ANY BIRD CAN DO.
WORKED OUT ON DA BACK OF HER OWN EXERCISE BOOK, DA ERRORS ADD UP TA A MAP. DA MAP HAB A HOLE IN IT, AN' DA HOLE IZ UNDER A FIELD TWO VALLEYS AWAY, AN' DERE IZ SOMETINK IN DA HOLE DAT HAB BIN SENDIN' POST TA A DEAD MAN!

b1.text:
A FEW WORDS IN A HAND YOU HAB NO LEARNED TA READ YET, AN' A DATE, AN' DA DATE IZ THURSDAY.
DA BIRD EATS AFTER DAT, AN' SLEEPS, AN' IN DA MORNIN' IT IZ GONE, AN' DA SHOEBOX HAB A FEATHER IN IT AN' A SMELL OF {smell}. SHE WRITES DA ARRIVAL TIME IN DA BOOK ANYWAY. SHE IZ REAL THOROUGH!

b2.text:
IT GOES UP, CIRCLES ONCE, AN' FLIES EAST INTO WEATHER DAT IZ NO DERE, AN' DOES NO COME OUT DA OTHER SIDE OF IT.
DA WEATHER DAT IZ NO DERE CLOSES. WHAT COMES DOWN OUT OF IT LANDS IN DA STUBBLE ON LEGS DAT IZ ALMOST A BIRD'S LEGS, AN' LOOKS AT DA LOFT, AN' DEN AT YOU!

a1_m.text:
THURSDAY, AN' DA SKY OVER DAT FIELD FILLS WIT BIRDS COMIN' IN OFF FOUR BORDERS, AN' LOGGIN' DEM DA WAY SHE HAB ALWAYS LOGGED DEM TAKES {A COUPLE OF HOURS|DA WHOLE MORNIN'|UNTIL DA LIGHT IZ UP PROPERLY}.
FORTY-ONE BIRDS IZ LOGGED. FORTY GO INTO DA LOFT. DA FORTY-FIRST LANDS ON DA ROOF, WAITS FOR DA OTHERS TA GO IN, AN' {WILL NO FOLLOW|STAYS OUT|SITS DERE}, AN' IT IZ RINGED IN A COLOUR DAT IZ NO ON HER CHART!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DAT ONE IZ NO HERS AN' IT IZ NO GOING IN.|COUNT DEM AGAIN.|FORTY-ONE ON A CHART OF FORTY.}"
asides.any: {member} {COUNTS DA LOG TWICE|GOES UP DA LADDER SLOWLY|PUTS CORN ON DA ROOF}

choices.text: LOG FORTY AN' SAY NUTTIN' 'BOUT DA FORTY-FIRST!
GET IT DOWN AN' READ DA RING!
LEAVE DA DOOR OPEN AN' WAIT FOR IT TA GO IN ON ITS OWN!

a1_ring.text:
IT COMES DOWN TA A HAND DAT KNOWS HOW TA OFFER, WHICH IZ NO LUCK, AN' DA RING IZ {CERAMIC|NO METAL|OLD} AN' DA NUMBER ON IT IZ A NUMBER IN A SERIES DA LOFT'S OWN CHARTS STOP AT {FOUR HUNDRED|A MUCH LOWER NUMBER|A LONG WAY SHORT OF}.
WHICH MEANS DA LOFT HAB BIN RUNNIN' A GREAT DEAL LONGER DEN DA COUNCIL'S GREEN PAINT, AN' DAT DIS BIRD IZ ON DA BOOKS OF WHOEVER WAZ RUNNIN' IT BEFORE!

a1_wait.text:
IT GOES IN AT DUSK, ON ITS OWN, WITOUT BEING COAXED, AN' SETTLES IN A BOX AT DA END OF DA ROW DAT HAB BIN EMPTY {AS LONG AS ANYBODY REMEMBERS|FOR YEARS|SINCE BEFORE SHE TOOK DA LOFT ON}.
DA BOX HAB A NAME CARD ON IT. DA CARD IZ FADED TA NUTTIN' EXCEPT DA LAST TWO LETTERS, AN' DA UNCLE, WHEN HE IZ ASKED, SAYS ONLY DAT IT IZ NO A NAME AN' DAT IT IZ A {PLACE|DIRECTION|HEADIN'}!

b1_m.text:
FOUR WORDS IN A HAND YOU HAB NO LEARNED TA READ YET, AN' A DATE, AN' DA DATE IZ THURSDAY.
DA BIRD EATS AFTERWARDS AN' DRINKS AN' IZ ENTIRELY CONTENT, AN' WHILE IT IZ EATIN' IT BECOMES OBVIOUS DAT DA SECOND SET OF EYELIDS IZ A WORKIN' ORGAN: IT IZ {CLEAN|FUNCTIONAL|BEING USED}, AN' IT CLOSES {SIDEWAYS|DA OTHER WAY|WHEN DA BIRD LOOKS AT ANYBODY}!

choices.text: PUT IT BACK IN DA SHOEBOX AN' CLOSE DA LID!
READ DA FOUR WORDS PROPERLY!
LOOK AT DA EYELIDS RATHER DEN DA MESSAGE!

b1_read.text:
FOUR WORDS, AN' ONCE DEY IZ READ DEY IZ ORDINARY, AN' DA ORDINARINESS IZ DA WORST PART: DEY IZ {AN INSTRUCTION 'BOUT DA LOFT|A NOTE 'BOUT DA BIRDS|FOUR WORDS OF HOUSEKEEPIN'}, ADDRESSED TA WHOEVER KEEPS IT, IN DA PRESENT TENSE.
DA DATE IZ THURSDAY AN' TODAY IZ THURSDAY AN' DA MESSAGE IZ THEREFORE {CURRENT|LIVE|FOR NOW}, AN' IT ASKS FOR ONE TINK TA BE DONE BEFORE DARK!

b1_eyes.text:
DA MEMBRANE IZ A NICTITATIN' MEMBRANE AN' IT IZ {IN DA WRONG PLANE|NO WHERE A BIRD'S IZ|AN ADDITION}, AN' UNDER IT DA EYE IZ A PIGEON'S EYE AN' BEHIND DAT DERE IZ MORE ROOM DEN A PIGEON'S SKULL HAB.
IT IZ NO AN INJURY AN' IT IZ NO A SPECIES. SOMEBODY MADE DIS BIRD, COMPETENTLY, FOR A JOB, AN' DA JOB IZ FLYIN' SOMEWHERE AN' COMIN' BACK, AN' DA RING ON ITS LEG IZ A {RECEIPT|DOCKET|WORKS NUMBER}!

e_meadows_chess.title: {DA BOARD LEFT OUT IN DA WEATHER|THREE MOVES FROM DA END|DA CLOCK IZ STILL RUNNIN'}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A CHESS TABLE CEMENTED INTO DA GRASS AT DA EDGE OF DA MEADOW, DA KIND DEY PUT IN PARKS, AN' A GAME ON IT {TWO|THREE|FOUR} MOVES FROM DA END.
DA PIECES IZ WET. DEY HAB BIN WET FOR A WHILE. SOMEBODY KEEPS DEM DUSTED ANYWAY.
ON DA FAR SIDE OF DA TABLE, AN OLD MAN IZ ASLEEP IN A DECKCHAIR WIT A SCARF OVER HIS FACE, AN' HE IZ EITHER ASLEEP OR HE IZ NO, AN' DERE IZ A CLOCK BESIDE HIM DAT IZ RUNNIN'.
DA CLOCK HAB BIN RUNNIN' FOR {A LONG TIME|DAYS|LONGER DEN A GAME} AN' BLACK'S FLAG HAB NO FALLEN!
n0.emText:
A PARK CHESS TABLE CEMENTED INTO A MEADOW, A GAME THREE MOVES FROM OVER, AN OLD MAN ASLEEP UNDER A SCARF WIT A CLOCK STILL RUNNIN' BESIDE HIM.
DA GAME IZ DA ROOM. YOU CAN SEE IT: DA WHOLE MEADOW IZ ARRANGED AROUND DIS POSITION DA WAY A SPELL IZ ARRANGED AROUND ITS LAST WORD, AN' SOMEONE HAB BIN HOLDIN' DA LAST WORD IN DEY MOUTH FOR A LONG TIME!
n0.bubba: BUBBA LIFTS DA SCARF AN INCH, REPLACES IT, AN' GIVES YOU A LOOK. "HE'S BREATHIN'. SORTA. UH-HUH. SCETATE, NO' - NAH. HE AIN'T WAKIN'."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.mischievous: {member} {GRINS: "DIBS ON WHATEVER LOOKS SHINY AN' DANGEROUS."|IZ ALREADY TRYIN' TA PICK DA MAINTENANCE LOCK WIT A WIRE|WONDERS ALOUD WHAT HAPPENS IF WE PRESS ALL DA BUTTONS AT ONCE|SMIRKS AN' TAPS DA CONSOLE TA SEE IF IT SPARKS}
asides.calm: {member} SITS DOWN ON DA OPPOSITE BENCH AS THOUGH DIS HAB BIN DA PLAN ALL ALONG!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: SIT DOWN AN' PLAY DA POSITION OUT!
WAKE HIM.
STOP DA CLOCK.
POCKET DA BLACK QUEEN AN' WALK!

a.text:
YOU TAKE WHITE, COZ WHITE IZ WHAT IZ LEFT TA TAKE.
DA SCARF DOES NO MOVE, BUT BLACK ANSWERS: DA PIECE SLIDES, UNHURRIED, AN' DA CLOCK CHANGES HANDS WIT A CLICK. THREE MOVES TA DA END, AN' DA END HAB BIN WAITIN' A LONG TIME FOR SOMEBODY TA COME AN' COLLECT IT!
a.bubba: "PLAY IT, SUGAR," SAYS BUBBA, ARMS FOLDED, HAT DOWN. "ME GOT MONEY ON YA. WIT' WHO, NO ASK."

asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
HE WAKES LIKE A MAN SURFACIN' FROM REAL DEEP WATER, AN' DA FIRST TINK HE DOES IZ LOOK AT DA CLOCK, AN' DA SECOND IZ SWEAR.
"FORTY YEARS," HE SAYS. "FORTY YEARS AN' YOU HAB KNOCKED IT." DEN HE LOOKS AT DA BOARD PROPERLY, AN' AT YOU, AN' HIS WHOLE FACE CHANGES, COZ BLACK IZ STILL LOST AN' NOW DERE IZ SOMEBODY HERE TA MAKE IT OFFICIAL!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PLAY HIM PROPERLY, OVER A BOARD, LIKE A PERSON!
ASK HIM WHO HE HAB BIN PLAYIN'!

c.text:
YOU PRESS DA PLUNGER AN' DA TICKIN' STOPS, AN' DA MEADOW GETS REAL MUCH LOUDER: BIRDS, WIND, A TRACTOR TWO FIELDS OFF, ALL OF IT ARRIVIN' AT ONCE LIKE A ROOM BEING LET BACK IN.
DA OLD MAN DOES NO WAKE. HE SIMPLY IZ NO DERE ANY MORE, AN' DA DECKCHAIR IZ OLD, AN' DA SCARF IZ DUST ON DA GRASS, AN' DA BOARD IZ DRY!

d.text:
IT IZ IN YA POCKET FOR A GOOD WHILE.
IN DA ELEVENTH MINUTE EVERY DOG IN DA VALLEY STARTS UP AT ONCE, AN' DA QUEEN IZ WARM, AN' WARMER, AN' BY DA TIME YOU HAB IT OUT OF YA POCKET AN' INTO DA GRASS IT HAB LEFT A MARK ON YA PALM SHAPED EXACTLY LIKE ITSELF.
YOU KEEP DA MARK. SOMEBODY, LATER, WILL PAY TA SEE IT!

b1.text:
HE IZ REAL GOOD AN' REAL SLOW AN' HE TALKS DA WHOLE WAY THROUGH, MOSTLY 'BOUT A WOMAN CALLED FRANCA AN' DA WINTER OF SIXTY-THREE.
HE WINS, OR YOU WIN. IT STOPS MATTERIN' SOMEWHERE AROUND DA FORTIETH MOVE. WHEN IT IZ OVER HE PUTS DA PIECES BACK IN DA POSITION DEY WAZ IN WHEN YOU FOUND DEM, EXACTLY, FROM MEMORY, AN' PUTS HIS SCARF BACK OVER HIS FACE!

b2.text:
"WHOEVER SITS DOWN," HE SAYS. "IT IZ NO ALWAYS A PERSON. IT IZ NO OFTEN A PERSON."
HE TELLS YOU WHAT HE HAB LEARNED IN MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE OF IT, WHICH IZ FOUR RULES, AN' DA FOURTH ONE IZ DA ONE DAT KEEPS YOU ALIVE, AN' HE MAKES YOU REPEAT IT UNTIL YOU HAB IT RIGHT!

b2_m.text:
"WHOEVER SITS DOWN," HE SAYS. "IT IZ NO ALWAYS A PERSON. IT IZ NO OFTEN A PERSON." HE TELLS YOU WHAT HE HAB LEARNED, WHICH IZ {FOUR TINKZ|A SHORT LIST|NO MUCH FOR DA YEARS HE HAB PUT IN}.
DA FOURTH TINK IZ DAT DA POSITION ON DA BOARD NEVER RESETS, AN' DAT HE HAB BIN PLAYIN' DA SAME GAME SINCE {1981|BEFORE DA WALL|A LONG TIME AGO}, AN' DAT HE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN} MOVES FROM LOSIN' IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{ONE GAME. MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE. AN' HE IZ LOSIN'.|ASK WHAT HAPPENS WHEN HE LOSES.|HE HAB NO MOVED DAT QUEEN IN A DECADE.}"
asides.any: {member} {LOOKS AT DA BOARD PROPERLY|COUNTS DA PIECES OFF DA BOARD|SITS DOWN ON DA OTHER BENCH}

choices.text: LET HIM TALK. LET HIM PLAY IT OUT!
ASK WHAT HAPPENS WHEN HE LOSES!
LOOK AT DA POSITION AN' FIND DA MOVE HE HAB MISSED!

b2_lose.text:
HE DOES NO KNOW. DAT IZ DA HONEST ANSWER AN' IT IZ DA ONE HE GIVES, AN' DEN HE GIVES DA OTHER ONE, WHICH IZ DAT {DA MAN BEFORE HIM|HIS PREDECESSOR|WHOEVER HAB DA BENCH BEFORE} ALSO DID NO KNOW, AN' LOST, AN' DA TABLE WAZ EMPTY FOR {FOUR YEARS|A WHILE|SOME YEARS} AFTERWARDS.
AN' DAT DA VILLAGE WAZ DIFFERENT IN DOZE FOUR YEARS, AN' DAT NOBODY WILL SAY HOW, AN' DAT HE SAT DOWN IN {1981|DAT SPRING|DA YEAR AFTER} COZ SOMEBODY HAB TA!

b2_move.text:
IT IZ {A QUIET MOVE|NO A CHECK|A ROOK LIFT} AN' IT DOES NO WIN, IT {HOLDS|DRAWS|MAKES DA POSITION UNBREAKABLE}, AN' IT HAB BIN AVAILABLE FOR {ELEVEN MOVES|A LONG TIME|YEARS} AN' HE HAB NO SEEN IT COZ HE HAB BIN PLAYIN' TA WIN.
HE PLAYS IT. BLACK TAKES {A COUPLE OF MINUTES|A LONG TIME|LONGER DEN IT HAB EVER TAKEN} TA ANSWER, AN' WHEN IT DOES DA CLOCK IZ {STOPPED|EVEN|HIS}, AN' HE SITS BACK AN' CRIES WITOUT MAKIN' ANY NOISE 'BOUT IT!

e_forest_verden.title: {DA BLUE-SKINNED NEIGHBOURS|READ ONLY|DA SMALLHOLDIN' IN DA TREES}

n0.text:
A SMALLHOLDIN' WHERE DA SURVEY SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN': NINE GOATS, A POLYTUNNEL, SOLAR PANELS TWENTY YEARS TOO GOOD, AN' WASHIN' ON A LINE.
DA FAMILY WORKIN' IT IZ BLUE-SKINNED, TALL, AN' ENTIRELY UNBOTHERED BY YOU. VERDEN. DA OLDEST OF DEM LOOKS UP FROM DA GOATS, LOOKS AT YOU FOR SLIGHTLY TOO LONG, AN' SAYS, PLEASANTLY: " STOP."
YOU HAB NO SAID ANYTINK YET.
DA GOATS IZ {NINE|ALL NINE} DA SAME AGE!
n0.emText:
NINE GOATS, A POLYTUNNEL, SOLAR PANELS OUT OF DA WRONG DECADE, AN' A FAMILY DA COLOUR OF A COLD SKY, WORKIN'.
DA OLDEST LOOKS UP AN' SAYS " STOP" BEFORE YOU OPEN YA MOUTH, AN' YOU FEEL IT HAPPEN: DA LIGHT TOUCH OF SOMEBODY READIN' DA FRONT PAGE OF YOU. DERE IZ REAL LIL' FRONT PAGE. BEHIND IT DERE IZ A LOCKED ROOM WIT NINETY-TWO PER CENT OF A LIFE IN IT, AN' SHE LOOKS AT DAT DOOR, AN' SHE TAKES A STEP BACK!
n0.bubba: "DEY READ MINDS," BUBBA TELLS YOU, IN WHAT HE BELIEVES IZ A WHISPER. "NO TINK NOTHIN' RUDE. AGGIA PENZA' A 'E CAPRE. GOATS. GOATS. GOATS."

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
