asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: APOLOGISE AN' ASK PERMISSION PROPERLY!
ASK WHAT DEY READ.
OFFER TA TRADE. DEY IZ A LONG WAY FROM ANY MARKET!
PUSH BACK. TINK SOMETINK LOUD AN' UNPLEASANT ON PURPOSE!

a.text:
IT COSTS YOU NUTTIN' AN' IT BUYS EVERYTINK. DA ELDEST SITS YOU DOWN ON A BENCH MADE OUT OF A PALLET AN' POURS SOMETINK OUT OF AN UNLABELLED BOTTLE.
"YOU IZ DA FIRST DIS YEAR WHO ASKED," SHE SAYS. "DA FOUNDATION PEOPLE DO NO ASK. DA EMPIRE PEOPLE ASK AN' DEN READ DA ANSWER ANYWAY."
WHAT DEY IZ HIDIN' FROM IZ ONE SPECIFIC PIECE OF PAPER!

asides.nurturing: {member} IZ ALREADY HOLDIN' SOMEBODY'S BABY. NOBODY SAW DA HANDOVER!
asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: ASK 'BOUT DA PIECE OF PAPER!
ASK DEM TA READ YOU, DELIBERATELY!

b.text:
"A ROAD," SHE SAYS. "YOU IZ MOSTLY ROAD. AN' ONE OF YOU HAB BIN CARRYIN' A QUESTION FOR DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT AN' HAB NO ASKED IT."
SHE DOES NO SAY WHICH OF YOU. SHE GOES BACK TA DA GOATS. BEHIND HER, A CHILD OF 'BOUT SIX IZ DRAWIN' ALL FOUR OF YOU ON DA SIDE OF DA POLYTUNNEL IN CHARCOAL, IN DA RIGHT ORDER, FROM BEHIND!

asides.melancholic: {member} GOES AN' LOOKS AT DA CHARCOAL DRAWIN' FOR A LONG TIME!
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: ASK HER 'BOUT DA EXTRA FIGURE IN DA DRAWIN'!
ASK DA QUESTION YOU HAB BIN CARRYIN'!

c.text:
DEY WANT SALT, BATTERIES, AN' NEWS; NO MONEY.
WHAT DEY HAB TA TRADE IZ MILK, CHEESE, CUTTINGS OUT OF DA POLYTUNNEL DAT SHOULD NO GROW AT DIS LATITUDE, AN' A LIL' QUANTITY OF SOMETINK DEY KEEP IN DA DARK AN' HANDLE LIKE GLASS!

choices.text: TRADE FAIR AN' TAKE DA PRODUCE!
ASK FOR DA TINK DEY KEEP IN DA DARK!

asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.hedonistic: {member} HAB EATEN MOST OF A CHEESE BEFORE TERMS IZ AGREED!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

d.text:
YOU TINK IT AS HARD AS YOU CAN.
DA ELDEST STOPS. DA GOATS STOP. EVERY VERDEN ON DAT SMALLHOLDIN' TURNS AN' LOOKS AT YOU AT DA SAME TIME WIT DA SAME EXPRESSION, WHICH IZ MUCH WORSE DEN ANGER: IT IZ DA LOOK OF PEOPLE DECIDIN' WHETHER YOU IZ A PERSON OR WEATHER.
DEY DECIDE. YOU IZ ASKED TA LEAVE, AN' YOU LEAVE, AN' DA LEAVIN' IZ NO ENTIRELY VOLUNTARY!

a1.text:
A PUBLICATION ORDER OUT OF DA ARCHIVE FOUNDATION, NAMIN' DIS FAMILY, DIS HOLDIN', AN' DA TINK DEY CAME OFF DA MOUNTAIN CARRYIN' IN {timeAgo}.
DEY ONLY ASK YOU TA CARRY A COPY OF IT OUT TA SOMEBODY IN {region} WHO HAB BIN WAITIN' ELEVEN MONTHS FOR PROOF IT EXISTS!

a2.text:
SHE READS YOU PROPERLY, WIT PERMISSION, WHICH IZ A DIFFERENT TINK ENTIRELY AN' TAKES 'BOUT FOUR MINUTES.
WHAT SHE GIVES BACK IZ A SHAPE: WHAT IZ MISSIN', HOW BIG IT IZ, AN' WHICH DIRECTION IT WENT. SHE WILL NO TAKE PAYMENT FOR DAT. SHE TAKES PAYMENT FOR DA CHEESE!
a2.emText:
SHE READS YOU PROPERLY, WIT PERMISSION, AN' IT TAKES A COUPLE OF MINUTES AN' SHE HAB TA SIT DOWN AFTERWARDS.
"DERE IZ A WOMAN IN DERE," SHE SAYS, "DA SIZE OF A CATHEDRAL, AN' SHE IZ NO IN DERE ANY MORE, AN' WHAT IZ LEFT IZ DA HOLE SHE WAZ STANDIN' IN." DEN, COZ SHE IZ KIND: "DA HOLE IZ ALSO YOU. YOU SHOULD KNOW DAT. DA HOLE IZ ALSO YOU."
a2.bubba: BUBBA DOES NO SAY ANYTINK FOR ONCE. HE JUST PUTS HIS HAT BACK ON YA HEAD, WRONG WAY ROUND, AN' GOES AN' LOOKS AT DA GOATS!

b1.text:
"DAT ONE COMES WIT YOU," SHE SAYS, WITOUT LOOKIN' AT DA DRAWIN'. "IT HAB BIN WIT YOU SINCE {timeAgo}. WE DO NO TALK TA IT. YOU SHOULD NO EITHER."
SHE GIVES YOU A CORD WIT FOUR KNOTS IN IT AN' SHOWS YOU WHICH KNOT TA UNTIE AN' WHEN, AN' REFUSES, ABSOLUTELY, TA SAY WHAT HAPPENS AFTER DA FOURTH!

b2.text:
YOU ASK IT OUT LOUD, IN A GOAT PEN, IN FRONT OF EVERYBODY, WHICH IZ DA ONLY PLACE ANYBODY HAB EVER GOT AN HONEST ANSWER TA A QUESTION LIKE DAT.
SHE ANSWERS IT. DA ANSWER IZ SHORT AN' IT IZ NO COMFORTABLE AN' IT IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA AFTERNOON!

c1.text:
SALT FOR CHEESE, BATTERIES FOR CUTTINGS, AN' AN HOUR OF NEWS FOR A JAR OF HONEY DAT TASTES OF A FLOWER NOBODY HERE CAN NAME.
DEY WALK YOU TA DA TREELINE. DA ELDEST TELLS YOU WHICH WAY TA GO HOME, AN' IT IZ NO DA WAY YOU CAME, AN' IT IZ SHORTER, AN' IT SHOULD NO BE!

c2.text:
DEY GO QUIET, AN' DEN DEY AGREE, WHICH SURPRISES DEM MORE DEN IT SURPRISES YOU.
IT IZ A SEED, OR SOMETINK WIT DA MANNERS OF A SEED, AN' IT IZ WARM, AN' DEY HAND IT OVER IN A CLOTH AN' TELL YOU NO TA PLANT IT IN DIS COUNTRY!

c2_m.text:
DEY GO QUIET, AN' DEN DEY AGREE, WHICH SURPRISES DEM MORE DEN IT SURPRISES YOU, AN' DA ELDEST GOES INTO DA POLYTUNNEL AN' IZ A LONG TIME.
WHAT COMES OUT IZ IN A CLOTH AN' IZ {A SEED|SOMETINK LIKE A SEED|NO OBVIOUSLY A SEED}, AN' BEFORE IT IZ HANDED OVER DERE IZ A CONDITION, SAID ONCE, WHICH IZ DAT IT IZ NO TA BE PLANTED {IN DIS COUNTRY|ANYWHERE WIT PEOPLE|ON EARTH}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DEY JUST TOLD US WHERE NO TA PLANT IT. DAT IZ A MAP.|TAKE DA CONDITION SERIOUSLY.|NOBODY ADDS A CLAUSE LIKE DAT FOR NUTTIN'.}"
asides.any: {member} {AGREES BEFORE ANYBODY ELSE CAN|ASKS WHAT HAPPENS IF IT IZ|TAKES DA CLOTH CAREFULLY}

choices.text: AGREE TA DA CONDITION AN' TAKE IT!
ASK WHAT HAPPENS IF IT IZ PLANTED HERE!
DECLINE IT. TAKE DA CHEESE AN' DA NEWS!

c2_what.text: WHAT HAPPENS IZ DESCRIBED PRECISELY AN' UNHURRIEDLY AN' TAKES {A COUPLE OF MINUTES|A WHILE|LONGER DEN ANYBODY WANTS}, AN' IT IZ A CHANGE, TA {DA GROUND|A VALLEY|EVERYTINK WITHIN A CERTAIN DISTANCE}, PERMANENT, AN' IT IZ DA CHANGE DAT WAZ DONE TA DIS SMALLHOLDIN' {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE AGO|WHEN DEY ARRIVED|ONCE ALREADY}, WHICH IZ WHY DA PANELS IZ TOO GOOD AN' DA GOATS IZ ALL DA SAME AGE!

b1_m.text:
"DAT ONE COMES WIT YOU," SHE SAYS, WITOUT LOOKIN' AT DA DRAWIN'. "IT HAB BIN WIT YOU SINCE {timeAgo}. WE ASSUMED YOU KNEW."
DA DRAWIN' IZ ON DA BACK OF AN ENVELOPE AN' DERE IZ {FIVE|FOUR} FIGURES ON IT AN' DA PARTY IZ FOUR PEOPLE. DA EXTRA ONE IZ DRAWN {SMALLER|BEHIND|AT DA EDGE}, AN' IT IZ DRAWN DA SAME WAY IN DA OTHER TWO DRAWINGS SHE HAB DONE DIS MONTH!

choices.text: TAKE DA DRAWIN' AN' CHANGE DA SUBJECT!
ASK HER TA DRAW IT ON ITS OWN!
ASK WHETHER IT CAN BE ASKED TA LEAVE!

b1_draw.text:
SHE DRAWS IT ON ITS OWN ON DA BACK OF A FEED BAG AN' IT TAKES HER {FOUR MINUTES|A WHILE|THREE GOES}, AN' SHE IZ NO A GOOD DRAWER AN' IT DOES NO MATTER.
IT IZ RECOGNISABLE. TWO OF DA PARTY RECOGNISE IT. NEITHER OF DEM SAYS SO IN DA GOAT PEN, AN' BOTH OF DEM SAY SO DAT NIGHT, SEPARATELY, TA DIFFERENT PEOPLE, WHICH IZ HOW DA PARTY WORKS OUT DAT IT IZ NO DA SAME TINK TA EACH OF DEM!

b1_leave.text:
IT CAN, SHE SAYS, BUT NO BY DEM AN' NO HERE: {A SMALLHOLDIN'|DIS GROUND|A PLACE WIT GOATS ON IT} IZ DA WRONG PLACE TA ASK ANYTINK TA LEAVE, COZ TINKZ DAT IZ ASKED TA LEAVE HAB TA HAB SOMEWHERE TA GO.
WHAT SHE DOES INSTEAD IZ TELL DA PARTY HOW TA ASK, AN' WHERE, AN' WHAT IT COSTS, AN' DA COST IZ NO MONEY AN' IZ NO LARGE AN' IZ DA KIND OF TINK DAT ONLY BECOMES EXPENSIVE YEARS LATER!

e_mountain_line.title: {DA BROKEN LINE|NUTTIN' CASTS HERE|DA SURVEYOR AT DA COL}

n0.text:
A LINE SURVEYOR IZ SITTIN' ON A ROCK WIT HER INSTRUMENT PACKED UP AN' HER HANDS ROUND A MUG, DOING NUTTIN', WHICH IZ NO WHAT DEY DO.
"NO BOTHER," SHE SAYS, BEFORE YOU ASK. "NUTTIN' CASTS HERE. NO HAB SINCE DA EIGHTIES. YOU CAN TRY IF YOU LIKE, EVERYBODY DOES."
BEHIND HER, {leyline}, AN' A STAKE DRIVEN INTO DA GROUND WIT DA TOP OF IT BURNT OFF.
HER INSTRUMENT IZ PACKED UP AN' DA CASE HAB {A FEW YEARS|A LONG TIME|A GREAT DEAL} OF STICKERS ON IT FROM DA SAME ELEVEN SUMMITS!
n0.emText:
A LINE SURVEYOR WIT HER KIT PACKED AN' HER HANDS ROUND A MUG. "NUTTIN' CASTS HERE," SHE SAYS. "NO HAB SINCE DA EIGHTIES."
YOU CAN FEEL IT: DA LEY RUNS UNDER DIS COL AN' IT IZ BROKEN DA WAY A BONE IZ BROKEN, AN' DA WHOLE MOUNTAIN IZ HOLDIN' DA LIMB STILL. YOU IZ MADE OF A BREAK LIKE DIS. YA WENT DA OTHER WAY: EVERYTINK POURED OUT OF YOU AN' SOMETINK ENORMOUS POURED IN!
n0.bubba: BUBBA TRIES A SPARK OFF HIS THUMB, GETS NUTTIN', AN' LOOKS PERSONALLY INSULTED. "WELL ME WILL BE. NUN SE MOVE NIENTE. SUGAR, NO YOU TRY NOTHIN' CLEVER."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.authoritative: {member} {BARKS OUT ORDERS TA SECURE DA PERIMETER|DEMANDS STATUS REPORTS ON DA DOUBLE|REMINDS EVERYONE TA MAINTAIN RADIO DISCIPLINE|TAKES CHARGE OF DA ENTRY TEAM WIT A BRISK NOD}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: ASK WHAT BROKE IT.
WALK DA LINE TA DA BREAK.
OFFER TA MEND IT.
ASK WHO PROFITS FROM A DEAD LINE!

a.text:
"CONTRACT," SHE SAYS. "DA LINE WAZ MOVED BY CONTRACT IN EIGHTY-FOUR AN' DA CONTRACT IZ SEALED, AN' WHEN YOU MOVE A LINE BY CONTRACT YOU HAB TA PUT DA OLD ONE SOMEWHERE, AN' DEY PUT IT IN DA MOUNTAIN."
SHE HAB BIN SURVEYIN' DA SAME ELEVEN KILOMETRES FOR SIX YEARS TA PROVE IT, ON HER OWN MONEY, AN' SHE IZ NEARLY DERE AN' SHE NO CAN GO DA LAST KILOMETRE ALONE!

asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO DA LAST KILOMETRE WIT HER!
TAKE HER FIGURES AN' SELL DEM TA DA OFFICE DAT SEALED DA CONTRACT!

b.text:
DA LINE IZ VISIBLE IF YOU KNOW HOW TA LOOK: GRASS DAT GROWS WRONG, SNOW DAT LIES WRONG, AN' AT DA BREAK, A SHEAR WHERE DA GROUND HAB MOVED ELEVEN METRES SIDEWAYS AN' NUTTIN' PHYSICAL HAB MOVED AT ALL.
STANDIN' IN DA BREAK IZ LIKE STANDIN' IN A DOORWAY WIT DA DOOR SWINGIN'!

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.artistic: {member} STANDS IN IT FOR A LONG TIME WIT DEY EYES SHUT!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: STAND IN DA BREAK AN' LET IT WORK ON YOU!
DRIVE A STAKE AN' MARK IT PROPERLY!

c.text:
MENDIN' A LEY IZ NO A TINK THREE PEOPLE DO ON AN AFTERNOON. MENDIN' ELEVEN METRES OF ONE, WIT A SURVEYOR WHO HAB DA FIGURES AN' A PARTY WHO CAN CARRY, IZ A TINK DAT CAN BE STARTED.
IT TAKES UNTIL DARK, IT COSTS BLOOD OUT OF SOMEBODY'S HAND, AN' IT IZ NO FINISHED, AN' DA FIRST SPARK DAT GOES DOWN DA LINE GOES DOWN IT WRONG AN' COMES BACK AT YOU!

d.text:
"PETROMANAGERS," SHE SAYS, IMMEDIATELY, AS THOUGH SHE HAB BIN WAITIN' A FEW YEARS FOR SOMEBODY TA ASK DAT INSTEAD OF DA OTHER QUESTION. "DERE IZ OIL UNDER DIS AN' DA LINE FOLLOWS DA OIL, AN' A LINE DAT DOES NO RUN NO CAN BE METERED."
SHE HAB DA PAPERWORK. SHE WANTS IT OUT OF HER HANDS AN' INTO SOMEBODY ELSE'S BEFORE SOMEBODY COMES FOR IT!

choices.text: TAKE DA PAPERWORK TA DA FOUNDATION!
TAKE DA PAPERWORK TA DA PETROMANAGERS AN' NAME A PRICE!

a1.text:
DA LAST KILOMETRE IZ A SCRAMBLE AN' A TRAVERSE AN' AN HOUR IN CLOUD, AN' AT DA END OF IT DA INSTRUMENT FINALLY READS SOMETINK, AN' SHE SITS DOWN IN DA SNOW AN' SWEARS FOR A FULL MINUTE.
WHAT SHE HAB PROVED IZ WORTH A GREAT DEAL TA SEVERAL OFFICES. WHAT SHE GIVES YOU IZ A SHARE, AN' DA COORDINATES, AN' A WARNIN'!

a2.text:
DA OFFICE IZ REAL GRATEFUL. DA OFFICE PAYS EXTREMELY WELL, IN {coin}, AN' ASKS FOR DA ORIGINAL NOTEBOOKS AS WELL AS DA FIGURES.
YOU HAND DEM OVER IN A CAR PARK IN {region}. SHE FINDS OUT IN A WEEK AN' A BIT, AN' WHAT SHE SAYS TA YOU DEN IZ SHORT AN' YOU WILL KEEP IT FOR YEARS!

b1.text:
A GOOD STRETCH OF SOMEWHERE ELSE GOES THROUGH YOU SIDEWAYS.
YOU COME OUT OF IT WIT A NOSEBLEED, A HEADACHE DAT LASTS A COUPLE OF DAYS, AN' DA CERTAIN KNOWLEDGE OF WHERE DA OTHER END OF DIS LINE COMES UP, WHICH IZ NO IN DIS COUNTRY AN' IZ NO ON DIS CONTINENT!

b2.text:
YOU DRIVE DA STAKE AN' PAINT DA TOP OF IT, AN' SHE TAKES DA BEARIN', AN' FOR DA FIRST TIME IN A COUPLE OF YEARS DA BREAK IZ ON A MAP.
A MAP IZ A LIL' TINK. MOST OF A SEASON LATER, IN A BAR IN {region}, SOMEBODY BUYS YOU A DRINK FOR IT AN' WILL NO SAY WHO DEY WORK FOR!

d1.text:
DA FOUNDATION TAKE IT, CATALOGUE IT, AN' PUBLISH IT, WHICH IZ DA ONE TINK DA SEALED CONTRACT COULD NO SURVIVE.
DA LINE DOES NO MEND. IT DOES, HOWEVER, GET AN INQUIRY, AN' DA SURVEYOR GETS HER SIX YEARS BACK IN DA FORM OF A SALARY!

d2.text:
DEY PAY WITOUT ARGUIN', WHICH IZ HOW YOU KNOW YOU ASKED TOO LIL'.
DA SURVEYOR IZ MOVED ON TA A DIFFERENT A GOOD DRIVE, ON FULL PAY, AN' TOLD TA BE PLEASED 'BOUT IT. SHE IZ NO PLEASED 'BOUT IT. SHE KNOWS EXACTLY WHO SOLD IT, COZ DERE WAZ ONLY EVER GOING TA BE ONE OF YOU!

b1_m.text:
ELEVEN METRES OF SOMEWHERE ELSE GOES THROUGH YOU SIDEWAYS, AN' IT TAKES 'BOUT {A COUPLE OF SECONDS|A MOMENT|NO TIME AT ALL}, AN' AFTERWARDS DERE IZ A NOSEBLEED AN' A HEADACHE AN' DA CERTAINTY OF HAVIN' BIN SOMEWHERE.
DERE IZ ALSO, IN DA HAND DAT WAZ NO HOLDIN' ANYTINK, {A STONE|SOMETINK|A LIL' OBJECT}, AN' IT IZ WARM, AN' IT IZ DA SAME ROCK AS DA ROCK DA SURVEYOR IZ SITTIN' ON AN' HAB BIN SHAPED!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{YOU CAME BACK HOLDIN' SOMETINK. DAT IZ NO HOW A BREAK WORKS.|PUT IT DOWN. OR DO NO. BUT LOOK AT IT.|SOMEBODY HANDED YOU DAT.}"
asides.any: {member} {PINCHES DA NOSE AN' HOLDS DA STONE UP|ASKS DA SURVEYOR TA LOOK AT IT|SAYS NUTTIN'}

choices.text: KEEP DA STONE AN' GET OFF DA MOUNTAIN!
PUT IT BACK INTO DA BREAK!
HAB DA SURVEYOR TAKE A BEARIN' ON IT!

b1_back.text:
STANDIN' IN ELEVEN METRES OF SOMEWHERE ELSE A SECOND TIME, DELIBERATELY, TA GIVE SOMETINK BACK, IZ A DECISION DAT NOBODY IN DA PARTY ARGUES WIT AN' EVERYBODY REMEMBERS.
IT IZ TAKEN. DA BREAK {CLOSES|NARROWS|GOES} BY 'BOUT A METRE WHILE EVERYONE IZ WATCHIN', WHICH IZ DA FIRST TIME IN SIX YEARS IT HAB DONE ANYTINK EXCEPT WIDEN, AN' DA SURVEYOR WRITES DAT DOWN WIT HER HANDS SHAKIN'!

b1_bear.text:
DA INSTRUMENT COMES OUT OF DA CASE FOR DA FIRST TIME IN {FOUR DAYS|A WHILE|WEEKS} AN' SHE TAKES A BEARIN' ON A STONE HELD IN A HAND, WHICH IZ NO WHAT INSTRUMENTS IZ FOR.
IT READS. IT READS A DIRECTION AN' A DISTANCE, AN' DA DISTANCE IZ {FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES|A LONG WAY|OFF DIS MOUNTAIN ENTIRELY}, AN' AT DA OTHER END OF IT DERE IZ A SECOND BREAK DAT NOBODY HAB EVER FOUND AN' DAT IZ NOW ON A CHART!

d1_m.text:
DA FOUNDATION TAKE IT, CATALOGUE IT, AN' PUBLISH IT, WHICH IZ DA ONE TINK DA SEALED CONTRACT COULD NO SURVIVE, AN' IT TAKES {A COUPLE OF MONTHS|A SEASON|MOST OF A YEAR} TA GO THROUGH.
WHILE IT IZ GOING THROUGH, DA SURVEYOR IZ {MOVED ON|REASSIGNED|TAKEN OFF DA MOUNTAIN}, AN' HER NOTEBOOKS IZ REQUESTED BY A FIRM OF SOLICITORS ACTIN' FOR A CLIENT WHO IZ NO NAMED, AN' SHE RINGS DA PARTY FROM A CALL BOX TA ASK WHAT TA DO!

choices.text: TELL HER TA HAND DEM OVER. IT IZ PUBLISHED NOW!
TELL HER TA LODGE DA ORIGINALS WIT DA FOUNDATION FIRST!
GO AN' GET HER AN' DA NOTEBOOKS OUT!

d1_lodge.text:
ORIGINALS LODGED, RECEIPTED, CATALOGUED, AN' PHOTOGRAPHED, WIT A COPY TA DA SOLICITORS AN' A COPY TA HER, WHICH TAKES {A COUPLE OF DAYS|A WEEK|SOME RUNNIN' 'BOUT} AN' ONE REAL WELL-WORDED LETTER.
DA REQUEST IZ WITHDRAWN {INSIDE DA FORTNIGHT|ALMOST AT ONCE|QUIETLY}. SHE KEEPS HER JOB, KEEPS HER NOTEBOOKS, AN' IZ ON DAT MOUNTAIN DA FOLLOWIN' SUMMER WIT A NEW CASE AN' DA SAME ELEVEN STICKERS!

d1_out.text:
GETTIN' SOMEBODY AN' {A FEW YEARS|FOUR BOXES|A CAREER} OF NOTEBOOKS OUT OF A RENTED ROOM IN A HILL TOWN IN ONE NIGHT IZ {A VAN JOB|NO DIFFICULT|EASIER DEN IT SOUNDS} AN' IZ ONLY ALARMIN' ONCE, AT DA BOTTOM OF DA STAIRS.
SHE IZ IN ANOTHER COUNTRY INSIDE A WEEK, WIT DA NOTEBOOKS, UNDER HER OWN NAME, WORKIN'. DA CONTRACT IZ STILL SEALED. DA NOTEBOOKS IZ NO, AN' SHE IZ PUBLISHIN' DEM HERSELF, ONE A YEAR, FOR DA REST OF HER LIFE!

e_desert_petro.title: {DA CONTRACT AT DA WELLHEAD|SENTIENT OIL|DA REDIRECTION}

n0.text:
A WELLHEAD IN DA MIDDLE OF NOWHERE WIT A FOLDIN' TABLE IN FRONT OF IT, AN' ON DA TABLE A CONTRACT IN FOUR COPIES, WEIGHTED DOWN WIT STONES.
DA PUMP IZ NO RUNNIN'. TWO PETROMANAGERS IN SHORT SLEEVES IZ WAITIN' IN DA SHADE OF A PICKUP WIT DA SORT OF PATIENCE DAT COSTS MONEY BY DA HOUR.
"YOU IZ NO DA SIGNATORY," ONE OF DEM SAYS, "BUT YOU WILL DO, IF YOU CAN READ."
DERE IZ {FOUR|THREE} COPIES ON DA TABLE AN' {FIVE|FOUR} PENS, AN' ONE OF DA PENS HAB BIN USED!
n0.emText:
A WELLHEAD, A FOLDIN' TABLE, A CONTRACT IN FOUR COPIES WEIGHTED WIT STONES, AN' TWO PETROMANAGERS WAITIN' IN DA SHADE TA HAB IT SIGNED BY ANYBODY AT ALL.
DA OIL UNDER DIS IZ AWAKE. YOU CAN FEEL IT DA WAY YOU FEEL SOMEONE READIN' OVER YA SHOULDER, AN' WHAT IZ ON DA TABLE IZ A CONTRACT WIT DA TINK IN DA GROUND, AN' DA COMPANY IZ ONLY DA NOTARY!
n0.bubba: BUBBA PICKS UP COPY THREE AN' READS DA BACK OF IT. "SUGAR. CLAUSE ELEVEN. UH-UH. 'A FIRMA NUN SE NE VA CCHIU'. ONCE YOU SIGN, YOU SIGNED FOREVER, DEY WROTE IT RIGHT DERE IN DA DAYLIGHT."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.hedonistic: {member} HAB ALREADY ASKED WHAT IT PAYS!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: READ ALL FOUR COPIES BEFORE ANYBODY SAYS ANYTINK ELSE!
ASK WHAT IZ ACTUALLY DOWN DERE!
SIGN.
TAKE DA TABLE, DA COPIES AN' DA PICKUP, AN' GO!

a.text:
THREE COPIES SAY DA FLOW IZ REDIRECTED TA DA COAST. DA FOURTH SAYS DA FLOW IZ REDIRECTED, AN' DOES NO SAY WHERE TA, AN' HAB A LINE 'BOUT DA REDIRECTION BEING "AS AGREED BY DA PARTY OF DA SECOND PART", AN' DA PARTY OF DA SECOND PART IZ NO NAMED.
DA PETROMANAGERS WATCH YOU FIND IT. ONE OF DEM STOPS CHEWIN'!

choices.text: REFUSE TA SIGN, AN' SAY WHY, OUT LOUD!
SIGN COPY THREE ONLY AN' HAND BACK DA OTHERS!

asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
"OIL," SAYS DA TALLER ONE, "WIT OPINIONS."
HE IZ NO JOKIN' AN' HE DOES NO ENJOY SAYIN' IT. IT HAB BIN TALKIN' TA DA NIGHT CREW FOR FOUR MONTHS. IT HAB ASKED, TWICE, TA BE MOVED. IT HAB BIN POLITE 'BOUT IT, AN' IT HAB BIN SPECIFIC 'BOUT WHERE IT WANTS TA GO, AN' DA DESTINATION IZ A TOWN OF ELEVEN THOUSAND PEOPLE!

choices.text: ASK TA SPEAK TA IT.
TELL DEM TA CAP DA WELL AN' WALK AWAY FROM IT!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text:
YOU SIGN, AN' DA PEN GOES COLD, AN' DA PUMP STARTS BY ITSELF, AN' DA TWO OF DEM RELAX IN A WAY DAT IZ NO PLEASANT TA WATCH.
YOU IZ PAID ON DA SPOT, WELL, IN CASH. WHAT YOU HAB AGREED TA, IN A CLAUSE YOU DID READ, IZ TA BE DA PARTY OF DA SECOND PART'S CORRESPONDENT FOR YEARS AN' YEARS.
IT WRITES TA YOU. IT STARTS DAT NIGHT!

d.text:
YOU TAKE DA LOT. DA PICKUP IZ A GOOD PICKUP.
ELEVEN KILOMETRES ON, EVERY COPY OF DA CONTRACT IN DA CAB IZ BLANK, AN' DA WELLHEAD BEHIND YOU IZ RUNNIN', AN' SOMETINK HAB SIGNED ON YA BEHALF USING A HAND IT BORROWED FROM SOMEWHERE!

a1.text:
YOU READ DA MISSIN' CLAUSE OUT LOUD IN A DESERT TA TWO MEN WHO ALREADY KNEW 'BOUT IT, AN' DA EFFECT IZ NO ON DEM.
DA WELLHEAD ANSWERS. DA PRESSURE GAUGE COMES OFF DA PEG AN' DA SAND ROUND DA BASE OF DA PUMP GOES GLASSY IN A RING, AN' BOTH PETROMANAGERS GET INTO DA PICKUP AN' DRIVE AWAY WITOUT YOU, WHICH TELLS YOU EVERYTINK!

a2.text:
YOU SIGN DA COPY WIT DA HOLE IN IT AN' HAND BACK DA THREE DAT IZ WATERTIGHT, WHICH MEANS DA ONLY EXECUTED CONTRACT IN EXISTENCE IZ DA ONE NOBODY CAN ENFORCE.
DA TALLER ONE LOOKS AT IT FOR A LONG MOMENT AN' DEN LAUGHS, ONCE, AN' PAYS YOU ANYWAY, COZ PAYIN' YOU IZ CHEAPER DEN DRIVIN' BACK OUT HERE!

b1.text:
DEY LET YOU, COZ IT MEANS DEY DO NO HAB TA.
YOU TALK TA A WELLHEAD IN A DESERT FOR HALF AN HOUR. IT IZ COURTEOUS, SLOW, AN' 'BOUT FOUR HUNDRED THOUSAND YEARS OLD, AN' IT WANTS TA GO HOME, AN' HOME IZ UNDER A TOWN OF ELEVEN THOUSAND PEOPLE, AN' IT DOES NO UNDERSTAND WHY DAT IZ AN OBJECTION.
YOU EXPLAIN. IT LISTENS. DAT IZ NO NUTTIN'!

b2.text:
"CAP IT," YOU SAY. "CAP IT AN' GO HOME AN' NEVER SIGN ANYTINK OUT HERE AGAIN."
DEY DO IT, WHICH SURPRISES EVERYBODY INCLUDIN' DEM. IT TAKES A COUPLE OF DAYS AN' A CREW AN' DA CREW IZ TERRIFIED DA WHOLE TIME AN' PAID TRIPLE FOR IT.
DA TOWN OF ELEVEN THOUSAND PEOPLE NEVER HEARS 'BOUT ANY OF DIS. DA COLLECTIVE AUDITOR WHO DOES HEARS 'BOUT IT FROM YOU, AN' PAYS!

a2_m.text:
YOU SIGN DA COPY WIT DA HOLE IN IT AN' HAND BACK DA THREE DAT IZ WATERTIGHT, WHICH MEANS DA ONLY EXECUTED CONTRACT IN DA DESERT IZ DA ONE DAT DOES NO SAY WHERE DA FLOW GOES.
DA TALLER ONE NOTICES {IMMEDIATELY|AT ONCE|BEFORE DA PEN IZ DOWN} AN' DOES NO SAY ANYTINK, AN' DA SHORTER ONE DOES NO NOTICE AT ALL, AN' DA TALLER ONE WATCHES DA PARTY DA WHOLE WAY BACK TA DA VEHICLE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{ONE OF DEM KNOWS EXACTLY WHAT WE JUST DID.|HE IZ NO GOING TA REPORT IT EITHER.|HE WANTED SOMEBODY TA DO DAT.}"
asides.any: {member} {FOLDS DA COPY INTO A JACKET|KEEPS WALKIN'|NODS TA HIM ONCE}

choices.text: DRIVE OFF WIT IT. DAT IZ DA JOB DONE!
GO BACK AN' TALK TA DA TALLER ONE ALONE!
GIVE HIM DA COPY.

a2_tall.text:
AWAY FROM DA TABLE HE TALKS FOR {FOUR MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|AS LONG AS HE DARES}, AN' WHAT HE SAYS IZ DAT HE HAB BROUGHT DIS CONTRACT TA {NINE|ELEVEN} WELLHEADS AN' DAT DIS IZ DA FIRST TIME ANYBODY HAB READ ALL FOUR COPIES.
HE HAB BIN {WAITIN'|HOPIN'|TRYIN'} FOR SOMEBODY TA DO IT. HE GIVES DA PARTY DA FILE, DA ROUTE AN' DA NEXT FOUR WELLHEADS ON IT, AN' ASKS DEM, WITOUT MUCH HOPE, TA GET DERE FIRST!

a2_give.text:
DA EXECUTED COPY GOES BACK ONTO DA FOLDIN' TABLE IN FRONT OF BOTH OF DEM, WHICH IZ {EITHER GENEROSITY OR A DARE|A GESTURE|NO WHAT ANYBODY EXPECTS}.
DA TALLER ONE PUTS IT IN DA CASE WIT DA OTHERS AN' SAYS THANK YOU, AN' DA PUMP DOES NO START, AN' DA TWO OF DEM GET IN DA PICKUP AN' DRIVE AWAY LEAVIN' DA TABLE AN' DA WELLHEAD EXACTLY AS DEY FOUND DEM. IT IZ CAPPED {MOST OF A SEASON|A SEASON|EVENTUALLY} BY SOMEBODY ELSE!

b2_m.text:
"CAP IT," YOU SAY. "CAP IT AN' GO HOME AN' NEVER SIGN ANYTINK OUT HERE AGAIN." DEY DO IT, WHICH SURPRISES EVERYBODY INCLUDIN' DEM, AN' CAPPIN' IT TAKES {A COUPLE OF HOURS|DA REST OF DA DAY|UNTIL DARK}.
AT 'BOUT DA THIRD HOUR DA TINK IN DA WELL STARTS {TALKIN'|MAKIN' ITSELF HEARD|SAYIN' SOMETINK}, THROUGH DA PIPE, IN A VOICE DAT IZ USING DA SHORTER MAN'S OWN VOWELS, AN' IT IZ OFFERIN' TERMS!

choices.text: KEEP CAPPIN'. DO NO ANSWER IT!
ANSWER IT.
GET DA SHORTER MAN AWAY FROM DA PIPE FIRST!

b2_answer.text:
ANSWERIN' A WELL IZ {NO A CONVERSATION|A FORMULA|A PROCEDURE}, AN' IT IZ DONE CORRECTLY, OUT OF A PIPE, IN A DESERT, WIT A COUPLE OF MEN IN OVERALLS HOLDIN' A CAP PLATE AN' WATCHIN' SOMEBODY DEY MET DIS MORNIN' DO SOMETINK DEY WILL NEVER DESCRIBE ACCURATELY.
IT STOPS. DA CAP GOES ON INTO SILENCE. WHAT IZ UNDER IT IZ NO GONE AN' IZ NO LONGER {OFFERIN'|TALKIN'|AWAKE}, AN' DA FIELD IZ ON NOBODY'S BOOKS FROM DAT AFTERNOON!

b2_pull.text:
GETTIN' A MAN AWAY FROM A PIPE DAT IZ TALKIN' IN HIS OWN VOICE TAKES {TWO PEOPLE|BOTH HANDS|MORE DEN ASKIN'}, AN' HE FIGHTS, BRIEFLY, AN' DEN STOPS AN' IZ EXTREMELY FRIGHTENED.
DA CAP GOES ON WIT DA PARTY DOING DA LAST OF IT. HE DOES NO SPEAK FOR DA REST OF DA DAY AN' DEN SPEAKS A GREAT DEAL, AN' WHAT HE SAYS HE HEARD IZ NO WHAT ANYBODY ELSE AT DA WELLHEAD HEARD!

e_badlands_bubble.title: {DA QUARRY DAT RESETS|SHIFT CHANGE|DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE OF TUESDAY WORK}

n0.text:
A WORKIN' QUARRY, AT WORK: CRUSHER RUNNIN', LORRIES LOADIN', A CROWD OF MEN ON SHIFT.
DA HOOTER GOES AT FOUR. EVERYTINK STOPS. EVERYONE WALKS TA DA GATE. AN' AT FOUR MINUTES PAST FOUR EVERYTINK IZ RUNNIN' AGAIN AN' DA SAME LORRY IZ BEING LOADED AGAIN BY DA SAME MEN, AN' DA PILE IT IZ TAKIN' FROM HAB NO GONE DOWN.
AT DA GATE DERE IZ A CHALK LINE DRAWN ACROSS DA TARMAC AN' A SIGN, HAND-LETTERED, SAYIN': DO NO CROSS BACK IN.
DA CHALK LINE IZ REDRAWN {DAILY|OFTEN|BY SOMEBODY WHO COMES AT DAWN}, AN' IT IZ DRAWN FROM DA OUTSIDE!
n0.emText:
A QUARRY IN A LOOP: HOOTER AT FOUR, SHIFT OUT, AN' FOUR MINUTES LATER DA SAME MEN LOADIN' DA SAME LORRY OFF A PILE DAT NEVER GOES DOWN.
A BUBBLE, AN' A LIL' ONE, AN' SOMEBODY OUTSIDE IT DREW A CHALK LINE AN' WROTE DO NO CROSS BACK IN, WHICH MEANS SOMEBODY GOT OUT AN' KNEW ENOUGH TA WRITE A WARNIN' AN' NO ENOUGH TA FIX IT!
n0.bubba: "ELEVEN YEARS," SAYS BUBBA, WATCHIN' DA LORRY FILL AGAIN. "DEY BIN DOIN' TUESDAY ELEVEN YEARS. POVERI GUAGLIUNI. SUGAR, NO STEP ON DAT CHALK."

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.impulsive: {member} HAB ONE FOOT OVER DA LINE WHILE DA REST OF YOU IZ STILL TALKIN'!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: CROSS IN AN' TALK TA DEM.
SHOUT ACROSS DA LINE AT DA MAN WHO LOOKS UP!
FIND WHOEVER DREW DA CHALK!
BREAK DA CRUSHER FROM OUTSIDE DA LINE!

a.text:
INSIDE, IT IZ TUESDAY, AN' IT IZ FOUR O'CLOCK, AN' IT ALWAYS WILL BE, AN' DA FOREMAN IZ GLAD OF DA EXTRA HANDS.
DA MEN KNOW. DAT IZ DA HORROR OF IT. DEY KNOW, AN' DEY HAB KNOWN FOR ELEVEN YEARS, AN' DEY HAB MADE A LIFE OUT OF FOUR MINUTES, AN' DEY HAB A ROTA FOR WHO GETS TA SIT DOWN!
a.bubba: BUBBA SHAKES FORTY HANDS IN A SHORT WHILE FLAT AN' REMEMBERS EVERY NAME. HE ALWAYS DOES!

asides.melancholic: {member} DOES NO SAY ANYTINK AT ALL FOR DA WHOLE FOUR MINUTES!
asides.nurturing: {member} ASKS 'BOUT DEY FAMILIES AN' IMMEDIATELY WISHES DEY HAB NO!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WORK A SHIFT WIT DEM AN' LEARN DA LOOP FROM INSIDE!
GET OUT AT DA HOOTER, TAKIN' ONE MAN WIT YOU!

b.text:
HE HEARS YOU. EVERYONE ELSE CARRIES ON.
HE WALKS TA DA LINE, STOPS A HAND'S WIDTH FROM IT, AN' SPEAKS FAST, COZ HE HAB FOUR MINUTES AN' HE HAB BIN REHEARSIN' DIS FOR ELEVEN YEARS IN CASE ANYBODY EVER CAME.
WHAT HE WANTS IZ NO RESCUE. WHAT HE WANTS IZ FOR SOMEBODY TA GO TA AN ADDRESS IN {region} AN' SAY TWO SENTENCES TA A WOMAN DERE!

choices.text: TAKE DA MESSAGE.
TELL HIM YOU WILL GET ALL FORTY OF DEM OUT INSTEAD!

asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

c.text:
SHE IZ LIVIN' IN A CARAVAN ON DA RIM WIT BINOCULARS AN' ELEVEN YEARS OF NOTEBOOKS, AN' SHE GOT OUT IN DA SECOND WEEK AN' HAB BIN WATCHIN' EVER SINCE.
"YOU NO CAN PULL DEM OUT," SHE SAYS. "ME HAB HAB TWO OUT. DEY COME APART AT 'BOUT DA BEST PART OF A WEEK. IT IZ A SHAPE DOWN DERE. DEY IZ PART OF DA SHAPE NOW."

choices.text: ASK WHAT WOULD BREAK DA SHAPE!
BUY DA NOTEBOOKS OFF HER.

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

d.text:
YOU PUT A CHARGE UNDER DA CRUSHER'S FEED FROM OUTSIDE DA CHALK, AN' IT GOES, AN' DA QUARRY STOPS FOR ELEVEN WHOLE SECONDS.
ELEVEN SECONDS IZ ENOUGH FOR THIRTY-NINE MEN TA LOOK UP. DEN IT RESETS, DA CRUSHER IZ WHOLE, AN' ONE MAN IZ STANDIN' OUTSIDE DA LINE WIT HIS HANDS OUT, AN' BEHIND HIM DA LOOP CLOSES OVER DA GAP WHERE HE WAZ.
HE NO CAN TELL YOU HIS OWN NAME. HE KNOWS YA!

a1.text:
A COUPLE OF MINUTES AT A TIME, OVER AN' OVER, FOR WHAT YA WATCH CALLS AN AFTERNOON AN' YA BODY CALLS A COUPLE OF DAYS.
YOU LEARN DA LOOP FROM INSIDE: WHERE IT THINS, WHAT IT WILL NO REPEAT, AN' DA ONE TINK IN DA QUARRY DAT CHANGES CYCLE TA CYCLE, WHICH IZ A TALLY CHALKED INSIDE DA CRUSHER HOUSIN' WHERE DA FOREMAN NO CAN SEE IT.
YOU COME OUT WIT DA NUMBER, AN' DA NUMBER IZ DA SHAPE OF DA TINK!

a2.text:
HE COMES OUT WIT YOU AT DA HOOTER, OVER DA CHALK, HOLDIN' YA ARM.
HE LASTS A WEEK AN' A BIT. DEY IZ GOOD DAYS, AN' HE SPENDS DEM WIT DA WOMAN FROM DA ADDRESS, AN' ON DA NINTH HE GOES BACK TA DA QUARRY ON FOOT AN' IZ AT DA GATE AT FOUR O'CLOCK, AN' AFTER DAT HE IZ ONE OF FORTY AGAIN AN' DOES NO LOOK UP ANY MORE!

b1.text:
YOU GO TA DA ADDRESS. IT TAKES TWO DAYS. DA WOMAN IZ EXPECTIN' DA TWO SENTENCES AN' HAB BIN FOR DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE, AN' WHEN SHE HAB HEARD DEM SHE SITS DOWN ON HER OWN FRONT STEP.
WHAT SHE GIVES YOU TA TAKE BACK IZ FOR YOU, AN' IT IZ DA TINK HER HUSBAND LEFT IN HER KEEPIN' BEFORE HE TOOK DA QUARRY JOB!

b2.text:
"YOU NO WILL," HE SAYS. "BUT THANK YOU. SAY DAT YOU WILL TRY, SO ME CAN TELL DA OTHERS SOMEBODY SAID IT."
YOU TRY. YOU IZ AT DAT GATE FOR DA BEST PART OF A WEEK AN' YOU GET FOUR OF DEM OUT AN' ALL FOUR GO BACK AN' NONE OF DEM WILL LOOK AT YOU.
YOU COME AWAY WIT AN EDUCATION IN BUBBLES DAT NO BOOK SELLS, AN' A DEBT TA FORTY MEN YOU NO CAN PAY!

c1.text:
"DA TALLY," SHE SAYS. "DERE IZ A TALLY INSIDE DA CRUSHER. IT IZ DA ONLY TINK DAT CARRIES OVER. SOMEBODY IN DERE IZ COUNTIN', AN' WHEN DA COUNT ENDS ME TINK IT STOPS, AN' ME HAB BIN SITTIN' HERE FOR ELEVEN YEARS TA SEE WHAT DA NUMBER IZ."
YOU GO AN' GET DA NUMBER. IT COSTS ONE MAN A LOOK AT DA RIM HE DOES NO USUALLY GET, AN' IT COSTS YOU A DAY!

c2.text:
ELEVEN YEARS OF OBSERVATIONS AT FOUR MINUTE ELEVEN SECOND INTERVALS, IN ELEVEN NOTEBOOKS, ALL OF IT METHODICAL AN' ALL OF IT AWFUL.
DA FOUNDATION WANT IT. SO DOES DA GUILD. YOU SELL IT ONCE AN' COPY IT TWICE, WHICH IZ DA ONLY HONEST TINK ANYBODY HAB DONE AT DIS QUARRY IN A DECADE!

a2_m.text:
HE COMES OUT WIT YOU AT DA HOOTER, OVER DA CHALK, HOLDIN' YA ARM, AN' ON DA OUTSIDE HE STANDS STILL FOR A REAL LONG TIME AN' LOOKS AT DA SKY.
HE LASTS A WEEK AN' A BIT. ON DA FOURTH OF DEM HE TELLS DA PARTY SOMETINK HE HAB BIN CARRYIN' SINCE {TUESDAY|DA DAY IT CLOSED|WHENEVER IT WAZ}: DAT DERE IZ A MAN IN DERE WHO CAME IN {AFTER|LATER DEN DA REST|A FEW YEARS AFTER IT SHUT}, ON PURPOSE, AN' WHO KNOWS HOW!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY WALKED IN VOLUNTARILY.|IF HE GOT IN AFTER IT CLOSED HE KNOWS DA WAY.|NINE DAYS. ASK HIM EVERYTINK.}"
asides.any: {member} {WRITES DOWN EVERYTINK HE SAYS|SITS WIT HIM|ASKS WHICH MAN}

choices.text: LET HIM HAB HIS NINE DAYS IN PEACE!
GET DA NAME OF DA MAN WHO WALKED IN!
GO BACK TA DA LINE AN' SHOUT FOR HIM!

a2_name.text:
DA NAME COMES WIT AN ADDRESS, A TRADE AN' A REASON, AN' DA REASON IZ {HIS DAUGHTER|SOMEBODY IN DERE|ONE OF DA FORTY}.
HE WENT IN IN {1987|DA THIRD YEAR|A LONG TIME AFTER DA HOOTER} CARRYIN' A CROWBAR AN' A BAG OF FOOD DAT WOULD NO HAB LASTED AN AFTERNOON, AN' HE IZ IN DERE NOW, A COUPLE OF MINUTES AT A TIME, AN' DA PARTY CAN SEE HIM FROM DA RIM IF DEY KNOW WHICH SHIFT HE IZ ON!

c2_m.text:
ELEVEN YEARS OF OBSERVATIONS AT FOUR MINUTE ELEVEN SECOND INTERVALS, IN ELEVEN NOTEBOOKS, ALL OF IT METHODICAL, ALL OF IT IN DA SAME HAND.
SHE WILL SELL DEM. SHE NAMES A PRICE DAT IZ {FAR TOO LOW|ALMOST NUTTIN'|A MONTH'S RENT} AN' DEN, WHILE DA MONEY IZ BEING COUNTED, SAYS DAT DERE IZ A TWELFTH NOTEBOOK AN' DAT IT IZ NO FOR SALE AN' IZ NO 'BOUT DA QUARRY!

choices.text: BUY DA ELEVEN. LEAVE DA TWELFTH!
ASK WHAT IZ IN DA TWELFTH!
BUY NUTTIN'. OFFER TA TAKE DA OBSERVATIONS OVER FOR A SEASON!

c2_twelve.text:
IT IZ 'BOUT DA CARAVAN. ELEVEN YEARS ON A RIM WIT BINOCULARS IZ ELEVEN YEARS OF SOMEBODY BEING ON DA OUTSIDE OF A BUBBLE, AN' DA TWELFTH NOTEBOOK IZ WHERE SHE HAB BIN WRITIN' DOWN {WHAT SHE HAB NOTICED 'BOUT HERSELF|DA FOUR MINUTE GAPS IN HER OWN DAYS|DA TINKZ DAT DO NO ADD UP OUT HERE}.
DERE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN} OF DEM. SHE READS TWO OUT. DEN SHE PUTS DA KETTLE ON AN' DOES NO READ ANY MORE, AN' DA PARTY DOES NO ASK!

c2_take.text:
A SEASON OF FOUR MINUTE ELEVEN SECOND INTERVALS ON A RIM IN A CARAVAN, IN SHIFTS, WIT A BORROWED PAIR OF BINOCULARS, SO DAT SHE CAN GO DOWN INTO DA TOWN AN' SLEEP IN A BED AN' SEE A DOCTOR.
SHE COMES BACK AFTER {A MONTH|FIVE WEEKS|SIX WEEKS} LOOKIN' LIKE A DIFFERENT PERSON. DA NOTEBOOKS STAY HERS. DA PARTY'S SHIFTS IZ IN DEM, IN A SECOND HAND, AN' SHE HAB ANNOTATED EVERY ONE OF DEM WIT CORRECTIONS!

e_ruins_ghost.title: {DA SPECTRAL AUDITOR|GHOST WIT A GRUDGE|UNFINISHED BUSINESS}

n0.emText:
SOMETINK'S CROSSIN' DA RUINS IN A DEAD STRAIGHT LINE, IN A COURT USHER'S COAT, WIT A PAPER IN ITS HAND, AT DA PACE OF A FUNCTIONARY.
ERIS'S COURT FETCHES PEOPLE LIKE DIS. SHE HAB OTHER ARRANGEMENTS FOR YOU, AN' DEY IZ WORSE, AN' DEY INVOLVE BEING INVITED!
n0.bubba: BUBBA GOES REAL STILL. "AOH. DAT IZ A SUMMONS WALKIN'. SUGAR, LISTEN TA ME: IT AIN'T FOR ME AN' IT AIN'T FOR YOU. 'A CARTA E' PE' N'ATU."

asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX TWICE OVER AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: {SHOW HIM A FAKE PERMIT FROM YA POCKET|BLUFF YA WAY PAST DA GHOST|FLASH A FORGED MUNICIPAL PASS|ARGUE ZONIN' LAW WIT HIM}
{TELL HIM DA GOVERNMENT COLLAPSED TWO CENTURIES AGO|BREAK DA NEWS 'BOUT DA EMPIRE|INFORM HIM HIS DEPARTMENT GOT LIQUIDATED|LAUGH AT HIS IMAGINARY FINES}
{GRAB WHATEVER SHINY RELICS HE'S GUARDIN' AN' BOLT|LOOT DA ALTAR WHILE HE RANTS|SNATCH DA GRIMORIE AN' RUN|IGNORE HIM AN' LOOT DA CHEST}
{DRAW STEEL ON DA OFFICER|PUT DA USHER DOWN|CUT DA CLERK OUT OF DA AIR|SWING AT HIM AN' BE DONE}

a.text:
IT WALKS INTO YOU AN' STOPS, EXACTLY, AT CONTACT, AN' LOOKS UP FOR DA FIRST TIME.
IT HAB A FACE LIKE A PASSPORT PHOTOGRAPH OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB BIN DEAD A WHILE. IT WAITS. IT IZ WAITIN' FOR YOU TA SAY DA TINK DAT PEOPLE SAY TA AN USHER, AN' NONE OF YOU KNOWS DA TINK!

choices.text: SAY YOU IZ NO DA ONE IT WANTS!
SAY YOU WILL COME.

asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
IT GOES TA A CELLAR UNDER DA THIRD HEAP AN' STANDS AT DA TOP OF DA STEPS AN' READS OUT A NAME, ONCE, AN' WAITS.
DA NAME IZ ANSWERED. SOMEBODY COMES UP OUT OF DAT CELLAR WHO HAB BIN LIVIN' DOWN DERE, AN' DEY IZ SHAKIN', AN' DEY GO WIT IT, AN' NEITHER OF DEM LOOKS BACK AT YOU!

choices.text: GO DOWN INTO DA CELLAR DEY CAME OUT OF!
WALK WIT DEM AS FAR AS DEY WILL LET YOU!

c.text:
IT LETS YOU. DAT IZ DA TINK NOBODY EXPECTS: IT HOLDS DA PAPER OUT, PATIENTLY, LIKE A MAN SHOWIN' A TICKET.
IT IZ A SUMMONS OUT OF DA COURT OF ERIS, IN FOUR LANGUAGES, THREE OF WHICH IZ NO USED FOR PAPERWORK, AN' DA NAME ON IT HAB BIN STRUCK OUT AN' REWRITTEN TWICE. DA SECOND NAME IZ NO DA ONE IT READ OUT AT DA CELLAR!

choices.text: ADD A NAME.
HAND IT BACK AN' LET IT GET ON WIT ITS WORK!

d.text:
YOU PUT A COURT OFFICER DOWN IN A FIELD OF RUBBLE, WHICH IZ A TINK DAT CAN BE DONE AN' WHICH HAB CONSEQUENCES.
IT COMES APART LIKE A COAT FALLIN' OFF A HOOK. DA PAPER DOES NO. DA PAPER STAYS IN DA AIR WHERE ITS HAND WAZ, AN' DEN GOES, ON DA SAME BEARIN', AT DA SAME PACE, WITOUT IT!

a1.text:
"ME IZ NO DA ONE YOU WANT."
IT LOOKS AT DA PAPER. IT LOOKS AT YOU. IT COMPARES, VISIBLY, FOR 'BOUT DA BETTER PART OF A MINUTE, AN' DEN IT STEPS ROUND YOU, WHICH IZ DA FIRST TIME IT HAB DEVIATED FROM DA LINE, AN' GOES ON.
WHERE IT STEPPED ROUND YOU, DA GROUND IZ SCORCHED IN TWO FOOTPRINTS, AN' DERE IZ SOMETINK IN DA SCORCH!

a2.text:
YOU SAY YOU WILL COME, AN' IT TAKES YOU AT YA WORD, AN' DA RUINS FOLD UP LIKE A MAP BEING CLOSED.
WHAT YOU GET IZ A COUPLE OF MINUTES IN A CORRIDOR OUTSIDE A COURT DAT DOES NO EXIST IN DIS DIMENSION, AN' A DOCKET WIT YA NAME ON IT DAT ENTITLES YOU TA BE HEARD AT A TIME OF DA COURT'S CHOOSIN'.
IT IZ WORTH AN ENORMOUS AMOUNT TA CERTAIN PEOPLE. IT IZ ALSO A DEBT!

b1.text:
SOMEBODY HAB LIVED DOWN DERE FOR A LONG TIME: A BED, A STOVE, A COUPLE OF YEARS OF TINS, AN' A WALL COVERED IN DATES CROSSED OFF.
DA LAST TWENTY IZ CIRCLED INSTEAD. AN' UNDER DA BED, IN A BAG PACKED AN' READY, IZ EVERYTINK DEY MEANT TA RUN WIT!

b2.text:
YOU WALK BESIDE A STRANGER TA DA EDGE OF DA RUINS WIT AN USHER ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DEM, AN' YOU TALK TA DEM DA WHOLE WAY 'BOUT NUTTIN' AT ALL, COZ DAT IZ WHAT YOU CAN DO.
AT DA BOUNDARY DEY THANK YOU, AN' GIVE YOU WHAT IZ IN DEY POCKET, AN' GO.
DA USHER, ON DA WAY PAST, LOOKS AT YOU FOR DA FIRST AN' ONLY TIME, AN' DOES NO WRITE ANYTINK DOWN, WHICH ONE OF YOU IZ QUITE SURE IZ A KINDNESS!

c1.text:
YOU WRITE A NAME ON A SUMMONS OUT OF DA COURT OF ERIS, IN PENCIL, COZ DAT IZ WHAT IZ IN YA POCKET.
IT IZ ACCEPTED. DAT IZ DA APPALLIN' PART: IT IZ ACCEPTED, AN' DA USHER TURNS NINETY DEGREES ONTO A NEW BEARIN', AN' SOMEWHERE AT DA END OF DAT BEARIN' A PERSON YOU HAB NEVER MET IZ GOING TA LOOK UP!

c2.text:
YOU HAND A DEAD FUNCTIONARY ITS PAPERWORK BACK AN' IT TAKES IT AN' GOES ON.
ON DA FOURTH STEP IT STOPS, COMES BACK, AN' GIVES YOU SOMETINK OUT OF ITS COAT: A TOKEN, BRASS, WIT A NUMBER ON IT. YOU HAB BIN GIVEN A PLACE IN A QUEUE. NOBODY WHO HAB EVER SEEN ONE OF DEZE HAB BIN ABLE TA TELL YOU WHETHER DAT IZ GOOD!

b1_m.text:
SOMEBODY HAB LIVED DOWN DERE FOR A LONG TIME: A BED, A STOVE, FOUR YEARS OF TINS, AN' A WALL COVERED IN DATES.
DA DATES IZ IN TWO COLUMNS. DA LEFT-HAND COLUMN STOPS {FOUR YEARS AGO|IN DA SPRING|ABRUPTLY}. DA RIGHT-HAND COLUMN DOES NO, AN' DA RIGHT-HAND COLUMN IZ STILL BEING ADDED TA, AN' TODAY'S DATE IZ ON IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY WROTE TODAY'S DATE ON DAT WALL.|TWO COLUMNS. TWO PEOPLE.|DEY IZ STILL HERE.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A HAND ON DA STOVE, WHICH IZ WARM|READS DA LAST FOUR ENTRIES|COUNTS DA TINS}

choices.text: TAKE WHAT IZ WORTH TAKIN' AN' GET OUT!
WORK OUT WHAT DA TWO COLUMNS IZ COUNTIN'!
WAIT IN DA CELLAR FOR WHOEVER IZ KEEPIN' DA RIGHT-HAND COLUMN!

b1_cols.text:
DA LEFT COLUMN IZ {DAYS HIDDEN|DAYS DOWN HERE|A TALLY OF A HIDIN'}. DA RIGHT COLUMN IZ {DAYS SINCE|DAYS OWED|A COUNTDOWN RUN DA OTHER WAY}, AN' IT STARTS ON DA DAY DA LEFT ONE STOPS, WHICH IZ DA DAY DA SUMMONS WAZ ISSUED.
WHICH MEANS DA PERSON IN DIS CELLAR IZ SERVIN' SOMETINK, VOLUNTARILY, BY A CALENDAR, AN' IT HAB {A FEW YEARS|A LONG TIME|DA BETTER PART OF A YEAR} LEFT TA RUN!

b1_wait.text:
FOUR HOURS IN SOMEBODY ELSE'S CELLAR WIT DEY STOVE AN' DEY TINS AN' A WALL OF DATES, WHICH IZ A LONG FOUR HOURS.
DEY COME DOWN DA STEPS AT {DUSK|DA USUAL TIME|'BOUT SEVEN} WIT WATER AN' IZ NO STARTLED, AN' SAY, BEFORE ANYBODY ELSE CAN SPEAK, DAT DEY HAB BIN EXPECTIN' DA COURT AN' DAT FOUR PEOPLE IZ MORE DEN DA COURT USUALLY SENDS!

c2_m.text:
YOU HAND A DEAD FUNCTIONARY ITS PAPERWORK BACK AN' IT TAKES IT AN' GOES ON, AN' ON DA FOURTH STEP IT STOPS, AN' COMES BACK, AN' HOLDS DA SUMMONS OUT AGAIN.
DERE IZ A SECOND NAME ON IT NOW. IT IZ A NAME ONE OF DA PARTY {KNOWS|RECOGNISES|HAB BIN AVOIDIN'}, AN' DA INK IZ {WET|FRESH|NO DRY}!

choices.text: GIVE IT BACK AGAIN AN' WALK AWAY!
ASK IT WHO WROTE DA SECOND NAME!
CROSS DA SECOND NAME OUT.

c2_who.text:
NOBODY WROTE IT. DAT IZ DA POINT OF A SUMMONS OUT OF DAT COURT: IT {ACCRUES|ADDS|FILLS IN} AS IT GOES, AN' DA USHER DOES NO KNOW DA NAMES ON DA PAPER IT IZ CARRYIN' AN' HAB NEVER BIN PERMITTED TA READ ONE.
IT SAYS SO PLAINLY, IN DA MANNER OF A CLERK EXPLAININ' A PROCEDURE, AN' DEN ASKS DA PARTY, FOR DA FIRST TIME IN {FOUR HUNDRED YEARS|A REAL LONG SERVICE|ITS ENTIRE CAREER}, WHAT DA SECOND NAME SAYS!

c2_cross.text:
A PENCIL LINE THROUGH A NAME ON A DOCUMENT OUT OF DA COURT OF ERIS, DRAWN BY SOMEBODY STANDIN' IN A FIELD OF RUBBLE WHO HAB DECIDED DAT IZ A TINK A PERSON CAN DO.
DA NAME GOES. SO DOES DA LINE. SO, AFTER 'BOUT {FOUR SECONDS|A MOMENT|DA BETTER PART OF A MINUTE}, DOES DA PENCIL, OUT OF DA HAND DAT WAZ HOLDIN' IT, AN' DA USHER LOOKS AT DA PAPER AN' DEN AT DA PARTY WIT AN EXPRESSION DAT IZ REAL CLOSE TA ADMIRATION!

e_graveyard_father.title: {DA RELIC IN DA CRYPT|GRAVE ROBBIN' FOR FUN & PROFIT|DA FAMILY VAULT}

n0.emText:
SOMETINK FELL IN DA NIGHT, TOOK A CORNER OFF A TOMB, AN' KILLED EVERYTINK WITHIN FOUR METRES OF WHERE IT STOPPED. BEYOND FOUR METRES, NUTTIN'.
YOU KNOW WHAT DIS IZ BEFORE YOU GET CLOSE. EVERYBODY IN DA WORLD KNOWS, COZ DEY WAZ TOLD ON DA NEWS: DA FATHER IZ IN ORBIT AN' HE IZ COMIN' DOWN IN PIECES, AN' DA PIECES DO DIS.
YOU IZ DA REASON HE IZ UP DERE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA PUTS AN ARM ACROSS YA CHEST WITOUT LOOKIN' AT YOU. "SUGAR. NO DIS ONE. AGGIA' DITTO: NO DIS ONE."

a.text:
IT WEIGHS NUTTIN'. IT IZ DA TEMPERATURE OF A HAND, AN' IT FITS A HAND, AN' HOLDIN' IT IZ LIKE HOLDIN' DA MOMENT BEFORE SOMEBODY SPEAKS.
WHOEVER PICKS IT UP DOES NO WANT TA PUT IT DOWN, AN' EVERYBODY ELSE CAN SEE DAT FROM DEY FACE!
a.emText:
IT WEIGHS NUTTIN' AN' IT IZ DA TEMPERATURE OF A HAND AN' IT FITS YA HAND EXACTLY, WHICH IZ NO A COINCIDENCE, COZ YA HANDS IZ EIGHT PER CENT OF A WOMAN WHO WAZ MADE INTO DA TINK DAT DID DIS.
NO SPEAK. IT RECOGNISES. DAT IZ WORSE!
a.bubba: "PUT IT DOWN, SUGAR. PUT IT DOWN. GUARDAME. LOOK AT ME. PUT IT DOWN."

choices.text: KEEP IT.
PUT IT DOWN, SLOWLY, AN' STEP BACK!

b.text:
DA NUMBER IN DA PARISH OFFICE RINGS THROUGH TA A VATICAN FIELD TEAM WHO IZ FOUR HOURS AWAY AN' WHO HAB DONE DIS OVER AN' OVER DIS MONTH.
DEY ARRIVE IN A VAN WIT NO MARKINGS, IN COVERALLS, WIT A LEAD-LINED BOX AN' A PRIEST, AN' DEY IZ GENTLE AN' THOROUGH AN' REAL TIRED, AN' DEY PAY FOR INFORMATION, AN' DEY ASK YOU NO TA HAB TOUCHED IT!

choices.text: TELL DEM DA TRUTH 'BOUT WHETHER ANYBODY TOUCHED IT!
TAKE DEY MONEY AN' DEY QUESTIONS AN' ASK ONE OF YA OWN!

c.text:
YOU PUT A PIECE OF GOD IN A HOLE IN A CHURCHYARD WIT YA OWN HANDS AN' YOU SAY DA ONLY WORDS ANYBODY PRESENT CAN REMEMBER.
DA GRASS COMES BACK INSIDE DA FOUR METRES WHILE YOU IZ STILL STANDIN' DERE, AT DA SPEED GRASS GROWS, ALL OF DA MISSIN' WEEKS AT ONCE, IN 'BOUT A MINUTE.
DA YEW DOES NO COME BACK. NUTTIN' BRINGS BACK A YEW!

d.text:
DERE IZ A MAN IN {region} WHO BUYS DEZE. EVERYBODY KNOWS DERE IZ A MAN IN {region} WHO BUYS DEZE.
HE PAYS WHAT HE SAYS HE WILL PAY, WHICH IZ LIFE-CHANGIN', AN' HE PAYS IT IN A CAR PARK, AN' HE HAB DA BOX OPEN BEFORE YOU HAB COUNTED IT, AN' HE IZ LOOKIN' AT IT DA WAY PEOPLE LOOK AT TINKZ DAT HAB ALREADY DECIDED SOMETINK 'BOUT DEM!

a1.text:
IT IZ IN DA PARTY'S KEEPIN' NOW, AN' IT WILL BE FOR A LONG TIME.
NUTTIN' DIES AROUND IT ANY MORE. DAT STOPS DA MOMENT SOMEBODY DECIDES TA KEEP IT, WHICH IZ DA SINGLE MOST FRIGHTENIN' TINK 'BOUT DA WHOLE BUSINESS: IT WANTED KEEPIN', AN' IT HAB BIN GOT!

a2.text:
IT TAKES REAL EFFORT AN' ONE OF DA OTHERS HAB TA HELP.
IT GOES BACK IN DA CRATER AN' DA CRATER IZ A CRATER AN' DA YEW IZ DEAD AN' DA AFTERNOON IZ AN ORDINARY AFTERNOON, AN' DA PARTY WALKS OUT OF DAT GRAVEYARD WIT NUTTIN', WHICH IZ, ON DIS PARTICULAR OCCASION, AN ACHIEVEMENT.
DA VATICAN TEAM, WHEN DEY COME, IZ TOLD EVERYTINK, AN' DEY IZ SO GRATEFUL DEY CRY!

b1.text:
YOU TELL DEM, AN' DEY TAKE IT SERIOUSLY AN' DEY TAKE BLOOD, AN' DEY GIVE WHOEVER TOUCHED IT A CARD WIT A NUMBER ON IT AN' A DATE FOUR MONTHS OUT.
DA MONEY IZ GOOD. DA CARD IZ BETTER. DA DATE IZ A PROMISE DAT SOMEBODY WILL CHECK, WHICH IN DIS WORLD IZ CLOSE TA LOVE!

b2.text:
"HOW MANY PIECES IZ DERE?"
DA PRIEST ANSWERS, COZ DA COVERALLS WILL NO. HE SAYS A NUMBER. HE SAYS IT IN A WHISPER IN A CHURCHYARD A COUPLE OF HOURS FROM ANYWHERE, AN' IT IZ NO A NUMBER DAT ANY ORGANISATION ON EARTH CAN PLAN AROUND, AN' HE HAB BIN CARRYIN' IT ALONE!

a1_m.text:
IT IZ IN DA PARTY'S KEEPIN' NOW, AN' IT WILL BE FOR A LONG TIME, AN' NUTTIN' DIES AROUND IT ANY MORE.
DAT STOPS BEING A BLESSIN' AT 'BOUT DA {FOURTH DAY|THIRD DAY|END OF DA FIRST WEEK}, WHEN IT BECOMES CLEAR WHAT NUTTIN' MEANS: DA BREAD DOES NO GO STALE, DA WOUND ON {member}'S HAND DOES NO CLOSE, AN' DA MEAT IN DA PACK IZ {EXACTLY|PRECISELY|STILL} AS IT WAZ WHEN IT WAZ BOUGHT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{NUTTIN' DIES. INCLUDIN' WHAT IZ IN DA PACK.|ME HAND HAB NO HEALED. IT HAB NO GOT WORSE EITHER.|DAT IZ A PAUSE.}"
asides.any: {member} {LOOKS AT DA CUT ON DEY HAND|PUTS DA TINK IN A TIN|COUNTS DA DAYS}

choices.text: KEEP IT. LEARN TA LIVE INSIDE IT!
WORK OUT HOW FAR IT REACHES!
TAKE IT BACK TA DA CRYPT.

a1_reach.text:
MEASURED PROPERLY, WIT A CUT HAND AN' A LOAF AN' {A COUPLE OF DAYS|A WEEK|SOME PATIENCE}, IT REACHES 'BOUT {ARM'S LENGTH AN' A BIT|A ROOM|NINE FEET} AN' IT FALLS OFF SHARPLY AT DA EDGE.
WHICH MEANS IT CAN BE WALKED OUT OF, AN' WALKED BACK INTO, AN' USED: PUT A DYING TINK INSIDE IT AN' DA DYING STOPS FOR AS LONG AS IT IZ IN DERE, AN' DOES NO RESUME ANY FASTER FOR DA WAIT!

b2_m.text:
"HOW MANY PIECES IZ DERE?" DA PRIEST ANSWERS, COZ DA COVERALLS WILL NO. HE SAYS A NUMBER. HE SAYS IT {QUIETLY|TA DA FLOOR|DA WAY A MAN SAYS A TINK HE HAB BIN TOLD NO TA}.
DA NUMBER IZ {NINE|ELEVEN|MORE DEN ANYBODY IN DIS CHURCHYARD IZ COMFORTABLE WIT}. DA FIELD TEAM'S LEADER CLOSES DEY EYES WHEN IT IZ SAID, WHICH IZ DA ONLY REACTION ANYBODY GETS OUT OF DEM ALL AFTERNOON!

choices.text: TAKE DA MONEY AN' DA QUESTIONS AN' GO!
ASK WHERE DA OTHER PIECES IZ!
ASK DA PRIEST, ALONE, AFTERWARDS!

b2_where.text:
FOUR OF DEM IZ ACCOUNTED FOR AN' IZ IN {FOUR DIFFERENT COUNTRIES|PLACES DA TEAM WILL NO NAME|CONTAINMENT}. TWO IZ WIT PRIVATE HOLDERS UNDER AGREEMENTS. THREE IZ NO ACCOUNTED FOR AN' ONE OF DOZE THREE WAZ IN DIS CHURCHYARD {A YEAR AGO|BEFORE DA CRATER|UNTIL RECENTLY}.
DAT LAST ONE IZ DA REASON A FIELD TEAM IZ FOUR HOURS AWAY FROM ANYWHERE ON A TUESDAY, AN' DA PARTY NOW KNOWS IT, AN' DA TEAM KNOWS DEY KNOW!

b2_priest.text:
AFTERWARDS, IN DA VESTRY, WIT DA TEAM PACKIN' UP OUTSIDE, HE SAYS DA NUMBER AGAIN AN' DEN SAYS DA OTHER TINK, WHICH IZ DAT HE HAB BIN COUNTIN' A DIFFERENT WAY AN' GETS {A HIGHER NUMBER|MORE|ONE EXTRA}.
HE HAB BIN COUNTIN' DA ONES DAT IZ {NO LONGER PIECES|WHOLE AGAIN|WALKIN'}, AN' HE HAB {TWO|ONE|THREE} ON HIS LIST, AN' ONE OF DEM IZ IN DIS PARISH AN' COMES TA MASS!

b.text:

{TRACK DOWN WHOEVER SCRATCHED DEY NAME ON DA CASE|HUNT DOWN DA ENGINEER|FIND DA GUY WHO BUILT DIS RIG|SEARCH FOR DA SUSPECT}

b2.text:
{DA NAME BELONGS TA AN EX-GUILD TECH WHO GOT KICKED OUT YEARS AGO FOR ILLEGAL TEMPORAL WIRETAPPIN'.|TURNS OUT DA GUY WAZ BLACKLISTED BY DA WIZARD GUILD IN DA EIGHTIES FOR RUNNIN' UNREGISTERED PARTY LINES.}

a1_m.text:
YOU KEEP DEM TALKIN' FOR FORTY MINUTES WHILE DEY RAMBLE 'BOUT HISTORICAL GOSSIP, RATIONIN', AN' AN IMPENDIN' SOMETINK DEY IZ NO WORRIED 'BOUT.
'BOUT HALFWAY THROUGH IT BECOMES CLEAR DEY CAN HEAR DA VESTRY: DEY ASK 'BOUT {DA DRAUGHT|DA BELLS|DA RAIN}, CORRECTLY, IN REAL TIME, AN' DEN DEY ASK WHO ELSE IZ IN DA ROOM WIT YOU, AN' GIVE A NUMBER, AN' DA NUMBER IZ ONE MORE DEN DERE IZ PEOPLE IN DA ROOM!

choices.text: KEEP DEM TALKIN'. IGNORE DA COUNT!
ASK DEM TA DESCRIBE DA FIFTH ONE!
ASK DEM WHAT YEAR IT IZ ON DEY END AN' LET DEM WORK IT OUT!

a1_fifth.text:
DEY DESCRIBE IT {READILY|WITOUT ALARM|DA WAY YOU DESCRIBE FURNITURE}, COZ ON DEY END IT IZ NO UNUSUAL AN' HAB BIN IN DAT VESTRY FOR AS LONG AS DEY LINE HAB BIN WIRED INTO IT.
DA DESCRIPTION TAKES {FOUR SENTENCES|A MINUTE|NO TIME}, AN' IT IZ A DESCRIPTION OF SOMETINK STANDIN' BEHIND DA PARTY, AN' DA PARTY DOES NO TURN ROUND UNTIL DA CALL IZ FINISHED, WHICH IZ DA RIGHT CALL AN' IZ DA HARDEST TINK ANYBODY DOES DAT WEEK!

b1_m.text:
YOU DIAL DA SECOND NUMBER AN' AN OLD MAN ANSWERS ON DA FIRST RING: "SO SOMEONE FINALLY FOUND DA VESTRY RIG."
HE IZ {DELIGHTED|NO SURPRISED|EXTREMELY TIRED}, AN' HE TALKS FOR {TWENTY MINUTES|A WHILE|AS LONG AS ANYBODY LETS HIM}, AN' AT DA END OF IT HE ASKS DA PARTY TA DO ONE TINK, WHICH IZ TA READ HIM DA SERIAL NUMBER OFF DA BACK OF DA HANDSET!

choices.text: READ HIM DA NUMBER.
ASK WHY HE WANTS IT FIRST!
GIVE HIM A WRONG NUMBER AN' SEE WHAT HE SAYS!

b1_why.text:
COZ DA SERIAL IZ DA {ADDRESS|ROUTIN'|KEY}, AN' READIN' IT OUT LOUD ON AN OPEN LINE IZ HOW DA RIG IZ RE-REGISTERED, AN' RE-REGISTERIN' IT MOVES DA FAR END OF DA CALL FROM {WHEREVER IT IZ NOW|1953|WHERE IT HAB BIN} TA WHEREVER HE IZ.
HE EXPLAINS IT PROPERLY WHEN ASKED, WHICH IZ DA WHOLE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN HIM AN' EVERYBODY ELSE WHO HAB EVER WANTED DIS RIG, AN' DEN HE LEAVES IT ENTIRELY UP TA DA PARTY!

b1_lie.text:
A SERIAL NUMBER DAT IZ ONE DIGIT OUT, READ CONFIDENTLY, INTO A LINE DAT HAB BIN WAITIN' {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE|A REAL LONG TIME|DECADES} FOR IT.
HE GOES QUIET. DEN HE LAUGHS, ONCE, AN' SAYS DAT IZ DA FIRST TIME ANYBODY HAB DONE DAT, AN' GIVES DA PARTY {AN ADDRESS|A NAME|SOMEWHERE TA COME}, AN' SAYS DAT IF DEY CAN BE BOTHERED TA LIE TA HIM DEY IZ WORTH TALKIN' TA PROPERLY!

n0.emText:

DEY SEALED IT WIT A DEAD OFFICE'S STAMP, WHICH MEANS WHOEVER DID IT NEEDED AUTHORITY DEY DID NO HAB AN' BORROWED SOME FROM A CORPSE. DAT IZ EXACTLY DA KIND OF TINK DAT GETS A PERSON MADE INTO A SPEAR!
n0.bubba: BUBBA PUTS HIS FACE TA DA BRICK AN' BREATHES IN. "AIR'S WARM. AN' IT IZ COMIN' OUT, NO GOIN' IN. CHI STA' LLÀ DINTO STA' RESPIRANNO, SUGAR."

a.text:
FOUR COURSES OUT AN' DA DRAUGHT BECOMES A ROOM: DRY, FLOORED, AN' LIT BY A WINDOW DAT NO CAN EXIST, COZ YOU IZ UNDER DA LENGTH OF DA ROOM OF KEEP.
DA ROOM IZ AN OFFICE. DERE IZ A DESK, A CHAIR, A FILIN' CABINET AN' A HAT STAND, AN' DA OFFICE CLOSED IN {timeAgo} AN' NOBODY CLEARED IT, AN' DERE IZ WORK ON DA DESK IN DA MIDDLE OF BEING DONE!

choices.text: READ WHAT IZ ON DA DESK.
OPEN DA FILIN' CABINET.
SIT AT DA DESK AN' FINISH DA WORK!

b.text:
DA ORDER WAZ PLACED BY DA VISITOR CENTRE'S OWN TRUSTEES YEARS AN' YEARS AGO, ON DA ADVICE OF A MAN WHO IZ NO A BUILDER AN' WHO SIGNED HIMSELF WIT A JOB TITLE DAT IZ NO A JOB.
HE LIVES IN DA VILLAGE. HE ANSWERS DA DOOR WIT A DRINK IN HIS HAND AT FOUR IN DA AFTERNOON AN' HE SAYS, BEFORE YOU HAB INTRODUCED YOURSELVES: "IZ IT OPEN?"

choices.text: TELL HIM IT IZ NO OPEN, YET!
ASK WHAT IZ IN DERE.

c.text:
YOU PUT A HAND ON DA BRICK AN' YOU TALK TA IT, AN' YOU KEEP TALKIN', AN' {IT TAKES ELEVEN MINUTES|ELEVEN MINUTES TICK BY|DA PLAYBACK LASTS ELEVEN MINUTES|ELEVEN MINUTES OF AUDIO} BEFORE ANYTINK ANSWERS.
WHAT ANSWERS TAPS: FOUR TAPS, EVENLY SPACED, AN' DEN A PAUSE, AN' DEN FOUR MORE, AN' IT IZ ONLY CHECKIN' DAT DA WALL IZ STILL DERE!

d.text:
DA VATICAN TAKE DA REPORT SERIOUSLY ENOUGH TA SEND A COUPLE OF DEM IN A WEEK, WHICH IZ FAST, AN' DEY RE-SEAL IT PROPERLY WIT DEY OWN STAMP, AN' DEY PAY YOU A CONSULTANCY FEE.
DEY ALSO ASK YOU NEVER TA COME BACK TA DIS CASTLE, AN' DA WAY DEY ASK MAKES IT CLEAR DAT DIS IZ FOR YA SAKE, AN' DAT DEY HAB BIN DOING DIS A LONG TIME!

a1.text:
IT IZ A REPORT, HALF-WRITTEN, ON DA SUBJECT OF DIS CASTLE, AN' IT STOPS MID-SENTENCE IN {timeAgo}, AN' DA SENTENCE IT STOPS IN DA MIDDLE OF IZ 'BOUT A DOOR IN DA UNDERCROFT.
DA PEN IZ ON DA BLOTTER. DA INK IN IT IZ WET!

a2.text:
FOUR DRAWERS, AN' DA FOURTH IZ HEAVY: NO FILES, OBJECTS, CATALOGUED, TAGGED, AN' EVERY TAG IZ A PLACE WITHIN A DAY'S WALK OF HERE.
WHOEVER WORKED IN DIS OFFICE SPENT A CAREER TAKIN' TINKZ OUT OF DIS COUNTY AN' PUTTIN' DEM IN A DRAWER, AN' DEN DA OFFICE CLOSED AN' DA DRAWER STAYED SHUT!

a3.text:
YOU SIT DOWN AT A DEAD MAN'S DESK AN' FINISH HIS SENTENCE IN HIS PEN, WHICH IZ DA MOST RECKLESS POLITE TINK ANYBODY HAB EVER DONE IN DIS UNDERCROFT.
DA WINDOW DAT NO CAN EXIST GOES DARK. DA REPORT CLOSES ITSELF. AN' IN DA DRAWER, WHICH WAZ LOCKED, DERE IZ NOW A COPY OF IT, BOUND, WIT YA HANDWRITIN' IN IT AN' A STAMP FROM AN OFFICE DAT CLOSED BEFORE YOU WAZ BORN!

b1.text:
HE SITS DOWN ON HIS OWN DOORSTEP WIT RELIEF AN' TELLS YOU DA WHOLE TINK, WHICH TAKES AN HOUR AN' WHICH HE HAB NO BIN ABLE TA TELL ANYBODY COZ OF WHAT HE SIGNED.
DA SHORT VERSION: HE DID NO BRICK UP A ROOM. HE BRICKED UP AN APPOINTMENT!

b2.text:
"AN OFFICE," HE SAYS. "A WORKIN' OFFICE. AN' A MAN IN IT WHO WAZ REAL POLITE AN' ASKED ME TA COME BACK ON DA THURSDAY, AN' ME HAB NEVER IN ME LIFE BIN SO FRIGHTENED OF A THURSDAY."
HE GIVES YOU DA ORIGINAL ORDER, DA INVOICE, AN' DA NAME OF DA MAN ON DA DESK, AN' DA NAME IZ HIS OWN FATHER'S!

a1_m.text:
IT IZ A REPORT, HALF-WRITTEN, ON DA SUBJECT OF DIS CASTLE, AN' IT STOPS MID-SENTENCE IN {timeAgo}, AN' DA SENTENCE IZ {AN ORDINARY ONE|'BOUT DRAINAGE|NUTTIN' DRAMATIC}.
DA PEN IZ BESIDE IT WIT DA CAP OFF. DA INK IN DA PEN HAB NO DRIED, AN' DA REPORT IZ {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE|A REAL LONG TIME|DECADES} OLD, AN' DERE IZ A SECOND CHAIR AT DA DESK DAT IZ PULLED OUT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{TWO CHAIRS. ONE REPORT.|DAT PEN IZ WET. LOOK AT IT.|SOMEBODY STOOD UP IN DA MIDDLE OF A SENTENCE AN' HAB NO COME BACK.}"
asides.any: {member} {READS DA LAST LINE TWICE|DOES NO SIT DOWN|LOOKS AT DA WINDOW DAT NO CAN EXIST}

choices.text: TAKE DA REPORT AN' GO.
READ WHAT DA SENTENCE WAZ GOING TA SAY!
SIT IN DA SECOND CHAIR.

a1_end.text:

a.text:
YOU LAY OUT SALT, BATTERIES, WIRE, A KNIFE, A TIN OF PEACHES.
A HAND COMES UP DA LADDER: GREY, LONG-FINGERED, ENTIRELY CALM, AN' IT TAKES DA SALT FIRST AN' DA PEACHES LAST, AN' IT PUTS BACK FOUR TINKZ DAT IZ WORTH OVER AN' OVER WHAT YOU OFFERED, COZ DA NAGUKA HAB NEVER ONCE BIN ABLE TA WORK OUT WHAT OUR TINKZ IZ WORTH AN' IZ TERRIFIED OF CHEATIN' ANYBODY!

b.text:
DOWN IZ A LONG WAY AN' DEN IT IZ A ROOM, LIT BLUE, WIT A FLOOR POLISHED BY A REAL LONG TIME, AN' ELEVEN OF DEM STANDIN' WELL BACK WIT DEY HANDS WHERE YOU CAN SEE DEM, WHICH SOMEBODY HAB TAUGHT DEM WE LIKE.
DA ELDEST SPEAKS OUR LANGUAGE LIKE A CAREFUL STUDENT. "YOU CAME DOWN," SHE SAYS. "NOBODY COMES DOWN. IZ YOU LOST, OR IZ YOU RUDE?"
b.bubba: "NEITHER, SIGNO'," SAYS BUBBA, HAT OFF. "WE IZ NOSY. E CHEST'E' PEGGIO." ONE OF DEM LAUGHS. DA REST LOOK AT DA ONE WHO LAUGHED!

ASK WHAT DEY WANT FROM UP DERE!

c.text:

WHAT HAPPENS IZ DAT DA GROUND UNDER DA REEDS IZ NO GROUND, AN' IT HAB BIN LISTENIN', AN' ELEVEN PEOPLE WHO HAB NEVER ONCE CHEATED ANYBODY TAKE AN EXTREMELY DIM VIEW!

YOU IZ. HE GOES DOWN. SOMEBODY ELSE COMES UP: OLDER, PAINTED WHITE AN' BLACK ACROSS DA EYES IN A PATTERN YOU HAB SEEN ON A HARBOUR WALL IN DA NORTH!

b1.text:

d1.text:

d2.text:

b.text:

HE HAB BIN ON DIS GATE ELEVEN YEARS AN' HE CAN NAME DA FOUR BIGGEST FRAGMENTS IN ORBIT BY DEY CATALOGUE NUMBERS!

c.text:
DA WALL ALWAYS WANTS HANDS: SHOT-LOADIN', TRACKIN' CREW, AN' DA ELEVEN-HOUR NIGHT WATCH DAT NOBODY LOCAL WILL TAKE TWICE.
YOU DO A WEEK. ON DA FOURTH NIGHT DA BATTERY FIRES, ONCE, AT SOMETINK AT FORTY THOUSAND FEET, AN' YOU IZ ON DA RAMMER FOR IT, AN' DA SHOCK THROUGH YA BOOTS IZ A TINK YOU WILL BE ABLE TA DESCRIBE FOR DA REST OF YA LIFE!

d.text:
EIGHT HUNDRED METRES OF FACE IN DA DARK WIT FOUR BARRELS ABOVE YOU DAT TRACK ANYTINK MOVIN', WHICH YOU KNEW WHEN YOU STARTED.
YOU GET TA DA EMPLACEMENT. DA CREW IZ ASLEEP, ALL FOUR OF DEM, AN' DEY SHOULD NO BE, AN' DA REASON DEY IZ ASLEEP IZ SITTIN' ON DA BREECH OF DA NUMBER TWO GUN WIT ITS LEGS CROSSED, WAITIN' FOR SOMEBODY TA CLIMB UP!

a1.text:
DA ERRAND IZ TA CARRY A SEALED BOX FROM DA THIRD COURTYARD TA A HOUSE FOUR STREETS OUTSIDE DA WALL, AN' TA DO IT WITOUT DA BOX BEING SEEN, AN' TA COME BACK AN' SAY DAT IT WAZ HEAVY.
IT IZ AN EMPTY BOX, AN' DA ERRAND IZ DA POINT, AN' SOMEBODY FOUR STREETS OUTSIDE DA WALL NOW KNOWS DAT DA CARDINAL'S CLERK HAB FOUR PEOPLE HE CAN USE!

a2.text:
"COZ IT IZ NO CONSECRATED ANY MORE," DA CLERK SAYS. "AN' COZ WHAT IT IZ NOW IZ A ROOM WHERE DA EMPIRE KEEPS DA TINKZ IT HAB TAKEN OFF PEOPLE LIKE YOU."
HE IZ OFFERIN'. A COUPLE OF MINUTES, ONE ROOM, AN' WHATEVER YOU CAN CARRY, IN EXCHANGE FOR A FAVOUR LATER DAT HE WILL NO DESCRIBE!

DA WATCH IZ {A COUPLE OF HOURS IN|HALFWAY THROUGH|WELL ALONG} BEFORE ANYBODY EXPLAINS WHAT DA WATCH IZ FOR, AN' DA EXPLANATION IZ A CARD, LAMINATED, WIT {NINE|ELEVEN} SILHOUETTES ON IT AN' INSTRUCTIONS FOR EACH, AN' NONE OF DA SILHOUETTES IZ AIRCRAFT!

c_copy.text:

DA COPY IZ GOOD ENOUGH. IT IZ ALSO, {A YEAR LATER|EVENTUALLY|IN DUE COURSE}, DA ONLY VERSION OF DAT CARD OUTSIDE DA WALL, AN' DERE IZ {THREE|FOUR} INSTITUTIONS WHO WOULD EACH PAY A SEASON'S MONEY FOR IT AN' ONE DAT WOULD PAY CONSIDERABLY MORE DEN DAT!

DA CLERK HAB BIN {COUNTIN'|KEEPIN' A PRIVATE LIST|NOTIN' DEM} FOR YEARS AN' YEARS, IN A NOTEBOOK, WHICH HE IZ NO SUPPOSED TA DO, AN' DERE IZ {FOUR HUNDRED|A GREAT MANY|MORE DEN ANYBODY WOULD GUESS} ENTRIES IN IT!

a2_put.text:

A SHORT WHILE LATER DA DOOR OPENS AN' DERE IZ NOBODY DERE AN' DERE IZ A REPLY ON DA MAT, AN' DA REPLY ANSWERS A QUESTION YOU HAB NO ASKED ANYBODY OUT LOUD SINCE YOU WAZ A CHILD!
