YOU PULL DA FUSE IN DA SHOP ABOVE AN' DA WHOLE BASEMENT GOES DARK AN' SILENT, AN' IT STAYS SILENT FOR 'BOUT FOUR SECONDS.
DEN DA FOUR BARS START AGAIN, IN DA DARK, OUT OF INSTRUMENTS DAT HAB NO POWER, AN' DA AMP DAT IZ NO CONNECTED TA ANYTINK IZ STILL IN DA RED!

c.text:
SOMEBODY IN DIS PARTY PICKS UP DA BASS DAT IZ LEANIN' BY DA STAIRS, WORKS OUT DA MISSIN' BAR IN 'BOUT A LONG MINUTE, AN' PLAYS DA RESOLUTION OVER DA TOP OF DEM.
DA LOOP BREAKS. ALL FOUR OF DEM STOP MID-NOTE AN' LOOK UP AN' DA SILENCE IZ ENORMOUS, AN' DA DRUMMER IZ SICK ON HIS OWN KIT, AN' DA GUITARIST HAB BIN PLAYIN' FOR A LONG RUN OF HOURS AN' HIS FINGERS IZ IN A STATE DAT WILL BE DISCUSSED BY DOCTORS!

d.text:
ELEVEN HOURS, SITTIN' ON DA STAIRS, AN' AT HOUR NINE IT STOPS BEING FOUR BARS AN' STARTS BEING SOMETINK ELSE: DA ROOM FILLS UP, NO WIT PEOPLE, WIT ATTENTION, AN' BY HOUR ELEVEN DERE IZ REAL OBVIOUSLY A FIFTH MUSICIAN.
AT HOUR ELEVEN AN' A HALF DEY RESOLVE IT THEMSELVES, AN' WHAT WALKS OUT PAST YOU UP DA STAIRS IZ NO ONE OF DA FOUR AN' PAUSES TA THANK YOU FOR STAYIN'!

a1.text:
YOU CARRY A NINETEEN-YEAR-OLD DRUMMER UP A FLIGHT OF STAIRS WHILE HIS HANDS IZ STILL PLAYIN', AN' DEY KEEP PLAYIN' IN DA STREET, AN' DEY STOP 'BOUT A SHORT WHILE AFTER DA COLD AIR HITS HIM.
HE CRIES. HE ALSO, IMMEDIATELY, WANTS TA GO BACK DOWN FOR DA OTHERS, WHICH IZ WHEN YOU FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PERSON HE IZ!

a1_m.text:
YOU CARRY A NINETEEN-YEAR-OLD DRUMMER UP A FLIGHT OF STAIRS WHILE HIS HANDS IZ STILL PLAYIN', AN' DEY KEEP PLAYIN' ON DA PAVEMENT, ON A COAT, ON A LAMPPOST, ON NUTTIN'.
DA BASEMENT BEHIND YOU DOES NO LOSE DA DRUMS. DA DRUMS IZ STILL IN IT, IN TIME, WIT NOBODY AT DA KIT, AN' DA OTHER THREE HAB NO LOOKED UP AN' DA TINK DAT IZ MISSIN' FROM DA MUSIC IZ STILL {DA RESOLVIN' BAR|ONE BAR|DA END}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DA KIT IZ STILL PLAYIN'. LOOK AT DA DOOR.|WE TOOK DA DRUMMER AN' WE DID NO TAKE DA DRUMMIN'.|DAT IZ FOUR BARS WIT A HOLE IN IT AN' DA HOLE IZ DA POINT.}"
asides.any: {member} {HOLDS DA DRUMMER'S HANDS DOWN|GOES BACK TA DA TOP OF DA STAIRS|LISTENS}

choices.text: GET DA OTHER THREE OUT DA SAME WAY!
GO DOWN AN' PLAY DA BAR DAT FINISHES IT!
GET DA DRUMMER'S HANDS TA PLAY DA RESOLVIN' BAR UP HERE!

a1_hands.text:
IT IZ A BAR. IT IZ {FOUR BEATS|ONE BAR|DA SIMPLEST TINK IN DA WORLD} AN' IT HAB TA BE GOT INTO A PAIR OF HANDS DAT IZ ALREADY BUSY, ON A PAVEMENT, IN OSLO, AT WHATEVER HOUR IT HAB GOT TA.
IT TAKES {NINE ATTEMPTS|A LONG TIME|MORE PATIENCE DEN ANYBODY HAB}. ON DA LAST ONE HIS HANDS TAKE IT, AN' PLAY IT, AN' STOP, AN' IN DA BASEMENT THREE INSTRUMENTS STOP WIT DEM AN' DERE IZ A SILENCE DAT DA WHOLE STREET NOTICES!

d_m.text:
DA REST OF DA SHIFT, SITTIN' ON DA STAIRS, AN' AT HOUR NINE IT STOPS BEING FOUR BARS AN' STARTS BEING SOMETINK ELSE.
AT HOUR TEN DERE IZ A FIFTH INSTRUMENT IN IT. DERE IZ FOUR PEOPLE IN DAT BASEMENT AN' DERE HAB BIN FOUR PEOPLE IN IT ALL NIGHT AN' AT HOUR TEN DERE IZ {A FIFTH|ONE MORE|ANOTHER} AN' IT IZ {KEEPIN' TIME|CARRYIN' DA LINE|HOLDIN' DA BAR DAT IZ MISSIN'}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{COUNT DEM AGAIN. FOUR. COUNT DA PARTS. FIVE.|SOMETINK IZ PLAYIN' WIT DEM.|DO NO GO DOWN DERE NOW.}"
asides.any: {member} {STOPS WRITIN'|COUNTS DA PARTS ON DEY FINGERS|GOES REAL STILL ON DA STAIRS}

choices.text: SIT IT OUT TA HOUR ELEVEN!
PICK OUT DA FIFTH PART.
GO DOWN NOW, WHILE IT IZ PLAYIN'!

d_fifth.text:
ISOLATED BY EAR FROM DA TOP OF A STAIRCASE, DA FIFTH PART IZ {DA RESOLVIN' BAR|DA MISSIN' BAR|DA END OF DA PHRASE}, PLAYED ONCE EVERY FOUR BARS, {A BEAT LATE|UNDERNEATH|SO QUIETLY DAT NOBODY IN DA ROOM CAN HEAR IT}.
IT HAB BIN TRYIN' TA FINISH DIS FOR A LONG RUN OF HOURS FROM WHEREVER IT IZ, AN' IT NO CAN BE HEARD OVER FOUR AMPLIFIERS, AN' DA WHOLE OF DA PROBLEM IN DAT BASEMENT IZ DAT NOBODY DOWN DERE CAN HEAR DA TINK DAT IZ TRYIN' TA LET DEM STOP!

p_napoli_camper.title: {DA YARD ON DA HILL|THREE CAMPERS ON BLOCKS|SOMEBODY ELSE'S ENGINE}

n0.text:
A YARD ON DA HILL WIT THREE CAMPERS ON BLOCKS, A DOG ON A CHAIN DAT IZ TOO LONG FOR ANYBODY'S COMFORT, AN' A MAN WHO WELDS.
TWO OF DA THREE IZ BEING CANNIBALISED FOR DA THIRD. DA THIRD HAB A LIMINAL ENGINE IN IT, OUT OF A COACH, AN' HE HAB FITTED IT HIMSELF WIT A MANUAL HE NO CAN READ AN' A DIAGRAM HE DREW FROM MEMORY.
"IT WORKS," HE SAYS. "IT WORKS TWICE OUT OF FOUR."
DA DOG'S CHAIN IZ TOO LONG FOR ANYBODY'S COMFORT AN' DERE IZ A WORN CIRCLE IN DA YARD DAT {STOPS|ENDS|DOES NO GO} FOUR METRES SHORT OF DA NEAREST CAMPER!
n0.emText:
THREE CAMPERS ON BLOCKS IN A YARD ON A HILL, TWO BEING EATEN TA FEED DA THIRD, AN' IN DA THIRD A LIMINAL ENGINE OUT OF A COACH, FITTED BY A MAN WIT A MANUAL HE NO CAN READ.
"IT WORKS TWICE OUT OF FOUR."
BUBBA INVENTED DA ENGINE. BUBBA IZ STANDIN' NEXT TA YOU. BUBBA IZ GOING TA SAY SOMETINK AN' DIS MAN IZ GOING TA HAB DA AFTERNOON OF HIS LIFE OR DA WORST FOUR MINUTES OF IT!
n0.bubba: BUBBA WALKS ROUND DA BACK OF DA CAMPER, OPENS DA HATCH, LOOKS IN, AN' GOES REAL STILL. "AOH. CHI T'HA FATTO STA COSA?" DEN, TA YOU, QUIETLY, DELIGHTED, APPALLED: "SUGAR. HE BUILT IT OUT'A NOTHIN'. IT IZ WRONG IN FOUR PLACES AN' IT WORKS."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.hedonistic: {member} WANTS TA KNOW WHETHER IT CAN DO DA COAST ROAD IN TWENTY MINUTES!
asides.sanguine: {member} HAB BIN FED TWICE ALREADY AN' HAB MET DA DOG!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: LET BUBBA FIX IT.
HELP HIM FIT IT PROPERLY.
BUY DA CAMPER OFF HIM.
TAKE IT FOR A RUN, TWICE OUT OF FOUR!

a.text: IT TAKES FOUR HOURS AN' MOST OF DA GOOD LIGHT!
a.emText:
IT TAKES FOUR HOURS AN' MOST OF DA GOOD LIGHT, AN' BUBBA DOES NO ONCE SAY WHO HE IZ.
HE REWIRES IT, RE-TIMES IT, AN' CORRECTS DA FOUR WRONG PLACES, AN' DA MAN WATCHES EVERY MOVEMENT AN' ASKS DA RIGHT QUESTIONS AN' BUBBA ANSWERS EVERY ONE OF DEM AS THOUGH DA MAN WAZ DA EXPERT. AT DA END OF IT DA ENGINE CATCHES FIRST TURN AN' HOLDS, AN' DA MAN PUTS HIS HANDS OVER HIS FACE.
ON DA WAY OUT, AT DA GATE, BUBBA TURNS ROUND: "SIGNO'. IT IZ CALLED A LIMINAL ENGINE. NUN 'O DICERE A NISCIUNO CA T'AGGIO AIUTATO."
a.bubba: "HE'S GOT IT NOW," SAYS BUBBA, IN DA VEHICLE, LOOKIN' OUT DA WINDOW. "CHILLO MO' 'O SSAPE. DAT IZ FOUR CAMPERS A YEAR HE CAN DO."

b.text:
FOUR HOURS, TWO BURNS, ONE ARGUMENT 'BOUT EARTHIN', AN' A MANUAL TRANSLATED LINE BY LINE BY WHOEVER IN DA PARTY CAN DO IT.
AT DA END OF IT DA ENGINE CATCHES ON DA FIRST TURN INSTEAD OF DA THIRD, AN' HE SITS DOWN ON AN OIL DRUM AN' DOES NO SAY ANYTINK FOR A WHILE, AN' DEN FEEDS ALL OF YOU UNTIL YOU NO CAN MOVE!

c.text:
HE DOES NO WANT TA SELL IT. HE WANTS SOMEBODY TA WANT TA BUY IT, WHICH IZ A DIFFERENT TINK, AN' ONCE YOU HAB WANTED TA BUY IT HE WILL NO TAKE YA MONEY.
WHAT HE TAKES INSTEAD IZ A PROMISE TA COME BACK THROUGH IN DA SPRING, AN' WHAT YOU DRIVE AWAY IN IZ A CAMPER DAT WORKS TWICE OUT OF FOUR AN' IZ DA BEST-LOVED VEHICLE IN {country}!

d.text:
IT WORKS. DEN IT DOES NO.
DA ROAD AHEAD COMPRESSES, CORRECTLY AN' BEAUTIFULLY, FOR 'BOUT A GOOD DRIVE, AN' DEN IT DECOMPRESSES ALL AT ONCE WIT DA CAMPER IN DA MIDDLE OF IT, AN' WHAT DAT DOES TA DA INSIDE OF A VEHICLE IZ NO SOMETINK ANYBODY IN DIS PARTY WANTS TA DESCRIBE TWICE!

c_m.text:
HE DOES NO WANT TA SELL IT. HE WANTS SOMEBODY TA WANT TA BUY IT, WHICH IZ A DIFFERENT TINK, AN' ONCE DAT IZ UNDERSTOOD DA PRICE STOPS BEING DA CONVERSATION.
WHAT DA CONVERSATION IZ INSTEAD IZ {FOUR HOURS|AN AFTERNOON|DA REST OF DA DAY} 'BOUT WHO PUT DA TINK IN DA CAMPER IN DA FIRST PLACE, AN' 'BOUT DA FACT DAT HE HAB NEVER DRIVEN IT AN' DAT DA DOG WILL NO GO WITHIN FOUR METRES OF IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DA DOG HAB MORE SENSE DEN ALL OF US.|HE HAB OWNED IT DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE AN' NEVER DRIVEN IT.|LOOK AT DA CIRCLE IN DA DIRT.}"
asides.any: {member} {WATCHES DA DOG RATHER DEN DA CAMPER|OPENS DA DOOR AN' DOES NO GET IN|ASKS WHO FITTED IT}

choices.text: BUY IT ANYWAY.
FIND OUT WHO FITTED IT.
TAKE DA DOG'S OPINION SERIOUSLY AN' LOOK UNDERNEATH!

c_fit.text:
A WORKSHOP IN {SECONDIGLIANO|DA NORTH OF DA CITY|A YARD A COUPLE OF STREETS OVER} DAT CLOSED IN {timeAgo}, AN' ONE NAME, AN' DA NAME IZ {STILL ALIVE|IN A HOME|NO HARD TA FIND}.
WHAT HE SAYS, WHEN HE IZ FOUND, IZ DAT HE FITTED {NINE|ELEVEN} OF DEM AN' DAT DIS IZ DA ONLY ONE STILL ON BLOCKS AN' DAT HE HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR SOMEBODY TA COME AN' ASK 'BOUT IT FOR {TWENTY YEARS|TWO DECADES|MOST OF HIS RETIREMENT}!

c_dog.text:
A DOG DAT WILL NO CROSS A LINE IN A YARD IZ A DOG TELLIN' YOU WHERE DA LINE IZ, AN' DA LINE, ONCE IT IZ CHALKED OUT, IZ A {CIRCLE|RING|ARC} CENTRED ON DA CAMPER'S REAR AXLE.
UNDERNEATH DA REAR AXLE, BOLTED UP INSIDE DA CHASSIS RAIL WHERE NOBODY LOOKS, DERE IZ {A SECOND UNIT|SOMETINK ELSE|DA ACTUAL TINK}, AN' IT IZ NO DA ONE DA OLD MAN IZ TRYIN' TA SELL, AN' HE DOES NO KNOW IT IZ DERE!

d_m.text:
IT WORKS. DEN IT DOES NO. DA ROAD AHEAD COMPRESSES, CORRECTLY AN' BEAUTIFULLY, FOR 'BOUT A HANDFUL OF SECONDS.
IN DA ELEVENTH SECOND DERE IZ {SOMETINK|A FIGURE|SOMEBODY} STANDIN' IN DA COMPRESSED PART OF DA ROAD, WHICH IZ A STRETCH OF ROAD DAT IZ NO ANYWHERE, AN' IT IZ {FACIN' DA CAMPER|WAITIN'|NO MOVIN'}, AN' DA COMPRESSION IZ STILL RUNNIN'!

choices.text: LIFT OFF. GET OUT OF IT.
HOLD IT. GO PAST WHATEVER DAT IZ!
STOP DA CAMPER INSIDE DA COMPRESSION!

d_past.text:
ELEVEN SECONDS BECOMES {FOURTEEN|A GOOD DEAL MORE|AS LONG AS ANYBODY CAN STAND IT}, AN' DA TINK STANDIN' IN DA ROAD IZ PASSED AT A DISTANCE OF {FOUR METRES|LESS DEN DAT|AN ARM'S LENGTH} AN' DOES NO MOVE AN' IZ NO HIT.
DA CAMPER COMES OUT OF IT {SIDEWAYS|BADLY|ON DA WRONG CARRIAGEWAY} AN' STOPS. EVERYBODY IZ FINE. NOBODY IN DA VEHICLE CAN AGREE AFTERWARDS ON HOW MANY PEOPLE WAZ STANDIN' IN DA ROAD, AN' DA ANSWERS RANGE FROM ONE TA FOUR!

d_stop.text:
STOPPIN' A VEHICLE INSIDE A HANDFUL OF SECONDS OF COMPRESSED ROAD, WITOUT LOCKIN' IT UP, IZ {A DRIVIN' JOB|A MATTER OF TOUCH|NO SOMETINK MOST PEOPLE COULD DO}, AN' IT IZ DONE.
DA ROAD STAYS COMPRESSED FOR AS LONG AS DA HANDBRAKE IZ ON. DA PARTY GETS OUT AN' WALKS {FOUR METRES|A SHORT WAY|UP DA ROAD} ON A SURFACE DAT IZ NO ANYWHERE, AN' TALKS TA WHAT IZ STANDIN' DERE, AN' GETS BACK IN, AN' LETS IT GO!

p_taranto_launch.title: {VOLUNTEERS FREE OF CHARGE|DA ARMOURED ROCKET|NINE OUT OF TEN}

n0.text:
DA SPACEPORT TAKES VOLUNTEERS FREE OF CHARGE, WHICH IZ ADVERTISED ON DA RADIO, AN' DA RADIO DOES NO MENTION DA REST OF IT.
DA ROCKET ON PAD FOUR IZ ARMOURED. NOBODY ARMOURS A ROCKET AGAINST ANYTINK DAT IZ IN DA SKY OVER TARANTO.
DA RECRUITIN' OFFICE IZ A PORTAKABIN WIT A QUEUE OUTSIDE IT, AN' DA QUEUE IZ MOSTLY YOUNG, AN' DA FORM IZ ONE PAGE AN' DOES NO ASK FOR NEXT OF KIN, WHICH IZ DA SINGLE MOST ALARMIN' FACT 'BOUT DA ENTIRE OPERATION.
DA FORM HAB A NEXT-OF-KIN BOX AN' DA BOX IZ {DA LARGEST ON DA PAGE|A THIRD OF DA SHEET|BIGGER DEN DA MEDICAL SECTION}!
n0.emText:
A SPACEPORT DAT TAKES VOLUNTEERS FREE OF CHARGE, AN ARMOURED ROCKET ON PAD FOUR, AN' A ONE-PAGE FORM DAT DOES NO ASK FOR NEXT OF KIN.
DA QUEUE IZ MOSTLY NINETEEN. DEY ARMOUR IT COZ OF WHAT IZ IN ORBIT, AN' WHAT IZ IN ORBIT IZ A BODY, AN' DA BODY IZ DAT OF A GOD WHO WAZ KILLED WIT A SPEAR MADE OUT OF YA LIFE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA READS DA FORM TOP TA BOTTOM. "NO NEXT OF KIN. AOH. SUGAR. CHEST'E' 'NA LISTA, NUN E' 'NU MODULO."

asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: VOLUNTEER.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TA DA LAST NINE!
ASK WHY IT IZ ARMOURED.
TALK DA QUEUE OUT OF IT.

a.text:
DA MEDICAL IZ FOUR MINUTES. DA TRAININ' IZ A DAY AN' A HALF. DA SUIT FITS SOMEBODY ELSE.
YOU GO UP ON PAD FOUR IN AN ARMOURED ROCKET WIT A CROWD OF STRANGERS, AN' WHAT HAPPENS AT FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES IZ DAT EVERYBODY ON BOARD SEES DA SAME TINK OUT OF DA SAME WINDOW AT DA SAME TIME AN' NOBODY AFTERWARDS DESCRIBES IT DA SAME WAY.
NINE WENT UP. NINE COME DOWN, WHICH IZ NO DA USUAL FIGURE, AN' DA OPERATION NOTES DAT IN A FILE!

b.text:
NINE WENT UP IN DA SPRING. NINE CAME DOWN.
DAT IZ DA OFFICIAL RECORD AN' IT IZ ACCURATE AN' IT IZ ALSO DA REASON DA RECRUITIN' OFFICER DRINKS: NINE CAME DOWN, AN' ONLY FOUR OF DEM WAZ DA ONES WHO WENT UP, AN' DA OTHER FIVE HAB BIN GIVEN PAPERS AN' JOBS AN' FLATS AN' IZ LIVIN' PERFECTLY ORDINARY LIVES IN DIS TOWN UNDER NAMES DAT WAZ ASSIGNED TA DEM!

c.text:
"DEBRIS," SAYS DA ENGINEER, AN' DEN LOOKS AT YOU PROPERLY AN' DECIDES YOU CAN TAKE IT. "PROPER DEBRIS. IT IZ IN A DECAYIN' ORBIT AN' IT IZ FOUR HUNDRED KILOMETRES OF IT AN' SOME OF IT IZ STILL WARM."
DEY HAB PLATES AN' PHOTOGRAPHS AN' A CHART OF DA ORBIT, AN' DA CHART IZ DA MOST VALUABLE PIECE OF PAPER IN DIS PROVINCE!

d.text:
YOU STAND OUTSIDE A PORTAKABIN AN' TELL FORTY YOUNG PEOPLE DA TRUTH 'BOUT DA FORM AN' DA NEXT OF KIN AN' DA NINE.
ELEVEN OF DEM LEAVE. DA REST STAY, COZ DEY HAB NUTTIN' ELSE, AN' ONE OF DEM TELLS YOU SO, AT LENGTH, AN' SHE IZ RIGHT AN' YOU HAB NO ANSWER FOR HER.
DA ELEVEN WHO LEFT BUY YOU A DRINK EACH, OVER A COUPLE OF YEARS, WHENEVER DEY SEE YOU!

b_m.text:
NINE WENT UP IN DA SPRING. NINE CAME DOWN. DAT IZ DA OFFICIAL RECORD AN' IT IZ ACCURATE AN' IT IZ NO DA ANSWER TA DA QUESTION DAT WAZ ASKED.
DA QUESTION DAT WAZ ASKED IZ HOW MANY OF DA NINE WHO CAME DOWN IZ {STILL AT DA SPACEPORT|WORKIN'|CONTACTABLE}, AN' DA ANSWER IZ {FOUR|THREE}, AN' DA OTHER FIVE IZ ON A LIST DAT A CLERK IN DA PERSONNEL OFFICE WILL READ OUT BUT NO PHOTOCOPY!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{NINE UP, NINE DOWN, FIVE GONE.|READ DA LIST AGAIN. SLOWLY.|DA RECORD IZ TRUE AN' IT IZ A LIE.}"
asides.any: {member} {WRITES DA FIVE NAMES ON A HAND|ASKS WHERE DA FOUR IZ NOW|LISTENS TWICE}

choices.text: TAKE DA RECORD AS READ AN' GO!
FIND ONE OF DA FOUR WHO IZ STILL HERE!
GET DA FIVE NAMES OFF DA CLERK PROPERLY!

b_four.text:
SHE WORKS IN {STORES|DA CANTEEN|GROUND HANDLIN'} NOW AN' SHE HAB NO BIN UP SINCE DA SPRING AN' IZ NO GOING TA BE, AN' SHE TALKS FOR {AN HOUR|A LONG TIME|AS LONG AS DA SHIFT BREAK ALLOWS}.
WHAT SHE SAYS IZ DAT NINE WENT UP AN' NINE CAME DOWN AN' DAT SHE COUNTED DEM HERSELF ON DA PAD, TWICE, AN' DAT BOTH TIMES SHE GOT {TEN|A DIFFERENT NUMBER|NINE AN' DEN TEN}, AN' DAT SHE HAB STOPPED COUNTIN' TINKZ!

b_five.text:
DA CLERK READS DEM OUT A THIRD TIME AN' DEN, COZ OF HOW DA QUESTION IZ PUT, WRITES DEM DOWN AN' HANDS DA PAPER OVER AN' ASKS NO TA BE NAMED.
FOUR OF DA FIVE IZ {DEAD|RECORDED AS DECEASED|LISTED WIT DATES}, AT HOME, OF ORDINARY TINKZ, WITHIN {ELEVEN WEEKS|MOST OF A SEASON|A SEASON} OF COMIN' DOWN. DA FIFTH HAB NO DATE AGAINST DEM AN' NO ADDRESS AN' IZ MARKED, IN A COLUMN DA CLERK NO CAN EXPLAIN, AS {STILL ON DA MANIFEST|ABOARD|NO RETURNED}!

p_omega_lift.title: {DA GOODS LIFT|FLOOR NINE HUNDRED AN' SOMETINK|NEUTRAL GROUND}

n0.text:
DA GOODS LIFT ON DA NORTH SIDE OF DA OMEGA TOWER IZ UNMANNED, UNLOCKED AN' ENORMOUS, AN' DA PANEL HAB NO NUMBERS ON IT: IT HAB A SLOT FOR A CARD AN' A HAND-WRITTEN LIST TAPED BESIDE IT OF WHAT IZ ON WHICH FLOOR, IN FOUR LANGUAGES, NONE OF DEM OFFICIAL.
SOMEBODY HAB LEFT A CARD IN DA SLOT.
DA LIST STOPS AT FLOOR 411. DA TOWER HAB CONSIDERABLY MORE FLOORS DEN DAT.
DA CARD IN DA PANEL IZ {NO A TOWER CARD|DA WRONG COLOUR|SOMEBODY'S OWN} AN' IT HAB BIN LEFT IN DA SLOT ON PURPOSE!
n0.emText:
AN UNMANNED GOODS LIFT ON DA NORTH SIDE OF DA OMEGA TOWER, A CARD LEFT IN DA SLOT, AN' A HAND-WRITTEN LIST OF FLOORS TAPED UP BESIDE IT DAT STOPS AT 411 IN A BUILDIN' WIT FAR MORE DEN 411 FLOORS.
DEY SCRAPE DA OUTSIDE OF DIS TOWER FOR FANTABLACK. IT IZ DA ONLY OBJECT ON EARTH DAT DA LOOP BUBBLES WILL NO TOUCH. AN' SOMEBODY HAB LEFT A CARD IN DA SLOT, WHICH MEANS SOMEBODY WANTS SOMEBODY TA GO UP!
n0.bubba: BUBBA GETS IN AN' HOLDS DA DOOR. "WELL, SOMEBODY LEFT IT. SARRÀ 'NU INVITO. OR A TRAP. SAME TINK IN A LIFT."

asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: RIDE IT TA 411.
RIDE IT PAST 411.
WAIT FOR WHOEVER LEFT DA CARD!
TAKE DA CARD AN' GO.

a.text:
FLOOR 411 IZ A MARKET, AN' IT IZ NEUTRAL GROUND: EMPIRE, COLLECTIVE, GUILD, HORDE AN' FOUR TINKZ NOBODY HAB A NAME FOR, ALL TRADIN', ALL ARMED, ALL EXTREMELY POLITE.
DA RULE OF DA FLOOR IZ WRITTEN ON DA WALL IN FOUR LANGUAGES: NUTTIN' STARTS HERE!

choices.text: TRADE.
ASK 'BOUT DA FLOORS ABOVE 411!

b.text:
ABOVE 411 DA LIFT STOPS ANNOUNCIN' FLOORS, AN' DA LIGHT THROUGH DA SHAFT GRILLES GOES FROM DAYLIGHT TA SOMETINK ELSE, AN' DA RIDE TAKES A GOOD WHILE LONGER DEN DA SHAFT IZ TALL.
WHEN DA DOORS OPEN IT IZ ON A CORRIDOR WIT A CARPET AN' A SMELL OF {smell} AN' A REAL LONG WAY OF DOORS, AN' DA DOORS HAB NAMES ON DEM RATHER DEN NUMBERS!

c.text:
SHE COMES BACK FOR IT AT FOUR: A SCRAPER, IN A HARNESS, WIT A TIN OF FANTABLACK ON HER BELT WORTH MORE DEN DA BLOCK SHE GREW UP IN.
"YOU NO TAKE IT," SHE SAYS, AN' DAT IZ DA ENTIRE TEST, AN' YOU HAB PASSED IT, AN' SHE TAKES YOU UP ON DA OUTSIDE OF DA TOWER RATHER DEN DA INSIDE!

d.text:
A TOWER CARD IZ WORTH 'BOUT FOUR MONTHS' WAGES TA DA RIGHT PERSON AN' YOU HAB ONE IN YA POCKET BY TEATIME.
WHAT YOU ALSO HAB IZ A SCRAPER STUCK ON DA NORTH FACE AT FOUR O'CLOCK WIT NO WAY DOWN, AN' IT TAKES HER ELEVEN HOURS TA GET IN, AN' SHE DOES, AN' SHE REMEMBERS!

a1.text:
EVERYTINK IZ FOR SALE ON 411 AN' MOST OF IT IZ FOR SALE LEGALLY, WHICH IZ DA STRANGE PART.
WHAT YOU COME AWAY WIT IZ DA TINK DA SELLER WOULD NO EXPLAIN, SOLD CHEAP, BY SOMEBODY WHO WANTED IT OUT OF DEY STALL BEFORE DA EMPIRE'S MAN CAME ROUND AGAIN!

a2.text:
FOUR PEOPLE REFUSE TA ANSWER. DA FIFTH IZ A COLLECTIVE BUYER FOUR DRINKS IN WHO SAYS: "ZERO 412. DERE IZ 411 AN' DEN DERE IZ WHERE DA TOWER IZ ACTUALLY FROM."
HE WILL DRAW YOU DA DIAGRAM FOR MONEY. IT IZ DA SORT OF DIAGRAM DAT GETS PEOPLE PUBLICATION ORDERS!

a1_m.text:
EVERYTINK IZ FOR SALE ON 411 AN' MOST OF IT IZ FOR SALE LEGALLY, WHICH IZ DA STRANGE PART, AN' DA TRADIN' TAKES {FOUR HOURS|DA WHOLE AFTERNOON|AS LONG AS ANYBODY HAB COIN FOR}.
DA LAST STALL IN DA ROW IZ BUYIN', AN' WHAT IT IZ BUYIN' IZ {TIME ON DA LIFT|CARD USE|RIDES}, AN' IT IZ PAYIN' WELL, AN' DA QUEUE FOR IT IZ {FOUR DEEP|LONG|DA LONGEST ON DA FLOOR}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY IZ BUYIN' LIFT RIDES. ASK YOURSELF WHY.|NOBODY PAYS FOR A RIDE DEY CAN TAKE THEMSELVES.|DAT QUEUE IZ PEOPLE SELLIN' DEY OWN ACCESS.}"
asides.any: {member} {JOINS DA QUEUE TA LISTEN|COUNTS DA QUEUE|ASKS DA STALL WHAT IT PAYS}

choices.text: TRADE AT DA ORDINARY STALLS AN' GO!
SELL DEM A RIDE.
WORK OUT WHAT A BOUGHT RIDE IZ FOR!

a1_sell.text:
A RIDE SOLD IZ {A CARD HANDED OVER|A SIGNATURE|FOUR MINUTES OF SOMEBODY ELSE BEING YOU} AN' IT PAYS {FOUR MONTHS' WAGES|EXTREMELY WELL|MORE DEN DA WHOLE AFTERNOON'S TRADIN'}.
DA LIFT GOES UP WITOUT DA PARTY IN IT AN' COMES BACK {ELEVEN MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|SOME TIME} LATER, EMPTY, AN' DA CARD IZ RETURNED, AN' IT IZ WARM, AN' DA NUMBER ON IT HAB CHANGED BY ONE!

a1_why.text:
EVERY CARD HAB A COUNT ON IT AN' DA COUNT ONLY GOES UP, AN' DA TOWER {READS|CHARGES|WEIGHS} DA COUNT RATHER DEN DA PERSON, AN' ABOVE 411 DA COUNT IZ DA ONLY TINK DAT GETS CHECKED.
WHICH MEANS A BOUGHT RIDE IZ SOMEBODY BUYIN' A NUMBER, AN' SOMEBODY WIT A HIGH ENOUGH NUMBER CAN GO {AS HIGH AS DEY LIKE|PAST DA FLOORS DAT IZ NO ANNOUNCED|ALL DA WAY}, AN' DA STALL HAB BIN BUYIN' FOR {YEARS|A LONG TIME|AS LONG AS DA FLOOR HAB BIN NEUTRAL}!

p_milano_note.title: {DA STRIP IN DA NOTE|COUNTIN' WITOUT LOOKIN'|DA MAN WHO IZ NO A MAN ANY MORE}

n0.text:
A MAN ON A FOLDIN' STOOL OUTSIDE DA EXCHANGE IZ COUNTIN' BANKNOTES WITOUT LOOKIN' AT DEM, WHICH IZ A BANK TELLER'S TRICK, EXCEPT DAT HE IZ LISTENIN'.
HE HOLDS EACH NOTE BY DA CORNER, NEAR HIS EAR, AN' 'BOUT ONE IN FORTY HE PUTS IN A SEPARATE TIN.
"DA STRIP SINGS," HE SAYS. "YOU WOULD HEAR IT TOO IF YOU WOULD HANDLED AS MANY AS ME. DEY PAY ME BY DA HOUR TA FIND DA ONES DAT SING."
HE IZ COUNTIN' WITOUT LOOKIN' AN' HIS LIPS IZ {MOVIN'|NO MOVIN'|COUNTIN' SOMETINK ELSE}!
n0.emText:
A MAN OUTSIDE DA EXCHANGE HOLDIN' BANKNOTES TA HIS EAR, ONE AT A TIME, PUTTIN' 'BOUT ONE IN FORTY IN A SEPARATE TIN.
"DA STRIP SINGS."
DA SECURITY STRIP IN A EURO NOTE IZ DA ARCANE PART; DA NAME ON IT IZ WHAT DEIFIED MARIO DRAGHI. HE HAB BIN GIVEN A JOB BY SOMEBODY WHO KNOWS EXACTLY WHAT ONE NOTE IN FORTY IZ, AN' HE DOES IT ON A FOLDIN' STOOL IN DA STREET FOR AN HOURLY RATE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA HOLDS A NOTE TA HIS OWN EAR FOR A WHILE AN' SHRUGS. "NUN SENTO NIENTE. BUT DEN ME IZ RICH, SUGAR, SO MAYBE DEY NO SING TA ME NO MORE."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}

asides.artistic: {member} LISTENS TA ONE OF DA TIN ONES FOR A LONG TIME AN' DEN HUMS FOUR NOTES, CORRECTLY!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: LISTEN TA ONE FROM DA TIN!
ASK WHO PAYS HIM.
BUY DA TIN.
TAKE DA TIN.

a.text:
YOU HOLD A BANKNOTE TA YA EAR ON A STREET IN MILANO AN' IT IZ SINGIN': FOUR NOTES, A REST, FOUR NOTES, IN A WOMAN'S VOICE, FROM INSIDE DA STRIP.
IT IZ NO A RECORDIN'. IT RESPONDS WHEN YOU MOVE IT. AN' WHEN YOU SAY SOMETINK TA IT, OUT LOUD, IN DA STREET, FEELIN' LIKE AN IDIOT, IT STOPS SINGIN' AN' WAITS!

choices.text: SAY SOMETINK TA IT.
GIVE IT BACK.

b.text:
"DA OTHER BANK," HE SAYS. "DEY COME FRIDAYS."
ON FRIDAY A CAR COMES AN' A WOMAN TAKES DA TIN AN' LEAVES AN ENVELOPE AN' DOES NO COUNT ANYTINK, AN' SHE HAB BIN DOING DIS EVERY FRIDAY FOR ELEVEN YEARS, AN' SHE IZ DA ONLY PERSON IN DA COUNTRY WHO KNOWS HOW MANY SINGIN' NOTES DERE IZ!

c.text:
HE NAMES A PRICE AN' IT IZ MORE DEN ONCE FACE VALUE AN' HE APOLOGISES FOR IT, AN' IT IZ DA BARGAIN OF DA DECADE.
WHAT IZ IN DA TIN IZ ELEVEN NOTES, ALL OF DEM SINGIN', ALL OF DEM DIFFERENT, AN' ONE OF DEM IZ NO SINGIN' IN A WOMAN'S VOICE!

d.text:
IT IZ A TIN ON A FOLDIN' STOOL HELD BY A MAN OF 'BOUT SEVENTY.
YOU HAB IT AN' YOU IZ ROUND DA CORNER IN A HANDFUL OF SECONDS. EVERY NOTE IN IT GOES QUIET DA MOMENT IT LEAVES HIS HANDS AN' NONE OF DEM EVER SINGS AGAIN, FOR ANYBODY, AN' ON FRIDAY A WOMAN GETS OUT OF A CAR AN' FINDS AN OLD MAN ON A STOOL WIT NUTTIN' TA GIVE HER!

a1.text:
YOU SAY YA NAME TA A BANKNOTE. DA BANKNOTE SAYS IT BACK, IN DA SAME VOICE, AN' DEN SAYS FOUR MORE WORDS WHICH IZ NO IN ANY OF DA LANGUAGES PRINTED ON IT.
DA MAN ON DA STOOL WRITES DA FOUR WORDS DOWN. HE HAB PAGE AFTER PAGE OF DEM. HE HAB NEVER ONCE BIN ABLE TA FIND ANYBODY WHO COULD GET A NOTE TA ANSWER!

a2.text:
YOU GIVE IT BACK AN' HE PUTS IT IN DA TIN AN' THANKS YOU FOR HANDLIN' IT PROPERLY, AN' DEN GIVES YOU ONE OF DA ORDINARY ONES OFF DA TOP OF DA STACK, WHICH HE SAYS IZ DA ONLY PAYMENT HE IZ ALLOWED TA MAKE.
IT IZ AN ORDINARY NOTE. IT STAYS ORDINARY FOR A COUPLE OF DAYS!

a2_m.text:
YOU GIVE IT BACK AN' HE PUTS IT IN DA TIN AN' THANKS YOU FOR HANDLIN' IT PROPERLY, AN' DEN GIVES YOU ONE OF YA OWN, OFF DA TOP OF DA STACK, WITOUT EXPLAININ' WHY.
IT IZ AN ORDINARY NOTE. IT IZ {NO SINGIN'|SILENT|QUIET}. HE SAYS IT WILL START IN {FOUR DAYS|A WEEK|ITS OWN TIME}, AN' DAT WHEN IT DOES DA PARTY SHOULD NO HOLD IT TA ANYBODY'S EAR EXCEPT DEY OWN!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{HE HAB JUST HANDED US A WAITIN' PROBLEM.|FOUR DAYS. MARK DA CALENDAR.|DO NO PUT DAT IN DA COMMON PURSE.}"
asides.any: {member} {FOLDS IT INTO A SEPARATE POCKET|WRITES DA SERIAL DOWN|ASKS WHAT HAPPENS ON DA FOURTH DAY}

choices.text: TAKE IT AN' WAIT DA FOUR DAYS!
ASK WHAT HAPPENS IF SOMEBODY ELSE HEARS IT!
SPEND IT. TODAY. ON SOMETINK ORDINARY!

a2_else.text:
WHAT HAPPENS IZ DAT IT STARTS SINGIN' TA DEM INSTEAD, FROM WHEREVER IT IZ, AN' DAT IT IZ {REAL PERSUASIVE|NO UNKIND|EXTREMELY GOOD AT IT}, AN' DAT DIS IZ HOW DA TIN GOT MOST OF ITS CONTENTS.
HE HAB BIN TAKIN' DEM OUT OF CIRCULATION SINCE {1979|A LONG TIME AGO|BEFORE DA EURO}, ONE AT A TIME, OFF A FOLDIN' STOOL OUTSIDE AN EXCHANGE, AN' NOBODY PAYS HIM AN' NOBODY EVER HAB AN' DA BANK DAT COMES ON FRIDAYS IZ {NO A BANK|SOMETINK ELSE|DA OTHER ONE}!

a2_spend.text:
A NOTE SPENT ON {A COFFEE|BREAD|SOMETINK ORDINARY} IN A BAR FOUR STREETS FROM DA EXCHANGE, IN DA ORDINARY WAY, OVER A COUNTER.
IT IZ IN DA TILL FOR {FOUR DAYS|A WEEK|NO LONG}. DEN IT IZ IN SOMEBODY'S WAGES, AN' DEN IT IZ IN A SHOP IN ANOTHER QUARTER, AN' DA PARTY STOPS BEING ABLE TA FOLLOW IT AN' DOES NO STOP THINKIN' 'BOUT IT, AN' DERE IZ A MAN ON A FOLDIN' STOOL WHO WILL HAB TA FIND IT AGAIN!

p_kola_shaft.title: {A GOOD DRIVE DOWN|DA CAP IZ WELDED|WHAT CAME UP IN 1970}

n0.text:
DA BOREHOLE IZ CAPPED WIT A STEEL PLATE AN' DA PLATE IZ WELDED, NO BOLTED, AN' DA WELDS HAB BIN REDONE AT LEAST FOUR TIMES BY DIFFERENT HANDS OVER A LIFETIME OF WORK.
DA SITE AROUND IT IZ DERELICT: CRANES, A CANTEEN WIT DA TABLES STILL OUT, AN' A HUT WIT A LIGHT ON IN IT.
IN DA HUT DERE IZ A MAN IN HIS SIXTIES ON A FOLDIN' CHAIR WIT A THERMOS AN' A SHOTGUN ACROSS HIS KNEES, AN' HE IZ FACIN' DA CAP.
DERE IZ FOUR WELDS AN' DEY IZ DATED, AN' DA GAPS IZ {TWENTY YEARS|DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE|GETTIN' SHORTER}!
n0.emText:
A WELDED CAP OVER DA DEEPEST HOLE ANYBODY HAB DRILLED, REDONE MORE DEN ONCE IN A LIFETIME OF WORK BY DIFFERENT HANDS, AN' A MAN IN A HUT WIT A THERMOS AN' A SHOTGUN WHO IZ FACIN' DA CAP RATHER DEN DA ROAD.
AN HOUR ON DA ROAD DOWN. DEY STOPPED COZ OF DA TEMPERATURE, WHICH IZ DA OFFICIAL REASON, AN' COZ OF WHAT DA MICROPHONES PICKED UP, WHICH IZ NO!
n0.bubba: BUBBA LOOKS AT DA WELDS AN' DEN AT DA MAN IN DA HUT. "FOUR TIMES. SOMEBODY KEEPS COMIN' BACK TA WELD IT AGAIN. CHI 'O SSAPE PECCHE'."

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}

asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}

choices.text: TALK TA DA MAN IN DA HUT.
PUT YA EAR TA DA CAP.
CUT DA CAP.
SEARCH DA CANTEEN AN' DA OFFICES!

a.text:
"ME FATHER DID DA SECOND WELD," HE SAYS. "ME DID DA FOURTH. DERE WILL BE A FIFTH AN' IT WILL NO BE ME."
HE HAB SAT HERE ON AN' OFF FOR DA BETTER PART OF A DECADE. HE DOES NO BELIEVE IN ANYTINK. HE IZ REAL CLEAR 'BOUT DAT, FOUR SEPARATE TIMES, AN' DEN HE TELLS YOU WHAT HE HEARS THROUGH DA PLATE WHEN DA SITE IZ QUIET. IT IZ A SCHEDULE!

choices.text: SIT DA NIGHT WIT HIM.
ASK WHAT DA SCHEDULE IZ.

b.text:
DA STEEL IZ WARM AN' IT CARRIES SOUND DA WAY A RAIL CARRIES SOUND.
WHAT IZ COMIN' UP TWELVE KILOMETRES OF BOREHOLE IZ REGULAR, AN' IT IZ NO MACHINERY, AN' 'BOUT EVERY ELEVEN SECONDS IT STOPS, AN' IN DA STOP DERE IZ SOMETINK DAT A HUMAN EAR INSISTS ON HEARIN' AS A QUESTION!

c.text:
IT TAKES TWO HOURS WIT EVERYTINK DA PARTY HAB AN' DA MAN IN DA HUT DOES NO STOP YOU, WHICH IZ DA MOST FRIGHTENIN' TINK 'BOUT DA WHOLE AFTERNOON: HE WATCHES, AN' HE DRINKS HIS TEA, AN' WHEN DA PLATE COMES FREE HE STANDS UP AN' PUTS HIS COAT ON.
WHAT COMES OUT OF AN HOUR ON DA ROAD OF HOLE IZ A PRESSURE, AN' DEN A SMELL, AN' DEN A SOUND LIKE A ROOM DA SIZE OF A COUNTRY!

d.text:
DA OFFICES HAB MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE OF LOGS IN RUSSIAN IN FILIN' CABINETS NOBODY HAB OPENED SINCE DA UNION CAME APART, AN' DA CANTEEN HAB DA TABLES LAID.
IN DA DRILLIN' LOG FOR 1970 DERE IZ FOUR PAGES TORN OUT AN' ONE PAGE PUT BACK IN A DIFFERENT HAND, AN' IT IZ DA INTERESTIN' PAGE, AN' IT IZ A TRANSCRIPT OF DA DOWNHOLE MICROPHONE!

a1.text:
ELEVEN HOURS IN A HUT WIT A MAN, A THERMOS AN' A SHOTGUN, AN' AT 'BOUT FOUR IN DA MORNIN' DA PLATE MAKES A SOUND AN' HE STANDS UP AN' POINTS DA GUN AT IT AN' NEITHER OF YOU SAYS ANYTINK FOR ELEVEN MINUTES.
NO HAPPEN. IT HAB NO HAPPENED FOR MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE. HE APOLOGISES FOR WASTIN' YA NIGHT, AN' GIVES YOU DA FOURTH WELD'S RODS, AN' ASKS WHETHER ONE OF YOU WOULD BE WILLIN' TA BE DA FIFTH!

a2.text:
"ELEVEN SECONDS," HE SAYS. "DEN A PAUSE. DEN ELEVEN AGAIN. AN' EVERY NINTH PAUSE IZ LONGER, AN' ON DA LONGER ONE, IF YOU IZ TOUCHIN' DA PLATE, YOU WILL FEEL IT WANT SOMETINK."
HE HAB TIMED IT FOR ELEVEN YEARS AN' WRITTEN IT ALL DOWN IN A SCHOOL EXERCISE BOOK, AN' HE GIVES YOU DA BOOK, COZ HE IZ SIXTY-EIGHT AN' HE IZ TIRED AN' SOMEBODY ELSE SHOULD HAB IT NOW!

a2_m.text:
"ELEVEN SECONDS," HE SAYS. "DEN A PAUSE. DEN ELEVEN AGAIN. AN' EVERY NINTH PAUSE IZ LONGER, AN' ON DA LONG ONES YOU DO NO PUT YA EAR TA DA PLATE."
HE HAB DA SCHEDULE WRITTEN ON DA INSIDE OF DA HUT DOOR IN PENCIL AN' IT GOES BACK {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE|THREE DECADES|TA HIS FATHER}, AN' DA LONG PAUSES IZ MARKED WIT A CROSS, AN' DA CROSSES IZ {GETTIN' CLOSER TOGETHER|MORE FREQUENT|NO EVENLY SPACED}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DA CROSSES IZ CLOSIN' UP DA SAME WAY DA WELDS IZ.|SOMEBODY HAB BIN KEEPIN' DIS SCHEDULE FOR A LIFETIME OF WORK AN' NOBODY HAB EVER PLOTTED IT.|ASK HIM FOR DA DOOR.}"
asides.any: {member} {COPIES DA DOOR ONTO PAPER|COUNTS DA CROSSES|ASKS WHETHER ANYBODY HAB EVER PLOTTED IT}

choices.text: TAKE DA SCHEDULE AS TOLD AN' LEAVE IT!
PLOT DA CROSSES.
SIT DA NEXT LONG PAUSE OUT WIT HIM!

a2_plot.text:
THIRTY YEARS OF CROSSES ON DA INSIDE OF A HUT DOOR, PLOTTED ON SQUARED PAPER, AN' DA CURVE IZ {CLEAN|SMOOTH|UNMISTAKABLE} AN' IT IZ DA SAME CURVE AS DA GAPS BETWEEN DA WELDS.
WHICH MEANS DA WELDS IZ A RESPONSE, AN' DA FIFTH ONE IZ DUE, AN' DA PLOT SAYS WHEN, AN' DA MAN IN DA HUT HAB {A COUPLE OF MONTHS|A SEASON|LESS TIME DEN HE THINKS}!

x_vat_witch.title: {DA WOMAN DEY IZ GOING TA BURN|UMBRA EXCIDII, FIELD OFFICE|ARCANE, IN {country}}

n0.text:
FOUR MEN IN GOOD COATS HAB A WOMAN IN DA BACK OF A CAR OUTSIDE A VILLAGE HALL, AN' DERE IZ A FORM ON DA BONNET, AN' DEY IZ FILLIN' IT IN PROPERLY.
DAT IZ DA TINK 'BOUT DA UMBRA EXCIDII: DEY IZ NO A MOB. DERE IZ A FORM, DERE IZ A WARRANT, DERE IZ A NUMBER, AN' DERE WILL BE A RECEIPT.
DA VILLAGE IZ WATCHIN' FROM BEHIND CURTAINS. NOBODY IN DAT VILLAGE HAB COME OUT.
DA FOURTH COAT HAB NO LOOKED AT DA CAR {ONCE|AT ALL|SINCE IT WAZ PUT IN}!
n0.emText:
FOUR GOOD COATS, A WOMAN IN DA BACK OF A CAR, AN' A FORM BEING FILLED IN ON DA BONNET, CORRECTLY, WIT A WARRANT NUMBER.
DA EMPIRE'S WITCH-FINDERS DO NO BURN ANYBODY IN A TEMPER. DERE IZ PAPERWORK. DERE IZ A RECEIPT. YOU IZ A WITCH WIT DA LARGEST UNEXPLAINED MAGICAL CAPACITY IN EUROPE AN' YOU IZ STANDIN' DA LENGTH OF DA ROOM AWAY WATCHIN' DEM DO DIS TA SOMEBODY WHO MAYBE-MAYBE SELLS POULTICES!
n0.bubba: BUBBA STEPS IN FRONT OF YOU WITOUT APPEARIN' TA MOVE. "SUGAR. AGGIA' PENZA' IO. YOU STAY BEHIND ME AN' YOU SAY NOTHIN'."

choices.text: ASK TA SEE DA WARRANT.
TAKE HER.
TALK TA DA VILLAGE.
LET IT HAPPEN.

a.text:
DEY SHOW IT TA YOU, COZ DAT IZ DA PROCEDURE, AN' IT IZ IN ORDER, AN' DA OFFENCE IZ NAMED IN LATIN AN' DA LATIN MEANS "ARCANE PRACTICE, UNLICENSED".
UNLICENSED. DERE IZ A LICENCE. NOBODY IN DIS VILLAGE HAB EVER BIN TOLD DERE IZ A LICENCE, AN' DA COATS KNOW DAT, AN' ONE OF DA FOUR NO CAN LOOK AT YOU WHILE YOU READ IT!

choices.text: GET HER LICENSED ON DA SPOT!
ASK DA ONE WHO NO CAN LOOK AT YOU!

b.text:
FOUR COATS, ONE CAR, A VILLAGE OF CURTAINS, AN' 'BOUT DA BETTER PART OF A MINUTE OF REAL FAST DECISIONS.
YOU GET HER. DA HARD PART IZ DA NEXT FOUR MONTHS, AN' DA FORM ON DA BONNET WIT A WARRANT NUMBER ON IT DAT NOW HAB YA DESCRIPTION IN DA MARGIN!

c.text:
IT TAKES A LONG TIME AN' FOUR DOORS BEFORE ANYBODY OPENS ONE, AN' DEN IT GOES QUICKLY.
DEY DID NO REPORT HER. DAT IZ DA FIRST TINK DEY SAY AN' DEY ALL SAY IT. SOMEBODY FROM OUTSIDE REPORTED HER, AN' DA VILLAGE HAB A REAL GOOD IDEA WHO, AN' BY DA TIME YOU HAB FINISHED DA FOURTH CONVERSATION DERE IZ ELEVEN PEOPLE IN DA STREET AN' DA COATS IZ VISIBLY RECALCULATIN'!

d.text:
YOU LET IT HAPPEN, WHICH IZ WHAT EVERYBODY BEHIND DA CURTAINS IZ DOING, AN' DA CAR DRIVES AWAY WIT DA FORM SIGNED AN' A RECEIPT LEFT WIT DA VILLAGE CLERK.
WHAT YOU KEEP IZ DA WARRANT NUMBER, WHICH YOU READ OFF DA FORM, AN' WHICH TURNS OUT, MOST OF A SEASON LATER, TA BE WORTH A GREAT DEAL TA SOMEBODY WHO IZ BUILDIN' A LIST!

a1.text:
DERE IZ A LICENCE. IT COSTS MONEY, IT TAKES FOUR SIGNATURES, AN' ONE OF DA SIGNATURES CAN BE GIVEN BY ANY OFFICER OF DA EMPIRE PRESENT AT DA TIME OF DA OFFENCE.
YOU MAKE DEM DO IT IN DA STREET ON DA BONNET OF DEY OWN CAR. IT TAKES A LONG STRETCH. IT IZ ENTIRELY LEGAL. DA SENIOR OF DA FOUR SIGNS IT WIT A FACE LIKE A MAN SWALLOWIN' A STONE, AN' DA WOMAN GETS OUT OF DA CAR LICENSED!

a2.text:
HE WAITS UNTIL DA OTHER THREE IZ IN DA CAR AN' DEN TALKS REAL FAST.
HE IZ FOUR MONTHS INTO DA JOB. DERE IZ A QUOTA. DERE IZ A LIST AN' DA LIST IZ FILLED FROM DENUNCIATIONS AN' DA DENUNCIATIONS IZ PAID FOR, AN' HE HAB DA GRIMORIE IN HIS COAT AN' HE WANTS SOMEBODY TA TAKE IT OFF HIM COZ HE IZ NO BRAVE ENOUGH TA LOSE IT HIMSELF!

c_m.text:
IT TAKES A LONG TIME AN' FOUR DOORS BEFORE ANYBODY OPENS ONE, AN' DEN IT GOES QUICKLY: DEY DID NO CALL IT IN, DEY DID NO SIGN ANYTINK, AN' DEY WOULD ALL LIKE HER BACK.
WHAT DEY WILL NO DO IZ SAY SO TA DA MEN IN DA COATS. SOMEBODY IN DA THIRD HOUSE SAYS WHY, AN' DA WHY IZ DAT {IT WAZ CALLED IN FROM OUTSIDE|DA PAPER CAME FROM DA PROVINCE|NOBODY HERE WROTE DAT NAME DOWN} AN' DAT DA VILLAGE HAB BIN TRYIN' TA WORK OUT WHO FOR {FOUR DAYS|A WEEK|SINCE TUESDAY}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY OUTSIDE DA VILLAGE NAMED HER.|FOUR DOORS AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM IZ FRIGHTENED OF DA FIFTH.|ASK WHO MOVED HERE RECENTLY.}"
asides.any: {member} {ASKS WHO IZ NEW IN DA VILLAGE|WRITES DA FOUR NAMES DOWN|STAYS ON DA STEP}

choices.text: TAKE WHAT DA VILLAGE SAYS TA DA COATS!
FIND OUT WHO INFORMED.
GET DA VILLAGE TA DA CAR, ALL OF DEM, NOW!

c_who.text:
IT TAKES {FOUR QUESTIONS|AN HOUR|TWO HOUSES} AN' IT IZ A NAME ON A FORM, FILED IN DA PROVINCE, BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB NEVER BIN TA DIS VILLAGE AN' WHO HAB FILED {NINE|ELEVEN} OF DEZE DIS YEAR.
DAT IZ A MUCH BIGGER TINK DEN A CAR OUTSIDE A VILLAGE HALL, AN' IT IZ ON PAPER, AN' PAPER CAN BE TAKEN TA TWO DIFFERENT OFFICES DAT WOULD EACH REAL MUCH LIKE IT!

c_crowd.text:
FORTY PEOPLE OUT OF FORTY HOUSES STANDIN' IN A LANE BETWEEN A CAR AN' A ROAD, SAYIN' NUTTIN', WHICH TAKES {ONE VOICE|SOMEBODY GOING DOOR TA DOOR|'BOUT A LONG STRETCH} TA ARRANGE AN' NO CAN BE ARRANGED TWICE.

ON ONE SIDE OF DA WRIST DA SLEEVE IZ WORN AN' DA SKIN IZ A WORKIN' HAND. ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DA WRIST, FOR AS LONG AS IT IZ OVER DA LINE, IT IZ {NO|CLEAN|NEW}, AN' IT GOES BACK TA BEING WHAT IT WAZ WHEN DA HAND COMES BACK, AN' DA GUARDS {DO NO REACT|HAB SEEN IT BEFORE|LOOK AWAY}!

d_guard.text:
HE HAB WORKED DIS POST FOR {FOUR YEARS|A WHILE|SINCE IT OPENED} AN' HE GOES HOME AT DA END OF EVERY SHIFT, OVER DA LINE, TA A HOUSE ON DA OTHER SIDE, AN' HIS BOOTS WEAR OUT {NORMALLY|DA WAY BOOTS DO|LIKE ANYBODY'S}.
HIS BOOTS IZ NEW. HE LOOKS DOWN AT DEM WHILE HE IZ SAYIN' IT AN' DA SENTENCE STOPS IN DA MIDDLE, AN' HE IZ {TWENTY-THREE|YOUNG|NO OLD}, AN' IT IZ DA FIRST TIME IN FOUR YEARS DAT ANYBODY HAB ASKED HIM A QUESTION HE HAB NO ALREADY ANSWERED TA HIMSELF!

e_city_court.title: {WINNERS STAY ON|DA CAGE UNDER DA FLYOVER|FIVE ON FIVE, NOBODY'S WATCHIN'}

n0.text:
{court}, AN' A GAME RUNNIN', AN' DA GAME IZ WRONG.
DA BALL DOES NO SOUND RIGHT OFF DA TARMAC. DA SCORELINE ON DA FENCE, CHALKED, READS 11-11, AN' IT HAB READ 11-11 EVERY TIME ANYBODY HAB LOOKED AT IT, AN' ONE TEAM IZ A SET OF LADS OFF DA ESTATE AN' DA OTHER IZ A COUPLE OF DEM NOBODY CAN QUITE DESCRIBE AFTERWARDS.
A BOY ON DA BENCH WIT AN ICE PACK AN' A KNEE SAYS, WITOUT BEING ASKED: "DEY HAB BIN AT ELEVEN-ALL SINCE HALF FOUR. WINNERS STAY ON. NOBODY'S BEATEN DEM."
DA CHALK SCORE ON DA FENCE IZ {IN ONE HAND|WRITTEN BY ONE PERSON|DA SAME HAND ALL DA WAY DOWN} AN' DA HAND IZ NO ON DA COURT!
n0.emText:
A CAGE COURT UNDER A FLYOVER, A GAME AT 11-11 SINCE HALF PAST FOUR, AN' ONE OF DA TWO TEAMS NO CAN BE DESCRIBED BY ANYBODY WHO HAB BIN WATCHIN' DEM FOR THREE HOURS.
YOU CAN FEEL IT FROM DA FENCE: DEY IZ PLAYIN' PERFECTLY FAIRLY INSIDE A RULE DAT IZ NO BASKETBALL, AN' DA RULE IZ HOLDIN' DA WHOLE AFTERNOON AT ELEVEN-ALL, AN' SOMEBODY HAB TA BREAK IT FROM INSIDE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA TAKES HIS HAT OFF AN' HANDS IT TA YOU. "ME GOT 'BOUT FOUR MINUTES OF DIS IN ME, SUGAR, AN' DEN ME IZ A DEAD MAN. MA JAMMO. NUN SE PO' PERDERE ACCUSSI'."

asides.adventurous: {member} {GRINS: "NOW DIS IZ WHAT ME SIGNED UP FOR."|IZ ALREADY CLIMBIN' DA RUBBLE TA SEE WHAT IZ ON DA OTHER SIDE|NO CAN WAIT TA SEE WHAT IZ BEHIND DA BLAST DOOR|RUSHES AHEAD TA GET DA FIRST LOOK}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.aggressive: {member} WANTS TA KNOW WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU FOUL ONE OF DEM!
asides.sanguine: {member} HAB DA ESTATE LADS LAUGHIN' WITHIN A MINUTE, WHICH IZ DA FIRST LAUGH ON DAT COURT ALL AFTERNOON!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TAKE DA COURT. WINNERS STAY ON!
ASK DA BOY WIT DA KNEE WHAT HAPPENED TA HIM!
RUB DA CHALK SCORE OFF DA FENCE!
GET DA ESTATE LADS OFF DA COURT AN' TAKE DEM HOME!

a.text:
DEY MAKE ROOM WITOUT A WORD. ONE OF DEM HOLDS DA BALL OUT TA YOU AN' YOU TAKE IT, AN' IT IZ WARM AN' IT IZ HEAVIER DEN A BALL, AN' DA TARMAC UNDER YA FEET HAB BIN SWEPT IN DA LAST FOUR MINUTES BY NOBODY.
FIRST TA ELEVEN. DAT IZ WHAT DEY SAY. DAT IZ WHAT DEY HAB BIN SAYIN' SINCE HALF FOUR!
a.bubba: "FIRST TA ELEVEN," SAYS BUBBA, HANDS ON HIS KNEES ALREADY. "MANNAGGIA. ALRIGHT. GIVE ME DA BALL."

asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
"WENT UP FOR A REBOUND WIT ONE OF DEM," HE SAYS. "CAME DOWN 'BOUT FOUR SECONDS AFTER HE DID. ME KNEE DID DA WHOLE FOUR SECONDS ON ITS OWN."
HE HAB BIN WATCHIN' DEM SINCE HALF FOUR COZ HIS BROTHER IZ STILL ON DA COURT, AN' HIS BROTHER HAB BIN ON DA COURT SINCE HALF FOUR, AN' HIS BROTHER IZ NINETEEN AN' LOOKS, FROM HERE, 'BOUT FOURTEEN!

choices.text: GO AN' GET DA BROTHER OFF DA COURT!
PLAY, AN' LOSE ON PURPOSE, SO DA ESTATE LADS GO HOME WINNERS!

c.text:
YOU TAKE YA SLEEVE TA ELEVEN-ALL AN' RUB IT OUT, AN' DA WHOLE COURT STOPS.
DA FIVE NOBODY CAN DESCRIBE TURN AN' LOOK AT DA FENCE, ALL TOGETHER, IN A WAY DAT IZ NO HUMAN AT ALL, AN' DEN, SLOWLY, ONE OF DEM PICKS UP DA CHALK FROM DA BENCH AN' WRITES IT AGAIN. 11-11.
DA GAME RESTARTS. BUT YOU KNOW SOMETINK NOW DAT NOBODY ELSE ON DIS COURT KNOWS: DA CHALK IZ DA GAME!

choices.text: TAKE DA CHALK.
WRITE A DIFFERENT SCORE.

d.text:
IT TAKES YOU DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR AN' A LOT OF PATIENCE AN' ONE REAL GOOD LIE 'BOUT SOMEBODY'S MOTHER, AN' YOU GET ALL FIVE OF DEM OFF DA COURT AN' UP DA RAMP.
BEHIND YOU DA FIVE WHO STAYED ON STAND IN DA EMPTY CAGE FOR A WHILE, AN' DEN SIT DOWN ON DA BENCH, AN' DEN IZ GONE, AN' DA CHALK ON DA FENCE STILL SAYS 11-11.
DA LADS BUY YOU CHIPS OUT OF A SHARED HANDFUL OF COINS. DA OLDEST ONE IZ SHAKIN' AN' PRETENDIN' IT IZ DA COLD!

b1.text:
HE DOES NO WANT TA COME. HE IZ WINNIN', HE SAYS, AN' HE HAB BIN WINNIN' SINCE HALF FOUR, AN' HIS LEGS IZ GONE AN' HIS HANDS IZ SHAKIN' AN' HE IZ NINETEEN AN' HE NO CAN STOP.
YOU TAKE HIM OFF DA COURT UNDER BOTH ARMS WIT HIS BROTHER SWEARIN' AT EVERYBODY, AN' DA MOMENT HIS FOOT LEAVES DA TARMAC HE WEIGHS 'BOUT HALF WHAT HE DID!

b2.text:
YOU PLAY TA LOSE AGAINST SOMETINK DAT HAB NO LOST SINCE HALF PAST FOUR, WHICH IZ A GREAT DEAL HARDER DEN IT SOUNDS, COZ IT DOES NO WANT TA WIN: IT WANTS TA STAY AT ELEVEN-ALL.
YOU GET BEATEN. IT COSTS YOU EVERYTINK YOU HAB GOT IN DA LEGS. DA ESTATE LADS GO HOME AT ELEVEN-ALL HAVIN' NO LOST, WHICH IZ WHAT DA WHOLE AFTERNOON WAZ ACTUALLY 'BOUT, AN' DA CAGE IZ EMPTY AT DUSK FOR DA FIRST TIME IN MONTHS!

c1.text:
IT IZ A STUB OF ORDINARY SCHOOL CHALK AN' IT IZ WARM AN' IT HAB BIN USED A GREAT DEAL.
WIT IT IN YA POCKET DA COURT BEHIND YOU FINISHES: SOMEBODY SCORES, DA SCORE GOES TA TWELVE, AN' DA GAME IZ OVER, AN' FIVE PLAYERS WALK OFF UP DA RAMP AN' DO NO ARRIVE AT DA TOP OF IT!

c2.text:
YOU WRITE 12-11 ON DA FENCE, TA DA ESTATE LADS.
EVERY HEAD ON DAT COURT TURNS. DA TARMAC MAKES A SOUND LIKE A HELD NOTE ENDIN'. AN' DEN DA FIVE WHO NO CAN BE DESCRIBED WALK OFF DA COURT, PAST YOU, IN A LINE, AN' EACH ONE OF DEM SAYS THANK YOU, AN' DA LAST ONE GIVES YOU WHAT IT HAB BIN CARRYIN' SINCE HALF FOUR!

b1_m.text:
HE DOES NO WANT TA COME. HE IZ WINNIN', HE SAYS, AN' HE HAB BIN WINNIN' SINCE HALF FOUR, AN' HIS LEGS IZ {FINE|NO TIRED|HOLDIN' UP}.
IT IZ {NINE|HALF NINE|DARK}. HE HAB BIN ON DAT COURT FOR {HALF A SHIFT|A LONG TIME|SINCE HALF FOUR} WITOUT WATER AN' HE IZ NO BREATHIN' HARD, AN' WHEN HE GOES UP FOR A REBOUND HE COMES DOWN {'BOUT HALF A SECOND LATE|SLOWLY|AFTER EVERYBODY ELSE}!

asides.nurturing: {member} HAB WATER OUT OF DA PACK AN' IZ AT DA SIDELINE BEFORE ANYBODY SAYS ANYTINK!
asides.any: {member} {COUNTS HOW LONG HE HANGS|WATCHES HIS FEET|CALLS HIS NAME AN' GETS NO REACTION}

choices.text: GO ON AN' GET HIM. PHYSICALLY!
GET HIM OFF WIT SOMETINK OTHER DEN HIS NAME!
TIME DA HANG.

b1_name.text:
HIS NAME DOES NO WORK AN' HAB NO WORKED SINCE HALF FOUR. WHAT WORKS IZ {HIS BROTHER'S|DA BOY WIT DA KNEE'S|SOMEBODY ELSE'S} NAME, CALLED ONCE, FROM DA SIDELINE, IN DA VOICE YOU USE WHEN SOMEBODY HAB BIN HURT.
HE COMES OFF DA COURT AT A RUN AN' DOES NO REMEMBER DA LAST {FIVE HOURS|FOUR HOURS|PART OF DA EVENIN'} AN' IZ FINE BY MORNIN', AN' DA FIVE NOBODY CAN DESCRIBE IZ STILL PLAYIN' AT DAWN WIT A GAP IN DA LINE!

b1_hang.text:
TIMED PROPERLY OFF A WATCH, ACROSS {NINE|ELEVEN} REBOUNDS, HE IZ IN DA AIR FOR {HALF A SECOND|A FIFTH OF A SECOND|A MEASURABLE AMOUNT} LONGER DEN DA PHYSICS OF A NINETEEN-YEAR-OLD ALLOWS, AN' DA FIVE HE IZ PLAYIN' AGAINST IZ IN DA AIR {TWICE|THREE TIMES} AS LONG AS DAT.
AN' DA GAP IZ CLOSIN'. HE IZ GETTIN' NEARER TA DEM EVERY QUARTER OF AN HOUR, AN' AT DA CURRENT RATE HE WILL MATCH DEM BY 'BOUT {TWO IN DA MORNIN'|MIDNIGHT|DA LIL' HOURS}!

c1_m.text:
IT IZ A STUB OF ORDINARY SCHOOL CHALK AN' IT IZ WARM AN' IT HAB BIN USED A GREAT DEAL, AN' IT IZ IN A POCKET NOW.
DA SCORE ON DA FENCE DOES NO STOP GOING UP. IT GOES UP WITOUT ANYBODY WRITIN' IT, IN DA SAME HAND, ON A FENCE WIT NO CHALK ANYWHERE NEAR IT, AN' IT IZ {ELEVEN-ALL|LEVEL|TIED} AGAIN BY DA TIME DA PARTY REACHES DA ROAD!

choices.text: KEEP DA CHALK AN' KEEP WALKIN'!
GO BACK AN' WRITE DA FINAL SCORE YOURSELF!
WORK OUT WHOSE HAND DA SCORE IZ IN!

c1_hand.text:
IT IZ A CHILD'S HAND: {ROUND|CAREFUL|SCHOOLROOM} LETTERS, DA NUMBERS FORMED DA WAY DEY IZ TAUGHT AN' NO DA WAY DEY IZ WRITTEN BY ANYBODY OVER {TWELVE|ELEVEN|TEN}.
DERE IZ A BOY ON DAT ESTATE WHO HAB BIN KEEPIN' DA SCORE ON DAT FENCE FOR {A COUPLE OF YEARS|A LONG TIME|AS LONG AS ANYBODY CAN REMEMBER} AN' WHO DOES NO GO ON DA COURT, AN' EVERYBODY KNOWS HIM, AN' NOBODY HAB EVER THOUGHT 'BOUT IT!

e_city_clinic.title: {DA BACK ROOM FITTIN'|{theatre}|CASH, NO PAPERWORK, NO ANAESTHETIC WORTH DA NAME}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A CARD IN DA WINDOW OF A LAUNDRETTE ON {street} WIT A PHONE NUMBER AN' FOUR WORDS: HARDWARE. FITTED. SAME DAY.
DA NUMBER ANSWERS ON DA SECOND RING. DA ADDRESS IZ {theatre}, AN' DA PERSON WHO OPENS DA DOOR IZ {surgeon}, AN' BEHIND DEM, LAID OUT ON A CLEAN TOWEL ON A CLEAN TABLE UNDER A REAL GOOD LIGHT, IZ DA STOCK.
IT IZ ALL REAL. DAT IZ DA ALARMIN' PART. IT IZ ALL REAL, AN' HALF OF IT IZ BETTER DEN ANYTINK A LICENSED CLINIC IN DIS COUNTRY WILL SELL YOU.
DA CARD IN DA WINDOW HAB BIN IN DAT WINDOW {ELEVEN YEARS|A REAL LONG TIME|SINCE BEFORE DA LAUNDRETTE}!
n0.emText:
A CARD IN A LAUNDRETTE WINDOW: HARDWARE. FITTED. SAME DAY. BEHIND DA DOOR AT {theatre}, {surgeon}, AN' A CLEAN TOWEL WIT DA STOCK LAID OUT ON IT UNDER A REAL GOOD LIGHT.
ALL OF IT REAL. SOME OF IT BETTER DEN DA CLINICS CARRY. YOU HAB A BODY DAT WAZ REBUILT ONCE ALREADY BY PEOPLE WIT A MUCH BIGGER BUDGET AN' A MUCH WORSE BEDSIDE MANNER, SO YOU IZ, IN A SENSE, AN EXPERIENCED CUSTOMER!
n0.bubba: BUBBA LOOKS AT DA TOWEL, DEN AT DA SURGEON'S HANDS, DEN AT DA TOWEL. "HANDS IZ STEADY. UH-HUH. SUGAR, 'E MMANE SO' BUONE. DAT IZ MOST OF IT, RIGHT DERE."

asides.scholarly: {member} {IZ ALREADY LOGGIN' SENSOR ANOMALIES WIT AN ANNOYED GRUNT|SCANS DA ALLOY AN' MUTTERS 'BOUT OBSOLETE MANUFACTURIN' DATES|CHECKS DA SURVEY RECORDS AN' COMPLAINS 'BOUT MISSIN' DOCUMENTATION|NOTES DAT DA READINGS MAKE ZERO THERMODYNAMIC SENSE}
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.hedonistic: {member} WANTS DA EYE. {member} HAB WANTED DA EYE SINCE DA DOOR OPENED!
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BE FITTED. PICK SOMETINK OFF DA TOWEL!
ASK WHY A SURGEON DIS GOOD IZ WORKIN' OVER A LAUNDRETTE!
ASK WHERE DA STOCK COMES FROM!
TAKE DA TOWEL AN' EVERYTINK ON IT!

a.text:
IT TAKES FOUR HOURS. IT COSTS EVERYTINK IN DA PARTY'S POCKETS AN' A PROMISE 'BOUT DA REST.
DA LIGHTIN' IZ BRIGHT, DA SURGEON'S HANDS IZ STEADY, AN' DA RADIO IZ A RADIO PLAYIN' {radio} IN DA NEXT ROOM, AN' SOMEWHERE IN DA MIDDLE OF IT YOU STOP BEING ABLE TA TELL WHETHER YOU IZ BEING REPAIRED OR IMPROVED!
a.bubba: BUBBA HOLDS A HAND THROUGH ALL FOUR HOURS AN' TALKS DA ENTIRE TIME 'BOUT A MULE HE OWNED. IT IZ, UNEXPECTEDLY, EXACTLY WHAT IZ NEEDED!

asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
"COZ DA CLINICS FIT WHAT DA CATALOGUE SAYS AN' ME FIT WHAT DA BODY WANTS," DEY SAY, AN' DEN, AFTER A MOMENT, HONESTLY: "AN' COZ ME IZ STRUCK OFF IN TWO COUNTRIES."
DEY SHOW YOU DA FILE. IT WAZ A PATIENT DA COLLECTIVE WANTED REFUSED AN' A SURGEON WHO DID NO REFUSE, AN' DA WHOLE OF DA REST OF DEY LIFE HAB COME OUT OF DAT ONE AFTERNOON!

choices.text: BE FITTED, AN' PAY DOUBLE!
OFFER TA MOVE DEM SOMEWHERE DEY CAN WORK!

c.text:
"SALVAGE," DEY SAY, WHICH IZ TRUE, AN' "DONATION", WHICH IZ ALSO TRUE, AN' DEN DEY STOP, COZ DA THIRD SOURCE IZ DA ONE YOU IZ ACTUALLY ASKIN' 'BOUT.
DA THIRD SOURCE IZ A MAN WHO COMES ON THURSDAYS WIT A COOL BOX AN' DOES NO GIVE A NAME, AN' EVERYTINK HE BRINGS IZ WARM, AN' DA SURGEON HAB STOPPED ASKIN' COZ DA ALTERNATIVE IZ NO FITTIN' ANYBODY AT ALL!

choices.text: BE DERE ON THURSDAY.
REFUSE DA FITTIN' AN' WALK OUT!

d.text:
IT IZ ON A TOWEL. IT IZ NO NAILED DOWN. DERE IZ THREE OF YOU AN' ONE OF DEM.
YOU WALK OUT OF {theatre} WIT ELEVEN PIECES OF HARDWARE WORTH MORE DEN DA BUILDIN', AN' BEHIND YOU SOMEBODY IZ STANDIN' IN A REAL GOOD LIGHT WIT DEY STEADY HANDS EMPTY, AN' EVERY PERSON IN DIS CITY WHO NEEDED A FITTIN' DIS MONTH NOW DOES NO GET ONE!

b1.text:
YOU PAY DOUBLE AN' YOU IZ FITTED, AN' DA EXTRA GOES ON STOCK, AN' DA STOCK GOES INTO SOMEBODY WHO NO CAN PAY ANYTINK AT ALL AN' WHO IZ WAITIN' ON DA STAIRS WHILE YOU IZ UNDER.
YOU MEET DEM ON DA WAY OUT. DEY IZ 'BOUT SIXTEEN. DEY DO NO KNOW WHAT YOU DID AN' DA SURGEON WILL NEVER TELL DEM!

b2.text:
IT TAKES DA BEST PART OF A WEEK, A VAN, FOUR PHONE CALLS AN' ONE EXTREMELY TENSE HOUR AT A BORDER.
DEY SET UP OVER A BAKERY IN {region} INSTEAD, WIT DA SAME LIGHT AN' DA SAME HANDS AN' A DOOR DAT DOES NO NEED A CARD IN A LAUNDRETTE WINDOW. DA FIRST TINK DEY FIT, IN DA NEW PLACE, DEY FIT FOR NUTTIN', TA WHOEVER BROUGHT DEM DERE!

c1.text:
THURSDAY, IN DA ALLEY BEHIND DA LAUNDRETTE, WIT A COOL BOX CHANGIN' HANDS.
HE IZ A MORTUARY PORTER FROM DA CITY HOSPITAL WIT FOUR CHILDREN AN' A REAL CAREFUL SET OF RULES 'BOUT WHICH BODIES HE WILL AN' WILL NO OPEN, AN' WHEN YOU HAB HEARD DA RULES YOU UNDERSTAND DAT HE IZ DA MOST MORAL PERSON IN DIS ENTIRE ARRANGEMENT.
HE ADDS YOU TA DA LIST. DERE IZ A LIST!

c2.text:
YOU WALK OUT, WHICH IZ DA RIGHT CALL, AN' IT COSTS YOU DA FITTIN' AN' IT COSTS DA SURGEON A CUSTOMER AN' IT DOES NO STOP DA THURSDAY MAN.
WHAT IT DOES DO IZ PUT YOU IN DA STREET OUTSIDE A LAUNDRETTE WIT A PIECE OF INFORMATION, AN' DERE IZ AN OFFICE IN {region} DAT PAYS FOR EXACTLY DIS AN' ASKS NO OTHER QUESTIONS!

c1_m.text:
THURSDAY, IN DA ALLEY BEHIND DA LAUNDRETTE, WIT A COOL BOX CHANGIN' HANDS. HE IZ A MORTUARY {PORTER|TECHNICIAN|ATTENDANT} AN' HE IZ TAKIN' {NUTTIN' DAT IZ MISSED|WHAT GETS WRITTEN OFF|TINKZ DAT WOULD BE BURNED}.
HE IZ ALSO, ONCE DA BOX IZ OPEN, {SHORT|ONE ITEM DOWN|NO CARRYIN' WHAT WAZ ORDERED}, AN' HE SAYS SO BEFORE HE IZ ASKED, AN' SAYS DA SHORTFALL WENT SOMEWHERE ELSE DIS WEEK!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DERE IZ A SECOND BUYER.|SOMEBODY OUTBID A SURGEON WHO WORKS OUT OF A LAUNDRETTE.|ASK WHO.}"
asides.any: {member} {LOOKS IN DA BOX|STANDS WHERE DA ALLEY CAN BE SEEN FROM|ASKS HIM IF HE IZ ALL RIGHT}

choices.text: TAKE DA BOX. NO OUR BUSINESS!
FIND OUT WHO DA SECOND BUYER IZ!
TELL DA SURGEON AN' LET DEM DECIDE!

c1_buyer.text:
IT TAKES {A FEW QUESTIONS|A NAME|ONE EVENIN'} AN' DA SECOND BUYER, WHEN IT IZ TRACED, IZ {A COMPANY|AN ACCOUNT|A STANDIN' ORDER} DAT PAYS MORE, ON TIME, AN' NEVER ASKS WHAT CONDITION ANYTINK IZ IN.
WHICH IZ DA WRONG WAY ROUND FOR DIS TRADE, AN' WHICH MEANS WHATEVER IT IZ BUYIN' IZ NO BEING FITTED TA ANYBODY!

c1_tell.text:
DA SURGEON LISTENS WITOUT STOPPIN' WHAT DEY IZ DOING AN' DEN PUTS DA INSTRUMENT DOWN, WHICH DEY HAB NO DONE ALL WEEK.
DEY HAB BIN {UNDERCUT|OUTBID|LOSIN' STOCK} FOR {MOST OF A SEASON|A SEASON|MOST OF DA YEAR} AN' HAB NO KNOWN WHY, AN' HAB BIN TURNIN' PEOPLE AWAY, AN' DEY SAY DA NUMBER OF PEOPLE OUT LOUD AN' DEN HAB TA SIT ON DA STEP IN DA ALLEY FOR A MINUTE!

b2_m.text:
IT TAKES DA BEST PART OF A WEEK, A VAN, FOUR PHONE CALLS AN' ONE EXTREMELY TENSE HOUR AT A BORDER, AN' DEY SET UP OVER A BAKERY WIT A PROPER THEATRE AN' A DOOR DAT LOCKS.
ON DA SECOND NIGHT SOMEBODY KNOCKS: {TWO OF DEM|A PAIR|PEOPLE IN GOOD COATS}, POLITE, WIT AN OFFER, WHICH IZ TA BUY DA PRACTICE, DA STOCK AN' DA SURGEON'S SILENCE, IN DAT ORDER!

choices.text: LET DA SURGEON ANSWER IT THEMSELVES!
ANSWER DA DOOR YOURSELF.
MOVE DEM AGAIN, TONIGHT, FURTHER!

b2_deal.text:
ANSWERIN' SOMEBODY ELSE'S DOOR AN' NEGOTIATIN' ON DEY BEHALF IZ A LIBERTY, AN' IT IZ TAKEN, AN' IT WORKS COZ DA PARTY IZ DA ONLY PERSON IN DA BUILDIN' WHO IZ NO FRIGHTENED.
DA PRACTICE IZ NO SOLD. WHAT IZ SOLD, FOR {A GREAT DEAL|MORE DEN DA PRACTICE IZ WORTH|A REAL GOOD PRICE}, IZ A SUPPLY AGREEMENT, ON DA SURGEON'S TERMS, AN' DA GOOD COATS GO AWAY HAVIN' PAID TA KEEP SOMEBODY WORKIN'!

b2_bad.text:
DA NEGOTIATION IZ CONDUCTED BY SOMEBODY WHO IZ NO A NEGOTIATOR, ON A LANDIN', OVER A BAKERY, AT {ELEVEN AT NIGHT|A BAD HOUR|DA WRONG TIME}.
DA OFFER IZ WITHDRAWN. SO, {FOUR DAYS LATER|INSIDE DA WEEK|SHORTLY}, IZ DA SURGEON'S STOCK, DEY LEASE AN' DEY VAN, BY PEOPLE WHO DO DIS PROFESSIONALLY, AN' DA PARTY HAB TA FIND DEM AGAIN TA APOLOGISE AN' IT TAKES {A SEASON|MONTHS|A LONG TIME}!

b2_move.text:
MOVIN' SOMEBODY TWICE IN A WEEK, AT NIGHT, WIT A THEATRE IN DA BACK OF A VAN, IZ {HARDER DA SECOND TIME|WORSE|A DIFFERENT KIND OF TIRED}, AN' IT WORKS.
DEY END UP {FOUR COUNTRIES|A LONG WAY|FURTHER DEN ANYBODY INTENDED} FROM WHERE DEY STARTED, IN A TOWN WIT NO CLINIC, AN' DEY IZ STILL DERE {YEARS LATER|NOW|A LONG TIME AFTERWARDS}, FITTIN' WHAT DA BODY WANTS, AN' DA PARTY'S NAME IZ ON DA DOOR IN A LANGUAGE NONE OF DEM READ!

e_city_job.title: {ONE NIGHT'S WORK|{mark}|SOMEBODY NEEDS FOUR PAIRS OF HANDS}

n0.text:
YOU IZ IN {bar} AN' A MAN YOU HAB NEVER MET BUYS DA ROUND AN' SITS DOWN WITOUT BEING INVITED.
DA JOB IZ {mark}. DA WINDOW IZ BETWEEN TWO AN' FOUR IN DA MORNIN'. DA SPLIT IZ FOUR WAYS, WHATEVER YOU FIND, AN' HE TAKES A THIRD OFF DA TOP FOR DA PLAN, WHICH IZ A FAIR RATE AN' EVERYBODY AT DA TABLE KNOWS IT.
"YOU IZ NO FROM HERE," HE SAYS. "DAT IZ DA QUALIFICATION. DAT IZ DA WHOLE QUALIFICATION."
HE HAB DA ROUND IN BEFORE HE SITS DOWN, WHICH MEANS HE KNEW WHAT EVERYBODY DRINKS!
n0.emText:
A MAN BUYS DA ROUND IN {bar} AN' SITS DOWN UNINVITED. DA JOB IZ {mark}, TWO TILL FOUR, FOUR-WAY SPLIT, A THIRD OFF DA TOP FOR DA PLAN.
"YOU IZ NO FROM HERE," HE SAYS. "DAT IZ DA WHOLE QUALIFICATION."
NO BEING FROM ANYWHERE IZ DA ONLY QUALIFICATION YOU HAB EVER BIN ABLE TA PROVE!
n0.bubba: BUBBA LEANS BACK WIT HIS ARMS FOLDED. "HE'S TELLIN' DA TRUTH 'BOUT DA MONEY AN' LYIN' 'BOUT SOMETHIN' ELSE. NUN SACCIO ANCORA CHE COSA. KEEP HIM TALKIN', SUGAR."

TAKE DA JOB, AN' CASE IT PROPERLY FIRST!

a.text:

IT GOES EXACTLY TA PLAN FOR NINE OF DA ELEVEN MINUTES!

choices.text: TAKE EVERYTINK AN' GO.
TAKE ONLY WHAT DA PLAN SAID AN' GO!
STAY FOR DA SAFE.

asides.stoic: {member} {SAYS NUTTIN' AN' CHECKS DA SEALS ON DEY SUIT|NODS ONCE AN' TAKES UP A DEFENSIVE POSITION|STANDS GUARD BY DA DOOR, COMPLETELY SILENT|KEEPS DEY EYES ON DA HORIZON WITOUT A WORD}

b.text:
A COUPLE OF DAYS OF WATCHIN', AN' DA PLAN IZ WRONG IN THREE PLACES, AN' ONE OF DA THREE IZ DA REASON HE WANTED PEOPLE WHO IZ NO FROM HERE.
{mark} IZ A DECOY. DA TARGET IZ A ROOM UPSTAIRS DAT IZ NO ON HIS PLAN, AN' DA REASON HE NEEDS STRANGERS IZ DAT EVERYBODY LOCAL KNOWS WHAT IZ IN IT!

choices.text: DO DA JOB AS BRIEFED AN' TAKE YA SHARE!
DO DA ROOM UPSTAIRS AN' CUT HIM OUT!
WALK, AN' TAKE WHAT YOU HAB LEARNED TA DA OWNER!

c.text:
YOU SAY NO IN A BAR AN' IT COSTS NUTTIN', WHICH IZ DA GOOD TINK 'BOUT A BAR.
HE SHRUGS, FINISHES DA ROUND HE BOUGHT, AN' FINDS FOUR OTHER PEOPLE BY CLOSIN' TIME, COZ DERE IZ ALWAYS FOUR OTHER PEOPLE.
WHAT YOU KEEP IZ YA NAME OFF A CHARGE SHEET, AN' DA LOCATION, AN' DA CERTAIN KNOWLEDGE DAT SOMEBODY IZ GOING THROUGH DAT BACK DOOR ON THURSDAY!

d.text:
YOU FIND WHOEVER OWNS {mark} AN' TELL DEM, AT DEY OWN KITCHEN TABLE, AT AN HOUR DAT MAKES IT CLEAR YOU IZ SERIOUS.
DEY DO NO THANK YOU AT FIRST. DEY THANK YOU AT 'BOUT FOUR IN DA MORNIN' ON THURSDAY, FROM BEHIND DEY OWN COUNTER, WIT DA LIGHTS OFF AN' TWO POLICEMEN IN DA STOCKROOM!

a1.text:
EVERYTINK. DA TILL, DA BACK OFFICE, DA STOCK, AN' DA TINK UNDER DA COUNTER DAT WAZ NO ON DA PLAN AN' DAT NOBODY HAB BIN ABLE TA IDENTIFY SINCE.
DA SPLIT HOLDS AN' DA FENCE IZ {fence} AN' BY FOUR IN DA MORNIN' YOU IZ THREE STREETS AWAY WIT MORE MONEY DEN DA JOB WAZ WORTH AN' A DESCRIPTION OF FOUR PEOPLE CIRCULATIN' BY SIX!

a2.text:
ONLY WHAT WAZ ON DA PLAN, AN' OUT AT A GOOD WHILE EXACTLY, AN' DA WHOLE TINK HAB DA SHAPE OF WORK DONE PROPERLY.
HE PAYS ON DA PAVEMENT, IN CASH, AN' SHAKES HANDS, AN' DAT IZ DA LAST ANYBODY SEES OF HIM, AN' NOBODY WHO WAZ IN DAT BUILDIN' CAN DESCRIBE ANY OF YOU!

a3.text:
DA SAFE TAKES NINETEEN MINUTES AN' IT IZ NINETEEN MINUTES YOU DID NO HAB.
WHAT IZ IN IT IZ WORTH EVERY SECOND. WHAT IZ IN DA DOORWAY AT MINUTE SEVENTEEN IZ NO DA POLICE!

b1.text:
YOU DO EXACTLY WHAT WAZ ASKED, TAKE EXACTLY YA SHARE, AN' LEAVE DA UPSTAIRS ROOM ALONE, AN' HE NO CAN SAY A WORD 'BOUT IT COZ HE NEVER MENTIONED IT.
HE PAYS. HE IZ FURIOUS IN A WAY HE NO CAN EXPRESS. TWO DAYS LATER SOMEBODY ELSE'S A FEW STRANGERS GO UP DOZE STAIRS, AN' ONE OF DEM COMES BACK DOWN!

b2.text:
DA ROOM UPSTAIRS HAB ONE WINDOW, FOUR LOCKS ON DA INSIDE OF DA DOOR, AN' A TINK IN A CASE DAT EVERYBODY LOCAL KNOWS 'BOUT AN' NOBODY LOCAL WILL TOUCH.
YOU TOUCH IT. HE GETS NUTTIN', WHICH HE DESERVES. YOU GET SOMETINK DA CITY HAB BIN CAREFULLY LEAVIN' ALONE FOR YEARS AN' YEARS, WHICH YOU MAY OR MAY NO DESERVE, AN' WHICH IZ NOW YA!

a2_m.text:
ONLY WHAT WAZ ON DA PLAN, AN' OUT AT A GOOD WHILE EXACTLY, AN' DA WHOLE TINK HAB DA SHAPE OF WORK DONE PROPERLY.
DA BAG IZ {LIGHTER|NO AS HEAVY|LESS} DEN DA PLAN SAID IT WOULD BE, WHICH IZ NOTICED IN DA CAR, AN' DA REASON IT IZ LIGHTER IZ DAT SOMEBODY HAB ALREADY BIN THROUGH {DA TILL|DA BACK OFFICE|DA SAME DRAWER} TONIGHT, BEFORE DA PARTY, WIT A KEY!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY WAZ HERE FIRST AN' HAB A KEY.|WE IZ DA NOISE, NO DA THEFT.|DIS WAZ A COVER, NO A JOB.}"
asides.any: {member} {COUNTS IT AGAIN IN DA CAR|DOES NO START DA ENGINE|LOOKS BACK AT DA SHOP}

choices.text: TAKE DA SHARE AN' ASK NUTTIN'!
WORK OUT WHAT DA TAKE SHOULD HAB BIN!
GO BACK IN AN' FIND OUT WHAT WAZ ACTUALLY TAKEN!

a2_short.text:
DA FLOAT, DA DAY'S TAKINGS AN' DA STOCK LIST SAY DA SHOP SHOULD HAB HAB {FOUR TIMES|CONSIDERABLY MORE|A GREAT DEAL MORE} IN IT DEN CAME OUT, AN' DA DIFFERENCE IZ NO LIL' ENOUGH TA BE A BAD TUESDAY.
WHICH MEANS DA MAN IN {bar} HIRED FOUR STRANGERS TA BREAK A DOOR DAT WAZ ALREADY GOING TA BE OPENED, SO DAT DA INSURANCE AN' DA POLICE WOULD BOTH BE LOOKIN' AT {A BURGLARY|FOUR STRANGERS|DA WRONG CRIME}!

a2_back.text:
BACK THROUGH A DOOR DAT IZ ALREADY OPEN, AT {TWENTY PAST TWO|DA WORST POSSIBLE HOUR|NO TIME TA BE DOING DIS}, WIT DA LOOKOUT HISSIN' FROM DA CORNER.
DA SAFE IZ SHUT AN' LOCKED AN' {EMPTY|HAB BIN EMPTIED|HAB NUTTIN' IN IT}, AN' IT HAB BIN EMPTIED WIT DA COMBINATION RATHER DEN WIT ANYTINK ELSE, AN' DA UPSTAIRS ROOM HAB HAB ITS FOUR LOCKS UNDONE FROM DA INSIDE!

b1_m.text:
YOU DO EXACTLY WHAT WAZ ASKED, TAKE EXACTLY YA SHARE, AN' LEAVE DA UPSTAIRS ROOM ALONE, AN' HE NO CAN SAY A WORD 'BOUT IT.
WHAT HE DOES IZ PAY {OVER|MORE DEN AGREED|DA FULL SUM} AN' DEN ASK, AS THOUGH IT HAB JUST OCCURRED TA HIM, WHETHER DA PARTY WOULD DO DA SAME JOB AGAIN IN {A DIFFERENT TOWN|FOUR WEEKS|ANOTHER CITY} FOR FOUR TIMES DA MONEY!

choices.text: TAKE DA SECOND JOB.
ASK WHY DA SAME JOB TWICE!
SAY NO AN' GET OUT OF DA TOWN TONIGHT!

b1_why.text:
COZ IT IZ DA SAME {ROOM|UPSTAIRS ROOM|LOCKED ROOM}, IN {FOUR|FIVE} TOWNS, AN' EACH ONE HAB DA SAME FOUR LOCKS ON DA INSIDE OF DA DOOR, AN' HE NEEDS SOMEBODY TA BREAK EACH OF DEM FROM DA OUTSIDE WITOUT GOING IN.
WHAT IZ IN DEM, HE DOES NO KNOW. HE IZ BEING PAID TA HAB DEM OPENED AN' NO ENTERED, AN' HE IZ BEING PAID A GREAT DEAL, AN' HE HAB STOPPED SLEEPIN'!

b1_out.text:
NO, SAID IN A BAR, TA A MAN WHO HAB ALREADY PAID, WHICH IZ DA ONE VERSION OF DIS CONVERSATION DAT HAB NO LEVERAGE IN IT.
HE TAKES IT WELL. HE IZ IN DA SAME SEAT {FOUR DAYS LATER|DA FOLLOWIN' WEEK|WHENEVER DA PARTY PASSES THROUGH AGAIN} WIT A DIFFERENT FOUR PEOPLE, AN' DA PARTY READS 'BOUT DA THIRD TOWN IN A NEWSPAPER AN' RECOGNISES DA SHAPE OF IT IMMEDIATELY!

e_docks_container.title: {DA CONTAINER DAT IZ OWED|FORTY FEET OF SOMEBODY'S PROBLEM|A JOB ON DA QUAY}

n0.text:
A WOMAN IN A TRUCKER'S SOCIETY JACKET BUYS YOU A COFFEE OUT OF A MACHINE AN' PUTS A FOLDED DOCKET ON DA TABLE.
"FORTY FOOT BOX, BONDED SHED, AN' IT NO IZ GOING TA BE DERE ON MONDAY WHATEVER ANYBODY DOES," SHE SAYS. "EITHER IT GOES OUT TONIGHT WIT PEOPLE WHO'LL DO IT PROPERLY, OR IT GOES OUT THURSDAY WIT PEOPLE WHO NO WILL."
DA DOCKET IZ REAL. DA SEAL NUMBER ON IT BELONGS TA A CONTAINER DAT CUSTOMS HAB FLAGGED AN' FORGOTTEN IN DA SAME WEEK.
DA DOCKET IZ FOLDED TA HIDE {ONE LINE|DA CONSIGNEE|A NUMBER}, AN' DA FOLD IZ OLD!
n0.emText:
A TRUCKER'S SOCIETY JACKET, A COFFEE OUT OF A MACHINE, AN' A FOLDED DOCKET ON DA TABLE FOR A FORTY-FOOT BOX IN A BONDED SHED DAT IZ GOING TA WALK WHATEVER ANYBODY DOES.
"EITHER IT GOES OUT TONIGHT WIT PEOPLE WHO'LL DO IT PROPERLY, OR THURSDAY WIT PEOPLE WHO NO WILL."
DAT IZ DA WHOLE MORAL ARCHITECTURE OF DIS WORLD IN ONE SENTENCE, AN' YOU HAB BIN AWAKE FOR ELEVEN MONTHS AN' YOU HAB ALREADY HEARD IT TWICE OVER!

choices.text: DO IT TONIGHT.
ASK WHAT IZ IN DA BOX.
TAKE DA DOCKET TA CUSTOMS!

a.text:
HALF ELEVEN, A BORROWED TUG UNIT, A GATE DAT IZ OPEN COZ SOMEBODY LEFT IT OPEN, AN' ELEVEN MINUTES OF DA MOST CAREFUL REVERSIN' ANYBODY HAB EVER DONE.

b.text:
"MEDICINE," SHE SAYS, "FOR DA INTERIOR, AN' DA PAPERWORK'S WRONG COZ DA PAPERWORK IZ ALWAYS WRONG WHEN DA COLLECTIVE NO WANT A TINK ARRIVIN'."
SHE OPENS DA BOX FOR YOU, WHICH NOBODY IN DIS TRADE EVER DOES. IT IZ MEDICINE. IT IZ ALSO, AT DA BACK, FOUR CRATES DAT IZ NO MEDICINE, AN' SHE KNOWS DEY IZ DERE, AN' SHE TELLS YOU WHAT DEY IZ WITOUT BEING ASKED!

choices.text: MOVE DA MEDICINE AN' LEAVE DA FOUR CRATES!

c.text:
CUSTOMS IZ GRATEFUL IN A WAY DAT MEANS NUTTIN' AN' FILE IT IN A WAY DAT MEANS EVERYTINK, AN' ON THURSDAY DA BOX GOES ANYWAY, WIT PEOPLE WHO DO NO DO IT PROPERLY, AN' TWO MEN ON DAT QUAY IZ HURT DOING IT.
YOU IZ PAID A LIL' OFFICIAL REWARD. IT IZ DA CORRECT AMOUNT AN' IT FEELS LIKE NUTTIN' AT ALL!

d.text:
YOU TAKE IT OUT CLEAN AN' YOU TAKE IT SOMEWHERE DAT IZ NO DA ADDRESS, AN' YOU SELL DA CONTENTS IN FOUR LOTS OVER A FORTNIGHT.
IT IZ DA BEST MONEY ANY OF YOU HAB EVER SEEN. DA SOCIETY DO NO COME AFTER YOU: DAT IZ NO HOW DEY WORK. WHAT DEY DO IZ STOP, ENTIRELY, BEING ANYWHERE YOU IZ, FOR YEARS!

b1.text:
DA MEDICINE GOES AN' DA FOUR CRATES STAY IN DA BONDED SHED WIT DA DOOR SHUT ON DEM, WHICH IZ EXACTLY WHAT SHE HOPED SOMEBODY WOULD DO AN' COULD NO SAY OUT LOUD.
DA INTERIOR GETS ITS MEDICINE FOUR DAYS EARLY. DA FOUR CRATES IZ SOMEBODY ELSE'S THURSDAY!

b2.text:
ALL OF IT, TOGETHER, ON ONE TUG UNIT, OUT OF ONE GATE, COZ SPLITTIN' A LOAD IZ HOW LOADS GET NOTICED.
DA FOUR CRATES GO ON TA DA INTERIOR WIT DA MEDICINE AN' IZ OPENED IN A PLACE WIT NO ELECTRICITY BY PEOPLE WHO HAB NO IDEA WHAT DEY HAB BIN SENT, AN' 'BOUT DAT, LATER, YOU WILL HAB A VIEW!

IT IZ KEPT FOR A MAN WHO PAYS FOR IT MONTHLY AN' WHO HAB NEVER ONCE ASKED FOR A CONTAINER NUMBER, AN' DA PARTY IZ NOW {A COUPLE OF LINES|A LINE|AN ENTRY} ON IT, AN' SO IZ EVERY DRIVER WHO HAB TAKEN DAT RUN!

b2_ring.text:
A YARD FOUR STREETS OFF DA ROUTE, A PHONE BOX, AN' A CONVERSATION DAT STARTS BADLY AN' GETS WORSE AN' DEN, 'BOUT {FOUR MINUTES|HALFWAY|TWO MINUTES} IN, TURNS INTO DA TRUTH.
DA ADDRESS ON DA DOCKET IZ NO WHERE DA MEDICINE WAZ GOING. SHE KNOWS DAT AN' HAB KNOWN IT FOR {TWO RUNS|A WHILE|A COUPLE OF MONTHS} AN' HAB BIN TRYIN' TA GET SOMEBODY TA TAKE DA LOAD AN' DEN NO DELIVER IT, AN' HAB NO BIN ABLE TA SAY SO OUT LOUD TA ANYBODY!

e_village_dream.title: {FOUR IN DA MORNIN', EVERYWHERE|DA ONE WHO COMES WHEN YOU SLEEP|NOBODY IN DIS VILLAGE IZ SLEEPIN'}

n0.text:

NOBODY HERE HAB SLEPT PROPERLY IN ELEVEN DAYS. DERE IZ A ROTA ON DA DOOR OF DA SHOP: WHO SITS UP WIT WHOM. DERE IZ COFFEE GOING IN DA CHURCH HALL AN' A WOMAN HANDIN' IT OUT WHO DOES NO APPEAR TA HAB BLINKED IN SOME TIME.
"IT GETS YOU WHEN YOU GO UNDER," SAYS {sleeper}, MATTER-OF-FACTLY, HOLDIN' A CUP WIT BOTH HANDS. "IT IZ DA SAME ONE EVERY TIME. IT IZ GOT A FACE AN' ME WOULD KNOW IT ANYWHERE AN' ME WOULD RATHER NO SAY IT OUT LOUD."
THREE PEOPLE HAB DIED IN DEY SLEEP IN ELEVEN DAYS. ALL THREE HAB {dreamHarm}.
EVERY LIGHT IZ ON AN' DA ELECTRICITY BILL FOR DIS VILLAGE IZ {FOUR TIMES|CONSIDERABLY MORE DEN|NO WHAT} WHAT IT WAZ IN DA SPRING!

THREE DEAD IN DEY BEDS WIT {dreamHarm} ON DEM. YOU HAB BIN DREAMIN' FOR ELEVEN MONTHS 'BOUT A ROOM YOU NO CAN REMEMBER BEING IN, AN' EVERY SINGLE NIGHT, SOMETINK IN DAT ROOM IZ POLITELY NO LOOKIN' AT YOU!

choices.text: SLEEP, DELIBERATELY, WIT EVERYBODY WATCHIN'!
SIT UP WIT DA ONES WHO IZ STILL GOING!

a.text:
DEY PUT YOU IN DA BACK ROOM OF DA CHURCH HALL WIT FOUR PEOPLE WATCHIN' AN' A LAMP ON.
YOU GO UNDER IN 'BOUT A LONG MINUTE, COZ YOU HAB NO SLEPT PROPERLY EITHER, AN' DEN YOU IZ IN {dreamPlace}, AN' IT IZ REAL QUIET, AN' DERE IZ SOMEBODY AT DA FAR END OF IT WHO HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR SOMEBODY WHO COULD GO DOWN AN' COME BACK.

a.emText:

{dreamPlace}. QUIET. AN' AT DA FAR END OF IT, SOMEBODY WHO HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR YOU SPECIFICALLY, COZ EVERYTINK IN DA WORLD DAT LIVES IN DA SPACE BEHIND SLEEP KNOWS EXACTLY WHO YOU IZ AN' WHAT WAZ TAKEN OUT OF YOU AN' WHO DID DA TAKIN'.

a.bubba: YOU HEAR BUBBA THROUGH DA FLOOR OF DA DREAM, FROM DA WAKIN' ROOM, SAYIN': "NUN 'A TUCCÀ. NO YOU TOUCH HER. NO YOU DAMN WELL TOUCH HER."

choices.text: WALK DOWN DA CORRIDOR TA IT!
WAKE SOMEBODY ELSE INTO DA DREAM WIT YOU!

choices.text: SLEEP, NOW, BEFORE IT COMES BACK FOR HIM!

c.text:
THREE DEAD IN A WEEK AN' A BIT. A MAN OF FORTY, A WOMAN OF EIGHTY-ONE, AN' A BOY OF NINE, IN THREE HOUSES AT OPPOSITE ENDS OF DA VILLAGE, WIT NUTTIN' IN COMMON AT ALL.
EXCEPT ONE TINK, WHICH TAKES AN AFTERNOON OF ASKIN' TA FIND: ALL THREE OF DEM, IN DA LAST MONTH, SLEPT SOMEWHERE DEY DO NO NORMALLY SLEEP. DA FRONT ROOM. DA BARN. A HOSPITAL BED BROUGHT DOWNSTAIRS.
ALL THREE OF DEM SLEPT ON DA GROUND FLOOR. NOBODY WHO HAB DIED WAZ UPSTAIRS!

choices.text: SLEEP ON DA GROUND FLOOR.

d.text:

A CROWD SLEEP AN HOUR ON DA ROAD AWAY IN A SCHOOL HALL AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM SLEEPS THROUGH, AN' DA VILLAGE STANDS EMPTY AN' LIT ALL NIGHT.
IN DA MORNIN', DA LIGHTS IN DA EMPTY VILLAGE IZ STILL ON AN' EVERY FRONT DOOR IZ OPEN. NOBODY LEFT DEM OPEN!

a1.text:
DA CORRIDOR IZ LONGER WALKED DEN LOOKED AT, AN' IT DOES NO GET CLOSER UNTIL YOU STOP TRYIN', AN' DEN IT IZ DIRECTLY IN FRONT OF YOU.
IT IZ A PERSON. DAT IZ DA TINK NOBODY IN DA VILLAGE CAN SAY OUT LOUD: IT IZ A PERSON, AN' IT IZ SOMEBODY DEY ALL KNOW, AN' IT HAB BIN DEAD SINCE {timeAgo}, AN' IT IZ EXTREMELY TIRED AN' IT DOES NO WANT TA BE DOING DIS AN' IT NO CAN STOP!

a2.text:
YOU REACH BACK THROUGH YA OWN SLEEP AN' TAKE HOLD OF DA PERSON HOLDIN' YA WRIST AN' PULL, AN' DEY COME UNDER WIT YOU, STILL HOLDIN' ON.
TWO OF YOU IN {dreamPlace} IZ A DIFFERENT PROPOSITION ENTIRELY. IT HAB SPENT ELEVEN DAYS GETTIN' PEOPLE ONE AT A TIME. IT HAB NO ARRANGEMENT AT ALL FOR TWO, AN' YOU CAN SEE IT WORKIN' DAT OUT!

a3.text:
YOU TURN ROUND IN A DREAM, WHICH IZ DA HARDEST PHYSICAL ACT DERE IZ, AN' YOU WALK BACK UP {dreamPlace} WIT SOMETINK KEEPIN' PACE BEHIND YOU AN' NO TOUCHIN' YOU AN' TALKIN' DA WHOLE WAY.

WHAT IT SAID IZ A NAME AN' AN ADDRESS, AN' DA ADDRESS IZ IN DIS VILLAGE, AN' IT IZ ASKIN' TA BE LET IN DA FRONT DOOR RATHER DEN DA BACK!

b1.text:

WHAT IT SAID IZ DAT IT IZ NO DA ONE KILLIN' DEM. WHAT IT SAID IZ DAT IT HAB BIN WAKIN' PEOPLE UP!

c1.text:
YOU SLEEP ON A GROUND FLOOR IN AN EMPTY HOUSE WIT DA DOOR UNLOCKED COZ DAT IZ HOW DA OTHER THREE WAZ FOUND.
NO COME DOWN A CORRIDOR DIS TIME. IT COMES UP THROUGH DA FLOOR, WHICH IZ WHAT IT HAB ALWAYS DONE, AN' WHICH IZ WHY DA UPSTAIRS IZ SAFE, AN' DA LAST TINK YOU SEE BEFORE IT IZ ON YOU IZ DAT IT IZ CLIMBIN'!

c2.text:
A CROWD, ONE NIGHT, EVERY ONE OF DEM UPSTAIRS, IN ATTICS AN' BOX ROOMS AN' ON LANDINGS, AN' TWO FAMILIES IN DA CHURCH TOWER.
EVERYBODY SLEEPS. EVERYBODY WAKES UP. IT IZ DA FIRST FULL NIGHT DA VILLAGE HAB HAB IN ELEVEN DAYS AN' DA NOISE IN DA STREET AT EIGHT IN DA MORNIN' IZ PEOPLE CRYIN' IN RELIEF.
WHAT IZ UNDER DA GROUND FLOORS IZ STILL UNDER DEM. BUT DERE IZ A RULE NOW, AN' A RULE YOU CAN LIVE WIT IZ DA DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A HAUNTIN' AN' A LIFE!

c2_m.text:
FORTY PEOPLE, ONE NIGHT, EVERY ONE OF DEM UPSTAIRS, IN ATTICS AN' BOX ROOMS AN' ON LANDINGS, AN' TWO FAMILIES IN DA CHURCH TOWER COZ DA CHURCH HAB NO UPSTAIRS.
IT WORKS. NOBODY GOES UNDER. AT 'BOUT {FOUR|HALF THREE|DA DEAD HOUR} EVERY GROUND FLOOR DOOR IN DA VILLAGE OPENS, ONE AFTER ANOTHER, IN ORDER DOWN DA STREET, AN' CLOSES AGAIN, AN' NOBODY UPSTAIRS SAYS A WORD UNTIL LIGHT!

WHICH GIVES DA NEXT ONE. IT IZ {DA SCHOOLHOUSE|A HOUSE AT DA END|NUMBER ELEVEN}, AN' DERE IZ TIME TA BE DERE, AN' DERE IZ TIME TA GET EVERYBODY ELSE CONSIDERABLY FURTHER AWAY DEN UPSTAIRS!

WORD FOR WORD, AN' IT TAKES HIM FOUR ATTEMPTS COZ HE KEEPS LAUGHIN', AN' DA LAUGHIN' IZ NO FUNNY TA ANYBODY IN DA ROOM INCLUDIN' HIM.
WHAT IT SAID IZ DAT IT IZ NO DA TINK IN DA CORRIDOR. IT SAID IT {PLAINLY|AS A CORRECTION|DA WAY YOU CORRECT A CHILD}, AN' DEN IT SAID WHAT IT IZ, AN' HE WILL NO REPEAT DAT PART, AN' HE IZ {NINETEEN|NO YOUNG|A GROWN MAN} AN' HE ASKS SOMEBODY TA SIT WIT HIM!

ASK WHERE DA WATER COMES FROM!
ASK WHY NOBODY IZ IN ON A TUESDAY!
GO THROUGH DA DOOR AT DA BACK OF DA HOT ROOM!

a.text:

b.text:
"OUT OF DA ROCK," SHE SAYS. "SAME AS IT ALWAYS HAB. SAME TEMPERATURE EVERY DAY OF DA YEAR AN' ME GRANDMOTHER SWORE BY IT AN' DA ROMANS PUT DA WALL UP SO DERE IZ YA OPINION FROM FOUR DIRECTIONS."

c.text:

STAY IN.

d.text:

DA WATER COMES UP THROUGH A ROMAN FLOOR. STANDIN' IN IT TA DA KNEE, EVERYTINK DAT HAB HAPPENED TA YOU DIS YEAR IZ BRIEFLY AVAILABLE ALL AT ONCE, IN ORDER, INCLUDIN' DA PARTS YOU WAZ NO DERE FOR!

c1.text:
YOU IZ OUT AN' DRESSED IN FOUR MINUTES AN' SHE LOCKS DA INNER DOOR AN' SITS DOWN AGAIN WIT DA CROSSWORD AN' HER HANDS IZ SHAKIN' SLIGHTLY.

c2.text:

IT IZ NO UNFRIENDLY. IT SWIMS FOUR LENGTHS IN A POOL DAT IZ ONE LENGTH LONG, AN' IT GOES PAST YOU TWICE, AN' DA SECOND TIME IT STOPS AN' STANDS UP, AN' DA WATER DISPLACES EXACTLY AS MUCH AS A LARGE PERSON WOULD DISPLACE, AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' DERE.
IT SAYS THANK YOU. NOBODY HAB STAYED IN BEFORE!

b_m.text:

DERE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN|A GOOD MANY} OF DEM. DEY IZ DA SAME TINK IN DIFFERENT SIZES, DEY IZ WORKED, AN' DA LARGEST OF DEM IZ {DA SIZE OF A HEAD|BIG|NO PORTABLE}, AN' IT IZ AT DA BOTTOM OF DA HEAP, WHICH MEANS IT CAME UP FIRST!

SHE LOOKS AT IT FOR A LONG TIME. DEN SHE SAYS DAT HER GRANDMOTHER HAB ONE ON DA MANTELPIECE AN' DAT SHE HAB ALWAYS ASSUMED IT WAZ {AN ORNAMENT|A STONE|NUTTIN'}, AN' GOES AN' GETS IT, AN' DA TWO OF DEM IZ DA SAME OBJECT AN' DA OLD ONE IZ {MUCH MORE WORN|OLDER|DA SAME TINK AFTER ANOTHER LIFETIME IN DA WATER}!
