A TRESTLE TABLE AT A JUNCTION, EVERYTINK TWO EUROS, AN' A TIN WIT A SLOT IN IT DAT NOBODY IZ WATCHIN', ON A ROAD WHERE ANYBODY COULD TAKE IT.
NOBODY HAB. DAT IZ DA INTERESTIN' FACT. DIS WHOLE COUNTRY IZ HELD TOGETHER BY TINKZ LIKE DIS TIN, AN' NOBODY WHO WRITES 'BOUT DA WORLD EVER MENTIONS DEM!
n0.bubba: BUBBA PUTS A NOTE IN DA TIN WITOUT TAKIN' ANYTINK AN' GETS BACK IN DA VEHICLE. "WHAT? AGGIA VISTO 'E POMMODORE. DEY LOOKED GOOD."

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.hedonistic: {member} HAB BOUGHT FOUR OF EVERYTINK!
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.nurturing: {member} TIDIES DA STALL AN' SQUARES UP DA BOXES WITOUT BEING ASKED!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BUY PROPERLY AN' PUT DA MONEY IN!
GO UP TA DA FARM AN' PAY IN PERSON!
MIND DA STALL FOR AN HOUR!
TAKE DA TIN.

a.text:
TWO EUROS A GO: TOMATOES DAT TASTE OF TOMATOES, EGGS DAT WAZ LAID DIS MORNIN', BREAD, AN' A JAR OF SOMETINK WIT A HANDWRITTEN LABEL.
DA PARTY EATS IN A LAY-BY A FEW KILOMETRES ON AN' DOES NO SPEAK FOR A GOOD WHILE COZ DA FOOD IZ DAT GOOD!

b.text:
DA FARM IZ A WOMAN, A DAUGHTER OF 'BOUT NINE WHO DOES DA BOARD IN HER BEST HANDWRITIN', AN' A DOG WIT STRONG OPINIONS.
DEY IZ ASTONISHED DAT ANYBODY WALKED UP. NOBODY EVER WALKS UP. YOU IZ FED, ON DA SPOT, OUT OF DA SAME BOXES, AN' SENT AWAY WIT MORE DEN YOU PAID FOR AN' A NAME TA USE AT DA NEXT FARM DOWN DA ROAD!

c.text:
AN HOUR BEHIND SOMEBODY ELSE'S TRESTLE TABLE AT A JUNCTION, SELLIN' TOMATOES AT TWO EUROS TA FOUR CARS AN' A TRACTOR.
YOU TAKE ELEVEN EUROS. DA GIRL COMES DOWN AT FIVE TA COLLECT AN' FINDS DA STALL TIDY, DA TIN HEAVY AN' FOUR STRANGERS STANDIN' BEHIND IT LIKE STAFF, AN' HER FACE DOES SOMETINK NONE OF YOU WILL FORGET!

d.text:
IT IZ A TIN WIT A SLOT IN IT ON A TABLE AT A JUNCTION. IT TAKES 'BOUT TWO SECONDS.
DERE IZ FORTY EUROS IN IT AN' A NOTE FROM A CHILD ASKIN' WHOEVER IZ READIN' DIS TA NO, AN' IT IZ DA CHEAPEST TINK ANYBODY IN DIS PARTY HAB EVER BOUGHT AN' IT COSTS MORE DEN IT SAYS ON DA TIN!

c_m.text:
AN HOUR BEHIND SOMEBODY ELSE'S TRESTLE TABLE AT A JUNCTION, SELLIN' TOMATOES AT TWO EUROS TA FOUR CARS AN' A TRACTOR.
IN DA FOURTH CAR DERE IZ A MAN WHO DOES NO BUY ANYTINK. HE COUNTS DA STOCK, LOOKS IN DA TIN, ASKS WHO IZ MINDIN' IT AN' WHEN DA FARM COMES DOWN, AN' DRIVES OFF {WITOUT BUYIN'|BEFORE ANYBODY ANSWERS|TOWARDS DA FARM}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DAT WAZ A SURVEY, NO A CUSTOMER.|HE COUNTED DA TIN.|SOMEBODY IZ GOING TA HIT DIS TABLE.}"
asides.any: {member} {GETS DA PLATE|WRITES DA TIME DOWN|PUTS DA TIN UNDER DA TABLE}

choices.text: FINISH DA HOUR AN' HAND DA TIN OVER!
TAKE DA TIN UP TA DA FARM NOW AN' SAY SO!
STAY AT DA TABLE PAST DA HOUR AN' WAIT FOR HIM!

c_warn.text:
DA FARM IZ {A WOMAN|A WOMAN AN' A GIRL OF NINE|UP A TRACK} AN' DA WARNIN' IZ TAKEN SERIOUSLY ENOUGH FOR DA TIN TA COME IN AT NIGHT FROM DAT DAY ON.
IT IZ HIT {DA FOLLOWIN' WEEK|A COUPLE OF DAYS LATER|ON DA THURSDAY}, AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' IN IT, AN' DA BOARD IZ TAKEN AN' DA TRESTLE IZ BROKEN AN' DA DAUGHTER'S BEST HANDWRITIN' IZ IN A DITCH. BUT DA MONEY IZ IN A JAR IN A KITCHEN, AN' DAT IZ DA WHOLE OF WHAT DA PARTY DID!

c_wait.text:
TWO HOURS PAST DA HOUR ON A TRESTLE TABLE AT A JUNCTION WIT DA LIGHT GOING, WHICH IZ {BORIN'|COLD|EXACTLY AS UNGLAMOROUS AS IT SOUNDS}.
HE COMES BACK AT DUSK WIT A SECOND MAN AN' STOPS DA CAR AN' GETS OUT, AN' FINDS A HANDFUL OF PEOPLE BEHIND A TABLE INSTEAD OF A TIN, AN' GETS BACK IN, AN' DAT JUNCTION IZ NO TOUCHED AGAIN IN DA TWO YEARS ANYBODY IZ COUNTIN'!

d_m.text:
IT IZ A TIN WIT A SLOT IN IT ON A TABLE AT A JUNCTION. IT TAKES 'BOUT A COUPLE OF SECONDS.
DERE IZ FORTY EUROS IN IT AN' A FOLDED NOTE UNDERNEATH DA COINS, AN' DA NOTE IZ {A LIST|IN A CHILD'S HAND|AN LOOT SACK}, AN' IT SAYS WHAT EVERYTINK ON DA TABLE COSTS AN' DEN, AT DA BOTTOM, WHAT DA TIN IZ BEING STASHED FOR!

choices.text: TAKE IT ANYWAY.
PUT IT BACK AN' PUT YA OWN MONEY IN!
READ DA BOTTOM LINE FIRST!

d_back.text:
DA TIN GOES BACK ON DA TABLE WIT FORTY EUROS IN IT AN' {TWENTY|A GOOD DEAL} MORE ON TOP OF DA FORTY, WHICH IZ NO A GRAND GESTURE AN' COSTS ALMOST NUTTIN'.
DA PARTY IZ FED AT DAT FARM {EVERY TIME|WHENEVER|FOR YEARS} DEY COME THROUGH, AN' DA DAUGHTER, WHO IZ NINE, REMEMBERS WHAT DA CAR LOOKED LIKE!

d_read.text:
IT IZ BEING STASHED FOR {A HEARIN' AID|A BICYCLE|DA VET}, AN' DA RUNNIN' TOTAL IZ ON DA BOTTOM LINE IN A CHILD'S HAND, AN' DA TOTAL IZ {SHORT|NOWHERE NEAR|'BOUT A THIRD OF DA WAY}.
DA TIN IZ PUT BACK. WHAT GOES IN IT IZ NO FORTY EUROS. WHETHER DA PARTY EVER FINDS OUT IF DA TOTAL WAZ REACHED IZ A DIFFERENT QUESTION AN' DA HONEST ANSWER IZ DAT DEY DO NO!

e_fields_harvest.title: {FOUR PAIRS OF HANDS|DA RAIN IZ COMIN' AN' DA CROP IZ STANDIN'|A DAY'S WORK}

n0.text:
A MAN ON A GATE FLAGS YOU DOWN WIT BOTH ARMS, WHICH IZ NO SOMETINK PEOPLE DO.
HE HAB FORTY ACRES STANDIN', A FORECAST DAT IZ GOING TA BREAK TONIGHT, ONE MACHINE, AN' A SON WHO HAB GONE TA {region} AN' IZ NO COMIN' BACK FOR IT.
"ME CAN PAY," HE SAYS, WHICH IZ NO TRUE, AN' EVERYBODY STANDIN' AT DA GATE KNOWS IT IZ NO TRUE.
DA FIELD IZ {ELEVEN HECTARES|BIG|MORE DEN ONE MAN DOES} AN' DA FORECAST ON DA RADIO IN DA CAB IZ NO GOOD!
n0.emText:
A MAN ON A GATE FLAGGIN' YOU DOWN WIT BOTH ARMS, FORTY ACRES STANDIN', RAIN COMIN' TONIGHT, ONE MACHINE AN' NOBODY TA WORK IT.
"ME CAN PAY," HE SAYS, AN' NO CAN. DERE IZ NUTTIN' UNCANNY HERE AT ALL. IT IZ A FIELD, AN' WEATHER, AN' A DAY'S WORK, AN' AFTER DA YEAR YOU HAB HAB DAT IZ ALMOST RESTFUL!
n0.bubba: BUBBA IZ OUT OF DA VEHICLE AN' HAB HIS SLEEVES ROLLED BEFORE ANYBODY HAB ANSWERED. "SIGNO', WE GOT TILL DARK. JAMMO, GUAGLIU'."

asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.grumpy: {member} {COMPLAINS LOUDLY 'BOUT DA FREEZIN' TEMPERATURE|CURSES UNDER DEY BREATH AT DA TERRIBLE FOOTIN'|MUTTERS DAT DIS JOB NO IZ WORTH DA HAZARD PAY|KICKS A PIECE OF DEBRIS AN' GRUNTS IN FRUSTRATION}
asides.sanguine: {member} HAB DA RADIO ON DA TRACTOR TUNED TA SOMETINK WIT A BEAT INSIDE A COUPLE OF MINUTES!
asides.hedonistic: {member} ASKS WHETHER DERE WILL BE FOOD AT DA END. DERE WILL BE ENORMOUS AMOUNTS OF FOOD AT DA END!
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WORK DA FIELD. ALL OF IT. UNTIL DARK!
WORK IT, AN' TAKE NO MONEY!
FETCH HELP. DERE IZ FOUR FARMS ON DIS ROAD!
WISH HIM LUCK AN' DRIVE ON!

a.text:
DA REST OF DA SHIFT. DUST, CHAFF, A MACHINE DAT STOPS TWICE, A BROKEN BELT FIXED WIT WIRE, AN' DA LIGHT GOING AN' DA CLOUD COMIN' UP FROM DA WEST DA WHOLE AFTERNOON LIKE SOMETINK WIT AN APPOINTMENT.
YOU GET IT IN. DA LAST TRAILER GOES UNDER COVER AS DA FIRST OF IT HITS DA YARD, AN' FORTY ACRES OF A MAN'S ENTIRE YEAR IZ DRY, AN' HE SITS DOWN ON DA STEP AN' PUTS HIS HANDS OVER HIS FACE!

b.text:
YOU WORK IT AN' YOU TAKE NUTTIN', AN' HE ARGUES 'BOUT IT FOR A SHORT WHILE AN' DEN STOPS ARGUIN' COZ DERE IZ A CROP TA GET IN.
WHAT YOU GET INSTEAD IZ DINNER AT HIS TABLE, BEDS IN DA HOUSE, DA LOAN OF ANYTINK ON DAT FARM ANY TIME YOU IZ ON DIS ROAD, AN' A NAME IN DA PARISH, WHICH IN DIS COUNTRY IZ A CURRENCY DAT DOES NO DEVALUE!

c.text:
FOUR FARMS, FOUR GATES, FOUR CONVERSATIONS, AN' BY TWO IN DA AFTERNOON DERE IZ THREE MORE MACHINES IN DAT FIELD AN' ELEVEN PEOPLE, AN' SOMEBODY'S MOTHER HAB ARRIVED WIT A CAR FULL OF FOOD.
IT IZ IN BY SIX. IT IZ A PARTY BY EIGHT. NOBODY ON DIS ROAD HAB DONE A HARVEST TOGETHER SINCE DA SON'S GENERATION LEFT, AN' DA FACT DAT IT TOOK FOUR STRANGERS TA ARRANGE IT IZ DISCUSSED, AT LENGTH, BY EVERYBODY!

d.text:
YOU WISH HIM LUCK, AN' HE TAKES IT WELL, AN' YOU IZ ELEVEN KILOMETRES ON WHEN DA RAIN STARTS.
NO STOP FOR DA BEST PART OF A WEEK. YOU KNOW EXACTLY WHAT DAT MEANS AN' SO DOES EVERYBODY IN DA VEHICLE, AN' NOBODY PUTS DA RADIO ON!

c_m.text:
FOUR FARMS, FOUR GATES, FOUR CONVERSATIONS, AN' BY TWO IN DA AFTERNOON DERE IZ THREE MORE MACHINES IN DA FIELD AN' A WOMAN WIT A TRAILER AN' A BOY WHO SHOULD BE AT SCHOOL.
DA FOURTH FARM SAID NO. IT SAID NO {HARD|FAST|WITOUT A REASON}, AN' DA MAN ON DA GATE DOES NO COMMENT WHEN HE IZ TOLD, WHICH IZ HOW DA PARTY WORKS OUT DAT DERE IZ {A HISTORY|SOMETINK|A FIFTY-YEAR ARGUMENT} DERE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{ONE NO OUT OF FOUR, AN' NOBODY WILL SAY WHY.|DAT IZ NO 'BOUT DA HARVEST.|ASK 'BOUT DA FOURTH FARM LATER.}"
asides.any: {member} {GETS ON A MACHINE|ASKS DA WOMAN WIT DA TRAILER|SAYS NUTTIN' AN' KEEPS WORKIN'}

choices.text: GET DA FIELD IN WIT DA THREE DAT CAME!
GO BACK TA DA FOURTH FARM!
WORK IT ALONE WIT HIM UNTIL DARK INSTEAD!

c_fourth.text:
DA FOURTH FARM IZ {A MAN OF SEVENTY|AN OLD MAN|SOMEBODY'S UNCLE} AN' DA ARGUMENT IZ {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE|TWO GENERATIONS|OLDER DEN EITHER OF DEM} OLD AN' IZ 'BOUT {A GATE|FOUR METRES OF HEADLAND|WATER}, AN' IT HAB NEVER ONCE BIN DISCUSSED.
IT IZ DISCUSSED. IT TAKES {AN HOUR|DA WHOLE AFTERNOON|TWO HOURS AN' A BOTTLE}. HIS MACHINE IZ IN DA FIELD BY FOUR AN' DA TWO OF DEM DO NO SPEAK ALL EVENIN' AN' BOTH OF DEM IZ DERE, WHICH DA WHOLE DISTRICT NOTICES!

d_m.text:
YOU WISH HIM LUCK, AN' HE TAKES IT WELL, AN' YOU IZ ELEVEN KILOMETRES ON WHEN DA RAIN STARTS.
IT DOES NO STOP. IT RAINS FOR {DA BEST PART OF A WEEK|DA REST OF DA WEEK|A COUPLE OF DAYS}, AN' DA PARTY IZ IN A TOWN WIT A ROOF OVER DEY HEADS FOR ALL OF IT, AN' DA FIELD IZ {ELEVEN HECTARES|A GREAT DEAL OF STANDIN' WHEAT|SOMEBODY'S WHOLE YEAR}!

choices.text: IT IZ NO YA FIELD. STAY DRY!
GO BACK WHEN IT STOPS AN' HELP WIT WHAT IZ LEFT!
RING ROUND DA FOUR FARMS FROM DA TOWN!

d_back.text:
FOUR DAYS OF RAIN MEANS {HALF OF IT|MOST OF IT|A GOOD DEAL} IZ FLAT AN' SPROUTIN' AN' WORTH NUTTIN', AN' GOING BACK MEANS FOUR DAYS OF SALVAGIN' WHAT IZ WORTH SALVAGIN' IN MUD.
HE DOES NO THANK ANYBODY, COZ HE IZ PAST DAT. WHAT HE DOES IZ PUT DA PARTY ON DA LIST AT DA MERCHANT'S SO DAT DEY CAN DRAW ON HIS ACCOUNT, WHICH IZ A TINK FARMERS DO FOR EACH OTHER AN' NO FOR STRANGERS!

d_ring.text:
FOUR PHONE CALLS FROM A TOWN IN DA RAIN, TA FOUR FARMS DAT HAB NEVER HEARD OF DA PARTY, ON BEHALF OF A MAN WHOSE NAME IZ {HALF REMEMBERED|DA ONLY TINK ANYBODY HAB|ON A GATE}.
THREE OF DEM GO. DEY GET {TWO THIRDS|MOST|MORE DEN ANYBODY EXPECTS} OF IT IN BETWEEN DA SECOND AN' THIRD DAY OF RAIN, IN A BREAK NOBODY IN DAT TOWN NOTICED, AN' DA PARTY IZ NO DERE FOR ANY OF IT AN' FINDS OUT {A MONTH LATER|IN DA SPRING|MUCH LATER} FROM SOMEBODY ELSE!

z_eris_tram.title: {DA WOMAN ON DA LAST TRAM|TWO STOPS PAST DA DEPOT|COURT ADJOURNED}

n0.text:
DA LAST TRAM OF DA NIGHT HAB ONE OTHER PASSENGER ON IT: {eris}.
SHE IZ SITTIN' IN DA SEAT DAT FACES BACKWARDS, WIT HER BOOTS ON DA SEAT OPPOSITE, AN' SHE HAB BIN WAITIN' LONG ENOUGH TA HAB FINISHED WHATEVER SHE WAZ EATIN'.
"SIT DOWN," SHE SAYS. "YOU HAB GOT TWO STOPS. AFTER DAT IT STOPS BEING A TRAM."
SHE IZ IN DA SEAT DAT FACES BACKWARDS, WHICH ON DIS LINE IZ {DA ONLY ONE|NO A SEAT ANYBODY CHOOSES|DA ONE NOBODY SITS IN}!
n0.emText:
DA LAST TRAM HAB ONE OTHER PASSENGER: {eris}, BOOTS UP ON DA SEAT OPPOSITE, IN DA CHAIR DAT FACES BACKWARDS.
EVERY LIGHT IN DA CARRIAGE FLICKERS WHEN YOU GET ON, AN' DA TICKET MACHINE PRINTS YA TICKET BEFORE YOU TOUCH IT, AN' DA TICKET HAB TODAY'S DATE AN' A TIME FOUR HOURS FROM NOW.
SHE IZ DELIGHTED TA SEE YOU. DAT IZ DA PART DAT COSTS. "SIT DOWN, SUGAR'S-NO-ME," SHE SAYS. "YOU HAB GOT TWO STOPS."
n0.bubba: BUBBA SITS DOWN BETWEEN DA TWO OF YOU LIKE A MAN SITTIN' ON A FENCE BETWEEN TWO DOGS, AN' TAKES HIS HAT OFF TA HER, AN' SHE DOES NO LOOK AT HIM ONCE, WHICH FOR BUBBA IZ WORSE DEN ANYTINK SHE COULD DO TA HIM!

asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.sanguine: {member} SAYS GOOD EVENIN' AS THOUGH DIS WAZ AN ORDINARY TRAM!
asides.paranoid: {member} {MUTTERS DAT SOMEONE'S DEFINITELY WATCHIN' US FROM DA SHADOWS|CHECKS DEY SIX MORE DEN ONCE AN' GRIPS DEY HOLSTER|HISSES DAT DA SIGNAL FREQUENCY IZ RIGGED|WHISPERS: "DEY KNEW WE WAZ COMIN'. LOOK AROUND."}
asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: SIT DOWN AN' HEAR HER OUT!
ASK WHAT SHE WANTS.
GET OFF AT DA NEXT STOP.
ASK HER 'BOUT DA BOUNTY ON SOMEBODY'S HEAD!

a.text:
SHE TALKS FOR A STOP AN' A HALF 'BOUT NUTTIN' AT ALL: DA TRAM NETWORK, A MAN SHE WATCHED MISS DIS TRAM FOR ELEVEN CONSECUTIVE NIGHTS, DA PRICE OF CHIPS.
DEN, AT DA SECOND STOP, WITOUT CHANGIN' TONE: "COME AN' HAB AN EVENIN'. ME HAB HAB A WEEK OF PAPERWORK AN' EVERYBODY ME SENTENCE CRIES. YOU NO CRY. YOU WILL DO."
a.emText:
SHE TALKS FOR A STOP AN' A HALF 'BOUT NUTTIN': DA NETWORK, A MAN WHO MISSED DIS TRAM ELEVEN NIGHTS RUNNIN', DA PRICE OF CHIPS.
DEN, IN EXACTLY DA SAME VOICE: "COME AN' HAB AN EVENIN'. BUBBA'S COMIN'. BUBBA, YOU IZ COMIN'." SHE STILL HAB NO LOOKED AT HIM. "AN' YOU CAN COME TOO, SINCE YOU IZ WHAT HE'S GOT."
DA CARRIAGE LIGHTS DIM BY EXACTLY ONE BULB!
a.bubba: "ME AIN'T LEAVIN' HER," SAYS BUBBA, TA DA WINDOW. "SO. SE VENENO TUTT'E DUJE O NUN VENE NISCIUNO."

choices.text: GO WIT HER.
SAY NO.

asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

b.text:
"AN EVENIN'," SHE SAYS. "DAT IZ IT. DAT IZ DA WHOLE ASK. EVERYBODY ASSUMES DERE IZ A SECOND HALF TA DA SENTENCE."
DERE IZ NO A SECOND HALF TA DA SENTENCE. DAT IZ WHAT MAKES HER DANGEROUS: DA FIRST HALF IZ ENTIRELY TRUE AN' IT IZ NEVER DA WHOLE OF WHAT HAPPENS!

choices.text: TAKE DA EVENIN'.
ASK WHAT IT COSTS.

c.text:
YOU GET OFF AT DA NEXT STOP AN' DA TRAM GOES ON WITOUT YOU AN' DA NEXT ONE IZ NO FOR ELEVEN HOURS.
ON DA SHELTER BENCH DERE IZ A COURT DOCKET WIT YA NAME ON IT, FILLED OUT, UNSIGNED, AN' A PEN.
IT IZ AN INVITATION WIT DA WRONG STATIONERY, WHICH IZ SOMEHOW MUCH WORSE!

d.text:
SHE SITS UP. DAT IZ DA FIRST TIME ANYBODY HAB SEEN HER SIT UP.
"YOU WANT TA TALK 'BOUT DA BOUNTY," SHE SAYS, DELIGHTED. "NOBODY WANTS TA TALK 'BOUT DA BOUNTY. DEY WANT TA COMPLAIN 'BOUT DA BOUNTY."
SHE EXPLAINS HOW IT WORKS, ALL OF IT, IN ONE STOP, HONESTLY, AN' IT IZ DA SINGLE MOST USEFUL A COUPLE OF MINUTES ANYBODY IN DIS PARTY HAB EVER SPENT, AN' AT DA END OF IT SHE SAYS: "RIGHT. DINNER. YOU HAB EARNED IT BY BEING INTERESTIN'."

a1.text: DA TRAM GOES TWO STOPS PAST DA DEPOT, WHICH DA DEPOT IZ NO DESIGNED TA PERMIT, AN' DA DOORS OPEN ON SOMEWHERE DAT HAB A RIVER IN IT AN' A TABLE BY DA RIVER WIT TWO PLACES LAID!
a1.emText:
DA TRAM GOES TWO STOPS PAST DA DEPOT ONTO A LINE DAT DOES NO EXIST, AN' DA DOORS OPEN ON A RIVER AN' A TABLE WIT THREE PLACES LAID, AN' ONE OF DEM HAB BUBBA'S HAT ON DA CHAIR ALREADY, WHICH SHE DID WITOUT LOOKIN'.
YA IZ DA CHAIR WIT DA WOBBLY LEG. IT IZ GOING TA BE A LONG EVENIN' AN' EVERY LIL' TINK IN IT IZ GOING TA GO SLIGHTLY WRONG FOR YOU AN' PERFECTLY FOR EVERYBODY ELSE, AN' SHE IZ GOING TA BE CHARMIN' 'BOUT IT DA ENTIRE TIME!

a2.text:
"NO," YOU SAY, ON A TRAM, TA DA GODDESS OF DISCORD, AN' SHE TAKES IT PERFECTLY WELL.
SHE GETS OFF AT DA DEPOT. EVERYTINK ON DAT TRAM WORKS NORMALLY AFTERWARDS. FOR DA BEST PART OF A WEEK EVERYTINK IN YA LIFE IZ EXACTLY AS CONVENIENT AS IT SHOULD BE, WHICH IZ HOW YOU KNOW SHE IZ NO FINISHED, COZ NUTTIN' IZ EVER DAT CONVENIENT!

b1.text:
"COSTS?" SHE LOOKS GENUINELY PUZZLED. "IT COSTS AN EVENIN'. YOU WILL BE HALF A SHIFT OLDER AN' YOU WILL HAB EATEN."
DEN, COZ SHE IZ HONEST IN DA WAY DAT ONLY SOMETINK WIT NO NEED TA LIE CAN BE: "AN' ME WILL KNOW YOU BETTER. DAT IZ DA BIT YOU IZ WORRIED 'BOUT, AN' YOU IZ RIGHT TA BE."

c_m.text:
YOU GET OFF AT DA NEXT STOP AN' DA TRAM GOES ON WITOUT YOU AN' DA NEXT ONE IZ NO FOR {ELEVEN HOURS|DA MORNIN'|A REAL LONG TIME}.
DA STOP HAB A SHELTER AN' A TIMETABLE AN' A BENCH, AN' ON DA BENCH DERE IZ {A COAT|HER COAT|SOMETINK} FOLDED, AN' IT WAZ NO DERE WHEN DA TRAM PULLED IN, AN' IT IZ DA RIGHT SIZE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DO NO PUT DA COAT ON.|SHE GOT OFF BEFORE US AN' SHE DID NO GET OFF.|DAT IZ A HOOK WIT A SLEEVE IN IT.}"
asides.any: {member} {SITS DOWN NEXT TA IT|READS DA TIMETABLE AGAIN|LOOKS UP DA LINE}

choices.text: LEAVE IT ON DA BENCH. WAIT FOR MORNIN'!
PUT IT ON. IT IZ DA REST OF DA SHIFT AN' IT IZ COLD!
WALK DA LINE BACK INTO TOWN!

c_coat.text:
IT IZ WARM AN' IT FITS AN' DERE IZ {SOMETINK|A CARD|A TICKET} IN DA INSIDE POCKET, AN' DA ELEVEN HOURS PASS IN WHAT FEELS LIKE {FOUR|TWO|THREE}.
IT IZ STILL A GOOD COAT IN DA MORNIN'. IT IZ A GOOD COAT FOR YEARS. EVERY SO OFTEN DERE IZ SOMETINK IN DAT POCKET DAT WAZ NO IN IT DA NIGHT BEFORE, AN' IT IZ NEVER ANYTINK BIG, AN' IT IZ ALWAYS SOMETINK DAT WAZ NEEDED DAT DAY!

c_walk.text:
A SHORT DRIVE OF TRAM LINE ON FOOT AT {ONE IN DA MORNIN'|DA DEAD HOUR|WHATEVER TIME IT IZ}, WHICH IZ NO DIFFICULT AN' IZ NO SENSIBLE AN' IZ AT LEAST A DECISION.
AT DA THIRD STOP DA LAST TRAM OF DA NIGHT IZ STANDIN' WIT ITS LIGHTS ON AN' ITS DOORS OPEN AN' NOBODY ON IT, AN' IT IZ {FACIN' DA WRONG WAY|POINTED BACK OUT OF TOWN|ON DA WRONG TRACK}, AN' DA PARTY IZ WELCOME TA GET ON!

z_eris_bet.title: {A BET ON A GAME NOBODY IZ PLAYIN'|TWO TA ONE ON DA LEFT-HAND ONE|SHE HAB ALREADY PAID OUT}

n0.text:
{eris} IZ STANDIN' AT A WALL WIT A BETTIN' SLIP IN HER HAND, WATCHIN' TWO PIGEONS.
"LEFT-HAND ONE," SHE SAYS. "TWO TA ONE. YOU IN?"
ZERO RACE. ZERO BOOKMAKER. DERE IZ TWO PIGEONS ON A WALL, AN' ONE OF DEM IZ GOING TA DO SOMETINK, AN' SHE HAB ALREADY WRITTEN DA PAYOUT ON DA SLIP.
DA BETTIN' SLIP IN HER HAND IZ {FILLED IN|WRITTEN ON|ALREADY MARKED} AN' IT IZ FOR A RACE DAT FINISHED {A COUPLE OF YEARS AGO|A LONG TIME AGO|IN DA SPRING}!
n0.emText:
{eris} AT A WALL WIT A BETTIN' SLIP, WATCHIN' TWO PIGEONS. "LEFT-HAND ONE. TWO TA ONE. YOU IN?"
SHE HAB ALREADY WRITTEN DA PAYOUT. BEHIND YOU, DA STRAP ON YA PACK GIVES WAY FOR NO REASON, AN' YA BOOTLACE GOES, AN' SOMEBODY'S WATCH STOPS, AN' SHE DOES NO LOOK ROUND, COZ LOOKIN' ROUND WOULD BE ADMITTIN' IT!

choices.text: TAKE DA BET.
OFFER HER A DIFFERENT BET!
ASK WHY SHE IZ STANDIN' AT A WALL BETTIN' ON PIGEONS!

a.text:

"GO ON DEN," SHE SAYS. "BUT IF YOU WIN ME IZ BUYIN' DINNER, AN' IF YOU LOSE ME IZ BUYIN' DINNER. DAT IZ DA STANDARD TERMS AN' ME NEVER CHANGE DEM."

c.text:

d.text:

FOUR STREETS ON DERE IZ A BOOKMAKER'S, AN' IN DA WINDOW DERE IZ {A RESULT BOARD|DA DAY'S RESULTS|A CARD}, AN' DA RACE ON HER SLIP IZ ON IT, AN' IT {RAN DIS MORNIN'|IZ TODAY'S|HAB JUST BIN SETTLED}, AN' IT FINISHED FOUR YEARS AGO!

GO IN AN' ASK 'BOUT DA RACE!

d_race.text:

HE DOES NO KNOW WHY AN' HE DOES NO ASK AN' HE PAYS OUT ON BOTH, AN' HIS BOOKS BALANCE, WHICH IZ DA PART DAT HAB KEPT HIM AWAKE SINCE {1974|DA SEVENTIES|HE TOOK OVER DA SHOP}!

c_m.text:

DEN SHE ASKS, WITOUT TURNIN' ROUND, WHETHER DA PARTY WOULD LIKE TA TAKE DA WATCHIN' OVER FOR {AN HOUR|DA AFTERNOON|A WHILE}, AN' SAYS IT DA WAY A PERSON ASKS A STRANGER TA MIND A BAG!

ASK WHAT SHE IZ NO WATCHIN'!
SAY NO, KINDLY, AN' STAY WIT HER INSTEAD!

AN HOUR AT A WALL WATCHIN' TWO PIGEONS, DELIBERATELY, WIT EVERYTINK ELSE IN DA WORLD {GOING ON BEHIND|HAPPENIN' ELSEWHERE|CAREFULLY NO BEING LOOKED AT}.
NUTTIN' HAPPENS IN DA HOUR, WHICH IZ DA WHOLE POINT AN' IZ DA HARDEST TINK ANY OF DA PARTY HAB EVER BIN ASKED TA DO. SHE COMES BACK AT DA END OF IT WIT {CHIPS|TWO COFFEES|NUTTIN' AT ALL} AN' TAKES DA WATCHIN' BACK AN' SAYS DAT IT IZ DA FIRST HOUR OFF SHE HAB HAB IN {FOUR HUNDRED YEARS|A REAL LONG TIME|LONGER DEN SHE WILL SAY}!

DA FOURTH ONE IZ {ON DA SPARE|DA WHEEL DAT WAZ ALREADY ON DA BACK|DA ONE NOBODY HAB USED}!

ASK HER TA STOP.
ACCUSE HER.
CHANGE DA FOURTH WHEEL AN' SAY NUTTIN'!

a.text:
YOU SIT ON A CRASH BARRIER AN' EAT SOMEBODY ELSE'S CHIPS AT DA WRONG HOUR OF DA AFTERNOON, AN' DA TRAFFIC GOES PAST, AN' IT IZ, UNEXPECTEDLY, QUITE NICE.
AFTER 'BOUT DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR SHE SAYS: "DERE IZ A PLACE A FEW KILOMETRES ON DAT DOES DIS PROPERLY. REAL FOOD."

"ALL RIGHT. ASK ME PROPERLY. ASK ME FOR SOMETINK. NOBODY ASKS ME FOR ANYTINK, DEY ONLY EVER ASK ME TA STOP."
b.emText:

"YOU WANT ME TA STOP. EVERYBODY WANTS ME TA STOP. HE LOOKS AT YOU LIKE DAT, YOU KNOW," SHE SAYS, NODDIN' AT BUBBA WITOUT LOOKIN' AT HIM, "AN' YOU NO EVEN NOTICE, AN' DAT IZ DA SINGLE MOST ANNOYIN' TINK 'BOUT YOU, AN' IT IZ NO GOING TA MAKE ME STOP."
DEN, AFTER A MOMENT, DIFFERENTLY: "ASK ME FOR SOMETINK INSTEAD."

DA TYRES HOLD FOR ELEVEN THOUSAND KILOMETRES AFTER DAT. ALL FOUR OF DEM. ON A SET DAT WAZ SECOND HAND WHEN YOU BOUGHT DEM!

b1.text: YOU ASK HER FOR AN EVENIN', WHICH IZ DA TINK SHE HAB BIN STANDIN' IN FOUR LAY-BYS WAITIN' TA BE ASKED FOR, AN' DA CHANGE IN HER IZ IMMEDIATE AN' SLIGHTLY FRIGHTENIN'!

IT GOES RIGHT. IT GOES RIGHT IN A WAY DAT IZ SO SMOOTH AN' SO TOTAL DAT FOR A FORTNIGHT AFTERWARDS YOU KEEP WAITIN' FOR DA BILL, AN' DERE IZ NO BILL, AN' DAT IZ SOMEHOW DA MOST UNSETTLIN' TINK SHE HAB DONE ALL WEEK!

TELL HER YOU WILL NO SENTENCE A STRANGER!

a.text:
YOU READ ELEVEN PAGES OF SOMEBODY'S WORST YEAR AN' YOU SAY A NUMBER OUT LOUD IN AN EMPTY COURTROOM.
SHE WRITES IT DOWN. SHE DOES NO CHANGE IT. DEN SHE CLOSES DA FILE, AN' LOOKS AT YOU FOR A WHILE, AN' SAYS: "DAT IZ WHAT ME HAB. COME AN' EAT SOMETINK, ME HAB BIN IN HERE SINCE TUESDAY."

b.text:
"ME NO WILL SENTENCE SOMEBODY ME HAB NEVER MET."
SHE PUTS HER FEET DOWN. "NO," SHE SAYS. "NO, DAT IZ RIGHT. DAT IZ DA CORRECT ANSWER AN' ME HAB NO HEARD IT IN A REAL LONG TIME AN' ME IZ GOING TA BE ANNOYED 'BOUT IT FOR A WEEK."
SHE CLOSES DA FILE. DA SENTENCE SHE EVENTUALLY HANDS DOWN IZ A COUPLE OF YEARS LIGHTER DEN DA ONE SHE HAB WRITTEN, AN' SHE NEVER TELLS ANYBODY WHY!

c.text:
"COZ HE'S GUILTY AN' IT NO MATTER," SHE SAYS. "COZ EVERYBODY IN DA FILE IZ GUILTY AN' DA BOUNTY IZ A MACHINE AN' DA MACHINE IZ ME AN' ME BUILT IT IN AN AFTERNOON COZ NOBODY ELSE WOULD."
IT IZ DA CLOSEST SHE COMES TA SAYIN' SHE IZ FRIGHTENED OF DA TINK SHE MADE, AN' SHE GETS UP HALFWAY THROUGH AN' STARTS STACKIN' DA FILES, WHICH IZ WHAT SHE DOES INSTEAD OF FINISHIN' DAT SENTENCE!

d.text:
SHE IZ DELIGHTED. SHE GETS IT OUT OF DA STACK IMMEDIATELY, WHICH MEANS IT WAZ IN DA STACK.
IT IZ FOUR PAGES LONG. TWO OF DEM IZ 'BOUT TINKZ YOU HAB DONE. ONE IZ 'BOUT TINKZ YOU IZ GOING TA DO. AN' DA FOURTH IZ SOMEBODY ELSE'S HANDWRITIN' ENTIRELY AN' IT IZ DATED BEFORE YOU WAZ BORN!

IT IZ FOUR PAGES. TWO IZ 'BOUT WHAT YOU HAB DONE. ONE IZ 'BOUT WHAT YOU IZ GOING TA DO. DA FOURTH IZ IN A HAND DAT IZ NO HERS AN' IZ DATED 1984, DA YEAR YOU WAZ BORN IN WIMBLEDON, AN' DA ONLY TINK WRITTEN ON IT IZ A LIST OF WHAT WAZ TAKEN AN' WHERE EACH PART OF IT WENT.
SHE WATCHES YOU READ IT. "ME IZ NO ALLOWED TA GIVE YOU DAT," SHE SAYS, AN' DOES NO TAKE IT BACK!

DA WALTZER WILL THROW YOU INTO DA RAIL. DA HOOK-A-DUCK WILL NO HOOK. DA CANDY FLOSS WILL GO IN YA HAIR. SHE HAB ARRANGED ALL OF IT AN' SHE HAB ALSO, GENUINELY, BOUGHT A FAIR FOR AN AFTERNOON COZ SHE WANTED COMPANY, AN' BOTH OF DOZE TINKZ IZ TRUE AT ONCE AN' DAT IZ DA ENTIRE PROBLEM WIT HER!
n0.bubba: BUBBA IZ ON DA WALTZER BEFORE DA SENTENCE IZ FINISHED, HAT IN DA AIR. "AOOOH! JAMME JA'! SUGAR, GET ON, SHE PAID!"

asides.hedonistic: {member} IZ GONE. {member} HAB BIN GONE SINCE DA WORD 'WALTZER'!
asides.nervous: {member} {SWEATS INSIDE DEY HELMET AN' ASKS HOW MUCH AIR WE HAB LEFT|KEEPS LOOKIN' BACK TOWARD DA LANDER WIT WIDE EYES|JUMPS AT EVERY CREAK IN DA HULL|WONDERS ALOUD IF WE CAN JUST LEAVE RIGHT NOW}
asides.artistic: {member} SAYS AN EMPTY FAIR WIT DA LIGHTS ON IZ DA MOST BEAUTIFUL TINK DEY HAB SEEN SINCE {timeAgo}!
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO ON EVERYTINK. ALL OF IT. TWICE!
ASK HER WHY.
GET DA OPERATORS OUT OF DA VAN AN' OPEN DA FAIR TA DA TOWN!
WIN HER SOMETINK OFF A STALL!

a.text: A COUPLE OF HOURS OF AN EMPTY FAIR WIT DA LIGHTS ON AN' NOBODY QUEUEIN', AN' DA WALTZER AT A SPEED DA OPERATORS WOULD NEVER ALLOW, AN' HOT SUGAR, AN' A BIG WHEEL STOPPED AT DA TOP FOR ELEVEN MINUTES COZ SHE WANTED TA LOOK AT DA TOWN!

b.text:
"COZ EVERYBODY ME MEET IZ EITHER IN FRONT OF ME OR RUNNIN'," SHE SAYS, LOOKIN' AT DA WALTZER RATHER DEN AT YOU. "AN' ME WANTED AN AFTERNOON WHERE NOBODY WAZ DOING EITHER."
DEN SHE TEARS ONE TICKET OFF DA ROLL AN' HANDS IT TA YOU AN' SAYS: "RIGHT. DAT IZ DA LAST HONEST TINK ME IZ SAYIN' TODAY. BIG WHEEL."

c.text:
IT TAKES TEN MINUTES TA GET DA OPERATORS OUT OF DA VAN AN' 'BOUT A LONG MINUTE AFTER DAT FOR DA FIRST FOUR CHILDREN TA ARRIVE, AN' BY FIVE O'CLOCK DERE IZ TWO HUNDRED PEOPLE ON A FAIR DAT WAZ BOUGHT FOR AN AFTERNOON BY ONE PERSON.
SHE STANDS AT DA GATE WIT DA ROLL OF TICKETS AN' WATCHES IT FILL UP. SHE DOES NO SAY ANYTINK FOR A LONG TIME. DEN SHE STARTS TEARIN' TICKETS AN' HANDIN' DEM OUT, AN' SHE IZ STILL DOING IT AT SIX!

d.text:
EVERY STALL ON DAT FAIR IZ RIGGED AN' SHE RIGGED FOUR MORE OF DEM ON TOP FOR DA FUN OF IT, AN' YOU WIN ANYWAY, AN' WHAT YOU WIN IZ A PLASTIC TINK WORTH 'BOUT ELEVEN CENTS.
SHE TAKES IT, AN' LOOKS AT IT, AN' PUTS IT IN HER COAT POCKET, AN' DOES NO MENTION IT AGAIN, AN' IT IZ IN DAT POCKET FOR YEARS!

a_m.text:
FOUR HOURS OF AN EMPTY FAIR WIT DA LIGHTS ON AN' NOBODY QUEUEIN', AN' DA WALTZER AT A SPEED DA OPERATORS WOULD NEVER HAB ALLOWED.
AT 'BOUT DA THIRD HOUR DA GENERATOR {COUGHS|STUMBLES|RUNS ROUGH}, AN' EVERY LIGHT ON DA FIELD DIPS, AN' IN DA HALF-SECOND OF DARK DA FAIR IZ {NO EMPTY|FULL|DA WAY A FAIR IZ ON A SATURDAY} AN' EVERY RIDE HAB PEOPLE ON IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DERE WAZ FOUR HUNDRED PEOPLE HERE FOR HALF A SECOND.|DO NO ASK HER. LOOK AT HER FACE.|WE IZ DA ONES WHO IZ NO HERE.}"
asides.any: {member} {STOPS DA WALTZER|LOOKS AT HER|COUNTS WHAT DEY SAW}

choices.text: SAY NUTTIN' AN' GO ON DA WALTZER AGAIN!
GO AN' FIX DA GENERATOR.
ASK HER WHOSE FAIR DIS IZ!

a_gen.text:
IT IZ {A FUEL FILTER|DA GOVERNOR|A LEAD} AN' IT TAKES {TEN MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|NO TIME} ON A FIELD WIT A TORCH HELD BY A GODDESS WHO IZ GENUINELY INTERESTED IN WHAT YOU IZ DOING WIT A SCREWDRIVER.
DA LIGHTS COME UP AN' STAY UP AN' DO NO DIP AGAIN. DA FAIR RUNS UNTIL {FOUR IN DA MORNIN'|IT GETS LIGHT|DA GENERATOR IZ DRY}, AN' NOBODY ELSE EVER APPEARS ON IT, AN' SHE DOES NO SAY THANK YOU AN' DOES SOMETINK CONSIDERABLY BETTER INSTEAD!

a_whose.text:
SHE GIVES DA ANSWER STRAIGHT: DA FAIR BELONGS TA {DA FOUR HUNDRED|DA PEOPLE IN DA HALF-SECOND|WHOEVER WAZ ON IT}, AN' IT HAB BIN RUNNIN' FOR DEM SINCE {DA NIGHT IT CLOSED|A PARTICULAR EVENIN'|DA YEAR OF DA ACCIDENT}, AN' SHE COMES TA IT COZ IT IZ DA ONLY PLACE SHE GOES WHERE NOBODY IZ IN FRONT OF HER OR RUNNIN'.
WHAT SHE IZ DOING, ON A FIELD, AT DAT SPEED, WIT DA LIGHTS ON, IZ {QUEUEIN'|WAITIN' HER TURN|BEING ONE OF DEM}, AN' SHE HAB NEVER TOLD ANYBODY DAT!

q_beacon.title: {DA KEEPER'S LIST|WHAT DA MAST NEEDS|DEAD AIR}

n0.text:
{brokenthing} STANDS OVER {place}, DEAD, PANELS OPEN TA {ground}. {asker} IZ HALFWAY UP IT WIT {instrument} AN' COMES DOWN WITOUT HURRYIN', COZ HURRYIN' STOPPED HELPIN' {A WHILE AGO|ON DAY TWO|BEFORE DA PARTY LANDED}.
DA LIST OF WHAT IT NEEDS IZ SHORT. IT NEEDS {qty} {material}. {sound}, AN' DA MAST DOES NUTTIN' 'BOUT IT. HE LETS YOU HEAR DAT.
{member} WALKS DA MAST'S FOOTIN' WHILE DA TALKIN' HAPPENS AN' FINDS DA SAME TINK TWICE: DA ANCHOR BOLTS HAB BIN OUT AN' BACK IN, RECENTLY, BY SOMEBODY WHO DID NO HAB DA RIGHT SPANNER AN' DID NO CARE.
WHOEVER SERVICED DIS LAST WAZ NO DA KEEPER!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: HAND OVER DA {material}.
FIX IT OUT OF DA SHIP'S OWN SPARES!
ASK WHAT A WORKIN' MAST IZ WORTH FIRST!

b.text:
DA KEEPER THINKS 'BOUT IT {FOR NINE SECONDS|A WHILE|WITOUT BLINKIN'}. PAYMENT IZ NAMED: {payment}.
DA MAST, IT IZ MENTIONED ON DA WAY BACK UP, WAZ LISTENIN' FOR WHAT MOVES OUT HERE BEFORE IT WENT DARK. IT HAB NO BIN LISTENIN' FOR {few} DAYS NOW, AN' DA KEEPER HAB BIN SLEEPIN' IN SHIFTS OF ONE!

choices.text: DAT WILL DO. HAND OVER DA {material}!
NO AT DAT PRICE.

g.text:
DA PANELS CLOSE OVER DA NEW {material} AN' DA MAST COMES BACK WIT A SOUND LIKE A STRUCK SHELF.
DA FIRST TINK IT HEARS GETS WRITTEN OUT LONGHAND AN' HANDED OVER, ALONG WIT WHAT WAZ PROMISED, AN' DA KEEPER {STOPS SLEEPIN' IN SHIFTS|SLEEPS A WHOLE NIGHT FOR ONCE|PUTS DA KETTLE ON AN' SITS DOWN}!

f.text:
IT TAKES {AN AFTERNOON|HALF A SHIFT|DA REST OF DA LIGHT} AN' IT IZ NO PRETTY, BUT A GOVERNOR OFF DA SHIP'S OWN STORES WILL HOLD DA LOAD IF NOBODY TELLS IT WHAT IT USED TA BE.
DA MAST COMES UP. DA KEEPER PAYS OVER DA ODDS, ON DA GROUNDS DAT A FIX DAT COSTS DA FIXER IZ A DIFFERENT {CLASS OF FIX|KIND OF FIX ALTOGETHER|ORDER OF FAVOUR}!

x.text:
DA SPARE DAT FIT WAZ NO A SPARE. SOMETINK BACK AT DA SHIP WILL MISS IT AT DA WORST POSSIBLE MOMENT, AN' DA FLYWHEEL HAB ONE MORE TURN IN IT, WHICH {leader} FINDS OUT AT CLOSE RANGE.
DA MAST STAYS DARK. DA KEEPER SAYS NUTTIN', WHICH IZ {WORSE DEN SAYIN' SOMETINK|WORSE DEN ANYTINK DEY COULD SAY|DA WORST OF DA AVAILABLE RESPONSES}!

e.text:
DA MAST STAYS DARK AN' DA KEEPER GOES BACK UP IT, ALONE, WIT DA WHISTLE IN DA REBREATHER KEEPIN' ITS OWN TIME.
{member} TAKES A BEARIN' ON DA SITE {IN CASE|FOR DA LOG|WITOUT BEING ASKED}, AN' NOBODY TALKS FOR DA FIRST KILOMETRE BACK!

g_m.text:
DA PANELS COME OFF PROPERLY DIS TIME AN' DA FAULT IZ NO DA FAULT DA KEEPER DESCRIBED. {DA {material} WILL FIT|DA PART WILL GO IN|IT WILL TAKE DA {material}}, BUT IT WILL FIT OVER DA TOP OF SOMETINK DAT WAZ PUT IN WRONG ON PURPOSE: A SHUNT, HAND-MADE, WIT DA MAKER'S INITIALS FILED HALFWAY OFF.
DA KEEPER WATCHES DA PARTY FIND IT AN' SAYS NUTTIN' AT ALL, WHICH IZ ITS OWN KIND OF ANSWER!

asides.cynical: {member}, QUIETLY: "{SOMEONE WANTED DIS MAST DEAF.|DAT IZ SABOTAGE WIT A SIGNATURE ON IT.|SOMEBODY PAID FOR DIS SILENCE.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A THUMB OVER DA FILED INITIALS AN' LOOKS AT DA HORIZON|PHOTOGRAPHS DA SHUNT BEFORE ANYBODY CAN OBJECT|COUNTS DA DAYS SINCE DA MAST WENT DARK, OUT LOUD}

choices.text: FIT DA {material} OVER DA SHUNT. NO OUR SKY, NO OUR ARGUMENT!
PULL DA SHUNT AN' READ WHAT IZ FILED OFF IT!
ASK DA KEEPER WHO HAB BIN UP DA MAST BESIDES DEM!

g_name.text:
UNDER DA FILE MARKS DA INITIALS COME BACK UP IN RAKIN' LIGHT, AN' DEY IZ A STATION CODE, AN' DA STATION IZ {THREE VALLEYS OVER|ONE RIDGE EAST|DA ONLY OTHER TINK OUT HERE WIT POWER}.
DA MAST GOES UP WORKIN'. DA KEEPER WRITES DA CODE ON DA INSIDE OF DA PANEL DOOR IN A HAND DAT PRESSES TOO HARD, AN' PAYS DA PARTY IN WHAT DEY CAME FOR AN' A LIL' MORE, FOR DA PART OF DA JOB NOBODY ASKED FOR!

g_burn.text:
DA SHUNT COMES OUT OF DA HOUSIN' {LIVE|HOT|STILL CARRYIN'}, WHICH NOBODY EXPECTED OF A MAST DAT HAB BIN DEAD FOR {few} DAYS, AN' IT TAKES DA SKIN OFF TWO FINGERS ON DA WAY.
DA MAST WORKS AFTERWARDS. DA INITIALS IZ GONE FOR GOOD, BURNED FLAT BY DEY OWN LAST TRICK, AN' DA KEEPER PAYS WHAT WAZ AGREED AN' NO A COIN OVER!

g_told.text:
NOBODY, SAYS DA KEEPER. DEN, AFTER DA LENGTH OF TIME IT TAKES TA DECIDE TA SAY A TRUE TINK: NOBODY SINCE DA SUPPLY RUN, AN' DA SUPPLY RUN WAZ {TWO|THREE} MEN AN' ONE OF DEM WENT UP DA MAST TA BE HELPFUL.
DA {material} GOES IN. DA MAST COMES UP. DA KEEPER GIVES DA PARTY DA SUPPLY MANIFEST AS WELL AS DA PAYMENT, AN' ASKS, WITOUT ASKIN', DAT SOMEBODY LOOK AT DA NAMES ON IT LATER!

f_m.text:
DA SHIP'S SPARES IZ LAID OUT ON A SHEET ON {ground} AN' DERE IZ EXACTLY ONE GOVERNOR IN DA BOX DAT WILL TAKE DA LOAD, AN' IT IZ DA ONE DA SHIP IZ CURRENTLY USING.
{asker} UNDERSTANDS DA ARITHMETIC BEFORE ANYBODY EXPLAINS IT, AN' OFFERS, SERIOUSLY, TA TRADE SOMETINK BACK: DA MAST'S OWN RECORDER, WIT {few} DAYS OF DEAD AIR ON IT AN' DA LAST HOUR BEFORE DA DARK ON DA FRONT OF DA REEL!

choices.text: TAKE DA GOVERNOR OUT OF DA SHIP. BOTH OF US LIMP!
TAKE DA RECORDER INSTEAD AN' BUILD A GOVERNOR OUT OF SCRAP!
LEAVE DA SHIP WHOLE. TELL DEM WHAT TA ORDER!

f_reel.text:
DA SCRAP GOVERNOR IZ UGLY, UNDERSIZED AN' CORRECT, AN' IT COMES UP ON DA SECOND ATTEMPT WIT DA LOAD SINGIN' THROUGH IT.
DA REEL IZ DA PAYMENT AN' DA REEL IZ WORTH IT: DA LAST HOUR BEFORE DA MAST WENT DARK HAB SOMETINK ON IT DAT WAZ NO WEATHER, REPEATIN', PATIENT, AN' GETTIN' {CLOSER|LOUDER|NEARER} ON EVERY PASS!

f_bodge.text:
DA SCRAP GOVERNOR HOLDS FOR {ELEVEN|NINE|SIX} MINUTES AN' DEN LETS GO IN A WAY DAT PUTS DA WHOLE MAST HEAD THROUGH ITS OWN CYCLE AT ONCE.
NUTTIN' IZ {ON FIRE|ACTUALLY ALIGHT|BURNIN'} AFTERWARDS, WHICH EVERYONE AGREES IZ DA GOOD NEWS. DA REEL IZ IN DA PARTY'S PACK AN' DA MAST IZ STILL DARK AN' DA KEEPER HAB STOPPED BEING POLITE 'BOUT IT!

f_order.text:
IT TAKES AN HOUR TA WRITE DOWN EXACTLY WHAT TA ORDER, IN DA PART NUMBERS DA SUPPLY RUN WILL ACTUALLY RECOGNISE, WIT DA TWO SUBSTITUTIONS DAT WILL ALSO WORK IN DA MARGIN.
DA MAST STAYS DARK FOR {ANOTHER FORTNIGHT|THREE MORE WEEKS|A WHILE YET}. DA KEEPER SAYS SO, AN' SHAKES HANDS ANYWAY, AN' DA PARTY LEAVES WIT NUTTIN' EXCEPT SOMEBODY A LONG WAY OUT HERE WHO WILL REMEMBER DEM!

q_stranded.title: {TWO HUNDRED DAYS|DA LANDER AT DA WRONG ANGLE|PARTS AN' SKY}

n0.text:
A LANDER SITS AT {place} AT DA WRONG ANGLE, AN' {asker} HAB BIN LIVIN' IN IT {LONG ENOUGH TA HAB A SYSTEM|LONG ENOUGH TA HAB OPINIONS 'BOUT DA VIEW|SINCE BEFORE DA LAST STORM SEASON}.
DA ASK IZ EXACT, REHEARSED, WORD-PERFECT: {qty} {material}, FOR DA {STABILISER|FUEL GOVERNOR|COIL HOUSIN'}, AN' DEN DA SKY AGAIN. {wrongness}.
DA GROUND AROUND DA LANDER IZ WRONG IN A WAY DAT TAKES A MINUTE TA NAME: DERE IZ NO PATHS WORN INTO IT. TWO HUNDRED DAYS OF LIVIN' SOMEWHERE AN' NUTTIN' HAB WALKED ANYWHERE TWICE!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: HAND IT OVER AN' HELP WIT DA FITTIN'!
SOMETINK HERE IZ OFF. LOOK DA LANDER OVER FIRST!
OFFER A LIFT INSTEAD OF PARTS!

h.text:
DA FITTIN' TAKES AN HOUR AN' DA CASTAWAY'S HANDS KNOW DA WORK BETTER DEN DA MANUAL DOES.
PAYMENT IZ DA ONLY COIN LEFT ABOARD: SOMETINK LEARNED IN TWO HUNDRED DAYS OF LISTENIN' TA {tone}, TAUGHT ON DA WALK BACK TA DA PAD, ONCE, PROPERLY, WIT {DA WIND FOR A BLACKBOARD|DA WIND TAKIN' MOST OF IT|NUTTIN' TA WRITE ON BUT DA AIR}!

w.text:
DA LANDER HAB NEVER FLOWN. DA UNDERCARRIAGE GROWS STRAIGHT OUT OF {ground}, AN' UNDER DA HULL DERE IZ {many} LIL' HEAPS OF DA KIND OF KIT A COURIER CARRIES AN' A COURIER IZ NEVER PARTED FROM.
WHATEVER IZ DOING DA ASKIN' HAB BIN FED BY DA ASKIN' FOR A LONG TIME!

choices.text: BACK AWAY WITOUT CHANGIN' PACE!
PUT IT DOWN, HERE, WHERE IT SLEEPS!

t.text:
IT LOOKS LIKE A LANDER RIGHT UP UNTIL {DA HOLD CLOSES|IT OPENS ALONG A SEAM NO LANDER HAB|DA RAMP COMES DOWN DA WRONG WAY}.
IT IZ NO {A HOLD|ANYTINK OF DA KIND|A HOLD AN' NEVER WAZ}!

k.text: IT STOPS PRETENDIN' DA MOMENT {DA FIRST SHOT GOES IN|ANYBODY RAISES ANYTINK|IT IZ LOOKED AT PROPERLY}, AN' DA LANDER SHAPE COMES OFF IT {LIKE WEATHER|DA WAY A COAT COMES OFF|IN ONE LONG MOTION}!

l.text:
DA LIFT IZ REFUSED {FAST|FLATLY|BEFORE IT IZ FULLY OFFERED}, WIT BOTH HANDS, BEFORE DA SENTENCE IZ EVEN FINISHED.
PARTS, IT SAYS. PARTS AN' NUTTIN' ELSE. NO LOOK AT DA PARTY WHEN IT SAYS IT; IT LOOKS AT {DA PACK|DA STRAPS|WHAT IZ IN DA PACK} DA PARTY IZ CARRYIN'!

choices.text: HAND OVER DA {material} DEN.
LEAVE, AN' KEEP DA PACK ON DA FAR SIDE OF DA GROUP!

e2.text:
DA LANDER IZ STILL IN DA MIRRORS A LONG WAY PAST WHERE {DA HORIZON|DA CURVE OF DA GROUND|DISTANCE ITSELF} SHOULD HAB TAKEN IT.
NOBODY SUGGESTS GOING BACK FOR A SECOND LOOK, AN' NOBODY {HAB TA SAY WHY|SAYS WHY|ASKS WHY}!

h_m.text:
DA STABILISER BAY IZ OPEN BEFORE DA PARTY HAB FINISHED AGREEIN', AN' DA HANDS WORKIN' IN IT IZ GOOD HANDS, FAST AN' SURE AN' ENTIRELY WRONG AT DA WRISTS.
DA FITTIN' WILL TAKE AN HOUR. DA CASTAWAY TALKS DA WHOLE TIME, AN' EVERYTINK IT SAYS 'BOUT TWO HUNDRED DAYS HERE IZ {TRUE, CHECKABLE AN' DULL|VERIFIABLE AN' BORIN'|DA KIND OF DETAIL NOBODY INVENTS}, WHICH IZ DA PART DAT WILL BOTHER {member} LATER!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{NOBODY IZ DIS NORMAL.|IT IZ DOING AN IMPRESSION OF A PERSON AN' IT HAB PRACTISED.|NUTTIN' OUT HERE TALKS DIS MUCH.}"
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS DA PACK ON DA FAR SIDE OF DA GROUP WITOUT BEING OBVIOUS 'BOUT IT|WATCHES DA WRISTS|DOES NO PUT ANYTINK DOWN}

choices.text: FIT DA PART AN' TAKE DA PAYMENT!
WATCH ITS HANDS AN' NAME WHAT IZ WRONG WIT DEM!
FIT DA PART, TAKE NUTTIN', LEAVE EARLY!

h_wrist.text:
{DA WRISTS DO NO ROTATE.|DA WRISTS NEVER TURN.|NUTTIN' AT DA WRIST MOVES AT ALL.} DA WHOLE FOREARM TURNS INSTEAD, SMOOTHLY, IN A SOCKET UNLIKE ANYTINK IN ANY BODY DA PARTY HAB EVER OPENED, AN' ONCE IT IZ SEEN IT STAYS SEEN.
IT NOTICES BEING SEEN. DA HOUR ENDS DERE, POLITELY, ON BOTH SIDES, WIT DA PART FITTED AN' DA PARTY WALKIN' BACKWARDS FOR DA FIRST {FORTY|FIFTY|SIXTY} METRES!

h_late.text:
DA HOUR GOES BY AN' DA HANDS IZ ONLY HANDS, AN' IT IZ A LONG WAY BACK TA DA PAD BEFORE {member} WORKS OUT WHAT WAZ WRONG WIT DEM, WHICH IZ DA WORST POSSIBLE TIME TA WORK IT OUT.
DA LESSON DAT WAZ TAUGHT ON DA WALK BACK IZ REAL. SO IZ DA FEELIN', ARRIVIN' LATE, DAT DA LESSON WAZ DA POINT OF DA ENTIRE AFTERNOON!

h_early.text:
DA PART GOES IN, DA PAYMENT IZ DECLINED TWICE, AN' DA PARTY IZ OVER DA RIDGE BEFORE DA LIGHT GOES.
NUTTIN' FOLLOWS. {member} CHECKS ANYWAY, {MORE DEN ONCE|TWICE, DEN ONCE MORE|AT EVERY RISE}, AN' DA LANDER SITS AT ITS WRONG ANGLE GETTIN' SMALLER, AN' NUTTIN' FOLLOWS!

q_cache.title: {SEALED ON PURPOSE|DA CASE UNDER DA ICE|WHAT DA SEAL IZ FOR}

n0.text:
A CASE OF {maker}'S MAKE SITS UNDER {remnant}, SEALED, WIT {A DIAL DAT TURNS TOO SMOOTHLY|A LATCH DAT HAB BIN FORCED ONCE ALREADY AN' RESET|WRITIN' WORN DOWN TA DENTS}.
{instrument} READS SOMETINK INSIDE WORTH DA WALK. {hazard}, SO DA WALK WAZ NO FREE EITHER.
DA DENTS IN DA LID IZ WRITIN', AN' DA WRITIN' WAZ DONE FROM DA INSIDE!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.impulsive: {member} HAB ALREADY TRIED DA LATCH ONCE, GENTLY, AS A SCIENTIFIC MATTER!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WORK DA SEAL PROPERLY.
BREAK IT.
LEAVE IT SEALED.

a.text:
DA SEAL GIVES DA WAY A GOOD SEAL GIVES: {ALL AT ONCE, UNDAMAGED, ALMOST GRATEFULLY|CLEANLY, WITOUT ARGUMENT, AS IF IT HAB BIN WAITIN'|IN ONE MOVEMENT, AN' STAYS WHOLE}.
INSIDE, PACKED DA WAY TINKZ IZ PACKED BY SOMEBODY WHO EXPECTED TA COME BACK: EVERYTINK IN ORDER, NUTTIN' SPOILED, AN' ROOM LEFT AT DA TOP FOR {ONE MORE TINK DAT NEVER ARRIVED|SOMETINK DAT WAZ NEVER BROUGHT|A LAST ITEM NOBODY CARRIED IN}!

c.text: DA CASE OPENS {DA HARD WAY|BADLY|WIT A NOISE DA WHOLE SITE HEARS}. 'BOUT HALF OF WHAT WAZ SHELVED INSIDE SURVIVES DA OPENIN', WHICH EVERYBODY AGREES, AFTERWARDS, IZ {STILL HALF|BETTER DEN NONE|HALF MORE DEN NUTTIN'}!

b.text: WHATEVER DA SEAL WAZ HOLDIN' SHUT, IT WAZ HOLDIN' IT {IN|SHUT FROM DA INSIDE}. DA CASE IZ EMPTY NOW, AN' DA AIR AROUND IT COSTS DA PARTY {SOMETINK|A GOOD DEAL|MORE DEN ANYBODY SAYS OUT LOUD} ON DA WAY BACK!

e.text:
SEALED BY {maker}, LEFT SEALED. {member} TAKES A RUBBIN' OF DA LID FOR DA DIARY AN' PUTS {ground} BACK OVER IT DA WAY IT WAZ FOUND.
SOME WALKS IZ FOR KNOWIN' WHERE A TINK IZ, NO FOR HAVIN' IT!

a_m.text:
DA SEAL COMES OFF CLEAN AN' DA CASE IZ A LID ON A SHAFT, AN' DA SHAFT IZ LINED, AN' DA LININ' GOES DOWN FURTHER DEN {instrument} HAB PATIENCE FOR.
WHAT IZ ON DA TOP SHELF OF IT IZ WORTH DA WALK ON ITS OWN: PACKED, DATED, LABELLED BY SOMEBODY WIT A SYSTEM. WHAT IZ UNDER DA TOP SHELF IZ DARK, AN' DA AIR COMIN' UP OUT OF IT IZ {WARMER DEN DA DAY|MOVIN'|DA WRONG TEMPERATURE ENTIRELY}!

choices.text: TAKE DA TOP SHELF AN' PUT DA LID BACK!
READ DA LABELS PROPERLY BEFORE ANYBODY CARRIES ANYTINK!
GO DOWN DA SHAFT.

a_label.text:
DA LABELS IZ AN INDEX, AN' DA INDEX IZ OF DA SHAFT: WHAT IZ ON EACH SHELF, IN ORDER, ALL DA WAY DOWN, IN A HAND DAT GETS {WORSE|SHAKIER|HARDER TA READ} WIT DEPTH AN' STOPS ENTIRELY {FOUR|THREE|FIVE} SHELVES FROM DA BOTTOM.
DA PARTY TAKES DA TOP SHELF, AN' TAKES DA INDEX, WHICH IZ WORTH CONSIDERABLY MORE DEN DA TOP SHELF!

a_down.text:
FOUR SHELVES DOWN DA LININ' STOPS BEING LININ' AN' STARTS BEING DA TINK DA LININ' WAZ COPYIN'.
DA PARTY COMES BACK UP WIT FULL PACKS, {FASTER DEN DEY WENT DOWN|TWO AT A TIME|WITOUT DISCUSSIN' IT}, AN' DA LID GOES BACK ON WIT {ground} PILED OVER IT AN' A CAIRN ON TOP DAT NOBODY AGREED TA BUILD!

n0.text:
DA ONE WAY THROUGH {place} IZ A GAP WIDE ENOUGH FOR ONE, AN' SOMETINK IZ SITTIN' IN IT, IN PLAIN VIEW.
IT HAB {A BOWL|A SET OF SCALES|AN OPEN CRATE} IN FRONT OF IT AN' PATIENCE BEHIND IT. DA TOLL IZ {qty} {material}. DA ALTERNATIVE IZ NO DISCUSSED, COZ IT DOES NO NEED TA BE.
DERE IZ BONES IN DA SCREE ON DA FAR SIDE, ARRANGED DA WAY A TIDY PERSON ARRANGES TINKZ DEY HAB FINISHED WIT!

asides.aggressive: {member} MEASURES DA GAP, DEN DA TINK IN IT, AN' DOES NO SHARE DA RESULT!
asides.calm: {member} NOTES DAT A TOLL IMPLIES TRAFFIC, AN' DAT TRAFFIC IMPLIES DA TOLL GETS PAID!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PAY DA TOLL.
STARE IT DOWN.
GO THROUGH IT.

p.text:
IT COUNTS WITOUT TOUCHIN', {NODS ONCE|INCLINES WHATEVER DAT IZ|MAKES A LIL' FORMAL MOVEMENT}, AN' LEANS BACK A WHOLE HAND'S WIDTH, WHICH IZ APPARENTLY DA OPEN POSITION.
AS DA LAST OF DA PARTY PASSES, IT PUTS SOMETINK OF ITS OWN IN DA BOWL AN' PUSHES IT AFTER DEM: CHANGE, OR A TIP, OR A RECEIPT. {DA CATEGORIES MAY NO APPLY|NONE OF DOZE THREE WORDS QUITE FITS|NOBODY DECIDES WHICH}!

s.text:
{IT BLINKS FIRST|IT LOOKS AWAY FIRST|SOMETINK IN IT GIVES FIRST}.
IT STANDS, WHICH TAKES LONGER DEN IT SHOULD AN' INVOLVES MORE OF IT DEN SEEMED TA BE DERE, AN' STEPS OUT OF DA GAP, AN' LEAVES DA BOWL WHERE IT SITS, FULL, AS A MATTER DA PARTY IZ INVITED TA {INTERPRET|MAKE OF WHAT DEY WILL|SETTLE AMONG THEMSELVES}!

f2.text: DA STARE GOES WRONG {SOMEWHERE IN DA MIDDLE|'BOUT A BREATH OR TWO IN|AT DA POINT WHERE IT SHOULD HAB ENDED}. WHAT IZ AT DA BOTTOM OF IT LOOKS BACK UP DA WHOLE LENGTH OF IT, AN' DA GAP STOPS BEING {A TOLL BOOTH|AN ARRANGEMENT|ANYTINK WIT RULES IN IT}!

fgt.text: IT STANDS UP BEFORE DA {SECOND|THIRD} STEP. DERE IZ {MORE OF IT DEN DA GAP EXPLAINED|A GREAT DEAL MORE OF IT DEN DA GAP SUGGESTED|MORE OF IT DEN DERE WAZ ROOM FOR}!

p_m.text:
{IT COUNTS DA TOLL WITOUT TOUCHIN' IT|IT COUNTS WITOUT TOUCHIN' ANYTINK|IT READS DA TOLL OFF DA BOWL WITOUT REACHIN' FOR IT} AN' DOES NO MOVE, COZ DA TOLL WAZ NEVER DA WHOLE PRICE.
IT PUTS ONE APPENDAGE FLAT ON DA ROCK BESIDE DA BOWL AN' WAITS, AN' DA MEANIN' IZ CLEAR ENOUGH: SOMETINK ELSE IZ OWED, AN' IT WILL TAKE {A NAME, A STORY, OR AN HOUR OF SOMEBODY'S TIME|A NAME, A STORY, OR AN HOUR|AN HOUR, A STORY, OR A NAME}, AN' IT DOES NO CARE WHICH!

choices.text: GIVE IT A NAME. NO ONE OF OURS!
SIT DOWN AN' TELL IT SOMETINK TRUE!
PUT A HAND FLAT ON DA ROCK BESIDE ITS OWN!

p_lie.text:
DA NAME GIVEN IZ A REAL NAME BELONGIN' TA NOBODY DA PARTY WILL EVER MEET AGAIN, AN' IT TAKES IT, AN' FOLDS WHATEVER IT HAB INSTEAD OF A FACE AROUND IT, AN' IZ SATISFIED.
DA GAP OPENS. ON DA FAR SIDE, {A HUNDRED METRES|A WHILE} ON, DERE IZ A MARKER WIT DAT SAME NAME CUT INTO IT, FRESHLY, AN' NOBODY LOOKS AT ANYBODY FOR A KILOMETRE!

p_caught.text:
{IT KNOWS.|IT KNEW.|IT HAB KNOWN DA WHOLE TIME.} NO IN DA MOMENT: IT LETS DA NAME BE GIVEN, LETS IT BE FINISHED, AN' DEN PUTS DA APPENDAGE DOWN FLAT IN A WAY DAT MEANS DA LIE IZ ON DA SCALES TOO NOW, AN' DA SCALES IZ ITS OWN.
{DA TOLL DOUBLES.|DA TOLL IZ DOUBLED.|DA PRICE GOES UP BY EXACTLY AS MUCH AGAIN.} IT IZ PAID, OUT OF DA PACK, COZ DA ALTERNATIVE IZ STANDIN' BEHIND IT!

p_hand.text:
DA ROCK UNDER BOTH HANDS GOES COLD ENOUGH TA HURT AN' STAYS DAT WAY FOR A COUNT OF NINE, AN' SOMETINK MOVES THROUGH DA CONTACT DAT IZ NO WARMTH AN' IZ NO INFORMATION AN' IZ DEFINITELY NO NUTTIN'.
IT GETS UP. IT IZ DA FIRST TIME IT HAB GOT UP FOR ANYBODY. DA GAP IZ LEFT OPEN BEHIND IT, AN' DA BOWL IZ LEFT FULL, AN' IT WALKS OFF INTO {DA NARROWS|DA SCREE|WHATEVER IZ PAST DA NARROWS} WITOUT LOOKIN' BACK!

fgt_m.text:
IT STANDS BEFORE DA {SECOND|THIRD} STEP, AN' STANDIN' IZ DA WHOLE ARGUMENT: DERE IZ MORE OF IT DEN DA GAP EXPLAINED, AN' IT UNFOLDS UPWARD WIT DA UNHURRIED CONFIDENCE OF SOMETINK DAT HAB DONE DIS AT DIS EXACT SPOT MANY TIMES.
DERE IZ A MOMENT, 'BOUT {A SECOND|A COUPLE OF SECONDS|A BREATH} LONG, IN WHICH IT IZ STILL POSSIBLE TA STOP WALKIN'!

choices.text: KEEP WALKIN'.
READ DA BONES ON DA FAR SIDE. HOW DOES IT FIGHT?
STOP WALKIN'. PUT DA TOLL IN DA BOWL!

fgt_read.text:
DA BONES SAY DA SAME SENTENCE A DOZEN TIMES: EVERYTINK IT HAB FINISHED WIT WAZ BROKEN {HIGH, ON DA LEFT, ONCE, HARD|ON DA LEFT, HIGH, IN ONE GO}.
DA PARTY GOES IN KNOWIN' WHICH SIDE TA STAND ON. IT IZ STILL DA WORST {FOUR|FIVE|THREE} MINUTES OF DA WEEK, BUT IT IZ FOUR MINUTES, AN' EVERYBODY WALKS OUT OF DA NARROWS ON DEY OWN FEET!

q_wager.title: {STONES|DA GAME AT DA FIRE|FAIR, WHICH IZ WORSE}

n0.text:
{asker} HAB A FIRE GOING AT {place} AN' A GAME LAID OUT ON A FLAT ROCK: {stakegame}.
DA RULES TAKE A MINUTE TA LEARN AN' A LIFE TA LIKE. DA STAKE IZ COIN. DA POT ON DA OTHER SIDE OF DA ROCK IZ {VISIBLE|REAL|ALREADY SITTIN' DERE, WHICH IZ EITHER CONFIDENCE OR BAIT}.
DERE IZ A SECOND SET OF STONES IN A BAG BY {asker}'S KNEE, WORN SMOOTHER DEN DA ONES ON DA ROCK!

asides.hedonistic: {member} IZ SITTIN' DOWN BEFORE DA RULES IZ FINISHED!
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: SIT DOWN AN' PLAY.
PLAY FOR INFORMATION INSTEAD OF COIN!
WATCH A FEW ROUNDS FROM DA WARM SIDE OF DA FIRE!

w2.text:
DA POT CROSSES DA ROCK. {asker} PAYS WITOUT A WORD AN' RE-RACKS DA STONES FOR DA NEXT TRAVELLER, COZ DERE IZ ALWAYS A NEXT TRAVELLER.
DA FIRE IZ SHARED FOR AN HOUR ON DA STRENGTH OF IT, AN' DA DIRECTIONS GIVEN AT PARTIN' IZ, AS FAR AS ANYONE CAN LATER TELL, {HONEST|ENTIRELY HONEST|CORRECT IN EVERY PARTICULAR}!

l2.text:
DA STAKE IZ GONE IN {few} MOVES.
DA GAME WAZ FAIR. EVERYBODY AT DA FIRE IZ QUITE SURE DA GAME WAZ FAIR, WHICH IZ {SOMEHOW WORSE|DA PART DAT STINGS|WORSE DEN BEING CHEATED WOULD HAB BIN}!

i.text:
DA WINNINGS IZ {A LESSON|DA TEACHIN' ITSELF|A TINK DAT HAB TA BE SHOWN}: DA GAME ITSELF, TAUGHT ACROSS DA FIRE, ONCE, PROPERLY, WIT DA MISTAKES NAMED AS DEY HAPPEN.
IT TRAVELS. EVERYTINK ELSE ON DIS ROCK STAYS WHERE IT IZ, BUT DA GAME {TRAVELS|GOES WIT DEM|PACKS}!

l3.text:
SOMEWHERE IN DA THIRD ROUND IT BECOMES CLEAR DA INFORMATION HAB BIN FLOWIN' DA OTHER WAY.
{asker} NOW KNOWS WHERE DA PARTY LANDED, WHAT DA SHIP CARRIES, AN' WHICH OF DA PARTY SLEEPS LIGHTEST, AN' PAID FOR {NONE OF IT|NO A COIN OF IT|PRECISELY NUTTIN'}!

v.text:
AN HOUR GOES BY AT DA FIRE WATCHIN' OTHER PEOPLE LOSE {INTERESTINGLY|IN WAYS WORTH STUDYIN'|SLOWLY AN' DEN ALL AT ONCE}.
NO MONEY CHANGES HANDS IN EITHER DIRECTION, WHICH BY DA LOCAL ARITHMETIC MAKES DA PARTY DA EVENIN''S {BIG WINNER|ONLY WINNER|CLEAR WINNER}!

v_m.text:
AN HOUR AT DA WARM SIDE OF DA FIRE IZ AN HOUR OF WATCHIN' {asker}'S HANDS, AN' DA HANDS IZ DA GAME.
DA STONES FROM DA BAG COME OUT ONCE, IN DA FOURTH ROUND, AGAINST A TRAVELLER WHO IZ LOSIN' ANYWAY AN' DOES NO NOTICE. NOBODY AT DA FIRE NOTICES. DA FIRE IZ REAL GOOD AT NO NOTICIN'!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DERE IT IZ.|SECOND BAG. EVERY TABLE HAB ONE.|TOLD YOU.}"
asides.any: {member} {WATCHES DA BAG AN' NO DA ROCK|COUNTS DA SWAP UNDER DEY BREATH|SAYS NUTTIN' AN' KEEPS WATCHIN'}

choices.text: SAY NUTTIN'. ENJOY DA FIRE!
CALL IT, QUIETLY, TA {asker} ALONE!
CALL IT OUT LOUD, TA DA WHOLE FIRE!

v_quiet.text:
IT IZ TAKEN DA WAY A PROFESSIONAL TAKES IT: NO DENIAL, NO OFFENCE, A LONG LOOK, AN' DA BAG GOES BACK INTO DA COAT.
DA REST OF DA EVENIN' IZ HONEST AN' {asker} PLAYS IT DAT WAY, BADLY, AN' LOSES, AN' PAYS, AN' AFTERWARDS TEACHES DA PARTY DA SWAP ITSELF AT DA EDGE OF DA FIRELIGHT AS A MATTER OF PROFESSIONAL RESPECT!

v_loud.text:
DA FIRE STOPS BEING A FIRE AN' BECOMES A ROOM WIT PEOPLE IN IT.
{asker} IZ GONE OVER DA ROCKS INSIDE MOST OF A MINUTE, DA POT GOES WIT DEM, AN' DA TRAVELLERS LEFT BEHIND DIVIDE DEY OPINION OF DA PARTY EVENLY BETWEEN GRATEFUL AN' FURIOUS, AN' IT IZ DA FURIOUS HALF DAT IZ STILL DERE AT DAWN!

q_specimen.title: {DA ONE DAT KEEPS COMIN' BACK|A FIXED HOUR|WHAT TOOK DEY}

n0.text:
{asker} WANTS ONE ANIMAL OUT OF {ground} DEAD OR CARRIED OFF: DA ONE DAT HAB TAKEN {few} OF DEY AN' WILL BE BACK FOR MORE.
IT COMES AT {A FIXED HOUR|DA SAME HOUR EVERY DAY|WHATEVER HOUR DA WIND DROPS}, WHICH IZ DA ONLY POLITE TINK 'BOUT IT. DERE IZ PAYMENT: {payment}.
DA KILLS IZ IN A LINE. WHATEVER IZ DOING IT IZ WALKIN' A ROUTE, AN' DA ROUTE ENDS AT {asker}'S DOOR!

asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.nurturing: {member} ASKS AFTER DA ONES ALREADY TAKEN, AN' DA SILENCE ANSWERS BEFORE ANYBODY DOES!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TRACK IT TA WHERE IT SLEEPS FIRST!
WAIT FOR DA HOUR AN' TAKE IT HEAD ON!
NO DIS ONE. NO TODAY.

tr.text:
DA TRAIL READS LIKE A SENTENCE WIT DA GRAMMAR WRONG, BUT IT READS.
IT SLEEPS BELOW {remnant}, DOWNWIND OF ITS OWN FRONT DOOR, ALONE, WHICH CHANGES {DA WHOLE ARITHMETIC OF DA AFTERNOON|EVERYTINK 'BOUT DA AFTERNOON|DA SHAPE OF DA AFTERNOON}!

amb.text: {HALF AN HOUR|AN HOUR|TWENTY MINUTES} INTO DA TRACKIN' IT BECOMES CLEAR FROM DA FRESHNESS OF DA GROUND DAT DA ROLES HAB BIN REVERSED FOR AT LEAST {TWENTY MINUTES|HALF AN HOUR|SOME TIME NOW}!

head.text: {IT IZ PUNCTUAL|IT ARRIVES ON DA HOUR|IT COMES WHEN DEY SAID IT WOULD}. DAT IZ DA LAST TINK 'BOUT DA NEXT TEN MINUTES DAT GOES TA {ANYBODY'S PLAN|DA PLAN|PLAN AT ALL}!

e3.text:
{asker} NODS LIKE SOMEBODY FILIN' AN ANSWER WIT ALL DA OTHER ANSWERS.
DA FIRE GETS BUILT UP A LIL' HIGHER FOR DA COMIN' HOUR, AN' DA PARTY IZ A LONG WAY OFF BEFORE IT {BURNS DOWN|GOES OUT|IZ OUT}!

tr_m.text:
DA TRAIL READS LIKE A SENTENCE WIT DA GRAMMAR WRONG, AN' IT READS ALL DA WAY TA A SCRAPE UNDER {remnant} WHERE SOMETINK LARGE SLEEPS DOWNWIND OF ITS OWN FRONT DOOR.
IT IZ ASLEEP NOW. IT WILL NO BE ASLEEP AT DA HOUR. DERE IZ TIME TA DO EXACTLY ONE TINK WELL!

choices.text: TAKE IT IN ITS SLEEP.
SET DA GROUND AGAINST IT AN' LET IT COME TA US!
DRIVE IT OFF DA ROUTE INSTEAD OF KILLIN' IT!

tr_trap.text:
DA GROUND IZ MADE READY IN DA LAST HOUR OF LIGHT: DA LINE NARROWED, DA FOOTIN' SPOILED, DA ONE GOOD APPROACH LEFT OPEN ON PURPOSE.
IT WALKS INTO ALL OF IT EXACTLY ON DA HOUR, AN' DA FIGHT IZ OVER BEFORE IT IZ PROPERLY A FIGHT. {asker} PAYS DA FULL PRICE AN' DEN SOME, HAVIN' WATCHED DA WHOLE TINK FROM DA ROOF!

tr_snap.text:
DA LINE IZ SET WRONG BY {ONE PACE|A SINGLE PACE|HALF A PACE} AN' DA TINK DAT WALKS INTO IT IZ NO DA TINK IT WAZ SET FOR: SOMETINK SMALLER, EARLIER, NOISIER, AN' NOW EXTREMELY AWAKE.
BY DA TIME DA REAL ONE ARRIVES DA WHOLE APPROACH IZ RUINED AN' EVERYBODY IZ STANDIN' {IN DA OPEN|OUT IN DA OPEN|WHERE NOBODY WANTED TA BE STANDIN'}!

tr_turn.text:
IT IZ NO DRIVEN OFF SO MUCH AS ARGUED WIT, IN DA ONLY LANGUAGE IT HAB: NOISE AT DA RIGHT PITCH, IN DA RIGHT PLACE, THREE NIGHTS RUNNIN', UNTIL DA ROUTE STOPS BEING WORTH WALKIN'.
{asker} GETS NO CORPSE AN' DOES NO MUCH CARE, COZ DA KILLS STOP. DA PAYMENT IZ SMALLER AN' COMES WIT A STANDIN' INVITATION TA DA FIRE DAT TURNS OUT, OVER DA FOLLOWIN' SEASON, TA BE WORTH A GREAT DEAL MORE DEN DA PAYMENT!

e3_m.text:
{asker} NODS LIKE SOMEBODY FILIN' AN ANSWER WIT ALL DA OTHER ANSWERS, AN' STARTS BUILDIN' DA FIRE UP HIGHER FOR DA COMIN' HOUR, ALONE, WIT WHAT DEY HAB, WHICH IZ NO MUCH.
DA PARTY IZ A HUNDRED METRES OUT WHEN IT BECOMES CLEAR DAT DA FIRE WILL NO BE HIGH ENOUGH!

choices.text: KEEP WALKIN'.
TURN ROUND. STAY FOR DA HOUR!
LEAVE WHAT WE CAN SPARE AT DA DOOR AN' GO!

e3_gift.text:
DA {material} IZ LEFT INSIDE DA DOOR WIT NO EXPLANATION, WHICH IZ DA ONLY WAY IT WOULD HAB BIN ACCEPTED.
WHAT HAPPENS AT DA HOUR HAPPENS WITOUT DA PARTY DERE TA SEE IT. SOME WEEKS LATER, A LONG WAY FROM {place}, SOMEBODY DA PARTY HAB NEVER MET BUYS DEM A MEAL ON DA STRENGTH OF A DESCRIPTION AN' WILL NO SAY WHO SENT DEM!

qe_pump.title: {DA PUMP|DEAD IRON AT DA WORST HOUR|WHAT DA YARD NEEDS}

n0.text:
DA PUMP AT {place} HAB DIED AT DA WORST POSSIBLE POINT OF DA WEEK, {weather}, AN' {stranger} IZ STANDIN' OVER IT HOLDIN' {tool} IN A WAY DAT SAYS {tool} HAB ALREADY BIN TRIED.
WHAT IT NEEDS IZ {qty} {material}. DA MERCHANT DAT STOCKS IT IZ {distance}, AN' SHUT ON ACCOUNT OF {misfortune}, AN' DA TROUGH LINE GOES DRY BY DARK.
DA YARD BEHIND DA PUMP HAB {NINE|ELEVEN|A GOOD MANY} BEASTS IN IT AN' ALL OF DEM IZ ALREADY AT DA FENCE, WATCHIN' DA TROUGH, WHICH IZ HOW EVERYBODY KNOWS EXACTLY HOW LONG DIS HAB LEFT!

asides.nurturing: {member} HAB DA SIDE PANEL OFF BEFORE ANYBODY HAB AGREED TA ANYTINK!
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: HAND OVER DA {material}.
STRIP IT DOWN AN' MACHINE DA PART FROM SCRAP!
MAN DA HAND PUMP UNTIL DA JOB IZ DONE, HOWEVER LONG DAT IZ!

g.text:
DA PART GOES IN, DA PUMP PICKS UP MID-STROKE LIKE IT NEVER STOPPED, AN' DA YARD COMES BACK TA LIFE AROUND IT.
PAYMENT IZ {payment}, PRESSED ON DA PARTY OVER TWO REFUSALS, AN' DINNER IZ NO OPTIONAL {EITHER|AN' IZ NO UP FOR DISCUSSION|AT ALL}!

f.text:
DERE IZ A PART IN DA SCRAP PILE DAT HAB NEVER HEARD OF DA PUMP BUT CAN BE TALKED INTO DA JOB WIT A FILE AN' AN HOUR.
IT RUNS ROUGH AN' IT RUNS. {stranger} WATCHES DA WHOLE OPERATION LIKE A SERMON AN' PAYS OVER DA ASKIN', {ON PRINCIPLE|OUT OF PRINCIPLE|COZ IT WAZ DONE PROPERLY}!

x.text:
DA FLYWHEEL HAB ONE MORE TURN IN IT, WHICH {leader} FINDS OUT WIT DA SMALLEST BONE IN ONE HAND.
DA PUMP STAYS DEAD. DA DINNER HAPPENS ANYWAY, OUT OF GUILT, AN' IZ REAL GOOD, WHICH DOES NO ENTIRELY SETTLE {DA GRIMORIE|MATTERS|IT}!

m.text:
HALF A SHIFT ON DA HAND PUMP IN SHIFTS, {weather}, WIT DA LIGHT GOING.
DA TROUGH LINE HOLDS. BY DA END HALF DA DISTRICT HAB COME PAST TA WATCH, AN' DA PARTY LEAVES WIT MORE INVITATIONS DEN IT CAN EAT THROUGH IN A MONTH!

g_m.text:
DA {material} IZ OUT OF DA PACK AN' ON DA BENCH BEFORE DA SENTENCE IZ FINISHED, AN' {stranger} HAB DA SIDE PANEL OFF TA MEET IT.
DA HOUSIN' UNDERNEATH IZ NO WHAT EITHER OF DEM EXPECTED: SOMEBODY HAB BIN IN HERE BEFORE, RECENTLY, AN' HAB FITTED A PART DAT IZ {NEARLY RIGHT|ALMOST DA RIGHT PART|DA RIGHT SHAPE AN' DA WRONG METAL} AN' HAB BODGED DA SEAT TA MAKE IT GO!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SOMEBODY HAB ALREADY BIN PAID FOR DIS ONCE.|DAT IZ A REPAIR WIT A BILL ATTACHED.|LOOK AT DAT SEAT AN' TELL ME DAT WAZ FREE.}"
asides.any: {member} {RUNS A THUMB ROUND DA SEAT AN' WHISTLES|HOLDS DA LAMP CLOSER WITOUT BEING ASKED|LOOKS AT DA BODGE FOR A LONG MOMENT}

choices.text: FIT OURS OVER DA TOP AN' GET DA TROUGH RUNNIN'!
CUT DA SEAT BACK TA TRUE FIRST. DO IT ONCE, PROPERLY!
FIND OUT WHO FITTED DA WRONG PART!

g_true.text:
CUTTIN' A SEAT TRUE BY HAND IN A YARD IN {weather} IZ NO A JOB ANYBODY WOULD CHOOSE, AN' IT TAKES {HALF A SHIFT|DA REST OF DA LIGHT|LONGER DEN DA JOB IZ WORTH}.
DA PUMP RUNS AFTERWARDS DA WAY IT RAN WHEN IT WAZ NEW, WHICH {stranger} NOTICES INSIDE A MINUTE AN' DOES NO STOP TALKIN' 'BOUT FOR DA REST OF DA EVENIN'. DA PAYMENT IZ DOUBLED, TWICE, OVER DA PARTY'S OBJECTIONS!

g_scrap.text:
DA SEAT GOES FROM BODGED TA RUINED IN 'BOUT {ONE PASS|A SINGLE PASS|A COUPLE OF SECONDS} OF A TOOL DAT WAZ NEVER MEANT FOR IT.
DA {material} IZ NOW NO USE TA ANYBODY AN' NEITHER IZ DA HOUSIN'. DA TROUGH LINE GOES DRY AT DARK, EXACTLY AS ADVERTISED, AN' DA BEASTS IZ WALKED {TWO FIELDS OVER|TA DA NEXT FARM|A LONG WAY} IN DA MORNIN' BY EVERYONE INCLUDIN' DA PARTY!

g_who.text:
IT TAKES {ONE NAME|A NAME AN' A HALF|A FEW QUESTIONS AT DA RIGHT GATE}: A MAN WHO DOES DA ROUNDS OF DA DISTRICT FITTIN' NEARLY-RIGHT PARTS AT PROPER PRICES TA PEOPLE WHO NO CAN CHECK.
DA PUMP IZ FIXED WIT DA PARTY'S OWN {material}. DA NAME GOES ROUND DA DISTRICT BY {NIGHTFALL|DA FOLLOWIN' EVENIN'|DARK} AN' DOES NO COME BACK, AN' THREE OTHER YARDS FIND OUT WHAT IZ IN DEY HOUSINGS BEFORE DA WEEK IZ OUT!

m_m.text:
HALF A SHIFT ON DA HAND PUMP IN SHIFTS, {weather}, WIT DA LIGHT GOING, AN' DA TROUGH LINE HOLDIN' BY {'BOUT A FINGER'S WIDTH|A HAND|NO MUCH}.
AT DA END OF DA SECOND HOUR IT BECOMES CLEAR DIS WILL HOLD ALL NIGHT IF SOMEBODY KEEPS AT IT, AN' DAT {stranger} INTENDS TA BE DAT SOMEBODY, ALONE, HAVIN' ALREADY BIN UP SINCE {FOUR|THREE|BEFORE LIGHT}!

choices.text: TAKE DA NIGHT IN SHIFTS WIT DEM!
RIG A COUNTERWEIGHT SO DA PUMP WORKS ITSELF!
HAND IT OVER AT DARK AN' GO!

m_night.text:
FOUR HOURS ON, FOUR OFF, IN A BARN DAT SMELLS OF {EVERYTINK A BARN SMELLS OF|HOT IRON AN' BEASTS|HAY AN' WET WOOL}, WIT SOMEBODY ELSE'S ANIMALS MAKIN' SOMEBODY ELSE'S NOISE ALL NIGHT.
DA LINE HOLDS. DA PARTY IZ FED AT DAWN LIKE VISITIN' ROYALTY AN' SLEEPS UNTIL NOON IN A LOFT, AN' DERE IZ A STANDIN' BED IN DIS DISTRICT FROM DAT MORNIN' ONWARD!

m_rig.text:
A BEAM, A BUCKET OF STONE, AN' DA TROUGH LINE'S OWN OVERFLOW TA FILL IT: DA PUMP LIFTS ITSELF ON DA DOWN-STROKE AN' RESETS ON DA UP, SLOWLY, {ALL NIGHT|FOR AS LONG AS DA WATER RUNS|INDEFINITELY}.
IT IZ STILL WORKIN' ELEVEN MONTHS LATER. PEOPLE COME TA LOOK AT IT. NOBODY IN DA DISTRICT HAB EVER BIN ABLE TA EXPLAIN WHICH OF DA PARTY THOUGHT OF IT, INCLUDIN' DA PARTY!

qe_debt.title: {FORTY MINUTES AHEAD OF DA BAILIFF|DA BOXES ON DA STEP|LIL' ARITHMETIC}

n0.text:
{stranger} IZ ON DA STEP OF A HOUSE AT {place} WIT DA DOOR OPEN BEHIND AN' EVERYTINK DEY OWN IN {few} BOXES.
DA BAILIFF IZ A LONG STRETCH AWAY BY {vehicle}. DA DEBT IZ REAL AN' DA ARITHMETIC IZ LIL', AN' DA HOUSE IZ NO LIL', AN' DAT IZ DA WHOLE STORY IN ONE SENTENCE.
DA BOXES IZ PACKED DA WAY PEOPLE PACK WHEN DEY HAB DONE IT BEFORE: {HEAVY AT DA BOTTOM, KITCHEN LAST|PROPERLY|BY ROOM, AN' LABELLED}!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PAY IT.
READ DA PAPERWORK. PAPERWORK ALWAYS HAB A FLAW!
SAY NUTTIN' 'BOUT MONEY AN' CARRY BOXES!

p2.text:
DA BAILIFF ARRIVES TA A SETTLED GRIMORIE AN' HATES IT, QUIETLY, {IN A VAN|FROM DA GATE|WIT DA ENGINE RUNNIN'}, FOR SOME TIME.
NOBODY INSIDE DA HOUSE SAYS THANK YOU MORE DEN ONCE, COZ MORE DEN ONCE WOULD MEAN STARTIN' TA CRY, AN' DERE IZ {A KETTLE ON INSTEAD|TEA INSTEAD|A KETTLE GOING INSTEAD}!

t2.text:
DA FLAW IZ IN DA DATES, WHERE DA FLAWS LIVE. DA DEBT IZ REAL; DIS WEEK'S SEIZURE IZ NO, AN' {leader} EXPLAINS WHY IN DA DOORWAY WIT DA PAPER HELD AT READIN' DISTANCE.
DA BAILIFF, TA HIS CREDIT, CHECKS, SWEARS ONCE WIT FEELIN', AN' LEAVES. EVERYONE UNDERSTANDS DIS IZ A POSTPONEMENT. A POSTPONEMENT IZ {A CURRENCY|WORTH HAVIN'|NO NUTTIN'}!

t3.text:
DA ARITHMETIC HOLDS ALL DA WAY DOWN. WHOEVER DREW DIS UP HAB BIN TA DA SAME SCHOOL AS DA FLAW AN' GOT DERE FIRST.
DA PARTY STAYS FOR DA LOADIN' ANYWAY. DERE IZ A RIGHT WAY TA {CARRY A BOX OUT OF A HOUSE|EMPTY A HOUSE|DO DIS} AN' IT INVOLVES NO BEING ALONE {WHILE IT HAPPENS|FOR IT|WHEN IT HAPPENS}!

c2.text:
{few} BOXES, ONE VAN BORROWED OFF A NEIGHBOUR, ONE DOG DAT RIDES IN DA FRONT OR NOWHERE.
AT DA END {stranger} SHAKES EVERY HAND TWICE AN' GIVES DA PARTY {payment}, AN' WILL NO HEAR A WORD 'BOUT IT!

p_m.text:
PAYIN' IT IZ {FOUR MINUTES|A SIGNATURE AN' A COUNT|DA EASIEST TINK ANYBODY WILL DO TODAY}, AN' DA BAILIFF IZ A LONG STRETCH OUT, AN' DA SUM IZ GENUINELY LIL'.
{stranger} SAYS NO. TWICE, AN' DEN A THIRD TIME WIT A REASON: DA DEBT IZ DEY {BROTHER'S|SON'S|LATE HUSBAND'S}, AN' PAYIN' IT IZ HOW DA NEXT ONE STARTS!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SO IT IZ A TAP.|PAY ONCE AN' IT IZ A SUBSCRIPTION.|DAT IZ AN ARRANGEMENT.}"
asides.any: {member} {SITS DOWN ON DA STEP AN' WAITS DIS OUT|LOOKS AT DA PAPERWORK OVER A SHOULDER|SAYS NUTTIN' AN' COUNTS DA BOXES}

choices.text: PAY IT ANYWAY. TODAY IZ TODAY!
PAY IT INTO DA COURT, NO TA DA MAN!
DO NO PAY. FIND DA BROTHER!

p_court.text:
PAID INTO COURT, DA MONEY STOPS BEING A FAVOUR AN' BECOMES A FACT, WIT A NUMBER ON IT AN' A DATE, AN' DA TAP DAT WAZ GOING TA BE OPENED NO CAN BE.
DA BAILIFF ARRIVES TA A RECEIPT HE NO CAN ARGUE WIT. {stranger} UNDERSTANDS WHAT HAB BIN DONE 'BOUT {AN HOUR|HALF A SHIFT|A DAY} LATER AN' COMES {A LONG WAY|FOUR MILES|ACROSS DA DISTRICT} TA SAY SO!

p_brother.text:
HE IZ {TWO STREETS|A VILLAGE|NO FAR} AWAY AN' IZ NO HIDIN', EXACTLY, AN' HAB {THREE|TWO} MORE OF DEZE RUNNIN' ELSEWHERE UNDER DA SAME ARRANGEMENT.
WHAT IZ SAID TA HIM IZ SAID QUIETLY AN' LANDS. DA DEBT IZ PAID BY DA PERSON WHO INCURRED IT, IN DA DOORWAY, IN CASH, {WATCHED BY A COUPLE OF STRANGERS|IN FRONT OF WITNESSES|WIT EVERYBODY PRESENT}. DA HOUSE STAYS PACKED FOR A WEEK ANYWAY, OUT OF SUPERSTITION!

p_cold.text:
TWO STREETS OF ASKIN' GETS {FOUR|FIVE} VERSIONS OF WHERE HE MIGHT BE AN' NONE OF DEM IZ WHERE HE IZ, AN' DA FORTY MINUTES GO BY OUT ON DA ROAD RATHER DEN ON DA STEP.
DA PARTY COMES BACK TA A VAN, A LOADED VAN, A CLOSED DOOR AN' A NEIGHBOUR WHO SAYS DA DOG WENT IN DA FRONT. DERE IZ NUTTIN' TA BE DONE DAT IZ NO {EMBARRASSIN'|WORSE|TOO LATE}!

c_m.text:
{few} BOXES, ONE VAN BORROWED OFF A NEIGHBOUR, ONE DOG DAT RIDES IN DA FRONT OR NOWHERE, AN' NOBODY MENTIONIN' MONEY IN EITHER DIRECTION.
DA LAST BOX OUT IZ DA ONE NOBODY WANTS TA LIFT, COZ IT IZ BOOKS AN' PHOTOGRAPHS AN' IT GOES IN LAST AN' COMES OUT FIRST {EVERYWHERE|IN EVERY HOUSE|EVERY TIME}. {stranger} CARRIES IT THEMSELVES AN' GETS TA DA VAN AN' HAB TA PUT IT DOWN!

choices.text: TAKE DA WEIGHT. SAY NUTTIN'!
SIT ON DA WALL WIT DEM UNTIL DEY CAN STAND UP!
FIND OUT WHERE DA VAN IZ ACTUALLY GOING!

c_wall.text:
IT TAKES {DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|AS LONG AS IT TAKES} ON A GARDEN WALL WIT A BOX BETWEEN TWO PEOPLE AN' NUTTIN' MUCH BEING SAID.
WHAT COMES OUT OF IT IZ 'BOUT {A NAME|SOMEBODY|DA PERSON DA PHOTOGRAPHS IZ OF}, AN' IT HAB NO BIN SAID OUT LOUD TA ANYBODY IN {TWO YEARS|A LONG TIME|YEARS}, AN' SAYIN' IT IZ DA WHOLE OF DA AFTERNOON'S WORK!

c_where.text:
NOWHERE, IZ DA ANSWER, PHRASED AS A PLACE: A COUSIN'S YARD {FOR NOW|UNTIL SOMETINK TURNS UP|FOR A FORTNIGHT}, WIT DA BOXES STAYIN' ON DA VAN COZ UNLOADIN' DEM WOULD MAKE IT REAL.
DA PARTY KNOWS {FOUR|THREE} PEOPLE BETWEEN HERE AN' DERE WIT A SPARE ROOM, AN' BY DARK TWO OF DEM HAB BIN ASKED AN' ONE OF DEM HAB SAID YES!

n0.text:
A CART IZ IN DA FORD AT {place} TA DA AXLE, AN' {animal} DAT PULLED IT IN HAB DEVELOPED STRONG VIEWS 'BOUT PULLIN' IT OUT.
{stranger} IZ UP TA DA KNEES IN IT, HOLDIN' DA BRIDLE, DA LOAD, AN' DEY TEMPER, IN DESCENDIN' ORDER OF SUCCESS. {weather}, WHICH IZ NO HELPIN'.
DA LOAD ON DA CART IZ ROPED DOWN BADLY ON ONE SIDE, AN' IT IZ DA {UPSTREAM|DEEP|WRONG} SIDE!

asides.calm: {member} ROLLS UP BOTH SLEEVES IN A WAY DAT HAB ENDED ARGUMENTS BEFORE!
asides.hedonistic: {member} POINTS OUT, FROM DA BANK, DAT DA WATER LOOKS COLD, WHICH IZ CONFIRMED FROM DA WATER!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GET BEHIND IT AN' HEAVE.
TAKE {animal}'S HEAD AN' TALK IT ROUND!
WALK ON.

h2.text:
DA CART COMES OUT ON DA THIRD HEAVE WIT A SOUND LIKE A BOOT LEAVIN' DEEP MUD, SCALED UP.
{stranger} INSISTS ON PAYMENT WIT DA STUBBORNNESS OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB DECIDED DA STORY NEEDS A PROPER ENDIN': {payment}, AN' NAMES TA GO WIT IT, AN' DA PROMISE OF A DRY SEAT BY DA FIRE AT DA NEXT FARM ALONG!

w3.text:
{animal} LISTENS DA WAY DEY LISTEN: SIDEWAYS, ONE EAR, READY TA DISAGREE.
DEN IT LEANS INTO DA COLLAR LIKE DA WHOLE ARGUMENT NEVER HAPPENED AN' WALKS DA CART OUT AT ITS OWN PACE, AN' {stranger} LOOKS AT {leader} AS IF WITCHCRAFT HAB BIN PERFORMED, WHICH IZ LEFT UNCORRECTED!

hx.text:
DA CART COMES OUT. ONE BOOT DOES NO, FOR A WHILE, AN' DA WATER GETS ITS FULL SAY IN DA MATTER BEFORE EVERYTINK IZ BACK ON DRY GROUND.
DA THANKS IZ REAL AN' SO IZ {DA COLD|DA COLD, FOR HOURS AFTERWARDS}!

e4.text:
DA VIEW BACK FROM DA NEXT RISE: DA CART STILL IN DA FORD, {SMALLER NOW|FURTHER OFF|NO SMALLER DEN IT LOOKED}, AN' DA SOUND OF DA ARGUMENT CONTINUIN' WITOUT ANY NEED OF DA PARTY'S OPINION.
SOME AFTERNOONS BELONG TA {OTHER PEOPLE|SOMEBODY ELSE|OTHER PEOPLE ENTIRELY}!

h_m.text:
GETTIN' BEHIND IT PUTS EVERYBODY IN DA WATER TA DA THIGH AN' DA WATER HAB {OPINIONS|A TEMPERATURE|A GREAT DEAL TA SAY}.
ON DA SECOND HEAVE DA BAD ROPES GIVE AN' DA LOAD SHIFTS, AN' WHAT IZ UNDER DA TARPAULIN IZ {CRATES|BOXES|CASES}, STENCILLED, WIT A CUSTOMS MARK DAT HAB BIN PAINTED OVER ONCE!

asides.cynical: {member}, IN DA WATER: "{AN' DERE IT IZ.|A CART STUCK IN A FORD AT DIS HOUR. OF COURSE.|NOBODY CARTS TURNIPS AT DIS HOUR.}"
asides.any: {member} {GETS DA TARPAULIN BACK OVER IT WITOUT BEING ASKED|LOOKS AT DA STENCIL AN' DEN AT {stranger}|SAYS NUTTIN', AN' HEAVES}

choices.text: COVER IT BACK UP AN' GET DA CART OUT!
READ DA STENCIL PROPERLY.
LET GO OF DA CART AN' STEP BACK!

h_stencil.text:
IT IZ A HOSPITAL MARK. DA CRATES IZ {DRUGS|MEDICINE|DRESSINGS AN' AMPOULES}, DA SHIPMENT WAZ WRITTEN OFF AS LOST {A COUPLE OF WEEKS|A MONTH|SOME TIME} AGO, AN' {stranger} IZ NO A SMUGGLER, {stranger} IZ DA ONE TAKIN' DEM DA LONG WAY ROUND COZ DA SHORT WAY HAB A CHECKPOINT ON IT.
DA CART COMES OUT ON DA FOURTH HEAVE WIT EVERYBODY PUSHIN' INCLUDIN' DA PARTY'S OPINION OF DA AFTERNOON!

h_step.text:
STEPPIN' BACK IN A FORD IZ A LOUD DECISION EVEN WHEN NOBODY SAYS ANYTINK, AN' {stranger} WATCHES IT HAPPEN FROM DA BRIDLE END WIT WATER TA DA KNEE.
DA CART COMES OUT AN HOUR LATER WIT TWO OTHER PEOPLE'S HELP. DA PARTY IZ A LONG WAY UP DA ROAD BY DEN, DRY FROM DA THIGH DOWN, AN' SLIGHTLY WORSE COMPANY DEN DEY WAZ AT NOON!

e_m.text:
DA VIEW BACK FROM DA NEXT RISE: DA CART STILL IN DA FORD, {SMALLER NOW|FURTHER OFF|NO SMALLER DEN IT LOOKED}, AN' DA ARGUMENT CONTINUIN' WITOUT ANY NEED OF DA PARTY'S OPINION.
DEN DA WATER COMES UP, SLOWLY: {A HAND'S WIDTH|FOUR INCHES|ENOUGH TA NOTICE} IN DA TIME IT TAKES TA WATCH, WHICH MEANS DERE IZ WEATHER SOMEWHERE UPSTREAM DAT NOBODY AT DA FORD CAN SEE!

choices.text: WALK ON. NO OUR RIVER.
GO BACK AN' SAY SO.
READ DA WATER AN' WORK OUT HOW LONG DEY HAB!

e_warn.text:
SHOUTIN' IT FROM DA BANK IZ ENOUGH. {stranger} TAKES ONE LOOK UPSTREAM, CUTS DA LOAD FREE WIT A KNIFE RATHER DEN UNTIE IT, AN' HAB {animal} OUT OF DA SHAFTS INSIDE {A COUPLE OF MINUTES|NINETY SECONDS|NO TIME AT ALL}.
DA CART GOES. DA LOAD GOES. EVERYTINK WIT A HEARTBEAT IN IT IZ STANDIN' ON DA BANK WHEN DA WATER COMES THROUGH, WHICH IZ DA ONLY ARITHMETIC DAT MATTERS AN' WHICH {stranger} WILL NO STOP SAYIN'!

e_flood.text:
READ PROPERLY, DERE IZ {DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|'BOUT DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR} IN IT, WHICH IZ ENOUGH FOR DA BEAST, DA LOAD AN' DA CART, IN DAT ORDER, IF NOBODY STANDS 'BOUT.
NOBODY STANDS 'BOUT. EVERYTINK IZ ON DA BANK WIT {TWO MINUTES|A LONG MINUTE|A MINUTE} TA SPARE AN' DA FORD IZ IMPASSABLE FOR TWO DAYS AFTERWARDS, AN' DA STORY OF IT IZ WORTH A FREE BED AT EITHER END OF DIS ROAD FOR A YEAR!

n0.text:
SNARES ON POSTED GROUND AT {place}: {few} OF DEM, SET {DIS MORNIN'|RECENTLY|BADLY, WHICH IZ A CRUELTY OF ITS OWN}, AN' ONE OF DEM HOLDIN' SOMETINK STILL ALIVE.
DA LAND BELONGS TA {stranger}, BY {sign} ON DA GATE. WHOEVER SET DA WIRE WILL BE BACK BEFORE DARK.
ONE SNARE IZ SET DIFFERENTLY FROM DA OTHERS: {TIGHTER|HIGHER|WIT A KNOT DA REST DO NO HAB}, BY SOMEBODY ELSE'S HANDS!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.aggressive: {member} HAB PICKED OUT A WAITIN' SPOT WIT A VIEW OF DA GATE AN' IZ STANDIN' IN IT!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: SPRING DA SNARES AN' FREE WHAT IZ IN DEM!
WAIT FOR DA ONE WHO SET DEM!
TAKE DA CATCH AN' DA WIRE BOTH!

s2.text:
DA WIRE COMES OFF {few} PEGS WITOUT A SINGLE ONE SNAPPIN' BACK, AN' DA LIVE ONE IZ GONE INTO DA HEDGE BEFORE DA COAT IZ BACK ON.
GOOD WIRE, DIS. IT GOES IN DA PACK, ON DA REASONIN' DAT IT HAB RESIGNED FROM ITS {PREVIOUS EMPLOYMENT|LAST JOB|FORMER LINE OF WORK}!

sx.text:
DA {LAST|THIRD} SNARE HAB A TEMPER. DA WIRE WHIPS, AN' TAKES ITS FEE OUT OF DA BACK OF A HAND ON ITS WAY PAST.
DA ANIMAL GETS AWAY CLEAN, WHICH EVERYBODY INVOLVED, INCLUDIN' DA HAND, RULES {A FAIR TRADE|A FAIR EXCHANGE|'BOUT RIGHT}!

fight.text: WHOEVER COMES OVER DA STILE AT DUSK COMES ARMED FOR {WIRE AN' RABBITS|RABBITS|AN EMPTY FIELD} AN' FINDS DA AFTERNOON HAB OTHER PLANS!

theft.text:
DA CATCH, DA WIRE, AN' DA PEGS, ALL OF IT, GONE INSIDE {TEN|FIFTEEN} MINUTES.
SOMEWHERE BEHIND, A POACHER IZ GOING TA STAND IN AN EMPTY FIELD WORKIN' OUT DAT SOMEBODY HAB POACHED DA POACHIN', AN' DERE IZ A LIL' UGLY SATISFACTION IN DAT WHICH DOES NO ENTIRELY SURVIVE {DA WALK|DA WALK BACK|DA FIRST MILE OF IT}!

fight_m.text:
WAITIN' TAKES DA LAST {HOUR|TWO HOURS|OF DA LIGHT} BEHIND DA HEDGE WIT DA WIRE IN VIEW AN' DA LIVE ONE IN DA SNARE GOING QUIET IN A WAY DAT IZ HARD TA SIT THROUGH.
WHOEVER COMES OVER DA STILE AT DUSK IZ {LIL'|NO LARGE|NOWHERE NEAR DA SIZE OF DA PROBLEM}, COMES ARMED FOR RABBITS, AN' STOPS DEAD AT DA SIGHT OF FOUR STRANGERS IN A POSTED FIELD!

choices.text: TAKE DEM. DEY IZ POACHIN'!
TALK FIRST. FIND OUT WHO SET DA ODD SNARE!
LET DEM GO AN' SAY NUTTIN' TA ANYBODY!

fight_talk.text:
FOUR OF DA SNARES IZ DEY AN' DEY SAY SO WITOUT MUCH PROMPTIN', COZ DEY IZ {TWELVE|FOURTEEN|NO OLD} AN' HUNGRY AN' OUT OF ARGUMENTS.
DA FIFTH IZ NO DEY. DA FIFTH BELONGS TA SOMEBODY WHO HAB BIN USING DIS FIELD FOR {A SEASON|MONTHS|LONGER DEN DAT} AN' WHO DOES NO SET WIRE FOR RABBITS, AN' DA DESCRIPTION OF DEM IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA CATCH AN' DA WIRE TOGETHER!

fight_let.text:
DEY IZ OVER DA STILE AN' GONE IN {A COUPLE OF SECONDS|NO TIME|DA TIME IT TAKES TA DECIDE NO TA MOVE}, LEAVIN' DA WIRE, DA CATCH AN' DA FIELD.
DA LIVE ONE GOES INTO DA HEDGE. DA WIRE GOES IN DA PACK. NOBODY ON EITHER SIDE OF DA HEDGE MENTIONS DA AFTERNOON AGAIN, AN' {A COUPLE OF MONTHS|A SEASON|SOME WEEKS} LATER A BAG OF SOMETINK EDIBLE IZ LEFT ON DA PARTY'S STEP BY SOMEBODY WHO DOES NO KNOCK!

theft_m.text:
DA CATCH, DA WIRE AN' DA PEGS GO IN DA PACKS INSIDE {TEN|FIFTEEN} MINUTES, WHICH IZ DA EASY PART.
DA ODD SNARE IZ DA HARD PART. IT IZ SET WIT A KNOT NOBODY IN DA PARTY CAN TIE, IT IZ SET FOR SOMETINK {LARGER|A GREAT DEAL LARGER|DA WRONG SIZE FOR DIS FIELD}, AN' IT IZ SET ACROSS A RUN DAT COMES OUT OF DA WOOD RATHER DEN OUT OF DA HEDGE!

choices.text: TAKE DAT ONE TOO AN' GO.
LEAVE IT EXACTLY AS FOUND AN' GET OFF DA LAND!
SET OURSELVES UP ON DA RUN AN' SEE WHAT IT IZ FOR!

theft_leave.text:
DA WIRE DA PARTY TOOK IZ DA PARTY'S. DA WIRE DA PARTY DID NO TAKE STAYS SET, ACROSS A RUN, EXACTLY AS FOUND, WIT DA KNOT UNDISTURBED.
A FORTNIGHT LATER, AT A FIRE {TWO VALLEYS|A DISTRICT|A LONG WAY} FROM HERE, SOMEBODY DESCRIBES DAT KNOT AN' DA WHOLE TABLE GOES QUIET, AN' DA PARTY DISCOVERS WHAT DEY WALKED AWAY FROM WITOUT EVER HAVIN' TA SEE IT!

theft_wait.text:
THREE HOURS ON DA RUN WIT DA LIGHT GOING AN' DA WOOD BEHIND, AN' WHAT COMES DOWN IT AT {FULL DARK|DA END OF DA LIGHT|DA WORST POSSIBLE HOUR} IZ WALKIN' ON TWO LEGS AN' IZ NO A POACHER.
IT IZ IN DA SNARE FOR A BREATH OR TWO, WHICH IZ THREE SECONDS LONGER DEN IT EXPECTS AN' ONE SECOND LESS DEN DA PARTY NEEDS, AN' DEN DA FIELD IZ A DIFFERENT KIND OF PLACE ENTIRELY!

qe_stall.title: {SHORT A ROOF|OPEN TA DA SKY|DA MISSIN' COURSE}

n0.text:
A ROOF AT {place} STANDS OPEN TA DA SKY WIT {stranger} ON TOP OF IT, AN' DA YARD BELOW SAYS DA JOB STOPPED MID-COURSE: TRESTLES OUT, LADDER UP, NUTTIN' MOVIN'.
DA JOB IZ SHORT {qty} {material}. DA SUPPLIER IZ {distance}, AN' BETWEEN HERE AN' DERE IZ {misfortune}, AN' DA SKY IZ NO GOING TA WAIT ON ANY OF IT.
DA TRESTLES IZ SET UP FOR {TWO PEOPLE|A PAIR|SOMEBODY AN' A MATE}, AN' DERE IZ ONLY ONE PERSON ON DA ROOF!

asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: HAND OVER DA {material}.
GO UP AN' MAKE WHAT IZ DERE STRETCH!
TAKE DA SUPPLIER'S NAME AN' MOVE ON!

g2.text:
DA COURSE GOES ON BEFORE DA LIGHT GOES, AN' DA ROOF IZ A ROOF BY DARK.
{stranger} PAYS OVER DA ODDS AN' WILL NO BE ARGUED DOWN: {payment}, COUNTED INTO {leader}'S HAND ON DA TAILGATE, AN' DA FIRST RAIN DAT NIGHT LANDS ON FINISHED WORK!

hh.text:
AN AFTERNOON OF PASSIN', HOLDIN', AN' NO LOOKIN' DOWN, AN' WHAT IZ DERE STRETCHES FURTHER DEN DA ARITHMETIC SAID IT COULD.
DA GAP DAT IZ LEFT IZ LIL' ENOUGH TA TARPAULIN WIT DIGNITY. PAYMENT IN {payment}, AN' A STANDIN' WELCOME UNDER DA ROOF DA PARTY {HELPED CLOSE|CLOSED|GOT A COURSE ONTO}!

hf.text:
A BATTEN GIVES, AN' FOR ONE LONG SECOND DA YARD IZ A GOOD DEAL CLOSER DEN PLANNED.
CAUGHT, MOSTLY, BY DA TRESTLE AN' PARTLY BY {stranger}, AT DA COST OF A BRUISE SHAPED LIKE CARPENTRY. DA TARPAULIN GOES ON IN SILENCE!

e5.text:
DA SUPPLIER'S NAME GOES IN {DA DIARY|DA BOOK|DA BACK OF DA DIARY} UNDER TINKZ DAT CAN BE FIXED BY SOMEBODY WIT A FULL PACK AN' A FREE MORNIN'.
BEHIND, ON DA ROOF, DA HAMMERIN' STARTS AGAIN ANYWAY, SLOWER, {weather}!

g2_m.text:
DA {material} GOES UP DA LADDER IN TWO LOADS AN' DA COURSE GOES ON BEFORE DA LIGHT GOES, AN' 'BOUT HALFWAY ALONG {stranger} STOPS AN' SITS BACK ON DEY HEELS.
UNDER DA OLD COURSE DA DECK IZ {SOFT|GONE|HOLDIN' ON OUT OF HABIT} FOR 'BOUT A METRE AN' A HALF, AN' IT HAB BIN DAT WAY A GOOD DEAL LONGER DEN DIS JOB HAB BIN RUNNIN'!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SO WE IZ ROOFIN' A HOLE.|LOVELY. NEW TILES ON WET CAKE.|DAT ROOF IZ AN OPINION.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A KNIFE INTO DA DECK AN' IT GOES IN TOO EASILY|HOLDS DA LADDER AN' LOOKS UP|WHISTLES ONCE}

choices.text: COVER IT. IT IZ DEY ROOF AN' DEY MONEY!
CUT DA BAD DECK OUT AN' SPLICE NEW IN!
COME DOWN. TELL DEM WHAT IT WILL COST DONE PROPERLY!

g2_deck.text:
A METRE AN' A HALF OF DECK OUT, NEW IN, SCARFED AT BOTH ENDS, AN' {A COUPLE OF HOURS|DA REST OF DA LIGHT|LONGER DEN ANYBODY WANTED} GONE ON A JOB NOBODY WAZ BEING PAID FOR.
DA ROOF IZ A ROOF BY DARK AN' WILL BE ONE IN TEN YEARS. {stranger} PAYS DA AGREED PRICE AN' DEN COMES {FOUR MILES|ACROSS DA DISTRICT|A LONG WAY} DA FOLLOWIN' WEEK WIT DA DIFFERENCE AN' AN APOLOGY FOR NO HAVIN' IT ON DA DAY!

g2_through.text:
DA BAD METRE AN' A HALF TURNS OUT TA BE {THREE|FOUR} METRES AN' DA SAW FINDS ALL OF IT AT ONCE, FROM ABOVE, STANDIN' ON IT.
NOBODY GOES THROUGH TA DA YARD, WHICH IZ DA ONLY REASON DIS COUNTS AS A NEAR MISS RATHER DEN A STORY. DA ROOF IZ OPEN WIDER DEN IT WAZ AT NOON, DA TARPAULIN GOES ON, AN' EVERYBODY COMES DOWN DA LADDER IN A SPECIFIC SILENCE!

g2_quote.text:
