IT IZ NO A CONVERSATION ANYBODY WANTS AT DA BOTTOM OF A LADDER IN {weather}, AN' IT TAKES {A GOOD WHILE|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|TWO GOES} COZ DA FIRST VERSION IZ TOO GENTLE TA BE USEFUL.
DA NUMBER IZ BAD. {stranger} TAKES IT STANDIN' UP, THANKS DA PARTY FOR SAYIN' IT BEFORE DA TILES WENT ON RATHER DEN AFTER, AN' GOES TA SELL {DA TRAILER|A FIELD|SOMETINK DEY WAZ KEEPIN'}!

e5_m.text:
DA SUPPLIER'S NAME GOES IN {DA DIARY|DA BOOK|DA BACK OF DA DIARY} UNDER TINKZ DAT CAN BE FIXED BY SOMEBODY WIT A FULL PACK AN' A FREE MORNIN'.
DA MORNIN' IZ FREE. DA SUPPLIER IZ {distance} AN' SHUT, AN' DA YARD BEHIND DA SHUTTER HAB EXACTLY WHAT DA ROOF NEEDS STACKED AGAINST DA WALL WHERE ANYBODY CAN SEE IT!

choices.text: WALK ON. IT IZ SHUT AN' IT IZ NO OURS!
FIND WHOEVER HOLDS DA KEY!
TAKE WHAT DA ROOF NEEDS AN' LEAVE DA MONEY ON DA STACK!

e5_key.text:
DA KEY IZ WIT A {DAUGHTER|NEPHEW|NEIGHBOUR} FOUR DOORS DOWN WHO HAB BIN WAITIN' THREE DAYS FOR SOMEBODY TA ASK, COZ DA SUPPLIER IZ IN HOSPITAL AN' NOBODY THOUGHT TA SAY SO.
DA YARD OPENS. DA ROOF GETS ITS COURSE. DA SUPPLIER GETS PAID, PROPERLY, BY POST, AN' HEARS 'BOUT DA WHOLE BUSINESS FROM {THREE|FOUR} DIRECTIONS BEFORE DA WEEK IZ OUT!

e5_take.text:
OVER DA WALL, OFF DA STACK, EXACT MONEY LEFT UNDER A BRICK WHERE IT WILL BE FOUND AN' NO BLOWN AWAY.
DA ROOF IZ FINISHED BY DARK. WHETHER DA MONEY IZ FOUND BEFORE DA BRICK IZ, IZ A MATTER NOBODY IN DA PARTY FINDS OUT, AN' IT STAYS IN DA BACK OF {member}'S HEAD FOR {A FORTNIGHT|SOME WEEKS|LONGER DEN IT SHOULD}!

qe_bet.title: {DA FAIR|DA STALL DAT DOES DA ARITHMETIC|LIL' STAKE, BIG POT}

n0.text:
A FAIR AT {place}: {many} STALLS, ONE BAND, AN' ONE STALL TAKIN' MONEY ON {A STRENGTH MACHINE|A RING TOSS DAT IZ NO AS EASY AS IT LOOKS|A CARD DA WHOLE CROWD IZ SURE IT CAN FOLLOW}.
{stranger} RUNS IT WIT DA FACE OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB DONE DA ARITHMETIC AN' SLEEPS WELL ON IT. DA STAKE IZ LIL'. DA POT IZ NO.
DERE IZ A SECOND MAN AT DA BACK OF DA STALL DOING NUTTIN' AT ALL, {WELL DRESSED|HANDS IN POCKETS|WATCHIN' DA CROWD RATHER DEN DA GAME}!

asides.hedonistic: {member} HAB ALREADY LOST TWICE AN' IZ HAVIN' A WONDERFUL TIME!
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PUT DA STAKE DOWN AN' PLAY!
READ DA TRICK BEFORE SPENDIN' A COIN!
JUST ENJOY DA FAIR.

wb.text:
DA POT PAYS OUT TA A STALL-HOLDER'S ROUND OF APPLAUSE, WHICH IZ HOW A PROFESSIONAL BURIES A BAD QUARTER OF AN HOUR.
DA CROWD CARRIES {leader} TA {bar} ON DA STRENGTH OF IT AN' DA STORY IZ ALREADY GROWIN' ON DA WAY!

lb.text:
DA ARITHMETIC WAZ DEY ALL ALONG, DA WAY IT ALWAYS WAZ.
DA STAKE IZ GONE, DA CROWD IZ KIND 'BOUT IT, AN' DA {drink} AFTERWARDS TASTES OF BEING ONE MORE PERSON DA STALL HAB PUT THROUGH DA SAME {SHORT EDUCATION|BRIEF EDUCATION|SHORT LESSON}!

rb.text:
DA TRICK IZ {IN DA THUMB|IN DA FELT|IN DA COUNT}, AN' ONCE SEEN IT NO CAN BE UNSEEN.
ONE PLAY, PLACED PROPERLY, AN' A QUIET EXIT AT DA PACE OF SOMEBODY WHO KNOWS EXACTLY HOW LONG A STALL-HOLDER TAKES TA {WORK OUT WHAT JUST HAPPENED|CATCH UP|DO DAT ARITHMETIC}!

lb2.text:
AFTER {FORTY MINUTES|AN HOUR|HALF AN EVENIN'} OF WATCHIN', DA ONLY FIRM DISCOVERY IZ DAT DA STALL HAB BIN WATCHIN' BACK, WIT PROFESSIONAL INTEREST, SINCE MINUTE FIVE.
NO COIN HAB CHANGED HANDS. BOTH SIDES UNDERSTAND IT IZ A DRAW, AN' DERE IZ A STRANGE COURTESY IN {DA NOD EXCHANGED AT PARTIN'|DA NOD AT DA END OF IT|HOW DA NOD IZ GIVEN}!

v2.text: DA BAND IZ {LOUD|TOO LOUD|LOUD AN' NO GOOD}, {food} IZ EXACTLY WHAT IT SHOULD BE AN' NO BETTER, AN' FOR ONE WHOLE EVENIN' DA PARTY'S LINE OF WORK DOES NO COME UP ONCE!

rb_m.text:
DA TRICK IZ {IN DA THUMB|IN DA FELT|IN DA COUNT}, AN' ONCE SEEN IT NO CAN BE UNSEEN, AN' DA WHOLE STALL UNFOLDS INTO ARITHMETIC IN 'BOUT {A COUPLE OF SECONDS|A MOMENT|DA SPACE OF ONE PLAY}.
DA MAN AT DA BACK HAB SEEN DA PARTY SEE IT. HE DOES NO MOVE. HE {SMILES|NODS|RAISES HIS CHIN} REAL SLIGHTLY, WHICH IZ EITHER AN INVITATION OR A WARNIN' AN' IZ ALMOST CERTAINLY BOTH!

choices.text: ONE PLAY, PLACED PROPERLY, DEN LEAVE QUICKLY!
GO AN' TALK TA DA MAN AT DA BACK!
TELL DA CROWD HOW IT WORKS!

rb_back.text:
HE IZ DA MAN WHO BUYS GOOD HANDS DRINKS AT DA END OF A FAIR, AN' HE HAB BIN STANDIN' DERE SINCE NOON WATCHIN' {FOUR HUNDRED|A GREAT MANY|DA WHOLE COUNTY'S WORTH OF} PEOPLE NO SEE IT.
DA CONVERSATION LASTS AN HOUR AN' COSTS DA PARTY NUTTIN' AN' ENDS WIT AN ADDRESS, A NAME TA USE AT IT, AN' WORK FOR ANYBODY WIT EYES, WHENEVER DEY WANT IT!

rb_out.text:
HE LISTENS TA DA WHOLE APPROACH WIT DA PATIENCE OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB HEARD IT IN {NINE COUNTIES|A DOZEN TOWNS|EVERY COUNTY BETWEEN HERE AN' DA COAST}, AN' DEN EXPLAINS, KINDLY, DAT DA STALL IZ HIS, DAT DA TRICK IZ HIS, AN' DAT DA PARTY HAB 'BOUT AS LONG AS IT TAKES TA FINISH A DRINK.
DA DRINK IZ FINISHED. NOBODY IZ TOUCHED. DA FAIR IZ A GREAT DEAL LESS FUN FROM DAT POINT ON!

rb_crowd.text:
EXPLAININ' A TRICK TA A CROWD DAT HAB BIN LOSIN' AT IT ALL AFTERNOON WORKS EXACTLY AS WELL AS IT DESERVES TA, WHICH IZ TA SAY {INSTANTLY AN' DEN REAL BADLY|BEAUTIFULLY FOR NINETY SECONDS|TOO WELL}.
DA STALL GOES OVER. SOMEBODY'S COAT GETS TORN AN' IT IZ NO DA STALL-HOLDER'S. DA PARTY LEAVES DA FAIR BY DA FAR GATE AT A GOOD PACE WIT {A SHARE OF DA FLOAT|DA POT|A HANDFUL OF SOMEBODY'S MONEY} AN' A DESCRIPTION OF DEM GOING ROUND DA FIELD!

v2_m.text:
DA BAND IZ {LOUD|TOO LOUD|LOUD AN' NO GOOD}, {food} IZ EXACTLY WHAT IT SHOULD BE AN' NO BETTER, AN' FOR ONE WHOLE EVENIN' DA PARTY'S LINE OF WORK DOES NO COME UP ONCE.
AT 'BOUT {TEN|ELEVEN|DA HOUR DA BAND STOPS} SOMEBODY STARTS SHOUTIN' NEAR DA GATE, AN' IT IZ DA SORT OF SHOUTIN' DAT HAB {A NAME|A PERSON|SOMEBODY'S CHILD} IN DA MIDDLE OF IT!

choices.text: STAY AT DA FIRE. NO TONIGHT!
GO AN' HELP LOOK.
GET DA GATES SHUT BEFORE ANYBODY LEAVES DA FIELD!

v2_found.text:
UNDER DA FLAP OF DA BEER TENT, ASLEEP, {FOUR METRES|A FEW FEET|NO DISTANCE AT ALL} FROM WHERE EVERYBODY HAB ALREADY LOOKED TWICE.
DA SHOUTIN' STOPS. DA BAND STARTS AGAIN. DA PARTY DRINKS FREE FOR DA REST OF DA NIGHT AT THREE SEPARATE STALLS AN' HAB TA BE TALKED OUT OF DA FIELD AT {TWO|ONE|SOME HOUR} IN DA MORNIN'!

v2_gate.text:
GETTIN' A FAIR'S WORTH OF PEOPLE TA STAY PUT TAKES ONE VOICE, ONE LIE 'BOUT DA POLICE, AN' 'BOUT {MOST OF A MINUTE|A COUPLE OF MINUTES|LESS TIME DEN IT SHOULD}.
DA CHILD IZ FOUND INSIDE DA FIELD, WHICH IZ WHAT EVERYBODY WANTED, AN' IT IZ FOUND BY DEY OWN MOTHER, WHICH IZ BETTER. NOBODY AFTERWARDS IZ ENTIRELY SURE WHOSE IDEA DA GATES WAZ, WHICH IZ HOW DA PARTY PREFERS IT!

v2_long.text:
IT GOES ON FOR {TWO HOURS|MOST OF DA NIGHT|A REAL LONG TIME}, WIT LAMPS, AN' A FIELD, AN' EVERYBODY CALLIN' DA SAME NAME IN DA SAME FOUR DIRECTIONS.
DEY TURN UP AT DAWN {TWO FIELDS OVER|BY DA RIVER|ASLEEP IN A VAN}, COLD AN' FINE, AN' DA RELIEF GOES THROUGH DA WHOLE FAIR LIKE WEATHER. DA PARTY SLEEPS BADLY AN' IZ NO SORRY!

qe_pilgrim.title: {DA PILGRIM|SHORT OF DA SHRINE|A VOW WIT A DEADLINE}

n0.text:
{stranger} IZ SITTIN' AGAINST {sign} AT {place}, SWEATIN', {weather}, A GOOD WAY SHORT OF WHERE A VOW SAYS DEY MUST STAND BY DARK.
SOMETINK'S WRONG IN DA CHEST AN' DEY WILL NO NAME IT, ON DA REASONIN', COMMON AMONG DA DEVOUT AN' DA FRIGHTENED, DAT NAMIN' A TINK INVITES IT IN.
DERE IZ A SECOND SET OF PRINTS ON DA VERGE, {STOPPIN' WHERE DEY IZ SITTIN'|COMIN' BACK DA OTHER WAY|WALKIN' OFF DA ROAD AN' NO RETURNIN'}!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GIVE WHAT MEDICINE DA PACK HOLDS!
TREAT IT IN DA FIELD, BARE-HANDED!
CARRY DEM DA REST OF DA WAY!

gm.text:
DA HERBS DO WHAT HERBS DO, SLOWLY, AN' DA COLOUR COMES BACK IN DA WRONG ORDER BUT IT COMES BACK.
DA PILGRIM PAYS IN DA ONLY COIN DA ORDER DEALS IN: A PRAYER DAT WORKS, TAUGHT WORD-PERFECT ON DA WALK DAT IZ LEFT, WIT STRICT INSTRUCTIONS 'BOUT {WHEN NEVER TA USE IT|DA ONE HOUR IT MUST NEVER BE USED|WHO IT MUST NEVER BE USED ON}!

wt.text:
BREATHIN' SETTLES UNDER {leader}'S HANDS DA OLD WAY: POSTURE, PRESSURE, AN' A VOICE KEPT DELIBERATELY BORIN'.
DA LAST STRETCH IZ WALKED SLOW, TOGETHER, AN' AT DA SHRINE DA PILGRIM STANDS DERE BEFORE DARK, AN' DOES NO LOOK BACK, AN' DOES NO NEED TA!

wf.text:
WHATEVER IZ WRONG IN DAT CHEST IZ ABOVE FIELD REPAIR AN' EVERYBODY KNEELIN' ON DA VERGE KNOWS IT.
WHAT CAN BE DONE IZ DONE: SHADE, WATER, AN' COMPANY, WHICH IZ NO NUTTIN'. DA VOW IZ MISSED. DA PILGRIM SAYS DA DEADLINE MATTERED LESS DEN DA WALKIN', AN' ALMOST SOUNDS {CONVINCED|AS IF DEY MEAN IT|LIKE SOMEBODY WHO BELIEVES IT}!

ct.text:
{distance}, MOST OF IT UPHILL, ALL OF IT IN DA OPEN, {weather}, IN RELAYS.
DA SHRINE APPEARS AROUND DA LAST BEND WIT DA BETTER PART OF AN HOUR OF DA LIGHT LEFT, AN' DA PILGRIM ARRIVES CARRIED, WHICH DEY ORDER, CONSULTED AFTERWARDS, RULES IZ ARRIVIN' ALL DA SAME!

cf.text:
A SHORT DRIVE OF IT, AN' DEN DA PARTY'S LEGS FILE A FORMAL OBJECTION ON A WET SLOPE.
EVERYBODY SITS ON DA WET SLOPE FOR A WHILE, WRECKED TOGETHER, AN' DA PILGRIM LAUGHS FOR DA FIRST TIME ALL DAY, WHICH IZ WORTH SOMETINK EVEN IF NUTTIN' ELSE WAZ {REACHED|ARRIVED AT|GOT TA}!

gm_m.text:
WHAT IZ IN DA PACK IZ {HERBS|WHAT A PACK HOLDS|TWO OR THREE USEFUL TINKZ} AN' NONE OF IT IZ FOR A CHEST, AN' EVERYBODY KNEELIN' ON DA VERGE KNOWS IT.
DA PILGRIM WILL TAKE DA HERBS. DA PILGRIM WILL NO TAKE DA OFFER OF A HOSPITAL, A VEHICLE, OR A DELAY, AN' SAYS SO IN DA TONE OF SOMEBODY QUOTIN' A RULE AT THEMSELVES RATHER DEN AT DA PARTY!

asides.nurturing: {member} HAB A WRIST BETWEEN TWO FINGERS AN' IZ COUNTIN' BEFORE ANYBODY HAB FINISHED ARGUIN'!
asides.any: {member} {GETS DA PACK OPEN|SHADES DEM WIT A COAT|SITS DOWN ON DA VERGE TA BE AT EYE LEVEL}

choices.text: GIVE DA HERBS. RESPECT DA VOW!
WORK OUT WHAT IZ ACTUALLY WRONG FIRST!
ARGUE DA RULE WIT DEM ON ITS OWN TERMS!

gm_diag.text:
IT IZ {DA GUT|DEHYDRATION AN' DA GUT|DA BEST PART OF A WEEK OF BAD WATER}, PRESENTIN' HIGH, DA WAY IT DOES, AN' IT IZ ENTIRELY FIXABLE ON A VERGE BY ANYBODY WHO KNOWS TA LOOK.
AN HOUR OF WATER TAKEN IN SIPS AN' DA PILGRIM IZ WALKIN', BADLY, AN' DEN WALKIN'. DEY STAND AT DA SHRINE WIT {TWENTY MINUTES|DA LIGHT|TIME} TA SPARE AN' DA VOW WHOLE!

gm_rule.text:
DA RULE SAYS UNAIDED. IT DOES NO SAY ALONE, AN' IT DOES NO SAY UNTREATED, AN' DERE IZ {FOUR HUNDRED YEARS|A GREAT DEAL|TWO CENTURIES} OF ARGUMENT ON DA SUBJECT DAT DA PILGRIM HAB CLEARLY NEVER BIN SHOWN.
BEING GIVEN PERMISSION BY A STRANGER WHO CAN CITE IT IZ NO SOMETINK DEY WAZ READY FOR. DEY TAKE DA HELP. DEY ARRIVE. AFTERWARDS DEY WRITE TA DEY ORDER 'BOUT IT, AT LENGTH, AN' DA LETTER DOES DA ROUNDS!

ct_m.text:
{distance}, MOST OF IT UPHILL, ALL OF IT IN DA OPEN, {weather}, IN RELAYS, WIT SOMEBODY ON YA BACK WHO WEIGHS MORE AT EVERY KILOMETRE.
AT DA HALFWAY STONE DERE IZ A CHOICE OF ROAD: DA PILGRIM ROAD, WHICH IZ LONGER AN' MARKED AN' CORRECT, AN' A TRACK OVER DA SHOULDER OF DA HILL DAT IZ {SHORTER|AN HOUR SHORTER|STEEPER AN' SHORTER} AN' IZ NO DA PILGRIM ROAD!

choices.text: DA PILGRIM ROAD. IT IZ DA WHOLE POINT!
OVER DA SHOULDER. ARRIVIN' MATTERS MORE!
PUT DEM DOWN AN' GO AN' FETCH A CART!

ct_short.text:
DA SHOULDER IZ {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|HALF AN HOUR|AN HOUR} OF GROUND NOBODY SHOULD CARRY ANYBODY OVER, AN' IT IZ DONE IN RELAYS WIT ONE PERSON ALWAYS BRACED BELOW.
DA SHRINE COMES UP FROM DA WRONG SIDE WIT {HALF AN HOUR|A GOOD HALF HOUR|MORE TIME DEN ANYBODY HOPED} IN HAND. DA PILGRIM STANDS. DEN SITS. DEN STANDS AGAIN FOR DA WHOLE OF IT, WHICH TAKES UNTIL DARK!

ct_cart.text:
DA NEAREST CART IZ {TWO KILOMETRES|A MILE AN' A HALF|DA WRONG WAY} BACK AN' BELONGS TA SOMEBODY WHO TAKES {TEN MINUTES|A WHILE|SOME PERSUADIN'} TA BE PERSUADED.
IT GETS DERE. DA PILGRIM ARRIVES ON WHEELS RATHER DEN ON FEET OR ON A BACK, AN' DEY ORDER, CONSULTED AFTERWARDS, IZ DIVIDED 'BOUT DIS IN A WAY DAT WILL KEEP {TWO|THREE} SCHOLARS BUSY FOR A SEASON!

qe_lockup.title: {LOT 41|DA LOCKUP NOBODY CLAIMED|KEYS DAT DO NO FIT}

n0.text:
A LOCKUP AT {place}, SOLD AT AUCTION {timeAgo} TA A BIDDER WHO NEVER CAME FOR IT.
{stranger} HAB A RING OF KEYS DAT DO NO FIT, A PAPER DAT SAYS DA CONTENTS IZ DEY IF DA DOOR IZ OPEN BY DARK, AN' AN OFFER: DA PARTY OPENS IT, DA PARTY GETS A SHARE OF WHATEVER IZ SHELVED INSIDE.
DA DUST AT DA FOOT OF DA DOOR HAB BIN DISTURBED {RECENTLY|IN DA LAST DAY OR TWO|BY SOMEBODY WHO WAZ CAREFUL 'BOUT DA REST OF IT}!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.impulsive: {member} HAB TRIED THREE KEYS ALREADY, ON DA GROUNDS DAT SOMEBODY HAB TA!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PICK IT.
FORCE DA DOOR.
READ DA AUCTION PAPER PROPERLY FIRST!

pl.text:
DA LOCK IZ OLD AN' PROUD AN' GIVES UP ITS DIGNITY ONE PIN AT A TIME.
INSIDE: SHELVES, PACKED BY SOMEBODY METHODICAL, AN' DA PARTY'S SHARE OF IT FILLS DA PACKS TA DA STRAPS. {stranger} KEEPS DA PAPER AN' DA STORY, AN' CONSIDERS IT {A BARGAIN|A GOOD TRADE|WELL BOUGHT}!

fl.text:
DA DOOR LOSES{, EVENTUALLY| IN DA END| ON DA FOURTH GO}, BUT TAKES ITS TOLL ON DA WAY DOWN: HALF OF WHAT WAZ SHELVED BEHIND IT DOES NO SURVIVE DA ARGUMENT.
DA HALF DAT DOES IZ STILL A GOOD AFTERNOON'S WORK BY {WEIGHT|WEIGHT ALONE|ANY MEASURE}!

pf.text:
DA DOOR WINS DA FIRST TWO ROUNDS AN' PART OF DA THIRD, AN' BY DARK IT IZ STILL SHUT AN' DA PAPER IZ SO MUCH KINDLIN'.
{stranger} IZ DECENT 'BOUT IT, WHICH STINGS WORSE DEN DA KNUCKLES!

ip.text:
DA PAPER IZ GENUINE, AN' BETTER DEN GENUINE: DOWN IN DA SCHEDULE, IN DA LIL' TYPE, IZ AN LOOT SACK DA SELLER NEVER READ.
{leader} NAMES A FAIRER SPLIT BEFORE A SINGLE KEY TURNS, WIT DA LOOT SACK AS DA ARGUMENT, AN' IT IZ AGREED TA AT SPEED. DA DOOR, TRIED ONCE MORE WIT FEELIN', OPENS AFTER ALL ON {DA PLAINEST KEY ON DA RING|A KEY NOBODY HAB BET ON|DA ONE KEY DAT LOOKED WRONG FOR IT}!

e6.text:
DA LIL' TYPE DEFEATS {DA LIGHT|DA EYES|EVERYBODY IN TURN} AN' DA LIGHT IZ GOING.
SOME DOORS KEEP DEY AFTERNOONS. DA KEYS GO BACK IN A POCKET, DA PAPER BACK IN ITS ENVELOPE, AN' DA LOCKUP KEEPS ITS SHAPES, PLURAL, FOR {ANOTHER OWNER|DA NEXT OWNER|SOMEBODY ELSE ENTIRELY}!

pl_m.text:
DA LOCK IZ OLD AN' PROUD AN' GIVES UP ITS DIGNITY ONE PIN AT A TIME, AN' ON DA THIRD PIN IT BECOMES OBVIOUS DAT SOMEBODY HAB BIN IN HERE {DIS WEEK|RECENTLY|BEFORE DA PARTY AN' AFTER DA AUCTION}: DA PINS IZ BRIGHT WHERE DEY SHOULD BE BLACK.
DA DOOR OPENS ON SHELVES, PACKED BY SOMEBODY METHODICAL, WIT {ONE GAP|A GAP IN DA MIDDLE SHELF|A RECTANGLE OF CLEAN FLOOR} WHERE SOMETINK DA SIZE OF A TRUNK USED TA BE!

choices.text: FILL DA PACKS AN' GO. PLENTY LEFT!
WORK OUT WHAT STOOD IN DA GAP!
SHUT IT, RELOCK IT, AN' WATCH DA LOCKUP UNTIL DARK!

pl_gap.text:
DA SHELVES EITHER SIDE OF DA GAP IZ AN LOOT SACK IN THEMSELVES: EVERYTINK ON DEM IZ {DA SAME TRADE|FROM ONE PROFESSION|PART OF ONE KIT}, AN' WHAT IZ MISSIN' IZ DA PART OF DAT KIT WORTH KILLIN' FOR.
{stranger} GOES REAL QUIET WHEN TOLD, AN' DEN NAMES DA BIDDER WHO NEVER CAME, AN' DEN SAYS DAT MAN HAB BIN DEAD {TWO YEARS|SINCE DA SPRING|A WHILE}!

pl_watch.text:
FOUR HOURS ACROSS DA ROAD IN A DOORWAY WIT DA LIGHT GOING AN' {stranger} LOSIN' PATIENCE IN {TEN-MINUTE|REGULAR|INCREASINGLY LOUD} INSTALMENTS.
AT DUSK SOMEBODY COMES WIT A KEY DAT WORKS. WHAT FOLLOWS IZ A CONVERSATION RATHER DEN A FIGHT, CONDUCTED AT A DISTANCE OF {FOUR METRES|SOME YARDS|DA WIDTH OF DA ROAD}, AN' AT DA END OF IT DA PARTY HAB HALF OF WHAT IZ INSIDE AN' DA WHOLE OF A NAME!

fl_m.text:
FORCIN' IT MEANS A BAR, A SHOULDER, AN' SOMEBODY COUNTIN', AN' DA DOOR LOSES{, EVENTUALLY| IN DA END| ON DA FOURTH GO}.
HALFWAY THROUGH DA THIRD GO DA NOISE BRINGS SOMEBODY OUT OF DA YARD OPPOSITE: {AN OLD MAN|A WOMAN WIT A DOG|SOMEBODY IN A DRESSIN' GOWN} WHO WATCHES DA WHOLE PERFORMANCE WIT DEY ARMS FOLDED AN' DOES NO GO BACK INSIDE!

choices.text: FINISH IT. LET DEM WATCH.
STOP, AN' GO AN' EXPLAIN OURSELVES!
STOP, AN' ASK DEM WHAT DEY KNOW 'BOUT DA LOCKUP!

fl_cover.text:
DA PAPER IZ GENUINE AN' DA STORY IZ TOLD WIT DA PAPER HELD UP, WHICH IZ {NINETY PER CENT|MOST|NEARLY ALL} OF HOW ANYTINK IZ BELIEVED.
DEY GO BACK INSIDE. DA DOOR COMES DOWN ON DA FOURTH GO. HALF OF WHAT WAZ SHELVED DOES NO SURVIVE IT AN' DA HALF DAT DOES IZ A GOOD AFTERNOON'S WORK BY WEIGHT!

fl_cops.text:
DA STORY IZ A LIL' TOO SMOOTH AN' DA PAPER IZ A LIL' TOO FAR AWAY TA READ, AN' DA DRESSIN' GOWN GOES BACK INSIDE AN' PICKS UP A TELEPHONE.
WHAT IZ IN DA LOCKUP IZ IN DA PACKS BY DA TIME ANYBODY ARRIVES, WHICH IZ {DA GOOD NEWS|DA ONLY GOOD NEWS|SOMETINK}. DA REST OF DA EVENIN' INVOLVES A GREAT DEAL OF STANDIN' IN A YARD BEING ASKED DA SAME FOUR QUESTIONS!

fl_ask.text:
DEY KNOW EVERYTINK. PEOPLE IN DRESSIN' GOWNS OPPOSITE LOCKUPS ALWAYS DO: WHO BID, WHO NEVER CAME, WHO HAB BIN ROUND {TWICE|MORE DEN ONCE|SINCE DA SPRING} WIT A TORCH AT NIGHT, AN' WHAT COLOUR VAN DEY DRIVE.
DA DOOR STILL HAB TA COME DOWN AN' IT STILL COSTS HALF DA CONTENTS. DA INFORMATION COSTS NUTTIN' AN' IZ WORTH CONSIDERABLY MORE DEN DA HALF DAT BROKE!

q_leyline.title: {DA BROKEN LINE|WHERE DA MAGIC STOPPED|DRY GROUND}

n0.text:
NUTTIN' CASTS AT {place}, AT ALL. {member} TRIES DA SMALLEST CANTRIP ANYBODY KNOWS AN' {ground} TAKES IT LIKE A STONE TAKIN' RAIN.
SOMEBODY BROKE DA LINE HERE, AN' DID IT ON PURPOSE, FROM DA LOOK OF DA BURN PATTERN. {asker} IZ CAMPED A HUNDRED METRES OFF DA DEAD SPOT WIT {instrument} AN' A FACE DAT SAYS DIS IZ WEEK THREE.
DA BURN PATTERN HAB A SECOND BURN INSIDE IT, OLDER, {DA SAME SHAPE BUT SMALLER|IDENTICAL AN' HALF DA SIZE|FROM DA LAST TIME SOMEBODY DID DIS}!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: SPLICE DA LINE WIT {qty} {material}.
READ DA BURN AN' WORK OUT WHO BROKE IT!
WHATEVER WANTED DIS GROUND DRY IZ STILL HERE. FIND IT!

sp.text:
DA SPLICE IZ UGLY WORK WIT DA PARTY'S OWN STOCK AN' IT HOLDS ON DA SECOND ATTEMPT.
DA LINE COMES BACK DA WAY A TAP COMES BACK: AIR FIRST, DEN EVERYTINK AT ONCE. EVERY HAIR ON DA AWAY TEAM STANDS UP, AN' FOR ONE SECOND {leader} CAN FEEL WHERE EVERY OTHER LINE ON DIS {ROCK|WORLD|WHOLE ROCK} RUNS!

rd.text:
DA BREAK WAZ CUT FROM UNDERNEATH AN' CUT CLEAN, WHICH TAKES A CONTRACT AN' A SPECIALIST, NO AN ACCIDENT.
{asker} LOOKS AT DA DIAGRAM FOR A LONG TIME AN' DEN NAMES A PRICE FOR DA PARTY NEVER HAVIN' DRAWN IT: {payment}, AN' DA DIAGRAM GOES IN DA FIRE!

rf.text:
DA BURN READS AS AN ACCIDENT RIGHT UP UNTIL DA PARTY IZ A DAY GONE AN' {member} SITS UP IN DA DARK HAVIN' WORKED OUT WHAT WAZ WRONG WIT DA THIRD MEASUREMENT.
BY DEN IT IZ SOMEBODY ELSE'S {DEAD GROUND|PROBLEM|DEAD GROUND ENTIRELY}!

oil.text:
DOWN UNDER {remnant}, IN A CUT NOBODY MADE WIT TOOLS, SOMETINK IZ SITTIN' IN ITS OWN WEIGHT AN' WAITIN' FOR DA LINE TA COME BACK.
WITOUT DA LEYLINE IT NO CAN REGENERATE. DAT IZ DA ENTIRE REASON DA LINE WAZ CUT, AN' WHOEVER CUT IT NEVER CAME BACK TA {FINISH DA JOB|FINISH IT|DO DA SECOND HALF}!

amb.text: {IT FINDS DA PARTY FIRST|IT IZ ALREADY MOVIN' WHEN DEY TURN|IT COMES UP OUT OF DA CUT FIRST}, WHICH ON DRY GROUND MEANS FINDIN' DEM WITOUT {A SINGLE SPELL|ONE SPELL|ANYTINK AT ALL} BETWEEN DEM AN' IT!

sp_m.text:
DA SPLICE IZ UGLY WORK WIT DA PARTY'S OWN STOCK, AN' HALFWAY THROUGH IT {asker} SAYS, CONVERSATIONALLY, DAT DA LAST PEOPLE TA SPLICE DIS LINE DID IT {DA BETTER PART OF A YEAR AGO|LAST SEASON|DA WINTER BEFORE} AN' WAZ NEVER SEEN LEAVIN'.
DA LINE IZ A HAND'S WIDTH FROM BEING JOINED. IT WOULD TAKE {A MINUTE|A LONG MINUTE|ONE MORE TURN} TA FINISH, AN' 'BOUT DA SAME TA UNDO!

choices.text: FINISH DA SPLICE.
FINISH IT, BUT EARTH IT FIRST SO WHATEVER DRINKS FIRST IZ NO US!
STOP. GO AN' FIND WHAT IZ DOWNSTREAM OF DIS BEFORE JOININ' IT!

sp_earth.text:
AN EARTH STRAP INTO WET {ground}, A SPIKE, AN' DA WHOLE FIRST SURGE GOES INTO DA PLANET INSTEAD OF INTO DA FOUR PEOPLE STANDIN' OVER DA JOINT.
DA LINE COMES BACK IN ITS OWN TIME AN' COMES BACK TAME. {asker} LOOKS AT DA STRAP, AN' DEN AT DA PARTY, AN' REVISES SOMETINK 'BOUT DEM UPWARD WITOUT SAYIN' WHAT!

sp_shock.text:
DA STRAP GOES IN DA WRONG SIDE OF DA JOINT AN' DA FIRST SURGE TAKES DA SHORTEST ROAD, WHICH IZ THROUGH DA JOINT, DA TOOLS, AN' {WHOEVER IZ HOLDIN' DEM|WHICHEVER HANDS IZ ON DEM|DA NEAREST PAIR OF HANDS}.
DA LINE IZ FIXED. EVERYTINK UP TA DA ELBOW IZ NUMB UNTIL {DA FOLLOWIN' AFTERNOON|DA NEXT DAY|WELL INTO DA NEXT DAY} AN' HUMS, FAINTLY, WHENEVER ANYTINK NEARBY IZ CAST!

q_grimoire.title: {DA BOOK DAT IZ EATIN' ITSELF|BAD CamelCase|BURN IT OR DO NO}

n0.text:
A BOOK AT {place}, OUT OF DA WEATHER UNDER {remnant}, OPEN, WIT SOMETINK WRONG ON DA LEFT-HAND PAGE.
ONE FORMULA IN IT HAB DA WORDS APART. IT HAB BIN COPYIN' ITSELF INTO ITS NEIGHBOURS FOR A WHILE NOW, AN' DA NEIGHBOURS HAB STARTED AGREEIN' WIT IT. {sound}, AN' DA PAGES IZ WARM.
ON DA RIGHT-HAND PAGE, IN DA MARGIN, SOMEBODY HAB WRITTEN DA SAME WORD {ELEVEN|NINE|FOURTEEN} TIMES, GETTIN' SMALLER, IN A HAND DAT STARTS AS ONE HAND AN' ENDS AS ANOTHER!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BURN IT. DAT IZ DA PROCEDURE!
CUT OUT DA CLEAN PAGES FIRST!
COPY DA INFECTED FORMULA DOWN PROPERLY BEFORE IT GOES!

burn.text:
IT GOES UP FAST AN' IT ARGUES ON DA WAY, WHICH BOOKS DO NO USUALLY DO.
WHAT IZ LEFT IZ A CLEAN PATCH OF {ground} AN' DA FLAT CERTAINTY OF HAVIN' DONE DA CORRECT TINK, WHICH IZ WORTH {LESS ON DA WALK HOME DEN IT SHOULD BE|SURPRISINGLY LIL' ON DA WALK HOME|ALMOST NUTTIN' BY DA TIME DA SHIP IZ IN SIGHT}!

cut.text:
{few} PAGES COME OUT CLEAN WIT DA KNIFE, TAKEN FROM DA OUTSIDE IN, AHEAD OF DA SPREAD.
DA REST BURNS. WHAT IZ STASHED IZ WORTH CARRYIN': WORKINGS FROM BEFORE WHOEVER WROTE DIS GOT CARELESS, IN A HAND DAT NEVER ONCE {SEPARATED A WORD|LET A WORD COME APART|GOT ONE WRONG}!

cop.text:
WRITIN' IT OUT CORRECTLY IZ DA HARDEST {HOUR|HALF A SHIFT} ANYBODY HAB SPENT SITTIN' DOWN. DA FORMULA DOES NO WANT TA BE JOINED UP AN' SAYS SO IN DA WRIST.
JOINED UP, IT IZ A REAL TINK, AN' A CONSIDERABLE ONE. DA BOOK GOES ON DA FIRE IMMEDIATELY AFTERWARDS AN' NOBODY {ARGUES|SAYS A WORD|OBJECTS}!

spread.text:
IT GETS INTO DA PARTY'S OWN NOTES BEFORE ANYBODY NOTICES DA HANDWRITIN' CHANGIN'.
EVERYTINK WRITTEN DOWN IN DA LAST {few} DAYS HAB TA BE BURNED IN A HEAP ON {ground}, AN' IT TAKES A PIECE OUT OF EVERYONE TA DO IT!

burn_m.text:
IT GOES ON DA FIRE AN' IT ARGUES, WHICH BOOKS DO NO USUALLY DO: DA PAGES TURN AGAINST DA DRAUGHT, AN' DA FORMULA WIT DA WORDS APART IZ ON TOP OF DA PILE EVERY TIME DA PILE SHIFTS.
IT IZ GOING TA TAKE {A WHILE|LONGER DEN A BOOK SHOULD|THREE ARMFULS OF WOOD}. LONG ENOUGH TA CHANGE ONE'S MIND IN!

choices.text: STAND DERE UNTIL IT IZ ASH. DAT IZ DA PROCEDURE!
TAKE ONE PAGE OFF DA TOP FIRST. JUST DA ONE!
SAY DA WORDS OVER IT WHILE IT BURNS. PROPERLY!

burn_page.text:
ONE PAGE, FOLDED TWICE, INTO DA INSIDE POCKET, WHILE DA REST OF IT GOES UP.
IT IZ A GOOD PAGE. IT IZ WORTH MONEY AN' IT IZ WORTH READIN' AN' IT IZ, FOR {A WEEK AN' A BIT|A FORTNIGHT|NINE DAYS}, PERFECTLY ORDINARY, AN' AFTER DAT {member} STARTS NOTICIN' DAT IT IZ NEVER QUITE WHERE IT WAZ LEFT!

burn_rite.text:
DA WORDS IZ SAID IN DA RIGHT ORDER OVER A FIRE DAT DOES NO WANT TA HEAR DEM, AN' DA FIRE GOES FROM ARGUIN' TA ORDINARY BETWEEN ONE SYLLABLE AN' DA NEXT.
WHAT IZ LEFT IZ ASH AN' A CLEAN PATCH OF {ground} AN' DA PARTICULAR SATISFACTION OF A PROCEDURE DONE CORRECTLY AN' COMPLETELY. DA GUILD HEARS 'BOUT IT FROM SOMEBODY WHO WAZ NO DERE!

burn_loud.text:
DA WORDS IZ SAID IN NEARLY DA RIGHT ORDER, WHICH IZ WORSE DEN NO SAYIN' DEM, AN' DA FIRE TAKES DA MISTAKE AN' HOLDS IT FOR A LONG MOMENT BEFORE LETTIN' IT GO.
DA BOOK BURNS. EVERYBODY'S EARS RING UNTIL {DA NEXT MORNIN'|DARK|WELL PAST DARK}, AN' FOR A WEEK AFTERWARDS NUTTIN' ANYBODY IN DA PARTY WRITES DOWN COMES OUT QUITE IN DEY OWN HAND!

q_kessler.title: {ABOVE DA CAGE|DA ARMOURED ROCKET|WHAT CAME DOWN INSTEAD}

n0.text:
SOMETINK CAME DOWN AT {place} DAT WAZ BUILT TA BE DESTROYED ON DA WAY UP: LAYERED PLATE, SACRIFICIAL, A HULL DAT IZ NINE TENTHS ARMOUR AN' ONE TENTH ROOM.
ONE OF DA ARMOURED LAUNCHES, DEN, AN' DIS ONE DID NO DOCK. {instrument} SAYS DERE IZ STILL POWER IN IT. {wrongness}.
DA HULL NUMBER HAB BIN PAINTED OVER, {ONCE, BADLY, FROM A LADDER|IN A HURRY|BY SOMEBODY STANDIN' ON SOMETINK UNSTEADY}, AN' PAINTED OVER ON DA INSIDE AS WELL!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: CUT IN.
POWER DA BEACON UP WIT {qty} {material} AN' LET SOMEBODY ELSE COME FOR IT!
STRIP DA PLATE AN' GO.

inn.text:
INSIDE: {THREE COUCHES, TWO OF DEM USED|FOUR COUCHES, THREE OF DEM USED|THREE COUCHES AN' TWO SETS OF BOOTS}, AN' A LOG KEPT BY HAND RIGHT UP UNTIL IT WAZ NO.
DEY GOT THROUGH DA DEBRIS. DEY GOT THROUGH IT AN' DA DOCKIN' NEVER HAPPENED AN' DEY CAME DOWN HERE INSTEAD, AN' SOMEBODY WROTE ALL OF IT DOWN FOR WHOEVER {OPENED DA DOOR|GOT HERE|CAME}!

cx.text:
SACRIFICIAL PLATE IZ SACRIFICIAL IN EVERY DIRECTION. DA LAYER DAT GIVES GIVES ALL AT ONCE, AN' TAKES {DA BACK OF A HAND|A LENGTH OF FOREARM|TWO FINGERS' WORTH OF GLOVE} WIT IT ON DA WAY PAST.
DA DOOR STAYS SHUT. WHATEVER IZ BEHIND IT {STAYS BEHIND IT|STAYS DERE|IZ LEFT DERE}!

bea.text:
DA BEACON TAKES DA {material} AN' LIGHTS, AN' STARTS SAYIN' DA SAME FOUR WORDS TA AN ORBIT NOBODY CAN CURRENTLY CROSS.
SOMEBODY WILL HEAR IT EVENTUALLY. DA PARTY'S REGISTRY IZ IN DA HEADER, AN' DAT IZ A NAME IN A FILE AT A SPACE CENTRE, WHICH IZ A TINK DAT PAYS OUT LATER AN' PAYS OUT {WELL|REAL WELL|BETTER DEN DA JOB DID}!

str.text:
DA PLATE COMES OFF IN {SHEETS|SLABS|LONG CURVED PIECES} AN' IT IZ GOOD PLATE: RATED FOR DA GRINDER, WHICH MEANS RATED FOR ANYTINK DA PARTY IZ LIKELY TA WALK INTO.
DA COUCHES STAY WHERE DEY IZ. NOBODY SAYS ANYTINK 'BOUT DA TWO DAT IZ USED, AN' NOBODY {HAB TA|NEEDS TA|DOES}!

inn_m.text:
DA CUT GOES THROUGH AN' DA AIR DAT COMES OUT IZ OLD AN' DRY AN' HAB BIN AT DA SAME PRESSURE FOR LONGER DEN DA PARTY HAB BIN ALIVE.
INSIDE: {THREE COUCHES, TWO OF DEM USED|FOUR COUCHES, THREE OF DEM USED|THREE COUCHES AN' TWO SETS OF BOOTS}, A HAND-KEPT LOG, AN' A LOCKER AFT DAT HAB BIN WELDED SHUT FROM DA OUTSIDE BY SOMEBODY WHO WAZ ABOARD AT DA TIME!

choices.text: READ DA LOG AN' TAKE WHAT IZ LOOSE!
OPEN DA AFT LOCKER.
TAKE DA COUCHES' NAMES OFF DA BOOTS AN' LEAVE DA REST!

inn_locker.text:
DA WELD COMES OUT IN A CLEAN LINE AN' DA LOCKER HOLDS WHAT DA LOG STOPS BEING COHERENT 'BOUT: A SEALED CASE, A SECOND LOG KEPT IN A DIFFERENT HAND, AN' {AN EMPTY COUCH HARNESS CUT THROUGH AT DA SHOULDER|A HARNESS CUT OPEN FROM DA WRONG SIDE|ONE SET OF STRAPS CUT, NO UNBUCKLED}.
WHAT IZ IN DA CASE IZ DA REASON DA LAUNCH NEVER DOCKED, AN' IT IZ WORTH CARRYIN' AN' IT IZ NO PLEASANT TA CARRY!

inn_cut.text:
DA WELD DOES NO COME OUT IN A CLEAN LINE. IT COMES OUT IN {A SPRAY|SEVERAL DIRECTIONS AT ONCE|TWO PIECES AN' A LOT OF HEAT}, AN' DA LOCKER DOOR WIT IT, AN' DA CASE INSIDE TAKES DA EDGE OF DA DOOR ACROSS ITS SEAL.
WHATEVER WAZ IN IT IZ AIR NOW. DA PARTY STANDS IN IT FOR DA {FOUR|FIVE} SECONDS IT TAKES TA GET DA HELMETS SEALED, AN' DOZE SECONDS IZ GOING TA BE DISCUSSED FOR SOME TIME!

inn_names.text:
DA NAMES IZ INKED INSIDE DA BOOT TONGUES, DA WAY CREWS DO IT, AN' DEY COME AWAY IN A PHOTOGRAPH AN' A NOTEBOOK PAGE AN' NUTTIN' ELSE IZ TOUCHED.
DA LAUNCH IZ LEFT SEALED. DA NAMES GO INTO A FILE AT A SPACE CENTRE {A WEEK AN' A BIT|A FORTNIGHT|SOME WEEKS} LATER AN' THREE FAMILIES FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED, WHICH IZ WORTH NUTTIN' AT ALL AN' IZ DA REASON ANYBODY GOES OUT DERE!

str_m.text:
DA PLATE COMES OFF IN {SHEETS|SLABS|LONG CURVED PIECES} AN' IT IZ GOOD PLATE, RATED FOR DA GRINDER, WORTH DA WALK ON ITS OWN.
UNDER DA FOURTH SHEET DA HULL STOPS BEING HULL. DERE IZ A SECOND SKIN UNDER IT DAT IZ NO SACRIFICIAL, NO RATED FOR ANYTINK, AN' NO ON ANY DRAWIN' OF DIS CLASS: THIN, SEAMLESS, AN' WARM TA DA GLOVE!

choices.text: TAKE DA PLATE. LEAVE DA SKIN ALONE!
TAKE A SAMPLE OF DA SECOND SKIN!
PUT DA PLATE BACK OVER IT AN' WALK AWAY!

str_skin.text:
DA SAMPLE COMES OFF DA WAY A SCALE COMES OFF A FISH, AN' UNDER IT DERE IZ ANOTHER ONE, AN' DA DRILL SAYS DERE IZ {NINE|ELEVEN|A GOOD MANY} MORE.
WHAT COMES BACK TA DA SHIP IN A JAR WILL PAY FOR DA SEASON. WHAT IT IZ REMAINS AN OPEN QUESTION AT EVERY INSTITUTION IT IZ SUBSEQUENTLY SHOWN TA!

str_burn.text:
DA SKIN DOES NO WANT TA BE SAMPLED AN' EXPRESSES DIS AT DA TEMPERATURE IT CHOOSES, WHICH IZ {HIGH|CONSIDERABLE|A GREAT DEAL HIGHER DEN DA DAY}, AN' DA GLOVE IZ DA ONLY REASON IT IZ FINGERS AN' NO A HAND.
DA PLATE STILL COMES AWAY. {DA JAR IZ EMPTY.|DA JAR COMES BACK EMPTY.|NUTTIN' GOES IN DA JAR.} DA BURN IZ DRESSED AT DA SHIP AN' TALKED 'BOUT LESS DEN IT DESERVES!

str_back.text:
DA SHEET GOES BACK OVER IT AN' IZ TACKED DOWN, BADLY, ON PURPOSE, SO DA NEXT PERSON TA COME OUT HERE CAN TELL AT A GLANCE DAT SOMEBODY ALREADY HAB A LOOK AN' DECIDED AGAINST.
DA COUCHES STAY WHERE DEY IZ. DA PARTY LEAVES WIT NUTTIN' AN' DA DISTINCT SENSE OF HAVIN' MADE {DA CORRECT CALL|A CALL DEY WILL KEEP MAKIN'|DA ONLY CALL}!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: FINISH DA UNLOAD AN' LEAVE DA MANIFEST SIGNED!
TAKE A SHARE AN' GO.
WAIT FOR WHOEVER IZ COMIN' BACK!

fin.text:
IT IZ {FOUR|FIVE|THREE} HOURS OF HONEST WORK AN' DA RAMP IZ CLEAR BY DA END OF IT, EVERYTINK SQUARED, DA CLIP SIGNED WIT DA PARTY'S OWN REGISTRY.
DA CREW, WHEN DEY COME BACK, COME BACK AT A RUN, AN' DA ARITHMETIC OF WHAT DEY WAZ EXPECTIN' TA FIND AGAINST WHAT IZ ACTUALLY STANDIN' DERE DOES SOMETINK TA DEY FACES. DA SOCIETY PAYS ITS DEBTS {DA SAME DAY|BEFORE DARK|INSIDE DA WEEK}!

hurt.text:
A DRUM DAT HAB TA STAY UPRIGHT DOES NO, AN' DA CORNER OF IT FINDS {A SHIN|AN ANKLE|DA OUTSIDE OF A KNEE} ON DA WAY OVER.
DA REST GETS UNLOADED SLOWER AN' WORSE. IT IZ STILL UNLOADED, AN' DA CLIP {STILL GETS SIGNED|GETS SIGNED|IZ SIGNED AT DA END OF IT}!

take.text:
WHAT COMES AWAY FITS IN DA PACKS AN' IZ WORTH HAVIN', AN' DA MANIFEST NEVER HAB A FOURTH PAGE TA DISAGREE WIT.
SOMEWHERE {AHEAD|DOWN DA ROUTE|AT DA FAR END OF DIS} DERE IZ A HAULER WHO IZ GOING TA STAND AT DA BOTTOM OF A RAMP DOING ARITHMETIC. DA SOCIETY KEEPS A REAL LONG MEMORY AN' {A REAL DENSE NETWORK|A NETWORK TA MATCH|NO GAPS ANYWHERE IN ITS NETWORK}!

wait.text:
A COUPLE OF HOURS ON DA RAMP WIT {sound} FOR COMPANY, AN' DEN DEY COME OVER DA RISE CARRYIN' DA FOURTH PAGE AN' A STORY 'BOUT WHY.
NOBODY IZ ROBBED, EVERYBODY EATS, AN' DA PARTY LEAVES WIT A NAME TA USE AT ANY FIRE ON DIS ROUTE AN' DA NUMBER OF AN OLD HANDSET DAT {ALWAYS ANSWERS|ANSWERS AT ANY HOUR|HAB NEVER ONCE NO ANSWERED}!

take_m.text:
DA PACKS IZ OPEN ON DA RAMP AN' DA ARITHMETIC IZ EASY: {cargo} IN UNITS LIL' ENOUGH TA CARRY, NUTTIN' SEALED, NUTTIN' COUNTED PAST PAGE THREE.
UNDER DA TOP LAYER OF DA THIRD PALLET DERE IZ A SECOND MANIFEST, IN A DIFFERENT HAND, LISTIN' DA SAME LOAD AT {HALF|A THIRD OF|TWO THIRDS OF} DA WEIGHT. SOMEBODY ON DIS RUN WAZ ALREADY STEALIN' FROM IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{SO WE WOULD BE ROBBIN' A THIEF.|DA GOOD NEWS IZ WE IZ NO DA FIRST.|EVERYBODY ON DIS ROAD HAB DEY HAND IN DA SAME BOX.}"
asides.any: {member} {READS DA SECOND SHEET TWICE AN' PUTS IT BACK EXACTLY AS IT WAZ|LOOKS UP DA ROAD, DEN DOWN IT|DOES NO TOUCH ANYTINK YET}

choices.text: TAKE A SHARE AN' GO. NOBODY WILL BE COUNTIN'!
TAKE DA SECOND MANIFEST INSTEAD OF DA CARGO!
PUT IT ALL BACK AN' WAIT ON DA RAMP!

take_paper.text:
DA TWO SHEETS SIDE BY SIDE IZ A CONFESSION WIT A SIGNATURE BLOCK AT DA BOTTOM OF IT, AN' IT TAKES {TEN MINUTES|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|LESS TIME DEN EXPECTED} TA WORK OUT WHICH OF DA RUN'S FOUR NAMES IT BELONGS TA.
DA SOCIETY PAYS FOR DAT SHEET DA WAY PEOPLE PAY FOR TINKZ DEY HAB BIN TRYIN' TA PROVE FOR {TWO YEARS|A LONG TIME|THREE SEASONS}, AN' DA CARGO GOES ON TA WHERE IT WAZ ALWAYS GOING!

take_slow.text:
DA NUMBERS WILL NO SIT STILL. DEY IZ CLOSE ENOUGH TA RIGHT TA BE MADDENIN' AN' WRONG ENOUGH TA MEAN SOMETINK, AN' BY DA TIME DA PARTY GIVES UP ON DEM DA LIGHT HAB GONE AN' DA CREW IZ COMIN' OVER DA RISE.
DEY FIND DEY LOAD WHOLE, DEY MANIFEST HANDLED, AN' FOUR STRANGERS STANDIN' OVER BOTH. IT TAKES {AN HOUR|MOST OF DA EVENIN'|A LONG COLD HOUR} TA TALK OUT OF, AN' IT IZ TALKED OUT OF, BARELY!

wait_m.text:
A COUPLE OF HOURS ON DA RAMP WIT {sound} FOR COMPANY. DA LIGHT GOES ORANGE, DEN GOES.
WHAT COMES OVER DA RISE FIRST IZ {ONE OF DEM|A SINGLE FIGURE|ONE MAN}, ON FOOT, ALONE, MOVIN' BADLY, CARRYIN' DA FOURTH PAGE FOLDED LIL' IN A FIST DAT HAB BIN CLOSED ON IT FOR A WHILE!

choices.text: GET HIM SAT DOWN AN' GET IT OUT OF HIM!
LOOK AT HIM PROPERLY BEFORE HE SAYS ANYTINK!
BACK OFF DA RAMP AN' LET HIM COME TA US!

wait_med.text:
HE IZ THREE HOURS INTO SOMETINK DAT WILL KILL HIM IN FIVE, AN' HE DOES NO KNOW IT, AN' DA FOURTH PAGE IZ IN HIS FIST COZ DA FOURTH PAGE IZ WHAT HE DECIDED TA CARRY INSTEAD OF WATER.
DA PARTY HAB {BOTH|DA WATER AN' DA HANDS|WHAT HE NEEDED}. HE LIVES. DA REST OF DA CREW ARRIVE AT DAWN TA FIND DEY LOAD SQUARED AN' ONE OF DEY OWN ASLEEP AN' BREATHIN', AN' AFTER DAT DERE IZ NO FIRE ON DIS ROUTE DAT DA PARTY PAYS AT!

wait_back.text:
HE COMES UP DA RAMP AT HIS OWN SPEED AN' GETS {HALFWAY|MOST OF DA WAY|AS FAR AS DA DRUMS} AN' STOPS, AN' HANDS OVER DA PAGE, AN' SITS DOWN WHERE HE IZ STANDIN'.
DA STORY COMES OUT SIDEWAYS OVER DA NEXT HOUR: WHAT WAZ ON DA FOURTH PAGE, WHAT CAME OUT OF DA SCRUB FOR IT, AN' WHY DA MANIFEST STOPS MID-WORD. {EVERYBODY EATS. NOBODY SLEEPS MUCH.|EVERYBODY EATS. NOBODY SLEEPS.|DERE IZ FOOD, AN' REAL LIL' SLEEP.}

q_verden.title: {DA PLANTED LIMB|WHAT GROWS BACK|TWO OF DEM NOW}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A GARDEN AT {place}, LAID OUT IN ROWS ON GROUND DAT GROWS NUTTIN', AN' A BLUE-SKINNED FIGURE WORKIN' IT WHO GREETS DA PARTY IN FLAWLESS MarkovSpeak AN' KEEPS WORKIN'.
ONE OF DA ROWS IZ AN ARM. IT IZ PLANTED AT DA WRIST, IT IZ NO DEAD, AN' IT IZ FURTHER ALONG DEN IT WAZ {LAST WEEK|A WEEK AGO|WHEN DA ROWS WAZ LAST COUNTED}.
DA ROWS IZ PLANTED IN DA ORDER SOMEBODY WOULD PLANT DEM IF DEY EXPECTED TA BE HERE FOR {TWO HUNDRED YEARS|A REAL LONG TIME|LONGER DEN ANYBODY IZ}!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GIVE {qty} {material} FOR DA BEDS.
WORK DA ROWS FOR A DAY.
ASK WHAT DEY THREW INTO A STAR, AN' WHY!

gv.text:
DA BEDS TAKE IT AN' DA GARDENER'S HANDS GO STRAIGHT TA WORK WIT IT, NO THANKS OFFERED, COZ THANKS IZ FOR STRANGERS.
WHAT COMES BACK AT DA END OF DA ROW IZ A CUTTIN' OF SOMETINK DAT SHOULD NO ROOT IN {ground} AN' DOES, AN' INSTRUCTIONS FOR IT DAT TAKE AN HOUR AN' IZ GIVEN TWICE {TA BE SURE|OVER|TA MAKE CERTAIN}!

wk.text:
A DAY IN DA ROWS: HEAVY, REPETITIVE, DONE PROPERLY, IN COMPANY DAT TALKS DA WHOLE TIME AN' SAYS SOMETINK WORTH KEEPIN' 'BOUT {ONE HOUR IN SIX|TWICE AN AFTERNOON|MORE OFTEN DEN DAT}.
BY DARK DA PARTY HAB BIN FED TWICE AN' GIVEN A NAME DAT WORKS IN ANY VERDEN HOUSEHOLD ON {ANY WORLD|ANY WORLD AT ALL|WHICHEVER WORLD DEY IZ ON}!

wf.text:
DA ROWS WIN. NOBODY WARNED DA PARTY DAT A VERDEN DAY IZ MEASURED AGAINST A VERDEN BACK.
DA GARDENER FINDS DIS FUNNIER DEN ANYBODY HAB FOUND ANYTINK IN WEEKS AN' PACKS DA PARTY OFF WIT FOOD AN' A GENUINELY SYMPATHETIC PAT DAT NEARLY PUTS {leader} IN {DA BED|DA ROW|DA SOIL}!

ask.text:
DA ANSWER TAKES DA WALK TA DA END OF DA ROW AN' BACK AN' IZ TOLD PROUDLY.
DEY PUT DA WHOLE OF IT INTO DA SUN ON PURPOSE, ALL OF IT, AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' IN DA TELLIN' DAT REGRETS IT, AN' BY DA END {leader} IZ NO LONGER CERTAIN DA PARTY'S OWN POCKETS REPRESENT DA WINNIN' SIDE OF {DA ARGUMENT|IT|DAT PARTICULAR ARGUMENT}!

ask_m.text:
DA ANSWER TAKES DA WALK TA DA END OF DA ROW AN' BACK, AN' IT IZ TOLD PROUDLY: DEY PUT DA WHOLE OF IT INTO DA SUN ON PURPOSE, ALL OF IT, AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' IN DA TELLIN' DAT REGRETS IT.
AT DA TURN OF DA ROW DA GARDENER STOPS AN' ASKS A QUESTION BACK, WHICH HAB NO HAPPENED BEFORE, AN' DA QUESTION IZ WHETHER DA PARTY WOULD LIKE TA SEE {WHAT WAZ KEPT|DA ONE TINK DEY KEPT|DA EXCEPTION}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DERE IZ ALWAYS AN EXCEPTION.|NOBODY THROWS AWAY EVERYTINK.|HERE IT COMES.}"
asides.any: {member} {SAYS YES BEFORE ANYBODY ELSE CAN|LOOKS AT DA ARM IN DA ROW AN' DEN AT DA GARDENER|NODS ONCE}

choices.text: YES. SHOW US.
NO. SOME TINKZ IZ NO FOR VISITORS!
ASK 'BOUT DA ARM IN DA ROW INSTEAD!

ask_kept.text:
IT IZ IN A JAR UNDER DA THIRD BED, AN' IT IZ {LIL'|NO LARGE|'BOUT DA SIZE OF A FIST}, AN' IT IZ DA ONLY TINK ON DIS WORLD DAT IZ NO GROWIN'.
WHAT IT IZ TAKES AN HOUR TA EXPLAIN AN' IZ NO EXPLAINED IN MarkovSpeak, WHICH IZ HOW DA PARTY LEARNS DA GARDENER HAB A FIRST LANGUAGE. DA JAR GOES BACK UNDER DA BED. EVERYBODY AGREES, WITOUT A VOTE, NEVER TA MENTION WHERE!

ask_arm.text:
IT IZ PLANTED AT DA WRIST COZ IT IZ DA ONLY PART OF DA PLANT DAT {WILL NO TAKE OTHERWISE|ROOTS|IZ WILLIN'}, AN' IT IZ AN ARM COZ DA SPECIES IT CAME OFF WAZ {SHAPED DAT WAY|BUILT LIKE DAT|NO HUMAN AN' NO FAR OFF}.
DA GARDENER WALKS DA PARTY THROUGH DA WHOLE GROWTH CYCLE, TWICE, WIT CORRECTIONS, IN DA MANNER OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB BIN WAITIN' A GREAT MANY YEARS TA BE ASKED A TECHNICAL QUESTION 'BOUT IT!

gv_m.text:
DA BEDS TAKE DA {material} AN' DA GARDENER'S HANDS GO STRAIGHT TA WORK WIT IT, NO THANKS OFFERED, COZ THANKS IZ FOR STRANGERS.
HALFWAY DOWN DA ROW DA HANDS STOP. SOMETINK IN DA NEW STOCK IZ {WRONG|NO WHAT IT SHOULD BE|CARRYIN' SOMETINK}, AN' DA GARDENER HOLDS IT UP TA DA LIGHT AN' SAYS, CONVERSATIONALLY, DAT IF DIS GOES IN DA BED DA BED WILL HAB TA BE BURNED!

choices.text: PUT IT IN ANYWAY. IT IZ WHAT WE HAB!
SORT DA WHOLE LOT BEFORE ANY OF IT GOES IN DA GROUND!
TAKE IT ALL BACK. BRING CLEAN STOCK ANOTHER TIME!

gv_sort.text:
SORTIN' IT IZ {A COUPLE OF HOURS|DA REST OF DA AFTERNOON|A LONG SLOW JOB} ON A CLOTH IN DA SHADE, WIT DA GARDENER NAMIN' WHAT IZ WRONG WIT EACH PIECE AS IT GOES ON DA BAD PILE.
DA GOOD PILE IZ MOST OF IT. DA BAD PILE IZ BURNED PROPERLY. WHAT COMES BACK AT DA END OF DA ROW IZ A CUTTIN' OF SOMETINK DAT SHOULD NO ROOT IN {ground} AN' DOES, AN' A DEBT DA GARDENER CONSIDERS SETTLED!

gv_burn.text:
DA SORTIN' IZ DONE BY EYE AN' DA EYE IZ NO TRAINED, AN' {TWO|THREE} PIECES GO IN DA BED DAT SHOULD NO HAB.
DA BED IZ BURNED NINE DAYS LATER. DA GARDENER DOES IT WITOUT BLAME AN' REPLANTS FROM SEED AN' WILL BE {TWO YEARS|A LONG TIME|DA BETTER PART OF THREE SEASONS} GETTIN' BACK TA WHERE DEY WAZ, AN' SAYS SO IN A TONE DAT HAB NO EDGE ON IT AT ALL, WHICH IZ WORSE!

gv_back.text:
DA STOCK GOES BACK IN DA PACK AN' DA PARTY COMES BACK WIT CLEAN MATERIAL {A WEEK AN' A BIT|A FORTNIGHT|SOME WEEKS} LATER, HAVIN' GONE A LONG WAY OUT OF DEY WAY TA DO IT.
DA GARDENER DOES NO COMMENT. DA GARDENER DOES, HOWEVER, PLANT DA NEW BED IN DA ROW NEAREST DA DOOR, WHICH ANYBODY WHO HAB SPENT A DAY IN DIS GARDEN WOULD UNDERSTAND!

q_magamui.title: {ONE AT A TIME|DA QUIET ONE IN DA CAMP|WHOSE IDEA WAZ IT}

n0.text:
A SURVEY CAMP AT {place}, {few} OF DEM, AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM CAN TELL YOU EXACTLY WHOSE IDEA IT WAZ TA DIG HERE EXCEPT DA ONE WHOSE IDEA IT WAZ.
DEY IZ ALL AGREED IT WAZ A GOOD IDEA. DEY IZ AGREED IN DA SAME WORDS. {wrongness}, AN' ONE OF DEM HAB NO BLINKED SINCE DA PARTY WALKED IN.
DA DIG ITSELF IZ {NINE|SEVEN|ELEVEN} METRES DOWN AN' NEATLY REVETTED, AN' NOBODY IN DA CAMP CAN SAY WHAT DEY IZ DIGGIN' FOR WITOUT {LOOKIN' AT SOMEBODY ELSE FIRST|CHECKIN' A FACE|GLANCIN' SIDEWAYS}!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WORK OUT WHICH ONE IZ BEING RIDDEN!
GET DA CAMP AWAY FROM DA DIG, ALL OF DEM, NOW!
NO DA PARTY'S DIG, NO DA PARTY'S CAMP!

id.text:
DA QUIET ONE IZ IN DA CLEAR, JUST {EXHAUSTED|RUNNIN' ON NUTTIN'|THREE DAYS PAST SLEEPIN'}, AN' HAB BIN CARRYIN' DA WHOLE CAMP'S SHIFTS COZ EVERYBODY ELSE KEEPS FORGETTIN' DEY AGREED TA TAKE DEM.
IT IZ DA ONE WHO HAB BIN MOST REASONABLE ALL AFTERNOON. DA GUILD HAB STANDIN' ORDERS 'BOUT DIS AN' DEY IZ ONE LINE LONG, AN' IT NEEDS DOING BEFORE DA TINK GETS TIME TA {MOVE HOUSE|CHANGE TENANT|FIND SOMEBODY ELSE}!

ev.text:
IT TAKES DA WHOLE OF {leader}'S VOICE AN' EVERY HOUR OF DAYLIGHT, AN' DA CAMP COMES OFF DA DIG IN ONE PIECE AN' STAYS OFF IT.
UP ON DA RIDGE, WIT DISTANCE UNDER DEM, {few} OF DEM START CRYIN' AN' ONE OF DEM STARTS REMEMBERIN' TINKZ 'BOUT DA LAST MONTH DAT HAB NO PREVIOUSLY HAPPENED TA ANYBODY!

wrong.text:
DA PARTY PICKS DA WRONG ONE, AN' DA CAMP CLOSES ROUND DA MISTAKE DA WAY A HAND CLOSES.
IT IZ A BAD {HALF HOUR|A LONG STRETCH|HOUR} AN' ONLY SOME OF IT IZ REMEMBERED AFTERWARDS, IN DA WRONG ORDER, BY {DIFFERENT PEOPLE|THREE DIFFERENT PEOPLE|EVERYBODY DIFFERENTLY}!

left.text:
BEHIND, DA CAMP GOES BACK TA AGREEIN' WIT ITSELF, IN DA SAME WORDS, ON DA SAME GROUND.
{member} WRITES DA COORDINATES DOWN AN' UNDERLINES DEM, WHICH IZ WHAT YOU DO WHEN YOU {NO CAN DO ANYTINK|CAN DO NUTTIN' ELSE|HAB NUTTIN' ELSE TA GIVE}!

ev_m.text:
GETTIN' {few} PEOPLE OFF A DIG DEY ALL AGREE 'BOUT TAKES DA WHOLE OF {leader}'S VOICE AN' EVERY HOUR OF {DAYLIGHT|DA LIGHT|DA AFTERNOON}, AN' IT WORKS, AN' IT WORKS COZ ONE OF DEM HELPS.
DA ONE WHO HELPS IZ DA {QUIET ONE|TIRED ONE|ONE WHO HAB BIN DOING EVERYBODY'S SHIFTS}, AN' HALFWAY UP DA RIDGE DEY TAKE {leader} BY DA SLEEVE AN' SAY, REAL FAST, DAT DERE IZ A SECOND CAMP TWO VALLEYS OVER DOING DA SAME TINK!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{OF COURSE DERE IZ.|DERE IZ ALWAYS A SECOND CAMP.|ONE IZ AN ACCIDENT. TWO IZ A PROGRAMME.}"
asides.any: {member} {GETS DA BEARIN' BEFORE DA SENTENCE IZ FINISHED|WRITES IT ON A HAND|LOOKS AT DA TWO VALLEYS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'}

choices.text: GET DIS CAMP CLEAR AN' GO NO FURTHER!
TAKE DA BEARIN' AN' GO AN' LOOK AT DA SECOND CAMP!
SIT DA QUIET ONE DOWN AN' GET DA WHOLE OF IT!

ev_two.text:
DA SECOND CAMP IZ {FOUR|FIVE} HOURS OVER BROKEN GROUND AN' IZ ALREADY {EMPTY|DOWN TA ONE|PAST HELPIN'}, AN' DA DIG DERE IZ FINISHED, AN' WHAT CAME OUT OF IT WENT EAST ON A SLEDGE TWO DAYS AGO.
DERE IZ A MANIFEST IN DA MESS TENT, UNBURNED, WIT A ROUTE ON IT. IT IZ DA SINGLE MOST VALUABLE PIECE OF PAPER ANYBODY HAB CARRIED OUT OF DIS REGION IN {A YEAR|TWO SEASONS|A LONG WHILE}!

ev_late.text:
TWO VALLEYS IZ EASY TA SAY AN' HARD TA WALK, AN' DA BEARIN' WAZ TAKEN OFF A HAND IN BAD LIGHT, AN' DA PARTY ARRIVES AT DA WRONG VALLEY {AT DUSK|WIT DA LIGHT GOING|AN HOUR AFTER IT MATTERS}.
DA RIGHT ONE IZ FOUND DA FOLLOWIN' MORNIN' BY DA SMOKE. DERE IZ NUTTIN' IN IT BUT DA DIG, OPEN, AN' DA SLEDGE RUTS GOING EAST, AN' A CAMP'S WORTH OF BOOTS ARRANGED IN PAIRS BY DA TENTS!

ev_talk.text:
IT COMES OUT IN DA ORDER TINKZ COME OUT IN WHEN SOMEBODY HAB BIN HOLDIN' DEM FOR {DA BEST PART OF A WEEK|A WEEK|TOO LONG}: DA SHIFTS, DA AGREEIN', DA WAY DA WORDS WAZ ALWAYS DA SAME WORDS, AN' DA FACT DAT DEY KNEW ON DAY TWO AN' COULD NO MAKE DA SENTENCE COME.
WHAT DEY KNOW IZ WORTH DA WHOLE TRIP. DEY IZ ALSO, BY DA END OF DA TELLIN', {ASLEEP SITTIN' UP|FINALLY ASLEEP|UNCONSCIOUS IN DA PROPER SENSE}, WHICH IZ ITS OWN KIND OF RESULT!

left_m.text:
WALKIN' AWAY FROM IT TAKES 'BOUT {A HUNDRED METRES|TWO HUNDRED PACES|DA FIRST RISE} TA START FEELIN' LIKE A DECISION RATHER DEN A DIRECTION.
BEHIND, DA CAMP GOES BACK TA AGREEIN' WIT ITSELF, IN DA SAME WORDS, ON DA SAME {ground}. AHEAD DERE IZ A WHOLE REST OF DA DAY IN WHICH NUTTIN' IZ REQUIRED OF ANYBODY!

choices.text: KEEP WALKIN'.
LEAVE WORD AT DA NEAREST STATION INSTEAD. SOMEBODY ELSE'S JOB!
TURN ROUND. GET DEM OFF DA DIG!

left_word.text:
DA NEAREST STATION IZ {A COUPLE OF DAYS|A DAY AN' A HALF|A FULL WATCH AN' DEN SOME} OUT AN' TAKES DA REPORT DA WAY STATIONS TAKE REPORTS, WIT A FORM, AN' A NUMBER, AN' A PROMISE DAT IZ NO EXACTLY A PROMISE.
SOMEBODY DOES GO. {DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT|A FORTNIGHT|A WEEK AN' A BIT} LATER, BY WHICH TIME DA ARITHMETIC OF DA TINK HAB CHANGED CONSIDERABLY, AN' DA PARTY'S NAME IZ ON DA FORM AS DA ONES WHO CALLED IT IN!

q_pigeon.title: {MOST OF A DAY ON DA ROAD AN HOUR|DA BIRD WIT DA STICK|POST}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A LOFT AT {place}, BUILT OUT OF {remnant} AN' CONSIDERABLE STUBBORNNESS, AN' {asker} KEEPIN' {many} BIRDS IN IT AGAINST {hazard}.
NUTTIN' ELECTRONIC GETS IN OR OUT OF HERE. DA BIRDS DO, AT NINETY WIT A TAILWIND, WIT A STICK TIED TA DA LEG, AN' ONE OF DEM HAB NO COME BACK.
DERE IZ A SECOND LOFT BEHIND DA FIRST, {SMALLER|HALF DA SIZE|NO BIGGER DEN A WARDROBE}, SHUT, WIT DA ENTRY HOLE BOARDED OVER FROM DA INSIDE!

asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO AN' FIND DA BIRD.
GIVE {qty} {material} FOR DA LOFT AN' CARRY DA POST YOURSELVES!
ASK WHAT IZ ON DA STICKS.

fnd.text:
IT IZ DOWN UNDER {remnant} WIT A WING DAT WILL MEND AN' A STICK STILL ON DA LEG, AN' IT PUTS UP A FIGHT 'BOUT BEING PICKED UP, WHICH IZ A GOOD SIGN IN A BIRD.
WHAT IZ ON DA STICK IZ SOMEBODY'S WHOLE YEAR. DA LOFT PAYS IN DA ONLY CURRENCY DAT MEANS ANYTINK OUT HERE, WHICH IZ BEING OWED SOMETINK BY {A KEEPER OF BIRDS|DA KEEPER OF A LOFT|SOMEBODY WHO KEEPS BIRDS}!

nof.text:
TWO DAYS OF {ground} AN' {hazard} AN' NUTTIN' WIT FEATHERS ON IT ANYWHERE.
DA KEEPER TAKES DA NEWS DA WAY KEEPERS DO, WHICH IZ BY GOING TA FEED DA OTHERS!

car.text:
DA LOFT GETS ITS {material}, AN' DA PARTY GETS A SATCHEL OF STICKS AN' A ROUTE, AN' DOES DA ROUND ON FOOT COZ A HULL WOULD NEVER MAKE DA LAST LEG.
EVERY STOP ON IT IZ SOMEBODY WHO HAB NO HEARD FROM ANYBODY IN A SEASON. NOBODY LETS DA PARTY LEAVE WITOUT FEEDIN' DEM {FIRST|FIRST, PROPERLY|BEFORE ANYTINK ELSE}!

asked.text:
BIRTHS, MOSTLY. PRICES. TWO DEATHS DAT PEOPLE NEEDED TA KNOW 'BOUT IN AN ORDER DAT MATTERED.
ONE STICK IZ NO READ OUT. IT GOES IN A BOX WIT {lots} OTHERS, AN' DA KEEPER SAYS DA BOX IZ FOR AFTER, AN' DOES NO SAY {AFTER WHAT|WHAT AFTER MEANS|ANY MORE DEN DAT}!

asked_m.text:
BIRTHS, MOSTLY. PRICES. TWO DEATHS DAT PEOPLE NEEDED TA KNOW 'BOUT IN AN ORDER DAT MATTERED, AN' ONE STICK DAT IZ NO READ OUT AN' GOES IN A BOX WIT {lots} OTHERS.
DA BOX IZ NO LOCKED. {asker} LETS ANYBODY LOOK WHO WANTS TA, OFFERS NUTTIN', AN' GOES TA FEED DA BIRDS IN A WAY DAT MEANS DA OFFER IZ {NEVER GOING TA COME|NO GOING TA BE MADE|DA PARTY'S OWN TA MAKE}!

choices.text: LEAVE DA BOX ALONE. ASK 'BOUT DA SECOND LOFT INSTEAD!
READ DA BOX.
ASK, STRAIGHT OUT, WHAT DA BOX IZ FOR!

asked_box.text:
DEY IZ ALL IN DA SAME HAND AN' ALL TA DA SAME PERSON AN' NONE OF DEM WAZ EVER SENT, COZ DA PERSON DEY IZ TA HAB BIN {DEAD|GONE|PAST READIN'} SINCE BEFORE DA LOFT WAZ BUILT.
DA LAST ONE IZ DATED DIS SEASON. DA PARTY PUTS DA LID BACK ON AN' DOES NO MENTION IT, AN' {asker} KNOWS DEY HAB READ IT, AN' SOMETINK BETWEEN DA TWO PARTIES SETTLES DAT NEITHER OF DEM WILL EVER NAME!

asked_loft.text:
DA SECOND LOFT IZ WHERE DA BIRDS GO DAT COME BACK WRONG: DA ONES DAT ARRIVE WIT DA STICK GONE, OR WIT DA WRONG STICK, OR {WIT TWO|CARRYIN' TWO|WIT A STICK TIED BY SOMEBODY WHO TIES KNOTS DIFFERENTLY}.
{asker} KEEPS DEM ALIVE AN' KEEPS DEM SEPARATE AN' HAB NEVER ONCE COOKED ONE, AN' DA REASON FOR DA BOARDS ON DA ENTRY HOLE IZ DAT {TWICE NOW|ON TWO OCCASIONS|MORE DEN ONCE} SOMETINK HAB COME IN THROUGH IT DAT WAZ NO A BIRD!

choices.text: OPEN IT. HAB A LOOK.
READ DA WRONG STICKS INSTEAD!
LEAVE DA BOARDS WHERE DEY IZ!

asked_open.text:
INSIDE: {NINE|ELEVEN|A DOZEN} BIRDS, QUIET, HEALTHY, ALL OF DEM FACIN' DA SAME WALL.
DERE IZ NUTTIN' ON DA WALL. DERE HAB NEVER BIN ANYTINK ON DA WALL. DA BOARDS GO BACK UP WITHIN DA MINUTE AN' {asker} HELPS, WITOUT A WORD, HAVIN' CLEARLY BIN WAITIN' FOR SOMEBODY ELSE TA LOOK FIRST!

asked_code.text:
DA WRONG STICKS IZ A SECOND CORRESPONDENCE RUNNIN' THROUGH DA SAME BIRDS, IN A SUBSTITUTION ANYBODY WHO HAB DONE A SEASON OF DIS WOULD SPOT, WHICH MEANS WHOEVER SET IT UP ASSUMED DA LOFT-KEEPER {NEVER WOULD|WOULD NEVER LOOK|HAB NO REASON TA}.
DEY IZ ROUTE REPORTS. SOMEBODY HAB BIN USING A BIRD LOFT IN DA MIDDLE OF NOWHERE AS A RELAY FOR {A FORTNIGHT|DA BETTER PART OF A SEASON|MONTHS}, AN' DA PARTY CAN NOW READ EVERY WORD OF IT!

car_m.text:
DA LOFT GETS ITS {material}, DA PARTY GETS A SATCHEL OF STICKS AN' A ROUTE, AN' DA ROUND IZ DONE ON FOOT COZ A HULL WOULD NEVER MAKE DA LAST LEG.
ON DA THIRD STOP DERE IZ NOBODY HOME AN' DA DOOR IZ OPEN, AN' DA STICK FOR DAT ADDRESS IZ STILL IN DA SATCHEL WIT {NOWHERE TA GO|NOBODY TA TAKE IT|NO HAND TA PUT IT IN}!

choices.text: FINISH DA ROUND. BRING DA UNDELIVERED ONE BACK!
READ DA GROUND AT DA OPEN DOOR BEFORE MOVIN' ON!
WAIT AT DA THIRD STOP UNTIL DARK!

car_track.text:
TWO SETS OUT, ONE SET IN, ALL OF DEM GOING DA SAME WAY AN' DA INCOMIN' SET ON TOP OF DA OUTGOIN' ONE, WHICH MEANS WHOEVER CAME BACK CAME BACK AFTER DA PEOPLE WHO LEFT.
DEY IZ HALF A DAY AHEAD ON AN EASY LINE. DA PARTY CATCHES DEM AT A WATER STOP, HANDS OVER DA STICK, AN' GETS DA WHOLE STORY PLUS A MEAL PLUS A NAME WORTH HAVIN' AT {FOUR|FIVE} MORE DOORS ON DIS ROUTE!

car_wait.text:
DARK COMES AN' NOBODY COMES WIT IT, AN' DA PARTY SLEEPS IN A STRANGER'S HOUSE WIT DA DOOR PROPPED AS IT WAZ FOUND, OUT OF {A SUPERSTITION NOBODY ADMITS TA|MANNERS|SOMETINK LIKE MANNERS}.
IN DA MORNIN' DA STICK IZ PUT ON DA TABLE UNDER A CUP, DA ROUND IZ FINISHED, AN' DA LOFT-KEEPER SAYS ONLY DAT DA THIRD STOP HAB DONE DIS {BEFORE|TWICE BEFORE|MORE DEN ONCE} AN' ALWAYS COMES BACK!

q_father.title: {WHAT FELL|DA PIECE OF HIM|NUTTIN' GROWS AROUND IT}

n0.text:
SOMETINK CAME DOWN AT {place} DAT IZ NO DEBRIS, AN' {ground} FOR {few} METRES AROUND IT HAB STOPPED DOING ANYTINK AT ALL: NO DUST SETTLIN', NO {sound}, NUTTIN' ROTTIN'.
{instrument} WILL NO READ IT. READIN' IT IZ NO DA SORT OF TINK IT IZ FOR. {asker} IZ KNEELIN' AT DA EDGE OF DA CIRCLE, AN' HAB BIN FOR SOME TIME.
DA KNEELIN' ONE HAB BIN DERE LONG ENOUGH FOR DA KNEES TA HAB MADE TWO SHALLOW CUPS IN GROUND DAT {DOES NO OTHERWISE TAKE A MARK|NUTTIN' ELSE HAB MARKED|HAB TAKEN NUTTIN' ELSE}!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TOUCH IT.
GET IT COVERED AN' GET WORD OUT!
LEAVE IT WHERE IT FELL.

touch.text:
IT IZ COLD AN' IT IZ NO STONE AN' SOMETINK GOES UP DA ARM AN' KEEPS GOING.
WHEN IT LETS GO, DA WORLD IZ ARRANGED SLIGHTLY DIFFERENTLY AN' {leader} HAB SOMETINK DEY DID NO {WALK IN|STEP THROUGH DA ENTRANCE|CROSS DA THRESHOLD|HEAD INSIDE} WIT, AN' NO TRAININ' ANYWHERE ACCOUNTS FOR IT, {WHICH IZ WHAT IT CAME FOR|WHICH IZ WHAT IT WANTED|WHICH IZ DA TRADE}!

cov.text:
DA {material} GOES OVER IT AN' DA CIRCLE GOES UNDER A CAIRN, AN' DA POSITION IZ WRITTEN DOWN TWICE IN TWO DIFFERENT HANDS.
DA KNEELIN' ONE THANKS DA PARTY IN A LANGUAGE DAT RAN OUT OF SPEAKERS A WHILE AGO, AN' PAYS IN DA WAY OF PEOPLE WIT NUTTIN': {EVERYTINK DEY HAB|ALL OF IT|WHAT LIL' DERE IZ}!

lv.text:
IT STAYS WHERE IT FELL WIT SOMEBODY KNEELIN' AT DA EDGE OF IT, AN' DA PARTY WALKS OUT THROUGH GROUND DAT STARTS BEHAVIN' NORMALLY AGAIN 'BOUT {FORTY|THIRTY|FIFTY} PACES ON.
IT IZ A RELIEF. NOBODY EXPECTED IT TA BE {A RELIEF|DAT|ONE}!

touch_m.text:
IT IZ A HAND'S BREADTH AWAY AN' DA COLD OFF IT ARRIVES BEFORE DA HAND DOES. DA KNEELIN' ONE DOES NO LOOK UP, AN' DOES NO STOP DA PARTY, AN' DOES SAY ONE TINK IN DA DEAD LANGUAGE, TWICE, IN DA CADENCE OF {A WARNIN'|AN INSTRUCTION|SOMETINK REHEARSED}.
NOBODY IN DA PARTY SPEAKS IT. EVERYBODY IN DA PARTY CAN HEAR DAT IT MATTERS!

choices.text: TOUCH IT ANYWAY.
GET DA WORDS DOWN AN' WORK DEM OUT FIRST!
HAB {member} TOUCH IT INSTEAD OF {leader}!

touch_word.text:
DA SENTENCE IZ AN INSTRUCTION AN' DA INSTRUCTION IZ 'BOUT DA HAND: WHICH ONE, AN' DAT IT MUST BE DA ONE YOU WRITE WIT, AN' DAT IT MUST BE FLAT.
DONE PROPERLY, WHAT GOES UP DA ARM GOES UP IT DA WAY WATER GOES UP A WICK RATHER DEN DA WAY A CURRENT GOES UP A WIRE. {leader} KEEPS EVERYTINK DEY CAME WIT AN' GAINS SOMETINK BESIDES, AN' DA KNEELIN' ONE WEEPS, WHICH IZ APPARENTLY WHAT DA INSTRUCTION WAZ FOR!

touch_other.text:
{member} PUTS A HAND ON IT WITOUT CEREMONY AN' GOES REAL STILL FOR {NINE SECONDS|A COUNT OF NINE|LONGER DEN LOOKS SAFE}.
WHAT COMES BACK IZ NO WHAT WENT IN. {member} IZ FINE, SAYS SO, KEEPS SAYIN' SO, AN' DOES NO SLEEP PROPERLY FOR A FORTNIGHT, AN' KNOWS THREE TINKZ ON DA WAY HOME DAT NOBODY TAUGHT DEM!

cov_m.text:
COVERIN' IT IZ EASY. GETTIN' WORD OUT IZ DA PART WIT A DECISION IN IT: DA NEAREST TINK TA A TRANSMITTER OUT HERE BELONGS TA SOMEBODY WHO WILL SELL DA COORDINATES ON WITHIN {A DAY|HOURS|DA WEEK}, AN' EVERYBODY STANDIN' AT DA CAIRN KNOWS IT.
DA KNEELIN' ONE WAITS TA BE TOLD WHAT DA PARTY HAB DECIDED, IN DA MANNER OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB ALREADY DECIDED NO TA ARGUE!

choices.text: SEND IT CLEAR. LET WHOEVER COMES, COME!
SEND IT IN A CIPHER ONLY DA EMPIRE READS!
SEND NUTTIN'. PUT IT UNDER DA CAIRN AN' FORGET DA NUMBER!

cov_cipher.text:
DA MESSAGE GOES OUT AS {FOUR GROUPS OF FIVE|TWENTY CHARACTERS|A BLOCK OF NONSENSE} AN' IZ REPEATED TWICE AN' IZ NEVER REFERRED TA AGAIN BY ANYBODY.
WHAT ARRIVES DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT LATER ARRIVES QUIETLY, IN DA RIGHT COLOURS, WIT DA RIGHT PAPERWORK, AN' TAKES DA TINK AWAY UNDER A TARPAULIN. DA PARTY IZ THANKED IN WRITIN' BY SOMEBODY WHO SIGNS WIT A TITLE AN' NO NAME!

cov_leak.text:
{DA CIPHER IZ GOOD.|DA CIPHER HOLDS.|NUTTIN' IZ WRONG WIT DA CIPHER.} DA OPERATOR IZ BETTER, AN' SELLS DA BLOCK ON UNREAD, WHICH TURNS OUT TA BE WORTH MORE DEN SELLIN' IT READ.
THREE PARTIES ARRIVE INSIDE A WEEK AN' NONE OF DEM IZ DA EMPIRE. DA CAIRN IZ OPENED, DA CIRCLE IZ WALKED IN BY PEOPLE IN DA WRONG {BOOTS|COLOURS|VEHICLES}, AN' DA KNEELIN' ONE IZ NO DERE DA NEXT TIME ANYBODY LOOKS!

cov_quiet.text:
DA CAIRN GOES UP PROPERLY, DA POSITION IZ WRITTEN DOWN TWICE AN' BURNED ONCE, AN' DA KNEELIN' ONE IZ LEFT WIT WATER, FOOD AN' DA SECOND COPY.
NOBODY PROFITS. {member} NOTES IN DA DIARY DAT DA GROUND INSIDE DA CIRCLE HAB BEGUN, REAL SLIGHTLY, TA SETTLE AGAIN BY DA TIME DEY LEFT, WHICH IZ EITHER {HEALIN' OR APPETITE|GOOD NEWS OR DA OPPOSITE|NUTTIN' OR EVERYTINK}!

q_prospect.title: {DA CLAIM|MARKERS IN DA GROUND|TWO NAMES ON ONE PATCH}

n0.text:
TWO SETS OF CLAIM MARKERS AT {place}, DRIVEN INTO DA SAME {ground}, {few} PACES APART, BOTH OF DEM LEGAL ON PAPER SOMEWHERE.
{asker} HAB ONE SET. DA OTHER SET'S OWNER IZ DUE BACK AT ANY HOUR, AN' DERE IZ EXACTLY ONE SEAM UNDER ALL OF IT. {sound}, WHICH DOES NO HELP ANYBODY'S NERVES.
BOTH SETS OF MARKERS IZ NEW. DA {ground} BETWEEN DEM HAB BIN WALKED OVER SO MANY TIMES IN DA LAST WEEK DAT IT IZ {POLISHED|BEATEN FLAT|SHININ'}!

asides.calm: {member} SUGGESTS DAT A SEAM UNDER TWO CLAIMS IZ A BIGGER SEAM DEN EITHER OF DEM COSTED FOR!
asides.aggressive: {member} HAB ALREADY WORKED OUT WHICH SET OF MARKERS COMES OUT EASIER!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BROKER IT BEFORE DA OTHER ONE GETS BACK!
SURVEY DA SEAM PROPERLY AN' LET DA GROUND DECIDE!
PULL DA OTHER SET OF MARKERS!

bro.text:
A SPLIT, IN WRITIN', WITNESSED BY {THREE|FOUR} PEOPLE WHO DO NO LIKE EACH OTHER, WHICH IZ DA STRONGEST KIND OF WITNESSIN' DERE IZ.
DA OTHER ONE ARRIVES TA A SIGNED PAGE INSTEAD OF AN ARGUMENT AN' TAKES TWENTY MINUTES TA STOP LOOKIN' FOR DA CATCH. DA PARTY'S CUT IZ WRITTEN IN AS BROKERAGE, WHICH NOBODY {OBJECTS TA|ARGUES WIT|QUERIES}!

sur.text:
DA SEAM RUNS {DA OTHER WAY ENTIRELY|NUTTIN' LIKE WHERE EITHER PAPER SAYS|AT RIGHT ANGLES TA BOTH OF DEM}. BOTH CLAIMS CLIP DA SHOULDER OF IT AN' NEITHER OF DEM SITS ON IT.
DA REAL BODY IZ OUT UNDER OPEN GROUND NOBODY HAB PAPERED AT ALL, WHICH DA PARTY KNOWS FIRST AN' BY {SOME DISTANCE|A CLEAR MARGIN|A DAY AT DA LEAST}!

brf.text:
DA OTHER ONE GETS BACK MID-SENTENCE AN' HAB BIN REHEARSIN' {ON DA WALK|DA WHOLE WAY UP|SINCE DA LAST RIDGE}.

nofound.text:
WHATEVER IT WAZ CLEANED UP AFTER ITSELF {THOROUGHLY|TA A STANDARD|DA WAY A PROFESSIONAL DOES}, AN' DA ONLY EVIDENCE LEFT WALKS AROUND EATIN' BREAKFAST AT DA CORRECT HOUR.
DA PARTY WRITES DOWN WHAT DEY SAW. WRITIN' IT DOWN IZ {WHAT DERE IZ|ALL DERE IZ|DA WHOLE OF WHAT CAN BE DONE}!

feed.text:
DA STORES GO INTO DA HOPPERS ALONG DA ROUTE AN' DA ROUTE GETS SWEPT AN' DA DOORS GET PROPPED WHERE DA DOORS WAZ STICKIN'.
DEY WILL GO ON UNTIL {DA BODIES STOP|DA LAST OF DEM WEARS OUT|SOMETINK ELSE STOPS DEM}. ZERO ARGUMENT IN WHICH DIS WAZ DA USEFUL TINK TA DO, AN' EVERYBODY DOES IT {ANYWAY|ANYWAY, ALL DAY|REGARDLESS}!

down.text:
IT IZ QUICK, AN' QUIET, AN' CORRECT BY EVERY STANDARD ANYBODY HAB WRITTEN DOWN.
NOBODY TALKS ON DA WAY BACK TA DA PAD. {member} IZ SICK BEHIND A ROCK AT DA HALFWAY MARK AN' NOBODY MENTIONS IT {DEN OR AFTERWARDS|DEN|AT ANY POINT AFTERWARDS}!

feed_m.text:
DA STORES GO INTO DA HOPPERS ALONG DA ROUTE, DA ROUTE GETS SWEPT, DA STICKIN' DOORS GET PROPPED.
ON DA SECOND DAY ONE OF DEM STOPS IN DA MIDDLE OF DA ROUTE, TURNS, AN' {LOOKS STRAIGHT AT {leader}|FACES DA PARTY|LOOKS AT SOMEBODY RATHER DEN THROUGH DEM} FOR 'BOUT A COUPLE OF SECONDS, AN' DEN GOES ON WALKIN'!

asides.nurturing: {member} IZ AT DA HOPPER BEFORE ANYBODY HAB DECIDED ANYTINK, AN' STAYS DERE!
asides.any: {member} {WRITES DOWN DA HOUR|MARKS DA PLACE ON DA ROUTE|SAYS NUTTIN' AN' WATCHES DA SAME ONE ALL AFTERNOON}

choices.text: KEEP FEEDIN' DEM. KEEP DA ROUTES CLEAR!
WORK ON DAT ONE. SEE WHAT IZ LEFT IN DERE!
FOLLOW DAT ONE'S ROUTE TA DA END OF IT!

feed_one.text:
IT TAKES {A WEEK AN' A BIT|A FORTNIGHT|ELEVEN DAYS} OF SITTIN' WIT SOMEBODY WHO IZ NO DERE, AN' ON ONE OF DOZE DAYS DERE IZ A NAME, AN' TWO DAYS AFTER DA NAME DERE IZ A SENTENCE WIT A WANT IN IT.
WHAT COMES BACK IZ NO ALL OF DEM AN' IZ UNMISTAKABLY SOMEBODY. DEY WILL NO BE WALKIN' DA ROUTE AGAIN. DA REST STILL IZ, AN' DAT IZ DA ARITHMETIC DA PARTY HAB TA CARRY OUT OF HERE!

feed_none.text:
DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT, AN' DEN A FORTNIGHT, AN' DERE IZ NUTTIN' IN DERE TA COME BACK: DA FOUR SECONDS ON DA ROUTE WAZ DA WHOLE OF IT, A GROOVE WORN BY SOMETINK DAT USED TA BE A PERSON WALKIN' PAST SOMETINK DAT USED TA MATTER.
DA PARTY LEAVES DA STORES STACKED AN' DA DOORS PROPPED AN' GOES, AN' {member} DOES NO EAT PROPERLY FOR {A WEEK|DAYS|SOME TIME} AFTERWARDS!

feed_route.text:
DA ROUTE ENDS AT A DOOR DAT IZ NO ON ANY OF DA OTHERS' ROUTES, AN' BEHIND DA DOOR DERE IZ A ROOM SET UP FOR {ONE PERSON|SOMEBODY|A SINGLE OCCUPANT} TA WAIT IN COMFORTABLY FOR A LONG TIME.
DERE IZ FOOD IN IT, REPLACED RECENTLY. SOMEBODY OUT HERE HAB BIN KEEPIN' ONE OF DEM, AN' IT IZ NO DA PARTY, AN' IT IZ NO ANY OF DA {few}!

down_m.text:
IT WOULD BE QUICK, AN' QUIET, AN' CORRECT BY EVERY STANDARD ANYBODY HAB WRITTEN DOWN, AN' EVERYBODY IN DA PARTY KNOWS WHICH OF DEM WILL DO IT AN' HAB KNOWN FOR {AN HOUR|SOME TIME|MOST OF DA AFTERNOON}.
DA ONE STILL DOING DA JOB DAT STOPPED MATTERIN' IZ AT DA FAR END OF DA ROUTE. IT WILL TAKE FOUR MINUTES TA WALK DERE, AN' DA FOUR MINUTES IZ DA WORST PART!

choices.text: DO IT.
CHECK, PROPERLY, DAT DERE IZ NUTTIN' LEFT IN ANY OF DEM FIRST!
PUT DA WEAPONS DOWN. FEED DEM INSTEAD!

down_check.text:
PUPILS, REFLEXES, DA LIL' TESTS DAT MEAN SOMETINK: {TWO|THREE} OF DEM IZ EMPTY IN DA WAY A COAT IZ EMPTY, AN' ONE OF DEM IZ NO, AN' DA ONE DAT IZ NO IZ DA ONE DOING DA JOB NOBODY NEEDS DONE.
DA EMPTY ONES IZ SEEN TA, CORRECTLY. DA OTHER IZ CARRIED OUT, AN' WAKES UP {A WEEK AN' A BIT|A FORTNIGHT|NINE DAYS} LATER A LONG WAY FROM HERE, AN' DA WHOLE BUSINESS IZ THEREAFTER A DIFFERENT STORY WIT A LIVIN' PERSON IN IT!

q_road.title: {DA TURN-OFF|ROAD WHERE NO ROAD IZ|DA ENCOMPASSIN'}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A ROAD AT {place}. A REAL ROAD, MADE, CAMBERED, WIT A WHITE LINE DOWN IT, RUNNIN' OUT OF {ground} AT BOTH ENDS INTO NUTTIN'.
{asker} IZ PARKED ON DA HARD SHOULDER OF IT WIT DA ENGINE RUNNIN' AN' HAB BIN FOR A WHILE, WORKIN' UP TA SOMETINK.
DA WHITE LINE IZ FRESH. SOMEBODY HAB BIN {REPAINTIN' IT|KEEPIN' IT UP|OUT HERE WIT A BRUSH} INSIDE DA LAST MONTH!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GET DA ENGINE CALIBRATED WIT {qty} {material} AN' TAKE DA TURN-OFF!
WALK IT TA DA END.
NOTE DA BEARIN' AN' STAY OFF IT!

turn.text:
CALIBRATED RIGHT, DA ROAD AHEAD FOLDS UP {LIKE A MAP BEING PUT AWAY|DA WAY A CONCERTINA GOES|INTO ITSELF}, AN' DA TURN-OFF IZ SOMEWHERE ELSE ENTIRELY BY DA TIME DA WHEELS REACH IT.
WHEREVER DAT WAZ, DA PARTY WAZ DERE FOR 'BOUT A COUPLE OF MINUTES AN' CAME BACK WIT TINKZ DAT IZ NO SOLD ANYWHERE {ON DIS ROCK|IN DIS SYSTEM|ANYBODY CAN NAME}!

walk.text:
IT TAKES {ALL DAY|UNTIL DA LIGHT GOES|DA BETTER PART OF A DAY} AN' DA ROAD ENDS DA WAY IT BEGAN, CLEANLY, MID-CAMBER, WIT DA WHITE LINE STOPPIN' AT A RIGHT ANGLE.
AT DA END OF IT DERE IZ A SHRINE OF SORTS, MADE BY DRIVERS, AN' EVERYTINK ON IT WAZ LEFT BY SOMEBODY WHO GOT SOMEWHERE. DA PARTY LEAVES SOMETINK AN' TAKES NUTTIN', AN' DA WALK BACK IZ SHORTER DEN DA WALK OUT BY A MARGIN NOBODY {WANTS TA DISCUSS|IZ WILLIN' TA NAME|DOES DA ARITHMETIC ON}!

loop.text:
SOMEWHERE PAST DA FOURTH HOUR DA ROAD STARTS ARRIVIN' AT ITSELF. DA SAME WHITE LINE, DA SAME {remnant} ON DA SAME SIDE.
IT TAKES {member} SPOTTIN' DEY OWN BOOTPRINT GOING DA OTHER WAY TA BREAK IT, AN' EVERYBODY COMES OFF DA SURFACE ONTO HONEST {ground} FEELIN' SEVERAL HOURS POORER DEN DA CLOCK SAYS!

off.text:
DA BEARIN' GOES IN DA BOOK AN' DA ROAD GOES ON LYING DERE BEING A ROAD.
{asker} IZ STILL PARKED ON DA SHOULDER WHEN DA PARTY IZ A KILOMETRE OUT, STILL WORKIN' UP TA {IT|WHATEVER IT IZ|DA TURN}!

walk_m.text:
IT TAKES {ALL DAY|UNTIL DA LIGHT GOES|DA BETTER PART OF A DAY} AN' DA ROAD ENDS DA WAY IT BEGAN: CLEANLY, MID-CAMBER, WIT DA WHITE LINE STOPPIN' AT A RIGHT ANGLE.
AT DA END OF IT DERE IZ A SHRINE OF SORTS, MADE BY DRIVERS OUT OF WHAT DRIVERS CARRY, AN' A PAINT TIN, AN' A BRUSH STANDIN' IN IT DAT IZ {STILL WET|NO YET DRY|WET ENOUGH TA USE}!

choices.text: SIT AT DA SHRINE A WHILE AN' GO BACK!
PAINT DA LINE ON. ANOTHER FEW METRES OF IT!
READ WHAT DA DRIVERS LEFT AT DA SHRINE!

walk_paint.text:
THREE METRES OF WHITE LINE ONTO GROUND DAT WAZ NO ROAD WHEN DA BRUSH WENT DOWN AN' IZ ROAD BY DA TIME IT LIFTS.
NOBODY DISCUSSES DIS ON DA WALK BACK. DA ROAD IZ THREE METRES LONGER. {member} CHECKS DA ODOMETER OF A VEHICLE DAT WAZ NO MOVIN' AN' FINDS IT {FOUR|THREE} KILOMETRES FURTHER ON DEN IT WAZ!

walk_read.text:
WHAT DA DRIVERS LEFT IZ A PROCEDURE: {NINE|SEVEN|ELEVEN} INSTRUCTIONS IN AS MANY HANDS, 'BOUT WHAT TA DO AT DA END OF DA ROAD, IN WHAT ORDER, AN' WHAT NO TA DO ON ANY ACCOUNT.
FOLLOWED PROPERLY IT TAKES A LONG STRETCH AN' INVOLVES A GREAT DEAL OF STANDIN' STILL. AT DA END OF IT DA ROAD IZ STILL DERE AN' SOMETINK 'BOUT DA PARTY'S RELATIONSHIP TA IT HAB BIN FORMALLY SETTLED!

off_m.text:
DA BEARIN' GOES IN DA BOOK AN' DA ROAD GOES ON LYING DERE BEING A ROAD.
{asker} IZ STILL PARKED ON DA SHOULDER WHEN DA PARTY IZ A KILOMETRE OUT, ENGINE RUNNIN', AN' DEN DA ENGINE STOPS, AN' IN DA QUIET DAT FOLLOWS IT IZ POSSIBLE TA HEAR A DOOR!

choices.text: KEEP GOING. NO OUR ROAD.
GO BACK FOR DEM.
WATCH THROUGH DA GLASS FROM HERE!

off_back.text:
DA VEHICLE IZ ON DA SHOULDER WIT DA DOOR OPEN AN' DA SEAT WARM AN' DA HANDBRAKE OFF, AN' DA ROAD AHEAD OF IT IZ {EMPTY|CLEAN|EXACTLY AS LONG AS IT WAZ}.
DA PARTY PUSHES IT OFF DA SURFACE ONTO HONEST GROUND, WHICH TAKES ALL FOUR OF DEM, AN' DA ENGINE STARTS ON DA THIRD TRY AN' WILL NO GO NEAR DA ROAD AGAIN. WHOEVER WAZ DRIVIN' IZ NO FOUND, DEN OR LATER!

off_watch.text:
THROUGH DA GLASS, AT A KILOMETRE, IT IZ POSSIBLE TA WATCH SOMEBODY GET OUT OF A VEHICLE, WALK TA DA WHITE LINE, STAND ON IT, AN' {STOP BEING DERE|NO BE DERE|GO FROM BEING A PERSON TA BEING A LENGTH OF ROAD} WITOUT ANY PART OF IT LOOKIN' SUDDEN.
DA PARTY MARKS DA SPOT, MARKS DA HOUR, AN' DOES NO GO BACK. DA NOTES ON IT IZ READ, LATER, BY PEOPLE WHO PAY FOR DAT SORT OF NOTE!

qe_bubble.title: {DA EDGE OF IT|EIGHTY OR NUTTIN'|TUESDAY AGAIN}

n0.text:
{hour}, ON DA ROAD OUT OF {place}, DA AIR AHEAD GOES WRONG IN DA WAY AIR DOES 'BOUT {few} METRES FROM DA EDGE OF ONE OF DEM.
DA MAP MARKS IT. DA MAP HAB NO BIN REDRAWN SINCE {timeAgo}, AN' DA EDGE HAB MOVED. {stranger} IZ STANDIN' JUST ON DA SAFE SIDE OF DA LINE WIT A BICYCLE AN' A FACE DAT SAYS TODAY IZ NO DA FIRST TIME.
DERE IZ {TWO|THREE} VEHICLES ON DA VERGE DIS SIDE OF DA EDGE, PARKED NEATLY, {WIT DA KEYS IN|UNLOCKED|ALL OF DEM FACIN' OUT}!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GO IN AN' BRING WHOEVER IZ IN DERE OUT!
RE-MARK DA EDGE PROPERLY, ALL DA WAY ROUND!
TAKE DA LONG WAY AN' SAY NUTTIN' TA ANYBODY!

outt.text:
INSIDE IT IZ DA SAME TUESDAY IT HAB BIN FOR A WHILE AN' EVERYBODY IN IT KNOWS, WHICH IZ DA PART NOBODY PREPARES YOU FOR.
GETTIN' OUT MEANS GOING OUTWARD OVER EIGHTY, AN' {vehicle} IZ NO BUILT FOR IT, AN' IT IZ DONE ANYWAY WIT A COUPLE OF DEM IN DA BACK HOLDIN' ON TA EACH OTHER AN' ONE OF DEM {COUNTIN'|COUNTIN' OUT LOUD|WATCHIN' DA NEEDLE}!

stuck.text:
DA RUN AT DA EDGE COMES UP SHORT, AN' SHORT MEANS DA WHOLE TINK AGAIN FROM DA TOP, ON DA SAME TUESDAY, WIT EVERYBODY'S CONFIDENCE A GOOD DEAL THINNER.
DEY GET OUT ON DA {FOURTH|THIRD|FIFTH} GO. SOME OF DA FOURTH GO IZ NO REMEMBERED, AN' DA PARTY COMES OUT WIT A DAY OF DEY OWN {MISSIN'|GONE|UNACCOUNTED FOR}!

mark.text:
POSTS AN' PAINT DA WHOLE WAY ROUND, AT DA REAL EDGE, WHICH TAKES UNTIL DARK AN' A GOOD DEAL MORE {material} DEN ANYBODY ESTIMATED.
EVERYTINK DAT COMES DOWN DAT ROAD FOR DA NEXT TWENTY YEARS WILL SLOW FOR DOZE POSTS. NOBODY WILL EVER KNOW DA PARTY DID IT. DA SOCIETY HEARS 'BOUT IT WITHIN A WEEK!

away.text:
DA LONG WAY IZ {AN HOUR AN' A HALF|HALF A SHIFT} OF BAD SURFACE AN' IT IZ {AN HOUR AN' A HALF|TIME|A DETOUR} NOBODY COMPLAINS 'BOUT.
BEHIND, DA MAP GOES ON SAYIN' WHAT IT HAB SAID SINCE {timeAgo}, AN' DA EDGE GOES ON BEING WHERE IT ACTUALLY IZ!

mark_m.text:
POSTS AN' PAINT DA WHOLE WAY ROUND AT DA REAL EDGE, WHICH MEANS WALKIN' DA REAL EDGE, WHICH MEANS {A FEW KILOMETRES|DA BETTER PART OF A DAY|A LONG CIRCUIT} OF FINDIN' OUT EXACTLY WHERE IT IZ BY DA ONLY METHOD AVAILABLE.
'BOUT TWO THIRDS OF DA WAY ROUND, DA EDGE CROSSES A FARM TRACK, AN' ON DA FAR SIDE OF DA TRACK, INSIDE, DERE IZ A HOUSE WIT A LIGHT ON!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DO NO KNOCK.|WE IZ MARKIN' IT, NO VISITIN' IT.|DAT LIGHT HAB BIN ON SINCE DA MAP WAZ RIGHT.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A POST IN ON DA NEAR SIDE OF DA TRACK AN' LOOKS AT DA HOUSE|CHECKS DA WATCH AGAINST DA SUN|COUNTS DA WINDOWS}

choices.text: POST IT, PAINT IT, AN' WALK ON ROUND!
KNOCK.
WORK OUT HOW LONG IT HAB BIN IN DERE!

mark_knock.text:
IT IZ ANSWERED INSIDE {A COUPLE OF SECONDS|NO TIME|DA TIME IT TAKES TA LOWER A HAND}, BY SOMEBODY WHO IZ DELIGHTED, WHO HAB DA KETTLE ON, AN' WHO ASKS AFTER {A WAR|A GOVERNMENT|SOMEBODY'S CORONATION} DAT FINISHED A LONG TIME AGO.
DA PARTY STAYS {A LONG STRETCH|HALF AN HOUR|TOO LONG} AN' COMES OUT ONTO DA TRACK WIT DA LIGHT GOING AN' DA DISTINCT SENSE OF HAVIN' LEFT SOMETINK BEHIND IN DERE DAT DEY NO CAN LOOT SACK!

mark_date.text:
DA CLOUDS INSIDE IZ DA WRONG CLOUDS FOR DA SEASON AN' HAB BIN DA WRONG CLOUDS FOR A WHILE, AN' DA GROWTH ON DA NEAR SIDE OF DA EDGE GIVES DA REST: {ELEVEN|NINE|FOURTEEN} YEARS, GIVE OR TAKE A SPRING.
DA FIGURE GOES ON DA POSTS ALONG WIT DA PAINT. EVERY HAULER ON DIS ROAD FOR DA NEXT TWENTY YEARS SLOWS AT DOZE POSTS AN' READS DAT NUMBER, AN' IT IZ DA NUMBER, NO DA PAINT, DAT MAKES DEM SLOW!

away_m.text:
DA LONG WAY IZ {AN HOUR AN' A HALF|HALF A SHIFT} OF BAD SURFACE AN' IT IZ TIME NOBODY COMPLAINS 'BOUT.
HALF AN HOUR ALONG IT DERE IZ A {vehicle} COMIN' DA OTHER WAY, FAST, WIT A LOAD ON AN' A DRIVER WHO DOES NO KNOW, AN' DERE IZ EXACTLY ONE CHANCE TA FLAG DEM DOWN!

choices.text: LET DEM GO. NO OUR ROAD.
FLAG DEM DOWN.
GET ACROSS DA ROAD AN' MAKE DEM STOP!

away_flag.text:
DEY SEE DA ARMS, DEY SLOW, DEY STOP, AN' DEY LISTEN WIT DA ENGINE RUNNIN' COZ DAT IZ HOW DEZE CONVERSATIONS IZ HAB ON A ROAD.
DA MAP IN DA CAB IZ DA SAME MAP. DEY TURN ROUND. AT DA NEXT FIRE DOWN DA LINE DA PARTY'S DESCRIPTION GOES ROUND ATTACHED TA DA PHRASE {"DA ONES ON DA BAD ROAD"|"DOZE FOUR ON DA DETOUR"|"WHOEVER FLAGGED KOLYA DOWN"}!

away_block.text:
STANDIN' IN A ROAD IN FRONT OF A LOADED {vehicle} IZ A WAY OF FINDIN' OUT WHAT YA OWN NERVE IZ WORTH, AN' IT WORKS, AT DA COST OF {A WING MIRROR|DA NEAR-SIDE MIRROR|SOMEBODY'S JACKET}.
DA DRIVER'S OPINION OF DA PARTY TAKES {A LONG STRETCH|A WHILE|DA REST OF DA LAYBY} TA COME ROUND, AN' DEN COMES ROUND ENTIRELY, AN' DERE IZ FOOD IN DA CAB AN' IT GETS SHARED!

qe_note.title: {DA SECURITY STRIP|NOTES WIT DA THREAD PICKED OUT|LIL' DENOMINATIONS}

n0.text:
IN A BACK ROOM OFF {street} DERE IZ A TABLE, A LAMP, AN' {stranger} TAKIN' DA SECURITY THREAD OUT OF EURO NOTES WIT A NEEDLE, ONE NOTE AT A TIME, INTO A SAUCER.
DERE IZ A LOT IN DA SAUCER. DA NOTES GO BACK INTO CIRCULATION AFTERWARDS AN' NOBODY HAB EVER NOTICED, COZ NOBODY HAB EVER HAB A REASON TA LOOK.
DA NEEDLE WORK IZ {BEAUTIFUL|EXTREMELY FINE|DA WORK OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB DONE THOUSANDS}, AN' DA HANDS DOING IT IZ SHAKIN' DA ENTIRE TIME!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BUY DA SAUCER.
WORK OUT WHAT IT IZ FOR.
DIS IZ A CURRENCY OFFENCE AN' A CONSIDERABLY WORSE ONE UNDERNEATH!

buy.text:
IT CHANGES HANDS INTO A TIN AN' DA TIN GOES INTO DA PACK WRAPPED IN {CLOTH|A SHIRT|TWO LAYERS OF DA SAME CLOTH}, COZ DA PIGMENT DOES NO CARE FOR LIGHT.
WHAT IT IZ WORTH IZ NO REALLY A PRICE. A ROUND OF IT WILL KILL SOMEBODY STANDIN' IN A LOOP, AN' DERE IZ ENOUGH HERE FOR A ROUND OR TWO, AN' NOW DAT IZ DA PARTY'S {PROBLEM TA CARRY|PROBLEM|TA CARRY}!

for.text:
IT IZ COATIN'.
DERE IZ A WORKBENCH UNDER DA TABLE WIT {few} ROUNDS ON IT, HALF DONE, AN' A LIST OF NAMES, AN' EVERY NAME ON DA LIST IZ SOMEBODY WHO HAB BIN SITTIN' INSIDE A BUBBLE BEING UNTOUCHABLE FOR YEARS WHILE PEOPLE ON DA OUTSIDE {HAB OPINIONS 'BOUT IT|ARGUED 'BOUT IT|WROTE LETTERS}!

forf.text:
DA STORY HOLDS ALL EVENIN': {A HOBBY, A PIGMENT, A PRIVATE ECCENTRICITY|AN OLD HABIT, A PIGMENT, NUTTIN' IN IT|A COLLECTION, A PIGMENT, A WAY TA PASS AN EVENIN'}, AN' DA SAUCER IZ JUST A SAUCER.
IT IZ A GOOD STORY AN' IT IZ TOLD BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB HAB A LONG TIME TA PRACTISE IT, AN' DA PARTY LEAVES WIT NUTTIN' BUT A SLIGHT ITCH 'BOUT DA {THIRD|SECOND|FOURTH} ANSWER!

rep.text:
IT GOES ON PAPER AN' DA PAPER GOES IN AT DA DESK WIT {paper} ATTACHED, AN' DA ROOM IZ CLEARED WITHIN A DAY.
DA PARTY NEVER LEARNS WHICH OF DA TWO POSSIBLE REASONS IT WAZ CLEARED FOR, {WHICH IZ AN ANSWER OF A KIND|WHICH ANSWERS IT WELL ENOUGH|WHICH IZ ANSWER ENOUGH}!

buy_m.text:
DA SAUCER CHANGES HANDS FOR {payment} AN' GOES INTO A TIN, WRAPPED IN {CLOTH|A SHIRT|TWO LAYERS OF DA SAME CLOTH}, COZ DA PIGMENT DOES NO CARE FOR LIGHT.
{stranger} DOES NO COUNT DA MONEY. {stranger} ASKS, INSTEAD, WHETHER DA PARTY WOULD LIKE DA LIST AS WELL, AN' DA LIST IZ A PAGE OF NAMES, AN' DA NAME AT DA TOP HAB BIN CROSSED OUT {RECENTLY|DIS WEEK|SINCE YESTERDAY}!

choices.text: TAKE DA TIN. LEAVE DA LIST. NO OUR BUSINESS!
TAKE DA LIST AN' FIND OUT WHAT DA CROSSIN' OUT MEANS!
ASK WHY DA HANDS IZ SHAKIN'!

buy_list.text:
CROSSED OUT MEANS DONE, AN' DONE MEANS A ROUND WAZ MADE AN' A ROUND WAZ USED, AN' DA MAN AT DA TOP OF DA LIST HAB BIN {UNTOUCHABLE|INSIDE A BUBBLE|BEYOND REACH} FOR {ELEVEN YEARS|A DECADE|A REAL LONG TIME} AN' IZ NO ANY MORE.
DA REST OF DA LIST IZ {NINE|ELEVEN} NAMES OF PEOPLE WHO IZ 'BOUT TA FIND OUT DA SAME TINK. WHAT DAT IZ WORTH DEPENDS ENTIRELY ON WHICH OF DEM DA PARTY WARNS, AN' WHETHER DEY WARN ANY!

buy_heat.text:
ASKIN' 'BOUT A CROSSED-OUT NAME IN A BACK ROOM OFF {street} IZ A QUESTION DAT LEAVES DA ROOM {INSIDE DA HOUR|BEFORE DA PARTY DOES|FASTER DEN DA PARTY DOES}.
DA TIN IZ IN DA PACK AN' DA PACK STAYS SHUT FOR A FORTNIGHT, COZ FOR A FORTNIGHT DERE IZ SOMEBODY AT DA END OF EVERY STREET DA PARTY WALKS DOWN, NO DOING ANYTINK, JUST BEING AT DA END OF IT!

buy_hands.text:
IT IZ DA PIGMENT. IT HAB BIN DA PIGMENT FOR {A FEW YEARS|A LONG TIME|LONGER DEN ANYBODY SHOULD}, AN' IT GOES IN THROUGH DA FINGERS AN' IT DOES NO COME OUT, AN' {stranger} HAB KNOWN DIS SINCE 'BOUT DA THIRD SAUCER.
DEY TAKE DA TREATMENT OFFERED, BADLY AN' GRUDGINGLY, AN' DEY DO NO STOP WORKIN'. BUT DA GLOVES DA PARTY LEAVES BEHIND IZ USED, WHICH IZ VISIBLE ON DA TABLE DA NEXT TIME ANYBODY PASSES!

rep_m.text:
IT GOES ON PAPER IN {A FEW LINES|A SHORT PARAGRAPH|AS FEW WORDS AS WILL DO} AN' DA PAPER GOES IN AT DA DESK WIT {paper} ATTACHED.
DA CLERK READS IT TWICE, WHICH CLERKS DO NO, AN' ASKS WHETHER DA PARTY WOULD PREFER DA CURRENCY DESK OR DA OTHER ONE, AN' DOES NO SAY WHAT DA OTHER ONE IZ!

choices.text: DA CURRENCY DESK. A CURRENCY OFFENCE IZ WHAT WE SAW!
DA OTHER ONE.
TAKE DA PAPER BACK. GO AN' WARN {stranger} INSTEAD!

rep_other.text:
DA OTHER DESK IZ {UP A STAIRCASE|AT DA BACK|ON A DIFFERENT FLOOR} AN' HAB NOBODY QUEUEIN' AT IT AN' A MAN BEHIND IT WHO LISTENS WITOUT WRITIN' ANYTINK DOWN.
DA ROOM OFF {street} IZ CLEARED INSIDE {A COUPLE OF HOURS|DA AFTERNOON|A DAY}. SO IZ {TWO|THREE} OTHER ROOMS IN OTHER TOWNS DAT DA PARTY NEVER MENTIONED, WHICH MEANS DA MAN BEHIND DA DESK ALREADY HAB MOST OF IT AN' WAZ WAITIN' FOR DA LAST PIECE!
