rep_warn.text:
DA PAPER COMES BACK OFF DA DESK, WHICH TAKES {A LIE|SOME NERVE|A STORY 'BOUT A NAME BEING WRONG}, AN' DA WALK BACK TA {street} TAKES {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR|NO TIME AT ALL}.
DA ROOM IZ EMPTY BY DA TIME DA PARTY GETS DERE. DA TABLE, DA LAMP AN' DA SAUCER IZ GONE AN' DA NEEDLE IZ STILL ON DA FLOORBOARDS, AN' SOMEWHERE OUT DERE SOMEBODY HAB {HALF A SHIFT|HALF A DAY|A START} DAT DEY WOULD NO OTHERWISE HAB HAB!

qe_naguka.title: {CORPSE PAINT AT DA CROSSROADS|DA ONE WIT DA WRONG FACE|KIN}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A NAGUKA SITTIN' AT DA CROSSROADS OUTSIDE {place} WIT DA PAINT HALF OFF, HOLDIN' A BROKEN INSTRUMENT AN' NO IDEA WHICH DIRECTION IZ WHICH.
DA HORDE WENT DAT WAY {timeAgo}. DIS ONE DID NO, AN' NO CAN EXPLAIN WHY IN MORE DEN 'BOUT {SIX|FIVE|SEVEN} WORDS AT A TIME, AN' KEEPS SAYIN' ONE OF DEM.
DA PAINT DAT IZ LEFT ON IT IZ DA HORDE'S OWN MARKIN', AN' SOMEBODY HAB TRIED TA SCRUB IT OFF {FROM DA OUTSIDE|WIT SAND|NO REAL KINDLY}!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.aggressive: {member} HAB COUNTED DA CROSSROADS' SIGHTLINES AN' DOES NO LIKE ANY OF DEM!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: FEED IT AN' TAKE IT AS FAR AS DA NEXT TOWN!
FIX DA INSTRUMENT WIT {qty} {material}.
HAND IT IN AT DA BARRACKS!

take2.text:
IT EATS LIKE SOMETINK DAT HAB NO, AN' WALKS IN DA MIDDLE OF DA GROUP WITOUT BEING ASKED TA, AN' BY DA SECOND HOUR IZ TELLIN' A STORY WIT 'BOUT {ELEVEN|NINE|A DOZEN} WORDS IN IT AN' USING ALL OF DEM TWICE.
AT DA TOWN IT IZ TAKEN IN BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB DONE DIS BEFORE. DA COLLECTIVE KNOWS, WITHIN DA DAY, DAT DA PARTY DID NO LEAVE ONE OF DEY {AT A CROSSROADS|IN A DITCH|STANDIN' AT A CROSSROADS}!

fix.text:
DA {material} DOES IT, ROUGHLY, AN' DA FIRST NOTE OUT OF IT STOPS DA CONVERSATION DEAD.
WHAT IT PLAYS AT DA CROSSROADS IZ NO FOR DA PARTY AN' IZ NO FOR ANYBODY. HALFWAY THROUGH, {member} REALISES DEY IZ HEARIN' SOMETINK DA HORDE IZ ALSO HEARIN', {distance}, AN' GETS REAL QUIET!

hand.text:
DA BARRACKS TAKE IT AN' SIGN FOR IT AN' IZ CORRECT THROUGHOUT, AN' DA SERGEANT DOES NO MEET {ANYBODY'S EYE|DA PARTY'S EYE|ANYBODY'S EYE AT ALL} WHILE DOING DA SIGNIN'.
DA COLLECTIVE UNCONSCIOUS DOES NO HAB A SUBTLE WAY OF REGISTERIN' AN OPINION, AN' IT {REGISTERS ONE|REGISTERS DIS ONE|MAKES IT KNOWN}!

take_m.text:
IT EATS LIKE SOMETINK DAT HAB NO, AN' WALKS IN DA MIDDLE OF DA GROUP WITOUT BEING ASKED TA, AN' BY DA SECOND HOUR IZ TELLIN' A STORY WIT 'BOUT {ELEVEN|NINE|A DOZEN} WORDS IN IT AN' USING ALL OF DEM TWICE.
AT DA THIRD HOUR DERE IZ A CHECKPOINT ON DA ROAD INTO DA NEXT TOWN, AN' IT IZ MANNED, AN' DA NAGUKA STOPS WALKIN' 'BOUT {TWO HUNDRED METRES|A DISTANCE|WELL} SHORT OF IT WITOUT BEING TOLD TA!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{IT KNOWS WHAT A CHECKPOINT IZ. TINK 'BOUT DAT.|IT STOPPED BEFORE WE DID.|SOMEBODY TAUGHT IT DAT.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A COAT OVER ITS SHOULDERS|WALKS BACK TA IT AN' WAITS|LOOKS AT DA CHECKPOINT AN' DEN AT DA DITCH}

choices.text: WALK IT THROUGH DA CHECKPOINT. STRAIGHT IN, HEADS UP!
TALK IT THROUGH. PAPERWORK AN' A STRAIGHT FACE!
GO ROUND. DITCHES, FIELDS, DA LONG WAY!

take_through.text:
DA STORY IZ DAT IT IZ A HIRED HAND, DEAF, AN' BEING TAKEN TA FAMILY, AN' IT HOLDS COZ IT IZ TOLD BY SOMEBODY WHO IZ BORED OF TELLIN' IT AN' COZ DA NAGUKA {SAYS NUTTIN' AT ALL|IZ SILENT|DOES NO OPEN ITS MOUTH} FOR DA WHOLE A COUPLE OF MINUTES.
ON DA FAR SIDE IT TAKES {leader}'S SLEEVE AN' DOES NO LET GO FOR A HUNDRED METRES. AT DA NEXT TOWN IT IZ CLAIMED BY SOMEBODY FROM DA HORDE WITHIN A DAY, AN' DA WORD GOES BACK DOWN DA LINE 'BOUT WHO BROUGHT IT!

take_round.text:
IT IZ {A FEW KILOMETRES|A LONG LOOP|TWO HOURS} OF DITCH, FIELD AN' ONE FENCE, IN DA DARK, WIT SOMETINK DAT DOES NO SEE WELL AN' WILL NO BE CARRIED.
IT ARRIVES FILTHY AN' ENTIRELY DELIGHTED. DA ROUTE GETS USED AGAIN, BY OTHER PEOPLE, WITHIN DA MONTH, AN' NOBODY EVER WRITES DOWN WHOSE ROUTE IT WAZ!

take_held.text:
IT IZ HELD AT DA CHECKPOINT FOR {FOUR HOURS|AN AFTERNOON|MOST OF A DAY} WHILE SOMEBODY RINGS SOMEBODY, AN' DA PARTY IZ HELD WIT IT, WHICH IZ DA ONLY REASON DA FOUR HOURS STAY FOUR HOURS.
IT IZ RELEASED TA DA PARTY AT DUSK WIT A FORM AN' A CONDITION: OUT OF DA DISTRICT BY MORNIN'. DAT IZ DONE. SOMETINK 'BOUT IT, THOUGH, DOES NO TALK FOR DA REST OF DA WALK!

hand_m.text:
DA BARRACKS IZ {FOUR HUNDRED METRES|UP DA ROAD|ACROSS DA SQUARE} AN' DA SERGEANT ON DA DESK HAB SIGNED FOR {TWO|THREE} OF DEZE DIS SEASON ALREADY.
HE SAYS SO. HE ALSO SAYS, WITOUT BEING ASKED AN' WITOUT LOOKIN' UP, DAT NONE OF DEM WENT WHERE DA FORM SAYS DEY WENT, AN' DAT HE WRITES DA FORM ANYWAY COZ DA FORM IZ WHAT HE HAB!

choices.text: HAND IT IN. IT IZ DA LAWFUL TINK!
ASK HIM, STRAIGHT OUT, WHERE DEY ACTUALLY GO!
TAKE IT BACK OUT OF DA BARRACKS AN' WALK IT NORTH!

hand_where.text:
HE TELLS IT IN {FOUR SENTENCES|DA FEWEST WORDS AVAILABLE|ONE GO}, LOOKIN' AT DA DESK, AN' DEN ASKS DA PARTY TA LEAVE, AN' DEN ASKS DEM NO TA COME BACK THROUGH DIS TOWN FOR A WHILE.
WHERE DEY GO IZ NO FAR AN' IZ NO A BARRACKS AN' IZ NO ON ANY FORM. KNOWIN' IT IZ WORTH SOMETINK TA DA HORDE, AN' IT WILL BE WORTH A GREAT DEAL MORE TA SOMEBODY ELSE IN 'BOUT A YEAR!

qe_ttd.title: {TINFOIL|DA IDEA GOING ROUND|EVERYBODY HAB IT AT ONCE}

n0.text:
HALF OF {place} IZ WEARIN' HATS AN' DA OTHER HALF IZ LAUGHIN' AT DEM, AN' DA HALF WEARIN' HATS HAB A POINT.
DERE IZ A THOUGHT GOING ROUND: DA SAME {rumour}, ARRIVIN' IN DA SAME WORDS, IN PEOPLE WHO HAB NO SPOKEN TA EACH OTHER. {stranger} KEEPS A LIST OF WHO HAB HAB IT AN' DA LIST IZ DA WRONG SHAPE FOR GOSSIP.
DA HATS IZ NO ALL FOIL. {TWO|THREE} OF DEM IZ OLDER DEN DAT AN' IZ MADE PROPERLY, BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB DONE DIS BEFORE!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: DAM IT. FOIL FOR EVERYBODY, {qty} {material} WORTH!
FIND PATIENT ZERO ON DA LIST!
SIT WIT IT AN' SEE WHAT IT WANTS!

dam.text:
IT LOOKS RIDICULOUS AN' IT WORKS, WHICH IZ DA WHOLE HISTORY OF DA COUNTERMEASURE IN ONE SENTENCE.
INSIDE A COUPLE OF DAYS DA LIST STOPS GROWIN'. NOBODY IN {place} WILL EVER BE ABLE TA SAY WHETHER IT WOULD HAB STOPPED ANYWAY, AN' EVERYBODY {KEEPS DA HAT|KEEPS WEARIN' DA HAT|HANGS ON TA DA HAT}!

zero.text:
DA LIST SORTED BY HOUR COMES TA A POINT, AN' DA POINT IZ A MAN WHO HAB NO LEFT HIS HOUSE IN {timeAgo} AN' DID NO TINK DA THOUGHT EITHER.
HE RECEIVED IT. DERE IZ A DIFFERENCE AN' HE IZ DA ONLY PERSON IN {place} WHO UNDERSTANDS IT, AN' HE HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR SOMEBODY TA {COME AN' ASK|ASK|TURN UP AN' ASK}!

want.text:
SAT WIT PROPERLY, IT IZ A SHAPE, AN' DA SHAPE IZ TRYIN' TA BE HELD BY ENOUGH PEOPLE AT ONCE TA BECOME A TINK.
{leader} DOES NO LET IT, WHICH IZ HARDER DEN IT SOUNDS AN' TAKES UNTIL DA LIL' HOURS, AN' DA SHAPE GOES {LOOKIN' ELSEWHERE|SOMEWHERE ELSE|OFF TA BE HELD BY SOMEBODY ELSE}!

caught.text:
EVERYBODY IN DA PARTY HAB IT BY DA EVENIN', IN DA SAME WORDS, ARRIVIN' AT DA SAME TIME.
IT TAKES {few} DAYS AN' A GREAT DEAL OF FOIL TA GET IT BACK OUT, AN' FOR A WHILE AFTERWARDS NOBODY TRUSTS AN IDEA DEY {HAB ON DEY OWN|ARRIVED AT ALONE|CAME UP WIT}!

dam_m.text:
FOIL FOR EVERYBODY LOOKS RIDICULOUS AN' WORKS, WHICH IZ DA WHOLE HISTORY OF DA COUNTERMEASURE IN ONE SENTENCE, AN' IT TAKES {AN AFTERNOON|HALF A DAY|TWO HOURS AN' A LOT OF ARGUIN'} TA HAND OUT.
DA PEOPLE WIT DA PROPER HATS WILL NO TAKE DA FOIL. DEY ALSO WILL NO SAY WHERE DA PROPER HATS CAME FROM, AN' ONE OF DEM ASKS DA PARTY, QUIETLY, WHETHER DEY HAB STARTED {DREAMIN' 'BOUT DA SAME ROOM|HAVIN' DA SAME DREAM|HEARIN' IT IN DA DREAM TOO}!

choices.text: FINISH DA DISTRIBUTION. IGNORE DA QUESTION!
ANSWER HONESTLY AN' ASK WHERE DA GOOD HATS COME FROM!
SLEEP IN {place} TONIGHT AN' FIND OUT!

dam_hats.text:
DEY COME FROM {A WOMAN TWO VILLAGES OVER|AN OLD MAN ON DA COAST|SOMEBODY IN DA NEXT VALLEY} WHO HAB MADE DEM SINCE BEFORE ANYBODY IN DIS TOWN WAZ BORN, AN' WHO MAKES 'BOUT {FOUR|FIVE} A YEAR, AN' WHO HAB NEVER EXPLAINED DA PATTERN TA ANYBODY.
DA PATTERN IZ WRITIN', REAL LIL', ALL DA WAY ROUND DA INSIDE, AN' DA PARTY IZ SHOWN IT AN' PERMITTED TA COPY IT, WHICH HAB HAPPENED {TWICE|ONCE|THREE TIMES} BEFORE IN A LIFETIME OF WORK!

dam_dream.text:
IT IZ A ROOM, AN' IT IZ DA SAME ROOM, AN' EVERYBODY IN DA PARTY IZ IN IT AT DA SAME TIME, WHICH NONE OF DEM MENTION AT BREAKFAST UNTIL SOMEBODY DESCRIBES DA WALLPAPER.
DA THOUGHT DOES NO ARRIVE IN WORDS DIS TIME. IT ARRIVES AS {AN INSTRUCTION|A PREFERENCE|A DIRECTION}, AN' IT IZ 'BOUT DA WELL BEHIND DA CHAPEL, AN' BY DA TIME ANYBODY IZ PROPERLY AWAKE TWO OF DA PARTY IZ ALREADY DRESSED!

zero_m.text:
DA LIST SORTED BY HOUR COMES TA A POINT, AN' DA POINT IZ A MAN WHO HAB NO LEFT HIS HOUSE IN {timeAgo} AN' DID NO TINK DA THOUGHT EITHER.
HE RECEIVED IT. DERE IZ A DIFFERENCE, AN' HE IZ DA ONLY PERSON IN {place} WHO KNOWS DERE IZ A DIFFERENCE, AN' HE HAB BIN WAITIN' FOR SOMEBODY TA KNOCK ON HIS DOOR 'BOUT IT FOR {FOUR DAYS|NEARLY A WEEK|DA WHOLE OF DIS}!

choices.text: SIT DOWN AN' LET HIM EXPLAIN!
FIND OUT WHAT HE WAZ DOING AT DA HOUR IT ARRIVED!
GET HIM OUT OF {place} TONIGHT.

zero_set.text:
HE WAZ DOING WHAT HE DOES EVERY EVENIN', WHICH IZ LISTENIN' TA A SET HE BUILT HIMSELF IN {1974|DA SEVENTIES|A LONG TIME AGO} ON A BAND NOBODY USES.
DA SET IZ STILL ON DA TABLE. IT IZ STILL RECEIVIN'. WHAT IT IZ RECEIVIN' IZ {A SHAPE|NO SPEECH|DA TINK, UNFOLDED}, AN' NOW DAT FOUR OTHER PEOPLE HAB HEARD IT, IT IZ NO LONGER ONLY HIS PROBLEM, WHICH HE SAYS IZ DA BEST NEWS HE HAB HAB ALL YEAR!

zero_out.text:
GETTIN' SOMEBODY WHO HAB NO BIN OUTDOORS IN {timeAgo} INTO A VEHICLE TAKES {A COUPLE OF HOURS|MOST OF DA EVENIN'|LONGER DEN DA DRIVE}, AN' DA FIRST {FOUR HUNDRED METRES|HUNDRED METRES|PART} OF DA JOURNEY IZ REAL BAD FOR HIM.
DA THOUGHT STOPS SPREADIN' IN {place} WITHIN A DAY OF HIM LEAVIN' IT, WHICH IZ EITHER A CURE OR A COINCIDENCE AN' WILL NEVER BE DISTINGUISHABLE. HE DOES NO GO BACK. HE DOES, EVENTUALLY, THANK DA PARTY, BY LETTER!

qe_wellhead.title: {DA WELLHEAD|WHERE DA LINE COMES UP|OIL AN' BLOOD}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A CAPPED WELLHEAD IN DA FIELD BEYOND {place} WIT {sign} RUSTED OFF IT, AN' EVERYTINK GREEN FOR {few} METRES AROUND IT IZ GROWIN' DA WRONG WAY ROUND.
DA LINE COMES UP HERE. {stranger} HAB BIN PAID BY SOMEBODY TA SIT AN' WATCH IT AN' HAB NEVER BIN TOLD WHAT FOR, AN' HAB WORKED MOST OF IT OUT ANYWAY.
DA GRASS IZ GROWIN' DA WRONG WAY ROUND IN {A PERFECT CIRCLE|A CIRCLE|A RING}, AN' DA CIRCLE IZ NO CENTRED ON DA WELLHEAD!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: RESEAL IT PROPERLY WIT {qty} {material}.
OPEN IT.
READ DA GROUND AN' FIND WHERE DA LINE ACTUALLY RUNS!

seal.text:
DA CAP GOES BACK ON RIGHT DIS TIME, GASKETED, WIT DA {material} DOING DA WORK DA ORIGINAL CONTRACTOR WAZ PAID FOR AN' DID NO DO.
DA GRASS ROUND IT WILL TAKE A SEASON TA REMEMBER WHICH WAY UP IT GOES. DA CHEQUES KEEP COMIN' TA DA WATCHER, WHO IZ NOW WATCHIN' A WELLHEAD DAT IZ ACTUALLY SEALED, AN' SAYS SO, AN' PAYS {A SHARE|A SHARE OF IT|DA PARTY A SHARE}!

open.text: WHAT COMES UP IZ NO {OIL|OIL AT ALL|WHAT DA CAP WAZ FOR}, OR IZ OIL {IN DA WAY DAT A PERSON IZ MEAT|DA WAY A BODY IZ CHEMISTRY|ONLY IN DA SENSE DAT IT CAME OUT OF DA GROUND}!

line.text:
NO RUN WHERE DA SURVEY SAYS. IT RUNS UNDER {place} ITSELF, UNDER DA SCHOOL AN' DA MARKET AN' DA ROAD, WHICH IZ WHY EVERYTINK IN DAT TOWN HAB ALWAYS FELT LIKE IT IZ 'BOUT TA HAPPEN.
WHAT DAT MAP IZ WORTH DEPENDS ENTIRELY ON WHO IZ SHOWN IT, AN' DA PARTY IZ HOLDIN' DA ONLY {COPY|COPY DERE IZ|COPY ANYBODY HAB}!

linef.text:
DA GROUND SAYS FOUR DIFFERENT TINKZ IN FOUR DIFFERENT PLACES AN' NONE OF DEM AGREE, WHICH IZ WHAT LEYLINES DO TA ANYBODY WITOUT DA TRAININ'.
{leader} COMES AWAY WIT A HEADACHE DAT LASTS INTO DA NEXT DAY AN' A REAL CLEAR SENSE OF HAVIN' BIN {READ BACK|READ IN RETURN|LOOKED AT BY DA GROUND}!

seal_m.text:
DA CAP GOES BACK ON RIGHT DIS TIME, GASKETED, WIT DA {material} DOING DA WORK DA ORIGINAL CONTRACTOR WAZ PAID FOR AN' DID NO DO.
BOLTIN' IT DOWN, IT BECOMES OBVIOUS DA FLANGE IZ DRILLED FOR {TWELVE|SIXTEEN} BOLTS AN' HAB ONLY EVER HAB EIGHT IN IT, AN' DA FOUR DAT IZ MISSIN' IZ MISSIN' IN A PATTERN, ON DA SIDE DA CIRCLE OF GRASS IZ CENTRED ON!

choices.text: EIGHT BOLTS HELD IT BEFORE. FINISH AN' TAKE DA CHEQUE!
DRILL AN' FIT DA MISSIN' FOUR PROPERLY!
FIND OUT WHY SOMEBODY LEFT FOUR BOLTS OUT ON PURPOSE!

seal_bolts.text:
FOUR HOLES DRILLED THROUGH OLD FLANGE STEEL IN A WET FIELD TAKES {DA REST OF DA DAY|HOURS|A LONG AFTERNOON} AN' DA LAST ONE IZ DONE BY LAMP.
SIXTEEN BOLTS, TORQUED IN SEQUENCE. DA CIRCLE OF GRASS STARTS STRAIGHTENIN' OUT WITHIN {A FORTNIGHT|DA MONTH|WEEKS}, WHICH NOBODY PREDICTED AN' WHICH IZ REPORTED IN A LETTER DA PARTY NEVER SEES TA AN OFFICE DAT DOES NO ANSWER IT!

seal_shear.text:
DA THIRD HOLE GOES THROUGH INTO SOMETINK DAT IZ NO DA ANNULUS, AN' WHAT COMES BACK UP DA DRILL IZ {WARM|UNDER PRESSURE|MOVIN'}, AN' DA DRILL HAB TA BE LEFT IN DA HOLE TA PLUG IT.
DA CAP IZ FINISHED WIT EIGHT BOLTS AN' A DRILL BIT. DA CHEQUE CLEARS. DA CIRCLE OF GRASS IZ {ARM'S LENGTH AN' A BIT WIDER|LARGER|NOTICEABLY BIGGER} BY DA SPRING!

seal_why.text:
COZ DA FOUR BOLTS WOULD HAB CLOSED IT, AN' DA CONTRACTOR WAZ PAID TA LEAVE IT {BREATHIN'|OPEN A CRACK|ABLE TA VENT}, AN' DA PAYMENT CAME FROM SOMEBODY WHO WAZ NO DA COMPANY.
DAT IZ WORTH KNOWIN' AN' IZ WORTH MORE WRITTEN DOWN. DA PARTY SEALS IT PROPERLY ANYWAY, WHICH TAKES DA REST OF DA DAY, AN' POSTS DA REST OF IT TA {TWO|THREE} PLACES AT ONCE SO DAT IT NO CAN BE LOST!

open_m.text:
DA CAP COMES OFF IN {FOUR MINUTES|NO TIME|LESS TIME DEN SEALIN' IT WOULD TAKE} AN' DA SMELL ARRIVES BEFORE ANYTINK ELSE DOES: NO OIL, OR OIL {IN DA WAY DAT A PERSON IZ MEAT|DA WAY A BODY IZ CHEMISTRY|ONLY IN DA SENSE DAT IT CAME OUT OF DA GROUND}.
WHAT IZ IN DA SHAFT IZ NO COMIN' UP YET. IT IZ AWARE DAT DA CAP IZ OFF, WHICH IZ A DIFFERENT TINK, AN' DERE IZ A SHORT INTERVAL IN WHICH DA CAP COULD GO BACK ON!

choices.text: STAND OUR GROUND. WHATEVER COMES UP, COMES UP!
CAP IT AGAIN, NOW, AN' WEIGHT IT!
PUT A LIGHT DOWN DA SHAFT AN' SEE WHAT IZ ON DA WALLS!

open_recap.text:
DA CAP GOES BACK ON IN {NINETY SECONDS|UNDER A SHORT WHILE|A GREAT HURRY} WIT A COUPLE OF DEM ON IT AN' EVERYTINK HEAVY IN DA FIELD PILED ON TOP, WHICH IZ NO A SEAL AN' IZ A GREAT DEAL BETTER DEN NUTTIN'.
IT HOLDS. {stranger} STOPS TAKIN' DA MONEY FROM WHOEVER WAZ PAYIN' DEM AN' STARTS TAKIN' IT FROM DA PARTY INSTEAD, WHICH IZ A SMALLER AMOUNT AN' A CONSIDERABLY BETTER ARRANGEMENT FOR EVERYBODY!

open_shaft.text:
A LAMP ON A LINE, DOWN {FORTY METRES|A LONG WAY|AS FAR AS DA LINE GOES}, AN' DA WALLS OF DA SHAFT IZ DA BARE ROCK.
DEY IZ WORKED. CUT, BY HAND, IN A PATTERN DAT GOES ALL DA WAY DOWN, AN' IT IZ OLD, AN' DA WELLHEAD WAZ DRILLED THROUGH IT {FORTY YEARS AGO|IN DA FIFTIES|AT SOME POINT} BY PEOPLE WHO PLAINLY DECIDED NO TA WRITE DAT DOWN!

qe_grimoire.title: {DA SHELF IT WAZ LEFT ON|BAD SPELLIN'|DO NO LEAVE IT BESIDE ANYTINK}

n0.text:
A HOUSE CLEARANCE AT {place}, AN' {stranger} STANDIN' IN DA DOORWAY NO GOING BACK IN, HOLDIN' DA DOOR WIT A BOOT.
ON DA SHELF INSIDE DERE IZ A BOOK WIT A FORMULA IN IT WRITTEN WIT DA WORDS APART, AN' IT HAB BIN ON DAT SHELF BESIDE OTHER BOOKS FOR {timeAgo}.
DA BOOT IN DA DOOR IZ DERE COZ DA DOOR HAB CLOSED ON ITS OWN {TWICE|MORE DEN ONCE|TWICE OVER} ALREADY DIS MORNIN'!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BURN DA SHELF, DA LOT OF IT!
SORT DA CLEAN ONES OUT OF IT!
TAKE DA WHOLE SHELF TA SOMEBODY WHO WANTS IT!

burn2.text:
DA WHOLE SHELF GOES INTO DA YARD AN' GOES UP, AN' IT TAKES LONGER DEN PAPER SHOULD AN' MAKES A NOISE 'BOUT IT.
{stranger} WATCHES DA ENTIRE BURN FROM DA GATE AN' DOES NO GO BACK INTO DA HOUSE UNTIL DA ASH IZ COLD, AN' DEN PAYS DA PARTY IN CASH OUT OF {A TIN|A BISCUIT TIN|DA TIN ON DA MANTELPIECE}!

sort.text:
WORKIN' FROM DA FAR END INWARD, AHEAD OF DA SPREAD, {few} VOLUMES COME OFF CLEAN AN' ONE OF DEM IZ SOMEBODY'S WORKIN' NOTEBOOK, AN' IT IZ BETTER DEN DA GRIMOIRE EVER WAZ.
DA REST GOES ON DA FIRE AN' IT IZ {A CONSIDERABLE FIRE|A FIRE DA WHOLE STREET COMES OUT FOR|A BIGGER FIRE DEN DA SHELF ACCOUNTS FOR}!

sp2.text:
IT HAB BIN ON DAT SHELF {A LONG TIME|YEARS|LONGER DEN ANYBODY SAID} AN' IT HAB BIN BUSY.
DA FORMULA IZ IN DA PARTY'S OWN PACK BEFORE ANYBODY CHECKS, AN' EVERYTINK WRITTEN DOWN IN DERE HAB TA COME OUT AN' GO ON DA FIRE, INCLUDIN' {DA MAP|DA MAP, WHICH HURTS|A COUPLE OF MONTHS OF DA MAP}!

sell.text:
DERE IZ ALWAYS SOMEBODY WHO WANTS A SHELF LIKE DAT AN' NEVER ANY DIFFICULTY FINDIN' DEM, WHICH IZ DA TINK 'BOUT PEOPLE WHO WANT SHELVES LIKE DAT.
DA MONEY IZ {GOOD|BETTER DEN GOOD|MORE DEN DA JOB WAZ WORTH}. DA BUYER IZ DELIGHTED. NOBODY INVOLVED HAB DONE ANYTINK DAT WILL LOOK {WELL WRITTEN DOWN LATER|WELL IN WRITIN' AFTERWARDS|GOOD IN ANYBODY'S ACCOUNT OF IT}!

burn2_m.text:
GETTIN' DA SHELF OUT OF DA HOUSE MEANS GOING INTO DA HOUSE, AN' DA WHOLE SHELF COMES OUT IN {FOUR|THREE} ARMFULS WIT EVERYBODY HOLDIN' DEY BREATH IN A WAY NOBODY IZ PREPARED TA JUSTIFY.
ON DA LAST ARMFUL DA BOOK WIT DA WORDS APART IZ ON DA KITCHEN TABLE, {OPEN|FACE UP|AT DA SAME PAGE}, IN A ROOM NOBODY HAB BIN INTO!

choices.text: PUT IT ON DA PILE. BURN DA LOT!
DO IT PROPERLY. SALT, ORDER, DA WORDS SAID OVER IT!
LEAVE DA HOUSE. BURN DA HOUSE!

burn2_rite.text:
IT TAKES {AN HOUR|DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|LONGER DEN DA BURNIN' DOES} AN' MOST OF IT IZ SPENT STANDIN' STILL IN A KITCHEN SAYIN' DA SAME FOUR LINES IN DA CORRECT ORDER.
DA BOOK GOES ON DA FIRE LIKE A BOOK. {stranger} GOES BACK INTO DA HOUSE BEFORE DA ASH IZ COLD, WHICH DEY HAB NO BIN ABLE TA DO IN {A FORTNIGHT|A FEW WEEKS|SOME TIME}, AN' DA CLEARANCE IZ FINISHED BY THURSDAY!

burn2_wild.text:
DA WORDS IZ SAID IN A KITCHEN BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB READ 'BOUT IT, WHICH IZ NO DA SAME AS HAVIN' DONE IT, AN' 'BOUT HALFWAY THROUGH DA ROOM {GETS REAL COLD|GOES QUIET IN A SPECIFIC WAY|STOPS HAVIN' A DRAUGHT}.
DA SHELF BURNS. SO DOES DA BACK OF DA HOUSE, EVENTUALLY, WHICH EVERYBODY AGREES AFTERWARDS WAZ MAYBE-MAYBE NECESSARY AN' DEFINITELY NO WHAT WAZ PLANNED!

burn2_house.text:
DA DECISION IZ A LOOK, AN' DEN A CONVERSATION WIT {stranger} AT DA GATE DAT LASTS {A LONG STRETCH|MOST OF AN HOUR|LONGER DEN DA FIRE DOES}, AN' DEN AN INSURANCE QUESTION DAT RESOLVES ITSELF SURPRISINGLY CLEANLY.
DA HOUSE GOES. DA SHELF GOES WIT IT. NUTTIN' FROM INSIDE EVER TURNS UP IN A MARKET ANYWHERE, WHICH IZ NO TRUE OF ANY OF DA OTHER FIDDLY BITS!

sell_m.text:
DERE IZ ALWAYS SOMEBODY WHO WANTS A SHELF LIKE DAT AN' NEVER ANY DIFFICULTY FINDIN' DEM, WHICH IZ DA TINK 'BOUT PEOPLE WHO WANT SHELVES LIKE DAT.
DA ONE WHO COMES IZ {POLITE|EXTREMELY POLITE|WELL DRESSED AN' UNHURRIED}, PAYS IN CASH, COUNTS IT TWICE, AN' ASKS, AS AN AFTERTHOUGHT, WHETHER DA PARTY WOULD BE WILLIN' TA SAY WHERE IT CAME FROM AN' WHO LIVED DERE!

choices.text: TAKE DA MONEY. SAY NUTTIN' 'BOUT DA HOUSE!
TELL DEM. IT IZ ONLY AN ADDRESS!
FIND OUT WHO DEY IZ BUYIN' FOR FIRST!

sell_addr.text:
IT IZ ONLY AN ADDRESS, AN' IT IZ GIVEN, AN' DA MONEY IZ A LIL' BETTER FOR IT.
{stranger} HAB PEOPLE AT DAT HOUSE FOR DA REST OF DA MONTH: AT DA GATE, AT DA DOOR, {TWICE|MORE DEN ONCE|ON MORE DEN ONE OCCASION} IN DA GARDEN AFTER DARK, AN' NONE OF DEM WILL SAY WHO SENT DEM, AN' ALL OF DEM KNOW EXACTLY WHICH SHELF IT WAZ!

sell_who.text:
IT TAKES {A FEW QUESTIONS|TWO QUESTIONS AN' A SILENCE|ONE BADLY ANSWERED QUESTION} TA ESTABLISH DAT DA BUYER IZ NO A COLLECTOR, IZ NO GUILD, AN' IZ BUYIN' TA COMPLETE A SET DAT IZ {ONE LOUDNESS SHORT|MISSIN' ONE|NEARLY WHOLE}.
DAT IZ WORTH KNOWIN' AN' WORTH SELLIN' ON. DA SHELF GOES FOR DA ASKIN' PRICE. WHAT DA PARTY KNOWS 'BOUT DA SET GOES, {A WEEK LATER|SOME DAYS LATER|SHORTLY AFTERWARDS}, TA DA GUILD, FOR CONSIDERABLY MORE!

n0.text:
{stranger} AT {bar} IN {place} HAB AN OLD HANDSET ON DA TABLE, DA INDESTRUCTIBLE KIND, AN' IT HAB RUNG TWICE DIS EVENIN' WIT NO NETWORK ANYWHERE NEAR IT.
NOBODY HAB ANSWERED IT. DAT IZ A HOUSE RULE NOW, ARRIVED AT DEMOCRATICALLY, AN' DA SECOND RING EMPTIED DA FAR CORNER OF DA ROOM.
DA HOUSE RULE HAB A SECOND HALF NOBODY MENTIONS UNTIL DA PARTY ASKS: IT ALSO DOES NO GET TAKEN OUT OF {bar}!

asides.brave: {member} {STEPS UP FRONT WIT A WEAPON READY: "ME WILL TAKE POINT."|GRINS AN' RACKS DA SLIDE: "LETZ SEE WHAT WANTS TA DIE TODAY."|IZ ALREADY AT DA HATCH BEFORE ANYONE CAN ARGUE|STEPS OVER DA THRESHOLD WITOUT FLINCHIN'}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: ANSWER IT.
BUY IT OFF DEM.
GET IT RETUNED PROPERLY, {qty} {material} OF PARTS!

ansr.text:
IT IZ SOMEBODY'S GRANDMOTHER, AN' SHE DIED IN {timeAgo}, AN' SHE IZ NO CONFUSED 'BOUT DAT AT ALL AN' WOULD LIKE DA PARTY TA PASS SOMETINK ON.
WHAT SHE PASSES ON TAKES A LONG MINUTE, IZ ENTIRELY PRACTICAL, AN' SETTLES AN ARGUMENT IN A FAMILY IN {place} DAT HAB BIN RUNNIN' SINCE BEFORE {ANYBODY IN DA ROOM WAZ BORN|DA WAR|ANY OF DEM WAZ BORN}!

bad.text:
SOMETINK ANSWERS DAT IZ ENJOYIN' BEING ANSWERED.
IT ASKS {leader} A QUESTION BY NAME, WAITS, AN' HANGS UP FIRST, WHICH IZ DA PART DAT {STAYS WIT EVERYBODY|NOBODY GETS OVER|IZ STILL DERE IN DA MORNIN'}!

buy2.text:
DA WHOLE {bar} WATCHES DA MONEY CHANGE HANDS AN' DA WHOLE {bar} IZ VISIBLY RELIEVED, AN' SOMEBODY STANDS DA PARTY A ROUND ON DA STRENGTH OF IT.
IT IZ A TALISMAN AS MUCH AS A PHONE: NEAR IT, A LOOP SITS STILL AN' A FRACTURE STAYS SHUT, AN' IT RINGS WHEN IT WANTS TA!

tune.text:
RETUNED IT STOPS RINGIN' AT RANDOM AN' STARTS RINGIN' ON PURPOSE, WHICH IZ EITHER BETTER OR WORSE DEPENDIN' ON DA WEEK.
{bar} KEEPS IT ON A HOOK BEHIND DA TAPS AN' TREATS IT LIKE A FIRE EXTINGUISHER, AN' DA PARTY DRINKS DERE FREE FOR AS LONG AS {DA PLACE STANDS|DA DOORS IZ OPEN|DERE IZ A BAR DERE}!

buy_m.text:
DA WHOLE {bar} WATCHES DA MONEY COME OUT AN' DA WHOLE {bar} IZ VISIBLY RELIEVED, AN' DEN SOMEBODY AT DA END OF DA TAPS SAYS, INTO DEY GLASS, DAT DA LAST PERSON TA BUY IT BROUGHT IT BACK INSIDE {A WEEK|DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT|DA FORTNIGHT}.
DEY BROUGHT IT BACK, IZ DA PHRASIN', AN' DERE IZ A DIFFERENCE AN' EVERYBODY IN DA ROOM IZ LETTIN' IT SIT DERE!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{ASK WHAT HAPPENED TA DEM. GO ON.|NOBODY IZ FINISHIN' DAT SENTENCE.|WE IZ BUYIN' A PROBLEM WIT A HANDLE ON IT.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS DEY GLASS DOWN|TURNS ROUND ON DA STOOL TA FACE DA ROOM|ASKS DA BARMAN A QUESTION WIT DEY EYEBROWS}

choices.text: BUY IT ANYWAY.
ASK DA ROOM WHAT HAPPENED TA DA LAST BUYER!
BUY IT AN' LEAVE IT ON DA HOOK. OURS, BUT IT STAYS HERE!

buy_last.text:
IT COMES OUT SLOWLY AN' IN DA WRONG ORDER, DA WAY A ROOM TELLS A TINK IT HAB AGREED NO TA TELL: A NAME, A FORTNIGHT, A VAN FOUND AT {DA COAST|DA RESERVOIR|A PLACE DAT IZ NO ON DA WAY TA ANYWHERE}.
AN' DA DETAIL DAT MATTERS, WHICH IZ DAT IT STOPPED RINGIN' AT RANDOM FOR DEM AN' STARTED RINGIN' AT DA SAME TIME EVERY NIGHT. DA PARTY BUYS IT KNOWIN' DAT, WHICH IZ DA ONLY SENSIBLE WAY TA BUY IT!

buy_hook.text:
BOUGHT, PAID FOR, AN' HUNG STRAIGHT BACK ON ITS HOOK BEHIND DA TAPS WIT DA PARTY'S NAME AGAINST IT IN DA CELLAR BOOK.
IT RINGS {TWICE|TWICE OVER|MORE DEN ONCE} A WEEK FOR DA NEXT YEAR, AN' {bar} ANSWERS IT, AN' TAKES MESSAGES, AN' POSTS DEM ON. SOME OF DA MESSAGES IZ FOR DA PARTY. ALL OF DEM ARRIVE!

tune_m.text:
RETUNIN' IT TAKES {qty} {material}, A BENCH, AN' DA BETTER PART OF AN EVENIN' WIT DA WHOLE {bar} PRETENDIN' NO TA WATCH.
HALFWAY THROUGH IT BECOMES CLEAR DA HANDSET WAZ RETUNED ONCE BEFORE, BADLY, AN' DAT UNDERNEATH DA BAD TUNIN' DERE IZ AN ORIGINAL ONE, FACTORY, {STILL LIVE|INTACT|PERFECTLY GOOD}, POINTIN' AT SOMETINK DAT IZ NO DA EXCHANGE!

choices.text: TUNE IT TA DA EXCHANGE PROPERLY AN' BE DONE!
RESTORE DA FACTORY TUNIN' AN' SEE WHAT IT POINTS AT!
PULL DA TUNIN' STAGE OUT ENTIRELY. MAKE IT A PHONE AN' NUTTIN' ELSE!

tune_fact.text:
FACTORY TUNIN' RESTORED, DA HANDSET DOES NO RING. IT LISTENS, WHICH IZ A DIFFERENT POSTURE ENTIRELY AN' IZ OBVIOUS WITHIN A MINUTE OF WATCHIN' DA METER.
WHAT IT IZ LISTENIN' TA IZ {A LONG WAY OFF|NO NEARBY|SOMEWHERE WIT A LOT OF SPACE AROUND IT} AN' IZ BROADCASTIN' A LIST, SLOWLY, ON A LOOP, AN' ONE OF DA TINKZ ON DA LIST IZ A ROAD DA PARTY HAB DRIVEN!

tune_dead.text:
DA TUNIN' STAGE COMES OUT AN' GOES IN DA BIN, AN' AFTER DAT IT IZ A HANDSET WIT A WIRE AN' NUTTIN' ELSE, AN' IT NEVER RINGS AGAIN.
{bar} IZ {RELIEVED|DELIGHTED|QUIETLY GRATEFUL} AN' SAYS SO WIT A TAB DAT STAYS OPEN FOR LONGER DEN DA PARTY IZ IN TOWN. NOBODY IN DA ROOM MENTIONS DAT DA LIST OF TINKZ IT MIGHT HAB SAID IZ NOW PERMANENTLY UNAVAILABLE!

qe_flood.title: {SANDBAGS|DA WATER IZ COMIN' UP THROUGH DA FLOOR|BY MORNIN'}

n0.text:
DA WATER IZ COMIN' UP THROUGH DA FLOORS ON {street} IN {place} FROM BELOW, AN' IT HAB BIN RISIN' SINCE FIRST LIGHT.
DERE IZ {many} HOUSES ON DAT ROW AN' 'BOUT A THIRD AS MANY PEOPLE TA DO ANYTINK 'BOUT IT. {stranger} IZ FILLIN' BAGS OFF DA PILE WIT DA WRONG SHOVEL AN' WILL NO STOP LONG ENOUGH TA BE GIVEN A BETTER ONE.
SOMEBODY'S CHEST FREEZER HAB COME UP THROUGH A KITCHEN FLOOR AT DA LOW END AN' IZ GOING ROUND IN DA CURRENT LIKE A BOAT WIT NOWHERE TA BE!

asides.nurturing: {member} HAB TAKEN ONE END OF A BAG BEFORE ANYBODY AGREES ANYTINK!
asides.calm: {member} SENDS DA FIRST FOUR PEOPLE DEY CAN FIND TA DA TOP OF DA ROW INSTEAD OF DA BOTTOM, AN' IZ RIGHT!
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BAGS, ALL NIGHT.
GIVE {qty} {material} TA PLUG IT AT DA SOURCE!
GET DA PEOPLE OUT AN' LET DA HOUSES GO!

held.text:
DA ROW HOLDS. IT HOLDS AT 'BOUT {FOUR|HALF THREE|FIVE} IN DA MORNIN', AN' DA LAST BAG GOES ON AT A POINT WHERE NOBODY HAB ANYTINK LEFT, AN' DEN IT HOLDS.
IN DA LIGHT EVERYBODY SITS DOWN IN DA MUD AT DA SAME TIME. SOMEBODY'S MOTHER GOES DOWN DA ROW WIT TEA AN' DOES NO ACCEPT {ANY REFUSALS|A SINGLE REFUSAL|NO FOR AN ANSWER}!

lost2.text:
IT GOES AT DA LOW END AT 'BOUT THREE AN' TAKES {few} HOUSES WIT IT, AN' DA REST OF DA NIGHT IZ CARRYIN' FURNITURE UPSTAIRS IN DA DARK.
NOBODY BLAMES ANYBODY. EVERYBODY LOOKS LIKE DEY MIGHT, FOR A WHILE, WHICH IZ {WORSE|DA HARDER PART|WORSE DEN BEING BLAMED}!

src.text:
IT IZ A CULVERT SOMEBODY BUILT OVER {timeAgo} AN' NOBODY HAB LOOKED AT SINCE, AN' DA {material} PLUGS DA MOUTH OF IT IN AN HOUR AN' A HALF BY LAMPLIGHT.
DA WATER STOPS RISIN' WHILE PEOPLE IZ STILL FILLIN' BAGS, AN' IT TAKES DA ROW {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|A WHILE} TA BELIEVE IT!

evac.text:
EVERYBODY OUT, {UP DA HILL|ONTO DA HIGH ROAD|TA DA CHURCH, WHICH IZ DA HIGH GROUND}, WIT WHAT DEY CAN CARRY AN' DA ANIMALS LOOSE BEHIND DEM.
DA ROW GOES. NOBODY DROWNS, WHICH WAZ DA ACTUAL QUESTION ALL ALONG, AN' DERE IZ A DIFFERENCE BETWEEN DOZE TWO FACTS DAT TAKES PEOPLE {A FEW WEEKS|DA WINTER|MONTHS} TA FEEL!

src_m.text:
IT IZ A CULVERT SOMEBODY BUILT OVER {timeAgo} AN' NOBODY HAB LOOKED AT SINCE, AN' ITS MOUTH IZ UNDER {TWO METRES|DA BEST PART OF TWO METRES|A GOOD DEPTH} OF MOVIN' WATER AT DA LOW END OF DA ROW.
PLUGGIN' IT MEANS GOING DOWN TA IT. DA {material} IZ IN DA PACK AN' DA LAMPS IZ ON DA BANK AN' EVERYBODY IZ NOW LOOKIN' AT WHOEVER IN DA PARTY IZ DA STRONGEST SWIMMER!

choices.text: PLUG IT FROM DA BANK WIT POLES AN' HOPE!
GO DOWN AN' DO IT BY HAND!
BLOW DA FAR END OPEN INSTEAD AN' LET IT DRAIN DA OTHER WAY!

src_dive.text:
THREE DIVES BY LAMPLIGHT INTO WATER DAT IZ {GOING SOMEWHERE|MOVIN' HARD|PULLIN'}, WIT A LINE ON DA WAIST AN' SOMEBODY COUNTIN' ON DA BANK EACH TIME.
DA MOUTH TAKES DA PLUG ON DA THIRD. DA WATER STOPS RISIN' WHILE PEOPLE IZ STILL FILLIN' BAGS WIT IT, AN' DA ROW IZ DRY BY MORNIN', AN' NOBODY ON DAT STREET EVER PAYS FOR A DRINK IN DA PARTY'S COMPANY AGAIN!

src_caught.text:
DA SECOND DIVE GOES IN SLIGHTLY WRONG AN' DA CULVERT MOUTH IZ EXACTLY AS INTERESTED IN A PERSON AS IT IZ IN A STREET'S WORTH OF WATER.
DA LINE HOLDS. DA PARTY ON DA BANK GET {leader} BACK UP IN {NINE SECONDS|UNDER A MINUTE|A REAL LONG FIFTEEN SECONDS} AN' DA PLUG GOES IN FROM DA BANK WIT POLES LIKE IT SHOULD HAB FROM DA START. DA ROW HOLDS. NOBODY SLEEPS!

src_blow.text:
DA FAR END OF DA CULVERT COMES OUT UNDER {A CAR PARK|DA OLD YARD|A WALL NOBODY OWNS}, AN' OPENIN' IT IZ A MATTER OF {A LIL' CHARGE|ONE CHARGE|REAL LIL', CORRECTLY PLACED}.
IT GOES AT {TWO IN DA MORNIN'|HALF TWO|SOME HOUR} WIT A NOISE DA WHOLE TOWN HEARS AN' A FOUNTAIN NOBODY EXPECTED, AN' AFTER DAT DA WATER HAB SOMEWHERE TA BE DAT IZ NO ANYBODY'S KITCHEN. DA COUNCIL SPENDS {MOST OF A SEASON|A SEASON|DA REST OF DA YEAR} ARGUIN' 'BOUT WHO TA BILL!

evac_m.text:
EVERYBODY OUT, {UP DA HILL|ONTO DA HIGH ROAD|TA DA CHURCH, WHICH IZ DA HIGH GROUND}, WIT WHAT DEY CAN CARRY AN' DA ANIMALS LOOSE BEHIND DEM.
AT DA TOP OF DA ROAD, COUNTIN' HEADS AGAINST A LIST SOMEBODY HAB MADE ON DA BACK OF AN ENVELOPE, DA COUNT COMES UP {ONE SHORT|SHORT BY ONE|ONE DOWN}, AN' DA NAME IT IZ SHORT BY LIVES AT DA LOW END!

choices.text: GO BACK DOWN FOR DEM.
GET ON A ROOF AN' FIND OUT WHERE DEY IZ FIRST!
NOBODY GOES BACK DOWN. DAT IZ DA RULE!

evac_back.text:
DA LOW END IZ CHEST DEEP AN' MOVIN', AN' DA DOOR IZ SHUT, AN' DA DOOR OPENS INWARD, WHICH IN {ARM'S LENGTH AN' A BIT|A DEPTH LIKE DAT|WATER LIKE DAT} MEANS IT DOES NO OPEN.
DA WINDOW GOES IN. DEY IZ UPSTAIRS, ON A BED, WIT A CAT AN' A BISCUIT TIN, AN' ENTIRELY FURIOUS 'BOUT BEING CARRIED. ALL THREE COME OUT. DA CAT OBJECTS FOR DA WHOLE OF DA FOLLOWIN' WEEK!

evac_spot.text:
FROM DA CHURCH ROOF WIT A LAMP IT TAKES {A SHORT WHILE|TWO SWEEPS|NO TIME} TA FIND DA UPSTAIRS WINDOW WIT SOMEBODY WAVIN' A TEA TOWEL OUT OF IT.
DAT IZ DA DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A RESCUE AN' A SEARCH: A COUPLE OF DEM GO TA ONE HOUSE INSTEAD OF ELEVEN PEOPLE GOING TA ELEVEN, AN' EVERYBODY IZ ON DA HIGH ROAD BY {TWO|HALF ONE|AN HOUR NOBODY REMEMBERS}!

n0.text:
DERE IZ A BOREHOLE IN DA GROUND NEAR {place}, CAPPED, AN' DA CAP HAB BIN REDONE {few} TIMES BY DIFFERENT HANDS OVER DA YEARS, EACH ONE HEAVIER DEN DA LAST.
{stranger} IZ MINDIN' IT OUT OF A HUT WIT A FLASK AN' NO PARTICULAR AUTHORITY, AN' IZ NO FACIN' OUTWARD.
EACH CAP HAB A DATE STAMPED IN IT AN' DA GAPS BETWEEN DA DATES IZ GETTIN' {SHORTER|SMALLER|NOTICEABLY SHORTER}!

asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: REWELD IT, {qty} {material} OF ROD.
LISTEN AT IT.
TAKE DA WATCH FOR A NIGHT SO SOMEBODY CAN SLEEP!

weld.text:
DA FIFTH CAP GOES ON OVER DA FOURTH AN' IT IZ {DA BEST OF DEM|BETTER DEN DA FOUR UNDER IT|DA FIRST ONE DONE BY SOMEBODY WHO WANTED IT TA HOLD}, DONE PROPERLY, WIT DA ROD DA PARTY CARRIED IN.
DA MINDER WATCHES EVERY PASS OF IT AN' AFTERWARDS SITS DOWN FOR DA FIRST TIME IN DA CONVERSATION. WHATEVER IZ DOWN DERE IZ A GOOD DEAL FURTHER AWAY DEN IT WAZ {DIS MORNIN'|AT BREAKFAST|WHEN DA PARTY WALKED UP}!

lis.text:
DERE IZ A SOUND AT DA CAP, TOO REGULAR FOR {WATER|ROCK} OR SETTLIN'. IT IZ A LONG WAY DOWN, AN' IT IZ GETTIN' TA DA TOP OF DA SHAFT SLIGHTLY FASTER DEN IT DID ON DA PREVIOUS MEASUREMENT.
SOMEBODY AT A DESK SOMEWHERE HAB DAT MEASUREMENT IN A FILE AN' HAB DECIDED NO TA BE DA PERSON WHO SAYS IT {OUT LOUD|FIRST|AT ALL}!

lisf.text:
WHATEVER IZ DOWN DERE HEARS DA LISTENIN'.
IT STOPS, ALL AT ONCE, FOR AS LONG AS DA EAR IZ ON DA PLATE, AN' STARTS AGAIN DA MOMENT IT COMES OFF, AN' {leader} DOES NO SLEEP WELL FOR {A WHILE|SOME NIGHTS|DA REST OF DA SEASON}!

watch.text:
A NIGHT IN A HUT WIT A FLASK AN' A CHAIR FACIN' DA WRONG WAY, LISTENIN' TA NUTTIN' FOR {ELEVEN|NINE|TEN} HOURS.
DA MINDER SLEEPS FOR DA FIRST TIME IN A FORTNIGHT, IN A BED, IN A HOUSE, AN' COMES BACK AT DAWN WIT BREAKFAST FOR EVERYBODY AN' AN OLD STORY DAT IZ NO IN {ANY ARCHIVE|ANY FILE ANYWHERE|DA RECORD}!

weld_m.text:
DA FIFTH CAP GOES ON OVER DA FOURTH AN' DA ROD DA PARTY CARRIED IN IZ GOOD ROD, AN' DA JOB IZ {HALF A SHIFT|AN AFTERNOON|MOST OF DA LIGHT} OF KNEELIN' ON A STEEL PLATE IN {weather}.
HALF WAY ROUND DA RUN, DA PLATE UNDER DA KNEES {MOVES|GIVES SLIGHTLY|ANSWERS}, ONCE, IN A WAY DAT HAB NUTTIN' TA DO WIT ANYBODY'S WEIGHT ON IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{DAT WAZ NO SETTLIN'.|FIVE CAPS. FIVE. ASK YOURSELF WHY.|WE IZ WELDIN' A LID, NO A HOLE.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS A HAND FLAT ON DA PLATE AN' KEEPS IT DERE|LOOKS AT DA MINDER, WHO IZ LOOKIN' AT DA HUT|CARRIES ON HOLDIN' DA ROD}

choices.text: FINISH DA WELD AN' DO NO MENTION IT!
WELD IT, AN' ADD A STRONGBACK ACROSS DA WHOLE CAP!
STOP WELDIN'. GET DA PLATE OFF AN' LOOK!

weld_back.text:
A STRONGBACK IZ {TWO LENGTHS|A CROSS|FOUR PIECES} OF DA HEAVIEST SECTION IN DA PACK, WELDED ACROSS DA CAP AN' OUT ONTO DA COLLAR, WHICH TURNS A LID INTO A STRUCTURE.
IT IZ OVER-ENGINEERED AN' EVERYBODY KNOWS IT AN' NOBODY SAYS SO. DA MINDER PUTS DA FLASK DOWN FOR DA FIRST TIME ALL DAY, AN' DA PARTY IZ PAID OUT OF A TIN DAT WAZ CLEARLY BEING KEPT FOR SOMETINK!

weld_crack.text:
A STRONGBACK WELDED ONTO COLD PLATE IN {weather} PUTS DA STRESS WHERE DA STRESS WAZ NO, AN' DA CAP CRACKS ALONG DA FOURTH WELD WHILE EVERYBODY IZ WATCHIN' IT COOL.
IT IZ {A HAIRLINE|FOUR INCHES|A CRACK YOU COULD LOSE A COIN IN}. IT IZ RE-WELDED BY MORNIN' BY DA MINDER ALONE, BADLY, AN' DA SIXTH CAP GOES ON DA FOLLOWIN' SPRING, WHICH IZ SOONER DEN ANY OF DA OTHERS!

watch_m.text:
A NIGHT IN A HUT WIT A FLASK AN' A CHAIR FACIN' DA WRONG WAY, AN' DA MINDER ASLEEP IN A BED IN A HOUSE FOR DA FIRST TIME IN {A FORTNIGHT|THREE WEEKS|SOME TIME}.
AT 'BOUT {TWO|HALF ONE|DA DEAD HOUR} DA SOUND AT DA CAP CHANGES: IT DOES DA REGULAR TINK, AN' DEN IT DOES DA REGULAR TINK {TWICE AS FAST|OUT OF STEP|WIT AN EXTRA BEAT IN IT}, AN' DEN IT GOES BACK!

choices.text: NOTE DA HOUR IN DA BOOK AN' KEEP SITTIN'!
TIME IT PROPERLY FOR DA REST OF DA NIGHT!
GO AN' WAKE DA MINDER.

watch_time.text:
SIX HOURS WIT A WATCH AN' A PENCIL PRODUCES {A COUPLE OF PAGES|A COLUMN|A PAGE} OF FIGURES, AN' DA FIGURES IZ NO RANDOM: DERE IZ A PATTERN, AN' DA PATTERN HAB A PERIOD, AN' DA PERIOD IZ {DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT|A FORTNIGHT|A WEEK AN' A BIT} LONG.
DA MINDER'S BOOK GOES BACK {FORTY YEARS|DECADES|A REAL LONG WAY}. LAID AGAINST IT, DA PARTY'S SIX HOURS TURN DA WHOLE ARCHIVE FROM A SUPERSTITION INTO A DATASET, AN' SOMEBODY WILL PAY FOR DAT!

watch_wake.text:
WAKIN' SOMEBODY WHO HAB NO SLEPT IN A FORTNIGHT TA TELL DEM A NOISE DID SOMETINK SLIGHTLY UNUSUAL IZ {A DECISION|A CALL|A TINK YOU ONLY DO ONCE}, AN' IT IZ MADE, AN' DEY COME OUT IN A COAT OVER NUTTIN' AT {TWO IN DA MORNIN'|DA DEAD HOUR|WHATEVER TIME IT IZ}.
DEY LISTEN FOR NINE MINUTES. DEY SAY: YES. DEN DEY GO AN' SIT IN DA HUT AN' DO NO GO BACK TA BED, AN' DA PARTY HAB TAKEN DA ONLY NIGHT OFF DAT MINDER WAZ GOING TA GET DIS YEAR!

qe_hauler.title: {UNDER EIGHTY ALL DA WAY|DA LOAD DAT NO CAN STOP|RELIEF DRIVER}

n0.text:
A HAULER IZ STOPPED ON DA HARD SHOULDER OUTSIDE {place} WIT DA HAZARDS GOING AN' {stranger} ASLEEP AGAINST DA WHEEL IN DA WAY OF SOMEBODY WHO HAB FOUGHT IT AN' LOST.
DA LOAD HAB TA BE SOMEWHERE BY FIRST LIGHT AN' DA ROUTE HAB {few} MARKED BUBBLES ON IT, AN' NEITHER OF DOZE FACTS IZ GOING TA NEGOTIATE.
DA LOAD IZ SHEETED AN' ROPED AN' DA ROPES IZ {NEW|NEWER DEN DA SHEET|NO DA SAME ROPES DAT LEFT DA DEPOT}!

asides.loyal: {member} {POSITIONS THEMSELVES BETWEEN {leader} AN' DA DOOR|NODS FIRMLY: "RIGHT BEHIND YOU, BOSS."|KEEPS A WATCHFUL EYE ON {leader}'S BLIND SPOT|STANDS READY TA BACK UP WHATEVER CALL IZ MADE}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: DRIVE IT. RELIEF FOR DA LAST LEG!
SIT IN DA CAB AN' KEEP DEM TALKIN' TA DA DEPOT!
NO DA PARTY'S LOAD AN' NO DA PARTY'S LICENCE!

drv.text:
IT IZ {distance}, HOLDIN' A HEAVY TINK UNDER EIGHTY PAST MARKED GROUND WIT SOMEBODY ASLEEP IN DA BUNK BEHIND, AN' IT IZ DA MOST CONCENTRATED HALF A SHIFT ANYBODY HAB SPENT DIS MONTH.
DA DEPOT SIGNS FOR IT ON DA HOUR, EXACTLY. DA SOCIETY PAYS RELIEF RATES, AN' RELIEF RATES IZ NO WHAT ANYBODY EXPECTS!

drf.text:
DA SPEEDO GETS AWAY ON A DOWNGRADE FOR 'BOUT {FOUR|THREE|FIVE} SECONDS AN' FOUR SECONDS IZ PLENTY.
CORRECTIN' IT COSTS DA LOAD A PALLET AN' DA PARTY'S NERVES DA REST OF DA DAY, AN' DA DEPOT IZ LATE, AN' DA SIGN-OFF HAPPENS ANYWAY WIT EVERYBODY BEING {REAL POLITE 'BOUT IT|EXTREMELY POLITE|CAREFUL 'BOUT IT}!

talk.text:
{FOUR|FIVE|THREE} HOURS IN A CAB WIT A FLASK, KEEPIN' SOMEBODY AWAKE BY MAKIN' DEM DESCRIBE EVERY DEPOT BETWEEN HERE AN' DA COAST.
BY DA END DERE IZ A NAME FOR EVERY STOP ON DAT ROUTE, WHICH OF DEM WILL LET YOU SLEEP IN DA YARD, AN' WHICH OF DEM OWES DA SOCIETY A FAVOUR DAT CAN BE {SIGNED OVER|CALLED IN|PASSED ON}!

no.text:
DA HAZARDS IZ STILL GOING IN DA MIRROR {A LONG WAY DOWN DA ROAD|MOST OF DA WAY TA DA NEXT JUNCTION|FOR LONGER DEN ANYBODY WATCHES}.
WHETHER DEY MADE IT IZ A TINK DA PARTY NEVER FINDS OUT, WHICH IZ DA ORDINARY CONDITION OF MOST OF DA GOOD ONE MIGHT HAB DONE!

drv_m.text:
DA CAB IZ WARM, DA SEAT IZ SOMEBODY ELSE'S SHAPE, AN' DA GEARBOX HAB {A THIRD|A SECOND|ONE GEAR} DAT NEEDS ASKIN' TWICE.
THIRTY KILOMETRES IN, DA LOAD SHIFTS {A HAND'S WIDTH|AN INCH|ENOUGH TA FEEL THROUGH DA WHEEL}, ON A BEND, IN A WAY DAT A SHEETED AN' ROPED LOAD HAB NO BUSINESS DOING!

choices.text: KEEP GOING. IT WILL HOLD TA DA DEPOT!
PULL IN AN' RE-ROPE DA WHOLE TINK!
PULL IN AN' LOOK UNDER DA SHEET!

drv_rope.text:
FORTY MINUTES IN A LAYBY IN {weather} WIT DA HAZARDS GOING, DOING A JOB PROPERLY DAT SOMEBODY DID BADLY IN A HURRY AT {FOUR IN DA MORNIN'|DA START OF DA SHIFT|A DEPOT TWO HUNDRED KILOMETRES BACK}.
DA LOAD DOES NO MOVE AGAIN. DA DEPOT SIGNS FOR IT ON DA HOUR AN' DA SIGN-OFF HAB DA PARTY'S NAME ON IT, AN' DAT NAME GOES ON A LIST OF PEOPLE DA DEPOT RINGS FIRST!

drv_sheet.text:
UNDER DA SHEET DA LOAD IZ {FOUR|FIVE} PALLETS OF SOMETINK LEGITIMATE AN' ONE DAT IZ NO ON DA MANIFEST, AN' DA ONE DAT IZ NO IZ WHERE DA MOVEMENT IZ COMIN' FROM, AN' IT IZ MOVIN' COZ DERE IZ {SOMETINK|AN ANIMAL|WEIGHT} ALIVE IN IT.
DA REST OF DA DRIVE IZ DONE AT DA SPEED LIMIT WIT DA RADIO OFF. WHAT IZ IN DA PALLET IZ SOMEBODY ELSE'S BUSINESS RIGHT UP UNTIL DA DEPOT, AT WHICH POINT IT REAL RAPIDLY BECOMES SEVERAL PEOPLE'S!

no_m.text:
DA HAZARDS IZ STILL GOING IN DA MIRROR {A LONG WAY DOWN DA ROAD|MOST OF DA WAY TA DA NEXT JUNCTION|FOR LONGER DEN ANYBODY WATCHES}.
AT DA NEXT JUNCTION DERE IZ A PHONE BOX DAT WORKS, AN' A DEPOT NUMBER PAINTED ON DA BACK OF EVERY HAULER ON DIS ROAD, INCLUDIN' DAT ONE, {LEGIBLE FROM HERE|READABLE IN DA MIRROR|BIG ENOUGH TA HAB READ}!

choices.text: DRIVE ON.
RING DA DEPOT FROM DA BOX!
RING DA DEPOT, DEN GO BACK AN' SIT WIT DEM!

no_ring.text:
IT TAKES {A SHORT WHILE|TWO MINUTES|ONE COIN} AN' A NIGHT CLERK WHO IZ AWAKE AN' UNSURPRISED AN' ALREADY REACHIN' FOR A DIFFERENT PHONE.
RELIEF IZ ON DA ROAD INSIDE DA HOUR. DA PARTY NEVER FINDS OUT DA DRIVER'S NAME, AN' DA PARTY'S OWN DESCRIPTION GOES INTO DA DEPOT'S BOOK AGAINST DA WORDS {"PHONED IT IN"|"CALLED IT"|"RANG FROM DA JUNCTION"}, WHICH IZ WORTH MORE ON DAT ROAD DEN MOST TINKZ!

no_back.text:
RINGIN' IT IN TAKES FOUR MINUTES. GOING BACK TAKES {TWENTY|FIFTEEN}, AN' SITTIN' IN A COLD CAB WIT SOMEBODY WHO IZ TOO TIRED TA BE EMBARRASSED TAKES DA REST OF DA NIGHT.
BY DA TIME RELIEF ARRIVES DA PARTY KNOWS EVERY DEPOT BETWEEN HERE AN' DA COAST, WHICH OF DEM WILL LET YOU SLEEP, AN' WHY {stranger} HAB BIN DRIVIN' ON NO SLEEP FOR A COUPLE OF DAYS, AN' DAT LAST ONE IZ A STORY DAT GOES SOMEWHERE!

qe_saint.title: {DA RELIQUARY|{saint} IZ MISSIN' A HAND|FEAST DAY IZ THURSDAY}

n0.text:
DA RELIQUARY AT {place} IZ OPEN AN' LIGHT AN' DA WRONG WEIGHT, AN' DA FEAST IZ ON THURSDAY.
{stranger} HAB TOLD NOBODY YET AN' IZ STANDIN' IN DA SACRISTY WORKIN' OUT WHETHER TELLIN' NOBODY IZ A SIN ON ITS OWN. DA LOCK WAZ NO FORCED. DAT IZ DA PART DAT HAB TAKEN DA COLOUR OUT OF DEY FACE.
DA SEAL ON DA RELIQUARY WAZ LIFTED WIT {SOMETINK THIN|A BLADE|A PAPER KNIFE} AN' PUT BACK, AN' IT HAB BIN PUT BACK REAL SLIGHTLY CROOKED!

asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: FIND IT BEFORE THURSDAY.
MAKE A REPLACEMENT NOBODY WILL QUESTION!
TELL DEM TA ANNOUNCE IT FROM DA ALTAR!

fnd2.text:
IT HAB NO LEFT {DA BUILDIN'|DA SACRISTY|DA PARISH}. IT IZ IN A DRAWER IN A ROOM DAT IZ USED BY ONE PERSON, WRAPPED IN A CLOTH, WIT A NOTE DAT IZ HALFWAY TA BEING A CONFESSION AN' DOES NO GET FINISHED.
IT GOES BACK ON DA VELVET BEFORE THURSDAY. NOBODY IZ NAMED. DA PARTY IZ ASKED FOR NUTTIN' AN' GIVEN {A GREAT DEAL|MORE DEN DEY CAME WIT|EVERYTINK DA PARISH CAN SPARE}!

nof2.text:
THURSDAY COMES AN' DA RELIQUARY IZ CARRIED ROUND DA SQUARE AT DA CORRECT PACE BY {SIX|EIGHT} MEN WHO DO NO KNOW WHAT DEY IZ CARRYIN'.
IT IZ A GOOD FEAST. EVERYBODY SAYS SO. DA SACRISTAN DOES NO {EAT|EAT A TINK|TOUCH ANYTINK}!

fake.text:
IT TAKES AN EVENIN' AN' {qty} {material} AN' A GREAT DEAL OF CARE 'BOUT DA COLOUR, AN' ON DA VELVET UNDER GLASS AT A FEW PACES IT IZ BEYOND QUESTION.
DA PROCESSION GOES ROUND DA SQUARE AN' DA TOWN GETS ITS THURSDAY. WHAT DA PARTY IZ LEFT HOLDIN' IZ DA KNOWLEDGE, WHICH IZ HEAVIER DEN DA RELIC WAZ!

tell.text:
IT IZ ANNOUNCED FROM DA ALTAR ON DA SUNDAY, PLAINLY, WITOUT AN EXCUSE ATTACHED, AN' DA SQUARE GOES REAL QUIET AN' DEN DOES NO FALL APART.
BY THURSDAY SOMEBODY HAB LEFT IT IN DA PORCH OVERNIGHT IN {A SHOEBOX|A BISCUIT TIN|A BAG WIT A SHOP'S NAME ON IT}, WHICH IZ HOW DEZE TINKZ HAB {ALWAYS ACTUALLY BIN RESOLVED|GENERALLY BIN RESOLVED|BIN SETTLED SINCE ANYBODY CAN REMEMBER}!

fake_m.text:
IT TAKES AN EVENIN' AN' {qty} {material} AN' A GREAT DEAL OF CARE 'BOUT DA COLOUR, AN' ON DA VELVET UNDER GLASS AT THREE PACES IT IZ BEYOND QUESTION.
AT ONE PACE IT IZ NO, AN' DA SACRISTAN KNOWS DAT, AN' ASKS DA ONLY QUESTION DAT MATTERS IN A VOICE DAT HAB STOPPED PRETENDIN': DOES DA PARTY INTEND TA TELL ANYBODY, EVER!

choices.text: NO. NOBODY. IT STAYS BETWEEN DA THREE OF US!
YES. AFTER DA FEAST. IT GETS WRITTEN DOWN!
MAKE DA COPY GOOD AT ONE PACE, NO THREE!

fake_record.text:
DA PROCESSION GOES ROUND DA SQUARE, DA TOWN GETS ITS THURSDAY, AN' ON DA FRIDAY A LETTER GOES TA DA DIOCESE WIT {FOUR NAMES|EVERYBODY'S NAME|ALL OF IT} ON IT AN' DA COPY IZ SURRENDERED WIT IT.
IT IZ DA WORST POSSIBLE OUTCOME FOR EVERYBODY'S COMFORT AN' DA BEST AVAILABLE ONE FOR DA RECORD, AN' DA DIOCESE, AFTER {A COUPLE OF YEARS|A LONG CORRESPONDENCE|MOST OF A YEAR}, SAYS SO IN WRITIN'!

fake_perfect.text:
DONE PROPERLY IT IZ {THREE EVENINGS|DA REST OF DA WEEK|A GREAT DEAL LONGER}, WIT DA RIGHT MATERIALS FETCHED FROM {TWO TOWNS|A LONG WAY|SOMEWHERE DAT ASKS NO QUESTIONS} AN' DA AGEIN' DONE BY HAND.
AT ONE PACE IT IZ BEYOND QUESTION. AT ONE PACE WIT A GLASS IT IZ BEYOND QUESTION. DA SACRISTAN HANDLES IT FOR DA PROCESSION AN' DOES NO SHAKE, AN' DA PARTY IZ PAID OUT OF DA PARISH'S OWN MONEY WIT DA CHURCHWARDEN PRESENT AN' CHEERFUL!

fake_caught.text:
IT IZ GOOD AT THREE PACES AN' AT ONE PACE IT IZ A PIECE OF {material} WIT PAINT ON IT, AN' DA BISHOP'S MAN, WHO WAZ NO EXPECTED, {PICKS IT UP|HANDLES IT|TURNS IT OVER} ON DA WEDNESDAY.
DA FEAST HAPPENS. SO DOES EVERYTINK AFTER DA FEAST, WHICH INVOLVES DA SACRISTAN, DA PARTY, A ROOM IN DA PRESBYTERY, AN' A CONVERSATION DAT LASTS {A COUPLE OF HOURS|MOST OF A DAY|UNTIL IT GETS DARK}!

tell_m.text:
IT IZ ANNOUNCED FROM DA ALTAR ON DA SUNDAY, PLAINLY, WITOUT AN EXCUSE ATTACHED, AN' DA SQUARE GOES REAL QUIET AN' DEN DOES NO FALL APART.
WHAT HAPPENS NEXT IZ DAT {FOUR|FIVE|A GOOD MANY} PEOPLE COME TA DA SACRISTY OVER DA FOLLOWIN' DAYS TA SAY SOMETINK, AN' BY TUESDAY IT IZ CLEAR DAT TWO OF DEM IZ SAYIN' DA SAME TINK 'BOUT DA SAME PERSON AN' NEITHER KNOWS DA OTHER HAB COME!

choices.text: WAIT. IT WILL COME BACK ON ITS OWN!
PUT DA TWO ACCOUNTS TOGETHER AN' GO AN' SEE DA PERSON!
GIVE BOTH NAMES TA DA SACRISTAN AN' STAY OUT OF IT!

tell_person.text:
DEY IZ {EIGHTY|REAL OLD|NO WELL} AN' DEY TOOK IT COZ DEY WAZ FRIGHTENED OF THURSDAY, WHICH TURNS OUT TA BE A WHOLE STORY OF ITS OWN GOING BACK {SIXTY YEARS|A REAL LONG WAY|TA BEFORE DA WAR}.
IT COMES BACK ON DA WEDNESDAY IN DA PARTY'S OWN HANDS WIT NOBODY ELSE TOLD. DA SACRISTAN'S NOTE, DA HALF-CONFESSION DAT WAZ NEVER FINISHED, GOES ON DA FIRE IN DA SACRISTY GRATE WIT BOTH OF DEM WATCHIN'!

tell_hand.text:
TWO NAMES ON A PIECE OF PAPER HANDED OVER AT DA SACRISTY DOOR, AN' DEN DA PARTY GOES, WHICH IZ DEFENSIBLE AN' IZ NO COMFORTABLE.
IT IZ DEALT WIT {PAROCHIALLY|INSIDE DA PARISH|QUIETLY}. DA RELIQUARY IZ ON DA ALTAR BY THURSDAY. SOMEBODY IN DAT TOWN DOES NO COME TA MASS AGAIN, AN' DA PARTY NEVER FINDS OUT WHICH OF DA TWO NAMES IT WAZ!

qe_fence.title: {DA BACK ROOM|NO QUESTIONS ON EITHER SIDE|WHAT IZ IN DA CRATE}

n0.text:
{fence} WORKS OUT OF A BACK ROOM OFF {street} AN' HAB A CRATE DAT CAME IN {timeAgo} DAT NOBODY HAB COME TA COLLECT.
DA ARRANGEMENT ON OFFER IZ DA USUAL: DA PARTY MOVES IT AS FAR AS {distance} AN' ASKS NUTTIN', AN' IZ PAID IN {payment}. DA CRATE IZ HEAVIER AT ONE END.
DA CRATE HAB BIN MOVED {TWICE|MORE DEN ONCE|THREE TIMES} INSIDE DA BACK ROOM, AN' DA MARKS ON DA FLOOR SAY IT WAZ MOVED BY SOMEBODY IN A HURRY EACH TIME!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: TAKE DA JOB AN' DO NO OPEN IT!
OPEN IT FIRST.
BUY IT OUTRIGHT AN' IT IZ NOBODY'S BUSINESS BUT DA PARTY'S!

job.text:
{distance}, DELIVERED, SIGNED FOR BY SOMEBODY WHO DOES NO GIVE A NAME AN' DOES NO NEED TA.
DA MONEY IZ GOOD AN' DA WALK BACK IZ DA FIRST TIME ALL WEEK NOBODY HAB HAB TA TINK 'BOUT ANYTINK, AN' NEITHER OF DOZE FACTS SURVIVES CONTACT WIT WHAT IZ IN {rumour} A FORTNIGHT LATER!

opn.text:
OPENED AN' RE-NAILED SO DAT NOBODY COULD TELL, WHICH IZ A SKILL, AN' WHAT IZ IN IT IZ WORSE DEN DA MONEY AN' BETTER DEN DA PARTY FEARED.
KNOWIN' CHANGES DA PRICE. {fence} PAYS DA NEW PRICE WITOUT ARGUIN', WHICH SAYS EVERYTINK 'BOUT WHAT {fence} ALREADY KNEW!

opf.text:
DA LID SPLINTERS AT DA CORNER AN' DERE IZ NO PUTTIN' DAT RIGHT WIT DA TOOLS TA HAND.
{fence} LOOKS AT DA CORNER FOR A LONG MOMENT AN' DEN SAYS DA JOB IZ OFF AN' DA PARTY SHOULD GO, IN A VOICE DAT HAB {NUTTIN' BEHIND IT AT ALL|NUTTIN' IN IT|NO WEATHER IN IT WHATSOEVER}!

own.text:
BOUGHT, CARRIED OUT THROUGH DA FRONT {FOR ONCE|IN DAYLIGHT|WITOUT ANYBODY DUCKIN'}, AN' OPENED ON DA PARTY'S OWN GROUND IN DA PARTY'S OWN TIME WIT NOBODY STANDIN' OVER IT.
WHAT IZ INSIDE WAZ WORTH CONSIDERABLY MORE DEN DA ASKIN' PRICE, WHICH IZ WHAT HAPPENS WHEN A TINK IZ PRICED BY HOW BADLY SOMEBODY {WANTS IT GONE|NEEDS IT OUT OF DA ROOM|WANTS RID}!

job_m.text:
DA JOB IZ {distance} WIT A CRATE DAT IZ HEAVIER AT ONE END AN' DOES NO LIKE CORNERS, AN' DA FIRST HOUR OF IT IZ ENTIRELY UNEVENTFUL.
IN DA SECOND HOUR IT BECOMES CLEAR DA PARTY IZ BEING FOLLOWED, AT A DISTANCE, BY {TWO|A PAIR|SOMEBODY AN' A SECOND SOMEBODY} WHO IZ NO TRYIN' PARTICULARLY HARD TA BE INVISIBLE 'BOUT IT!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{NOBODY FOLLOWS A CRATE DEY DO NO KNOW DA CONTENTS OF.|DAT TAIL IZ AN ESCORT.|DOZE TWO KNEW DA ROUTE BEFORE WE DID.}"
asides.any: {member} {CHANGES DA GRIP ON DA CRATE AN' DOES NO LOOK BACK AGAIN|COUNTS DA CORNERS|TAKES DA OUTSIDE OF DA PAVEMENT}

choices.text: DELIVER IT AN' LET DEM FOLLOW!
LOSE DEM IN DA STREETS.
PUT DA CRATE DOWN AN' WAIT FOR DEM!

job_lose.text:
IT TAKES {FOUR TURNS|A FEW STREETS AN' A YARD|A COVERED MARKET AN' TWO ALLEYS} AN' ONE OF DEM IZ A MISTAKE, AN' DA MISTAKE IZ WHAT ACTUALLY DOES IT.
DA CRATE ARRIVES. IT IZ SIGNED FOR BY SOMEBODY WIT NO NAME WHO LOOKS PAST DA PARTY UP DA STREET FOR {A GOOD WHILE|LONGER DEN IZ COMFORTABLE|SOME TIME} BEFORE CLOSIN' DA DOOR, AN' DA MONEY IZ DOUBLED WITOUT A WORD 'BOUT WHY!

job_caught.text:
DA THIRD TURN IZ INTO A YARD WIT ONE WAY OUT OF IT AN' DA TWO IZ ALREADY STANDIN' IN IT, WHICH MEANS DEY KNEW DA ROUTE, WHICH MEANS {fence} SOLD IT OR SOMEBODY IN DAT BACK ROOM DID.
DA CRATE STAYS IN DA YARD. DA PARTY DOES NO, WHICH IZ DA GOOD OUTCOME AVAILABLE, AN' IT IZ AVAILABLE COZ DA TWO WANT DA CRATE RATHER DEN A FIGHT!

job_wait.text:
PUTTIN' A CRATE DOWN IN DA MIDDLE OF A STREET AN' SITTIN' ON IT IZ NO SOMETINK EITHER OF DA TWO HAB ANY PROCEDURE FOR, AN' IT SHOWS: DEY STOP 'BOUT {A LONG WAY OFF|A STREET'S LENGTH|A LONG WAY} OFF AN' HAB A CONVERSATION WIT DEY HANDS.
ONE OF DEM WALKS OVER. WHAT DEY WANT IZ TA KNOW WHO SENT DA CRATE, AN' DEY IZ WILLIN' TA PAY CONSIDERABLY MORE DEN {fence} IZ FOR DA ANSWER!

choices.text: SELL DEM DA NAME.
SAY NUTTIN'. PICK DA CRATE UP. FINISH DA JOB!

job_sell.text:
DA NAME IZ WORTH {payment} AN' IZ HANDED OVER ON A STREET CORNER IN 'BOUT {NINE SECONDS|A MOMENT|DA TIME IT TAKES TA SAY IT}.
DA CRATE GETS DELIVERED ANYWAY, COZ DA JOB IZ DA JOB. {fence} WORKS OUT WHAT HAPPENED INSIDE {A WEEK|DA BETTER PART OF A FORTNIGHT|DA MONTH}, AN' DA BACK ROOM OFF {street} IZ NO SOMEWHERE DA PARTY CAN WALK INTO AGAIN!

own_m.text:
BOUGHT, CARRIED OUT THROUGH DA FRONT {FOR ONCE|IN DAYLIGHT|WITOUT ANYBODY DUCKIN'}, AN' SET DOWN ON DA PARTY'S OWN GROUND WIT NOBODY STANDIN' OVER IT.
IT IZ NAILED SHUT WIT {NINE|ELEVEN} NAILS WHERE FOUR WOULD DO, AN' DERE IZ A SECOND LID UNDER DA FIRST, AN' BETWEEN DA TWO LIDS DERE IZ A FOLDED SHEET OF PAPER WIT A DATE ON IT {FOUR DAYS FROM NOW|NEXT WEEK|IN DA NEAR FUTURE}!

choices.text: OPEN IT ANYWAY. IT IZ OURS NOW!
READ DA PAPER FIRST AN' DO WHAT IT SAYS!
WAIT FOR DA DATE.

own_paper.text:
IT IZ INSTRUCTIONS, IN THREE LANGUAGES, AN' DA THIRD ONE IZ NO A LANGUAGE ANYBODY IN DA PARTY HAB SEEN WRITTEN DOWN BEFORE. WHAT DA TWO READABLE ONES SAY IZ: NO BEFORE DA DATE, AN' NO INDOORS.
DONE OUTDOORS, ON DA DATE, AT DA HOUR, IT OPENS CORRECTLY, AN' WHAT IZ INSIDE IZ INTACT AN' WORTH {A REAL GREAT DEAL|CONSIDERABLY MORE DEN DA PURCHASE PRICE|DA WHOLE SEASON}!

own_wait.text:
FOUR DAYS OF A CRATE SITTIN' IN DA CORNER OF WHEREVER DA PARTY IZ SLEEPIN', WHICH IZ FOUR DAYS OF EVERYBODY WALKIN' ROUND IT.
ON DA DATE IT OPENS ON ITS OWN AT 'BOUT {FOUR IN DA MORNIN'|FIRST LIGHT|AN HOUR NOBODY CHOSE}, BOTH LIDS AT ONCE, QUIETLY, AN' WHAT IZ IN IT HAB ARRANGED ITSELF SINCE DA NAILS WENT IN!

qe_dig.title: {DA CONTRACTOR'S DEADLINE|BONES UNDER DA FOUNDATION|POUR IT MONDAY}

n0.text:
A SITE AT {place} WIT DA FOUNDATION DUG AN' DA POUR BOOKED FOR MONDAY, AN' SOMETINK IN DA TRENCH DAT STOPPED DA MACHINE ON FRIDAY.
{stranger} IZ DA ONE WHO HAB TA DECIDE, AN' HAB BIN STANDIN' AT DA EDGE OF DA TRENCH SINCE. DERE IZ A CARVIN' ON WHAT IZ DOWN DERE AN' IT IZ OLDER DEN DA TOWN.
DA MACHINE DRIVER HAB NO COME BACK TA DA SITE SINCE FRIDAY AN' IZ NO ANSWERIN', AN' NOBODY WANTS TA BE DA ONE TA SAY DAT OUT LOUD!

asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: WORK IT OUT PROPERLY. DA BEST PART OF A WEEK, UNPAID!
SHORE IT AN' POUR AROUND IT, {qty} {material}!
NUTTIN' WAZ EVER FOUND HERE!

arch.text:
A COUPLE OF DAYS ON HANDS AN' KNEES AN' IT IZ A BOUNDARY STONE, IN PLACE, STILL DOING ITS JOB, MARKIN' A LINE DAT EVERY WALL IN {place} HAB QUIETLY RESPECTED FOR EIGHT HUNDRED YEARS WITOUT ANYBODY KNOWIN' WHY.
DAT IZ A PAPER, AN' DA PAPER HAB DA PARTY'S NAMES ON IT, AN' DA FOUNDATION PAYS FOR {PAPERS|PAPERS LIKE DAT|A PAPER}!

archf.text:
TWO DAYS, AN' AT DA END OF IT DA HONEST ANSWER IZ DAT NOBODY IN DIS TRENCH IZ QUALIFIED TA SAY WHAT IT IZ.
MONDAY ARRIVES REGARDLESS. DA POUR HAPPENS. WHATEVER IT WAZ IZ UNDER {A HUNDRED|NINETY|A HUNDRED AN' TWENTY} CUBIC METRES OF CONCRETE AN' WILL BE SOMEBODY'S PROBLEM IN {DA NEXT CENTURY|A HUNDRED YEARS|WHICHEVER CENTURY DIGS IT UP}!

shore.text:
SHUTTERIN', A VOID FORMER, AN' DA {material} TA HOLD IT: DA POUR GOES AHEAD ON MONDAY AN' DA TINK IN DA TRENCH KEEPS A ROOM TA ITSELF UNDER DA NEW FLOOR.
IT COSTS DA CONTRACTOR A WEEKEND AN' IT COSTS NOBODY DA DEADLINE, AN' DERE IZ A HATCH, AN' DA HATCH IZ ON {DA DRAWINGS|DA DRAWINGS, IN INK|EVERY SET OF DA DRAWINGS}!

pour.text:
DA MACHINE GOES BACK IN ON DA SATURDAY AN' BY SUNDAY NIGHT DERE IZ NUTTIN' IN DAT TRENCH BUT TRENCH.
DA POUR GOES AHEAD. {stranger} PAYS CASH AN' DOES NO SHAKE ANYBODY'S HAND, AN' DA BUILDIN' GOES UP STRAIGHT AN' STAYS UP, WHICH IZ NO {DA POINT|DA POINT AT ALL|WHAT ANYBODY WAZ ASKIN'}!

arch_m.text:
DA BEST PART OF A WEEK ON HANDS AN' KNEES IN A TRENCH, UNPAID, WIT DA POUR BOOKED AN' DA CONTRACTOR WATCHIN' FROM DA EDGE EVERY HOUR ON DA HOUR.
BY DA END OF DA FIRST DAY IT IZ A BOUNDARY STONE, IN PLACE, STILL DOING ITS JOB. BY DA MIDDLE OF DA SECOND DERE IZ {A SECOND ONE|ANOTHER|DA NEXT ONE IN DA LINE} ARM'S LENGTH AN' A BIT ALONG, AN' A THIRD WHERE DA TRENCH ENDS, AN' DA LINE DEY MAKE RUNS {STRAIGHT UNDER DA TOWN|OFF UNDER DA HOUSES|DA LENGTH OF {place}}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{MONDAY IZ NO MOVIN' FOR DIS.|TWO DAYS UNPAID AN' NOW DERE IZ THREE OF DEM.|WE HAB FOUND SOMETINK TOO BIG TA HAB FOUND.}"
asides.any: {member} {GETS DA THEODOLITE OUT OF DA VAN WITOUT ASKIN'|PUTS A TAPE ON DA SPACIN'|PHOTOGRAPHS ALL THREE BEFORE ANYBODY DECIDES ANYTINK}

choices.text: FILE DA REPORT ON DA ONE STONE. DAT IZ WHAT WAZ DUG UP!
SURVEY DA WHOLE LINE BEFORE ANYBODY POURS ANYTINK!
DATE DA STONES AN' FIND OUT WHAT DEY WAZ FOR!

arch_line.text:
DA LINE IZ SURVEYED IN AN AFTERNOON AN' IT IZ {ONE SIDE OF SOMETINK|AN EDGE|DA NORTH WALL OF SOMETINK} DAT HAB {FOUR|FIVE|THREE} CORNERS, AN' TWO OF DA CORNERS IZ UNDER STANDIN' HOUSES.
DA POUR IZ OFF. IT IZ OFF FOR {A YEAR|TWO SEASONS|MOST OF A YEAR}. DA CONTRACTOR LOSES DA JOB AN' GAINS A CONSIDERABLY LARGER ONE, AN' DA PARTY'S NAMES IZ ON DA FIRST PAGE OF DA REPORT!

arch_date.text:
DA STONES IZ {EIGHT HUNDRED|SIX HUNDRED|A GREAT MANY} YEARS OLDER DEN DA TOWN DAT HAB BIN RESPECTIN' DEM, AN' DEY IZ NO LOCAL STONE, AN' DEY WAZ CUT SOMEWHERE DAT HAB NO EXISTED FOR LONGER DEN DAT.
WHAT DAT MEANS IZ ABOVE DA PAY GRADE OF EVERYBODY CURRENTLY STANDIN' IN DA TRENCH. IT IZ NO ABOVE DA PAY GRADE OF DA PEOPLE WHO ARRIVE {A WEEK AN' A BIT|A FORTNIGHT|A FEW WEEKS} LATER, WHO PAY WELL AN' ASK DA PARTY TA SAY NUTTIN'!

pour_m.text:
DA MACHINE GOES BACK IN ON DA SATURDAY. IT TAKES {A LONG STRETCH|AN HOUR|MOST OF DA MORNIN'} AN' IT IZ DA EASIEST MONEY ANYBODY WILL MAKE DIS MONTH.
AT DA BOTTOM OF IT, UNDER WHERE DA TINK IN DA TRENCH WAZ, DA BUCKET BRINGS UP SOMETINK DAT IZ NO STONE AN' NO SOIL, AN' DA DRIVER STOPS WITOUT BEING TOLD TA, FOR DA SECOND TIME IN {DA BEST PART OF A WEEK|A WEEKEND}!

choices.text: KEEP GOING. SUNDAY NIGHT, NUTTIN' IN DA TRENCH BUT TRENCH!
GET DOWN DERE AN' LOOK AT IT!
STOP DA MACHINE. CALL DA TWO DAYS BACK ON!

pour_look.text:
DOWN IN IT, UNDER LAMPS, WIT DA SIDES OF DA TRENCH {NO LIKIN' IT|MOVIN' SLIGHTLY|AS UNHAPPY AS TRENCH SIDES GET}, IT IZ A VOID: {A METRE|A METRE AN' A HALF|'BOUT A METRE} ACROSS, LINED, GOING DOWN.
WHAT COMES OUT OF IT IN DA NEXT HOUR IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA BUILDIN', AN' DA CONCRETE GOES IN ON MONDAY OVER DA TOP OF DA REST OF IT REGARDLESS, COZ MONDAY IZ MONDAY!

qe_race.title: {SATURDAY ON DA LONG STRAIGHT|UNDER EIGHTY OR NO AT ALL|DA BET}

n0.text:
DERE IZ A STRAIGHT OUTSIDE {place} WHERE DEY RUN ON A SATURDAY, AN' DA WHOLE GAME IZ DAT DA ONES WHO WIN IZ DA ONES WHO DO NO GO OVER.
EVERYBODY KNOWS WHERE DA BUBBLE SITS. {stranger} TAKES DA MONEY ON DA GATE. {many} PEOPLE IZ HERE FOR IT AN' 'BOUT HALF OF DEM HAB OPINIONS 'BOUT {vehicle} DA PARTY ARRIVED IN.
DERE IZ A WREATH ON DA FENCE AT DA THREE-QUARTER MARK, AN' IT IZ {DIS SEASON'S|NO OLD|FRESH}!

asides.hedonistic: {member} HAB PUT MONEY ON SOMEBODY DEY HAB NEVER MET ON DA STRENGTH OF A JACKET!
asides.cautious: {member} {WATCHES DA PERIMETER WIT A FROWN: "BAD IDEA."|CHECKS DEY WEAPON CHARGE AN' BACKS UP A STEP|KEEPS A FINGER ON DA SAFETY AN' MUTTERS A WARNIN'|EYES DA SURROUNDINGS: "DIS HAB TRAP WRITTEN ALL OVER IT."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PUT MONEY ON IT.
RUN IT.
FLAG DA EDGE FOR DEM BEFORE SOMEBODY ELSE GOES OVER!

won2.text:
DA ONE IN DA JACKET HOLDS IT AT {SEVENTY-NINE|SEVENTY-EIGHT|A SHADE UNDER} DA WHOLE WAY DOWN AN' TAKES IT BY A LENGTH AN' A HALF WITOUT EVER ONCE BEING INTERESTIN' TA LOOK AT, WHICH IZ DA ENTIRE ART.
DA GATE PAYS OUT IN CASH AN' DA PARTY IZ BOUGHT DRINKS BY STRANGERS FOR {DA REST OF DA EVENIN'|DA REST OF DA NIGHT|HOURS}!

lost3.text:
DA ONE IN DA JACKET GOES OVER AT DA {THREE-QUARTER MARK|LAST MARKER|TOP OF DA STRAIGHT}, WHICH EVERYBODY IN DA CROWD SEES COMIN' 'BOUT A SECOND BEFORE IT HAPPENS.
DA STAKE IZ GONE AN' DA JACKET IZ GONE, AN' DA GATE KEEPS TAKIN' MONEY, COZ DERE IZ ANOTHER ONE IN {DA BEST PART OF AN HOUR|HALF AN HOUR|A QUARTER OF AN HOUR}!

ran.text:
HOLDIN' A TINK AT SEVENTY-NINE DA WHOLE LENGTH OF DA STRAIGHT, WIT A CROWD SCREAMIN' AT YOU TA DO DA ONE TINK DAT WILL END YOU, IZ A TEST OF NERVE.
{leader} TAKES IT AT A WALKIN' PACE BY COMPARISON TA EVERYBODY ELSE AN' WINS, AN' DA STRAIGHT GIVES DEM DA SORT OF SILENCE DAT TURNS INTO A ROAR!

ranf.text:
IT GETS AWAY AT DA TOP END FOR A MOMENT AN' DA MOMENT IZ ENOUGH TA BE PULLED AT, AN' DA PULL IZ FELT IN DA CHEST AN' DA TEETH BEFORE DA BRAKES ANSWER.
DA PARTY COMES OFF DA STRAIGHT AT A CRAWL WIT EVERYBODY REAL WHITE. DA CROWD {APPLAUDS ANYWAY|CHEERS ANYWAY|MAKES A NOISE 'BOUT IT ANYWAY}, WHICH IZ {SOMEHOW WORSE|WORSE|DA WORST PART OF IT}!

flag.text:
POSTS AN' TAPE AT DA REAL EDGE, LAID OUT IN DA AFTERNOON BEFORE DA CROWD ARRIVES, WIT DA {material} DA PARTY CARRIED IN.
SATURDAY GOES OFF WIT NOBODY LOST FOR DA FIRST TIME IN A SEASON. DA GATE IZ FURIOUS FOR 'BOUT AN HOUR AN' DEN BUYS DA PARTY A DRINK, {TWICE|TWICE OVER|AN' DEN ANOTHER}!

ran_m.text:
HOLDIN' A TINK AT SEVENTY-NINE DA WHOLE LENGTH OF DA STRAIGHT, WIT A CROWD SCREAMIN' AT YOU TA DO DA ONE TINK DAT WILL END YOU, IZ A TEST OF NERVE, AN' IT GOES WELL FOR {TWO THIRDS|MOST|DA FIRST HALF} OF DA STRAIGHT.
DEN DA ONE IN DA JACKET COMES UP DA INSIDE AT A SPEED DAT SAYS DEY HAB DECIDED TODAY IZ DA DAY, AN' DEY IZ {A WHEEL|HALF A LENGTH|INCHES} AHEAD AN' STILL CLIMBIN'!

choices.text: HOLD SEVENTY-NINE. LET DEM GO OVER IF DEY IZ GOING!
GO WIT DEM. MATCH IT.
GET ALONGSIDE AN' FORCE DEM OFF DA LINE!

ran_match.text:
EIGHTY-ONE FOR {FOUR SECONDS|A COUPLE OF SECONDS|'BOUT A SECOND AN' A HALF}, WHICH IZ FOUR SECONDS LONGER DEN DA EDGE ALLOWS AN' IZ DA REASON DERE IZ A WREATH ON DA FENCE.
BOTH OF DEM COME OFF DA STRAIGHT. ONLY ONE OF DEM COMES OFF IT AT DA FAR END, AN' IT IZ DA PARTY, AN' IT TAKES {A FORTNIGHT|SOME WEEKS|A WHILE} BEFORE ANYBODY CAN SAY HOW!

ran_push.text:
DERE IZ EXACTLY ONE WAY TA DO IT DAT IZ NO MURDER, AN' IT INVOLVES {DA INSIDE|A WHEEL|TWO FEET OF TARMAC} AN' DA CERTAINTY DAT DA OTHER DRIVER WILL TAKE IT RATHER DEN DA EDGE.
DEY TAKE IT. BOTH CARS COME OFF DA STRAIGHT SLOW, SIDEWAYS AN' WHOLE, AN' DA CROWD DOES NO KNOW WHETHER TA CHEER, AN' DA ONE IN DA JACKET SITS IN DA CAR FOR {A LONG TIME|FOUR OR FIVE MINUTES|A WHILE} BEFORE GETTIN' OUT AN' SHAKIN' HANDS!

flag_m.text:
POSTS AN' TAPE AT DA REAL EDGE, LAID OUT IN DA AFTERNOON BEFORE DA CROWD ARRIVES, WIT DA {material} DA PARTY CARRIED IN.
DA GATE ARRIVES AT {FOUR|FIVE|DA BACK OF FOUR} AN' IZ FURIOUS, COZ TAPE AT DA REAL EDGE MEANS EVERYBODY CAN SEE WHERE IT IZ, AN' DA WHOLE BUSINESS OF DA SATURDAY IZ DAT DEY {NO CAN|CAN ONLY GUESS|HAB TA FEEL FOR IT}!

choices.text: STAND BY DA TAPE. LET DEM BE FURIOUS!
MAKE DA CASE TA DA DRIVERS, NO DA GATE!
TAKE PAYMENT TA MOVE DA TAPE BACK WHERE IT WAZ!

flag_drivers.text:
DA DRIVERS IZ IN A SHED BEHIND DA START WIT DA DOORS OPEN AN' DEY LISTEN, COZ DA PERSON TALKIN' HAB {RUN IT|BIN DOWN DA STRAIGHT|DRIVEN IT TODAY} AN' DEY SAW DEM DO IT.
DA VOTE IZ NO CLOSE. DA TAPE STAYS. DA GATE TAKES {A BAD SATURDAY|A POOR GATE|HALF OF WHAT DEY EXPECTED} AN' DA DRIVERS TAKE DA WHOLE SEASON WITOUT LOSIN' ANYBODY, AN' DA FOLLOWIN' YEAR DA TAPE GOES UP BEFORE ANYBODY ASKS!

flag_pulled.text:
DA CASE IZ MADE TA DA WRONG PEOPLE IN DA WRONG ORDER AN' DA GATE HAB {FOUR|FIVE} MEN AN' DA PARTY HAB AN ARGUMENT.
DA TAPE COMES DOWN AT {SIX|HALF FIVE|BEFORE DA CROWD}. SATURDAY RUNS DA WAY SATURDAY RUNS. DERE IZ A NEW WREATH ON DA FENCE BY {NINE|DA LAST RACE|DARK} AN' DA PARTY IZ A LONG WAY DOWN DA ROAD BY DEN, WHICH DOES NO HELP AT ALL!

flag_bribe.text:
IT IZ OFFERED BEFORE IT IZ ASKED FOR, WHICH IZ HOW DA GATE DOES BUSINESS, AN' IT IZ {GOOD MONEY|A LOT OF MONEY|MORE DEN DA POSTS COST}.
DA TAPE GOES BACK WHERE IT WAZ. DA PARTY TAKES DA MONEY AN' DOES NO STAY FOR DA RACIN', AN' DOES NO FIND OUT UNTIL {A MONTH LATER|DA SPRING|MUCH LATER} WHETHER ANYBODY WENT OVER DAT SATURDAY, AN' BY DEN NO KNOWIN' HAB BECOME A DECISION IN ITSELF!

qe_orchard.title: {DA ORCHARD NOBODY OWNS|A SEASON OF IT|WINDFALLS}

n0.text:
DERE IZ AN ORCHARD BEHIND {place} DAT HAB BIN UNOWNED SINCE {timeAgo}, AN' DIS YEAR IT HAB COME IN HEAVY ENOUGH TA BREAK ITS OWN BRANCHES.
{stranger} HAB BIN PICKIN' IT ALONE FOR A WEEK. NOBODY ELSE HAB COME. DA WHOLE CROP GOES OVER IN 'BOUT FOUR DAYS IF IT IZ NO TAKEN.
DA TREES IZ IN {NINE|ELEVEN|A GOOD MANY} ROWS AN' DA NINTH ROW IZ A DIFFERENT VARIETY, PLANTED LATER, BY SOMEBODY WHO MEANT IT!

asides.nurturing: {member} IZ UP A LADDER WITHIN 'BOUT NINETY SECONDS!
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: PICK IT. ALL OF IT.
GIVE {qty} {material} FOR CRATES AN' GET DA TOWN UP HERE!
PRUNE IT PROPERLY FOR NEXT YEAR INSTEAD!

pick.text:
{FOUR|FIVE|THREE} DAYS OF LADDERS AN' ACHIN' HANDS AN' MORE FRUIT DEN ANYBODY HAB CONTAINERS FOR, AN' IT IZ ALL IN BEFORE DA WEATHER TURNS.
DA PARTY LEAVES WIT AS MUCH AS DEY CAN CARRY AN' DA STANDIN' RIGHT TA COME BACK NEXT YEAR, WHICH IN A PLACE LIKE DIS IZ {A DOCUMENT|AS GOOD AS A DEED|WORTH MORE DEN PAPER}!

pickf.text:
DA WEATHER COMES IN ON DA SECOND DAY AN' DA REST GOES OVER ON DA BRANCH IN A NIGHT.
WHAT WAZ GOT IZ WORTH HAVIN'. WHAT IZ LEFT DROPS INTO DA GRASS AN' FEEDS {animal} INSTEAD, WHICH SOMEBODY OLDER POINTS OUT IZ {NO NUTTIN'|NO A WASTE|DA OLDER ARRANGEMENT}!

town.text:
CRATES, A CART, AN' WORD PUT 'BOUT, AN' BY DA SECOND MORNIN' DERE IZ {many} PEOPLE IN AN ORCHARD DAT NOBODY OWNS TAKIN' WHAT DEY NEED AN' STACKIN' DA REST.
IT GOES TA DA SCHOOL, DA TWO HOUSES ON DA CORNER, AN' A WOMAN ON {street} WHO HAB NO ASKED ANYBODY FOR ANYTINK IN {timeAgo}!

prune.text:
DA CROP GOES OVER AN' EVERYBODY AGREES, OUT LOUD, DAT IT WAZ GOING TA.
WHAT GETS DONE INSTEAD IZ DA SAW WORK NOBODY HAB DONE SINCE {timeAgo}, AN' IN {THREE|FOUR} YEARS DAT ORCHARD WILL CARRY TWICE DIS AN' NO BREAK ITSELF DOING IT, AN' NONE OF DAT IZ VISIBLE {TODAY|FROM HERE|DIS AFTERNOON}!

town_m.text:
CRATES, A CART, AN' WORD PUT 'BOUT, AN' BY DA SECOND MORNIN' DERE IZ {many} PEOPLE IN AN ORCHARD DAT NOBODY OWNS.
BY DA SECOND AFTERNOON DERE IZ TWO MEN AT DA GATE WIT A PAPER DAT SAYS SOMEBODY DOES OWN IT, AN' DA PAPER IZ {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE OLD|DATED BEFORE DA TOWN WAZ CLEARED|NO OBVIOUSLY WRONG}!

asides.cynical: {member}: "{FUNNY HOW OWNERSHIP TURNS UP AT HARVEST.|NOBODY OWNED IT IN MARCH.|MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE OF NUTTIN' AN' NOW A PAPER.}"
asides.any: {member} {PUTS DA CRATE DOWN AN' WALKS TA DA GATE|READS DA PAPER OVER SOMEBODY'S SHOULDER|KEEPS PICKIN'}

choices.text: STOP DA PICKIN'. IT IZ DEY ORCHARD!
READ DA PAPER PROPERLY.
KEEP PICKIN' AN' LET DEM STAND DERE!

town_law.text:
DA PAPER IZ REAL AN' DA CLAIM UNDER IT LAPSED {YEARS AN' YEARS AGO|A DECADE BACK|LONG BEFORE DIS YEAR'S BLOSSOM} FOR WANT OF ANYBODY DOING ANYTINK WIT DA GROUND, WHICH IZ A TINK DAT IZ WRITTEN DOWN AN' CAN BE SHOWN TA TWO MEN AT A GATE.
IT IZ SHOWN. DEY GO. DA PICKIN' FINISHES ON DA THIRD DAY, DA CROP GOES TA DA SCHOOL AN' DA TWO HOUSES ON DA CORNER AN' EVERYWHERE ELSE, AN' DA LAPSE GETS REGISTERED PROPERLY {DAT WINTER|BEFORE DA YEAR IZ OUT|BY SOMEBODY WHO NOW KNOWS HOW}!

town_stop.text:
STOPPIN' A HUNDRED PEOPLE PICKIN' FREE FRUIT TAKES {LONGER DEN STARTIN' DEM|MOST OF AN HOUR|MORE VOICE DEN ANYBODY HAB LEFT}, AN' IT IZ DONE, AN' DA CRATES COME BACK DOWN TA DA GATE STACKED.
DA TWO MEN TAKE DA ORCHARD AN' DO NO PICK IT. IT GOES OVER ON DA BRANCH IN {A FORTNIGHT|DA FOLLOWIN' WEEK|A WET A WEEK AN' A BIT}, ALL OF IT, AN' EVERYBODY IN DA TOWN WATCHES DAT HAPPEN FROM DA ROAD!

prune_m.text:
DA CROP GOES OVER AN' EVERYBODY AGREES, OUT LOUD, DAT IT WAZ GOING TA, AN' DA SAW WORK STARTS ON DA SECOND MORNIN'.
IN DA NINTH ROW, DA DIFFERENT ONE, DA PRUNIN' UNCOVERS WHAT DA ROW IZ: EVERY TREE IN IT IZ {DA SAME TREE|ONE TREE|DA SAME TREE OVER AN' OVER}, GRAFTED, FROM ONE STOCK, AN' AT DA END OF DA ROW DERE IZ A STUMP WIT {A PLATE ON IT AN' A NAME|A NAME PLATE|A BRASS PLATE AN' A NAME}!

choices.text: FINISH DA PRUNIN'. LEAVE DA PLATE ALONE!
GRAFT FROM DA NINTH ROW BEFORE DA SAW WORK GOES ON!
FIND OUT WHOSE NAME IZ ON DA PLATE!

prune_graft.text:
{NINE|ELEVEN|A DOZEN} CUTTINGS, TAKEN CORRECTLY, WAXED, AN' CARRIED OUT IN A DAMP CLOTH TA SOMEWHERE DEY WILL TAKE.
DA VARIETY TURNS OUT TA BE ONE DAT WAZ WRITTEN OFF AS GONE {MOST OF A WORKIN' LIFE AGO|TWO GENERATIONS BACK|IN DA WAR}, AN' DERE IZ PEOPLE WHO WILL PAY FOR A STICK OF IT, AN' DERE IZ MORE PEOPLE WHO WILL SIMPLY BE REAL GLAD, AN' DA SECOND LOT IZ BETTER TA KNOW!

prune_name.text:
IT TAKES {TWO AFTERNOONS|A DAY|SOME ASKIN'} IN A TOWN DAT HAB MOSTLY STOPPED KEEPIN' RECORDS, AN' DA NAME ON DA PLATE BELONGED TA SOMEBODY WHO PLANTED A ROW OF ONE TREE AN' DEN LEFT AN' DID NO COME BACK.
DERE IZ A GRANDDAUGHTER, {TWO VALLEYS OVER|IN DA NEXT TOWN|NEARER DEN ANYBODY EXPECTED}, WHO DID NO KNOW DA ORCHARD EXISTED. SHE COMES UP DA FOLLOWIN' SPRING. AFTER DAT IT IZ NO AN UNOWNED ORCHARD ANY MORE!

n0.text:
{stranger} IN {place} HAB A SUMMONS WIT SOMEBODY ELSE'S CRIME ON IT AN' DEY OWN NAME, SPELLED CORRECTLY, IN A HAND DAT NEVER MAKES MISTAKES.
HER COURT DOES NO DO APPEALS IN DA USUAL SENSE. IT DOES ARBITRARY, AN' IT DOES IT FAST, AN' DA HOUR NAMED ON DA PAPER IZ TOMORROW'S.
DA SUMMONS IZ DATED {TOMORROW|DA DAY AFTER|FOR A DAY DAT HAB NO HAPPENED YET} AN' HAB ALREADY BIN STAMPED AS HEARD!

asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.empathetic: {member} {LOOKS AT DA WRECKAGE AN' SHAKES DEY HEAD: "TOUGH WAY TA GO."|CHECKS FOR SURVIVOR LOGS WIT A QUIET SIGH|HOPES WHOEVER WAZ HERE GOT OUT IN TIME|MUTTERS A QUIET CONDOLENCE FOR DA CREW}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: BUILD DA ALIBI AN' GET IT FILED!
PAY DA FINE AN' MAKE IT GO AWAY!
GO AN' STAND WIT DEM.

ali.text:
IT TAKES AN AFTERNOON OF {paper} AN' {few} PEOPLE WILLIN' TA SIGN SOMETINK, AN' DA FILIN' IZ DONE WIT AN HOUR IN HAND.
IT WORKS, IN DA SENSE DAT DA SUMMONS IZ WITHDRAWN. NOBODY WILL SAY BY WHOM, OR WHETHER ANYBODY READ IT, AN' DA PARTY IZ CAREFUL NO TA CELEBRATE ANYWHERE IT MIGHT BE OVERHEARD!

alif.text:
DA FILIN' IZ ACCEPTED, STAMPED, AN' HAB NO EFFECT WHATSOEVER ON ANYTINK DAT HAPPENS DA FOLLOWIN' DAY.
IT WAZ NEVER GOING TA. SOMEWHERE IN DA ARITHMETIC OF DA TINK DERE IZ A JOKE, AN' DA PARTY IZ NO {DA AUDIENCE FOR IT|DA AUDIENCE|WHO IT IZ FOR}!

pay.text:
DA FINE IZ PAID AT A WINDOW BY SOMEBODY WHO DOES NO LOOK UP, AN' DA SUMMONS IZ MARKED SETTLED IN DA SAME HAND DAT WROTE IT.
IT COST WHAT {A YEAR|MOST OF A YEAR|A REAL GOOD YEAR} COSTS. DA PERSON ON DA PAPER WILL BE PAYIN' DA PARTY BACK IN INSTALMENTS FOR DA REST OF DEY LIFE AN' WILL {INSIST ON IT|INSIST|NO BE TALKED OUT OF IT}!

stand.text:
STANDIN' IN DAT ROOM WIT SOMEBODY IZ NO A LEGAL STRATEGY AN' IT IZ NO NUTTIN'.
IT GOES {HOW IT GOES|DA WAY IT WAZ ALWAYS GOING TA|BADLY, AN' QUICKLY}. AFTERWARDS, OUT IN DA LIGHT, DA PARTY IZ THANKED BY SOMEBODY WHO HAB JUST LOST A GREAT DEAL AN' IZ THANKIN' DEM {PROPERLY ANYWAY|PROPERLY|CAREFULLY, ANYWAY}!

stand_m.text:
STANDIN' IN DAT ROOM WIT SOMEBODY DOES NUTTIN' LEGALLY AN' EVERYTINK OTHERWISE, AN' DA ROOM IZ {SMALLER|A GOOD DEAL SMALLER|LESS GRAND} DEN DA WORD COURT SUGGESTS.
DERE IZ {FOUR|FIVE} OTHER MATTERS ON BEFORE DIS ONE AN' ALL OF DEM GO DA SAME WAY, QUICKLY, WIT DA SAME PHRASE USED EACH TIME, AN' BY DA FOURTH IT IZ POSSIBLE TA HEAR WHAT DA PHRASE IZ ACTUALLY ASKIN' FOR!

choices.text: STAND DERE. SAY NUTTIN'. SEE IT THROUGH!
GIVE DA PHRASE BACK TA HER, CORRECTLY!
TAKE DA BLAME FOR IT INSTEAD!

stand_phrase.text:
IT IZ SAID ONCE, FLATLY, FROM DA BACK OF DA ROOM, IN DA SAME WORDS AN' DA RIGHT ORDER, AN' DA WHOLE PROCEEDIN' STOPS FOR {DA BETTER PART OF A MINUTE|A LONG MOMENT|DA LENGTH OF A HELD BREATH}.
DA MATTER IZ DISMISSED WITOUT EXPLANATION. SO IZ DA TWO AFTER IT. NOBODY IN DA ROOM LOOKS AT DA PARTY ON DA WAY OUT AN' EVERYBODY IN DA ROOM KNOWS EXACTLY WHAT HAPPENED, WHICH IZ HOW HER COURT HAB ALWAYS WORKED!

stand_worse.text:
IT IZ SAID FROM DA BACK OF DA ROOM WIT ONE WORD OUT OF PLACE, AN' ONE WORD OUT OF PLACE IN DAT ROOM IZ {AN INVITATION|AN APPLICATION|A VOLUNTEERIN'}.
DA MATTER ON DA PAPER IZ SETTLED IN {stranger}'S FAVOUR IMMEDIATELY. DA MATTER DAT REPLACES IT ON DA LIST HAB DA PARTY'S OWN NAME ON IT, CORRECTLY SPELLED, IN A HAND DAT NEVER MAKES MISTAKES!

stand_blame.text:
TAKIN' SOMEBODY ELSE'S SUMMONS ONTO YA OWN NAME IZ A TINK DA COURT PERMITS, HAB ALWAYS PERMITTED, AN' HAB CLEARLY BIN WAITIN' ALL AFTERNOON FOR SOMEBODY TA DO.
DA FINE IZ {NUTTIN'|A COIN|DELIBERATELY INSULTIN'}. DA CONDITION ATTACHED TA IT IZ NO, AN' IT WILL COME DUE AT A TIME AN' IN A MANNER ENTIRELY OF HER CHOOSIN'!

pay_m.text:
DA FINE IZ PAYABLE AT A WINDOW BY SOMEBODY WHO DOES NO LOOK UP, AN' DA NUMBER ON DA PAPER IZ WHAT {A YEAR|MOST OF A YEAR|A REAL GOOD YEAR} COSTS.
DERE IZ A SECOND WINDOW. NOBODY IZ QUEUEIN' AT IT. ABOVE IT, IN DA SAME HAND AS DA SUMMONS, IT SAYS DAT PAYMENTS MADE DERE IZ {AT DA COURT'S DISCRETION|ASSESSED RATHER DEN CHARGED|WHATEVER IZ HONEST}!

choices.text: PAY DA NUMBER AT DA FIRST WINDOW!
GO TA DA SECOND WINDOW.
ASK DA CLERK WHICH WINDOW SHE WOULD USE!

pay_second.text:
DA WINDOW OPENS ON SOMEBODY WHO ASKS ONE QUESTION, WHICH IZ WHAT DA PARTY THINKS IT IZ WORTH, AN' DEN WRITES DOWN WHATEVER IZ SAID {WITOUT COMMENT|WITOUT LOOKIN' UP|AS IF IT WAZ A FACT}.
WHAT IZ PAID IZ EITHER A GREAT DEAL LESS DEN DA FINE OR A GREAT DEAL MORE, AN' WHICH OF DOZE IT TURNS OUT TA HAB BIN IZ NO ESTABLISHED FOR {SOME WEEKS|A SEASON|A CONSIDERABLE TIME}!

pay_clerk.text:
DA CLERK LOOKS UP FOR DA FIRST TIME, WHICH BY ITSELF IZ WORTH DA QUESTION, AN' SAYS: DA SECOND ONE, ALWAYS, AN' NOBODY EVER DOES.
DA PARTY USES DA SECOND WINDOW. DA CLERK IZ, IT BECOMES CLEAR OVER DA FOLLOWIN' {YEAR|SEASONS|WHILE}, A PERSON WORTH KNOWIN', AN' REMEMBERS BEING ASKED!

qe_smith.title: {DA FORGE IZ OUT|COLD SINCE WEDNESDAY|ONE MORE FIRIN'}

n0.text:
DA FORGE AT {place} HAB BIN COLD SINCE WEDNESDAY AN' {stranger} IZ STANDIN' IN DA DOORWAY OF IT WIT AN ORDER BOOK DAT IZ STILL FULL.
WHAT IT TAKES IZ FUEL AN' {qty} {material} FOR DA TUYERE, AN' DA MERCHANT IZ {distance} AN' HAB STOPPED EXTENDIN' CREDIT TA ANYBODY IN DIS TRADE.
DA ORDER BOOK HAB {TWO|THREE} PAGES TORN OUT OF DA FRONT OF IT, AN' DA STUB EDGES IZ {CLEAN|FRESH|NO OLD}!

asides.disciplined: {member} {FOLLOWS STANDARD BREACH PROTOCOL BY DA BOOK|CLEARS EVERY CORNER WIT MILITARY PRECISION|KEEPS A STEADY FIRIN' STANCE AN' MONITORS DA SENSORS|CHECKS DA AMMO COUNT AN' MAINTAINS POSITION}
asides.cynical: {member} {SNORTS: "GREAT. MORE OVERPRICED SCRAP."|ROLLS DEY EYES: "TEN CREDITS SAYS DERE IZ NUTTIN' USEFUL INSIDE."|SCOFFS: "IF DERE WAZ ANYTINK VALUABLE HERE, SOMEONE WOULD HAB STOLEN IT ALREADY."|SHRUGS: "LETZ JUST GRAB DA LOOT BEFORE SOMETINK EXPLODES."}
asides.any: {member} {KEEPS AN EYE ON DA SENSORS AN' SAYS NUTTIN'|WATCHES DA APPROACH WIT A NEUTRAL SQUINT|CHECKS DEY HOLSTER WIT QUIET EFFICIENCY|STANDS BY DA ENTRYWAY, READY FOR TROUBLE}

choices.text: GIVE DA {material}.
WORK DA BELLOWS AN' GET ONE FIRIN' OUT OF WHAT IZ HERE!
BUY DA WHOLE ORDER BOOK OFF DEM!

give2.text:
DA TUYERE GOES IN AN' DA FORGE TAKES 'BOUT FORTY MINUTES TA REMEMBER WHAT IT IZ FOR AN' DEN REMEMBERS HARD.
DA FIRST TINK OFF DA ANVIL IZ FOR DA PARTY, MADE PROPERLY, IN DA HOUR DA FIRE CAME BACK, AN' IT IZ NO OFFERED SO MUCH AS PUT IN {leader}'S {HANDS|HANDS WITOUT A WORD|HANDS AN' CLOSED OVER}!

one.text:
{TWO|THREE} HOURS ON DA BELLOWS WIT WHAT IZ IN DA BUNKER GETS ONE FIRIN', AN' ONE FIRIN' CLEARS DA TOP THREE LINES OF DA BOOK.
DOZE THREE LINES IZ DA ONES WIT PEOPLE'S NAMES ON DEM RATHER DEN COMPANIES. DAT IZ NO AN ACCIDENT AN' DA SMITH DOES NO {PRETEND IT IZ|PRETEND OTHERWISE|CLAIM OTHERWISE}!

onef.text:
DA FIRE WILL NO COME UP PAST A SULK AN' DA BELLOWS LEATHER GOES AT DA SEAM 'BOUT {NINETY MINUTES|AN HOUR|TWO HOURS} IN.
EVERYBODY IZ FILTHY AN' NUTTIN' IZ MADE. DA SMITH PUTS DA KETTLE ON DA DEAD FORGE OUT OF HABIT AN' DEN {LAUGHS AT HAVIN' DONE IT|LAUGHS|SITS DOWN ON DA ANVIL LAUGHIN'}!

buy3.text:
DA WHOLE BOOK, AT FACE VALUE, IN CASH ON {DA ANVIL|DA QUENCH TROUGH|DA ONLY CLEAN SURFACE IN DA BUILDIN'}, WHICH IZ NO HOW ANYBODY IN DA TRADE DOES ANYTINK.
IT CLEARS DA DEBT AN' IT CLEARS DA CREDIT AN' BY DA FOLLOWIN' WEEK DA FORGE IZ LIT AN' DA BOOK IZ FILLIN' AGAIN, AN' DA PARTY HOLDS PAPER ON {EVERY LINE IN IT|DA WHOLE BOOK|EACH LINE OF IT}!

give2_m.text:
